tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅ / /dag yig skor gyi dpe rgyun dkon po 'ga' phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa mru nyig tshom bu/mtsho sngon mi rigs dpeskrun khang /

dpe skrun gsal bshad/dpe deb 'di ni da phan sus kyang lcags par du ma btab pa'i dag yig skor gyi dpe rgyun dkon po'iXrigs te/ 'di'i nang du dpang lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pa'i tshogs gsum gsal ba dang / skyogs ston gyi li shi'i gur khang / zha lu lo tsā ba'i dag yig za ma tog lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rje'i dag yig mkhas pa'i 'byung gnas/ dbyangs can rol ba'i 'o mtsho yi dag yig mkhas pa dga' skyed/ a lag sha'i dag yig gces bsdus 'khrul sbong skya rengs sogs brda dag la nang byan chud pa'i mkhas dbang du ma'i dag —yig skor zhig phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa yin pas/ bod kyi brda dag la slob sbyong dang zhib 'jug byed par nges par du mkho ba'i bklag deb bzang po zhig yin/dag yig 'di par du bskrun par rma lho khul thun rin rdzong tang gi slob grwa'i dge rgan rin chen rgya mtsho dang / nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i zhib 'jug slob ma lcags thar rgyal gnyis kyis bsam pa bzang pos ma phyi mkho sprod gnang bar snying thag pa nas bka' drin che zhu/

dkar chagablo1 gas gsum gsal ba ba( 1gas so// ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷༷ ༷ ༷dpang lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pas brtsams(1)bod kyi brda'i bstan bcos legs par bshad pa rin po che'i za ma tog barmeked pa che)ma byu4 ba bzhugasaXso// ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷༷༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷༷ zha lu lo tsā ba rin chen chos skyong bzang pos brtsams(39)dag yig mkhas pa'i 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs so//lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rjes brtsams/ ༷ ༷ (93)bod kyiXskad las gsar rnying gi brda'i khyad par ston pa legs par bshad pa li shi'i gur khang zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ skyogs ston rin chen bkra shis kyis brtsams(397)dag yig mkhasaXpa dga' skyed ces bya ba bzhugs so// ༷ ༷ ༷ dbyangs can rol ba'i 'o mtshos brtsams (425)dag yig rnams kyi zur 'debs legs bshad mkhas pa dgyes byed bdud rtsi'i mchod sprin rnam dag ces bya ba bzhugs so// ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷༷ ༷ dge 'dun shes rab kyis brtsams/(439)dag yig gces bsdus 'khrul spong legs par bshad pa'i skya rengs gsar ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ a lag sha ngag dbang bstan dar gyisabartsams/(457)
sum bab blo gros ‘

༄༅ / /i swa ste si rnyir stu/ dpal ldan dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsung gi yan lag tshad med pas/ /sna tshogs brjod pa ston mdzad kyang / brjod med chos dbyings legs rtogs pa/ /rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal te/ /tha snyad tshul la 'khru' ba 'ga'/ /mthong bas de rnams bsal ba dang / /don gnyer rnams la phan ched du/ /de tshul phyogs 'ga' bri bar bya//'dir phal cher saṃskṛ ta dang 'brel ba'i yi ge dang ming dang tshig gi tshogs kyi rnam par gzhag pa bshad par bya ba las/ de la dang bor yi ge'i dbye ba brjod par bya ste/ dbyangs ni bcu bzhi gsal byed ni/ /sum cu gsum du mkhas pas gsungs/ /sde ba lnga tshan lnga dngaXni/ /mthar gnas bzhi dang dro ba bzhi/ /dbyangs rnams bcu bzhi ste/ a ā/ i yī/ a spru/ ṛ dzā/ t+pa 'o// e i/ o au'o/ /sde ba'i yiXge ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ho ṇa/ ta tha da rnya na/ pa pha ba bha ma ste sde ba lnga tshan lnga dang / mtharaXganas ya ra la wa dang / dro ba sha ṣa sa ha rnams te/ gsal byed sum cu rtsa gsum mo/ /'o na la yig ni saṃskṛ ta la kṛlha zhes pa las gzhan na med cing /de yang mdog gzhan gyis bkag pasaXn mi dgos so zhe na/ lce mi bde bas ṛ yig '-i ru brjod pa la dpyas pa na/ '-i yig nye bar mkho'o zhes slob dpon chos 'bangs 'chad do/ /'o na lo la ring bo med pas bcu gsum du 'grur ro zhe na/ slobaXdapon bgrod seng ges/ ji ltar rjes zlos byed pas 2

dpyas pa la '-i yig thung ngu yod pa ltar de laXring bo'ang yod do zhes 'chad do/ /gzhan du gsungs rnams rigs kyis na/ /'di rnams nyid du 'dus pa yin/ bzhi bcu rtsa bdun po 'di las gzhan pa brda sprod pa dang sdeb sbyor gyi gzhung la sogs par gsungs pa rnams ni bzhi cu rtsa bdun po 'di nyid duXrigs kyi sgo nas 'dus so/ /gzhan pa'ang ci lha du zhe na/ a i u ṛ bzhi noms la/ /thung ring rlu ta gsum gsum ste/ /re re la yang u data ta/ /a nu data ta/ swa ri ta'o/ /dbyangs kyi yi ge bzhi bo de la so sor re re la thung ru dang ring bo dang p+lu ta zhes pa'i shin tu ring bor bye bas gsum gsum ste/ de gsum re re la'ang u data ta dang a nu data ta dang swa ri ta ste re re la gsum gsum du bye bas dgu dgu'o/ /de yang sna ldan sna med du/ /bye bas bco brgyad rnams su 'gyur/ /dgu bo re re la yang sna ldan dang sna ldad ma yin paXganyis gnyis su bye bas a la sogs pa re re yang bco brgyad du 'gyur ro/ /mtshams sbyor yi ge thung ngu med/ /'-i yig ring bo med pas na/ /lnga bo bcu gnyisaXbacu gnyis so/ /e iXyo au rnams mtshams sbyor gyi yi ge'i ming can yin zhingaXde bzhi la thung ngu med la/ la la ring bo med pasaXbachu gnyis re ste/ bsdoms pas brgya dang sum cu gnyis/ brda sprod pa'i gzhung che ba rnams su dbyangs brgya sum cu rtsa gnyis su bshad do/ /sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas su/ gsal byed rnams ni sum cu bdun/ /'di ni dbyangs yig nyi shu gnyis/ /'di rnams 3

yi ge lnga bcu dgu/ /zhes gsungs pas/ sa i khu ṛ bzhi la thung ngu dang gsum yig gi(nya)rtags kyis mtshon pa'i shin tu ring bo dang / '-i la ring bo med pas gnyis dang /— e i yo yo rnams la thung ngu med pas gnyis gnyis te/ bsdoms pas dbyangs nyi shuXrtsa gnyis so/ /gsal byed ni sngar bshad pa'i spum cu rtsa gsum dang rjes su nga ro'i ming can klad gor dang /rnam par gcad bya'i ming cad tsheg drag dang / lce rtsa can gyi ming can ka dang kha'i steng du 'byung ba'i ḍa ma ru'i rnam pa can ṅka r+ṇa zhes pa lta bu dang / mchu dang nye ba can pa dang pha'i steng du 'byung ba'i glang bo che'i myos bum gyi rnam pa can dzi phi zhes pa lta bu ste sum cu rtsa bdun no zhes bshad do/ /gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde 'ga' zhig tu gsungs pa dang / sbyir yi ges rtsen pa rnams la i aḥ gnyis bsnan pas dbyangs bcu drug ces grags so/ /de rnams las brgya sum cu rtsa gnyis su bye ba ni rnam par bye ba tsam yin gyi rigs bcu bzhi boXlas gzhan pa med do/ /rjes su nga ro ni sde ba'i lnga ba rnams ji ltar rigs par 'dus shing / tsheg drag ni ra dang sa nyid la yin/ de dag brjod pa'i rten a yig ni dbyangs dang bo nyid yinaXno/ /gsal byed la yang k+ṣa ni ka dang sa 'dus la/ lce rtsa can dang mchu dang nye ba can tsheg drag nyid de/ de dag brjod pa'i rten ka kha dang pa pha 'og tu sbyar ba'o/ /spra sgo'i 'grel ba la sogs par bsdu ba'i tshul du ma ni yi ge nyer lnga dang bcu gcig dang bdun du dbyangs rnams dang gsal 4

byed thams cad 'dus shing / de yang u ru 'dus zhes 'chad pa ni snying bo med pa ste/ gsal byed dbyangs su 'dus zhes spra ba ni gyang ri mor 'dus zhes pa dang 'dra'o/ /gzhan yang de na dpyad mi bzod pa mang po snang ste rang bzos blun po mgo bskor ba'o/ /gang yang dpal dus kyi 'khor lor/a i ṛ u '-i zhes pa dbyangs thung ngu lnga dang / ā yī dzā spru '-i zhes pa ring bo lnga dang / de lnga'i rim pa bzhid gyi yon tan a e adra o alnga zhes pa dang / de lnga 'phel ba ā ste ādra yo ālnga zhes pa dang / de lnga'i ya ṇar bsgyur ba thung ba ha ya ra wa la zhes pa dang / de ring ba hā yā rā wā lā zhes pa ste/ dbyangs sum cur gsungs pa ni rnam par gzhag pa gzhan kho na yin pas spyi skad dang mi mthun te/ yon tan dang 'phel ba'i sa yig gsum dang / ā yig gsum rnams a'i yi ge ru 'dus shing / ra la dbyangs med dang ha sogs bzhi gsal byed yin pa'i phyir ro/ /da ni yi ge'i rgyu brjod pa/ brjod 'dod dbang gis rlung g.yos shing / /de yis gnas dang byed pa dang / /rtsol ba bskyed de dadugs dbyung dang / /lhan cig yi ge gdangs rnams skye/ /slob dpon chos mchog gis/ ngag gi don snang ba'i sems pa las brjod 'dod skye la/ de las gnas dang byed paXphrad cing de las sgra skye'o zhes gsungs mod/ gnas phrad par byed pa la rlung yang dgos par gsal lo/ /thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyu'i dbang du mdzad nas/ slob dpon chen po tsan+d+ra go mis yi ge'i mdor/ gnas dang 5

byed pa dang rtsol ba rnams las yi ge rnams skye'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de la gnas bshad pa'i ched du bshad pa ni/ a ku ha ṅka mgrin pa las/ /i tsu ya sha rkan las 'byung / /yīta eta ita rnams mgrin rkan las/ ṛ ṭu ra ṣa spyi bo las/ /'-i tu la sa so las 'byung / /u pu dzi rnams mchu dag las/ /lhata eta yota rnams mchu mgrin las/ /wa ni mchu dang so las 'byung / /rjes su nga ro sna las te/ /sna dang rang gi gnas dag las/ /sde ba'i lnga ba rnams 'byung ngo / /'di rnams btsun pa zla bas gsungs/ /a'i yi ge dang /tsan+d+ra ba'i mdo la sogs par uta'i sde dang bcas pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pas sde ba'i dang bo la dbyangs u yig sbyar bas de'i sde ba go bar brda chad byas pa'iXphyir/ ku ste ka sde dang / ha yig dang lce rtsa can gyis mtshon pa'i tsheg drag rnam 'gyur dang bcas paXrnams ma yin pa las 'byung ngo / /de bzhin du gzhan rnams la'ang sbyar bar bya ste sba'o/ /tsu ṭu tu pu rnams kyis snga ma ltar rang rang gi sde dang bcas pa rtogs par bya'o/ /byed pa bshad pa'i don du brjod pa/ byed pa lce yi rtsa ba ni/ /lce rtsa can gyi yin par bshad/ /lce dbus rkan las 'byung rnams kyi'o/ /lce rtse dang nye steng 'byung ba'i/ /so las 'byung ba'i lce rtse ste/ /lhag ma'i rang gi gnas nyidaXdo/ /zhes pa slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis so/ /lce rtse can gyi byed pa lce'i rtsa baXdang / rkan las 'byung ba rnams kyi byed pa lce'i dadus yin zhes sbyar te/ phyi ma dag kyang de dang 'dra'o/ /steng las 'byung ba ni spyi bo las 6

'byung ba'o/ /dngos su bshad pa'i lhag ma rnams kyi byed pa ni rang rang gi gnas kho na yin pas logs pa med do/ /rtsol ba bshad pa/ rtsol ba nang dang phyi rol te/ /nang gi phye dang btsum pa dang / phrad dang cung zad phrad pa'o/ /phyi rol sgra med sgra ldan dang / /srog chung ba dang srog chen dang / /dro ba zhes bya rnams su bshad/ /rtsol ba zhes bya ba ni byed pa rnams kyi nang du gtogs pa'i yon tan gyi khyad par te/ de yang nang dang phyi gnyis so/ /nang ni nang du 'jug pa'i byed pa'i nang du son pa'o/ /de las bzlog na phyi rol lo/ /bye ba zhes pa ni mgrin pa ma bsdams par brjod pa dbyangs rnams dang bo ba rnams dang sde ba'i gnyis pa dang bzhi ba rnams kyi yin par gsungs shing / de rnams las lhag par bye ba yin pa ita kyi yin pa dang / de dag pas kyang lhag par ches cher bye ba yota dngaXlota dag gi yin la/ de dag pas kyang lhag par phye ba yin pa ā yig gi'o/ /btsum pa ni mgrin pa ma bye ba'i brjod pa ste/ a yig thung ngu'i yin par rnam par gzhag par bya'o/ /phrad pa ni yi ge 'byung ba'i gnasaXde rnams rtsol ba chen pos bcing baXste/ sde ba lnga'i yi ge rnams de lta bu las 'byung ngo / /cung zad phrad paXni/ phrad pa las bzlog pa mthar gnas bzhi'i yin no/ /nang gi rtsol ba bshad zin to/ /sgra med ni mgrin pa bye bas sgra rjes su rtogs par 'gyur ba/ sgra zhes pa'i yon tan 'di rnams la med pa ste/ sde ba'i dang bo dang gnyis pa dang sha dang ṣa dang sa dang tsheg drag dang lce rtsa can 7

dang nye ba can rnams yin no/ /deXlas gzhan pa'i gsal bshad rnams sgra ldan yin par don gyis go ste/ yi ge'i mdo ru sde ba'i gsum pa dang bzhi ba dang lnga ba dang mthar gnas dang rjes su nga ro dang ha yig rnams te ༷mgrin pa btsum pas sgra rjes su rtogs paraX'agyur ba rnams yin par gsungs shing / 'grel bar sgra'am dbyangs zhes pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes 'chad do/ /srog chung ba ni sde ba'i dang bo dang gsum pa dang lnga ba dang mthar gnas rnams te/ 'grel bar srog ces bya ba'i rlung 'di rnams la chung zhing phra bas so/ /zhes bshad do/ /de las cig shos rnams srog ched po ste/ sde ba'i gnyis pa dang bzhi ba dang dro ba rnams yin zhing / 'grel ba snga ma las bzlog pas so zhes so/ /gang yang spra sgo la sogasaXpar/ sal pa pā ṇa gnyis gcig yin/ mahākrāṇa gcig gnyis yin/zhes dang / srog chung ba dang che ba'i dper brjod phaṭa'i ṭa lta bu dang / sde ba'i zhes pa rnams la byas pa ni mi shes bzhin du rang bzo byas pa yin te/slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mi'i gzhung dang 'gal bas so/ /da ni sngar gyi dbye ba 'ga'i ngo bo brjod par 'dod pas smras pa/ thung ngu phyi mo gcig pa ste/ /ring bo phyi mo gnyis pa'o/ /p+luta phyi mo gsum par gsungs/ /rim pa ltar yi ge gcig gi yun du brjod pa dang / gnyis kyi yun du brjod pa dang /gsum gyi yun du brjod pa'o/ /zhes gsungs mod/ /p+lu ta rgyang ring bo nas 'bod pa dang / ngu ba dang / glu len pa la sogs pa la byas pa la yi ge shin 8

tu mang bo'i yun du brjod pa'ang yod do/ /mthon po rnams kyi u data ta/ /yi ge gang nga ro mtho bas brjod par bya ba de ni thu data ta zhes bya ba'o/ /dma' bas sa nu data ta'o/ /yi ge gang nga ro dma' bas brjod par bya ba de a nu data ta'o/ /smra sgor/ lha dat+ta ni mtshungs gnyis gcig /sa nu data ta byedaXcha yin/ /zhes 'chad pa ni snga ma ltar 'khrul ba yin no/ /de dag bar ma swa ri ta'o/ /swa ri ta nga ro mtho dman ma yin par bar mas brjod par bya ba'o/ /rang gi gnas dang sna las byung / sna ldan cig shos de las bzlog /yi ge rang rang gi gnas dang sna las byung ba ni rjes su sna ldan te/sna'i gnas dang bral ba ni rjes su sna ldan ma yin no/ /mthar gnas de lhar gnyis su dbye/ /rjes su sna ldan dang sna ldan ma yin pa gnyis so/ /da ni dbyangs gsal byed ci rigs pa'i bklag thabs brjod par bya ste/'greng bu can dang na ro can/ /ring cha can rnams gnyis yun bklag /shin tu ring rnams gsum yun bklag /lhag ma gcig yun thung ba'o/ /dbyangs rkyang ba'am ki nas bṛ ka zhes pa'i bar gsal byed la zhugs pa'ang rung ste/ e i yo au rnams dang / ā yī sgri dzā rnams ring bo yin pas dbyangs yig thung ba gnyis kyi yun du bklag par bya'o/ /shin tu ring bo slu ta'i rtags can rnams ni gsum gyi yun du bklag par bya zhing / la sogs pas sngar bshad pa lhar ches bsrings te klog pa'ang yod do/ /gzhan sa i yu ṛ '-i rnams ring cha med pa dkyus mar bklag go /i yo 9

dag ni e yo dag /thung ba i kusaXbargyan par bklag /i oṃ zhes pa rgya gar gyi yi ge la kai sha(ral ba)steng na yod pa dang / bod yig la de mtshon pa'i ched du 'greng du dang na ro nyis brtsegs yod paXni e ring cha med pa la es brgyan pa e i zhes pa lta bu dang / yo ring cha med pa la zhus brgyan pa o u zhes pa lta bur bklag cing gnyis yun nyid yin no//da ni gsal byed kyi bklag thabs bstan pa'i ched du smras pa/ gsal byed srog med phyi mo'i mgor/ /brtsegs pa'am tsheg med yar sbyar bklag /gsal byed dbyangs med pa yi ge phyi ma'i steng du brtsegs pa busto zhes pa lta bu dang / snga ma'i yi ge dang tsheg gis bar ma bcad paXphaṭa lta bu yi ge snga ma la sbyar bar bya'o/ /sde ba'i dang bo dbyangs med dza/ /bod kyi ga sogs bzhin yar sbyar/ /sde ba'i dang bo ka la sogs pa dang / dza yig srog med rnams yar yi ge sbyar bar bya zhing / de yang bod kyi ga bzhinaXdu ka dang / da yig bzhin du tsa pa ṭa dang madz+dza zhes pa lta bu dza yig dang / ba bzhin du pa yig bklag par bya ste/ dper na/ ṭhak+ka ra/ gats+tsha/ askyo/ spuji/ablar zhes pa lta bu'o/ /nya ṇa yar sbyar na ltar bklag /nya dang ṇa srog med pa yar sbyar na ni na ltar bod par bya ste/ palca/ tsan+d+ra lta bu'o/ /gzhan sbyar phal cher bod dang 'dra/ /sde ba'i gnyis pa sbyar ba shas chung bas/gsum pa sbyar ba/ asdi/ khudhe/ sabha/ sogs dang / lnga ba sbyar ba/ sasna/ nan+d+ra/asbra sogs dang / ya sbyor ba saṃskṛṭa la mi srid cib / ra sbyar ba/10

rnyarma lta bu dang / la sbyar ba/ kalpa lta bu ste/wa sbyar ba med do/ /sa sbyor bod ltaraX'adod pa'ang yod/ /sa srog med 'ga' zhig ni 'ang zhes pa'i gong ma la yar sbyar ba/ namasgyurāya zhes pa lta bu dang / 'ga' zhig bod dang 'dra ba skaji dang / sha stu dang / bsna dang / spaṣ+ṭha dang / ta sma dang / sa ha sra lta bu'o/ /dza la nya btags 'gya gnyar bklag klog lugs de gnyis rgya gar dbus pa dang kha che'i lugs so zhes gsungs te nges pa yod med phe tshom za'o/ /sha ṣa yar sbyar sa dang mthun/ /ṣa la btags pa gdangs gcig pa'ang / /sha dang ṣa(yig)steng du brtsegs pa yi ge gong ma la sbyar ba na sa dang rnam pa mthun pa tsam ste/ nam:rtse zhes pa dang / kaṣ+ṭikate zhes pa lta bu'o/ /ṣa la yi ge gzhan btags pa steng 'og gnyis ka la skad gdangs gcig tu klog pa yiṣ+ṭa zhes pa dang / ṭān zhes pa lta bu'ang yod do/ /bla ma 'ga' zhig rgya gar lugs la gsal byed kyi/ /yi ge thams cad brtsegs yod pas/ /gcig stong gcig brgya lnga bcu drug /ces pa la sogs pa gsungs pa ni/ tsan+d+ra ba'i mdor yang / ya'i wa la dbye'o zhes ya la yi ge gzhan btags med par gsungs pa la sogs pa dang 'gal bas na cha med kyi rgyus gtam gsungs par zad do/ /ya btags 'greng bu ring cha mang / wa btags na ro gcig yun can/ /yi ge phal che bar ya btags pa ni/ yi ge de dang de la e srog tu zhugs pa lta bu la thung ngu gcig yun du bklag go /de bzhin du/ wa btags pa sa twa zhes pa lta du rnams yo 11

yig gcig yun du bklag par bya'o//da ni de'i dmigs bsal bstan pa/ ka kha ya btags bod bzhin te/ /ra la ya btags ra yar sbyar/ /ka dang kha la ya btags pa ni bod rnams k+kog pa dang tshulaXmathun par bya ste/ shākya saṃkhyaXzhes pa lta bu'o/ /ra la ya btags pa ād+ma zhes pa lta bu ra yig yar yi ge gong ma la sbyar te/ 'og ma ya nyid du bklag go /ra la wa btags pa shin tu shas chung zhing /gal te srid da de bzhin du ste/ kha cig sarba la sarla zhes klog pa mthong ngo / /ra btags phal cher bod gdangs mtshungs/ /ra btags pa phal cher ste/ kra gra za pra bra bhā phra shra sraXhra rnams saṃskṛta la yig pa ni bod kyi klog pa ltar bklag cing / dz+ra zhes pa bod skad la med pa'ang yod do/ /ming thog sde ba'i gsum pa rnams/ 'a yis 'phulaXb lta bur bklag /dbus mthar yod pa bod dang mtshungs/ /saṃskṛta'i skad kyi ming rnams kyi thog ma na yod pa'i sde ba'i gsum pa/ gu ṇa dang / dza na dang / ḍi na dang / dā na dang / badz+ra zhes pa lta bu ni bod kyi tshul la da rnams 'as 'phul ba lta bu/'ga'/ 'dza'/ 'dra/ 'da'/ 'ba' lta dur bklag par bya'o/ /ming gi dkyil na yod pa ga ga na dang / bha dza na dang / wad na dang / arbaṇa lta bu dang / ming gi mtha' na yod pa/ bha ga ga dza/ brdo/ wa da/ gan rnyarba lta bu rnams ni bod kyi gdangs ji lha ba bzhin du/ ga dang dza dang da dang ba nyid du bklag go /yar sbyor ba ma gtogs pa kun 'as 'phul bzhin no 12

zhes smra ba ni 'khrul ba'o/ /bzhi ba rnams ni gsum pa la/ /(ha)sgra cung zad ldan par bya/ gha la sogs pa lnga stug cing byings che ba ha'i sgra cung zad dang ldan pa ste/ 'kha'/ 'cha'/ 'aṭha'/ 'tha'/ 'pha' 'dra bar bklag go zhes gsungs pa ni rgya gar ba'i klog tshul ma gzigs pa'o/ /sde ba gsum pa'i dang bo bzhi/ /ta sde ra btags cha mthun te/ /lce rtse cung zad nang bkug bklag /ṭa'i sde ba'i dang bo bzhi ni ta sde ba'i dang bo bzhir btags dang ldan pa dang cha mthun te/ ta sde'i byed pa lce'i rtse mo yin zhing / ṭa sde'i byed pa lce rtse dang nye ba yin pas na/ sde ba lnga char yang lce rtse cung zad steng du bkug ste bklag par bya'o/ /ṣa yang de dang 'dra ba ste/ k+ṣa ni khya dang cha mthun pa'o/ /ṣa yig kyang spyi bo las 'byung zhing de'i byed pa lce rtse dang nye ba yin pas ṭa sogs dang 'dra'o/ /k+ṣa yig ni ka dang ṣaXyin yang rnam pa 'ol spyo 'dra zhing / ṣa yod pas lce rtse cung zad steng du dgug go /gsal byed lhag ma bod dang mtshungs/ lhag ma/ ka kha nga / tsa tsha nya/ta tha na/ pa pha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha sa ha ste bcu dgu rnams bod kyi gdangs ji lta bur bklag par bya'o/ /rjes su nga ro sde ba la/ /rang rang sde ba'i lnga bar bklag /ya sogs brgyad ni nga ru'o/ /tsheg drag bcad de drag por bklag /klad gor byung na de'i rjes su ka sde byung na nga ru klog pa nas/pa sde byung da ma ru bod pa'i bar rang rang gi sde ba'i lnga bar bod do/ /mthar gnas bzhi dang dro ba bzhi'i rjes su byung na nga nyid du bod do/ /13

rnam par gcad bya ni ming dang mthun par rdum sa rdums te drag por bklag go /lce rtsa can dang mchu can ni/ /aka sapa ces pa lta bur bklag /ṅka zhes pa ka lce rtsa can dang / gra zhes pa pa mchu can dag gi byed pa lce'i rtsa ba yid pas ag ces pa dang / apa ces pa dang cha mthun par bklag par bya'o/ /kha cig yi ge la de 'dra'i yi ge medaXdo zhes gsung ba ni ma bsgab pa'i shes bya la rnam gzhag byed pa'o/ /brjed du mi rung mang dngaXnyung / /brtsams pa rang sgra dran tsam du/ /phral bklag dbyangs ni 'og ma dbang / /'dra gnyis brtsegs pa'am mi 'dra ba'ang / /dus kyi 'khor lo'i rnam bcu dbang ldan dang gdan bzhi'i sgo 'gegs pa'i sa bonaṭ+wālha bu phral te bklag cing / yi ge 'dra ba gnyis brtsegs k+ka zhes paXlha bu dang /mi 'dra ba brtsegs pa t+pa zhes pa dngaX/ sa rte cadang / pisna dang / dat+na zhes pa dang / bra t+pa zhes pa lta bu'ang phral te bklag cing / dbyangs ni yi ge 'og ma'i srog nyid do/ /spyir na dbyangs ltar ngag las bslab/ /yi ge bris pa 'di lta bu yin no zhes pa dang / de bshad pas ji lta ba bzhin shes par mi nus kyi/ mdo dbyangs dang yi ge'i dbyangs slob pa bzhin du legs par slob dpon gyi gsung las 'bad pas bslab par bya'o/ /de yang bod dmas sngags mos pas klog pa tsam yin gyi/ rgya gar ba lta bu'i gdangs shes pa shinaXtu dkon la/ de shes kyang rgya gar gyi skad ma shes na gcod mtshams log pas dan 'dzol bar 'gyur te/ dper na rten 'aprel 14

snying bo la/ yo zhes pa gang zhes pa dang / niro rnya zhes pa 'gog pa zhes pa yin pa la/ yo ni zhes bcad pas mo mtshan gyi ming du 'gyur ba lta du'o/ /des na don yod zhags pa'i gzungs lta bu la yang saṃskṛta'i skad la zhen pa ma byas par sngon gyi lo tsā ba chen po rnams kyis bod skad du rung tshad bsgyur ba de lta du bklags na 'thad par mthong ngo / /yi ge'i tshogs cha tsam bshad zin to/ /ming gi ngo bo bshad pa/ yi ge gnyis sam mang 'dus pa'i/ /don gyi ngo bo rjod byed pa/ /ming yin dod la blo gzhol phyir/ /de yang dngos dang btags pa yin/ /yi ge gnyis 'dusaXnas brjod bya'i don gyi ngo bo rjod par byed pa/ saṃskṛta la ku nes pa/ ka dang u 'dus pas sa gzhi'i ming dang / bod la'ang kha dang ya 'dus pas kha'i du ga'i ming dang / nya zhes pa nya yig dngaX.a 'dus pas sems can gyi bye brag gi ming yin pa lta bu'o/ /yi ge mang bo 'dus pas don gyi ngo bo brjod pa sugata dang / de bzhin gshegs pa zhes pa la sogs pa shin tu mang ngo / /de'i nges pa'i tshig ni/ namaḥ zhes pa phyag 'tshal ba dang byings gcig pas ni phyag gi yul las 'dud pa bo dma' bar byed pa yin pa dang 'dra bar/ (don)la blo gzhol zhing 'bab par byed pas na ming zhes bya'o/ /de la dbye na rnam par gtan la dbab pa bsdu bar/ nye bar 'dogs pa dang / yang dag pa'i dngos can zhes gsungs pa lhar btags ming dang dngos ming ngo /15

de la dngos ming dgos pa dang rgyu mtshan la ma ltos par don de dang de la rgan po rnams kyis btags pa/ bum pa ba lang seng ge zhes pa la sogs pa lta bu'o/ /btags ming ni don ma yin pa la der bod pa/ bram ze'iXkhye'u la seng ge zhes btags pa lta bu'o/ tshad ma rnam 'grel du/ don med na yang 'gro ba yis/ /gang la grags pa'i sgra bkod pa/ /de la de dngos zhes pa dang / /rtag tu dngos dang sgra 'dogs la/ /seng ge bram ze'i khyi'u la/ /de ltar brjod pa'ang 'jig rten yod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de la btags ming la ni/ de dang der 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan dgos te/ rnam 'grel du/ gal te 'dir ni btags 'dod na/ /rgyu mtshan gang gis de 'dod pa/ /de ni dngos po thams cad la/ de dgaXgis rgyur cis mi 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ rgyu mtshan med pa yang 'dogs na kun la 'dogs par thal bar 'gyur ba'i phyiraXro/ /de yang 'dra ba las 'dogs pa/ bram ze'i khyi'u la seng ge zhes pa lta bu dang / rgyu la 'bras bus btags pa/ sangs rgyas 'byung ba bde ba ste/ /zhes pa lha bu dang / 'bras bu la rgyusaXbatags pa/ reg pa'i skye mched drug po 'di rnams ni sngon gyi las su rig paraXbya'o/ /zhes pa lha bu dang / cha shas la tshogs pas btags pa ras yug gi phyogs tshig pa la ras yug tshig ces pa lha bu dang / de nyid tshogs pa la phyogs gcig gis btags par yang 'gyur ba dang / rten la brten par btags pa mtsho ma dros pa lha bu dang / grogs la grogs can gyis btags 16

pa bdun pa dang lhan cig pa'i sems la 'dun par btags pa lta bu yin par gsungs/ rnam 'grel gyi 'grel bar/ dgos pa med pa'i phyir nye bar gdags par mi bya'o zhe na/ ma yin te/ zhes gsungs pa ltar btags pa'i dgos pa dgos te/ de med na 'dogs pa po rtogs ldan ma yin par 'gyur bas so/ /dngos yin pa la gnod byed dgos te/ de med na/ phreng sogs la ni chen po sogs/ /nyer btags las 'dod gang yin pa/ /dngos dang khyad med rnam shes kyi/ /gzung bya nyid phyir nyer btags na/ /zhes pa ltar btags pa ba nyid du mi 'grub pas so/ /smra sgor/ dang bo gzhan gyi ming la ma brten7par de nyid la btags pa ka ba zhes pa lta bu ༷ thogs pa 'dod rgyal ba zhes bya ba dang / de la brtan pa skyes bu brtan pa laXka ba zhes pa lha bu'i ming ni rjes su grub pa'o zhes 'chad pa'ang dngos dang btags ming gnyis su zad do/ /rjes su grub pa la yang don dang ldan pa khyi dkar bo la dung zhes pa lta du dang / 'dod rgyal la khyi nag po la dung zhes brjod pa ltaXdu yod do zhes kyang 'chad pa ni/ ming ji ltar 'dod pa byed la rag go /yang ming gcig don mang 'jug pa dang / /don gcig rnam grangs mang bo can/ /zhes 'don pa ltar/ rim pa ltar/ go'i sgra gcig pus/ ngag phyogs sa dang 'od zer dang / /gas dang mig dang rdo rje dang / /mtho ris chu steXdon dgu la/ /mkhas pas go sgra nges par brtag /ces dpal ldan 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis zhib mo rnam 'thag tu gsungs pa ltar 17

don dgu rjod par byed pa dang / nyi ma gcig pu'i don la yang / nam mkha'i nor bu dang / 'od kyi nor can dang / rta ljang can la sogs pa ming sum cu rtsa bdun 'chi med mdzod du bshad pa lta bu'o/ /gzhad yang pho dang mo dang ma ning gi rtags kyi dbye ba'i ming gsum dang / dbyangs kyi mtha' can dang gsal byed kyi mtha' can gnyis su dbye ba saṃskṛta'i skad la yod de/ rgya cher mngon brjod kyi bstan bcos su shes par bya'o/ /ming gi tshogs tsam bshad zin to// tshig gi tshogs smra bar bya ba'i ched du/ de'i ngo bo dam pa'i chos kyi gzhung du gsungs pa brjod pa/ ming gnyis sam ni mang bo yis/ /don gyi khyad par brjod byed pa/ dam chos mngon par gsungs pa yi/ /tshig yinaXyi ge 'dus pa nyid/ /ming gnyis 'dus pas don gyi khyad par brjod pa sangs rgyas ni skyabs so zhes pa lta bu dang / ming mang bo 'dus pas don gyi khyad par brjod pa chos thams cad bdag med pa'o zhes pa lta du'o/ /de bzhin du 'du byas mi rtag pa'o zhes ming gnyis pa dang / mya nganaXlas 'das pa sdug bsngal thams cad zhi ba'o/ /zhes pa ming mang bo 'dus pa yin te/ de ni chos mngon par gsungs pa'i tshig yin no/ /brda sprod pa po la grags pa'i tshig ni/ ming la rnam dbye brgyad bye ba/ /nyi shuXrtsa bzhi sbyar ba dang / /byings la ti sogs sbyar ba yis/ /rang rang don rnams 'byed pa'i tshig /sgra ba rnams kyi lugs kyis ka lā ba'i mdor/ snga ma dang phyi ma 18

dag gi don nye bar dmigs pa na/ zhes 'byung ba ltar/ rang bzhin zhes bya ba rkyen sbyar bar bya ba'i yul ming dang byings dag la rnam dbye'i ming can gyi rkyen/ tsan+d+ra ba'i tha snyad du supra dang tidra dag dang / ka lā ba'i tha snyad kyi ti sogs dang si sogs dag sbyar ba ni tshig yin te/ brgyad stong 'grel chen du'ang / tshig ces pa ni suphra kyi thams cad dang tidra gi thams cad kyi yi ge tshogs pa'o zhes gsungs so/ /de dag saṃskṛta la rkyen gyi yi ge gang yin pa dang / rang bzhin dang rkyen phud pa'i rnam 'gyur la sogs pa ni 'dir brjod kyang mgo rmongs par 'gyur bas na/ shes par 'dod pa rnams kyis tsan+d+ra ba dang / ka lā ba la sogs par shes par bya'o//'dir bod la nye bar mkho ba'i mingaXl sbyar ba'i rnam dbye'i rnam pa tsam bshad par bya ste/ ngo bo las dang byed pa ched/ /'byung khungs 'brel ba gnas gzhi dang / /bod pa'i don la rnam dbye brgyad/ /re re'ang gcig gnyis mang tshig can/ de la rnam dbyeXdang bo ngo bo tsam ston pa/ shing / me/bum pa zhes pa lta bu ste/ saṃskṛta'i phal che ba la rkyen gyi rdzas yod pas/ 'di dang bo gcig tshig sbyar ba'o/ /zhes bshad mod kyang / bod skad la dang bo'i gcig tshig la de medaXpas/ de dang ming laXkhyad med do/ /dang bo'i gnyis tshig shing dag ces pa ltaXbu dang / mang bo'i tshig shing rnams zhes pa lta bu dag la bod skad la yang ming dang khyad par yod do/ /gnyis pa las su bya ba'i rnam dbye'i gcig tshig dang / gnyis tshig dang / mang bo'i 19

tshig sbyar ba ni rim pa ltar/ shing la/ shing dag la/ shing rnams la rlung gis bskyod ces pa lta bu ste/ rlung gis bskyod pa'i bya ba yin zhing /de'i las shing yin pas bya ba'i las zhes kyang bya'o/ /gsum pa byed pa'i rnam dbye'iXtshig gsum sbyar ba rim pa ltar/ shing gis/ shing dag gis/shing rnams kyis nags tshal mdzes zhes pa lta bu'o/ /bzhi ba dgos ched kyi rnam dbye'i tshig gsum sbyar ba/ shing gi ched du/ shing dag gi ched du/ shing rnams kyi ched du chu drongs zhes pa lta bu'o/ /lnga ba 'byung khungs kyi rnam dbye sbyar ba/ shing las/ shing dag las/ shing rnams las me tog skyes zhes pa lta bu'o/ /drug pa 'brel ba'i rnam dbye sbyar ba/ shing gi shing dag gi shingaXrnams kyi yal ga mtho zhes pa lta bu'o/ /rnam dbye bdun pa gzhi'i don can spyar ba/ shing la/ shing dag la/ shing rnams la bya tshang bcas zhes pa lha bu'o/ /brgyad pa bod pa'i rnam dbye ni/ skyes bu 'ga' zhig ljon shing zhes par ming btags te/ de bod pa/ kye shing / kye shing dag kye shing rnams zhes pa lta bu'o/ /de la shing zhes pa shing yin zhing / la/ gisaXzhes sogs rnam dbye ste/ rlung gis bskyod ces pa nas tshang bzhag ces pa'i bar ni/rnam dbye de dang der gsal bar byed pa'i tshig yin no/ /de lta bu'i rnam dbye rnams ni ming thams cad la sbyar du rung ba yin no/ /de bdun dngos su brjod pa dang / mi mngod byas pa tshig sdud gnyis/ /rnam dbye snga ma bdun po rnam dbye dngos sam/ de bsgyur ba'i yi ge dngos su yod pa dang /20

tshig snga phyi'i bar ma rnam dbye phyis te mi mngonaXpar byas pa tshig sdud gnyis saṃskṛta la yod cing / bod skad la ni rgya skad la tshig sdud du yod pa dzā dzā pu ru zhes pa rnam dbye drug pa phyis pa yod pa la/ bod skad la rgyal bo'i skyes bu zhes rnam dbye drug pa dngos su yod par bsgyur ba dang / rgya skad la don gcig gi khyad par mang bo rnams so so la rnam dbye re re sbyar ba/ dus 'khor gyi gleng gzhir/ sarbarnyitshwanakāyedinakawapuṣe zhes pa/ yi/ ṣe/zhes khyad par re re la rnam dbye gnyis pa'i gcig tshig re sbyar ba yod mod kyang / bod skad la/ thams cad macan la/ ye shes sku la/ nyin byed sku la/ zhesaXrnam dbye mang na mi bde bar dgongs nas mkhas pa 'ga' zhig gis khyad chos kun rjes 'brangs pa'i mjug tu/ lha mchog rnams kyis btud la zhes pa gcig tu bsdus pa yod de/ de la/ legs sbyar skad la nom dbye rnams/ /bsdus pa dbye dang so so ba/ /bsdu dang gzhan du bsgyur ba ni/ /bod la bde ched skabs bzhin bya/ /zhes 'don no//de la tshig sdud rnam pa drug /'bru mang bo dang las 'dzin dang / /ba gnyis pa dang de'i skyes du/ /zlas dbye ba dang grangs med pa'o/ /deXrnams las 'bru mang bo bshad pa/ /tshig gnyis dag gam mang bo rnams/ /don gzhan ston pa 'bru mang bo'am/ /gzhan gyi don zhes bya ba ste/ /tshig gnyis pa'i 'bru mang bo ba ba khra mo can zhes pa lta bu dang / mang bo'i 'bru mang bo ba rtogs pa'i dra ba rnam bsal cing rgya che'i sku mnga' ba/ zhes pa lta bu/21

dngos su brjod pa'i tshig gi don la/ don gzhan rim pa ltar ba khra mo yod pa'i phyogs sam/ bdag po go ba dang / rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas go ba lta bu ste/ tsan+d+ra bar/ gzhan gyi don la gcig ma yin pa'o zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de dag la rnamaXdabye phyis nas tshig sdud byas pa'i tshul ni/ saṃskṛta'i skad las shes par bya'o/ /phyogs kyi ming dag phyogs bral la'ang / /brjod pa las gzhan go ba'i 'bru mang bo bar 'gyur te/ shar dang lho brjod pas me mtshams go ba la sogs pa lta bu'o/ /smra sgor/ rang ming dang ldan pa'i 'bru mang bo ba yod ces 'chadaXpa ni 'bru mang bo ba'i rnam pa go ba yin no/ /de'i tshig mang bo'i 'bru mang bo la gzhi mthun gyi bsdu ba khong na yod pa/ spre'u gnas sa mthon po zhes pa la spre'uXganas sa yang yin la/ mthon po yang yin pa zhes las 'dzin pa'i bsdu ba can gyis spre'u yod pa'i shing dang khang ba sogs go ba dang / tshigaXganyis pa la yang / ba gnyis pa khong da yod pa sa bcu ba zhes pa lta bu dang / smra sgor/ byed pa drug gis bsgyur zhes 'chad pa lhar/ gnyis pa la sogs pa'i bsdu ba khong na yod pa rim pa lhar/ chos la sbyong ba zhes pa'i la bsdus pas chosaXsbyong can dang / chos kyis 'phel ba'i kyis bsdus pa chos 'phel can dang / chos kyi ched du phan pa zhes pa'iXched du bsdus pa chos phan dang / chos las nyams pa la/ las bsdus pas chos nyams dang / chos kyi gtam can la/ kyi bsdusaXpa chos gtam can dang / chos la gnas pa'i la bsdus pa chos gnas zhes pa lta du 22

dang / zlas dbye khong na yod pa/ zab dang rgya che'i sku mnga' ba/ /zhes pa lta bu yod de/ rnam dbye dang bo bsdus pa khong na yod pa las 'dzin pa dang / ba gnyis pa dang / zlasaXdabye'i bsdu ba can lta bu'o/ /smra sgor/ brgya dang drug chu rtsa brgyad du dbye'o zhes 'chad pa ni/ 'ga' zhig brjod byas stong ba yin no/ /da ni tshigs bcad rkang ba gsum pa las 'dzin pa gtan la phab pa/ /khyad par can dang khyad par tshig /gzhi mthun sdud pa las 'dzin pa'am/ /khyad par bsdu ba'i don gcig pa'o/ /khyad par can ut+pal dang / khyad par sngon po dag gzhi mthun par sdud pa/ ut+pal yang yin la/sngon po yangaXyin pas bzal sngon zhesaXpa lta bu ni/ ka khā ba'i tha snyad kyis las 'dzin pa zhes bya ba'am/ tsan+d+ra ba'i tha snyad kyis khyad par gyi bsdu ba zhes bya ba'o/ /de bzhin du paṇ+ḍi ta sdom brtson zhes pa la sogs pa shin tu mngaXngo / /tsan+d+ra bar/ don gcig gi khyad par ro zhes gsungs so/ /tshig sdud gsum pa tshigasaXbacad rkangaXb gnyis pas nges par bya ba/ de nyid grangs dang bgrang bya ni/ /ba gnyis pa'am grangs sngon can/ /de nyid khyad par grangs yin zhing / /khyad par can bgrang bya yin pa thod pa lnga zhes pa lta bu ni/ kalā ba'i brdas/ dīgu zhes pa/ tshig gnyis pa'am ba gnyis la zhes bya ba dngaX/ tsan+d+ra ba'i brdas/ grangs sngon ma can zhes bya'o/ /mdor/grangs dang bo can kun sdud pa la'o/ /zhes so/ /byed pa can gyi de'i skyes bu'i bsdu ba 'chad pa/ ming dang pha rol tshig gis ni/ /gnyis pa la sogs 23

sdud pa ni/ /byed can drug pa'i bsdu ba'o/ /dgag pa'i bsdu ba 'dir mi 'byor ming sngon la yod pa rgyal ba zhes bya ba lta bu dang / tshig sras po zhes pas/ rgyal ba sras po zhes rnam dbye drug pa bsdus pa lta bu/ gnyis pa la sogs pa bdun pa'i bar gyi rnam dbye sdud cing phyis pa de ni byed pa can lnga la 'jug pa'i rnam dbye dang / rnam dbye drug pa bsdusaXpa'i tshig sdud de/ de'i skyes bu'i bsdu ba yin no/ /de la byed pa can drug ni/ byed po las dang byed pa ched/ /'byung khungs gzhi rnams byed can drug /drug brgyad dor ba'i rnam dbye gzhi/ /zhes pa yin no/ /de la byed pa po la 'jug pa rnam dbye dang bo bsdus pa ni/ tshig sdud gzhan yin pas 'dir ma smos shing / las la 'jugaXpa'i rnam dbye gnyis pa bsdus pa/ chos la brten pa la chos brten zhes pa dang / grong la song ba la grong song lta bu'o/ /byed pa la 'jug pa'i gsum pa bsdus pa zla bas snga ba ni zla snga lta bu'o/ /ched du bya ba la 'jug pa'i bzhi ba bsdus pa ni/ rgyan gyi ched kyi gser ni rgyan gser dang / 'byung bo'i ched kyi gtor ma la 'byung gtor lta bu'o/ /'byung khungs la 'jug pa'i lnga ba bsdus pa shing las skyes pa shing skyes dang / yul nas byung ba la yul byung lha bu'o/ /byed pa can ma yin yang drug pa bsdus pa/ rgyal bo'i skyes bu ni rgyal bo skyes bu'am rgyal skyes dang / mi'i mgo la mi mgo lta bu'o/ /gzhi la 'jug pa'i bdun pa bsdus pa/ yul na gnas pa la yul gnas lta du'o/ /tsan+d+ra bar/ byed pa can mang bor ro/ /zhes dang /24

drug pa'o zhes gsungs so/ /dgag pa'i skyes bu ni/ tshig sdud legs sbyar la tshig sdud med na dgag tshig na yig tu gnas shing / yod na a dang an du 'gyur ba de/ bod skad la mi 'byor ba la/ ngos ma zin cing skabs su ma bab pa'i spros pa mang bo byas gnang ngo / /tshig sdud lnga ba 'chad par 'dod pa/ gzhan dang gzhad ni sbyor ba dang / /kun sdud pa la ming gnyis sam/ /mang bo bsdu ba zlas dbye ba'am/ /dang gi don gyi bsdu ba'o/ /ming dbye bu gnyis gnyis sam mang bo rnams la ming re re la rnam dbye re re sbyor dgos kyang / thams cad kyi tha mar rnam dbye gcig sbyar bar bsdus pa ni ka lā ba'i brdas/ zlas dbye dang / tsan+d+ra ba'i brdas/ dang gi dod gyi bsdu ba'o/ /de la dbye na gnyis te/ cig shos dang cig shos sbyor ba zhesaXbya ba/ ming gnyis kyis bsdus na rnam dbye gnyis tshig sbyor ba/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal dang / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dag ces pa lta bu dang / sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dud rnams zhes pa lha bu mang bo sdud na mang tshig sbyor ba yan lag gtso bor byas pa dang / gnyis dang mang bo gang gis bsdus kyang gcig tshig mjug tu sbyor ba/ rkang ba dang lag pa ni zhes dang / tshangs pa dang brgya byin dang khyab 'jug dang dbang phyug ni zhes pa lta bu/ tshogs pa gtso bor byas pa kun sdud pa zhes bya'o/ /tshig sdud drug pa ni/ gang gi snga ma brjod byar gyur/ /mi zad gyur pa'am grangs med pa'o/ /mi zad pa'i grangs med pa zhes pa don ston pa'i ming 26

yin yang / rtags gsum gyi nges pa med pa de las rnam dbye rnams dbyi ba sngon gyi lo tsāXb rnams kyis tshig phrad ces bya bar ming btags pa de snga mar bkod cing / de brjod bya'i gtso bor gyur pa'i tshig sdud ni/ ka lā bar/ mi zad par gyur pa zhes dang / tsan+d+ra bar/ grangs med pa zhes pa'i sdud pa ste/ upakum+bha zhes pa'i ub nyer bsgyuraXnye ba'i don can gyi mi zad pa ste/ tshig dang bo na yod pa gtso bo yin pa lta bu'o/ /tshig sdud noms niXrgya skad la rnam pa gsal zhing / de'i skyes bu'i rnam dbye bar drug bsdus pa bod skad la'ang rnam pa cung zad gsal lo/ /tshig sdud ni drug po de las gzhan pa med kyi de rnams nyid du 'dus so/ /tshig sdud min pa tshig sdud du/ /bshad dang tshig sdudaXnyid yin yang / /yang yang bzlas pas go dka' ba/ /tshul 'dis rnam dbyer shes par bya/ /smra sgor/ lce khyi 'brug gis brtsams pa'i gnas brgyad bstan pa zhes pa'i rjes su 'brangs te/ 'bru mang bo dang tshig sdud dang / /khyad par dag dang yan lag dang / /gzhi dang gzhi gcig bsdu ba dang / /gdi mthun pa dang de'i skyes bu/ /zlas dbyeXb dang phyogs tsam mo/ /zhes 'chad pa tshig sdud yin zhing dgosaXpa rnams sngar bshad pa rnams su 'dus la/ la la ni bzlas te bshad pa dang / sgra ba'i lugs kyi tshig sdud ma yin pa'ang 'ga' zhig yod pas rnam par bye ste brjod par bya'o/ /de la dang bo 'bru mang bo ba ni brjod zin pa yin no/ /gnyis pa tshig sdud ni sngar bshad pa de rnams kyi nang du grangs med kyi 26

bsdu ba ma gtogs pa'i tshig sdud thams cad 'dus pa yin zhing / de rnams so so'i ming gi rnam grangs sbyar ba smra sgo nyid kyi 'grel ba na yod do/ /de la yang gzhan gyi tshig gi bsdu ba zhes bya ba 'azu mang bo ba bshad zin pa zlos pa'i skyon can no/ /gsum pa khyad par bsdu ba ni/ las 'dzin pa yin zhing tshig sdud lnga'i ya gyal bye brag gi tshig bsdu ba zhes pa'ang yin pas zlos so/ /bzhi ba yan lag bsdu ba ni sogs kyis bsdus pa gzugs la sogs pa'i phung bo zhes pa la sogs pa go rim gye yan lag bsdu ba la sogs pa bzhi 'chad pa ni/ phung bo gang rnams kyi dang bo gzugs yin pa de rnams zhes pa la sogs pa'i tshig rnam par)sbyar ba 'jug pas 'bru mang bo'i tshig sdud yin zhing / logs su byas pa dgos pa med do/ /lnga ba gzhi bsdu ba yang tha dad du mi dgos pa de nyid dang 'dra'o/ /drug pa gzhi gcig tu bsdu ba yang drug por ma 'dus pa'i tshig sdud min zhing / de la tshig sdud yod pa ni sngar gyi de nyid du 'dus te/ 'dus byas thams cadaXmi rtag ces pa ni/ las 'dzin pa dang / 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas thams cad bdag med ces pa ni/ zlas dbye khong na yod pa'i las 'dzin pa yin no/ /bdun pa gzhi mthun pa ni/ bye brag gi tshig bsdu ba dang / khyad par bsdu ba nyid bzlas pa yin pas las 'dzid pa nyid do/ /brgyad pa de'i skyes du ni/ tshig sdud lnga'i ya gyal byed pa'i tshig dang / bye brag gi dngaXrnam grangs kyi mig sdud nyid yin pas logs su mi dgos so/ /dgu ba zlas dbye 27

ba ni sngar gyi brgyad por ma 'dus shing sgra ba la grags pas dgos mod bshad zin to/ /bcu ba phyogs ston pa sems tsam zhes pa lta du'o zhes 'chad paXni nun sprul kho na ste/ tsam gyi skad dod/ mātra ni tsan+d+ra ba'i mdor/tshad la mātra'o/ /zhes gsungs pas de phan gyi rkyen yin pas na sems tsam zhes pa ming gcig yin zhing / ming gcig la bsdu ba med pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar don med pa mang bo bkod cing / don dang ldan pa rnams kyang yang yang bzlas te bshad pas 'jug pa po rnams mgo rmongs par byed par snang ngo / /de bzhin phrad min phrad du dang / /phrad kyang logaXpar 'chad pa'ang dbye/ /gang yang phrad du 'chad pa na/ /gang zhig rang gi don med cing / /zhes mdor bstan nas rgyas par ston pa na phrad 'di don 'di snyed cig la 'jug go zhes 'chad pa ni blun pos kyang 'gal bar rtogs so/ /spyir phrad ces pa ni/ a mār ko ṣar mi mad pa/ zhes ming btags pa rnam dbye sbyar ba'i yul du gyur pas ming gi nang du gtogs pa de las rnam dbye dbyi ba kho nar 'gyur ba zhig saṃskrota la yod cing / de 'dra'i 'jug pa rnams mngon brjod kyi bstan bcos na rgyas so/ /des na phrad rnams la rang rang gi brjod bya'i don med pa ma yin no/ /des na byut+pati chen po dang / smra sgor phrad dang phrad ma yin pa ci rigs par 'dres paXbris snang ngo / /de la gang dang ci dang de nga 'di rnams ni phrad min pas de rnams las rnam dbye dbyi bar nges pa med do/ /na zhes pa ni/ dus gcig na 28

zhes dang / kun dga' ra ba na zhes dang / 'di yod na 'di 'byung zhes pa laXsogs pa mang bo zhig rnam dbye bdun pa yin zhing / bsdoms su na zhes pa la sogs pa 'ga' zhig legs sbyar la skad dod med pa la lo tsā bas bla thabs su bsnan pa yod de/ de mdor bsdu na zhes dang / yin grang na zhes dang / lha yang phyag 'tshal na zhes dang / don dam par dbyer med na zhes dang / byang chub thob par bya na zhes dang / gang gi tshe na zhes pa lta bu la sogs pa'o/ /de rnams kyi don 'di lta bu'o zhes 'chad pa ni/ na nyid nus pa ma yin gyi/ snga phyi'i tshig rnams kyi nus pa yin par yin no/ /te dang nus ni k+ta'i rkyen gyi mtha' na bsgyur ba yin na/ phyag 'tshal te bshad par bya'o/ /zhes dang / grub pa kun tu macan pa sman/ /'gro ba'i bla mar phyag 'tshal nas/ /sgra yi mtshan nyid brjod par bya/ /zhes pa lta du niXbyed pa po gcig gis bya ba gnyis byed pa'i snga ma la sbyar ba'o/ /de la gzhan pa'i te zhes pa ni/ tshig mtshams gcod pa'i ched du bla thabs su bsnan pa ste/ nas ni/ mdzod nas nor 'byung zhes pa lta bu rnam dbye lnga bar yang 'gyur ro/ /dang zhes pa 'byid pa zlas dbye'i don dang / sdudaXpa yang dang 'dra bar 'chi med mdzod du'ang bshad do/ /rgyu mtshan dang tshe skabs dang gdamis ngag la 'jug pa 'di lta bu'o zhes rtags 'jug gi rjes su 'brangs te bshad pa'i dang yig rnams ni/ skad dod med pa la lo tsā bas bla thabs su byas pa yin zhing / don de dang de ni tshig snga ma rnams kyi nus 29

pa yin gyi/ dang gi nus pa mid te/ gzhan du'ang de ltar ci rigs par shes par bya'o/ /ni zhes pa/ de la gzugs ni zhes pa lta bu bkar zhing dmigs 'dzin pa ste/ tu dang hu bsgyur ba'o/ /yang dang kyang zhes pa gong ma'i rjes 'jug gi stobs kyis mi 'dra ba ste/ don gzhan sdud pa/ 'gal 'bras la yang zhes pa dang / 'gal rgyan du 'gyur ba/ smra ba bcad kyang sred pa 'chang / /ces pa lta bu'o/ /kho na zhes pus mi ldan pa gcod pa dang /gzhan dang ldan pa gcod pa dang / mi srid pa gcod pa rnams gzhung chen po dag tu gsungs so/ /nyid ces pa ni/ e waXzhes pa/ lo tsā ba 'ga' zhig gis kho na dang / 'ga' zhig gis nyid du bsgyur bas kho na dang 'dra zhing /dngos po'i rkyen du 'gyur ba/ sra ba nyid ces pa lta bu ming ni cha shas yin pas phrad ba yin no/ /tsam zhes pa'ang de bzhin te sngar bshad zin to/ /'ba' zhig ces pa phrad med pa'i ming yin no/ /yang dag dang / yongs su dang / kun tu dang / rabaXtu dang / rnam par dang / nye bar dang / shin tu la sogs pa la don stod pa med do zhes 'chad pa ni nyer sgyur gyi 'grel bar ma gzigs pa'o/ /tshul zhes pa'ang tshig phrad ma yin zhing / cis kyang ming de dag la 'jug pa rtsi na/ rnam bshad rigs par/ tshul gyi sgra ni bden pa dang / /lam dang 'brel 'byung rigs pa dang / /des 'byed cha dang spru ngan 'da'/ /thabs dang rigs pa nyid yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar shes par bya'o/ /bzhin zhes pa ni/ ka khā bar/ nya bar 'jal ba la 30

wati'o/ /zhes pa de phan gyi rkyed yinaXzhing / des na ming giXcha shas yin gyi/phrad min no/ /bzhin gyi bshad pa la de bzhin dang de lta bu zhes pa skad dod gcig la 'gyur mi 'dra bar byas pa dag dang / de bzhin nyid la 'chad pa ni rnam par 'khyams pa'o/ /cing / zhing / shing zhes pa rjes 'jug gi yi ge dang bstun te byas ni phrad ma yin gyi/ lo tsā bas tshig gi 'jog mtshams la bla thabs su byas pa'o/ /la zhes pa rnam dbye gnyis pa dang bzhi ba dang bdud par 'gyur bas skabs brtag la shes par byaXzhing /la lar tshig gi 'jog mtshams la bla thabs su byas pa'ang yod do/ /gzhi dang tshe skabs la byas pa'i la ni bdun pa nyid yin par ma mkhyen par snang ngo / /kyi dang gyis dang las zhes pa rnam dbye drug pa dang gsum pa dang lnga ba yin pas phrad min zhing / de lta mod kyi zhes pa dang / ta thā pi zhes pa bsgyur ba ni phrad gzhan yin gyi a pa'i nus pa min no/ /nas lnga ba la 'jug pa/ kha gdangs nas nyal zhes pa lta bu ni sngar bshad zin to/ /mig nas lus kyi bar zhes pa lta bu ni/ bar zhes pa'i don gsal b.raXbyed pa bla thabs su byas pa'o/ /gtsug lag khang du dang / khyams su dang /spyi bo ru dang / lag par zhes pa rnams bdun pa yin pas phrad ma yin no/ /du zhes pa ming gi phung bo rnams ni du shes pa lta bu ni grangs ci tsam dri ba'o/ /gtsug lag khang du zhes pa lta bu ni rnam dbye bdun pa'o/ /'o la sogs pa sgar sdud pa'o zhes gsungs kyang rjes 'jug bcu yo yig dang 31

ldan pa ni rdzogs tshig dang mtshams gcod pa la bla thabs spu byas pa'o/ /'am zhes bya ba 'byed sdud yinaXzhes gsungs kyang / yang na dang 'dra bar rnam par brtag pa yin no/ /dag dang rnams ni mang bo'i tshig ces gsungs kyang/ sngon gyi lo tsā ba chen po rnams kyis byut+pa ti chen por/ dag gnyis tshig dang rnams mang tshig tu mdzad mod/ phyis gnyis dang mang bo la'ang dag byas par chog par snang ngo //sogs ni phrad ma yin gyi ming yin zhing / don gzhan gcig dang gnyis dang mang bo sdud pa yin no/ /pa zhes pa don mang bo la 'jug ste/ chos byed pa la chos pa dang / rtog ge shes pa'am smra ba la rtog geXb dang / rta zhon pa la rta ba zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ /can zhes pa/ blo gros can zhes pa lta bu ldan pa'i don can yin mod/ ming gi mjug yin pas phrad ni ma yin no/ /'ga' zhig tu 'bru mang bo'i tshig sdud gsal bar byed pa la sbyar ba'ang yod de/ ba khra mo can zhes pa lta bu'o/ /ba spyir bzhag pa'iXdaper ma brjod la/ za ba/ lta ba/ nyal ba zhes bkod pa'ang / de dang de'i bya ba brjod pa yin gyi/ byir bzhag pa mi gsal lo/ /phrad 'di yin zhes pa'i ngo bo dang 'jug pa 'chi med mdzod kyi don sna tshogs pa'i sde dang mi zad pa'i sde na yod cing / slob ma la phan pa'i le'u drug pa na'ang yod pas de dag tu shes par bya'o/ /phrad 'dus pa zhes 'chad pa ni/ brjod byas stongaXbs mgo rmongs byed/ gzhan yang phrad 'dus pa zhes pa gang la zhes pa'i ga dang la sbyar te/ gal zhes pa 32

dang / ci zhig na zhes pa te na zhes par 'gyur bas gal te na zhes par 'gyur ro/ /zhes 'chad pa ni shin tu mi bzad pa'i rdzun gyi nyan pa bo mgo rmongs par byed pa ste/ gal te ni/ saṃskṛta la yadi zhes pa dang tseta zhes pa yodaXpa bsgyur ba'i ming gcig yin pas na gal dang te bye ba'i bshad pa ni rgyal ba zhes pa la rgyal dang ba bye ste bshad pa dang 'dra'o/ /de bzhin du tarnyi zhes pa'o na zhes par bsgyur ba la/ 'o zhes pa dang na zhes pa'i phrad 'dus pa'o zhes bris pa dang / a ho zu ta ces pa dang a tha zhes pa bsgyur ba'i 'on te na zhes pa 'on dang te dang na rnams phral te 'chad pa dang /gal te/ ci te/ 'on te/ de te zhes pa la/ gal dang / ci dang / 'on dngaXde zhes pas dmigs mi 'dzin pa dang / te rnams kyis dmigs 'dzin no zhes 'chad pa— dang / 'on kyang zhes pa la/ 'on dang kyang phral nas 'chad cing / 'on zhes pa yang sdud pa'i tshig yin zhes bris pa dang / gang ltar dang ci ltar dang de lhar zhes pa la sogs pa'ang phrad gnyis yin zhes 'chad pa dmas ni brjod byas stong ba brjod pas don du gnyer ba rnams mgo rmongs par byas pa yin no/ /de'i phyir smra sgo ni rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi tas brtsams pa ma yin gyi/ bod kyi paṇ+ḍi ta skyes thob kyi shes rab dga' tshad yod pa/ mkhas par rlom pa blo gzu bo zhig gis legs legs 'dra byas par snang ngo / /de'i 'grel bar ga dang ha'i sgra ldan pa na stobs che ba zhes bde spyod kyi mdo las 'byung ngo / /zhes bkod pa yang rdzun lung yin te/33

brjod bya de sgra'i lugs la med pa'i phyir dang / rjod byed de sgra'i mdo'i tshig gi rigs ma yin pas so/ /'di rnams smra sgo'i 'khrul ba che long tsam smos pa ste/ 'di rnams kyi'ang rgyu3mtshan zhib pa dngaX/ 'khrul ba gzhan rnams brjod da shin tu mang bar 'gyur bas 'dir ma bris so/ /tshul des na smra sgo bod du dar phyin chad byung ba'i skad gnyi sa smra ba rnams kyis kyang /ka lā ba dang / mngon brjod amār koṣa la sogs pa la chos skad chagaku pa dang gzigs rtogs chud pa'i slob gnyer ma mdzad pa—sa smra sgo'i mtshang ma shes par de'i tshigs bcad bde mos bslus te/ bstan bcos tshad ldan du bsams nas bsdus don dang ṭīka la sogs pa'iXcha lag mdzad snang ngo / /mkhas pa'i mkhas pa shong ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi phyag rjes rnams las rjes su dpags na macan par gsal mod/ ches che ba'i mkhas par gyur nas yun ringaXbo ma bzhugs pas rnam gzhag mdzad pa mi snang ngo / /bdag nyid chen po de'i legs par bshad pa'i bka' drin la sa bdag gis tsan+d+ra ba la sogs pa'i gzhung mgo mjug la lta rtog chud pa tsam du gyur pas smra sgo'i mtshang rnams rig nas smras pa'o/ /pod kyi dag yig ces bya ba/ /sngar gyi slob dpon du ma yis/ /shin tu mang bar mdzad pas na/ /'khrul gzhi gsal byed kha cig brjod par bya'o zhes pa lhag ma'o/ /ska cog la sogs pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyis che cher mang ba mdzad pas na phal cher brjod mi dgos shing / thud mong ma yin pa'i 'khrul gzhi can 'ga' zhig 34

bdag gis bri bar rgya'o/ /de la rgya gar gyi skad du rat+na zhes dkon cog dang rin chen zhes par sngon gyi brda rnying 'ga' zhig la'ang yod pas de ltar byas na legs mod kyang / dkon mchog tu byas te/ dkon pa dang mchog gi don can du 'chad pa la de dag gi skad dod med cing / de bzhin du rin chen zhes par byas te/ rin thang che ba'i don du 'amad pa la'ang skad dod med do/ /'on kyang grags tshod che bas gang mos ltar bya'o/ /ka tham zhes pa bsgyur ba dri ba dang / rtsod pa 'dzugs pa la 'jug pa ni/ ci lhar zhes ca yig can yin zhing / ya tha zhes pa bsgyur ba dper ston pa laX'ajug pa ni/ ji ltar zhes pa steXja yig can yin no/ /skad cig ces pa dus thung ba brjod pa la/ skad ces da yig mtha' rten du byas pa ni skad cig 'don pa'i yun tsam mo zhes 'khrul ba mthong bas/ da'i rjes 'jug dngaX/ gas 'phul ba gnyis ka med par bya'o/ /skye rgu zhes pa la/das 'phul ba dgu zhes grangs brjod pa dang 'dra bar byas pa ni grangs su 'khrul te/ kha cig gis skye dgu ni/ zla ba dgu nas skyes pas mi yin zhesaXdang / la las 'dod khams das shi nas khams gsum so sor skye ba gsum dang / de bzhin du gzugs khams dang gzugs med khams nas shi ba'ang de bzhin yin pas dgu'o zhes 'khrul ba mthong bas na/ ra la ga btags pa rgur bya'o/ /sa'i mjug tu shes zhes par byas pa ni/ skabs 'gar/ shes par 'khrul ba bdag gis myongaXbs grub pas na/ sa'i 'jug tu zhes zhes 35

par bya'o/ /sems pa zhes pa la dpa' zhes par byas nas dpa' bo'i don can du 'chad pa'ang dpa' bo'i skad dod med pas pa rkyang bar byas na legs so/ /tshul 'di gzu bo'i blos dpyad nas/ /mkhas pa'i gzhung gi rjes 'brangs te/ /'khrul ba bsal nas legs bshad pas/ /shes ldan legs bshad dga' ston mdzod/ /gtsug lag rnams kyi tshig dang don/ /rang rang gzhung bzhid mi shes kyang / /'chad cing yi ger 'god byed pa'i/ /mkhas rlom chu shing snying bo 'dra/ /des na gzhan zer grags pa dang / /gang zag 'ga' yi rtogs spangs nas/ /dag yangs gzu bo'iXblos dpyad de/ /chos don snying bo blang bar bya/ /byis pa'i shes rabaXnyam chung zhing / /gzhung rnams dpyis phyin ma bslabasaXpas/ /'diXl 'khrul ba ci mchis pa/ /mkhas pa rnams la bzod par gsol/ /'di yi dge bas 'gro ba kun/ /'gro la gnod pa kun spangs nas/ /byang chub spyod mchog kun spyad de/ /kun tu bzang bo myur thob shog /tshogs gsum gsal ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/ lung dang rigs pa'i dbang phyug dam pa/ dpal stag sde ba seng ge rgyal mtshan zhabasaXkyi bka' drin las lung dang rigs pa'i tshul gyi blo'i snang ba phraXmo rnyed cing / de nyid sras kyi thu bo lo tsā ba rnams kyi rgyal mtshan gyi tog lta bu/ shong ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi legs par bshad pa'i srol dang / de'iXsras dam pa bla ma lo tsā ba mchog ldan legs pa'i blo gros la sogs pa'i bka' drin las tha snyad gtsug lag rnams kyi rnam pa cung 36

zad tsam mthong ba dpal ldan blo gros brtan pa zhes bya bas/ blo gros dang brtson 'grus kyi stobs kyis rgyal ba'i bstan pa la khur 'dzin cing / dam pa'i chos ston pa'i dga' ston gyis gdul bya rnams kyi yid tshim par ༷mdzad pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gzhon nu seng ge zhes bya ba'i gsung gis bskul te/ mkhas pa du ma byon pa'i gnas e chos 'byung ba'i gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba legs par grub pa'o/ /legs par bshad pa phul du byung ba 'dis rgyal ba'i bstan pa dang lus can ma lus pa mtha' dag la che cher phan par gyur cig maṅga lo/ rtag brtan chos sde chen por par du brkos/ /('di'i ma phyi ni bris ma zhig yin pas yig nor yod nges na'ang 'ol tshod kyis bca' ba'i spobs pa ma mchis/ de rang sor bzhag yod pa la klog mkhan dag gis dgongs dpyod mdzod)37
༄༅ //bod kyi brda'i bstan bcos legs par bshad pa rin po che'i za ma tog bkod pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so//zha lu lo tsā ba rin chen chos skyong bzang pos brtsams/

༄༅//rgya gar skad du/ su bhā ṣi ta t+na ga raṇ+ḍa skru ta nā ma sto ṭa su saṅga ta shā stu/ bod skad du/ bod kyi brda'i bstan bcos legs par bshad pa rin po che'i za ma tog bkod pa zhes byaXb/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi gsung zer cha tsam gyis kyang seng ge(khyab 'jug)'phrog byed(dbang phyug)nor gyi gnyen(tshangs pa)sogs kyi/ /gzhung lugs kun da'i tshal rnams zum mdzad gser mngal can(tshangs pa)dang dpal mgrin la(dbang phyug)sogs(brgya byinaXdang khyab 'jug dang kun drug du dang lus ngan dang tshogs bdag sogs)pa/ /'jig rten 'di na che bar rab grags lhaXmachog kun gyis gang gi zhabs pad la/ /gus pas btud pa'i lha mi'i bla ma zas gtsang sras pos rtag tu dge legs mdzod/ /de sras thu bo 'jam pa'i dpal/ /'jig rten dbang phyug la(phyag rdor sogs)sogs pa'i/ /bstan pa sdud mdzad sems dpa' che/ /rnams la'ang gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /nges par rgyal ba'i 'phrin las pa/ /gangs can khrod pa'i bla ma mchog /sasto ṭa zhes rab grags pa'i/ /bstan pa sdud mdzad(dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i 'grel chen khri nyis stongab las sdud pa po rnams kyis jeg pa gsum bod kyi yul du ni bod skad kyis bris zhes gsungs pas 'di sdud pa por bstan gsungs)zhabs la 'dud/ /mkhan po 'di yis mdzad pa'i brda/ /gsung rab bde blag rtogs pa'i sgo/ /blang dor gsal bar ston pa'i tshul/ /'bad pa du mas baspub par rigs/ /mkhas pa du mas mang bshad kyang / /thams cad brjod par mi 40

nus pas/ /'di ni 'khrul gzhi can gyi brda/ /('khrul gzhi med pa rnamasaXkyang skad kyi 'jug pa shes pa'i phyir bstan na'ang skyod med mod kyang de dag ni go slaXb dang 'dir yi ge nyung ngur bya ba'i phyir ro)sdom la/ rkyang pa/ (sngod 'jug dang mgo gsum med pa'i)'phul can/ (ga dang ba ma 'a'i)mgo can no/ /(ra la sa'i)re re'ang(bod kyi lugs)gsal byed tha ma(a yig go)dang / /i u e yo ya ra la/ /wa yig rjes 'jug bcu yis brgyan/ /dper na(ka yig la sngon 'jug mgo gsum med pa/ gsal byed tha ma dang dbyangs bzhi dang ya ra la wa dang rjes 'jug gis bye ba'i brda sde) slobaka ba ka tadaXka ra dang / /ka ma la(pad+ma ma)dang ka pa la/ /( thod pa'i snod)ka lā pa gnas ka lpa dus/ /(dus kyi bskal ba la 'di lhar byed pa lo tsā ba ma snye ṭīs te jo nang lo tsar grags pas skad sor bzhag yin pa'i dbang gis mdzad de 'gal ba med do)ke ke ru dang keng rus dngaX/ /ka la piṅka ko ba dang / /glang chen thal kar yungs kar za/ /krog krog sgra skad lham krad dang / /'on kyang khro kyisaXlcags kyus btab/ /kye kye kyal ka klan ka spongs/ /shing kun sman yin mang tshig kun/ /ko'u shi ka(ko'u shi ka ste mkhas paXsogs mang po la 'jug go)sor bzhagaXsgra/ /kyi hud kla klo dud 'gro klu/ /klad pa klad kor(stod kor sogs kyang mtshon)klad kyi don/ /'byam klas mtha' klas chu klung du/ /rus krang(krong nger bsdad pa sogs)skyil krung bcas klog 'don/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sku 'byam klas/ /༷41

'dir ni ka ye bod pa'i tshig /〈likhang ba khams bde khon 'dzin med('di rnams la sngon 'jug dang pha la ra btags spang bar bya'o)khong khro khron pa khra bo mdog /khrag khrig khri grangs sha khrag dang / /khrung khrung khral 'jal seng ge'i khri/ /go khrab ri mo'i khram kha dang / /sna khrid tshul khrims khris 'jags dang / /khru gang khyel yod khrun ring gos/ /khrums stod khrums smad('di gnyis skar ma'o)khrag khrug dang / /('thab krol dngadeb cha 'dzings pa)khrus bya khro bo dur khrod khros/ /chu khrems khrom nas khrol tshags nyos/ /lcags kyi sil(romaXmo'i bye brag)khrol khre ni 'bru/ /'dir ni khā ni 'dab chags so/ //lhagrong khyer grangs med grags pas khyab/ /chos grwar grul dum grib gnon bsrungs/ /grub thob rim gro gral rim bzhin/ /grib dang grib ma'i gnod las grol/ /grung bo(rig pa)gros mkhas gru(skar ma nam gru'ang ngo)nang zhugs/ /grang ba'i nad med shin tu grims(rigs pa sha skud paXsorgas) rtsemo'i gra ma(shing gra ma)'bru yi gro/ /ngam grog(gcong rong)gron can(zas gron che)grod pa can/ /ral gri gos kyis gril zhes grag /grum bu'i nadaXkyis grongs pa 42

chibs pa cha de chu zheng gab/ /chu bo dar gyi chud po dang / /rin poche dang 'bru yichen//rgyal po'i chad pa myosa'agyur chang //nga jo bo ja sigs ji snyed dang / /ji skad ji srid ji ltar dang / /ji cherasong nas jag pa byas//nga 'di dmas la ma mya spong bar stonanyon mongs can gyis nya sha nyos//nga gtsug tor dkon cog ta la la/ /sgron me dang ye shes sgron me zhes pa la'ang 'jugating 'dzin rgyal po me tog dang //mu tigachun po ting shags dang //lo tog ta la'i 'dab ma til/ /sletres tig tas nan tan du/ /yon tan rin chen tog phyir mchod//tug ring tug chom tog tog sgra//rtag tu nan tur shin tu byas//rgyab tu gal te pha rol tu//brtags te bstan te legasabastarate//stsal to gyur to phyin to sogs//44

nga jigajiga'adul ba las 'byungalham gyi sgra skad do//'dzishing drung drang srong drang bor bzhugs/ /ma drosaklu'i rgyal po ma drosapa la'angamatsho ru g.yung drungabarnyes//phyi dro snga dro'i dus drugasmin drug sogasatu//dri ba kun gyi dris lan 'debs//drag po drag shul nor gyis dregs//gzhan dring mi 'jog dril bu dang //dri mchogadra badra byed dang //bka' drin dran dang dred lpags dang //dre'u rngog dang dri mas sbags//drod dang drob sa la drud/ /khrims sogs dralalcam dralala'angangodang zas drangs drongs//tshem grub dang ni thal bas drags//ya rabs dra ma la sogs pa//da yig ra btags can du bri//nga pang pa'i par busnadapa wa sangs/ /gcig pur pir gyis pi lngang bris/ /pu shu'imada' yabapu shudabyapi pi lingadrod sman/ /praphabame long sogs lastag gipags pa sogs//45

phyog('di rnams la 'phul yig sogs spang)/ /phra ma phrag dog phrag pa(lus kyi)dang / /phran tshegs brgya phrag mi pham mgon/ /phra zhib rdul phran phrug gu dang / /tshig phrad rgyan gyi phyang phrul phyal(grod pa'i zhes pa'o)/ /phyang nge ba dang phru ma(mngal gyi zu ma dngadamarga gi phru ma btabaces pa'o)dang / /phru ba shur bu phre'u(ska rags kyiXbye brag)dang / /phyogs bcur tsan dan bye ma 'thor/ /gnas su phyin dang shugs nas phyung / /phyag dar 'gro don phyad par byed/ /phyag tu byed phul nor gyis phyug /mi gtsang phyi sa phyi rol dor/ /()byin rlabs gnas su bla bre bres/ /byi brun sa yi dong du brubs/ /brag ri'i byang gi bram ze rnams/ /yi ger bris la bsod stoms brims/ /byes nas byon la byug pa byin/ /byisaXpas bran gyi bya ba byos/ /brang(lus kyi brangayang ngo)'gro'i dug rnams byams pas thul/ /bre yis bshar ba'i bye mas brab/ /byad dang byur rnams byabasaXpas byer/ /byol song byag mkhan shin tu brel/ /bro gar bro bor(mna' bskyal ba'i ming)bro nad(mig nad kyi mi)dang / /chu brug(chu brugapar snang)pa dang bru ba tsha(stogasapa'o)/ /thabs bral 'dam byeng brang nger snang / /rin chen byu ru byi la dang / /bla ma'i bla dwags bde blag46

rlobs/ /mngon rlom rlam sems rlom pa can/ /kha rlangs rlon pa rdul du rlog /rlung gis dgra bo rlag par byed/ /khung bu'i rlubs dang mdoms kyi rlig //lhashar phyogs shel gyi gnas shig na/ /'dab chags shang shang shis khar shi /shul du shing zan gyis shes 'dzer/ /shes ldan sham thabs shur dus bcings/ /shed du shed bdag shed las skyes/ /shun lpags dang ni shubaXbus zlos/ /snye ('di rnams kyang sa yig sngon 'jugamed pa'i sde tshan yin)sangs rgyas sor mo se mo do/ /sil sil sgra ldan sil snyan dang / /sen mo zangs mdog so rnams dkar/ /'od srungs sras bcas lam srang du1 /sra mkhregs srid pa srul bo'i phyir/ /srin po lus srul tshe srog za/ /rnams la'ang srod dang sa sros tshe/ /drang srong lam srol brtse bas ston/ /dud 'gro sram dang sreg pa sogs/ /yid srubs('di 'dodapa'i ming yin la srub shing srub thag sogs kyang ngo)las byung sre nag rnams/ /ye shes mes sreg srab mor mdzad/ /ces pa rkyang ba'i brda bye brag tu bshad pa ste rnam par bcad pa dang po'o/ /49

na ma sasto ṭā ya/ /de yang 'jam dbyangs sprul ba yis/ /(rtags kyi 'jug pa las)pho yi yi ge 'ba' zhig la/ /sde ba byed dang brgyad gnas pa'ang / /sde tshan lnga ru dril byas la/ /pho dang ma ning mo dang ni/ /shinaXtu mo dang bzhi bzhi ru/ /sde ba bzhi ba yan chad dbye/ /lhag ma bcu bzhi gnas pa la/ /tsa sogs gsum ni(tsa tsha dza dang)ca sogs(ca cha wa dang)sbyar/ /wa ni ba dang sbyar bar bya/ /lhag ma drug ni(zha za 'a ya sha sa dang)mo ru sbyar/ /ra la ha ni mo gsham ste/ /ma ning mtshan med ces kyang bya/ /zhes gsung de yang 'di ltar dbye/ /phyogs su lhung ba nyi shu dgu/ /(ayig)sum cu ba ni phyogs lhung med/ /ka ca ta pa tsa rnams pho/ /kha cha tha pha tsha ma ning / /ga ja da ba dza wa zha/ /za 'a ya sha sa rnams mo/ /nga nya na ma shin tu mo/ /ra la ha ni mo gsham mo/ /mo gsham dang ni shin tu mo/ /gnyis kyang mo las gzhan du min/ /(yang de nyid las)mo yi yi ge'i nang nas ni/ /'jug pa'i yi ge bcu dbyung bya/ /ga nga da na ba ma 'a/ /ra la sa rnams rjes 'jug go /'jug pa bcu yi nang nas ni/ /sngon 'jug yi ge lnga dbyung bya/ /ga da ba ma 'a rnams so/ /sngon 'jug yi ge lnga bo la/ /pho dang maXning mo dang ni/ /shin tu mo dang bzhi ru dbye/ /ba dang ga da 'a dngaXm/ /rim pa bzhin du sbyar bar bya/ /de dag re re'ang bzhi byed de/ /gang la 'jug byed gang gis byed/ /ji lhar 'jugaXbyed ci phyir byed/ /pho ni pho dang mo laX'ajug /mo ni mo dang ma ning la'o/ /ma ning yang ni pho mo la'o/ /shin tu mo ni ma ningaXdang / /mo dang shin tu mo 50

nyid la'o/ /zhesaXpa'i tshig kyang 'di ltar dbye/ /ba yig sngon 'jug('dir yang ka ga sa gsum rkyang brtsegs gnyis ka 'phul/ ra la gnyis brtsegs pa kho na 'phul gzhanarnams rkyang ba kho na 'phul lo/ /makas pa dag gis kyang brtsegs pa'aphul ba ba las med ces bshad do)pho yid pas/ /ming gzhi'i pho yig ka ca dang / /ta tsa(bzhi dang)mo yig ga da zha/ /za sha sa na ra la'o(dgu la'o)/ /mo yig 'a ni ming gzhi yi/ /mo yig ga ja da ba dza/ /maXning kha cha tha pha tsha/ /ma ning ga dang da gnyis ni/ /pho mo'i yi ge la 'jug ste/ /ge ni pho yig ta ca tsa/ /mo yig da zhaXza ya sha /sa nya na dang bcu gcig la'o/ /da ni pho yig ka pa dang / /mo yigaXg nga ba ma la'o/ /ma yig 'phul byed shin tu mo/ /de ni ma ning kha cha dang / /tha tsha mo yig ga ja da/ /dza nya nga na bcu gcig la'o/ /mi 'jug pa ni 'di dag ste/ /(sngon 'ardug)pho(ba yig)ni( ming ga'i'i)maXning(kha cha tha pha tsha rnams)la mi 'jug /(sngon 'jug)mo('a yig)ni pho(ka ca ta pa tsa rnams)la 'jug pa min/ /ma ning(la cha tha pha tsha)rang(ming rgazhi'i gad gnyis po sngon 'jug gi ma ning yin pas)la rang mi 'jug /rang gi sde dang phrad pa na/ /(sngon 'ardug)pho(bayig)yang (ming gzhi'im yig lha bu)mo la 'jugaXmi 'gyur/ /(ga da gnyis po)ma(sngon 'ardug gi)ning(yin pas ming gzhi'i phomo la spyir 'jug kyang rang sde dang phrad pa'i tshe/ ka dang nga gnyis ming gzhi'i phoXmo yin kyang gsami 'phul/ ta dngan gnyis das mi 'phul ba sogs shesapar bya'o)mo yang de bzhin no/ /ji ltar 'jug par byed ce na/ /pho ni drag po'i tshulaXgyisaXte/ /ma ning ran par 'jug pa yin/ /mo ni zhan pa'i tshul gyis 'jug /shin tu moXni mnyam pas so/ /(sgra drag zhad bar mgasum dang sgra mnyam par 51

'byung zhes pa ste/ dper na bkas drag gda' ran/ 'ga' zhan/ mkha' mnyam zhes pa lhagu)ci phyir 'jug par byed ce na/ /pho ni(ba yig)'das dang gzhan bsgrub phyir/ /(gos bkab lam bstan lhabu'o)ma(gad)ning gnyis ka da ltar(gzhon nu chos la gzhol/ dga' bas dgod)ched/ mo ni bdag dang ma('byang bar 'gyur/ 'byung /)'ongs phyir/ /shin tu mo ni(ma yig)mnyam(mkhyen pa mnga' mnyam par gzhog mngon sum mjal)phyir ro/ /zhes pas sngon 'jug gtanaXl phab/ /da ni de dag so so yi/ /brda yi 'jug pa bstan pa'i phyir/ /rim pa bzhin du spro bar bya/ /thog mar(sngon 'jug gipho)bas 'phul bshad pa la/ /rkyang 'phul dang ni brtsegs 'phul lo/ /ka ca ta tsa ga da zha/ /za sha sa(bcu bo)rnams rkyang 'phul te/ /dper brjod rim bzhin bstan par bya/ /gnang bkag('gro ba bkagasogs ni)stongadaXbakang(thugs dam bskang sogs)bkad sa(zas kyi g.yokhang) dang / /lag pa bkan dang gos sogs bkab/ /bka' bsgo logs su bkar ba dang / /khal dang khral dang srad bu bkal/ /dum dur bkas dang mdun du bkug /srog bkums pa dang(mang pos bkurasogs)bkur ste dang / /(khu/ 'byid pa'i)sman bku ba dang(khu ba btonapa'i sman)bkus te bor/ /bde la bkod dang zur du(snod spyad sogs bkol ba)bkol/ /bcings pa'i bkyigs dang pho nya bkye(sprul ba bkye 'od bkye lha bu)/ /rnam bkra bkra shis bkrag mdangs can/ /rgyal pos bkrabs dang me tog bkram/ /khral sogs(dgongs pa bkral)bkral dang khrid pa'i bkri(gzhanagyis bkri bar mi btub lta bu)/ /52

khrus kyis bkru bkrus dadul ba'i bkren/ /ltogs pa'i bkres dang bsad pa'i bkrongs/ /mdud pa dgongs pa bcings pa bkrol/ /mdo sde bklags sogs bas 'phul ka'o/ /bza' bca'(dam bca' dang khrimasabaca' sogs)zhabs kyis bcags pa dang / /lag tu bcangs(norabacangs pa sogs)dang shing sogs bcad/ /nyes pa bcabs dang mig sogs bcar/ /nor bcol khrims bcas phyir bcil dang / /bcing bas bcings dang nang du bcug /bcud led(rasanang du zas kyi bcud sogs)nang du bcum pa dang / /bcu dang bzhi bcu lnga bcu dang / /dgu bcu(bcu tshan bzhi bo'adil bas 'phul yodapayin no)dang ni chu bcuXdang / /bco lnga bco brgyad bcom ldan 'das/ /dgra bcom bstan bcos ras bcos du(bcosam langa' ngo)/ /las bcol la sogs bas 'phul ca'o/ /ming btags blos btang spyir btang dang / /ri bo btang bzung btang stoms dang / /sa bon btab dang gdan btings dang / /sngags btu kun las btus dngaXbatud(zhabasal btud sogs)/ /rung ba'i btub dang dgra bo btul/ /skom gyiXbatung ba byes su bteg /da sogs ba yis 'phul ba'i ta/ /dmar ba'i btsag dang(tshags kyis btsags zhes pa'angango)bka' btsan dang / /lcags kyi btsa'aXdang nor sogs btsal/ /bu btsas ko btsas(gru btsas la btsas kyang)btsan dug dang / /'tshir ba'i bcir dang shing sogs btsugs/ /nang du btsud dang btsun pa dang / /btsun mo mig btsums 63

gos btsems dang / /btso blag mkhan(tshos mkhanano)dang btso ma'i gser/ /ngan pa'i btsog(rderga btsog kyang)dang sgogaXbatsong dang / /tshos kyi btsod dang btson du bzung / /zong du btsongs dang tshos kyis btsos/ /de rnams tsa yig bas 'phul can/ /lam bgags pa dang gad mo bgad/ /sad pa'i bgam dang gegs byed bgegs/ /bgo ba bgos dang dus sogs bgyangs ('gyangs zhes pa'ang 'thad)bya ba'i bgyi dang byed pa'i bgyid/ /byas pa'i bgyis dang grangs kyi bgrangs(bgrang phreng 'angango)/ /mig sogs bgrad(bsgrad ces pa'ang 'azad)dang rgan pa'i bgres//gros byed bgro sogs(bgro gleng lta bu)bas 'phul ga'o//bdag gzhan bdag po bda'('ded pa'i bda' ba dang bda' ded byed pa)ba'i zas/ /mdun duXbadar dang phyugs sogs bdas/ /bdug spos(shug pa sogs)bdud dang bdud rtsi dang / /grangs kyi bdun dang blom pa'i bde/ /bde gshegs bden gnyis bdog pa'i nor/ /( gzhu bdungs zhes pa'ang bas 'phulayin no)dar ba'i bdo sogs bas 'phul da'o/ /gnas su bzhag zin(nang khrolabazhag kyang ngo)gad mo bzhad/ /bzhabs nas 'gro dang bzhams bsgo byed/ /brlan pa'i bzha'(bzher ba dang)dang skra sogs bzhar/ /grangs kyi bzhi dang de bzhin nyid/ /skar ma me bzhi groXbazhin dang / /byiXbazhin dpang po'i che bzhi(grangs kyi bzhi min no)dang / /byad bzhin mar bzhu stan— la bzhugs/ /'byon bzhud bzhun(nor bzhunaXgayog 64

banud sogs)dang stan las bzhengs/ /dgongs bzhed zas bzhes 'o ma bzho/ /bzhon(rta sogs)pa zhon sogs bas 'phul zha'o//bza' ba(bza' mi dang rgyaXmobaza' bal mo bza' sogs)bzang po bzabs nas(gzabs zhes kyang 'thad)sbyin//zas bzas myos pa'i bzi ba dang / /gtum pa'i mi bzad lag pas bzung / /lhung bzed(rnod kha bzed pa'ang)bzod zhalaXbazo bo dang / /bzod pa tshogs bzums gcig tu bklums/ /gzungs sngags bzla bzlas mya ngan bzla/ /mi bzlog pa dang g.yul bzlog sogs/ /za yig sngon du ba zhugs can/ /sdig bshags bshang gci chosaXsogs bshad/ /bkod pa bshams dang bre la bshar/ /chus bshal gsad bya'i bshas dang ni/ /mkhar sogs bshig dang ko lpags bshus/ /bsher mal byed dang mdza'aXbashes dang / /bshes gnyen g.yo ba'i bsho ba dang / /g.yos pa'i bshos dang lha bshos dang / /phyi bshol la sogs bas 'phul sha'o/ /tshogs bsags dri mas sbags pa bsangs/ /sems can bsad dang drin lan bsabs/ /bsam pa bsam bya bsams pa dang / /bkag pa bsal dang dmigs bsal dang / /mdun nas bsu dang dri bsung dang / /ri dwags bse ru ko ba'i bse/ /nor bsogs bsod nams bsod snyoms dang / /bsod pa'i zas sogs bas 'phul sa'o/ /de rnams rkyang ba brtsegs pa yi/ /saXr la rnams 'phul tshul ni/ /rim 55

pa bzhin du dgod bya ste//ro bska ba(a ru ra'i ro lta bu)dang kha bskangs(ma tshang ba)dang / /chu bo bskams dang yul gyis bskal(bskaladonasha za'ang)//bskal ba dus yin sbas pa'i bskungs/ /byug pa bsku bskus yan lag bskums/ /'phrin dang dbang bskur chos la bskul/ /drin gyis bskyangs dang bskyad du med(dpag tu med)/ /'jigs las bskyabs dang snod mi bskyam(lhung bzed mibaskyam zhes pa lta du)/ /slar yang bskyar dang gnas su bskyal/ /'phos pa'i bskyas dang nor bskyi(bskyisapa'ang)dang / /bskyin pa 'jal dang 'khyil ba'i bskyil/ /gcom bsgyungs pa dang bya ba bsgyungs/ /brjedaXpa'i bskrud dang bya ba bskyur/ /sems sogs bskyed dang mi bskyod dang / /bskor ba gos bskon rgyal sar bskos/ /gnas nas bskrad dang zas la bskru/ /bskyed pa'i bskrun dang rta la bskyon//de rnams bas 'phul sa mgo'i ka'o//mna' bsgags pa dang bya ba'i(dngos gzhi)bsgang / /bu ram bsgar dang 'phrad du bsgugs/ /bag chags bsgo bsgos bka'aXbasgo dang / /gcig tu bsgongs dang ting 'dzin bsgoms/ /seng ge rnam bsgyings kha dog bsgyur/ /chos bsgrags chu bsgral phyogs gcig bsgrigs/ /bsgrin mi phod dang 'od sogs bsgribs/ /blo bsgrims baspub bya baspun mi nus/ /(bya ba)bsnyub pa rigs bsgre rgyal mtshan bsgrong / /gzhan gyis mi bsgul srad bu bsgril/ /gan rkyal bsgyel sogs bas 'phul sga'o//sdug bsngal spang phyir dge ba bsngo/ /bsngags pa brjod dang kha dog 56

(rnam par bsngos pa'i 'du shes zhes)bsngos/ /zhes pa bas 'phul sar btags nga'o /rgyu mtshan bsnyad dang phar la bsnyabs/ /phan tshun bsnyams dang thang la bsnyal/ /lhang bzed bsnyigs dang phyir bskrad bsnyil/ /na ba'i bsnyun ('in zhes pa nad kyi ming yin la'adi ni tsha ba'i snyun gyis bsnyun zhes pa lta du ste na ba'i ming ngo)dang rjes bsnyegs dang / /'jigs pa'i bsnyengs dang bsnyen bkur dang / /dge bsnyen bsnyen gnas bsnyen rdzogs dang / /zas bsnyod bsnyon tol (bston can bston dor canasogs kyang)nas sogs bsnyor/ /zhes sogs(yo byadabasnyangs pa zhes pa'ang ngo)ba yis 'phul ba'i snya'o/ /bste stang bstang(mdor bsdus rgyas dang sangs rgyas kyi/ /bstang bas yongs su ma bzung dang zhes pa'o)bas ma bzung dang / /sna bstad pa dang 'gro chas bstad/ /bstan bcos dang ni gzhan la bstad/ /byin len bstabs dang bste gnas(ngal gso ba'i gnas)dngaX/ /thung ngu bstungs dang slar yang bstud/ /gzhung dang bstun(bya ba bstun pa sogs)dang bzabs pa'i bstar/ /'phya ba'i bsteng dang bstod pa byed/ /mngon par bstod dang mkhas pa bsten/ /de sogs bas 'phul sa ta'o//stan la bsdad dang nyes pa bsdams/ /bsdu bya bsdu ba phan tshun bsdur/ /mdor bsdus pa dang phan tshun bsdebs/ /grabs kyi bsdogs dang nyer bsdogs dang / /phyogs gcig bsdoms dang srog dang bsdos/ /gzhan 57

la bsdigs sogs bas 'phul sda'o/ /mang du bsnan dang phyag tu bsnams/ /gnad(brdzun)dang mtshon dang nu ma bsnun/ /srol sogs bsnubs dang(brdubs zhes kyang ngo)dus sogs(gong 'og sogs)bsnur/ /gong 'og bsnol dang bsnor ba sogs/ /bas 'phul sa la na btags pa'o//bzod bsran yon po bsrang ba dang / /bsrabs pa'i sa dang bya ba'i(mi blo bsral can zhes pa)bsral/ /nor bsri ba dang yud du bsring / /bskur ba'i bsrings dang bsrung ba dang(bgergas sogs)/ /dulaXb ma yin mi bsrun dang / /gcig tu bsre dang bsreg bya dang / /ring bsrel dang ni 'chang ba'i bsrel/ /me la bsro dang bsro khang sogs/ /bas 'phul sa la ra btags pa'o/ /gyen du bslang dang slong mo bslangs/ /skyon gyis ma bslad bslab bya dang 1 /zla la bslan dang bslu ba med/ /la sogs ba yis 'phul ba'i sla/ /nor('di bya ba dang 'brel bas bas 'phul yod)brku ba dang brkus pa dang / /'dod la brkam dang sa brko brkos(bya bdang 'brel)/ /sra brkyang dang ni yan lag brkyangs/ /la sogs bas 'phul ra mgo'i ka'o/ /brgal(brgal brtag kyang ngo)lan brgya phrag brgyad cu brgyad/ /brgyud mar 'byung(bla ma brgyudapa'angango)dang rgyan gyis brgyan/ /dran med brgyal dang dbyug pa brgyab1 /'o brgyal chu bo las brgal dang / /'phreng sogs brgyus dngaXmyur du brgyugs/ /58

smra ba'i(khas brgya bar zad ces bka' yang dag pa'i tshad ma las bshad cing / ding sang yang zhab brgya byas zhal brgyas zhes sogs 'phral skad la snang ngo)brgya dang lam brgyags dang / /spyo ba'i brgyad sogs bas 'phul rga'o/ /btsas ma brngas pa bas 'phul rnga'o/ /lhun po ltar brjid gzi bajid can/ /brjid chags brjed nges(dran pa mi gsal ba)brjed byed dang / /mi brjed gzungs thob brjodaXbya(brngod pa'ang ngo)dang / /phan tshud brjes sogs bas 'phul rja'o/ /gzugs brnyan sgra brnyad rnyan pa'i gos/ /(gzhan la)brnyas thabs spangs pas bdud rtsi brnyes/ /g.yas pa'i brnyas sogs bas 'phul rnya'o/ /kun brtags mtshan nyid legs par brtags/ /brtag dpyad gnas brtan mi 'gyur brtan/ /glo bur brtad pa('dul ba nasabartad pa las byung ba'i gos zhes dang brtad pa las byung pa'i spang kung bshad)ba sa sems ngartas('di gnyis la 'phul med rtas dang nud zhes pa'ang 'thad)/ /brtun(rtun kyang 'thad)pa bskyed dang brtul zhugs dang / /spyi brtol can dang snag sogs(bu ga)brtol/ /ljon shing yongs 'du sa brtol sogs/ /ba yis 'phul ba'i rta yig go /go byed brda dang chal brdab dang / /gri sogs brdar dang chal mar brdal/ /brdung bya brdungs dang gzhan la brdeg /brdeg 'chos la sogasaXbs 'phul rda'o/ / bsam pa'i brnag pa(bkas bcad chen mo'i mjug tu rang gi brnag pa rdzogs par 69

bya phyir dang zhes bshad do)bzod pa'i brnag(bzod dka'ab la brnag bka' ba zhes pa'ang yod)/ /zas kyis brnangs dang nan tan brnan/ /brnab sems mdun du brdu ba dang (mdun du 'then pa'i ming)/ /sbas pa'i banogs sogs bas 'phul rna'o/ /brtsad cing brgal nas brtsam bya brtsams/ /mkhar sogs brtsigs dang snying brtse ba/ /khang brtsegs ha cang brtsengs(rtsengs zhes pa'anga'azad)pa'i gos/ /bgrang ba'i brtsis dang legs par brtsis brtson 'grus brtson pa brtse ba can/ /bas 'phul ra la btags pa'i tsa'o/ /nor gyis brdzangs dang srog chags(zan bajis pa dang rdog pas)brdzis/ /gzhan gyis mi baji srin por brdzus/ /ral ba gyen brdzes brdzun tshig smra/ /de sogs rdza yig bas 'phul can/ /bcom brlag yul du dgra bo brlag /rtsub tshig brlang bo chu yiXbarlan/ /lus kyi brla sha byin gyis brlabs/ /gdon gyis brlams(bskyod pa'i)dang ya ma brla(snying bo med pa'i don)/ /dul ba'i brling sogs bas 'phul rla'o/ /blta bya dang ni gosaXsogs bltab/ /sku bltams yon tan du mas bltams(bang ba'i don te gtamasaXzhes pa'ang 'thad)/ /bltos sa bltos chos balhar rung bltas/ /bas 'phul la mgo ldan pa'i ta'o/ /bldag pa bldag dang mur ba'i bldad/ /la sogs lda yig bas 'phul bzhed/ /ces pa bod kyi brda'i bstan bcos legs par bshad pa rin po 60

che'i za ma togaXbakod pa las/ ba yig gi 'jug pa bye brag tu(pho ni'adas dang gzhan baspub phyir zhes pa'i 'jug pa gtso bor)bshad pa ste nom par bcad pa gnyis pa rdzogs so//de nas ga dang da gnyis kyi/ /'jug tshul rim pa bzhin du ste/ /ca nya ta da na tsa zha/ /za ya sha sa'i yi ge rnams/ /gas 'phul bcu gcig tuXbazhed dper/ /yid la gcags dang gcadaXbya'i shing / /gcan gzan sgra gcan la gcan pa/ /gcam bu'i tshig dang gcal du bkram/ /grangs kyi gcig dang gcin gci ba('di gnyis drichu'i ming)/ /yid gcugs khon gcugs spun zla gcung(rjes skyes)/ /gcud la bor dang rtsad nas gcun/ /phag tu gcur dngaXlag pa gcus/ /spun gyi gcen(sngod skyes so)dang gcer bu dang / /gces 'dzin gces spras dum bur gcog /nad gcong shing gcod gros gcom dang / /gcom bsgyungs la sogs gas 'phul ca'o//glang sogs gnya' ba'i gnya' shing dang / /bka'(btsan pa'i)gnyan(sabadag)gnyan nad dud 'gro gnyan/ /grangs kyi gnyis dang gnyug ma gshis(gnas lugs)/ /bshes gnyen dpung gnyen rtsa lag gnyen(nye du'o)/ /spang bya'i gnyen po rdzas kyi gnyer(bcol banyer ba sogs)/ /gnyid nyal khro gnyer nang khrol gyi/ /gnye ma la sogs gas 'phul nya'o/ /gtang bya'i rdzas dang lag tu gtad/ /(dus)gtan du bsamaXgatan gtan tshigs dang / /(sgo glegs sam sgo gtan)gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin 61

dang / /brdung gtag dang ni gtang rag dang / /sbyin gtong gtor ma me tog gtor/ /gdams pa'i gtams dang nor gyi gter/ /grangs kyi gtams dang gleng ba'i gtam/ /nor gyi gta' ma(gteng baXdang gta' zhes kyang zer te 'dul ba las gta' nyis rir blang bar bya'o zhes pa lha bu)khrag gtar dang / /zabs kyi gting dang nun pa gtibs/ /zad pa'i(de dag yongs su gtugs pa dang)gtugs dang gzhan la gtugs/ /gtun bus gtunaXshing dum bur gtubs(gtub pa'ang)/ /khro ba'i gtum dang gtum mo(rlung)dang / /se gol gtogs dang khongs su gtogs/ /lha chen gtogs 'dod gzhan la gtod/ /'bem la gtod dang dmigs pa gtod/ /ri bo'i gtos(lto ba ri yi gtos tsam bkres pas nyed)mnyam gas 'phul ta'o/ /ming gdags(gdags pa'i bstan bcos)gdangs snyan(gdangs can gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs te)bsnyung ba gdangs/ /gdan la bzhugs dang sa bon gdab/ /gdam nga byed dang(ding sang 'dam ka byed zer)gdams ngag ston/ /skas kyi gdang du gos 'gel gdang / /zhe sa'i gda' dang gding ba stan/ /gdug pa can dang gdung bsaXgadungs/ /sku gdung(bang ba'i gdung zhes pa'ang mtshon par bya ste shes par bya'o)gdung rgyud gdung 'dzin dang / /sor gdub gdub kor gdu bu dang / /mchod rdzas gdugs dang nyin mo'i gdugs/ /rnyed la gdu dang gdul bya 'dul/ /srang la gdeg dang gdeng thob dang / /byad kyi gdong dang gdod ma nas/ /gdon bgegs gdol ba(rigs ngan pa)62

gdos pa 'dzin(gru'i dar bo 'dzin pa'i ming)/ /de sogs da yig gas 'phul can/ / bung ba ltar gnag gnang ba mdzad/ /chos kyi gnad dang mkha' yi gnam/ /gna' dus gnas mal gnong mi bkur/ /gnod byed gnod sbyin grib gnon gdon/ /zil gnon la sogs gas 'phul na'o/ /khrag 'don gtsags bu gtsang sbra dang / /dri gtsang khang dang chu gtsang sogs/ /mche ba gcigs dang gtsug lag dang / /gtsug tor spyi gtsug gtsubs shing dang / /gtsub stan gtsub las me 'byung dang / /gtser pas gtses dang gtse ba dang / /gtso bo laXsogs(yul gtsang dang chu gtsang bo dang mi rgatsang bdang gtsigs che ba sobs kyang ngo)gsaX'aphul tsa'o/ /rnam gzhag dran pa nyer gzhag dang / /mnyamaXgazhag lus kyi cha shas gzhang / /gzhan dag gzha' tshon('ja' tshon no)gzhar yang lta/ /gzhal bya gzhal med khang bzang dang / /kun gzhi rnam shes gnas kyi gzhi/ /brtag gzhig gzhibs pa(khu ba 'jib pa)bsgrigs pa'i ming / /nyon mongs gzhil sbad chos la gzhug /gzhung lugs yid gzhungs gzhur med('od zer can ma'i mdo las 'byung)dang / /mda' gzhu pags pa'i g.yang gzhi dang / /'tsho zhing gzhes(dus kyi gzhes kyang)dang gzhogs slong(sbo gzhegs)dang / /lag na gzhong thogs(shing gi gzhong ba sogs)gzhon nu dang / /dgra bo gzhom dang chos la gzhol/ /la sogs zha yig gas 'phul can/ /63

tsher ma gzang ring gcan gzanaXdang / /zas kyi gzan dang rdul gzan dang / /gzan stan gzan cheXstan gyi gzar(phying gzar srin gzar sogs)/ /dgang gzar blugs gzar gzar bu dang / /gzar thag(rgos kyi gdangs bu'i mi)bla gos phrag par gzar/ /ri gzar gza' skar gzi mdangs dang / /brdeg par gzas dang gzi brjid dang / /gzi 'od dang ni nor bu gzi/ /stag gzig spyad gyis gzigs nas gzims/ /gru gzings drang ba'i gzu bo dang / /gzugs can snying bo gzugs brnyan dang / /gzugs su rung dang gzungs sngags dang / /gzungs btab(dra'o drub bo gzungs btab po zhes pa lta bu)gzung 'dzin dge la gzung / /ma brtags(bab col spra ba)gzu lums gzegs(gzegasama'ang ngo)zan dang / /gzengs bstod sdod gzeb 'od gzer dang / /shing sogs gzer dang drin du gzo/ /rko ba'i gzong dang gzod ma'i dus/ /bsgo ba rnar gzon(bslababya la mi nyan pa ste 'dul ba'i brda)byas chud gzon/ /de sogs ga yis 'phul ba'i za'o /dud 'gro g.yag dang dpal gyi g.yang / /g.yan pa dgab dang g.yab mos g.yabs/ /skyi g.ya' ba dngaXlcags sogs g.ya'/ /g.yar ngo(bcol ba'i ngo)g.yar khral g.yas phyogs dang / /drug dmar g.yu dang g.yung drung dang / /g.yul ni 'khrug dang 'bru yi las/ /g.yung mo(rigs ngan pa)rnam g.yeng log g.yem dang / /mi brtson g.yel dang g.yo sgyu dang / /sa g.yos g.yog 'khor g.yon phyogasaXdang / /g.yang sa mi g.yo g.yor mo(gru la btsugs 64

pa'i shing dar dang bcas pa zhig gi ming)sogs/ /ga yis ya yig 'phul ba'o//dum bur gshags dang(gshags 'byed pa'ang ngo)rol mo gshang / /'gab kyi gsham dang mo gsham dang / /chos lugs gsha' ma yin du gsha'/ /gshin rje gshed po zhing sa gshin(mnyes gshin pa zhesapa'ang ngo)/ /gshis lugs sbod pa'i gshung ba dang / /gshe bar byed(la 'thab pa)dang song ba'i gshegs/ /brlan gsher 'dab gshog(shing gshog pa'ang)dma' ba'i gshong / /yur ba'iXgashor(brel gshor dang 'phrang la gshor sogs kyang )dang thong gshol(gshol mda'a'adzin kyang ngo)te/ /de sogs sha yig gas 'phul ldan//kha gsag gsang sngags gsad bya dang / /snyan gsan 'bebs dang srog chags gsa'/ /gsar bu 'od gsal ral ba gsigs/ /ne'u gsing 'khar gablol dum bur gsil/ /gsung rab gnyis med gsung bas gsungs/ /gson lus gsog gsobaXgaso dka' dang / /gsong bor smra dang sba bya gsong / /srogaXchags gsod dang gsog 'jogaXdang / /snyan du gson dang 'begs byed gsor/ /gsol ba 'debs sogs gso ma'i ras/ /la sogs sa yig gas 'phul can/ /ka ga nga dang pa ba ma/ /das 'phul drug tu bzhed de dper/ /lce rtse dkan(rkanazhes kyang 'thad)sbyar kha dog dkar/ /dkar chag(tho yig)dka' thub dka' tshegs dang / /dka' 'grel dku klum dku skabs phyin/ /(dri)bsnam na rab dku dkon cog dkor(rdzas kyi ming)/ /dkyil 'khor dkyil 66
