dang dkyus(dkyus ma dkyus sogs)ring dang / /kun nas dkris dang(nyon mongasakyi ming)gos mi sa ba kris/ /bstan pa dkrugs dang(gong 'og dkrugs pa zho dkrugs sogs)rol mo dkrol/ /dkrongs bskyed la sogs das 'phul ka'o/ /dgag pa byed dang dgang gzar dang / /gos dgab('gebs pa'i don)dga' ba grangs kyi dgu/ /mang tshig dgu dang(skye dgu yodadagu bzang dgu sogs)dbyibs dgu ba/ /mdun du dgug dang mtshan mo'i dgong / /dus kyi dgun dang dge slong dang / /dge bshes dge ba dge legs sogs/ /dgongs pa dang ni(bsam pa'i)phyi dro'i dgongs/ /rgyan dgod(bde la dgod gad mo dkod yi ge dgod)dgon pa dgon dung dang / /ri dwags dgo ba dbyibs dgye ba/ /dga' ba'i dgyes dang mdza' min dgra/ /me tog dgram dang mdud pa dgrol/ /(dkongs pa dgrol bcingasaXpa dgrol)/ /laXsogs ga yig das 'aspul can/ /snyan dngags dang ni dngangs(sngangs zhes kyang 'azad)skrag dang / /rin chen dadul dang 'bab chu'i dngo(chungogs)/ /gri yi dngo dang dngos poXdang / /dngos med don dngos dngos gzhi dang / /ro dngar(mngar zhes kyang 'thad)dngos grubaXl sogs pa/ /nga yig das 'phul can du bya//dpag tshad rjes dpag dpag tu med/ /che bzhi'i dpang po dpa' bo dang 1 /byang chub sems dpa' dpal ldan dang / /lus kyi dpung ba dmag gi dpung / /dpe byad dper na dpe cha dang / /dpag bya dpog dang rje 66

dpon dang / /rgyal po'i dpya dang dpyang thag dang / /g.yang sa'i dpyang dang rtag dpyad dang / /sta zur dpyi dang dus kyi dpyid/ /rnam dpyod la sogs das 'phul pa'o//skyon gyi dbags dang dbang ldan dang / /dbang bo(lha'i dbangabo)dbang phyug dbang bskur dang / /ye shes dbab dang gtan la dbab/ /zhe sa'iXdaba' dang chu'i dba' rlabs/ /dbal ni tog dang rtse mo dang / /sha nyam me yi drod la'o/ /mgo bo'i dbu dang chu'i dbu ba/ /dug pa dbug dang kha nang dbugs/ /dbung dang dadus ni dkyil gyi ming / /dbu ma'i don dang gdugs sogs dbub/ /bsod stoms dbul bgyi bkren pa'i dbul/ /skar ma dbo dang chu sogs dbo/ /lung dbog nor dbog dbon po la/ /dbyangs snyan dbyar dus dbyig gnyen dang / /chos dbyings dbyibs dang dbye ba dang / /dbyig pa dbyug pa ber ka'i ming / /phyir dbyung ba dang ri mo dbyi(sub pa'i don)/ /'byed pa'i dbyen dang dbyug gu dang / /zha nye'i dbyar 'dab(snod kyisteng bu dang semasacan gyi dbyi zhes pa)la(dbral bar dka' dang nor dbrog sogs)sogs pa/ /da yis 'phul ba'i ba yig go /dmag dpon dmangs rigs dman pa(theg dman sogs)dang / /mtho min dma' dang kha dog dmar/ /dmigs med(nyes dmigasadamigs pa zhes pa'ang)blodanun(blun po'i rnamagrangs)'dzum dmul te/ /danu chu('dre srid danu zhes pa'ang)danus long dme po(rusagacig pa gsod pa po)dang / /dmod pa 'dor 67

dang dmyal ba sogs(bu ga'i dmig ces pa'ang)/ /ma yig da yis 'phul ba can/ /zhes pa bod kyi brda'i bstan bcos legs par bshad pa rin po che'i za maXtog bkod paXzhes bya ba las ga dang da'i 'jug pa bye brag tu bshad pa ste rnam par bcad pa gsum pa'o//de nas 'a yig 'jug tshul te/ /kha ga cha ja tha da dang / /pha ba tsha dza 'as 'phul bcu'o/ /de dag rim bzhin bstan bya ste/ /gzhan la 'khang dang 'khar rnga dang / /rten pa'i 'khar ba skud pa 'khal/ /blo 'khums pa dang gzhan la 'khu/ /zas kyi 'khur ba khur 'khur dang / /khral 'khul ba dang bya ba'i(khyab pa lta bu'i don)'khobs/ /grang ba'i 'khyags dang yul gzhan 'khyam/ /gzhan du 'khyar dang ngag 'khyalaXdang / /bcing ba'i 'khyig dang nyi ma 'khyims/ /gdugs 'khyer chu bo 'khyil ba(g.yas su 'khyilasogs)sogs//glog 'khyug pa dang mgul nas 'khyud/ /bsgyuraXbs 'khyur dang bros pa'i 'khyus/ /gnas su 'khyer dang brten pa'i 'khra/ /bro 'khrab gnas su 'khras pa dang / /khral sogasaX'akhri dang pho mo 'khrig /gnas su 'khrid dang bred nas 'khrims/ /'khyud pa'i 'khril dang 'khris pa dang / /'khru sbyongs 'thab 'khrug balhams pa'i 'khrungs/ /dri ma 'khrud dang nor ba'i 'khrul/ /khyem la 'khren dang rol mo 'khrol/ /de sogs 'a yis kha yig 'phul//skye 'gag 'ga' zhig mi mthun 'gal/ /'gan 'khur shing 'gas g.yo 'gul dang / /'chi ba'i 'gum dang thog ma'i 'go /'gog bden lam 68

'gor sems mi 'gong / /bde la 'god dang dus skabs 'gol/ /'go ba'i nad 'gos dus 'gyangs dang / /sems kyi 'gyu ba 'gyur ba dang / /'od 'gye 'gyed dang 'gyel ba dang / /'gyod dang lto 'grangs phan tshun 'gran/ /'gram pa rtsig 'gram mi mthun 'gras/ /sbyar ba'i 'grig dang 'phel 'grib dang / /'grim 'grul byed dang thur du 'gril('dril zhes pa'ang 'bad)/ /brtson 'grus rigs bgre 'greng ste 'dud/ /rkang ba 'gred dang chu sogs 'grems/ /nga tshun 'grel dang gzhung don 'grel/ /lam du 'gro dang grogs dang 'grogs/ /'chi ba'i 'grongs dang mdud pa 'grol/ /de sogs ga yig 'as 'phul can//zhabs 'chag 'chag sa lag tu 'chang / /chos 'chad nyes pa sbod pa'i 'chab/ /gar 'chams gnas 'cha' gtad med 'chal/ /nyi ma 'char dang srog 'chad 'chi/ /zhags pas 'ching dang stobs kyis 'chun/ /'dod la zhen pa'i 'chums pa dang / /gnas su 'chur dang yo ba'i 'chus/ /zhen pa'i 'chel dang gros 'choms dang / /chu sogs 'chor dang las 'cholaXsogs/ /'a yis 'phul ba'i cha yig go /khris 'jags dang ni rtswa 'jag ma/ /ma tshor 'jab bu reg na 'jam/ /mkha' yi 'ja' tshon blo yis 'jal/ /'jig rten 'jig dang bred pa'i 'jigs/ /mchu yis 'jibs dang 'jib pa dang / /'dam gyi 'ji ba 'jim pa dang / /zhi 'gyur 'jil dang gos la 'ju/ /khung du 'jug dngaX69

ser sna'i'ajungs/ /smad 'tshong ming r+ṣa/ 'jud mthun dang / /srad bu'i'ajur ba lag pa 'jus/ /snyan pa'i 'jibs dang 'o ma 'jo/ /gnas su 'jog dang dbyibs 'jong dang / /yul 'joms byed sogs 'as 'phul ja'o /zhib mor 'thag dang 'os pa'i 'thad/ /nan tan 'than(mi 'than ngo )dang 'khrug pa'i 'thab/ /grogs su 'thams dang mkhregs pa'i 'thas/ /smod tshig 'thing sladaXmun pa 'thibs/ /srab 'ang skom 'thungs chad pa 'thud/ /'thun pe zhes pa sngon gyi brda/ /dum bur 'thub dang blo 'thums dang / /du ba 'thul dang zas la 'thus/ /rkang baX'atheng dang thag pa 'then/ /gos 'thebaXyod dang nan chags 'thems/ /chu yis sha 'thog nang nas 'thon/ /bred 'thoms chu 'thor nyes pa 'thol(mthol zhes pa'ang rungango)//la sogs tha yig 'as 'phul can// chu dbus 'damaXdang 'gul ba'i 'dar/ /skyo ma 'dal dang dus kyi 'das/ /nye ba'i 'di dang gnas su 'dug /phyag 'tshal 'dud dang blo 'dun pa/ /bang 'dur 'dul sbyong gyen du 'degs/ /rjes 'ded gsol 'debs gnas su 'dong / /blo la 'dod dang gnas nas 'don/ /phyogs gcig 'dzom pa'i 'dom paXdang / /bor ba'i 'dor dang mtshungs pa'i 'dra/ /khrims su bcas pa 'dral ba dang / /yi ger 'dri dang gleng mo 'dri/ /slu ba'i 'drid dang rul 'gyur 'drul/ /khung bu 'dru dang shing sogs 70

'drud/ /lha 'dre gartsod byedaX'adreg mkhan dang / /gnas nas 'dren dang phyogs gcig 'dres/ /de sogs da yig 'as 'phul can/ / sgod pa'i 'phya dang phyag dar 'phyag /thur du 'phyang dang yan pa'i 'phyan/ /dar 'phyar 'phyas smod dus 'phyi ba/ /gyen du du ba 'phyur ba dang / — /lto 'bye rkang med 'phye bo ste/ /rang dgar 'phyo dang springs pa'i 'phrin/ /'phrin las rnam 'phrul 'phreng ba dang / /'od 'phro nor 'phrogaXlag tu 'phrod/ /de sogs pha1yig 'as 'a phul can/ / — sgrib pa 'byang 'gyur rab 'byams dang / /sbyar ba'i 'byar dang 'dam du 'bying / /'gred pa'i 'byid dang mi tshe 'byid/ /ma 'ongs 'byung dang sgo 'bye 'byed/ /bros pa'i 'byer dang rjes su 'brang / /bral ba'i 'bral dang du da 'gro'i 'bri/ /'grib pa'i 'bri dang bar ma'i 'bring / /lo tog 'bru dang skad chen 'brug /nad kyi 'brum bu sbrel ba'i 'brel/ /grong las thag ring 'brog gi gnas/ /dud 'gro 'brong dang rus kyi 'brom/ /de sogs ba yig 'as 'phul ldan/ / 'dzom pa'i 'tshag dang lus stobs 'tshag /chu sogs 'tshag dngaXnang du 'tshangs/ /blo 'tshabs dus 'tshams long ba'i 'tshar/ /shes dang chog pa'i 'tshal zhes dang / /mes 'tshig til mar 'tshir ba dang / /du baX'atshubs dang gnodaXpa'i 'tshe/ /rgyal ba'i 'tshengs dang zas 'tsheng dang / /'od 'tsher srog 'tsho sman 'tsho byed/ /dud 'gro 'tsho dang brdeg 'tshog 71

dang / /yo byad 'tshog chas tshong du 'tshong / /nor 'tshol la sogs 'as 'phul nga //chu 'dzag zad pa'i 'dzad pa dang / /bzlas pa'i 'dzab dang 'dzam bu gling / /'phyangs pa'i 'dzar dang 'du 'dzi dang / /phan tshun 'dzings dang lag pas 'dzin/ /zags pa'i 'dzir dang rang srol 'dzugs/ /snod du 'dzud dang bzhid gyi 'dzum/ /gzur ba'i 'dzur dang 'og tu 'dzul/ /gyen du 'dzeg dang rdo yi 'dzang / /snod du 'dzed dang ngo nga 'dzem/ /logs skyes 'dzer ba skad 'dzeraXdang / /'khrugs pa'i 'dzag 'dzog bsags pa'i 'dzom/ /nor ba'i 'dzol ba la sogs pa//dza yig 'a yi sngon 'a jug can//zhes pa bod kyi brda'i bstan nga sa legs par bshad pa rin po che'i za ma tog bkod pa zhes bya ba las 'a yig gi 'jug tshul bye brag tu dpyad pa ste rnam par becad pa bzhiXb rdzogs so// de nas ma yig 'jug tshul ni/ /kha ga nga dang cha ja nya//tha da na dang tsha dza rnams/ /mas 'phul bcu gcig yin te dper/ /mkhanaXpo nam mkha'aXmakhar du mkhas/ /nang khrol mkhal ma mkho ba'i nor/ /ser sna dpe mkhyud mkhyud spyad dang / /shes pa'i mang pa sra ba'i mkhregs/ /de rnams ma yis la 'phul ba'o// bzo bo'i mgarab mgal me dang / /mgal dum dang ni mgrin pa'i mgur/ /myur ba'i malhogs dang dga' ba'i mgu/ /mgul dang lus kyiXmago 72

bo dang / /skyabs mgonaXsems can mgron du gnyer/ /de sogs ga yig ma yis 'phul/ /bran gyi mngag gzhug lan mang mngags/ /thugs la mnga' dang mnga' thang dang / /mnga' ris mnga' 'og mnga' zhabs dang / /mngon pa mngon shes mnga' bdag dang / /mngon mtshan mngon sum mnga' mdzad dang / /lus kyi mngal sogs mas 'phul ldan//dur gyi mchad pa yi ge'i mchan/ /'bru 'thag mchig(mas gtun)dang mchig gu(yasaXgatun)dang / /nor bu mching bu rgya mtsho mching(dkyil gyi don)/ /'bel ba'i bka' mchid nang khrol mchin/ /rus kyi mchims dang 'gro ba'i mchi(skyabs su mchi sogs)/ /yod pa'i mchis dang med ma mchis/ /'dzugs pa'i mchu dang skye mched dang / /me mched sku mched la sogs dang / /nang khrol mtsher ba rtsal kyi mchongs/ /bkur stes mchod pa la sogasaXpa/ /cha yi sngon du ma yig 'gro/ /phrad pa'i mjal dang go ba'i mjal/ /lus kyi mjing ba mjug ma dang / /pho mtshan dngos ming mi marjed zhing / /de rnams jaXyig mas 'phul ldan/ / rna bas mnyan dang mnyan yod gnas/ /mtshungs pa'i mnyam dbanyed pa'i mnyed/ /ko ba mnyes dang mnyen pa dang / /dgyes pa'i mnyes sogs mas 'phul nya'o/ /73

smad kyi mthang dang mthang gos dang / /mtha'aX'akhob mtha' dang mthar thug dang / /mang tshig mtha' dag mtha' klas dang / /kha dog mthing kha mthon mthing dang / /lag mthil nus mthu mthun mi mthun/ /sor mo'i mthe bong mthe'u chung / /tshad kyi mtho dang dpangs kyi mtho/ /mig gis mthong rnams mas 'phul tha'o/ /me mdag dang ni dus kyi mdangs/ /bkrag mdangs mda' gzhu dang ni mdung / /mdun du bdar dang mda' yi mde'u/ /dpral ba'i mdongasaXdang mdud pa dang / /gsung rab mdo dngaXmador bsdus dang / /'dun pa'i mdong gsol kha dog mdog /mig mdongs(ldongs zhes pa'ang rung)la sogs mas 'phul da'o/ /'og tu mnan dang dri mnam dang / /mna' bskyal mnal gzims mnoXbasam gtong / /zas mnog mnog chung man ngag mnos/ /las kyis mnar ba mnar med gnas/ /de sogs na yig ma sngon 'gro'o/ /skyon gyi mtshang dang ming gi mtshan/ /mtshan nyid mtshan ma phyogs mtshams dang / /dud 'gro mtsha' dang mdzes pa'i mtshar ngo mtshar mtshan mo 'dra ba'i mtshungs/ /tshon rtsi mtshal dang dur mtshod mtshun/ /rus kyi mtshur dang kha mtshul dang / /chu bo'i mtsho dang mtshe'u dang / /gri sogs mtshon cha mas 'phul cha'o//'phrin las mdzad pa mthun pa'i mdza'/ /legs pa'i mdzes dang 74

nad kyi mdze/ /ya rabs mdzangs pa dud 'gro mdzo/ /dkor mdzod las mdzod mas 'phul dza'o/ /zhes pa bod kyi brda'i bstad bcos legs par bshad pa rin po che'i za ma tog bkod paXzhes bya ba las ma yig gi 'jug tshul bye brag tu dpyad pa ste rnam par bcad pa lnga ba rdzogs so//da ni mgo can bshad bya ste/ /ra la sa yi dbye bsaXgasum/ /'ga' zhig bas 'phul skabs su bshad/ /lhag ma rnams ni 'dir brjod bya/ /ka ga nga dang ja nya ta/ /da na ba ma tsa dza rnams/ /ra mgo ldan pa bcu gnyis te/ /chom rkun rkus shig rkang ba rkub/ /sa rko rkos mkhan rko bar byed/ /nad kyi rkong ba chig rkyang dang / /snod spyad rkyen dang rkyal ba dang / /rgyu rkyen chu'i rkyal ra rka'o/ /na tshod rgan po rga shis gzir/ /rgad pas sdug bsngal blo rgod dang / /bya rgod dang ni sems g.yeng rgod(bsam gtan gyi skyon)/ /dud 'gro rgod ma grung ba'i rgod/ /rtsod pa'i rgol ba snga phyi rgol/ /rgya mtsho phyagaXrgya rgyas btab dang / /rgya che rgyang ring nor sogs rgyas/ /ri dwags rgya dang skyed byed rgyu/ /zas kyi rgyags dang rang rgyud dang / /gtam rgyud 'phreng rgyud rgyud mangs dang / /mdzes byed rgyan dang lus kyi rgyab/ /chu rgyun rgyu mtshan phan tshun rgyug /lus kyi rgyus pa rgyu ma dang / /brdeg pa'i spyob dang rgyal po dang / /mi pham rgyal sogs rar btags ga'o/ /g.yag rnga'i rnga yab brdung bya'i rnga/ /gla rngan byin dang bkres rnga 76

dang / /hams pa'i ngoms dang lus kyi rngul/ /rdzul gzan rol mo rnge'u chung dang / /dud 'gro rnga mo rnge'u dang / /dadugs rngub sdug bsngal zug rngu dang / /rta yi rngogam nas sogs rngod/ /ri dwags gsod byed rngon pa dang / /rngam brjid che sogs rar btags nga'o//rje dpon rje btsun lha rje dang / /rdo rje bkur ste'i rjed pa dang / /sha rjen dzes 'jug rgad pa'i jud/ /de sogs ra la ja btags pa'o/ /nor rnyed pa dang so yi rnyil/ /sngon gyi nor rnying chu'i rnyog ma/ /ri dwags 'dzin pa'i rnyod dang rnyi/ /de sogs ra 'og nyal ba'i nya'o/ /mi 'jig rtag pa bred pa'i rtab/ /dbang rtul rtogs ldan blo yis rtogs/ /rjes kyi rting dang rtul phod dang / /rkang ba'i rting ba mi gtsang rtug /'jig rten lha rten rnam rtog dang / /yid ches rton pa la sogs pa/ /ta yig ra yi mgo can bri'o/ /grong rdal thog rdib rdul phran dang / /du ram rdog ma rdo rje rdo/ /la sogs da yig ra mgo can/ /rul ba'i rnag dang zhing rnang ma/ /tshig phrad rnam par rnam pa rnams/ /rnal 'byor rtse no rar btags na'o//khye rbad rbab sgril rbod gtong sogs/ /ba yig ra la btags pa'o/ /'gram gyi rmang dang ngo mtshar rmad/ /rmad byung dang ni dris pa'i rmas (brda rnying ste dri ba'o)/ /lus kyi rma dang rmi lam rmi/ /dud 'gro'i rmig pa gnod 76

pa'i rmugs/ /gnodasbyin rmugs 'dzin rmugs par byed/ /khyes rmur ba dang sun pa'i rmus/ /rmeg med bcom dang sga yi rmed/ 1bal sogs rmel dang gnyer rmo mo/ /rmongs pa dbu rmog go cha'i rmog /zhing sogs rmo rmod rmon dor te/ /de sogs ma yig ra mgo can//rtsa ba rtse mo tsher ma'i rtsang / /rtsad nas gcod dang btung ba'i rtsab /sngo yi rtswa dang lus kyi rtsa/ /rtsa lag rtsi shing rtsi mar dang / /tshon rtsidang ni stobs kyi rtsal/ /zhing rtsing spu yi rtsid pa dang / /rus pa'i rtsib ma 'khor lo'i rtsibs/ /rtsis mkhan rtsis byed reg bya rtsub/ /rtsed mo rtse dang rtses dang rtsen/ /(lngas rtsen dang sum rtsen sogs)/ /'thab rtsod bya ba rtsom rtsoms shig /rtsol ba bskyed sogs rar btags tsa'o//snod kyi rdza dang 'dam rdzab dang / /dngos po'i rdzas dang phyugs rdzi sogs/ /chu yi rdzing buXrdzu 'phrul dang / /mi bden rdzun dang zog gi rdzub/ /rdzus skyesaXbrag rdzong 'bul ba'i rdzongs/ /bya ba zin pa'i rdzogs pa dang / /kun rdzob la sogs rar btags nga //zhes pa ra mgo can gyi brda bye brag tu gtan la phab pa ste le'u drug pa'i dang bo'o//la mgo ldan pa rnam bcu ste/ /ka ga nga dang ca ja ta/ /da dang pa ba ha rnams so/ /lus kyiXlkog ma lkog byur dang //dud 'gro'i lkog shal lkugs pa sogs/ /la la btags pa'i ka yin no//77

sgang ba sman lga spyam tshwa(rgyam tshwa 'thad)la'ang / /'ga' zhig(ji rabasapa'i)bzhed deXlar btags ga'o//grangs kyi lnga nyid lar btags nga'o//rin chen lcags dang lcang ma shing / /ral ba'i lcang lo lcam dral dang //reg bya spru yang tsha sprubs dang / /mnyen lhag lcug ma gri yi rdzugs/ /kha nang lce dang lce 'bab(gnam lcags)'jigs/ /me lce 'bar dang 'chi phyir lceb/ /me tog mgo sngogs blo yis lhogs/ /sbal sngong la sogs lar btags ca'o//zhal nas ljags brkyang kha dog lngang / /lngang bu sman ljongs yul sngongs dang / /sngon shing lngan ldin(mi gtsang)lar btags ja'o//grub mtha'i lta ba mig gis lta//ji ltar delhar de lta bu//gnya' yi stag pa lhad mo lta/ /gos sogs ltab dang mtshan ltas dngaX/ /mdun gyi sto ba lte ba dang / lteng ga lteng rgyas 'od srungasaXdang / /ltung bas gos na mnar med ltung / /lto 'bye ltos 'gro ltos pa dang / /mngal gyi gnas skabs lhar ltar sogs/ /ta yig la yi mako ldan pa'o/ /nyal las ldang dang 'khobs pa'i ldang / /yod pa'i ldan dang nam mkha'i lding / /skad kyi ldab ldib 'brug sgra ldir/ /lde mig mchod rdzas lda ldi dang / /btung ba ldud dang snod du ldugs/ /ming gi lde dang me sogasaXlde/ /shing gi seng ldeng logs kyi ldebs/ /drang min ldem dang ldem dgongs dang / /sman gyi lde gu lder bzo'i lha/ /phyir mi ldog dang dris lan ldon/ /ldob 78

skyen(shes sla ba'i mi)ro stoms ldom bu dang / /ldan pa la sogs lar btags da'o/ /sems can shun lpags lar btags pa'o//mgul gyi lnga ba chu'i sbu ba/ /la mgo can gyi ba yig go /ri rgyal lhun po lho phyogs dang / /lha dang lhang tsher lhag ma dang / /lhag par lhan ne lhang nge dang / /lham me lhun grub lhad can dang / /lhad cig lhab lhub lham sgrog lhod/ /gzhan dang 'khrul gzhi med pa yin/ /zheku pa la mgo can gyi brda'i bye brag tu dpyad pa ste drug pa'i le'u gnyis pa'o/ /sa mgo ldan pa bcu gcig ste/ /ka ga nga dang nya ta da/ /na pa ba ma tsa rnams so/ /skar ma skag dang sgra skad dang / /'dzin spyad skam pa skal ba bzang / /lus kyi sbu dang rgyal gyi skugs/ /sbas skungs snum skud skud pa 'khal/ /skur ba 'debs dang skul byed dang / /ska rags skod chings skem byed dang / /rid pa'i skem dang skor baXbyed/ /thugs dam skong dang re ba skong / /gos sogasaXskon dang zas skom dang / /jaXsogs skol dang kha dog skya/ /skyabs gnas skyabs 'gro chu skyar bya/ /bde skyid bya skyibs skyil krung bcas/ /zas sogs sgyugs pa sgyung kas zos/ /ro skyur ba dang sgyu ruXr/ /saXnas skyes dang rtsis kyi skyeg /kha skyengs skyed byed mgyogs pa'i skyen/ /shing gi skyer ba kha dog skyer/ /gnas su skyel dang skyes pa sogs/ /sems skyo 'tsho skyong sgul skyod dang / /nyes skyon lasaXskyobs skyob pa dang / /skyobs shigaXchu 79

sogs skyomasaXshig dang / /'dabasaXpa'i skyor dang sa skyor dang / /gnas su skyol dang skyos shig sogs/ /sa yig thod du bcings pa'i ka'o/ /rta sga sa'i sgang blo sgam dang / /shing gi sgam dngaXlus sgal tshigs/ /sgul skyod miXbyaXsge'u gsher sman/ /sgo khang sgo srungs sgos kyi dpon/ /mdzes pa'i sgeg pa sgeg mo dngaX/ /sgo nga sgog pa sgom chen dang / /sgom par byed dang lha sgoms shig /zas sogs sgongs shig bu ram sgor/ /dbyibs kyi sgor mo sgying skyur dang / /sgyid(rkangaba'i sgyid pa'ang )lug gnyen gyi sgyug mo dang / /sgyu rtsal g.yo sgyu sgyu ma mkhan/ /'khor lo sgyur sogs sgyur byed dang / /snod phad sgye'u tshugs thab sgyed pu/ /sgyel cig sgraXskad cher sgrogs shig /phyogs gcig sgrig dang sgrigs shig dang / /mkhas pa'i sgrin po sdig sgrib dang / /yolaXbs sgrib dang bya ba sgrims/ /phyogs gcig sgril dang sngon rabs sgrung / /'gran pa'i sgrun dang bya ba sgrubs/ /sgrub thabs ji bzhin lha spubs shig /zos pa'i sgrogs pa gcer bu'i sgren/ /bya sgro bshad sgros lcags sgrog dang / /chos sgrogs pa dang chu las sgrol/ /snang byed sgron me rus pa'i sgrom/ /sgrol ma sgrol mdzad la sogs pa/ /sa yig gtsug tu bcings pa'i ga'o//snga ba'i dus dang snga dro dang / /zhal snga spyan snga snga sor dang / /rim pa snga ma snga phyi sogs/ /gzungs sngags mal gyi sngas stan dang / /mdun gyi spun dang kha dog sngo/ /dge ba de ltar sngo b.raXbyed/ /sngon tshe mdog sngon sngags pa sogs/ /nga yig sa yi (1 can lags/ /80

tha snyad snyan tshig ji snyam sems/ /rna ba'i zhe sa snyan gtam snyan/ /reg bya snyi ba snyigs ma'i dus/ /snying bo snying dang gnyen snying mo/ /ri rtse snyil byed nad kyi snyun/ /nga rgyal snyems dang sngas la snyes/ /snye ma 'bru yiXdog pa'o/ /sman gyi go snyod btang stoms dngaX/ /bsod stoms stom lasaXsems snyoms dang / /spu snyol chang snyol la sogs pa/ /nya mgo sa yis brgyan pa bya'o/ /dud 'gro stag dang kom pa'i stabs/ /lus kyi sta zur shing stag pa/ /mig gi lta stangs 'dings pa'i stan/ /dngul rdo stang zil 'phreng ba'i star/ /dgra sta sta re ste'u dang / /kom pa'i stang stabs bkur snyi dang / /bste stang('diraskabs 'di'ibardar mibazung)dang ni 'thug pa'i stug /'phyar g.yeng gzhogs stegs steng gi phyogs/ /mkhas pa sten cig yon tan ster/ /stes dbang grangs stong stong ba nyid/ /zad pa'i stongs dang chos ston dang / /ston mo ston dus ston pa la/ /sbyin len stobasaXdang rtsal gyi stobs/ /zhal du stob dang bor ba'i stor/ /mi gtsang 'bab pa'i stor khung sogs/ /sa la btags pa'i ta yig go /zhe sdang sdang sems bred pa'i sdar/ /srog chags sdig pa dge sdig dang / /sdigs mdzub sdigs dang gnas kyi sdings/ /sdig to can dang sdug bsngal dang / /mdzes pa'i sdug dang nor sogs sdud/ /mang po'i sde dang sde tshan dang / /sdeb sbyor phyogs gcig sdeb pa dang / /snod spyad sder ma sder 81

mo rdo/ /ljon shing sdong bo sdong bu dang / /gnas su sdod dang sdod cig dang / /sdom pa bsrung sdom srog dang sdos/ /zhes sogs da yig sa mgoXcan/ /dri 'dzin sna dang 'ju ba'i sna/ /rnam pa sna tshogs sna mang dang / /snag tsha snang ba mthong snang dang / /mi gtsang snabs dang snam bu dang / /snam sbyar rgyab kyiXsnam logs dang / /gos rgyu snal ma 'bru mar snum/ /snur shig snoms shig snrel zhi 'phreng / /skar ma sgron dang sprubs la sogs/ /na yig saXmago ldan par bri'o//mji saXpa'i spa baXganas nas spags(zas kyi spags kyang)/ /spang bya spangs dang pha spad dang / /rngul gyi spabs dang go 'phang spar/ /lus kyi spu dang ba spu dang / /rin chen spug dang phung bor spungs/ /rgyan gyis spud dang gnyen gyi spun/ /mkha' la bya spur mkhar gyi spe'u/ /rtsi shing spen ma gza' spenaXpa/ /rgyan gyi spen tob nor sogs spel/ /spel mar byas dang gos sogs sgo/ /mtho ba'i spo dang spang gshongs dang / /sred pa spongs shig zas kyi spong / /mkhas pa'iXspobs pa gong du sgor/ /bdug spes dngos spyad ce spyang dang / /mig gi spyan dngaXlus spyi bo/ /du ma'i spyi dang snod spyi blugs/ /chu laXspying dang 'byar byed spyin/ /rtswa yi spyil bo mtha' la sprugs/ /gshe ba'i spyo dang longs spyod spyod/ /tshur spyon dge ba sgrogs pa'i spyoms(bdag nyid sgrog pa'o)//dud 'gro spra dang nor med sprang / /lag tu sprad dang rgyan gyis spras/ /sprang po'i spar mor 82

sba dbyug 'chang / /'phrin spring ba dang chu 'dzin sprin/ /spru ma(sman)spa maX(shing)rdul sprugs dang / /sprul ba 'gyed dang dud 'gro spre'u/ /sems spro ba dang 'thab mo sprod/ /mang du spros pa la sogs pa/ /sa mgo ldan pa'i pa sku ga go /gsang ba'i sba ba phyogs gcig sprags/ /'dres pa'i sbags dang dud 'gro'i sbangs/ /chang gi sbang ma chu la sbangs/ /du ma phyogs gcigaXsbams pa dang / /me sogs sbar dang sbor shig dang / /srog chags sbal ba sbal du 'jug /gter du sbas dang sbos shig dang / /stobs kyi spungs dang me chas spung / /shun pa'i spun pa khung bu'i spubs/ /srog chags grog spur chu la sbengs/ /mdzod du sped dang gsus pa sbos/ /phra ba las bzlog sbom po dang / /sbyang bya sbyangs dang legs par sbyar/ /nor sbyin gnod sbyin sbyin pa'i bdag /dge sbyong gso sbyong sbyor ba dang / /'dubs pa'i spra dang nyis sprag dag /sha sprang sgrang bu sbrang rtsi can/ /gtsang sbra can dang sbrang ma dang / /grogs spu spran dang sa le sbram/ /g.yal ba'i sbid pa srog chags sprul/ /zan sogs sprus dang thag pas sbrel/ /ra mda' sbon sogs sa mgo'i ba'o//mun pa'i smag rum lus kyi smad/ /nad gso'i sman dang sman pa dang / /zong min smar dang skar ma smal/ /chur 'khrul smig rgyu smin drug bu/ /skar ma smin drug 'bras du khrin/ /kha dog sgrug po sme ba dang / /'phya ba'i smod dang smon lam 'debs/ /ming nas sbos dang sman byed dang / /shing gi spyig ma 83

smyug ma dang / /zas bcadaXsprung gnas dusaXsmyur te/ /sems 'khrul smyo ba smyon pa dang / /gtam smra ba dang smras pa dang / /gdong gi sma ra smin ma dang / /smreng 'don smre sngags dur smrig sogs/ /sa yig thod du bcings pa'i ma'o /bka' stsal ba dang dngos grub stsal/ /dngos grub stsol dang stsal du gsol/ /sbyin pa tshul bzhin sprul bgyi sogs/ /sa mgo ldan pa'i tsa yig go/zhes pa sa mgo can gyi brda bye brag tu dpyad paXste drug pa'i gsum pa rdzogs te/ de ltaraXbod kyi brda'i bstan bcos legs par bshad pa rin po che'i za ma tog bkod pa zhes bya ba las/ mako can gyi brda bye bragaXtu dpyad pa ste rnam par bcad pa drug pa rdzogs so//de ltar sngon 'jug lnga dang ni/ /ra la sa yi mgo can brda/ /nges par dka' ba rnams bshad pas/ /brda rnams phal cher de yis rtogs/ /da ni snga ma'i ming shugs kyis/ /phyi ma ji ltar thob pa'i tshul/ /dper brjod 'phreng ba dang bcas pa/ /cung zad gsal bar bshad par bya/ /mkhan po thon mi sastoXṭas/ /sum cu ba las rjes 'jug gi /i dang mthun lugs 'di zhes bya/ /dang bo gnyis la dang boXmathun/ /gsum lnga bcu la kya dang sbyar/ /lhag ma rnams la gya dang sbyar/ /de dag i sbyar 'brel ba'i sa/ /zhes gsungs de yi ngo bo ni/ /da ba sa kyi ga nga gi /na ma ra la gyi ste dper/ /bdag gi rkang gi khong nas ni/ /khyodaXkyi rgyab kyi g.yas kyi char/ /zhes dang / /don gyi tshul 84

dang gtam gyi gzhi/ /shar gyi phyogs dang dpal gyi bdag /ces pa lta du'o/ /'a dang rkyang ba 'dogs can gyi/ /rjes su 'i thob tshigs bcad kyi/ /yi ge ma tshang yi thob dper/ /rtse dga'i dga'aXb bde ba'i dpal/ /sa yi bdag po de yi bzhin/ /ga dang ba yi rjes su tu/ /nga da na ma ra la du/ /sa su 'a dang 'dogs can dang / /rkyang ba ru ste dpe rim bzhin/ /rtag tu rab tu 'byung du re/ /snod duXrgyun du zhim du zo/ /myur du mjal du 'ong dus su'ang / /bza' ru yod pa'i gnas 'di ru/ /kha ru zhim rgyu'i zas 'diXsbyin/ /da de na ra la sa te/ /btud de bzlan te byin pa yis/ /bskyar te thul te 'dzags te byung / /ga nga ba ma 'a rnams dang / /'dogs can rkyang mthar sa ste ste/ /skrag ste gsang ste gnas pa yis/ /thub ste 'dzum ste dpa' ste gda'/ /bde ste sha changaXza ste snang / /ga da ba sa'i rjes su kyang / /skabs 'gar da yi rjes su'ang kyang / /bdag kyang 'bad kyang 'bras med kyang / /bya ba thob kyang des kyang ci/ /'on kyang 'phral gyi 'tsho ba 'byung / /nga 'a na ma ra la yang / /yang yang skyes bu 'ga' yang ni/ /byon yang nam yang ma phradaXde/ /slar yang mjal yang spyan ma 'drongs/ /'dogs can rkyang mthar phal cher 'ang / /tsheg bar ma tshang yang ste dper/ /ci yang yod pa'i phyug po yang / /de 'dra bdag la 'byung du'ang re/ /ga da ba cing sa mthar shing / /phyug cing blun pa rgad cing 'gro/ /slob cing nus pa mkhas shingaXphyug /nga 'a na ma ra la dang / /'dogs can rkyang ba rnams zhing dper/ /85

drang zhing bde ba rab dga' zhing / /snyan zhingaX'agyur ba 'jam zhing mdzes/ /dar zhing rgyas par 'tshal zhing bdag /bde zhing skyid nas za zhing snang / /ga da ba ces ngaX' dngaX/ /na ma ra la sa dang ni/ /rkyang baX'adogs can zhes te dper/ /rtag ces bya ba'i bdag yod ces/ /smra ba zab ces 'byung zhes thos/ /gda' zhes 'di lta yin zhes pa'am/ /'di tsam zhes par 'gyuraXzhes par/ /'khrul zhes ston pas legs gsungs zhes/ /mi mkhas paXzhes smra zhes bshad/ /kha cig(sngon byiXmakhas pa)sa mthar shes zhes zer/ /mi 'thad par mthong(lo chen blo ldan shes rab dang dpang losakyang bkag pas)kho bos dor/ /ga da ba cig sa mthar shig /rkyang ba'i rjes su'ang cig 'thob dper/ /shog cig sod cig spyob cig ces/ /gyis shig ces ni kha cig smra/ /nga 'a na ma ra la dang / /'dogs can rnams kyi mthar zhig dper/ /cung zhig sdod la 'ga' zhig la/ /'phrin zhig nam zhig bskur zhig ces/ /ngal zhig bsos la mdo zhig sgrogs/ /na ra la gsum rjes su ni/ /sgra bsgyur snga mas da drag bzhed/ /phyi ma rnams kyis da drag dor/ /des na naXr la gsum gyi/ /rjes su zhing zhes zhig yin na'ang / /da drag nges par thob pa der/ /da drag sbyor ram mi sbyor kyang / /cing ces cig ces legs te dper/ /mkhas par mkhyen cing yon tan gyis/ /brgyan ces thos kyi ston cig ces/ /zer ces mthong nas 'tshal ces te/ /bdagaXkyang 'di 'drar gyur cig ces/ /smon lam stsal cing slob par ni/ /'tshal ces zer gyis 86

myur nga cig /ga da ba mthar ce na dang / /sa mthar she na sbyar te dper/ /su 'dug ce na bla ma bzhugs/ /ci 'chad ce na gdams pa ste/ /gang zab ce na spros bralaXchos/ /sus thos she na bdag gis so/ /nga 'a na ma ra laXdang / /'dogs canaXrkyang ba zhe na dper/ /gang byung zhe na hor 'dra ste/ /duXgada' zhe na mang po'o/ /su yin zhe na dben pa ste/ /khrims kyis dben nam zhe na dben/ /ci bskor zhe na rgyal khams te/ /gang btsal zhe na nom pa'o/ /ci skye zhe na bu skye ste/ /su la zhe na ma la'o/ /ga da ba sa na ma pa/ /zag pa med pa'i bde ba ni/ /thob pa nyes pa las grol nas/ /'gro la phan pa'i bsam pa'i gnas/ /ngaX' ra la 'dogs can dang / /rkyang ba'i rjes su ba byed lbar/ /'bod pa rnams la ba sbyar zhing / /gzhan la pa nyid sbyaraXte dper/ /btung ba bda' ba myur bar 'thungs/ /mjal bar zhuXb tsha ba 'dod/ /lung ba mda' ba 'byor ba che/ /yul ba phu ba bya ba mang / /dri ba'am dgag tshig skabs su ni/ /mtha' rten rnams la ma sbyor zhing / /skabs 'gar ra la ta dang ni/ /'dogs can rkyang ba'am ste dper/ /'dug gam 'byung ngam yong ngam dang / /yin nam grub bam sgom mam dang / /dga' 'am 'gyur ram 'tshal lam dang / /shes sam zer ram go 'am dang / /kha'am zhes pa lta bu'o/ /rdzogs tshigaXskabs su na ra gnyis/ /ma gtogs mtha' rten brgyad po la/ /rang la na ro sbyar te dper/ /khyod ni phyug go gshis bzang ngo / /gtong yang phod do chos grub bo/ /'khor yang 87

'dzom mo bzhugs gda' 'o/ /thugs kyang dal lo zhes thos so/ /na ra gnyis la na ro dang / /to zhes rnam pa gnyis 'gyur dper/ 1bzhin no zhes ni ngas bstan to/ /ngo mtshar ro zhes gzhan 'dzer to/ /rkyang ba 'dogs can 'o ste dper/ /sha ni za'o skyid 'di'o/ /de dag rnams dang tshig rkang mthar/ /nyis shad le'u mtshams bzhi shad thob/ /ga yig rjes su chig shad bya/ /shad gong phal cher(nga yig ma gtogs)phyi tsheg spang / /rkyang shad dang ni tsheg shad dag /thob tshul skabs dngaXsbyar la dpyad/ /gzhan yang 'phul dang mtha' rten dag /sbyar du rung dang mi rung ba'i/ /rnam par dbye ba'ang cung zad bstan/ /tshogs dang tshoms dang myos 'gyur chang / /mngon sum phun sum rim gro dang / /sku khams khros dang khro ba dang / /phra ma khon 'dzin phrag pa sogs/ /mang bor 'phul yig spang bar bya/ /lha btsun bza' btung rje btsun dang / /lha rje nga rgyal bya rgod dang / /rdo rje rgya mtsho la sogs pa/ /mang bor mtha' rten med phyir spang / /pus mo'i lha nga sgo nga dang / /sla nga sogs la nga mtha' spang / /yi ge lu gu rgyud dang ni/ /myu gu sogs la gaXmatha' spang / /gsung rab macan rab rig sngags dang / /mkha' spyod sa spyod go 'phang dang / /nyamaXng nyam chung nyam thag dang //lo tog sogs la sa mtha' spang / /lhas byin klus byin mis byin sogs/ /mang bo zhig la med na nor/ /yi ge zhal ltaXtha dad dang / /la sogs da lta zhes rnams la/ /bar nga ga mi byed blun po'i lugs/ /de ltar dug la rma yiXphyogs/ /bstan pa 88

bzhinaXdu mkhas rnams kyis/ /rgya chen gsung rab mthong ba dang / /rang gi rnam par dpyod pas brtag /ces pa bod kyi brda'i bstan bcos legs par bshad pa rin po che'i za ma tog bkod pa zhes bya ba las/ /snga ma'i ming shugs kyis phyi ma ji ltar thob tshul sogs gces pa sna tshogs paXthun mong du dpyad pa ste rnam par bcad pa bdun pa rdzogs so/ /bod yul dbus kyi rgyal po mchog /gnam ri srong btsan yan chad la/ /bod la yi ge med ces grag /chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i dus/ /mkhan po thon mi sasto ṭas/ /(kha che'i yi ge la dpe mdzad nas lha sa'i skuXmabar ma ru bya bar rje blon mtshams bcad nas brtsams par grags)lāñdza'i yi ger dper mdzad nas/ /dbyangs yig i u e yo bzhi/ /gsal byed ka sogs sum cu mdzad/ /de las rjes su 'jug pa bcu/ /de lasaXkyang ni sngon 'jug lnga/ /ra la sa yi mgo gsum dang / /ya raXl yi smad 'dogs gsum/ /da dang sa yi yang 'jug sogs/ /ston pa'i bstan bcos rnam brgyad mdzad/ /(ces grags na'ang bstan paX'aphel 'grib kyi dbang gis deng sang sum cu ba dang rtags 'jugaganyis las mi snangango)bka' srol de nyid laXbarten nas/ /lo paṇa skyes mchog duXm yis/ /rgya gar rgya nag kha che dang / /li dang bal bo'i yul sogs nas/ /thub pa'i gsung rab sna tshogs bsgyur/ /brda yang mi 'dra sna tshogs gyur/ /chosaXrgyal ral ba can gyiXdus/ /ska rtsog zhang sogs mkhas mang gis/ /rgyal po'i bkas bskul gsar bcad kyi/ /skad kyisaXbarda sbyar gtan la phab/ /slad nas 89

rin chen bzang po dang / /blo ldan shes rab la sogs pa/ /mkhas mchog rnams kyangaXde la brten/ /kho bos mkhan po thon mi'i gzhung / /sum cu ba dang rtags 'jug gi('di gnyis ka la ṭī shā re byasayod cing 'di yang de dag dbang du byas nasabashad pas so)/ /don yang legs par gtan la phab/ /ska cog rin chen bzang po dang / /blo ldan shes rab shong dpang sogs/ /mkhas mang legs bshad bcud myangs te/ /'phags yul skad dang gangs can gyi/ /gsung rab brda la 'dris pa'i blos/ /don 'diXlegs par bkod paXnyid/ /gang zhig gsung rab noms kyi don/ /gtan la 'bebs na smos ci 'tshal/ /'jig rten phal ba'i rnam gzhag cig /byed kyang tshig gi sbyor ba gces/ /'di ni mkhas rmongs 'byed pa ste/ /don 'di khong du chud pa'i mi/ /mang bo 'dus pa'i nang dag tu/ /mkhas pa'i stan la 'dug par dbang / /'di la nongs pa'i cha mchis na/ /mkhas pa dag gis bcos par gsol/ /legs par bshad pa'i dge tshogs kyang / /thub bstan gsal ba'i 'od du gyur/ /legs sbyar brda sprod ka lā tsan+d+ra pa ṇi ni/ /sā dhu kāṭī rab 'byor zla ba drag 'byor dang / /bgrod dka' seng ge chos 'bangs 'chi med seng ge sogs/ /shong dpang brgyud pa'i bla mas legs bshad gang yin dang / /bod kyi mkhan po thon mi'i sum rtags bstan bcos dang / /ska cog sogs kyi gsar bcad sgra sbyor bam gnyis dang / /dag byed mkhan po'i gaṅgā(snyeXthang pa grags seng ge)bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun(gtsang nag phug pa thugs rje seng 90

ge'i)dang / /(stagaston rgazhon nu dpal)'od zer brgya ba(buston seng ge 'od)sgraXdon rgya mtsho'i me long dang / /(rje byams pa gling ba'i)smra ba'i brgyan dang(bsam sdings pa kun bsam gyi)'khrul ba sbong ba la sogs pa'i/ /legs bshad snying bo gces so 'tshal noms 'dir bsdus te/ /yi ger 'bri dang smra dang 'chad dang rtsom pa sogs/ /kun la phan phyir rnam dkar bsam pas 'di brtsamasaXso/ /zhes pa bod kyi brda'i bstan bcos legs paraXbashad pa rin po che'i za ma tog bkod pa zhes byaXb/ legs par sbyar ba'i skad kyis brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos dag thos shing cha shas tsam rig la/ gangs can gyi bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab mtha' dag gi bsgyur tshul rjes su dpag pa las rtogs shing brda gsaraXrnying gi rnam dbyeXlegs par byed pa'i lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong zha lu ba rin chen chos skyong bzang po zhesaXbya bas/ dngos po'i(shing pho khyi ste rang lo don ba'i ba'i)lo sa ga zla ba'i tshes nyer lnga la chos grwa grwa thang du grub par bgyis pa'o/ /'di ni gsung rab snang byed sgron me ste/ /gangs can skadaXsmra spyi yi yid bzhin nor/ /skye dgu dga' byed yar ngo'i zla ba ste/ /mkhas rnams snying la 'babs pa'i tshig gi gter/ /legs sbyar rgya mtsho ri byi'i khyor chu bzhin/ /gangs can skad tshul nor 'dzin khyon yangs pa/ /rnam dpyod gom gcig gis gnon sred med bu/ /mi shes stobs ldan sa 'og 'ching 'di su/ /zhes kyang smras so/ /slar yar yar stod rab brtan lhun po sgang du par du bzhengs pa'i tshe/ chos la 'jug 91

pa'i skad gnyis shan sbyor ba dang mchan bu 'debs pa'ang gyis shig ces bkas bskul te/ skadaXdod dang brda gsar rnying sbyor 'os sogs kyi mchan bu 'ga' zhig 'debs pa dang / sngar gyi rtsom pa la snon 'brid dang bsgyur ba ci rigs pa'ang zha lu lo tsā ba rang nyid kyis/ mi zad pa'i(me pho gyi ste rang lo brgyad cu rtsa drug pa'i)lo la bsam grub sde chen du bgyis pa ni dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du par du bsgrubs pa'o/ / sarba maṅga lo/ /(dag yig 'di ni sde dge'i shing par gzhir bzung nas bsgrigs pa yin)92
bas pa bzhubaba'i rdo rjes

༄༅//o bde legs su gyur cig dpal ldan rgya chen tshogs gnyis gser gyi rdul brtsegasaXmatshar sdug lhun po mtha' yas yon tan nyi 'dumaX'od kyis 'khyud/ /bdud sde'i mtshon gyisaXnam yang mi phug bla gos thunamatshams rtse dga' la 'grogs mes po'i dpal yang mog por bgyid/ /rten 'brel zab mo'i gtam gyi 'od zhags ring bor spyong bas log smra kun dang srid zhi'i rgud mun lhan cig gzhom/ /srid gsum dregs ldan ral rtser zhabs sen dngar ba'i thub dbang gang des deng 'dir dge legs 'dzum rlabs 'khyil bar mdzod/ /gang gi mang pa'i pha mtha' kun gzigs tshad ma'i srang la btegs kyang mtha' yas bskal bar gzhal du ma spyod pas/ /rgyal ba kun bgros rang gi rje bor bkur kyang 'gro slad rgyal sras tshul gyis rnam rol mang pa'i gter chen dang / /gang gi mtshan tsam dran pa'i snying la skad cig nyid du rab dkar ngang mo 'o ma'i rgya mtshor chas pa bzhin/ /thugs rje'i 'od dkar 'gyed pas dge legs spobs pa mchog nga sgra dbyangs lha mos 'gro kun rang gi zlar bskrun cig /gzhan ched 'khor ba'i 'brog dgon pad tshalaltar dgongs rang don zhi bde'i dbyings kyangami spyod rgyal sras sems dpa'i tshogs/ /thub bstan mi nub 'dzin spel gtad rabs bdun dang shing rta che gnyis 'phagasabod paṇa grub rnam dag gser ri'i phreng / /dpal ldan thub pa kun gyi yon tan mdzes sdug gcig bsdus 'jam dpal snyeng bo sras bcas dbyig ldan dpal yon che/ /94

rnam mang drin gyis rang lci dngos brgyud yongs 'dzin mtha' dag 'dir ni 'gro 'di'i gdung sel dge legs bye ba'i char rgyun phobs/ /brtan pa'i 'khor los srid zhi'i dpal gyis 'jig rten 'di nyid mchog tu mdzes par bsgrub pa'i ched/ /dpung bzhi'i stobs kyi gom pa rgyal phranaXbye ba'i thor cog rtse mor 'god pas rnam sgeg cing / /mchog gsum gtsug bsten dge bcu'i lugs bzang rtsibs stong rab mdzes bka' khrims gser gyi 'khor lo ches/ /gling 'dir dbang bsgyur mi rje'i tshul 'dzin gang gi chab srid bsngags 'os gshis su brtan gyur cig /smra ba'i nyi ma thub pa'i dbang bo yis/ /skye dgu'i don gnyis bde blag bsgrub pa'i slad/ /bka' stsal zabaXrgyas chos phung dgongs 'grel bcas/ /lhar bcas 'gro ba'i mchod gnas dam pa ru/ /ji srid kun gsal mdzes ma'i lang tsho yis/ /rang gi rang bzhin ma dor de srid du/ /dri mas ma bslad gnas dang 'phel ba yis/ /phun tshogs srid zhi'i 'dod pa 'jo ba'i ched/ /gsung rab kun la mkho ba'i ming tshig dang / /so so'i brda skad rnam bzhag maXlus po/ 1chen po hor gyi skad du bsgyur ba'i tshul/ /dpyad gsum dag pas 'dir ni dgod par bya/ /ma sbyangs rang 'dod phyogs zhen gzu lums kyis/ /gang dran ma dag tha snyad mang sbyar bas/ /thub bstan dri mas slod la ches rings pa'i/ /bsgyur byed gzugs brnyan de dag ngal gsos shig /shākya'i ring lugs snying la legs bcangs nas/ /gzhan phan bsgrub la 96

brtson pa'i shes rab ldan/ /phyogs lhung 'khyogs po'i spyod tshul ring dor ba/ /de dag dga' ba'i 'dzum ni da ston cig /de la 'dir lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba thams cad kyi 'dren pa dam pa bsod nams dang ye shes kyiXtshogs rlabs poXches bgrang las 'das pa'i bskal bar bskrun pa'i gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal gyis tshangs pa dang khyab 'jug dang dbang bo la sogs pa srid na shin tu che ba'i dregs ldan ma lus pa'i ral ba'i thor cog la zhabs sen gyi pad+mo rnam par dgod pa/ ches gdul bar dka' ba'i snyigs ma lnga bdo'i 'gro ba rnams la lhag par yang thugs rje ched po'i gzhan dbang du gyur pa'i snying stobs kyi cha shas yongasaXsu rdzogs pa'i stobs bcu mnga' ba stong gi dbus na pad dkar lta bur bsngags pa/ dbang bcu dang stobs bcu dang mi 'jigs pa bzhi'i pha rol du son pas rnam paraXgrol ba don du gnyer ba'i skyes bu rnams la gcig tu mi bslu ba'iXbaden pa bzhi dang rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i gtam gyi seng ge'i nga ro 'jig rten du yang dag par sgrogs par mdzad pa/ chos kyi rgyal po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dpal rgyal ba shākya thub pa zhes snyan pa'i grags pas 'jig rten gsum rnam par 'gengs pa de nyid kyis/ bdag cag kho na'i phyir du byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed/ bskal ba grangs med pa gsum du bya dka' ba'i rlabs po che'i bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs bsags nas 'og min stug po 96

bkod pa'i zhing khams suXbla na med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i go 'phang mchog dam pa brnyes te longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku mngon du mdzad/ skad cig de nyid la bye ba phrag brgya'i 'jig rten gyi khams su sprulaXba'i sku'i rnam par rol bas dga' ldan gyi gnas nas 'pho ba la sogs pa'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis rnam pa du mar cig char du ston par mdzad pa las/ 'dzam bu brik+ṣa'i ljon pas mtshon pa'i gling 'di nyid du ni rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du rgyal po zasaXgatsang ma zhes bya ba'i sras su nye bar bltams/ rgyal srid kyi phun tshogs kyang snyeng bo med par gzigs nas khyem nas mngon par byung ste nges par 'byung ba'i spyod pas dka' ba spyad de/ sa ga'i nya la babs pa na rdo rje'i gdan du byangaXchub kyi shing gi drung du gshegs te srod la bdud dmag bye ba dung phyur du ma byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis tshar bcad/ tho rangs mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i tshul bstan/ mi mjid kyi bdag po tshangs pas rtsibs stong dang ldan pa'i gser gyi 'khor lo phul nas chos 'khor bskor bar bskul bas sems can thams cad la rgyu med par gcig tu mnyes gshin pa'i sgo nas/ 'jig rten na makon dang skyabs ma mchis shing / ma rig pa 'thug pos blo mig rab tu g.yogs pa srid pa'i chu bo chen pos sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho gting mtha' med par khyer ba rnams/ nyid kyis brnyes pa'i bdud rtsi'i ro phul du byung bas tshim par mdzad par dgongs nas/ gdul bya rnams kyi khams dang bsam pa 97

dang bag la nyal dang mthun par chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa gsum du bskor nas chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong snyed du 'doms par mdzad de/ theg pa gsum gyi rigs can mtha' yas pa'i rmongs pa'i mun pa sel bar byed pa'i chos kyi sgron mes 'jig rten thams cad la thar ba dang thams cad macan pa'i lam snang bar mdzad do/ /de nas sku dngos kyi gdul bya rnams smin cing grol bar mdzad zin pa na gdul bya rtag 'dzin can rnams chos la bskul ba'i phyir du/ 'od srung chen po la bstan paXgatad de mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan to//de nas kun dga' bo dang / nye bar 'khor dang / 'od srung chen po rnams kyis/ bka' thams cad mdo sde dang / 'dul ba dang / mngon pa'i sde snod gsum du bsdus so/ /theg pa chen po'i sdeXsnod ni/ rgyal gras kun tu bzang po dang / byams pa dang / 'jam dbyangs la sogs pas bsdus shing / gsang sngagasaXni gsang ba'i bdag pos bsdus par grags so/ /bstan pa ni 'od srung chen pos kun dga' bo sogs laXrim par gtad de thub pa nyi ma'i gnyen gyi bstan pa 'jig rten gyi mig tu gyur pa 'di nyid mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan du byas shing / theg pa chen po'i gsung rab phal mo che zhig ni lha dang klu'i yul du spyan drangs shing dar bar gyur pa las/ phyis su bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis lung bstan pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed chen po 'phags pa na ga rdzu nas klu'i yul nas yum 'bum pa la sogs pa spyan 98

'dren par mdzad cing / 'phags pa thogs med kyis lha'i yul du byon nas rje btsunaXmi pham pa las theg pa chen po'i chos mang du gsan zhing mi yul du spyan drangs te/ de gnyi kas theg pa chen po'i sde snod mang du brtsams/ ma rtogs pa dang log par rtogs pa'i dri ma rnams rigs pa'i tshul rnam par dag pas bsal nas zab pa dang rgya che ba'i lam bzang bo shin tu gsal bar byas so/ /shing rta'i srol chen po 'di dag las rim par brgyud de theg pa gsum gyi sde snod rnams bshad pa dang sgrub pas 'dzin cing spel ba'i paṣ+ṭa ta dang grub pa thob pa gnam gyi skar ma lha bus rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du gang zhing thub pa'i bstan pa shin tu dar bar gyur to//phyis su rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi gdul bya'i zhing khams ma hā tsi na'i yul du ni/ sngon ci'u zhes pas rgyal srid 'dzin pa'i skabs su/lho nub mtshams nas nam mkhar 'od kyi phung bo chen po zhig byung ba/ rgyal pos ltas mkhan rnams la dris par/ phyogs der skyes bu dam pa zhig 'khrungs pa'i ltas yin cing da nas lo stong tsam na de'i lugs 'dir rgyas par 'grur zhes lung bstan/ phyis su han ming rdi rgyal po'i ring la/ skabs shig rgyal po'i rmi lam du skyes bu gser gyi kha dog can 'dom gsum lhag pa nyi ma'i 'od zer 'phro ba zhig nam mkha' nas pho brang gi yang thog tu phebs pa zhig mis pa/ phyi nyin ci yin snyam du blon po rnams la dris shing 99

yig rnying k+kog pas sngar gyi lung bstan de rnyed nas ngo mtshar zhing / mi ring bar rgya gar nas dus la babs par shes nas dgra bcom pa gcig dang /par+bhe ta gcig ste gnyis kyis sku dang thugs kyi rten 'ga' zhig dang /gsung rab mang bo spyan drangs nas rgya nag tu phebs rdzu 'phrul mang du bstan/ gnyug mar gnas pa'i bon po rnams tshar bcad pas mchog dmanaXmatha' dag mos par gyur/ de nas brtsams te rim gyis paṇa grub mang du byon nas rgyal ba'i bka' dang bstan bcos rnams rang gi skad du bsgyur shing gtan la phabs/ bshad snyub kyi sde mang du btsugs te bstan pa rinaXpo che dar rgyas su gyur pa da lta'iXbar du gnas so/ /'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi gdul ba'i zhing bams kha ba can gyi ljongs spur rgyal bod kyi rgyal khams su bstan pa dar tshul ni/ bod rje'i thog ma gnya' khri btsan po yin la/ de nas rgyal rabs nyer drug pa chos rgyal tho tho ri gnyanaXbatsan gyi dus su dam pa chos kyi dadu brnyes/ de nas rgyal rabs lnga ba chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i dus su jo shāka sogs lha rten mang du spyan drangs te gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa dang thon mi sam sgo ṭa rgya gar du brdzangs/ bram ze li byin dang lha rig pa'i seng ge sogs las yi ge dang bstan bcos mang du bsgabs/ des bod du phebs nas rgya gar gyi yi ge la yul skad kyiXdabang gis snon bri cung zad byas te dbyangs yig bzhi dang gsal byedaXsum curaXgatan la phabs te bod yig brtsams/100

sum cu ba dang rtags kyi 'jug pa sogs yi ge'i bstan bcos kyang mdzad/thugs rje chen po'i chos skor dang mdo sde dkon mchog sprin sogs bka' dang bstan bcos 'ga' zhig kyang bsgyur te dam pa'i chos mang du bsgyur ba'i srol btod/ de nas rgyal rabs drug pa khri srong lde btsan gyi dus su mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho dang slob dpod pad+ma sam bha wa sogs paṇa grub spyan drangs/ sbas rat+na sogs sad mi mi bdun rab tu byung / mdo rgyud bstan bcos bgrang las 'das pa bsgyur/ chos grwa chen po bcuXganyis dang sgom grwa du ma btsugs pa sogs bstan pa'i bya ba rgya cher mdzad/ khri ral ba can gyi skabs sngar yab mes kyi dus su bsgyur ba'i chos rnams la zhu gtugs mdzad de skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phabs/ dge 'dun gyi bsnyen bkur dang dge bcu'i khrims 'cha' ba sogs bod gling thams cad dkar bo dge ba'i lam la bkod/ de ltar sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyin mo ltar gsal ba bar skabs su bdud kyis yid bslad pa'i rgyal po sdig can gyi dbang gisaXcung zad 'grib par gyur pa slar yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid chen po rnams kyi thugs bskyed rlabs po che'i mthu las mdo khams smad nas bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal sogs kyis bstan pa'i me ro gsos pa las rim gyis bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa dar zhing / khyad par du gnas lnga rig pa'i pani ta byang chub kyi sems kyis thugs rgyud gtams pa dpal ldan a ti sha dī paṃ ka ra shritshwa na zhes yongs 101

su grags pa de nyid bodaXchos rgyal gyi gdung rgyud lha bla ma ye shes 'odalnga dbon gyis 'bad pa chen pos sprun drangs/ bod du phebs nas byang chub lam gyi sgron ma sogs mdzad de rgyal ba'i bstan pa la ma rtogs pa dang log par rtogasaXpa'i dri ma mtha' dag bsal nas bstan pa rin po che yongs su rdzogs pa legs par byi dor byas te gsal bar mdzad/ sras kyi thu bo khu rngog 'brom gsum sogs kyis bshad sgrub gnyi kas bstan pa bskyangs pas jo boXbaka' gdams pa zhes pa'i rnam thar gtsang ma'i tshad du 'khyol bas bod yul mdzesaXpar byas/ gzhan yang dpal ldan sa skya baXyab sras dang grub dbang mar ba yab sras sogs las kyang rim par ༷brgyud pa'i bshad pa dang sgrub pa'i sde mang du tshugs shing / mkhas grub tshad ldan du mas gangs ri'i ljongs yongs su gang bar grur/ phyis su rgyal sras dam pa rnams kyi nang nas kyang snying stobs dang rnam dpyod phul du byung ba rje btsun brtan pa'i 'khor lo nyid ngur sprig gi zlos gar 'chang ba'i tshul du rolaXshing mthon mthing ral ba'i thor cog ni paṇa zhwa gser gyi mdog canaXdu mdzad de bstan pa'i bdag por gyur pa rje rgyal ba gnyis pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyis dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang du bsten/ phyi nang gi grub mtha' spyi dang nang ba'i grub mtha' bzhi'i khyad par phra mo dag la'ang rigs pa dri ma med pa'i sgo nas zhib tu sbyangs pas grub mtha' rgya mtsho lta bu'iXpha rol tu phyin/ rig gnas mdo sngags thams cad la thos 102

bsam bsgoms pas grub pa'i rtogs pa mchog brnyes/ yi dam gyi lha du ma'i zhal gzigs/ rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs las zab rgyas kyi gdams pa mang du gsan/ 'chad rtsod rtsom pas sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi'i gsung rab mtha' yasaXpa gdul bya rnams la 'doms par mdzad pas shākya'i ring lugs dri ma medaXpa nyin mo ltar gsal bar gyur to/ /de nyid kyi sras kyi thu bo rgyal tshab mkhas grub sogs 'phags yul gyi 'dzam gling rgyan drug lta bu du mas rje nyid kyiXbazhed srol ji lta ba bzhin rim par bskyangs/ rje btsun de nyid kyi bka' drin las mdo sngags bshad sgrub thams cad phan tshun 'gal ba med par gcig grogs su gcig 'char ba'i sgo nas rang gzhan thams cad kyi don legs par sgrub nus pa'i mkhas pa dang grub pa'i skye bo du mas sa steng thams cad mdzes par gyur zhing kun macan bu ram shing ba'i ring lugs zla ba yar gyi ngo ltar 'phel ba 'di bzhin lags so//chen po hor gyi yul du ni sngon gnam gyi bu bur to cho nor grags pa ༷ las/ mi rabs dgu ba du bun mer gen 'das rjes nag mo e lan yugs sar gdas pa la/ nam mkha' nas 'ja' 'od lta bu zhig byung ba lus la phog pa las bde ba sbong ste/ mngal du sems can chags pa btsas nas po tog char du grags/ de las mi rabs dgu ba yi su khe'i bā thur gyi sras su gnam bskos sa yi tshangs pa ching gi si 'khrungs/ yangs pa'i rgyal khams 103

phal mo cher mnga' bsgyur shing / de nyid kyi rigs las rgyal po khro go ta'i sras gnyis pa rgyal bu go dan gyis rig pa'i gnas lnga la sbyangs pa mthar phyin pa'i malas pa chen po sa skya paṣ+ṭi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po spyan drangs te mchod yon du 'brel nas bstan pa'i dbu brnyes/ho pi li se chen rgyal po'i dus su rje btsun de nyid kyi rigs dbon 'gro ba'iXmagon po chos rgyal 'phags pa gdan drangs teXgo ṭī ste rgyal bo'i dbu blar mnga' gsol/ chos zhus pa'i yon bod chol kha gsum dang zang zing mang du phul/ gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa dang dge 'dun gyi sde 'dzugs pa/ nyan bshad sgom spub byed pa sogs bstan pa'i srol legs par btsugs/ hor yig gsar du brtsams na'ang cung zad ma tshang bas dam pa'i chos mang du bsgyur ba sogs ma byung 'dug ha'i sang khu lug rgyal po'i dus su kun macan chos sku 'od zer gdan drangs/ 'di la chos kyi 'od zer yang zer ba 'dug cing / gser ldings pa gzhon nu 'od kyi sras yin min brtag par bya zhing / dus thog 'grig par snang la kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zeraXsku na so phra ba'i skabs kyi mtshan chos kyi 'od zer la chos rgyal 'phags pas chos sku 'od zer zhes bsgyur bar khong gi rnam thar las 'byung ba dang yang 'grig par snang ngo / /des sngar brtsams pa'i hor yig la bsnon dgos pa rnams bsnan nas tshang bar byas mdo dang bstan ༷ bcos mang duXbasgyur ba'i srol btod/ bu yan thu rgyal po'i ring la bcom 104

ldan rig ral gyi slob ma mkhas pa chen po 'jam dbyangs pa spyan drangs te mchod gnas mdzad/ 'dis rgyu rkyen sbyaraXte snar thang gi bstan 'gyuraXbazhengs/ phyis su thu med alaXthan rgyal po'i ring la rgyal dbang thams cad macan pa bsod nams rgya mtsho gdan drangs gson gshin gyi dge bar rlom pa'i srog gcod pa sogs chos log tu spyod pa rnams 'dor du bcug gtsug laka khang chen po bzhengs/ 'bangs noms chos mthun gyi dge ba la sbyor ba sogs mdzad de/ dpal mnyam med ri bo dge ldan pa dang mchod yon du 'brel bar gyur/ de'i cung rjes tsam la paṣ+ṭa ta bhā ke thu ku shrī chos rjes yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum sogs sog skad du bsgyur/ cha kar gyi legs ldan hu thug thu'i ring la yang kun dga' 'od zer sogs lo tsā mang du bsags nas bka' 'gyur ro cog sogs chos mang du bsgyur bar grags la/ de dag nas brtsams te da lta'i bar du chos bsgyuraXb dang 'chad nyan byed pa sogs chos lugs legs par 'phel bsaXhoraXgyi yul stsongs thams cad dkar po dge ba'i lam la gnas shing mchog gsum bla mar 'dzin pa'i dad pa dang gtong ba sogs ya rabs kyi spyod tshulaXl shin tu brtson par gyur to//khyad par du 'u cag chen po ching gi rgyal rabs 'di la bsod nams stobs kyis bla na 'phags pa phe'i tsung pog to rgyal po nug ten gyi sar bzhugs skabs snang mtha'i sprul ba paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan 105

dang / rgyal dbang lnga ba chen pos se chenaXchos rjer grags pa mngags/bstan pa la thugs kyis dgongs dgos tshul zhus pas pog to rgyal po shin tu dgyes/ bod la rgyal ba yab sras la 'bul ba dang bshad sgrub kyi sde che chung mtha' yas pa la 'bul 'gyed gya nomaXpa mdzad de ri bo dge ldan ༷ pa'i bstan pa la lhag par mos paraXgyur/ mi ring bar de'i sras gong ma shi tsu shun ṭi rgyal pos rgya bod hor gsum gyis mtshon pa'i gnam 'og gi skye 'gro phal mo che dbang du bsdus/ 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyub dang gnyis su med pa'i rgyal dbang lnga ba chen po pho zang duXspyan drangs/ gtsug lag khang)mngaXdu bzhengs/ rgyal dbang de nyid bstan pa'i bdag por mnga' gsol te lung las kyis gzengs bstod pa sogs rgyal ba thub pa'i dbang po'i bstan pa la sri zhu lhag par mdzad/ de'i sras gang gi dpal dang gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pas sngon dus che sor 'gying ba'i sa bdag phal mo che'i snyems pa 'phrog cing / byams brtse'i stobs kyi gom pa mtha'i rgyal phrad bye ba'i cod pan la ngal gso ba'i sa skyong chen po 'jam ༷ dpal dbyangs dngos gong ma shing tsu bde skyid rgyal pos dge 'dun gyi sde mang du btsugs/ sku gsung thugs rten bgrangaXlas 'das pa bzhengs/mkhas grub tshad ldan du ma yul gru so so nas gdan drangs te bstan pa rgyas par byed du bcug gnam 'og gi skye 'gro spyi dang khyad par hor gyi skye bo mtha' dag la gcig tu brtse ba'i sgo nas/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro 106

cog hor gyi skad du bsgyur ba rnams la mkhas pa du mar zhu gtugs kyis gtan la legs par 'beb tu bcug steXpar du bsgrubs nas dad pa dang skal bar ldan pa rnams la chos sbyin gyi sgo 'phar brgya phrag phye ste tshim par mdzad pa sogs rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che 'di nyid mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan du mdzad do//de rjes 'jam dpal non po mi rje'i gar gyis rol ba gong ma shi tsung yong ṭing rgyal pos dkon mchog gsum gtsug tu mchod/ zhwa— ser cod panaX'achang ba'i ringaXlugs bla nas blar spel bar mdzad cing bstan pa'i bya ba mdzad tshul ni snga ma ji lha ba bzhin la/ khyad par du bdag po 'di nyid zab mo dbu ma'i lta ba nyams su bzhes pa zhig go /gnam 'og gi chab 'bangs mtha' dag la brtse ba chen pos chos srid zung du 'brel ba'i bka' khrims bzang pos bde bar bskyangs/ bstan bcos 'grur ro cog gi par gsar du bsgrubs pa sogs mkhas pas gcig tu bsngags par 'os pa'i mdzad pas nor 'dzin gyi can dge legs kyis khyab par mdzad do/ /de nas da lta'i gong ma chen po 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa 'di nyid kyis yab mes kyi srol bzang po gong nas gong du 'phel ba dang / chabaX'abangs mtha' dag la thugs shin tu brtse bas bde bar skyong ba'i thabs 'ba' zhig thugs la brnag pas bstan 'gro'i sman yon du 'gyur ba'i mdzad pa rlabs po che 'phel bzhinaXpa nas/ bye brag hor sog spyi la mchog 107

tu sman par dkongs te/ nye lam bka' yi dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos 'gyur ro cog hor gyi skad du bsgyur te par du bskrun dgos tshul gyi bka' phabs par brten/ bka' spyi bos blangs te bsgyuraXb la nye bar zhugs so/ /de la yang chen po hor gyi yul gru so so'i skad kyi byings 'dra yang /zur cung zad tsam re mi 'dra ba mang zhing / khyad par du chos bsgyur ba'i ming brda' 'dogs tshul bkas bcad 'dra ba zhig mi 'dug pas/ lo tsā ba du mas so sor rang rang gi 'dodaXpas tha snyad mi mthun pa sna tshogs sbyar tshe thos bsam byed pa rnams kyis rtogs dka' ba sogs nyes pa du ma'i gzhir 'gyur bas gsung rab kyi ming brda'i tha snyad 'dogs lugs rags bsdus zhig sbyar nas par du bsgrubs te/ kun la khyab par byas na legs tshul zhus par de ltar gyis zhes pa'i bka'aXstsal ba spyi bos mnos te/tshul de 'god par bya ba la/ de yang bod kyi yi ge'i 'jug tshul sogs spyi'i rnam bzhag ston pa thon mi sasto ṭas mdzadaXpa'i sum cu baXdang rtags kyi 'jug pa/ khri ral ba canaXgyi dusaXsu lo paṇa rnams kyis chos bsgyur tshul bkas bcad du mdzad pa sgra sbyoraXbam gnyis/ ka cog sogs lo tsā ba du mas mdoXlas 'byung ba'i ming gi rnam bzhag du ma bsdus pa bye brag rtogs byed che chung / gzhan yang stag ston gzhon nu dpal gyi dag yig 'od zer brgya ba/ bu ston seng ge 'od kyi sgraXdon rgya mtsho'i me long / byams pa gling ba'iXsmra rgyan bsam ldings pa'i 'khrul sgong / zha lu lo chen gyi za ma tog108

dpal khang lo tsā ba'i ngag sgron/ brda' gsar rnying gi rnam bzhag ston pa skyogs ston gyi li shi'i gur khang dang dbus pa blo gsal gyis mdzad pa/blo ldan shes rab kyi nyer mkhoXbasdus pa/ gzhan yang dam pa mang pos mdzad pa'i sum rtags kyi ṭik+ka sogs mang du yod pa las 'dir ni de dag rnams las 'byung ba'i ming dang brda'i rnam bzhag dang / brda' gsar rnying gi dbye ba sogs che long dang rig gnas so so'i gzhung bsgyur ba la nye bar mkho ba'i rang rang gi skabs kyi med du mi rung ba'i ming gi rnam grangs rnams ji ltar nus pa bzhin du le tshan so sor bri bar bya'o//de la spyir rgyal ba'i gsung rab rin po che ni thog mtha' bar gsum du dge ba/ grol baXdon du gnyer ba rnams la thar ba dang thams cad macan pa'i lam gsal bar byed pa'i mig tu gyur pa sha stag yin pas/sgyur byed lo tsā rnams kyis kyang tshul 'di nyid 'jig rten du yun ring du gnas na ci ma rung snyam pa'i bsam pas thub bstan gces par 'dzin pa 'ba' zhig yid la brnags te/ khe 'dod dang grags 'dod phyogs su lhung ba'i yid spangs/ gzu bo'i blos tshig dang don gyi cha la legs par dpyad/rang gis ji lta ba bzhin ma shes pa rnams mkhas par grags pa mchog dman su la yang rungaXste legasaXpar dris shing the tshom bcad nas/ tshig gsal zhing go bde ba don dang mi 'galaXbar byas te legs par bsgyur na/rang gzhan gyi rgyud la legs tshogs du ma spel bar nus zhing / rgyal ba'i 109

bstan pa la bya ba byas par 'gyur bas bsod nams kyi phung bo gzhal du med pa 'thob par 'gyur gyi/ gzhan du na rang nyid mkhas pa min kyang mkhas par rlom pas dregs/ gzhan mkhas par gyur kyang de la phyogs su lhung ba'i yid kyis sdang bas blo mig bsgribs/ dam pa'iXchosaXl gal chung du bzung bas nyi ma 'phul thabs kyi sbyor bas po ti ji mang mang du bsgyur ba la dga' ba dag gis ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' dri ma med pa log bshad nyes bshad kyi btsog chus bslad pa'i 'bras bu rang gzhan kun la 'di phyir bzod par dka' ba'i sdug bsngal 'byungaXb laXcir yang mi sems par zad do/ /de ltar phan yon dang nyes dmigs legs par nges par byas nas bsgyur tshul dngos la/ gzhung gi tshig rnams bod skad kyi go rim ji lta baXbazhin du bsgyur na hor skad la go bde zhing / don 'khrugs par mi 'byur ba rnams ni de ji lta ba bzhin du bsgyur bar bya zhing / de lta ma yin par tshig gong 'og bsnor na don go ba gsal zhing brjod bde ba rnams ni tshigs bcad yin na sh+lau ka gcig gi nang du gang bde bar snor zhing bsgyur ba dang / chi ga lhug pa rnams ni tshig gcig gam gnyis sam gsum sogs tshig de dag gi don gang du bsnyegs pa yan chad du gang bde bar snor zhing bsgyur bar bya/ 'on kyang don snga phyi 'khrugs par mi 'gyur ba gal che la/ de yang tshig de ka'i nus paX'adon lugs la legs par brtags 110

dgos so/ /yang 'ga' zhig bod skad ji lha ba bzhin bsgyur na hor yig la tshig lhag ha cang mang bas don gyiXcha bsgribs pa lta bu yang mang du yod pas/ de la ni don la mi gnod par byas teXtshig lhag noms dor bas chog la/ skabs 'ga' zhig tu tshig zur cung zad re ma bsnan na don gyi nus pa mi rdzogs pa lha bu yang yod pas/ de la ni don gsal ba la phan zhing tshig ror ma song ba'i skad zur bsnan nas bsgyur bar bya'o/ /ming gcig don du ma la bsnyeg tu rung ba rnams ni ltag 'og la legs par brtags te/ phyogs gcig la thag gcod du rung na gar bsnyegs pa der bsgyur la/thag gcod du mi rung zhing hor skad la phyogs gnyi kar bsnyegs pa'i skad dod ma rnyed na ni bod skad bor gnas su bzhag par bya'o/ /yang paṇa grubaXdang rgyal blon la sogs pa'i gang zag gi ming dang yul dang me tog dang rtsi shing la sogs pa'i ming bsgyur na go dka' zhing tshig mi bde ba dang /'ol byir bsgyur du rung mang don de ltar yin min gtol med pa rnams la ni ming gi mgo mjug ji ltaraXrigs par palha ta dang rgyal po dang / me tog zhes sogs gang la bya ba'i ming gcig bla thabs suXbasnan nas rgya gar skad dam bod skad sor bzhag tu bzhag par bya'o/ /gzhung chen mo'i 'grel ba rnams la rang rang gi rtsa ba'i dpe sngar bsgyur zin pa yod na 'grel ba'i nang giXrtsa ba'i tshig kyang de dang mthud par bya la/ med na sngon du rtsa ba'i dpe bsgyur zhing de yang 'grel ba la bstun nas bsgyur bar ༷ 111

bya'o/ /snga rgol phyir rgol gyi rtsod pa'i tshig rnams ni phan tshun gnyi ka'i bsam pa'i gdengs dang rtsod pa 'gro lugs legs par brtags te bsgrub ngag dang sun 'byin pa'i ngag rno zhing go bde ba'i tshig gis bsgyur dgos so/ /gzhan yang bstod pa'i tshig dang / smad pa'i tshig dang / ngo mtshar ba'i tshig dang / skyo bar 'gyur ba'i tshig dang / 'jigs pa'i tshig lta du rnams la ni/ hor skad du kun la grags pa nus pa che zhing yid 'khul btub pa skabs su babs pa'i tshig gis bsgyur bar bya'o/ /gzhung gis don legs par ma shod pa'am log par bshad par mngo—/ pa 'ga' zhig 'dug na'ang gzhung rtsom pa pos ji ltar brtsams pa ltar bsgyur bar bya yi/gzhung gzhan gyi legs par bshad pa las blangs te 'chos paraXmi bya ste/gal te de ltar byas na slob dpon rnams kyi lugs so so ba rnams 'khrug par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /gdams ngag gi gzhung rnams su lha dang rdzas dang grangs sogs kyi ming gab tshig gzhan gyis bostad pa rnams ni de jiltaXb bzhin bsgyur bar bya yi/ rang ming rjen par mi bsgyuraXte/ de ltar na gab pa'i dgos pa med par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /yang snyan dngags kyi skabs su mngon brjod kyi ming gis bstan pa bong bu la mgrin bzang zhes pa lta bu yang ming de nyid kyis bsgyur bar bya yi rang ming gis mi bsgyur te/gzhan du na mi mdzes par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang rtsa ba'i rnamaXshes dang kun gzhi zhes pa gnyis don bsnyegs pa'i gzhi phal cher gcig 112

yin kyang phal chen sde ba dang sems tsam pa gnyis kyis ming 'dogs lugs dang bshad tshul cung zad mi 'dra ba lta bu rnams kyang rang rang gi gzhung las ji ltar 'byung ba ltar bsgyur bar bya yi/ don gcig pa bsams nas tha snyad phan tshun bsre bar mi bya'o/ /yang bden par grub pa dang / rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pa gnyis dbu ma thal 'astsar ba ltar na don gcig pas gcig yong sar gcig shos su bsgyur chog pa'i skabs yod mod kyang / dadu ma rang rgyud pa ltar na de gnyis shin tu mi 'dra bas don gcig par byed mi rung ba lta bu yang mang bas/ legs par dpyad nas rang rang gi lugs ltar bsgyur shes dgos so/ /gzhan yang bdag med dang bden med gnyis kyang dbu ma ba ltar na 'gangs 'dra na yang /grub mtha' 'og ma'i skabs su chos thams cad bdag med par khas len kyang bden med du khas mi len pa sogs kyi khyad par 'gangs che ba rnams kyang byed dgos te/ gzhan du na phyogs gcig la don gcig tu bshadaXpa mthong bas skabs thams cad du don gcig par bzung nas ma brtag par tha snyad phan tshun bsres na grub mtha' rnams kyi mi 'dra ba'i khyad par mtha' dag 'chol bar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang grub pa/ bsgrubs pa/ 'grub pa/ zhes dang / bcom/ gzhom/ 'joms zhes pa lta bu 'das pa dang da lta ba dang ma 'ongasaXpa'i tshig gi khyad par rnams dang / 'dis rnyed pa dang / 'di rnyed pa lta bu byed pa dang / las kyi sgras bstan pa'i khyad 113

par dang / sangs rgyas kho na yon tan dang ldan zhes dang / sangs rgyas yon tan dang ldan pa kho na zhes pa lta bu kho na zhes pa'i sgra tshig gi gong 'og tu 'jug pa'i khyad par gyis gzhan ldan rnam gcod dang / mi ldan rnam gcod kyi tshig tu 'gyur tshul dang / 'phral ba zhes pa brda' gsar la so sor phye ba'i don la 'jug na'ang brda' rnying la dpral ba'i skad don yin pa lta bu sogs mang du yod pa rnams legs par ltag 'og la brtags nas bsgyur dgos so//gzhan yang hor skad la tshigs bcad dang lhug pa'i khyad par dang /tshigs bcad kyang rkang ba ring thung snyoms pa sogs bod skad ji lta ba bzhin mi 'byung na'ang tshigs su bcad pa rnams ni snyan 'jebs don rdzogs pa go sla ba rkang ba ring thung yang phal cher stoms pa bya zhing bstod pa dang gsol 'debs lta du 'ga' zhig la hor skad la grags pa'i mgo mtshungs kyi rgyan lta bu byas kyang 'gal ba med la/ gzhung chen mo rnams la ni de ltar mi bya ste/ gzhan du na tshig lhag mang du 'jug pas don bsgribs par 'gyur bas so/ /gzhan yang brda' sbyor gyi gzhung 'di dang gzhan dag tu ma 'byung ba'i brda' gsar du sbyor dgos pa byung na rang rang gi sar 'dod pas rang dgar mi 'dogs par bsgyur ba'i grwar gtugs te gzhung dang gtan tshigs dang mi 'gal bar bsgyur bar bya'o/ /de dag ni gleng gzhi dang chos bsgyur tshul bkas bcad mdo tsam mo/ /114

da ni gzhung don dngos la 'jug par bya ste/ de la gnyis/ rig pa'i gnas lnga soXso'i gzhung bsgyur ba la mkho ba'i ming gi rnam grangs bstan paXdang / thun mong la mkho ba'i brda' gsar rnying gi dbye ba sogs bshad pa'o/ /dang po la lnga/ nang rig pa dang / gtan tshigs rig pa dang / sgraXrig pa dang / bzo rig paXdang / gso ba rig pa'i gzhung bsgyur baXl mkho ba'i ming gi rnam grangs bstanaXpa'o/ /dang po la/ mtshan nyid kyi theg pa dang / sngags kyi beg pa gnyis las dngaXpo la/ phar phyin dang / dbu ma dang / mngon pa dang / 'dul ba dang / grub mtha' spyi'i gzhung bsgyuraXb la mkho ba'i ming gi rnam grangs bstan pa dang lnga las/dang po/ — phar phyin gyi ga'ung gi brjod bya'i gtso bo dngos po brgyad la don bdun cus ston pas/ dang po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la mtshon byed kyi chos bcu las dang po theg chen sems bskyed ni/ sa lta bu'i sems bskyed/ gser/ zla ba/ me/ gter/ rin chen 'byung gnas/ mtsho/rdo rje/ ri/ sman/ bshes gnyen/ yid bzhin nor bu/ nyi ma/ glu/ rgyal po/mdzod/ lam po che/ bzhon pa/ bkod ma'i chu/ sgra snyan/ chu bo/ sprin lta du'i semasaXbaskyed de nyeraXganyis/ yang na sbon pa'i sems dang / 'jug pa'i sems gnyis/ yang na mos pa spyod pa/ lhag bsam dag pa/ rnam par smin pa/ sgrib pa spangs pa'i sems bskyed de bzhi/ yang phyugs rdziXlta du/mnyan pa lta bu/ rgyal po lta bu'i sems bskyed de gsum/ yang kun rdzob 115

dang / don dam sems bskyed gnyis/ rags pa brda' las byung ba dang /chos nyid kyis thob pa'i sems bskyed de gnyis rnams so/ /gnyis pa theg chen baspub pa'iXgadams ngag la/ baspub pa'i ngo bo la gdams pa/ bden pa bzhi/ dkon mchog gsum/ ma zhen pa/ yongs su ngal ba med pa/ lam yongs su 'dzin pa/ spyan lnga/ mngon shes drugamathong lam/ sgom lam la gdams pa dang bcu'o/ /'di'i spyan lnga dab mngon shes drug dge 'dun nyi shu'i ming gi skor rnams ni mngon pa'i skabs su balha bar bya'o/ /gaspum pa nges 'byed yan lag la/ sbyor lam drod/ rtse mo/ bzod pa/chos mchog bzhi/ dmigasaXpa/ rnam pa/ rgyu/ yongs su 'dzin pa/ spang bya rnam rtog ngo bo che 'bring chung gsum gyi sgo nas khyad par du 'phags pa ste khyadaXchos drug go /rnam rtog bzhi ni/ kun nas nyon mongs gzung rtog dang / rnam byang gzung rtog gnyis rdzas su yod pa dang / btags par yod par 'dzinaXpa'i 'dzin rtog gnyis te bzhi'o//bzhi ba sgrub pa'i rten rang bzhin gnasaXrigs la/ rtogs pa'i chos drug dang / gnyen po dang spang ba'i sgrub pa/ spang bya yongs su gtugs pa/shes rab/ snying brtse ba/ thun mong ma yin pa/ gzhan don go rim du byed pa/ ye shes rtsol ba mi mnga' bar 'jug pa'i sgrub pa ste sgrub pa bcu gsum gyi rten rigs bcu gsum mo/ /yang rang bzhin gnas rigs dang rgyas 116

'gyur gyi rigs gnyis/ lugs gzhan nyan rang byang sems kyi rigs gsum dang / nges pa'i rigs/ ma nges pa'i rigs/ rigs chad dang drug tu bshad do//lnga ba theg chen bsgrub pa'i dmigs pa la/ dge ba dang / mi dge ba dang / lung du ma bstan pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa dang / ma 'das pa dang / zag bcas dang / zag med kyi chos dang / 'dus byas dang / 'dus ma byas pa dang / thun mong dang thung mong ma yin pa'i chos te bcu gcig go /drug pa theg chen bsgrub pa'i ched du bya ba la sems chen po dang /sgong ba chen po dang / rtogs pa chen po ste gsum mo/ /bdun pa go cha'i sgrub pa la sbyin pa nas shes rab kyi bar gyi go sgrub drug go /brgyad pa 'jug pa'i bsgrub pa la/ bsam gtan dang gzugs med pa'i snyoms 'jug la 'jug pa dang / sbyin sogs dang / 'phags pa'i lam/tshad med pa/ mi dmigs pa dang ldan pa/ 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa/ched du bya ba/ mngon par shes pa/ rnam pa thams cad mang pa nyid la 'jug pa ste dgu'o/ /'di'i bsam gtan gzugs med dang zhi lhag gi skor rnams mngon pa'i skabs su blta'o/ /dgu ba tshogs kyi bsgrub pa la/ brtse ba'i tshogs kyi basprub pa/ sbyin 117

sogs drug zhi gnas/ lhag mthong / zhi lhag zung 'brel/ thabs la mkhas pa/ ye shes/ bsod nams/ lam/ gzungs/ sa bcu/ gnyen po'i tshogs kyi sgrub pa ste bcu bdun no/ /'di'i gzungs la bzod pa/ chos/don/ sngags kyi gzungs te bzhi/ sngags la rig sngags/ gzungs sngags/gsang sngags gsum mo/ /'di'i skabs kyi stong nyid bcu drug dngaXs bcu sogs dbu ma'i skabs su blta bar bya'o//bcu ba nges 'byung basprub pa la/ ched du bya ba dang / mnyam pa nyid/sems can gyi don byedaXpa/ 'bad pa med pa/ mtha' las 'das pa/ donaXthobaXpa'i mtshan nyid/ rnam pa thams cad mang pa/ des khyad par gyiXlam gyis nges par 'byung ba ste brgyad do/ /mang pa yul gyi sprub pa/ sbyor ba bye brag gi bsgrub pa gnyis so//gnyis pa lam shes pa nyid la mtshon byed kyi chos bcu gcig las/dang po lamaXshes kyi yan lag la/ lam shes kyi snod rung du basprubs pa/yul nges pa/ rigs kyis khyab pa/ lam shes kyi rang bzhin/ lam shes kyi byed las te lnga'o/ /gnyis pa nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi skabs su bden bzhi'i rnam pa la/ sduka bden la mi rtag sdugaXbasngal/ stong / bdag med bzhi/ kun 'byung bdenaXpa la/ rgyu/ kun 'byung / rab skye/ rkyen bzhi/'gog bden la/ 'gog pa/ zhi ba/ gya nom/ nges 'byung bzhi/ lam bden118

la/ lam/ rig pa/ sgrub pa/ nges 'byin bzhi ste bcu drug go /gsum pa rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lamaXshes kyi skabs su/ rang rgyal la/ bse ru lta du dang / tshogs spyod che chung gnyis te gsum mo/ /bzhi ba theg chen mthong lam la/ bar chad med lam/ rnam grol lam gnyis/ mnyam bzhag dang / rjes thob ye shes gnyis/ 'da' bya dang /'da' byed kyi mthong lam gnyis/ shes bzod bcu drug mngon pa'i skabs su blta'o//lnga ba theg chen sgom lam gyi byed pa la/ nad zhi ba sogs drug ste sga'o/ /drug pa mos pa sgom lam la/ rang don/ gzhan don/ rang gzhan gnyis ka'i don gyi mos pa sgom lam ste gsum mo//bdun pa de'i phan yon la/ bstod pa/ bkur ba/ bsngags pa ste gsum mo//brgyad pa bsngo ba sgom lam la/ bsngo ba khyadaXpar can/ mi dmigs pa/phyin ci ma log pa/ dben pa/ sangs rgyas kyi bsod nams dran pa/ thabs dang bcas pa/ mtshan ma med pa/ rjes su yi rang ba/ khams gsum du ma gtogs pa/ chung 'bring chen po'i ming can te bcu gnyis so//dgu ba rjes su yi rang bsgom lam la/ thabs khyad par can dang /shes rab khyad par can gyis zin pa gnyis so/ /de rnams la zag bcasaXsgom lam zer ro//119

bcu ba sgrub pa sgom lam la/ ngo bo/ 'bras bu/ byed las/ gnas skabs kyi yon tan/ mtha'i yon tan gyis khyad par du byas pa lnga'o/ /bcu gcig pa rnam dag sgom lam la/ sa bcu'i bcu'o/ /'di gnyis ni zag med sgom lam mo/ /spyir mthong lam la bden paXmangon rtogs dang /sgom lam la rjes la mngon rtogs zhesaX'abyung ngo / /gsum pa gzhi thams cad shes pa nyid la mtshon byed kyi chos dgu las/ dang po shes pas srid la mi gnas pa ni/ kun rdzob la ltos pa'i srid mtha' 'gog byed do/ /gnyis pa snying rjes zhi la mi gnas pa ni/ kun rdzobaXl ltos pa'i zhi mtha' 'gog byed do/ /gsum pa thabs ma yin pas ring ba'iXgazhi shesaXso/ /bzhi ba thabs kyis ringaXb ma yin pa'i gzhi shes so/ /lnga ba mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes so/ /drug pa gnyen po phyogs kyi gzhi shes so/ /bdun pa gzhi shes sbyor ba la/ yul gyi sgo nas bzhi/ ngo bo'i sgo nas gsum/ byed pa'iXsgo nas gnyis/ dpe'i sgo nas gcig ste bcu/ 'di'i bya dka' rnam gsum ni/ ched du bya ba/ sbyor ba/ las bya dka' ba'o/ /snang ba rnam bdun ni/ thi lam/ sgyu ma/ smig rgyu/ sgra brnyan/ gzigs brnyan/ dri za'i grong khyer/ sprul ba'o/ /brgyad pa sbyoraXb de'i mnyam pa nyid laXgazugs sogs kyi ngo bo dang /mtshan nyid dang / dbye baXdang / yul can la zlom pa med pa'i bzhi'o/ /dgu ba mthong ba'i lam ste/ gzhi shes de ni thegaXdaman gyi rtogs 120

rigs su gnas pa'o//bzhi ba rnam kun mngon par rdzogs par rtogs pa la mtshon byed kyi chos bcu gcig las/ dang po rnam pa la/ med pa/ mi skye ba/ dben pa/ miXrdzi ba/ gnas med pa/ nam mkha'/ brjod du med pa/ ming med pa/ 'gro ba med pa/ mi 'phrogs pa/ mi zad pa/ skye ba med pa/ byed pa po med pa/shes pa po med pa/ 'pho ba po med pa/ 'dul ba po med pa/ ngo bo nyid med pa/ ma skyes pa/ ma 'gags pa/ gzod ma nas zhi ba/ rang bzhin gyis mya ngan las 'dasaXpa/ kun nas nyon mongs pa med pa/ rnam par byang baXmed pa/ gos pa med pa/ spros pa med pa/ rlom pa med pa/ mi g.yo ba'i rnam pa ste gzhi shes kyi rnam pa nyer bdun/ 'dod chags dang bral ba/ mi gnas pa/ zhi ba/ 'dod chags med pa/ zhe sdang med pa/ gti nug med pa/kun nas nyon mongs med pa/ sems can med pa/ tshad med pa/ mtha' gnyis dang ma 'brel ba/ tha mi dad pa/ mchog tu 'dzin pa med pa/ rnam par mi rtog pa/ gzhal du med pa/ chags pa med pa/ mi rtag sogs bzhi/mtshan nyid med pa/ stong nyid bcu drug ni dbu ma'i skabs su blta'o/ /nges lam shes kyi rnam pa so drug go /byad phyogs so bdun/ rnam thar gsum/ sprul ba'i lam gsum/ mthong chos bder gnas kyi lam lnga/ 'dasaXlam dgu/ spong lam bzhi rnams kyi ming mngon pa'iXskabs su blta'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi lam bcuXni/ phar phyin bcu/ stobs bcu/ mi 'jigs pa 121

bzhi/ soXso yang dag par rig pa bzhi/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dresaXbaco brgyad rnams chos skur blta'o/ /de bzhin nyid/ rang byung / sangs rgyas kyi rnam pa ste rnam macan gyi rnam pa brgya rtsa bcu rnams bsdoms pas mang gsum gye rnam pa brgya don gsum mo//gnyis pa sbyor ba la/ sbyor ba po ni sangs rgyas bsten pa sogs bzhi ste sla'o/ /sbyor ba dngos la/ mi gnas pa'i sbyor ba/ de bzhin du gnas pa bkag pa/ zab pa/ gting dpag dka' ba/ tshad med pa/ tshegs chen yun ring rtogs pa/ lung bstan pa/ phyir mi ldog pa/ nges par 'byung ba/ bar chad med pa/ byang chub la nye ba/ byang chub myur ba/ gzhan don/ 'phel 'grib med pa/ chos dang chos min sogs med pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa mi mthongaXb/ rnam par mi rtog pa/ 'bras bu rin chen sbyin byed/ rnam par dag pa/ sa 'tshams kyi sbyor ba dang nyi shu'o//gsum pa sbyor ba'i yon tan ni/ bdud kyiXmathu bcom pa sogs bcu bzhi dang / bzhi ba skyon ni/ 'gal rkyen rang la brten pa nyer gsum/mthun rkyen ma tshang ba rang gzhanaXgang rung la brten pa nyer gsum ste zhe drug 'di rnams ming 'dogs sga'o//lnga ba mtshan nyid la/ shes pa/ khyad par/ byed pa/ ngo bo nyid kyi mtshan nyid de bzhi'o/ /drug pa thar ba cha mthun ni/ tshogs lam che 'bring chung gsum mo/ /dad pa dang / drag pa dang / brtson 'grus dang / ting 'dzin 122

dang / shes rab phun sum tshogs pa ste yul lnga'o/ /dbang bo rno rtul gnyis ni/ chos kyi rjesaX'abrang dang / dad pa'i rjes 'brang gnyis so/ /bdun pa nges 'byed cha mthun ni/ sbyor lam ste sngar ltar ro/ /brgyad pa phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun la/ phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags zheXbazhi ste gzhan rnams sla la/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis ni/ bsod stoms pa/ stan gcig pa/ zas phyis miXlen pa/ chos gos gsum pa/ phying ba pa/ phyag dar khrod pa/ dgon pa pa/ shing drung pa/ gla gab med pa/ dur khrod pa/ tsog pu pa/ gzhi ji bzhin pa rnams so/ /dgu ba srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi sbyor ba'o/ /bcu ba zhing dag bla na med pa'i sbyor ba'o/ /bcu gcig pa thabs mkhas sbyoraXba'o/ /lnga ba rtse mo'i mngon par rtogs pa mtshon byed kyi chos brgyad las dang po rtse mo'i rtags ni/ rmi lam na yang chos thams cad rmi lam lta bur lta ba sogs rtags bcu gnyis te sga la/ drod rtse sbyor ro/ /gnyis pa rnam 'phel ni/ rtse mo'i rtse sbyor ro/ /gsum pa brtan pa ni/bzod pa'i rtse sbyor ro/ /bzhi ba sems kun gnas paXni/ chos mchog gi rtse sbyor ro/ /lnga ba mthong lam rtse sbyor la/ spang bya rtog pa ni/ ldog pa gzung rtog 'jug pa gzung rtog/ rdzas 'dzin rtog pa/ btags 'dzin rtog pa bzhi re re la'ang dgu re yod la/ longs spyad byar zhen pa/ longasaXspyod byed du zhen pa gnyis gzung 'dzin gyi khyad par ro/ /gzung rtog yin la 'dzin rtog ma yinaXpa sogs kyi nu bzhi yod/ mthong lam gyi 'bras bu ni/123

zad med skye med kyi byang chub chen po'o/ /skabs 'dir gang zag gi bdag med dang / gzung 'dzin rdzas gzhan gyis stong ba dang / chos thams cad bden med du rtogs pa'i nol 'byor gyi sa gsum bshad do/ /drug pa sgom lam rtse sbyor la/ mthar gnas stoms 'jug dgu/ seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ thod rgal gyi snyoms 'jug rnams las/ snyoms 'jug dgu dang rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi ming mngon pa'i skabs su blta'o/ /spang bya sgom spang gzungaX'adzin gyi rtog pa'o/ /bdun pa bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor ni/ rgyun mtha'i bar chadaXmed pa'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /brgyad pa bsal bya log sgrub la/ bden gnyis la brten pa'i log par rtogs pa bcu drug bsdu naXkun rdzob sgo can dang / don dam sgo can gyiXklan ka gnyis so/ /drug pa mthar gyis pa'i mngon par rtogs pa la mtshon byed rkye chos bcu gsum ni/ phar phyin drug sangs rgyas/ chos/ dge 'dun/ tshul khrims/ gtong ba/ lha rjes su dran pa drug dngos med ngo bo nyid kyi mthar gyis sbyor ba ste bcuXgasum mo/ /bdun pa skad cig ma'i sbyor ba la mtshon byed kyi chos bzhi ni/ rnam par smin pa ma yin pa/ rnam par sminaXpa/ mtshan nyid med pa/ gnyis su med pa'i skad cig sbyor te bzhi'o//124

brgyad pa chos sku la mtshon byed kyi chos bzhi las/ dang po ngo bo nyid sku la mtshan nyid lnga ni/ 'dus ma byas pa dang / dbyer med pa dang /mtha' gnyis spangs pa dang / sgrib pa gsum las grol ba dang / rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'o/ /yon tan lnga ni/ gzhal du med pa/ grangs med pa/ bsam du med pa/ mnyam pa med pa/ dri mas dag pa'o/ /khyad chos gsum ni/ zag med ye shes kyi sde tshan nyer gcig dang ldan pa'i khyad par/sgrib gnyis bag chags bcas pa dang bral ba'i khyad par/ rang bzhin bden pas stong ba'i ngo bo'i khyad par dang gaspum/ rang bzhin rnam dag gi char gyur pa dang / glo dur dri bral gyi char grur pa'i ngo bo nyid sku gnyis/'dus ma byas kyi sku/ rtag pa'i sku/ ngo bo nyid sku rnams don gcigaganyis pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skuXl/ nges pa lnga ni/ gnas 'og minaXstug po bkod pa kho nar bzhugs pa/ dus 'khor ba ma stong bar duXbazhugs pa/ sku mtshan dpe gsal rdzogs kyis spras pa/ 'khor theg chen 'phags pa sha stag gis bskor ba/ chos theg chen gyi chos 'ba' zhig gsungs pa rnams so/ /yon tan gyi khyad par lnga ni/ sku ston pa rgyun mi 'chad pa/ gsung brjod pa rgyun mi 'chad pa/ thugs mdzad pa rgyun mi 'chad pa/ 'bad rtsol gyi mngonaXpar 'du byed med pa/ sna tshogs spu snang yang bden par ma grub pa rnams so/ /mtshan nyid lnga ni/ gzhan dbang gnas 'gyur gyi mtshan nyid/ dkar po'i chos kyi rang bzhin gyi mtshan nyid/126

gnyis su med pa'i mtshan nyid/ rgyun gyis rtag pa'i mtshan nyid/ bsamaXgyisaXmi khyab pa'i mtshan nyid lnga'o/ /mtshan spum cu rtsa gnyis ni/ phyag zhabs 'khoraXlos mtshan pa/ zhabs rus sbal dang 'dra ba/ sor mo dra bas 'brel ba/ phyag zhabs 'jam zhing gzhon sha chags pa/ bdun dag mtho ba/ sor mo ring ba/ zhabs kyi rting ba yangs pa/ sku che zhing drang ba/ zhabs pus mo'i lha nga mi mngon pa/ baXspu re re nas gyen du phyogs pa/ byin pa ri dwags e na ya dang 'dra ba/ phyag ring zhing mdzes pa/ 'doms kyi sba ba spubs su nub pa/ pags pa gser mdog pags pa 'jam zhing srab pa/spu re re nas g.yas su 'khyil ba/ zhal mdzod spus brgyan pa/ ro stod seng ge 'dra ba/ dpung mgo skrum pa/ thal gong rgyas pa/ ro mi zhim pa'ang ro mchog tu snang ba/ zu gro ta ltar chu zheng gab pa/ dbu gtsug tor dang ldan pa/ ljags ring zhing mdzes pa/ gsung tshangs pa'i dbyangs 'dra ba/ 'gram pa seng ge 'dra ba/ tshems shin tu dkar ba/ tshems tshad mnyam pa/ tshems thags bzang ba/ tshems grangs bzhi bcu tshangaXb/ spyan mthon mthing 'dra ba/ spyan rdzi ba mchog gi 'dra ba rnams so/ /dpe byad brgyad cu ni/ sen mo zangs mdog lta bu/ sen mo'i mdog snum pa/ sen mo mtho ba/ sor mo klum pa/ sor mo rgyas pa/ sor mo byin gyis phra ba/ sku'i rtsa mi mngon pa/ rtsa mdud med pa/ long bu mi mngon pa/ zhabs mnyam pa/ seng ge dang / ngang ba dang / glang po che dang / khyu mchog gi stabs su gshegs pa/ g.yasaXphyogs 126

su gshegs pa/ mdzes par gshegs pa/ drang por gshegs pa/ sku 'khril bag chags pa/ sku byi dor byas pa 'dra ba/ sku rim par 'tshams pa/ sku gtsang ba/ sku 'jam pa/ rnam par dag pa/ mtshan yongs su rdzogs pa/ kho lag yangs shing bzang ba/ gom pa snyoms pa/ spyan dag pa/ sku gzhon sha can/ zhum pa med pa/ sku rgyas pa/ sku shin tu grims pa/ yan lag rnam par 'byes pa/ gzigs pa dag pa/ dku klum pa/ dku skabs phyin pa/dku ma rnyongs pa/ phyal phyang nge ba/ lte ba zab pa/ ri mo g.yas su 'khyil ba/spyod lam lta na sdug pa/ kun spyod gtsang ba/ spe ba gnag bag med pa/phyag shing bal lhar 'jam pa/ phyag ris mdangs yod pa/ ri mo zab pa ri mo ring ba/ zhal ha cang mi ring ba/ mchu bem pa ltar dmar ba/ ljags mnyen pa/ srab pa/ dmar ba/ gsung 'brug sgra lta bu/ gsung mnyen zhing 'jam pa/ mche ba klum pa/ no ba/ dkar ba/ mnyam pa/ byin gyis phra ba/shangs gzeng mtho ba/ dag pa/ spyan yangs pa/ rdzi ma snyug pa/ spyan pad+ma'i 'dab ma 'dra ba/ smin ma tshugs ring ba/ 'jam pa/ snum pa/ spuXmanyam pa/phyag ring zhing rgyas pa/ snyan mnyam pa/ dbang po ma nyams pa/ dpral ba legasaXpar 'byes pa/ dpral ba dbyes che ba/ dbu rgyas pa/ dbu skra dung ba ltar gnag pa/ stug pa/ 'jam pa/ ma 'dzings pa/ mi gshor ba/ dri zhimaXpas skyes du'i yid 'phrog par byed pa/ phyag zhabs dpal gyi be'u dang bkra shis kyi ri mos mtshanaXpa rnams so/ /mngon rtogs rgyan du med kyang 127
