mkho che bas gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu yang phyogs gcig tu 'bri bar bya'o/ /de ni mnyen pa/ 'jam pa/ yid du 'ong ba/ yid du 'thad pa/dag pa/ dri ma med pa/ 'od gsal ba/ snyan cing 'jebs pa/ mnyan par 'os pa/ mi tshugs pa/ snyan pa/ dul ba/ mi brlang ba/ rab tu dul ba/rnaraXsnyan pa/ lus sim par byed pa/ sems sim par byed pa/ snying dga' bar byed pa/ dga' bde bskyed pa/ gdung ba med pa/ kun shes par bya ba/rnam par rig par bya ba/ rnam par gsal ba/ dga' bar byed pa/ mngon par dga' bar byed pa/ kun shes par byed pa/ rnam par rig par byed pa/ rigs pa/ 'brel ba/ zlos skyon med pa/ seng ge'i sgra'i shugs can/glang po che'i sgra skad/ 'brug gi skad/ klu'i dbang po'i sgra/ dri za'i glu dbyangs/ ka la ping ka'i sgra dbyangs/ tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs/ shangaXshang te'u'i sgraXdabyangs/ lha'i dbang po'i dbyangs ltar snyan pa/ rnga'i sgra/ ma 'khengs pa/ mi dma' ba/ sgra thams cad kyi rjes su 'jug pa/ tshig zur phyin pa/ ma tshang ba med pa/ ma zhum pa/ mi zhan pa/ rab tu dga' ba/ khyab pa/ chub pa/ rgyun chags pa/ 'brel ba/ sgra thams cad rdzogs par byed pa/dbang po thams cad tshim par byed pa/ ma smad pa/ miX'agyur ba/ ma brdabs pa/ zhi bar byed pa/ dul ba/ sel ba/ bdud tshar gcod pa/ rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'o/ /gsum pa sprul sku la skye ba sprul sku/bzo ba sprul sku/ mchog gi sprul sku gsum mo/ /mdzad pa bcu gnyis ni/128

dga' ldan gyi gnas nas 'pho ba dang / lhums su zhugs pa dang / sku bltams pa dang / btsun mo'i 'khor gyis rol ba dang / bzo yi gnas la mkhas pa dang / khyim nas mngon par byung ba dang / dka' ba spyad paXdang /byang chub snying bor gshegs pa dang / bdud sde bcom pa dang / mngon par byang chub pa dang / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / spru ngan las 'da' ba ste bcu gnyis so/ / bzhi ba ye shes chos sku mdzad pa dang bcas pa la/ ye shes lnga ni/ me long lta bu'i ye shes/mnyam pa nyid kyi yi shes/ so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes/bya ba bsgrub pa'i ye shes/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes lnga'o/ /zag med ye shes kyi sde tshan nyer gcig la/ byang phyogs so bdun/ tshad med bzhi/ rnam thar brgyad/ mthar gnas stoms 'jug dgu/ zad par bcu/ zil gyis gnon pa'i skye mched brgyad/ mngon shes drug rnams kyi ming ni mngon pa'i skabs su blta'o/ /nyon mongs med pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ smon gnas mang ༷pa/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi ni/ chos/ don/ nges tshig spobs pa so sor yang dag par rig pa'o/ /yongasaXsu dag pa bzhi ni/ rten/ dmigs pa/ thugs/ ye shes yongs suXdag pa bzhi'o/ /dbang bcu ni/ tshe/ sems/yo byad/ las/ skye ba/ mos pa/ smon lam/ rdzu 'phrul/ ye shes/ chos la dbang ba'o/ /stobs bcu ni/ gnas dang gnas ma yin pa/ las kyi rnam par smin pa/ mos pa sna tshogs pa/ khams sna tshogs pa/ dbang bo mchog dang mchog 129

ma yin pa/ thams cad du 'gro ba'i lam/ kun nas nyon mongs pa dang rnam par byang ba/ sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa/ 'chi 'pho ba dang skye ba/zag pa zad pa macan pa'i stobs so/ /mi 'jigs pa bzhi ni/ rtogs pa phun tshogs la/ bar du chod pa'i tshes bstan pa la/ nges par 'byung ba'i lam bstan pa la/ spangs pa phun tshogs la mi 'jigs pa'o/ /bsrung ba med pa gaspum ni/ sku dang / gsung dang / thugs kyi skyon yongs su dag pas bsrung ba med pa'o/ /dran pa nye bar bzhag pa gsum ni/ chos mnyan par 'dod pa la rjes su chags pa med pa/ mnyan par mi 'dod pa la khong khro ba med pa/ gnyis ka 'dres ma la chags sdang gnyi ka med pa'o/ /bsnyel ba mi mnga' ba'i chos nyid/ bag chags yang dag par bcom pa skye bo thams cad la thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa/ ma 'dres pa'i chos bco brgyad ni/ sku la 'khrul ba med pa/ gsung la ca co med pa/ dran pa nyams pa med pa/ thugs mnyam par ma bzhag pa med pa/ tha dad pa'i 'du shes med pa/ ma brtags pa'i btang snyoms mi mnga' ba ste spyod pas bsdus pa drug 'dun pa/ brtson 'grus/ dran pa/ ting 'dzin/ shes rab/ rnam par grol ba las nyams pa med pa ste rtogs pas bsdus pa drug sku dang /gsung dang / thugs kyi 'phrin las ye shes kyi sngon du 'gro zhing rjes su 'brang ba ste 'phrin las kyis bsdus pa gsum/ 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da lha ba la ma chags ma thogs pa'i ye shes mnga' ba ste ye shes 130

kyis bsdus pa gsum mo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid sogs gsum steXsde tshan nyer gcig go /'phrin las nyer bdun ni/ zhi ba'i las la 'god pa/ gzhan rgyud smin byed bsdu bzhi la 'god pa/ blang dor rtogs pa la 'god pa ste tshogs lam laX'agod pa'i 'phrin las gsum/ gnas lugs kyi don rtogs pa la/ phyin drug rdzogs byed la/ gnyis don gyi spyodaXpa la/lta ba rnam dag la 'god pa ste sbyor lam la 'god pa'i bzhi/ stong nyid mngon sum du gsar du rtogs pa la 'god pa ste mthong lam la 'god pa'i gcig tshul khrims kyi nyams len la/ bzod pa'i nyams len la/ byang chub phyogs mthun shes pa'i shes rab la/ bden bzhi shes pa'i shesaXrab la/ rten 'brel shes pa'i shes rab la/ sems can yongs su smin pa la/lam gsum shes pa'i shes rab la/ bden par zhen pa bzlog pa la/ dkon mchog btags pa ba'i byang chub 'thob pa la/ zhing rnam par dag pa la/theg dman du mi lhung bar nges pa'i 'tshang rgya ba la/ sems cad gyi don tshad med pa bsgrub pa la/ yon tan khyad par can bsgrub pa la/ byang chub kyi yan lag la/ las chud mi za ba la/ bden pa shes pa la/ phyin ci log zad pa la/ gzhi med pa la/ rnam byang rdzogs pa la/ srid zhi mnyam nyid la 'god pa'i 'phrin las te sgom lam la 'god pa'i bco brgyad/ mi gnas pa'i myang 'das la 'god pa ste 'bras bu la 'god pa'i gcig ste sangs rgyas kyi 'phrinaXlas nyer bdun no/ /pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzhung gi brjod 131

bya'i gtso bo rnams kyi ming gi rnam grangs mdor bsdus pa'o//gnyis pha dbu ma'i ga'ung las 'byung ba'i ming gi rnam grangs la/thabs kyi cha dang / shes rab kyi cha gnyis las/ dang po la/ byang sems las dang po ba'i chos gsum ni/ snying rje/ gnyis su med pa'i shes rab/byang chub kyi sems gsum mo/ /snying rje la/ sems can tsam la dmigs pa/chos la dmigs pa/ dmigs med la dmigs pa'i snying rje gsum mo/ /rgyuX'abras man ngag bdun ni mar shes/ drin dran/ drin gzo/ byams pa/ snying rje/ lhag bsam rnam dag byang chub kyi sems te bdun no/ /yang rtsol bcas kyi sems bskyed dang / rtsol med sgom byung gi myong ba thon pa'i sems bskyed gnyis/ yang sems bskyed la sems can thams cad bsgral ba dang / dgrol ba dang / mngon par byang chub par bya ba/ yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i sems bskyed pa ste byams pa chen po'i dbang du byas pa bzhi/ sems can thams cad kyi don bya ba dang / ngan 'groXlas yongs su bskyab pa dang / theg pa dman pa las bslang ba dang / yang dag pa'i lam du dgod pa ste snying rje chen po'i dbang du byas pa bzhi'o/ /byang sems 'phags pa'i sa bcur 'jog tshul la/ khyad par brgyad ni/ des tshig giXkhyad par/ bslab pa gsum la slob pa dang phung bo lnga'i sbyong tshul gyi khyad par/ yon tan gyi grangs gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i khyad par/ mthu phul du byung ba thob pa'i khyad par/ phar phyin lhag pa'i khyad par/ rnam smin gyi 132

skye ba 'dzin pa'i khyad par/ sa thob pa'i rtags dang mi ltas kyi khyad par/gnyen po yongs sbyong gi khyad par te brgyad do/ /sa bcu ni/ rab tu dga' ba/ dri ma med pa/ 'od byedaXpa/ 'od 'phro ba/ sbyang dka' ba/ mngon du gyur pa/ ring du song ba/ mi g.yo ba/ legs pa'i blo gros/ chos kyi sprin te bcu'o/ /sa bcu gnyis ni/ de'i steng du byang chub tu sems ma bskyed pa'iXs dngaX/ kun tu 'od kyi sa gnyis bsnan pas bcu gnyis so/ /smon sems kyi bslab byaXl ni/ sems bskyed kyi phan yon dran pa/ lan drug bskyed pa/ sems can blos mi spong ba/ tshogs gnyis bsags pa/ nag chos bzhi spang zhing dkar chos bzhi la slob pa'o/ /nag chos bzhi ni/ mkhanaXslob sogs rdzud gyisaXslu ba/ dgeXb byed pa la 'gyod pa bskyed pa/ sems bskyed pa la mi snyan pa brjod pa/ g.yo sgyus spyod pa ste bzhi'o/ /dkar chos bzhi ni/ sems can kun la rdzun spong ba/ drang pos gnas pa/ byang sems kun la ston pa'i 'du shesaXbaskyed pa/ rang gis smin rung sems bskyed la dgod pa'o/ /bsdu ba bzhi ni/ sbyin pa/ snyan smra/ don mthun/ don spyod pa'o/ /phan phyin drug ni/ sbyin pa la/ chos/ zang zing / mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa ste gsum/ tshul khrims la/ nyes spyod sdom pa/ dge ba chos sdud/ sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims gsum/ bzod pa la/ gnod byed la ji mi snyam pa/133

sdug bsngal dang len/ chos laXnges sems kyi bzod pa gsum/ brtson 'grus la/ go cha'i/ gong na med pa'i/ semasaXcan don byed kyi brtson 'grus gsum/ bsam gtan la/ lus sems bder gnas/ yon tan mngon sgrub/ sems can don byed gsum/ shes rab la/ kun rdzobaXrtogs pa/ don dam rtogs pa/ sems can gyi don byedaXtshul rtogs pa'i shes rab gsum mo/ /spyod pa'i sdom bcu gnyis ni/ lus/ longs spyod/ dge rtsa gsum/ btang ba/ bsrung ba/ dag pa/ spel ba bzhi rer phye ba'o/ /phyin drug gi sdom dgu ni/ ngo bo nyid/ thams cad pa/ dka' ba/ sgo thams cad pa/ skyes bu thams cad pa/ rnam pa thams cad pa/ phongs shing 'dod pa/'di dang gzhan du bde ba/ rnam par dag pa'i sbyin pa ste gzhan lnga la'ang 'dra'o/ /phar phyin bcu ni/ phyin drug giXsteng du/ thabs la mkhas pa la/sems can thams cadaXl snying rje dngaXldan par blta ba/ rang bzhin ji ltaXb bzhin shes pa/ bla med byang chub 'dod pa/ 'khar ba mi gtong ba/ nyon mongs pa can ma yin pas 'khor bar 'khor ba/ sangs rgyas 'dod pa'i brtson 'grus 'bar ba ste nang sangs rgyas kyi chos 'grub pa las brtsams pa'i thabs mkhas drug sems can gyi dge rtsa chung ngu rnams tshad med par bsgyur ba/ tshegs chung ngus dge rtsa chen po basprub pa/ bstan pa la 'gras pa rnams kyi khong khro sel ba/ bar mar gnas pa rnams bstan par 'dzud pa/ zhugs pa rnams smin par byed pa/ smin pa rnams sgrol bar byed 134

pa ste phyi'i sems can smin par bya ba las brtsam pa'i thabs mkhas drug ste bcu gnyis so/ /smon lam la/ sems bskyed pa'i smon lam/ skye ba'i smon lam/ spyod yul gyi smon lam/ yang dag pa'i smon lam/ smon lam chen po ste lnga'o/ /yang rgyal ba thams cad la mchod pa dang rim gro'i/ dam chos gzung ba'i/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'gro ba'i/ rgyal sras kyi spyod pa thams cad sgrub pa'i/ sems can sminaXpa'i/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du 'jug pa'i/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing sbyong ba'i/ theg pa chen por 'jug pa'i/spyod pa thams cad don yod pa'i/ theg chen baspub pa rgyun mi 'chad pa'i smon lam chen po ste re re la'ang 'dum phrag grangs med pa phrag re re ste phrag bcu'o/ /stobs la/ bsam pa/ lhag pa'i bsam pa/ gzungs/ ting nge 'dzin/ yang dag par 'byor ba/ dbang / spobs pa/ smon lam/ pha rol tu phyin pa/ byams pa chen po/ snying rje chen po/ chos nyid/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs pa'i stobs te bcu'o/ /bcu ba ni ye shes kyi phar phyin no/ /don bya ba rnam pa bcu gcig ni/ bya ba byed pa dang sdug bsngal ba'i grogs kyi/ thabs la rmongs pa'i/ phan 'dogs pa'i/'jigs pas nyen pa'i/ spya ngan gyis gzir ba'i/ yang dag par zhugs pa'i/ log par zhugs pa'i/ rdzu 'phrul gyi sgo nas gdul bya'i don byed pa ste rnam pa bcu gcig go /byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa la/ ltung ba'i ris ni/ pham pa dang /136

nyes byas kyi sde tshan gnyis so/ /pham pa bco brgyad ni/ rnyed bkur la zhen te bdag bstod gzhan laXsmod pa/ sdug bsngal ba dang mgon med pa la ser snas chos nor mi ster ba/gzhan gyi bshad sbyang mi len par khro bas 'tshog pa/ theg chen gyi chos spong zhing chos ltar snang ston pa ste byang sa nas gsungs pa bzhi la phye na brgyad/dkon mchog gi dkon ma byin par len pa/ dam pa'i chos spong ba/ rab byung la 'tshe ba/ 'tshams med byed pa/ log lta 'dzin pa/ gnas 'jig pa/snod min laXzab mo ston pa/ theg chen las bzlog pa/ so thar spong ba/nyan thos kyi theg pa la bskur ba/ bdag bstod gzhad smod/ mi chos bla ma'i rdzun smra ba/ dkon mchog gi dkor len pa/ khrims ngan 'cha' ba/yangaXdag 'jog gi longs spyod ma byin par len pa/ smon sems gtong ba gsum gcig tu bgrang ba'i pham pa ste bcu bzhi ni bslab btus nas gsungs pa'o/ /byang sa'i dang po dang bslab btus kyi bcu gcig pa gnyis gcig tu bgrangs na bcu bdun no/ /thun mong gi yan lag bzhi ni/de la spyod 'dod ma log pa/ /dga' zhingaXmagu ba ma log pa/ /ngo tshaXkhrel yod ma skyes pa/ /nyes par mi lta ba'o/ /yan lag gi bye brag gis kun dkrisaXche 'bring chung gsung du 'jog la/ pham pa'i yan lag maXtshang ba ni/ zag pa chung 'bring ngo / /nyes byas la/ nyes pa dang bcas ma bcas gnyis/ nyon mongasaXcan 136

yin min gnyis/ chung 'bring chen po gsum rnams so/ /zhe drug ni/ dkon mchog gsum la mi mchod pa/ 'dod pa'i sems kyi rjes su 'jug pa/ rgan pa la mi gus pa/ dris pa la lan mi 'debs pa/ mgron du bos pa khas mi len pa/ gser sogs bstabs pa mi len pa/ chos 'dod pa la mi sbyin pa/ma dungs pa dang tshul 'chal yal bar 'dor ba/ pha rol dad phyir thun mong ba'i bcas par mi slob pa/ sems can gyi don la bya ba chung dur gnas pa/ log 'tsho lnga dang du len pa/ 'phyar nas rab tu rgod pa sogs byed pa/ 'khor ba gcig pu bgrod par sems pa/ grags pa ma yin pa mi spong ba/ gzhan don du 'gyur bzhin sbyor ba rtsub mos mi 'tshe ba/ dgesbyong gi chos bzhiXdang bral ba/ khros pa rnams yal bar 'dor ba/ pha rolaXshad kyis 'chags pa spong ba/ khros pa'i rjes su 'jug pa/ rnyed bkur 'dod pas 'khor bsdu ba/ le lo sogs sel bar mi byed pa/ bre mo'i gtam la chags pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyi don mi 'tshol ba/ sgrib pa lnga mi sgongaXb/ bsam gtan gyi ro la yon tan du lta ba/ nyan thos kyi pheg pa sgong ba/rang tshul yod bzhin bor nas ha cang de la mi brtson pa/ phyi rol ba'i gzhung la mtha' gcig tu brtson pa/ de la dga' bzhin du brtson pa/ byang sems kyi sde snod la skur ba 'debs pa/ bdag la bstod cing gzhan la smod pa/ chos bgro ba'i ched du 'gro bar mi byed pa/ chos smra ba la sgod cing tshig la rton pa/ dgos pa'i grogs su mi 'gro ba/ nad pa'iXrim gro spong ba/ 137

sdug bsngal sel bar mi byed pa/ bag med pa la rigs pa mi ston pa/ phan lan mi byed pa/ gzhan gyi spru ngan mi sel ba/ nor 'dod pa la mi sbyin pa/'khor rnams kyi don mi byed pa/ gzhan gyi blo dang mthun par mi byed pa/yon tan can gyi bsngags pa mi brjod pa/ skyon du 'tsham par tshar miXgacod pa/ rdzu 'phrul gyis bsdigs par mi byed pa/ snying brtse can la skabs su babs na lus ngag gi bdun gnangaXb mi byed pa ste zhe drug go /phyi ma 'di ma brtsis par zhe lngar bgrang ba'ang yod do/ /lhung ba 'byung ba'i sgo bzhi ni/ ma gus pa/ bag med pa/ mi shes pa/nyon mongs mngaXb ste bzhi'o/ /gong gi log 'tsho lnga ni/ tshul 'chos pa/ kha gsag gzhogs slong / thob kyis 'jal ba/ rnyed pas rnyed pa 'dod pa lnga'o/ /sgrib pa lnga ni/ rgod 'gyod gnyis/ gnod sems/ rmugs gnyid gnyis/ 'dod pa la 'dun pa/ the tshom ste lnga'o/ /'dul ba la brtson pa'i phun sum tshogs pa gsum ni/ bsam pa dang / sbyor ba dang / sngon gyi rgyu phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /gnyis pa shes rab kyi cha la/ mdo sde sa bcu ba las gsungs pa'i mnyam nyid bcu ni/ chos thams cad mtshan ma med par mnyam pa nyid dang / de bzhinaXdu sbyar te/ skye ba med pa dang / ma skyes pa dang / dben pa dang / gdod ma nas rnam par dag pa dang / spros pa med pa dang / blang dor med pa dang / chos thams cad sgyu ma dang rmi lam dang mig yor dang 138

brag cha dang chu zla dang gzugs brnyan dang sprul ba lta bur mnyam pa nyid dang / dngos po dang dngos po med pa gnyis su med par mnyam pa nyid de bcu'o/ /byangaXs las 'byung baXni mtshan ma med pa dang / mtshan nyid med pa dang / bdag nyid ma skyes pa dang / rgyu las ma skyes pa dang / gzod ma nas zhi ba dang / spros pa med pa da nga / blang doraXgyi 'du byed dang bral ba dang / dben pa dang / sgyu ma dang sprul ba lta bu dang / dngos po dang dngos po med pa gnyis su med pa mnyam pa nyid de bcu'o/ /dgag bya la lam gyi dgag bya dang rigs pa'i dgag bya gnyis/ dang po la/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang / shes bya'i sgrib pa dang / snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa gsum mo/ /yang chags sgrib/ thogs sgrib/ dman sgrib gsum mo/ /rigs pa'i dgag bya la phyin ci log dang / der 'dzin pa'i shes pa gnyis so/ /lha ba ngan pa bcu drug ni/ bdag 'das pa'i dus na byung ba dang ma byungaXb dang gnyis ka dang gnyis ka ma yin par lta ba bzhi/ 'jig rten rtag pa dang miXrtag pa dang gnyis ka dang gnyis ka ma yin par lta ba bzhi ste brgyad ni sngon gyi mtha' la brten pa'o/ /bdag ma 'ongs pa'i dus na byungaXb dang ma byung ba dang gnyis ka dang gnyis ka ma yin par lta ba bzhi dang / 'jig rten mtha' dang ldan pa dang mi ldan pa dang gnyis ka dang gnyis ka ma yin par lta ba bzhi ste brgyad ni phyi ma'i mtha' la brten pa'o/ /bdag tuXlta ba nyi shu ni/ gzugs bdag tu lta ba dang / de bzhin du 139

bdag gzugs dang ldan pa/ gzugs la bdag yod pa dang / bdag la gzugasaXyod par lta ba dang / de bzhinaXdu phung bo gzhan bzhi la sbyar bas nyi shur 'gyur ro/ /bdag la gzugasaXlas gzhan du lta ba sogs lnga bsnanaXpas nyer lnga'o/ /dgag bya'i bdag la gang zag dang chos kyi bdag gnyis las/ de re re la'ang lhan skyes dang / kun btags gnyis gnyis/ gang zag gi bdag la rtagaXgacig rang dbang can du grub pa/ bdag phung bo las don gzhan du grub pa/ rang skya thub pa'i rdzas yod du grub pa/ phung bo dang mtshan nyid mi mthun pa'i rang skya bar grub pa/ bden par grub pa/rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pa'o/ /'jig lta lhan skyes la ngar 'dzin pa dang nga yir 'dzin pa gnyis/ 'di la lha gsum ste/ gang zag gi bdag 'dzin yin la 'jig lta lhan skyes ma yin pa'i nu/ gnyis ka yin pa'i myu/gnyis ka ma yin pa'i mu ste gsum mo/ /chos kyi bdag ni rnam rig pa ltar —na/ gzung 'dzin rdzas gzhan du grub pa/ rdul cha med bsags pa'i rags pa/ gzung ba don gzhan/ gzugs phyi rol don du grub pa/ rang 'dzin rtog pa'i zhen gzhir rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pa rnams yin la/ phyi ma 'di dang rtog pa'i zhen gzhi yin pa rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pa gnyis mi gcig go /rang rgyud pa ltar na blo gnod med la snang ba'i dbang gis bzhag tsam ma yin par yul rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i sdod lugs kyi ngos nas grub pa dang / thal 'gyur ba ltar na rtog pas btags pa tsam ma 140

yin par rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pa'o/ /don dam par grub pa/ yang dag par grub pa/ bden par grub pa rnams don gcig rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pa/ rang bzhin byis grub pa/ rang gi ngo bos grub pa/ rang ngos nas grub pa/ tshugs thub tu grub pa/ rdzas yod du grub pa/ sdod lugs kyi ngos nas grub pa rnams don gcig des bden med sogs dang / rang gi mtshan nyid kyis med pa sogs kyi don gcig lugs kyang shes par bya'o/ /dbu ma ba 'ga' zhig ltar naXdon dam du grub pa la gnas lugs dpyod pa'i rigs shes la don dam du byas pa dang / 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag ye shes la don dam du byas pa dang / bden par grub pa la don dam du byas pa gsum mo/ /yang don dam la/ don dam dngos dang / mthudaXpa'i don dam gnyis su bshad pa'i lugs kyang yod do//yang dod dam la/don don dam pa/ thob pa don dam pa/ sgrub pa don dam pa gsum dang /kun rdzob la/ btags pa'i kunaXrdzob/ shes pa'i kun rdzob/ brjod pa'i kun rdzob gsum du bshad pa'ang yod do/ /rdzas yod la/ sgras brjod rigs kyi sgo nas dbye na rigs pas grub pa'i rdzas yod/ brtan pa'i rdzas yod/don byed nus pa'i rdzas yod/ rang skya thub pa'i rdzas yod/ tshugs thub kyi rdzas yod/ bden grub kyi rdzas yod de drug go /btags yod ni de dag las log pa'i chos te skabs dang bstunaXnas rangaXrang gi gzhung lhar shes dgos so/ /rang skya thub pa dang / rang skya 'dzin thub pa gnyis mi gcig 141

go /'gog byed kyi rigasaXpa la gzhan grags sam rang grags kyi thal 'gyur dang / gtanaXtshigs gnyis las/ gtan tshigs la/ phyi don 'gog pa lhan cig dmigs nges kyi gtan tshigs/ bden grub 'gog pa mgo stoms kyi gtan tshigs/ rgyu la dpyod pa rdo rje gzegs ma'i gtan tshigs/'bras bu la dpyod pa yod med skye 'gog gi gtanaXtshigs/ rgyu 'brasaXganyis ka la dpyod pa nu bzhi skye 'gog gi gtan tshigs/ ngo bo la dpyod pa gcig tu bral gyi gtan tshigs/ cha thams cad la dpyod pa rigs pa'i rgyal po rten 'brel gyi gtan tshigs/ gang zag gi bdag 'gog pa rnam lnga'i rigs pa dang rnam bdun gyi rigs pa rnams gtso bo yin no/ /mtha'aXbazhi'i skye ba ni/ bdag skye/ gzhan skye/ gnyis ka las skye ba/ rgyu med las skye ba'o/ /yod med skye 'gog gi bzhi ni/ rgyu dus na yod pa'i 'bras du skye ba/de bzhin du sbyaraXte med pa dang / gnyis ka dang / gnyis ka ma yin pa'i 'bras bu skye ba'o/ /mu bzhi'i skye ba ni/ rgyu du ma las 'bras bu gcig kho naXskye ba/ rgyu gcig las 'bras bu du ma skye ba/ rgyu gcig las 'bras bu gcig kho na skye ba/ rgyu du ma las 'bras bu du ma skye ba'o/ /yod mtha'/ /rtag mtha'/ sgro 'dogs kyi mtha' rnams don gcig med mtha'/ chad mtha'/skur 'debs kyi mtha' rnams don gcig de gnyis dang zal ba ni dbu ma'o/ /dbu ma la sgras brjod kyis dbye na/ gzhung dang / lam dang / 'bras 142

bu'i dadu ma gaspum mo/ /gzhi bden pa gnyis la/ kun rdzob kyi bden pa dang / tha snyad bden pa dang / thabs kyi bden pa dang / tshu rolaXgyi bden pa rnams don gcig don dam bden pa dang / mchog gi bden paXdang /thabs las byung ba'i bden pa dang / yang dag pa'i bden pa rnams don gcig kun rdzobaXbaden pa la/ yang dag kun rdzob dang / log pa'i kun rdzob gnyis/ thal 'grur ba lhar na yang log gnyis tha snyad pa'i shes ngo kho nar 'jog go /yang dag ni 'phral gyi 'khrul rgyus ma bslad pa'i yul yul can drug dang / log pa ni bslad pa'o/ /kun rdzob la skad dod kyi steng nas yang dag pa'i sgrib byed dang brdzun pa'i don du bshadaXdo/ /don dam bden pa ni/sprung 'das dang / 'gog bden phra mo dang / stong nyid dang /ngo bo nyid sku rnams so/ /chos nyid dang / stong nyid dang / chos dbyings dang / phyag rgya chen po dang / chos rnams kyi gnas lugs dang / rang bzhin dang / ngo bo nyid dang / de nyid dang / deXkho na nyid dang / de bzhin nyid rnams don gcig go /stong nyid la dbye na/ nang stongaXb nyid/ phyi stong ba nyid/ phyi nang stong ba nyid/ stong ba nyid stong ba nyid/ chen po stong ba nyid/ don dam pa stong ba nyid/ 'dus byas stong ba nyid/ 'dus ma byas stong ba nyid/ mtha' las 'das pa stong ba nyid/ thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong ba nyid/ dor ba med pa stong ba nyid/ rang bzhin stong ba nyid/ chos thams cad stong ba nyid/143

rang gi mtshan nyid stong ba nyid/ mi dmigs pa stong ba nyid/ dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong ba nyid de bcu drug go /de'i steng du dngos po stong ba nyid/ dngos po med pa stong ba nyid/ rang gi dngos po stong ba nyid/gzhan gyi dngos po stong ba nyid bzhi bsnan pa ni stong nyid nyi shu'o/ /yang sgras brjod kyis dbye na/ snang stong gnyis tshogs ma yin dgag gi stong nyid dang / bden pa rnam par bcad tsam gyi med dgag gi stong nyid de gnyis/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes pa la thal 'gyur ba ltar na/ zag bcas zag med gnyis/ zag bcas la thos bsam bsgom gsum gyi rigs shes gsum dang / donaXspyi'i tshul gyis rtogs pa'i mnyam bzhag ye shes dang /'phags pa'i rjes thob ye shes rnams so/ /zag med la slob pa 'phags pa gsum gyi stong nyid rtogs pa'i mnyam bzhag ye shes dang / sangs rgyas kyiXye shes te bzhi'o/ /yang gnyis snang dang bcas pa dang / gnyis snang nub pa'i shes pa gnyis so//dbu ma thal 'byur ba'i thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad par ni/ rang gi mtshan nyid tha snyad du yang zhalaXgyis mi bzhes pa dang / bden 'dzinaXsogs nyon mongs thams cad la phra rags gnyis gnyisaXsu 'byed tshul thun mong ma yin pa dang / bdag med phra mo gnyis 'dod tshul dang / rtog pas btags pa tsam rten 'brel gyi don du 'dod pa dang / las 'bras kyi rten gzhi bdag 'jog tshul thun mong ma yid pa dang / phyi don 'jog tshul 144

thun mong ma yin pa dang / kun gzhi dang rang rig dang rang rgyud khas mi len tshul thun mong ma yin pa dang / sgrib gnyis kyi 'jog tshul dang spong tshul thun mong ma yin pa dang / nyan rang 'phags pa la chosaXrang bzhid med par rtogs pas khyab par khas len pa dang / so skye la rnal 'byor mngon sum yod paraXkhas len pa dang / zhig pa dngos por 'dod pa sogs dus gsum 'jog tshul khyad par ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi shes bya macan tshul thun mong ma yin pa ste bcu gnyis ni gtso bo yin la khyad par phra mo mtha' yas so/ /dbu ma ba'i lugs mang du yod pa noms kyi ming gi rnam grangs ni grub mtha' spyi'i skabs su blta bar bya la/ 'di'i tshad ma dngaXgatan tshigs la mkho ba'i ming gi rnam grangs ni gtan tshigs rig ༷pa'i skabs su blta bar bya'o/ /dbu ma'i gzhung gi brjod bya'i gtso bo rnams kyi ming gi rnam grangs mdor bsdus pa'o//gsum pa mngon pa'i ga'ung las 'byung ba'i ming gi rnam grangs la/mngon pa sde bdun ni/ ye shes la 'jug pa/ rab tu byed pa/ rnam shesaXkyi tshogs/ chos kyi phung po/ gdags pa'i bstan bcos/ 'gro ba'i rnamaXgrangs/khams kyi tshogs te bdun yin la/ de dag ni/ rim pa bzhin du/ ka t+ya'i bu dang / dbyig bshes dang / bram ze lha skyid dang / shā ri'i bu dang / mong gal gyi bu dang / gsus po che dang / gang pos byas pa'o/ /brjod bya'i gtso bo gzhiXlnga ni/ snang ba gzugs kyi gzhi/ gtso bo sems kyi gzhi/ 'khor 145

sems byung gi gzhi/ ldan pa ma yin pa'i 'du byed kyi gzhi/ 'dus ma byas pa'i gzhi ste lnga'o/ /mngon pa la don dmaXpa'i chosaXmangon pa dang / brdar btags pa'i chos mngon pa gnyis/ dngaXpo ni/ zag med shes rab rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'o/ /phyi ma la thob byed lam gyi mngon pa/ brjod byed gzhung gi mngon pa gnyis so/ /'dir 'phags pa thogs med kyis mdzad pa'i mngon pa kun las btus dang / kun macan dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i mngon pa mdzodaXganyis la mngon pa gong 'og gnyis su grags paXlas/snga ma ming gi rnam grangs mang zhing brjod bya rgya che bas de las byung ba ༷ bzhin 'bri bar byaXl/ der mi 'byung ba'i mngon pa 'og ma'i sgos kyi tha snyad rnams bar bar du 'bri bar bya'o//mngon pa gong ma la mtshan nyid kun las btus pa dang / rnam par nges pa kun las btus pa gnyis las/ dang po la mtshan gzhi'i dbye ba dang / grangs nges/ nyer len/ mtshan nyid/ rnam bzhag go rim/ ming don/dpe/ dbye ba/ bsdus pa/ mtshungs ldan/ ldan pa ste bcu gnyis so/ /phung bo lnga ni/ gzugs/ tshoraXb/ 'du shes/ 'du byed/ rnam par shes pa'i phung bo'o/ /khams bcoXbargyad ni/ ming gi khams dang / de bzhin du spyaraXte rna ba/ sna/ lce/ lus/ yid kyi khams dngaX/ ming gi rnam par shes pa'i khams nas/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i khams kyi bar drug dang / gzugs/ sgra/dri/ ro/ reg bya/ chos kyi khams te bco brgyad de/ bsdu na rten bdag rkyen 146

gyi khams/ dmigs pa yul gyi khams/ brten pa rnam par shes pa'i khams gsum mo/ /skye mched bcu gnyis ni/ mig sogs drug dang / gzugs sogs drug gi skye mched de bcu gnyis so/ /bdag gi gzhi lus yongs su gzung ba dang bcas pa dngaX/ bdag gi gzhi longs spyod dang / bdag gi gzhi tha snyad dang / bdag gi gzhi mngon par 'du byed pa dang / bdag gi gzhi de dag gi gnas brjod pas na phung bo lnga'o/ /longs spyod pa po'i gnas kyi sgo nas yul 'dzin pa dang / dmigs pa'i sgo nasaX'adzin pa dang /nyer spyod rang gi mtshan nyid 'dzin pa gsum gyi sgo nas khams drug tshan gsum mo/ /lus dang / yongs su gzung ba gnyis kyis rnam shes skye ba dang /rgyas pa'i sgo 'byed pas na skye mchedaXdrug tshan gnyis so/ /nye bar len pa ni/ 'dun pa dngaX/ 'dod chags so/ /mngon paX'og mar/ 'thab bcas/sdug bsngal/ kun 'byung / 'jig rten/ lha gnas/ srid pa rnams zag bcas nyer len gyi phungang bo'i ming gi rnam grangs su bshad do/ /gzugs kyi mtshan nyid ni/ reg pa dang yul spyad pas gzugs su rung ba'o/ /tshor ba ni/ sbong b.raXbyed pa'i rigaXpa'o/ /dbye na/ sim pa/ gdung ba/ bar ma'i rnam pa canaXgasum mo/ /'du shes ni/ mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i rig pa'o/ /dbye na mtshan ma tsam du 'dzin pa'i rtog med kyi 'du shes dang / bkra bar 'dzin pa'i rtog bcas kyi 'du shes gnyis kyis mthong ba dang / thos pa dang / bye brag phyed pa dang / rnam par shes pa'i don la tha snyad 'dogs pa 1‘17

bzhi'o/ /'du byed ni/ phung bo bzhi las gzhan du gyur pa'i 'du byas so/ /dbye na mtshungs ldan 'du byed dang / ldan pa ma yin pa'i 'du byed gnyis so/ /mtshan gzhi'i gtso bo sems pa ni/ rang dang mtshungs ldanaXgyi sems yul la g.yo zhing bskul bar byed pa'i sems byung ngo / /de la gnas skabs nyer lnga ni/ bde ba dang / sdug bsngal dang / gnyis ka ma yin pa dang /chung 'bring che gsum dang / dge mi dge lung ma bstan gsum dang / thos bsam bsgom gsum dang / basbab pa gsum dang / phyi nang dang / gzung 'dzin dang / spong gnyen dang / mngon du gyur ma gyur dang / rgyu dang 'bras bu'i gnas skabs te nyer lngar 'jug go /rnam par shes pa ni/ yul gyi ngo bo rnam par rig pa'o/ /dbye na gzugs rnam paraXshes pa sogs drug go /mig gi khams la 'das pa'i migaXgis gzugs mthong zin pa dang /da lta ba'i mig gis gzugs la lta bzhin pa dang / rgyu mthun gyi sa bon dang / rnam smin gyi sa bon bzhi'o/ /de bzhin du rna ba sogs la'ang rigs 'gre'o/ /gzugs kyi khams sogs la yul can gyi sgo nas mtshon pa dang rgyu'i sgo nas mtshon pa gnyis gnyis so/ /mig gi rnam par shes pa'i khams sogs la mngon gyur gyis bsdus pa dang / sa bon gyis bsdus pa gnyisaXganyisaXso/ /skye mched rnamasarākyang de dang 'dra'o/ /gzugs kyi phung bo la/rgyu gzugs 'byung ba chen po bzhi dang / 'bras gzugs bcu gcig go /rgyur 'gyur tshul ni/ 'byung ba'i rgyu/ 'dug pa'i rgyu/ rjes su 'gyur ba'i rgyu/148

gnas par byed pa'i rgyu/ 'phel bar byed pa'iXrgyu ste lnga'o/ /sa'i khams ni sra zhing 'thasaXpa'o/ /chu'i khams ni brlan zhing gsher ba'o/ /me'i khams ni tsha zhing sreg pa'o/ /rlung gi khams ni yang zhing g.yo ba ste ngo bo dang byed las gnyis gnyis so/ /mngon pa 'og mar 'dzin pa dang / sdud pa dang smin pa dang 'phel zhing rgyas par byed pa rnams byed las su bshad do//'bras gzugs bcuXgacig ni/ dbang bo gzugs can pa lnga/ de'i gzung don lnga/ chos kyi skye mched pa'i gzugs rnams so/ /dbang bo lnga la/rang rgyuX'abyung ba chen po bzhi'i skal mnyam gyi rgyuXlas byung ba'i rgyu'i khyad par/ rnas shes kyi rten bdag po'i rkyen byed pa'i byed las kyi khyad par/gzugs can dang bos bsdus pa'i ngo bo'i khyad par te gsum gsum mo/ /gzugs kyi mtshan nyid ni/ rang rgyu 'byung ba bzhi rgyur byasaXpa'i mig shes kyi gzung bya ste sgra sogs la yang rigs bsgro sbyor tshul shes par bya'o/ /dbye na nyer lnga ste/ sngon po/ ser bo/ dmar bo/ dkar bo/ ring bo/ thung ngu /lham pa/ klum po/ rdul phra mo/ rags pa/ phyal le ba/ phyal le ba ma yin pa/mthon po/ dma' ba/ grib ma/ nyi ma/ snang ba/ mun pa/ sprin/ du ba/ rdul/khug sna/ mngon par skabs yod pa/ rnam par rig byed/ nam mkha' kha dog gcig pa'i gzugs rnams so/ /bsdu naXbazhi ste/ bzang bo dang / ngan pa dang / bar ma dang / kha dog dang 'dra ba'o/ /sgra la dbye na bcu gcig ste/ yid du 'ong ba/ mi 'ong ba/ gnyis ka ma yin pa/ zin pa'i 'byung ba 149

chen po'i rgyu las byung ba/ ma zin pa'i 'byung ba chen po'i rgyu las byung ba/de gnyis ka ma yin pa/ 'jig rten gyi grags pa/ grub pas bstan pa/kun brtags pa/ 'phags pas tha snyad btags pa/ 'phags pa ma yin pas tha snyad btags pa'i sgraXrnams so/ /mngon pa 'og mar/ zin pa'i 'byung ba la sa gyur paXdang / ma zin pa'i 'byung ba las gyur pa'i sgra gnyis la sems can du ston pa dang mi ston pa dang / snyan pa dang mi snyan pa bzhi rer phye nas brgyad du bshad do/ /dri la dbye na drug ste/ dri zhim pa/ dri nga ba/ dri mnyam pa/ lhan cigaXskyes pa/ sbyar ba las byung ba/ gyur paXlas byung ba'i dri rnams so/ /ro la dbye na bcu gnyis te/ kha ba/ sgyur ba/ tsha ba/ bska ba/ lan tshwa/ mngar ba/yid du 'ong ba/ yid duXmi 'ong ba/ gnyis ka ma yinaXpa/ lhan cig skyes pa/sbyar ba las byung ba/ gyur pa las byung ba'i ro rnams so/ /'byung 'gyur gyi reg bya la dbye na nyer gnyis te/ 'jam pa/ zub pa/ yang ba/ lci ba/mnyen pa/ lhod pa/ lhod pa ma yin pa/ grang ba/ bkres pa/ skom pa/ tshim pa/nyams yod pa/ nyam chung ba/ brgyal ba/ g.ya' ba/ 'dred pa/ na ba/ rga ba/'chiXb/ ngal ba/ ngal bsos pa/ spungs che ba'i reg bya rnams so/ /chos kyi skye mched pa'i gzugs la lnga ste/ bsdus pa las gyur pa/ mngon par skabs yod pa/ yang dag par blang ba las byung ba/ kun brtags pa/dbang 'byor ba'i gzugs rnams so/ /mngon pa 'og mar/ g.yeng ba dang 150

sems med pa'i gnas skabs su yang 'byung ba/ dge baXdang mi dge ba gang rung yin pa/ rgyun mchog tu rjes su 'brel ba/ 'byung ba chen po bzhi ci rigs rgyur byas pa ste khyad par bzhi ldan gyi chos kyi skye mched pa'i gzugs dang byed pa'i gzhi mthun yin pa ni rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs dang / chos kyi skye mched pa'i gzugs la/ kun brtags pa'i gzugs dang / sgro ma btags par rgyus bskyed pa'i gzugs gnyis su bshad do/ /tshor ba'i phung bo mig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba nas yid kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba'i bar drug dang /lus kyi tshor ba/ sems kyi tshor ba/ zangaXzing dngaXbacas pa'i tshor ba zang zing med pa'i tshor ba/ zhen pa bsten pa'i tshor ba/ mngon par 'byung ba bsten pa'i tshor ba ste bcu gnyis la bde sdug btang stoms gsum gsum du bye bas so drug go /lus tshor sems tshor gnyis la/ dbang shes su gyur pa'i tshor ba dang / yid shes suXgyur pa'i tshor ba 'es kyang bya'o/ /'du shes kyi phung bo la/ rten gyi sgo nas drug ste/ mig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i 'du shes sogs drug ko /dmigs pa'i sgo nas drug ste/ mtshan ma dang bcas pa/ mtshan ma medaXpa/ chung du / rgya chen por gyur pa/ tshad med pa/ ci yang med do snyam pa'i 'du shes te drug go /mtshan bcas la tha snyad la mabs pa'i 'du shes/ 'dus byas mi rtagaXpa sogs la dmigs pa'i 'duXshes/ dmigs rnam gsal ba'i 'du shesaXso/ /'du byed kyi phung 161

po la/ 'dus byas dang 'du byed mi gcig la/ 'du byed kyi mtshan gzhi'i gtso bo sems byung sems pa ni/ mig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i sems pa sogs drug go /spyir 'du byed kyi phung bo la dbye na/ tshor ba dang 'du shes ma gtogs pa'i sems byung rnams dang / sems dang mi ldan pa'i 'du byed de gnyis so/ /mtshungs ldan 'du byed la/ tshor ba/ 'du shes/sems pa/ yid la byed pa/ reg pa ste kun 'gro lnga/ 'dun pa/ mos pa/dran pa/ ting 'dzin/ shes rab ste yul nges pa lnga/ dad pa/ ngo tsha shes pa/khrel yod pa/ ma chags pa/ zhe sdang med pa/ gti mug med pa/ brtson 'grus/ shin tu sbyangs pa/ bag yod pa/ btang stoms/ rnam par mi 'tshe ba ste dge ba bcu gcig 'dod chags/ khong khro/ nga rgyal/ ma rig pa/ the tshom ste lta min lnga dang / 'jig tshogs la lta ba/ mtha' 'dzin pa'i lta ba/lta ba mchog 'dzin/ tshul khrims brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin/ log lta ste lta ba lnga gcig tu bgrang na rtsa ba'i nyon mongs drug khro ba/ khon du 'dzin pa/'chab pa/ 'tshig pa/ phrag dog ser sna/ sgyu/ g.yo/ rgyags pa/ rnam par 'tshe ba/ ngo tsha med pa/ khrel med pa/rmugs pa/ rgod pa/ ma dad pa/ le lo/bag med pa/ brjed ngesaXpa/ shes bzhin ma yin pa/ rnam par g.yeng ba ste nye ba'i nyod mongs pa nyi shu/ gnyid/ 'alhod pa/ rtog pa/ dpyod pa ste gzhan 'gyur bzhi/ bsdoms na sems byung lnga bcu nga gcig go /'dun pa la gsumaXste/ 'phrad par 'dod pa dang / mi 'bralaXbar 'dodaXpa dang /162

don du gnyer ba'i 'dun pa'o/ /dad pa la/ yid ches pa'i dad pa dang /dang ba'i dad pa dang / 'dod pa'i dad pa gsum mo/ /brtson 'grus la/go cha/ sbyor ba/ zhum pa med pa/ mi ldog pa/ chog par mi 'dzin pa'i mngon par spro ba ste lnga'o/ /shin sbyangs la/ lus dang sems shin sbyangs gnyis so/ /lta ba lnga la/ bzhi ni sgro 'dogs pa'i lha ba dang gcig ni skur 'debs kyi lta ba'o/ /lnga ba ngan pa drugaXcu rtsa gnyis ni/ rtagaXpar smra ba'i bzhi/ rgyu med du smra ba'i gnyis/ mtha' dang ldan mi ldan du smra ba'i bzhi/lha mi spong bar smra ba'i bzhi/ 'du shes yod par smra ba'i bcu drug medaXpar smra ba'i brgyad/ gnyis min du smra ba'i brgyad/ chad paraXsmra ba'i bdun/tshe 'di nyid la grol bar smra ba'i lnga ste re gnyis so/ /de dag gi ming gi rnam grangs phal cher ni dadu ma'i skabs su bshad zin to/ /rnam g.yeng la/ ngo bo nyid kyi g.yeng ba/ phyi rol du g.yeng ba/ nang gi g.yeng ba/ mtshan ma'i g.yeng ba/ gnas ngan len gyi g.yeng ba/ yid la byed pa'i g.yeng ba ste drug go /mngon pa 'og mar/ sems kyi sa mang bcu/dge ba'i sa mang bcu/ nyon mongs chen po'i sa pa drug mi dge ba'i sa pa gnyis/ nyon mongs chung ngu'i sa pa bcu/ ma nges pa'i mtshungs ldan brgyad de zhe drug tu bshad la ming gi rnam grangs ni snga ma'i nangaXdu 'dus so/ /ldan pa ma yin pa'iX'adu byed la/ thob pa/ 'du shes med pa'i stoms 'juga'agog pa'i snyoms 'jug 'du shes med pa/ srog gi dbang bo/ ris 153

mthun pa/ skye ba/ rga ba/ na ba/ mi rtag pa/ ming gi tshogs/ tshig gi tshogs/yi ge'i tshogs/ so so'i skye bo/ 'jug pa/ so sor nges pa/ 'byor 'brel ba/'jog pa/ go rim/ dus/ yul/ grangs/ tshogs pa ste nyer gnyisaXso/ /thob pa la/ rnyedaXthob/ ldan thob gnyis so/ /mngon pa 'og mar bcu bzhiXbashad pa'i ma thob pa dang / skal mnyam ma gtogasaXrnams snga mar 'du la/ thob pa la/ chosaX'adas pa'i thob pa 'das pa/ da lta ba/ ma 'ongs pa gsum dang / de bzhin du chos da lta ba dang / ma 'ongs pa gnyis la'ang gsum re dang dge sogs gsum gyi thob pa dge ba sogs gsum/ khams gsum dang zag med kyi thob pa bzhi/ mthong spang / sgom spang / spang bya ma yin pa'i thob pa gsum yod cing / chos deXdang / de'i thob pa dang thob pa'i thob pa yang yod par bshad la/ bye smras ldan min bcu bzhi bo rdzas grub tu 'dod par bshad do/ /rnam shes kyi phung bo la/ sems/ yid/ rnam shes gsum ming gi rnam grangs so/ /sems kyi gtso bo kun gzhi la/ sa bon thams cad pa'i rnam par shes pa/ kun gzhi rnam par shes pa/ rnam par smin pa'i rnam par shes pa/ len pa'i rnam par shes pa rnams don gcig go /yid la don dam pa'i yid dang / gnas skabs pa'i yid gnyis las/ snga ma ni nyon yid dang / phyi ma ni 'jug shes drug 'gags ma thag pa'i rnam paraXshesaXpa'o/ /rnam par shes pa tshogs drug ni mig gi rnam par shes pa sogs drug 154

go /khams kyi rnam par bzhag pa'i ming gi rnam grangs yang der 'du'o/ /chosaXkhams kyi 'dus maXbyas la brgyad de/ dge ba'i de bzhin nyid/ mi dge ba'i de bzhin nyid/ lung ma bstan gyi de bzhin nyid/ nam mkha'/ so sor brtags pa'i 'gog pa/ so sor brtags mid gyi 'gog pa/ mi g.yo ba'i 'gog pa/ 'du shes dang tshor ba 'gog pa rnams so/ /dge ba'i de bzhin nyid la/ gang zag gi bdag med dang / chos kyi bdag med gnyis so/ /bdag med pa dang / stong ba nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / yang dgaXpa'i mtha' dang / don dam pa/ chos kyi dbyings rnams ming gi rnam grangs so/ /mig yin la mig gi khams ma yin pa/ mig gi khams yin la mig ma yin pa/ gnyis ka yin pa/ gnyis ka ma yin pa ste muXbazhi yin la/de ni dbang bo gzugs can gzhan rnams dang yid la yang 'dra'o/ /mig gis gzugs la blta ba'i tshe yul dbang rten gsum ka sa mtshungs pa dang /yul rten saXmatshungs shing dbang bo sa mi mtshungs pa dang / yul dbang sa mtshungs shing rten sa mi mtshungs pa yang yod/ de bzhin du rna ba la yang rigs 'gre'o/ /'dod pa'i yid la dge sogs gsum las/ dge ba la/skyes thob dang sbyor byung gnyis so/ /nyonaXmongs can gyi sems la kun 'gro dang / kun 'gro ma yin pa gnyis so/ /lung ma bstan la rnam smin skyes dang / tha mal bar 'dug pa/ mngon paraX'adu byed pa las byung ba'i spyod lam pa/ bzo'i gnas pa/ sprul sems rnams so/ /des khams 166

gong ma rnams kyi sems kyi ming gi rnam grangs kyang ci rigs su shes par bya'o/ /phung bo rnams kyi go rim ni/ gnas dang gnas pa'i rim pa/ rten pa dang brten pa'i rim pa/ kun nas nyon mongs dang rnam byang gi rten gyi dbang du byas pa'o/ /mngon pa 'og mar/ rags phra'i rim pa/ kun nas nyon mongs skye ba'i rim pa/ zas la longs spyod pa'i rim pa/ khams gsum na spyod tshul gyi rim pa rnams kyi sgo nas bshad do/ /phung bo'i sgra don ni/spungs pa dang khur dang sdong bo ste gsum mo/ /spungs pa ni/ 'das pa sogasaXgasum dang / phyi nang gnyis/ rags phra gnyis/ ngan pa/ gya nom pa/rgyang ring ba/ thag nyeXb ste sred pa'i dmigs pa bcu gcig go /khams kyi don ni/ rigs/ sa bon/ rgyu/ rang bzhin/ cha phra ba/ gzhi ste drug go /skye mched kyi sgra don ni/ skye zhingaXrgyas par byed pa'o/ /phung bo lnga'i dpe ni/dbu ba brdos pa/ chu yi chu bur/ smig rgyu/ chu shing / sgyu ma rnams so/ /chos gsum gyi rnam pa'i rab dbye la/ rdzas su yod pa/ btags paḍi yod pa/kun rdzob tu yod pa/ don dam du yod pa bzhi/ shes par bya ba/ rnam par shes par bya ba/ mngon par shes par bya ba gsum/ shes par bya ba la gzhanaXrnams go sla la/ spyod yul bcu gsum ni/ mos pa shes pa'i spyod yul/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ rigasaXpa/ rnam par 'phro ba med pa/ so so rang gi shes pa/ gzhan gyi bdag nyid/ 'og ma/ gong ma/ rnam par sun 'byin 156

pa/ kun nas mi ldang ba/ mi skye ba/ shes pa/ mthar thug pa/ don chen po shes pa'iXspyod yul te bcu gsum mo/ /rnam par shes par bya ba la dgu/rnam par mi rtog pa/ rnam par rtog pa/ rgyu/ 'jug pa/ rgyu mtshan/ rgyu mtshan lasaXbyung ba/ mi mthun pa/ gnyen po/ phra ba'i rab tu dbye ba'o/ /mngon par shes par bya ba la/ kun du 'gro ba/ rjes su thos pa/ spyod pa la 'jug pa/ 'ong ba/ 'gro ba/ mngon par byung ba ste drug go /de niXrdzu 'phrul dang /lha'i rna ba dang / gzhan gyi sems shes pa dang / sngon gnas rjes dran dang /lha'i mig dang / zag pa zad pa'i mngon shes te drug gi yul lo/ /gzugs can yin min la/ gzugs kyi bdag nyid dang / 'byungaXb rten gyur dang / dga' ba kun 'byung ba dang / phyogs bcas dang / khyab pa/yul nye bar bstan du rung ba/ yul spyod yul du 'gyur ba/ gnyis spyod yul du mtshungs pa/ 'brel ba/ rjes su 'brel ba/ rab tu rtog pa/ gnod bya yin pa/ go bar byed pa/ bsags pa/ phyi rol du bltas pa/ nang du bltas pa/ yun ringaXb/ yongs su chad pa/ de'i dus/ nges par ston paXste gzugs can nyi shu'o/ /gzugs can min pa ni de las ldog pa'o/ /bstan du yod pa bstan du med pa gnyis/ thogs pa dang bcas pa/ thogs pa med pa gnyis las/ thogs bcas ni/ rang bzhin cha phra ba/ bri ba cha phra ba/ sems dbang sgyur ba cha phra ba gsum las log pa'i rigs dang / nye bar bsags pa dang / yongs su sbyang ba ma byas pa'i thogs bcas gsumaX157

mo/ /mngon pa 'og mar/ yul la thogs bcas dang / bsgribs pa'i thogs bcas yin min la nu bzhi dang / yul la thogs pa dang dmigs pa la thogs pa yin min la mu gsum du bshad do//zag bcas zag med la/ zag pa'i sgo drug gang rung dang 'brel ba zag bcas te/ sgoXdrug ni/ zag pa'i bdag nyid/ zag pa dang 'brel ba/zag pas bcings pa/ zag pa'i rjes su mthunaXpa/ zag pa'i rgyu las byung ba ste drug go /'thab bcasaX'athab med gnyis/ zang zing dang bcas pa/zang zing med pa gnyis/ zhen pa bsten pa/ mngon par 'byung ba bsten pa gnyis rnams la 'thab pa'i sgo drug zang zing gi sgo drug zhen pa'i sgo drug re yod pa rnams snga ma'i rigs bsgre sbyar nas shes par bya'o/ /'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas gnyis so/ /'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa gnyis las/ 'jig rten pa la dag pa dang ma dag pa gnyis/ 'jig rten las 'das pa la/ mnyam bzhag dang rjesaXthob gnyis/ 'di ni chos kyi dbang du byas pa yin la/ gang zag gi dbang du byas na skye 'phags kanyis so/ /byung ba dang ma byung ba gnyis las/ byung baXl dang po byung ba/ rgyun gyis byung ba/ rgyas pa las byung ba/ rten byung ba/ 'gyur bar byung ba/yongs su smin par byung ba/ mnyam par byung ba/ khyad par du byung ba/ 'od gsal bar byung ba ma yin pa/ kun tu 'gro bar byung ba/ sa bon dang bcas par byung ba/ sa bon ma yin par byung ba/ gzugs brnyan dang 158

dbang 'byor ba dang nges par bstan pa'i phyir byung ba/ gcig nas gcig tu byung ba/ skad cig zhig nas byung ba/ phrad pa dang bral bar byung ba/gnas skabs gzhan du byung ba/ 'chi 'pho ba dang skye bar byung ba/ 'jig pa dang chags par byung ba/ sngon gyi dus na byung ba/ 'chi ba'i dus na byung ba/ bar du byung ba/ nying 'tshams sbyor ba'i dus na byung ba ste nyi shu rtsa bzhi'o/ /mngon pa 'og mar/ rnam smin skyesaXdang / rgyas byungaXdang / rgyu mthun lasaXbyung ba/ rdzas ldan gyi khyad par/ skad cig ma'i dbye ba dang lnga'i sgo nas byung ba'i rnam bzhag bshad do/ /'dzin pa dang gzung ba gnyis las/ 'dzin pa la phrad nas 'dzin pa dang / ma phradaXpar 'dzin pa gnyis dang / rang mtshan 'dzin pa dang / spyi mtshan 'dzin pa gnyis so/ /phyi bltas nang bltas gnyis la dbye ba med de/ nyon mongs can yin min gnyis las/ nyon mongs can la/ mi dge ba dang / bsgribs lung ma bstan gnyis so/ /nyon mongs can ma yin pa la/ dge ba dang / ma bsgribs lung ma bstan gnyis so/ /dus gsum ni/ 'das pa dang /ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'o/ /dge sogs gsum las/ dge ba la/ ngo bo nyid kyi dge ba/de bzhin du sbyar te/ 'brel ba/ rjes su 'brel ba/ slong ba/ don dam pa/skye bas thob pa/ sbyor ba/ mdun du byas pa/ phan 'dogs pa/ yongs su 'dzin pa/ gnyen po/ nye bar zhi ba/ rgyu mthun pas dge ba ste bcu gnyis so/ /de'i nang gi gnyen po la/ rnam par sun 'byinaXpa'i gnyen po/ spong 169

gnyen/ gzhi gnyen/ thag bsring ba gnyen po/ rnam paraXganon pa gnyen po/ bral ba gnyen po/ nyon sgrib kyi gnyen po/ shes sgrib kyi gnyin po ste brgyad do/ /desaXmi dge ba dang lung ma bstan gyi ming gi rnam grangs yang shes sla'o/ /'dod pa dang ldan pa/ gzugs dang ldan pa/ gzugasaXmed paXdang ldan pa gsum gyi dbye ba ni sla'o/ /zhar byung chags bral la/ phyogs gcig la chags pa dang bral ba/mtha' dag la chags pa dang bral ba/ rtog pas chags bral/ gnon pa'i chags bral/ legs par ston pa'i chags bral te lnga dang / yang chags bral bcur dbye ba yang yod de go sla'o/ /slob pa/ mi slob pa/ gnyis ka ma yin pa'i chos/ mthong spang / sgom spang spang bya ma yin pa rnams kyi ming gi rnam grangs yang gong 'og tu ci rigs par 'byung ba'i phyir 'dir ma bris so/ /rten 'brel gyi rnam bzhag ni/ mdo sngags dang grub mtha' spyi la mkho bas mngon pa gong 'og dang gzhung gzhan las 'byung ba'i med mi rung gi ming gi rnam grangs mdor bsdus te 'bri bar bya'o/ /de la brten pa dang /'phrad pa dang ltos pa gsum skabs 'dir don gcig la/ rten 'brel gyi ming gi rnam grangs la rten 'brel/ brten nas 'byung ba/ brten nas skyes pa/ rkyen las skyes pa/ rten nas grub pa/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba zhes pa rnams 'byung zhing / ltos nas grub pa/ brten nas btags pa/rkyen nyidaX'adi pa tsam/ btags pa tsam zhes kyang grub mtha' gong ma 160

rnams kyi skabs su 'byung ngo / /dbye na/ phyi dang nang gi rten 'brel gnyis/gzugs/ shes pa/ ldan min 'du byed kyi rten 'brel gsum/ sems can du ston pa dang mi ston pa'i rten 'brel gnyis/ skad cig ma/ rgyun chags pa/ 'brel ba can/ gnas skabs pa'i rtenaX'abrel te bzhi/ snodaXdang bcud kyi rten 'brel gnyis rnams su yod la/ dbu ma pa'i lugs la 'dus byasaXdang 'dus ma byas kyi rten 'brel gnyis kyang 'dod do/ /skabs 'dir rkyen gsum las byung baXrten 'brel gyi don te/ rkyen gsum ni/ g.yo ba med pa'i rkyen/ mi rtag pa'i rkyen/ nus pa'i rkyen te gsum mo//yanaXlag bcu gnyis ni/ dang po ma rig pa la sngon gyi mtha' la rmongs pa/de bzhin du sbyar te/ phyi ma'i mtha'/ gnyis ka nang / phyi/ de gnyis kalas/ rnam par smin pa/ deXganyis ka sangs rgyas/ chos/ dge 'dun/sdug bsngal/ kun 'byung / 'gog pa/ lam/ rgyu/ rgyu lasaXbyung ba/ reg pa'i skye mched la rmongs pa ste bcu dgu dang / de re re la yang yul la rmongs tsam dang / the tshom dang / log par rtog pa'i rnam pa can gsum gsum ste ngaXbadun/ de re re la che 'bring chung gsum re ste brkya dang don gcig yod do/ /yang dus/ dngos po/ 'pho ba/ mchog de kho na nyid/ kun byang /mngon pa'i nga rgyal la rmongs pa bdun du yang bshad do/ /yang nyon mongs can yin min gnyis dang / nyon sgrib tu gyur pa/ shes sgrib tu gyur pa gnyis dang / gang zag gi bdag 'dzin/ chos kyi bdag 'dzin gnyis dang /161

las 'bras la rmongs pa dang / de kho na nyid la rmongs pa gnyis rnams so/ /yan lag bcu gnyis kyi dang po'i ma rig pa dang thog ma'i ma rig pa gnyis don mi gcig /rgyu'i kun slong du gyur pa dang / dus kyi kun slong du gyur pa'i ma rig pa gnyis/ ldan pa'i ma rig pa/ 'ba' zhig pa'i ma rig pa gnyis kyang yod la/ de gnyis la 'dres pa dang / ma 'dres pa'i ma rig pa zhes kyang zer ro/ /'khor ba'i rtsa bar gyur pa'i ma rig pa dang / 'phen byed kyi rgyu'i ma rig pa gnyis la snga ma yin la phyi ma ma yin pa dang / phyi ma yin la snga ma ma yin pa dang / gnyis ka yin pa/ gnyis ka ma yin pa ste pru bzhir bshad pa'ang yod do/ /ma rig pa dngaX'ajig lta gnyis gcig tu 'dod pa dang / tha dad du 'dod pa'iXlugs gnyis so/ / gnyis pa 'du byed la/ dge ba dang / mi dge ba dang / mi g.yo ba'i las gsum ste/ dang po gnyisaXl/ bsod nams dang / bsod nams ma yin pa'i las zhes kyang zer ro/ /'di rgyas par 'og tu 'byung ngo / /gsum pa rnam shes la/ rgyu dus kyi rnam shes/ 'bras dus kyi rnam shes gnyis dang / dge mi dge lung ma bstan gsum dang / phyi ma la bsgribs lung ma bstan dngaX/ ma bsgribs lung ma bstan gnyis/ yang rnam shes tshogs drug dang / kun btus ltar na tshogs brgyad kyang yod la/ de dag ni rnam shes dang yan lag gsum pa rnam shes kyi rten 'brel gnyis ma byed pa'i dbang du byas pa yinaXpas/ gong 'og gi yan lag gzhan rnams 162

la'ang de ltar shes par bya'o/ /bzhi ba ming gzugs la/ ming dang / gzugs gnyis/ ming la tshor ba/'du shes/ 'du byed/ rnam par shes pa ste phung bo bzhi'o/ /gzugs la/gzugs kyi sa bon tsam dang / nur nur po/ nar nar po/ ltar ltar po/'khrang 'gyur ba/ rkang lag 'gyus pa ste lnga yod/ nur nur po sogs la ming 'dokas mi 'dra baXmang ngo lnga ba skye mched drug ni/ nang gi skye mched drug ste brong du bshad zin to/ /drug pa reg pa ni/ spyir reg pa la sems byung reg pa dang / reg bya dang / rnam shes drug yul dang 'phrad pa'i cha la regaXpar brjod pa ste gsum yod/ yang thogs pa'i reg pa/ tshigs bla dwags kyi reg pa gnyis/rig pa'i reg pa/ ma rig pa'i reg pa/ de gnyis las gzhan pa'i reg pa/dri med kyi reg pa/ nyon mongs can gyi reg pa gnyis/ phyi ma la ma rig pa'i reg pa/ gnod sems kyi reg pa/ rjes su chags pa'i reg pa gsum/bde ba myong 'gyur gyi reg pa/ sdug bsngal sbong 'gyur gyi reg pa/ btang snyoms sbong 'gyur gyi reg pa ste gsum yod la/ reg pa drug ni sngar bshad zin to/ /bdun pa tshor ba la/ bde sdug btang stoms gsum/ migaXgi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba sogs drug yid tshor la nye bar rgyu ba bco brgyad de zag bcas kyi tshor ba'o/ /gong gi nur nur po sogs ni gzugasaX163

kyi ngo bo yin la/ skye mched drug ni gzugs kyi khyad par te/ de gnyis ni longs spyod pa po dang / reg pa yul gyi longs spyod dang / tshor ba rnam smin gyi longs spyod do/ /brgyad pa sred pa la/ 'dod pa'i sred pa/ gzugs kyi sred pa/gzugs med pa'i sred pa gsum/ yang 'dod sred/ 'jig sred/ srid sred gsum yod do/ /dgu ba len pa la/ 'dod pa/ lta ba/ tshul khrims brtul zhugs/bdag tu smra ba nye bar len pa ste bzhi'o//bcu ba srid pa la/ khams gsum gyi srid pa gsum/ gzhol ba'i sridaXpa/ zhugs pa'i srid pa gnyis/ spyir srid pa la bar srid/ skye srid/ sngon dus kyi srid pa/ 'chi srid dang bzhi yod do//bcu gcig pa skye ba la/ skyes pa/ shin tu skyes pa/ 'phos pa/ mngon par 'byung ba/ rab tu skye ba ste lnga/ thob tshul gyis phye na/ phung khams skye mched so sor thob pa gsum/ ngo bos bye na/ phung bo grub pa dang / srog dbang skye ba gnyis rnams so/ /gnyis pa rga shi ni/ rga ba la/ yongs su nyams pa'i rga ba/ nye bar 'khridaXpa'i rga ba gnyis/ yongs su nyams pa la/gzugs yongs su 'gyur ba/ stobs yongs su 'gyur ba/ shes rab 'gyur ba/ dran pa 'gyur ba/ longs spyod kyi bde ba 'gyur ba/ dbang bo 'gyur ba/tshe 'gyur ba ste bdun/ shi ba la/ 'phos pa'i shi ba'i rten 'brel/ 'pho ba'i 164

shi ba'i rten 'brel gnyis so/ /yan lag bsdu ba la/ 'phen par byed pa rgyu'i yan lag 'phangs pa 'bras bu'i yan lag mngon par 'grub par byed pa rgyu'i yan lag mngon par grub pa 'bras bu'i yan lag ste rgyu 'bras skor gnyis dang / gang gis 'phen pa'i yan lag ji lhar 'phen pa'i yad lag gang 'phangs pa'i yan lag gang gis 'grub pa'i yan lag ji ltar 'grub pa'i yad lag gang 'grub pa'i yan lag nyes dmigs kyi yan lag ste bdun dang / nyon mongs pa'i kun nyon/ las kyi kun nyon/ skye ba'i kun nyon nam pa'i kun nyon te gsum dang / sngon dang /phyi ma dang / bar gyi cha ste cha gsum dang / nyon mongs pa dang / las dang /gzhi gsum du bsdu ba dang/ nyon mongs pa'i lam/ las kyi lam/ sdug bsngal gyi lam ste gsum du bsdu ba dang / sdug bsngal bden pa dang / kun 'byung bden pa gnyis su bsdu ba rnams yod la/ spyir mdo las bstan tshul ni/ kun byang gi rted 'brel gnyis las/ kun nyon gyi rten 'brel lugs 'byung / kun nyon lugs 'byungaXgi rjes 'gro/ rnam byang lugs 'byung gi ldog 'gro rnams don gcig la/ rnam byang gi rten 'brel lugs 'byung / kun nyon lugs 'byung gi ldog 'gro/ rnam byang lugs 'byung gi rjes 'gro rnams don gcig go /kun btus 'dir yan lag bcu gnyis re re la yang sems can la bya ba byed pa'i las dang / chos la bya ba byed pa'i las te byed las gnyis gnyis dang / rig pas rig pa dang bem po la rkyen 166

du byed pa dang / bem pos bem po dang rig pa la rkyen du byed pa la rkyen bzhiraX'agyur tshul sogs go sla bas ma bris so/ /sgra don la/ byed pa po med pa/ rgyu dang bcas pa/ sems can med pa/ gzhan gyi dbang / g.yo ba med pa/ mi rtag pa/ skadaXcig pa/ rgyud rgyun mi 'chad pa/ rgyu 'bras 'thun pa/sna tshogs pa/ rgyu 'brasaXso sor nges pa ste rted 'brel gyi sgra don bcu gcig go /rten 'brel rtogs dka' ba la/ rgyus zab pa/ mtshan nyidaXkyis zab pa/ skye bsaXzab pa/ gnas pas zab pa/ 'byung bas zab pa ste lnga dang /skad cig pa yang yin la gnas par yang dmigs/ g.yo ba med pa'i rkyen las byung ba yang yin la nus pa so sor nges par yang dmigs/ sems can med pa yangaXyin la sems can duXyang dmigs/ byed pa po yang med la las chud mi zaXbar yang dmigs/ mtha' bzhi las kyang mi skye la byed pa don gzhan la ltos med du yang 'byung ba ste 'gal baXltar snang ba lnga'o/ /lhag ma ni go sga'o/ /des ni rten 'brel gyi skor bshad zin la/da niXdakyus la 'jug par bya ste/ rkyen la rgyu rkyen dang / lhan cig byed rkyen gnyis/ yang rgyu'i rkyen/ de ma thag pa'iXrkyen/ dmigs pa'i rkyen/bdag po'i rkyen te bzhi/ rgyu rkyen la kun gzhi bzhag pa'i dbang du byas na/zag bcas kyi rkyen kun gzhi sa bon gyi chas bsdus pa/ zag med kyiXrkyen dge ba'i bag chags te gnyis so/ /snga ma la rnam smin gyi cha dang / mngon 166

par 'du byed pa las byung ba gnyis so/ /kun gzhi ma bzhag pa'i dbang du byas na/ ngo bo dang dbye ba'i sgo nas byed rgyu/ lhan cig 'byung ba'i rgyu/mtshungs ldan gyi rgyu/ skal mnyam gyi rgyu/ kun 'gro'i rgyu/ rnam smin gyi rgyu ste drug go /byed rgyu la/ 'byung ba'i byed rgyu/ de bzhin du sbyar te gnas pa/brten pa/ gsal ba/ 'bral ba/ bsgyur ba/ yid ches pa/ yid ches par byed pa/ 'thob pa/ tha snyad/ ltos pa/ 'phen pa/ mngon par 'grub pa/yongs su 'dzin pa/ chud par byed pa/ so sor nges pa/ lhan cig byed pa/mi mthun pa/ mi mthun pa ma yin pa'i byed rgyu ste nyi shu'o/ /de ma thag rkyen la/ dge mi dge lung ma bstan gsum mo/ /dmigs rkyen la/ yul yongs su chad pa'i dmigs pa dang / deXbazhin du sbyar te/ yongs su ma chad pa/bkra 'dzin med pa/ bkra bar dmigs pa/ dngos po dang bcas pa/dngos po med pa/ dngos po/ kun brtags pa phyin ci log phyin ci log ma yin pa/ thogs pa dngaXbacas pa/ thogs pa med pa'i dmigs pa ste bcu gnyis so/ /bdag po'i rkyen la/ rten la dbang byed pa/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ 'phen pa/ lhan cig 'byung ba/ skye ba/ gnas pa/ 'bras bu/'jig rten pa'i rnam par dag pa/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rnam par dag pa la dbang byed pa ste brgyad do/ /mngon pa 'og mar byed rgyu la/ nus ldan/ nus med gnyis dang / lhan cig 'byung ba'i rgyu la/ mtshan nyid/mtshan gzhi/ sems kyi rjes 'jug ngos bzung ba/ rjes su 'jug tshul dang 167

gzhi'i sgo nas bcad la/ sems kyi rjes 'jug la/ rgyu bcur bshad pa dang / 'bras bu la skyes bu byed 'bras/ bral 'bras/ rnam smin gyiX'abras bu/rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu/ bdag po'i 'bras bu ste lnga dang / skal mnyam gyi rgyu la/ nyon mongs can yin min gnyis rnams su bshad la gzhan rnams kyi ming gi rnam grangs gong gi der 'du'o/ /dbang bo nyer gnyis ni/ mig sogs drug pho mo'i dbang bo gnyis/ srog gi dbang bo/ bde ba/ sdug bsngal/ yid bde/ yid mi bde/ btang snyoms te tshor ba'iXdabang bo lnga/dad pa/ brtson 'grus/ dran pa/ ting 'dzin/ shes rab kyi dbang bo/ mi shes pa kun shes par byed pa'i dbang bo/ kun shes pa'i dbang bo/ /kun shes pa dang ldan pa'i dbang boXrnams so/ /yang rten mtshungs kyi dbangaXboXdang / de mtshungs kyi dbang bo gnyis dang / zin pa'i dbang bo ste gsum mo/ /yul 'dzin par dbang ba drug rigs brgyud la dbang ba gnyis/ris mthun par gnas pa la dbang ba gcig dge mi dge 'bras bur nye bar spyod pa la dbang ba lnga/ 'jig rten 'dod chags dang bral ba la dbang ba lnga/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i 'dod chags dang bral ba la dbang byed pa gsum mo/ /bye zag smra bas/ sems kyi rten nam gzhi'i dbang du byas pa drug sems can gyi bye brag 'byed pa la dbang ba gnyis/sems can gyi rigs rgyun gnas paXl dbang ba gcig kun nas nyon mongs la dbang ba lnga/ rnam byang gi rgyu tshogs pa la dbang ba lnga/ rnam 168

byang gi ngo bo la dbang ba gaspum du 'dod par mngon pa mdzod du bshad rdo / /sdug bsngal gsum ni/ sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal dang / 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal/ khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gsum mo/ /rnam par smid pa dang bcasaXpa ni/ mi dge ba dang / dge ba zag bcas rnams so/ /rnam par smin pa'i gtso bo ni/ kun gzhi rnam shes mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa'o/ /zas la bzhi ste/ kham gyi zas/ reg pa'i zas/ sems pa'i zas/rnam par shes pa'i zas so/ /kham gyi zas la rags pa dang phra ba gnyis/zas bzhi ni rim pa bzhin du dbang bo rten bcas kyi lus gnas pa dang /brten pa sems sems byung rgyasaXpa dang / yang srid phyi maX'aphen pa dang las kyis 'phangs pa'i bag chags gso ba'i byed las can no/ /yang ma dag pa'i lus gnas par byed pa dang / dag pa dang ma dag pa'i lusaXganas par byed pa dang / dag pa'i lus gnasaXpar byed pa dang / gnas par kun tu stod par byed pa ste byed las bzhi'o/ /gong ma dang bcas pa dang / gong na med pa gnyis la dbye ba gzhan med do/ /ngo bo nyid gsumaXni/ kun brtags pa'i mtshan nyid/ rnam par brtags pa'i mtshan nyid/chos nyid kyi mtshan nyid gsum mo/ /yang na kun brtags/ gzhan dbang yongs grubaXgasum mo/ /kun brtags ni chos gsum las bdag sems can/ srog skye ba po/ gso baXpo/ gang zag shed las skyes/ shed bu zhes 169

brtags pa'o/ /spyir kun brtags la/ rnam grangs pa'i kun brtags dang /mtshan nyid yongs su chad pa'i kun brtags gnyis/ gzhan dbang la dag pa'i gzhan dbang dang / ma dag pa'i gzhan dbang gnyis/ yongs grub la sgras brjod kyis dbye na/ phyin ci ma log pa'iXyongs grub dang / 'gyur med kyi yongs grub gnyis/ phyi ma la/ gang zag dang / chos kyi bdag medaXkyi dbang du byas pa gnyis rnams su yod do/ /rab tu dbyeXb rnam pa bzhi ni/ mtshanaXnyid kyis rab tu dbye ba/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ rnam pa/ lus/rgyun gyis rab tu dbye ba'o/ /rab dbye drug ni/ phyi rol du bltas pa/ nang du bltas pa/ rgyun ring ba'i dus/ dus yongs su chad pa/ de'i dus/ kud tu bstan pas rab tu dbye ba'o/ /'di yan chad kyis rnam pa'i rab dbye rdzogs pa yin la/ de yang rdzas yod sogs bzhi/ shes bya sogs gsum/gzugs can sogs drug zag bcas sogs bcu gnyis/ byung sogasaXbargyad/ 'das sogs bcu drug rkyen sogs bcu gcig ste sde tshan bdun dang / ngo bo nyid gsum/ rab dbye bzhi dang drug ste bsdus pa'i dbye ba gsum gyi sgo nas phung khams skye mched kyi chos so drug rgyas par bshad pa'o /bsdus pa rnam pa bcu gcig ni/ mtshan nyid kyis bsdus pa/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ khams/ rigs/ gnasadagabs/ grogs/ phyogs/ dus/phyogs gcig gis bsdus pa/ mtha' dag gis bsdus pa/ gcigaXgis 170

gcig bsdus pa/ don dmaXpas bsdus pa'o/ /mtshungs ldan drug ni/ tha dadaXmed pas mtshungs par ldan pa/ 'dres pa mtshungs ldan/ 'phrad pa mtshungs ldan/ lhan cig 'byung ba mtshungs ldan/ bya ba grub pa mtshungs ldan/ mthun pa rtogs pa mtshungs ldan no/ /mthun pa rtogs pa mtshungs ldanaXl/ mtshungs ldan rnam pa lnga mtshungs ni/ rten/ dmigs pa/ rnam pa/dus/ rdzas mtshungs pa'o/ /de'i dbye ba la/ nges pa'i mtshungs ldan/ ma nges pa'i mtshungs ldan/ gnas skabs kyi mtshungs ldan/ rgyun gyi mtshungs ldan/ rgyun chad pa'i mtshungs ldan/ phyi rol du bltas pa'i mtshungs ldan/nang du bltas pa'i mtshungasaXldan/ 'dris pa'i mtshungs ldan/ ma 'dris pa'i mtshungs ldan te dgu'o/ /ldan pa gsu ma ni/ sa bon dang ldan pa/dbang dang ldan pa/ kun 'byung ba dang ldan pa'o/ /mtshan nyid kun las btus pa rdzogs so/ /gnyis pa rnam par nges paXkun las btus la gsum las/ bden pa rnam nges la/ bden pa bzhi las/ sdug bsngal gyi bden pa la/ bcud kyi 'jigaXrten/ snod kyi 'jig rten gnyis/ bcud la/ lams gsum gyis dbye na/ 'dod khams pa/ gzugs khams pa/ gzugs med lams pa'o /'gro baXlnga ni/ dmyal ba/ yi dwags/ dud 'gro/ mi/ lha'o/ /dmyal ba la/ tsha dmyal/ grang dmyal/ nye 'khor/ nyi tshe bzhi'o/ / tsha dmyal brgyad ni/ yang sos/ thig nag bsdus 'joms/ ngu 'bod/171

ngu 'bod chen po/ tsha ba/ rab tsha ba/ mnar med do/ /grang dmyal brgyad ni/ chu bur can/ chu bur rdol ba/ so tham tham pa/ kyi hud zer ba/ a chu zer ba/ ut+pal ltar gas pa/ pad+ma lhar gas pa/ pad+ma ltar cher gas pa'o/ /nye 'khor ba'i dmyal ba ni/ me ma nur gyi 'obs/ ro myags kyi 'dam/ spu gris gtams pa'i lam/ ral gri'i lo ma can gyi nags tshal/ shal ma li'i tshal/ chu klung rabs med rnamasaXso/ /nyi tshe ba'i dmyal ba ni/ gtun/phyags ma/ ka ba/ rtsig pa/ phru chen la sogs pa'i dbyibs dang ldan pa la sogs pa mtha' yas pa yod do/ /dud 'gro la/ byings na gnas pa dang / kha 'thor ba gnyis so//yi dwags la/ phyi'i sgrib paXcan/ nang gi sgrib pa can/ zas skom gyi sgrib pa can te gsum mo/ /mi la/ gling bzhi'i bzhi'o/ /'dod lha rigs drug ni/ rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa/ 'thab bral/dga' ldan/ 'phrul dga'/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed do/ /gzugs khams gnas rigs bcu bdun ni/ tshangs ris/ tshangs paXmadun na 'don/tshangs chen te gsumaXni bsam gtan dang po'o/ /'od chung / tshad med 'od/ 'od gsal gsum ni bsam gtan gnyis pa'o/ /dge chung / tshad med dge dge rgyas gsum ni bsam gtan gsum pa'o/ /sprin med/bsod nams skyes/ 'bras bu che ba ste so so skye bo'i gnas gsum dang / mi che ba/ mi gdung ba/ shin tu mthong ba/ gya nom snang ba/ 'og min te 172

'phags pa'i gnas lnga ste brgyad ni bsam gtan bzhi ba'o/ /'di'i gong na dbang phyug chen po'i gnas zhes bya ba'i gnas rigs bco brgyad pa zhig yod par theg pa chen po'i sde snod las 'byung ngo / /gzugs med rigs bzhi ni/ nam mkha'i mtha' yas skye mched/ rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched/ ci yang med pa'i skye mched/ 'du shes med 'du shes med min gyi skye mched do/ /lha ma yin ni lha dang dud 'gro yi dwags ci rigs su 'du'o/ /srid pa bdun ni/ dmyal ba'i srid pa/ dud 'gro'i srid pa/ yi dwags kyi srid pa/ lha'i srid pa/ mi'i srid pa/ las kyi srid pa/ srid pa bar ma'o/ /rnamaXshes kyi gnas da bdun ni/ lus dang 'du shes gnyis ka tha dad pa dang / lus tha dad cing 'du shes gcig pa/ de las ldog pa/gnyis ka gcig pa/ gzugs can ma yin pa'i gnas dang po gsum ste bdun no/ /de'i steng du srid rtse dang 'du shes med pa'i sems can bsnan pa ni sems can gyi gnas pa dgu'o/ /sems kyi gnas pa bzhi ni/ phung bo dang po bzhi la spyod pas phye ba'o//skye gnas bzhi'i dbye ba ni/ sgong skyes/ mngal skyes/ drod gsher lasaXskyes pa/ rdzus skyes te bzhi'o/ /snod la/ 'og gi gzhir gnas pa ni rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ chu'i dkyil 'khor/ sa'i dkyil 'khor/ de la brten pa'i gnas ni ri rab lhan po gru bzhi ba bang rim bzhi ba/ shar shel/ lho baiḍū r+ya/nub pad+ma rā ga byang gser las grub pa'o/ /de'i mtha' skor du gser gyi 173

ri bdun te/ gnya' shing 'dzin/ gshol mda' 'dzin/ seng ldeng can/ lta na snyug rta rna/ rnam 'dud/ nu khyud 'dzin no/ /'khor yug tu ni lcags kyi ri'o/ /de dag gi bar du rol mtsho bdun dang / phyi'i rgya mtsho chen po'o/ /rol mtsho rnams ni yan lag brgyad ldan yin la/ yan lag brgyad ni/bsil ba/ zhim pa/ yang ba/ 'jam pa/ dang ba/ dri nga ba med pa/ 'thung na mgrin pa la mi gnod pa/ lto ba la mi gnod pa'o/ /klu'i gnasaXbargyad ni/dga' bo/ nye dga' bo/ rta yi gzhi/ btang bzung / gzi can/ yulaX'akhor bsrung / nag po chen po/ a la'i 'dab kyi gnas so/ /rgya mtsho la gnas pa'i gling bzhi ni/ lus 'phags gling / 'dzam bu gling / ba lang spyod/sgra mi snyad te dbyibs ni rim paXbazhin du/ zla gam dang / shing rta lta buXdang / rlum po dang / gru bzhi'o/ /gling g.yog gam gling phran brgyad ni/ lus dang lus 'phags gnyis/rnga yab dang rnga yab gzhan gnyis/ g.yo ldan dang lam mchog 'gro gnyis/sgra miXsnyan dang sgra mi snyan gyi zla rnams so/ /'dzam duXgling na rdo rjeXgadan nas byang du ri nag po dgu 'das pa na gangs ri chen po te se yod do/ /de dang sgos ngad ldang ba'i ri gnyis kyi bar na mtsho ma dros pa yod do/ /de las gaṅga/ sin+d+ra/ si ta/ pak+ṣu ste chu bo chen po bzhi 'bab bo/ /gling 'di'i ri chen po gsum ni/ gangs can/ 'begs byed/ man+ta ra gsum/ shing khyad par can gaspum ni/ 'dzam bu/ shal ma li/ sa la'i rgyal po rab brtan 174

gsum mo/ /spes ngad ldang ba'i byang phyogs na/ brag gser gyi bya skyibs dang / rdzing bu dal gyis 'thor zhes bya ba yod/gnas chen lnga ni/ rdo rje gdan/ ri bo rtse lnga/ po ta la/ o ṭi ya na/sham+bha la'o/ /gling 'di'i 'og na/ gong du bshad pa'i dmyal ba rnams dang yi dwags kyi grong khyer ser skya zhes bya bar gshin rje'i rgyal po'i pho brang rgyal po'i khab ces bya ba yod do/ /lhun po'i chu mtshams su ni lha ma yin gyi grong khyer 'od can dang / de'i 'og tu skar phreng / de'i 'og tu zab pa/de'i 'og tu gser ldan la sogs pa yod do/ /lhun po'i byed na nyi ma dang zla ba'o/ /ri rab kyi bang rim dang po la/ gnod sbyin lag naXgazhong thogs/gnyis pa la phreng thogs/ gsum pa la rtag myos/ bzhi ba la rgyal chenaXbazhi ba'i lha rnams gnas so/ /lhun po'i rtse moXd sum cu rtsa gsum ste/ 'di'i so gsum ni/ 'jig rten pa la grags pa ltar na nor lha brgyad/ nyi ma'i bu bcu gnyis/ drag po bcu gcig tha skad kyi bu gnyis rnams yin la/bstan bcosaXl grags pa ni/ grong khyer gyi phyogs bzhi na 'khor gyi gtso bo nye dbang brgyad brgyad de so gnyis dang / dbus na lha'i dbang bo brgya byin te so gsum mo/ /lhan po'i rtse mo bzhi na lag na rdo rje thogs pa'i gnod sbyin gnas pa'i khang bu brtsegs pa bzhi dang / dbus na brgya byin gyi pho brang grong khyer lta na sdug pa yod/ de'i dbus na rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang yod do/ /grong khyer de'i phyi rol gyi phyogs bzhi na shing rta sna 175

tshogs can/ rtsub 'gyur/ 'dres pa/ dga' ba'i tshal zhes bya ba'i skyed mos tshal bzhi'o/ /byang shar mtshams na shing sa brtol yongs 'du dang /lho nub mtshams na chos bzang lha'i mdun sa yod do/ /de'i steng naXdaga' ldan nas brtsams te yas rim bzhin gong du bshad pa'i lha'i gnas rnams yod do/ /de lta bu'i 'jig rten gyi khams stong phrag gcig la stong spyi phud kyi 'jig rten gyi khams/ de stong la stong bar ma'i 'jig rten gyi khams/ de stong la stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams zhes bya'o/ /sems can de dag gi lus tshad dang snod kyi rgya che chung rnams dang dpangs sogs gzhal tshul ni/ rdul phra rab dang / rdul phran/ lcags rdul/chu rdul/ ri bong gi rdul/ lug rdul/ glang rdul/ nyi zer gyi rdul/sro ma/ shiganas/ sor mo rnams rim pa bzhin du bdun 'gyur dang / sor mo nyi shu rtsa bzhi la khru gang / khru bzhi la gzhu 'dom gang / de lnga brgya la rgyang grags gcig de brgyad la dpag tshad du 'jog pa'o/ /sems can gyi tshe tshad dang bskal chen sogs kyiXbartsi tshul ni/ dus mtha'i skad cig ma brgya nyi shu la de'i skad cig de drug cu la thang cig de sum cu la yud tsam/ de sum cu la nyin zhag de sum cu la zla ba/ zhag mi thub drug dang bcas pa'i zla baXbacu gnyis la lo gcig tu 'jog go /bskal baXl bar bskal/ 'jig bskal/ stong bskal/ chags bskal/gnas bskal/ bskal ba chen po rnams su yod do/ /gzugs dang dus kyi 176

tshad gzhal bar byed pa'i grangs kyi gnas la lugs mi 'dra ba lnga tsam yod kyang / mngon pa'i lugs ni/ gcig bcu/ brgya/ stong / khri/ 'bum/ sa la/bye ba/ dung phyur te dgu ni rkyang ba dang / ther 'bum/ khrag khrig rab bkram/ gtams/ dkrigs/ mi 'khrugs/ khyad 'byin/ pang steng / ded 'dren/ mtha' snang / rgyu rigs/ 'od mdzes/ dbang bo/ legs phyin/rtogs 'gro/ 'byid rdul/ rgya rtags/ stobs 'khor/ brda' shes/ rnam byung / stobs mig byams pa/ snying rje/ dga' ba/ btang snyoms rnams chen po'i zla dang bcas la/ grangs med/ tshad med/ dpag med/ brjod med/ dpag yas/ gzhal med/ gzhal gyis mi lang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams gong nas gong du bcu bcur bsgre'o/ /'di la mngon pa mdzod kyi 'grel bar stobs mig chen po dang grangs med kyi bar du gnas brgyad ma rnyed par gsungasaXpas/ de'i tshab tu tshad med bzhi chen po re dang bcas bsnan nas 'dren pa ni bla ma gong ma'i phyag len yin no/ /de ltar na bar bskal gcig la mi lo dkrigs chen po gsum/ dkrigs gsum/ gtams chen po dgu/ gtams bdun/ rabaXbakram chen po bdun/ khrag khrig chen po drug khrag khrig gnyis/ ther 'bum chen po bzhi rnams su yod la/ de lta bu'i bar bskal nyi shu ni chags pa'i bskal ba/ nyi shu gnas bskal/ nyi shu 'jig bskal/ nyi shu stong bskal te bar bskal brgyad cu la bskal chen gcig tu 'jog go /177

gnas bskal la ya thog ring mo/ bar gyi khug pa bco brgyad/ ma thog ring mo ste nyi shur bshad do/ /mkhas pa kha cig bar bskal gcig la mi lo dkrigs phrag dgur bshad pa'ang yod do/ /de lta bu'i bskal chen grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags pa las sangs rgyas 'thob bo/ /bskal ba brgyar sangs rgyas 'byung ba la mnyes par byas pa las rang sangs rgyas 'thob bo/ /mi rnams kyi tshe lo dpag med nas brgyad khri'i bar du 'khor losaXbasgyur baX'abyung ngo / /de la gser dadul zangs lcags kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba bzhi'o/ /des ni rim pa bzhin du gling bzhi dang / gsum dang /gnyis dang / gcigaXl dbang bsgyur bar byed do/ /dbang byed tshul ni/phas nas bsuXb dang / rang nyid 'gro ba dang / g.yul bshams pa tsam dang / mtshon brtsam pa tsam gyis dbang du byed do/ /de'i rin po che sna bdun ni/ 'khor lo/ glang po/ rta/ bud med/ nor bu/ khyemaXbadag blon po/rin po che dang bdun no/ /nye ba'i rin po cheXbadunaXni/ ral gri/ pags pa/khang ba/ gos/ nags tshal/ mal cha/ lham rin po che ste bdun no/ /'jig bskal gyi rgyu la/ nu ge dang / nad dang / mtshon gyi bskal ba bar ma gsum dang / meXchu rlung gsum gyis 'jig pa rnams su yod do/ /de dag ni snod bcud kyi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rnam par bzhag pa'i ming gi rnam grangs slob dpon sku mched kyi gzhung las byung ba rnams phan tshun bsres te bris pa yin la/ mngon pa gong gnyis bzhed pa cungaXzad mi 'dra ba mang du yod 178

kyang 'dir ni ming tsam bsdu bar 'dod pas gnyi ka las 'byung ba'i ming phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa la skyon du ma 'dzin shig yongs su dag pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can lta bu ni sdug bsngal gyi bdenaXpa ma yin no/ /sdug bsngal gyi mtshan nyid ni sdug bsngal brgyad du dbye ba la/ dang po skye ba'i sdug bsngal la/ sdug bsngal dang ldan pas sdug bsngal ba/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ gnas ngan len dang ldan pa/ sdug bsngal gyiXganas su gyur pa/nyon mongs kyi gnasaXsu gyur pa/ mi 'dod bzhin du 'bral ba'i chos nyid yin pas sdug bsngal ba ste lnga'o/ /gnyis pa rga ba la/ lang tsho/ mthu stobs/dbang bo/ yul la longs spyod pa tshe yongs su nyams pas sdug bsngal ba ste lnga'o/ /gsum pa na ba la/ lus kyi rang bzhin 'gyur ba/ sdug bsngal dang yid mi bde 'phel zhing de la gnas pa/ yid du 'ong ba'i yul spyad du med pa/ yid du mi 'ong ba nan gyis spyadaXdagos pa/ srog gi dbang boXdang 'bral bar 'gyur ba ste lnga'o/ /bzhi ba 'chi ba la/ longs spyod sdug pa dang 'bral ba/ 'khor sdug pa dang 'bral ba/ lus sdug ji1 dang 'azal ba 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal dang / yid mi bde drag po myong ba ste lnga'o/ /lnga ba mi sdug pa dang phrad pa la/ sdug bsngal dang yid mi bde 'phel ba/ chad pas 'jigs pa/ gtam ngan gyis 'jigs pa/ nyam nga bzhin du 'chi bas 'jigs pa/ ngan 'gror song dogs nasaX'ajigs pa ste lnga'o/ /drug pa sdug pa dang bral ba la/ sems la mya ngan skye ba/ ngag gi smre sngags 'don pa/179

lus la gnod pa skyed pa/ 'dod pas yid gdung ba/ longs spyod ma tshang ba ste lnga'o/ /bdun pa 'dod pa btsal te ma rnyed pa la lnga ste snga ma dang 'dra'o/ /brgyad pa nye bar len pa'i phung bo'i sdug bsngal la/ mngon par 'grub pa'i sdug bsngal gyi snod/ mngon par grub pa la brten pa'i sdug bsngal gyi snod/ sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal gyi snod/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal gyi snod/ khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyi rang zhin yin pa ste lnga'o/ /sdug bsngal gsum yang der 'du'o/ /sdug bsngal gnyis ni/ kun rdzob pa'iXbaden par sdug bsngal ba/ don dam pa'i bden par sdug bsngal ba ste gnyis so/ /sdug bsngal spyi'i mtshan nyid la mi rtag pa/ sdug bsngal ba/ stong ba/ bdag med bzhi'o/ /mi rtag pa la/ med pa'i mtshan nyid/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ rnam par 'jig pa/ 'gyur ba/ 'bral ba/ nye ba/ chos nyid/ skad cig ma/ rgyud/ nad la sogs pa/ rnamaXpa sna tshogs kyi sems 'byung ba/longs spyod rgad pa/ snod chags 'jig gi mtshan nyid de bcu gnyis so/ /sems can 'chi 'pho ba'i rgyu la/ tshe zad pa/ bsod nams zad pa/ lasaXzad pa steXgasum mo/ /yang sdug bsngal gyi dbye ba la/ sdug bsngal shin tu rgyas la ma bsrabs pa/ bsrabs pa/ gnyi ka yin pa/ bar ma ma bsrabs pa/srab la ma bsrabs pa/ ches srab la bsrabs pa/ shin tu bsrabs la srabaXpa/ bsrabs pa chen pos nye bar gnas pa ste brgyad do/ /sdug bsngal mngon par 'grub pa'i rim pa la/ 'chi sems gsum ni/ dge ba dang / mi 180

dge ba dang / lung ma bstan pa'i sems dang ldanaXpas 'chi ba'o 'chi ba'i tshe lus kyi bye bragaXl/ dge ba byed pa ni thog mar smad nas drod sdudaXpa dang / mi dge ba byed pa ni thog mar stod nas drod sdud pa'o/ /'dod lha'i 'chi ltas lnga ni/ gos la dri ma chags pa/ me tog gi phreng ba rnying ba/mchan khung du rngul 'byung ba/ lus la dri nga ba/ stan la mi dga' ba'o/ /maXnges pa'i ltas lnga ni/ gos rgyanaXlas sgra mi snyan pa 'byung ba/ lus kyi 'od chung ba/ lus la khrus chuXchags pa/ yul gcig la chags pa/ mig gi rdzi ma 'khrab pa ste lnga'o/ /bar srid 'grub tshul la/ yid las byung ba/ dri za/ srid 'tshol/ srid pa bar ma/ mngon par 'grub pa'i srid pa rnams ni bar do'i ming gi rnam grangs so/ /dmyal ba'i bar do'i kha dog ni/ sdong dum tshig pa lta bu/ dud 'gro'i du ba lta bu/ yi dwags kyi chu lta bu/ 'dod pa'i lha mi'i gser lta bu/ gzugs khams pa'i dkar po'o/ /tshe tshad ni zhag bdun no/ /de ltar thogs na bdun bdun bzhi bcu zhe dgu'o/ /dbyibs ni sngonaXdus kyi srid pa'i sha tshugs can no/ /las kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi shugs dang ldan pa/ dbang bo kun tshang ba/ gang la'ang thogs pa med pa/ ris mthun dang lha'i mig dag pas mthong ba ste khyad par bzhi ldan no/ /'gro tshul ni/ lha'i bar do gyen/ mi'i bar do thad ka ngan 'gro'i spyi tshugs su 'gro'o/ /gnyis pa kun 'byung bden pa la/ nyon mongs pa dang / las gnyis las/ nyon mongs pa'i kun 'byung la mdo las/ sredaXpa gtso bor bshad pa ni/ dngos 181

po thams cad du 'gro ba dang / de bzhin du sbyar te gnas skabs/ dus/lams/ tshol ba/ rnam pa thams cad du 'gro ba ste drug la dgongs pa'o/ /gzhung 'dir chos bcu'i sgo nas nyon mongs rgyas par bshad de/ grangs/mtshan nyid/ 'byung ba/ dmigs pa mtshungs par ldan pa/ rnam grangs/ldog par zhukas pa/ khams/ ris/ spong byed gnyen po ste bcu'o/ /grangs la rtsa ba'i nyon mongs pa drug ste/ 'dod chags/ khong khro/ nga rgyal/ ma rig pa/ the tshom/ lha ba'o/ /lta ba la dbye na/ 'jig lta/ mthar lta/ log lta/ lta ba mchog 'dzin/ tshul khrims brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin te lnga'o/ /mtshan nyid ni/ sems kyi rgyud rab tu ma zhi bas rab tu phye ba'o/ /'byung ba'i rgyu ni/ bag la nyal/ dmigs pa/ tshul bzhin ma yin pa'i yid byed de gsum mo/ /dmigs pa ni/ nyon mongasaXdang / nyon mongs 'byung ba'i gzhi dang /med pa'i don te gsum mo/ /mngon pa 'og mar/ nyon mongs drug po phra rgyas su bshad la/ phra rgyas kyi don/ bye brag smra bas/ kun dkris nyon mongs la 'dod/ gnas ma bu ba'i sde ba rnams kyis nyon mongs pa'i thob pa la 'dod/ mdo sde ba dang slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis nyod mongs pa'i sa bon la bzhed par bshad cing / nyon mongs skye ba'i rgyu la/ rgyu phra rgyas ma spangs pa dang / nyon mongs skye ba'i yul nyeXb dang / tshul bzhin ma yin pa'i yid byed gsum duXbashad do/ /mtshungs ldan ni/ /nyon mongs gang dang mtshungs ldan/ tshor ba 182

gang dang mtshungs ldan/ rnam shes gang dang mtshungs ldan te gsum gyis bshad la/ mtshungs par ldan tshul mngon pa gong 'og cung zad mi 'dra'o/ /nom grangs la nyi shu rtsa bzhi las/ dang po kun sbyor la/ rjes su chags pa'i kun sbyor/ khong khro ba'i kun sbyor/ nga rgyal gyi kun sbyor/ ma rig pa'i kun sbyor/ lta ba'i kun sbyor/ mchog tu 'dzin pa'i kud sbyor/ the tshom gyi kun sbyor/ phrag dogaXgi kun sbyor/ ser sna'i kun sbyor te dgu'o/ /nga rgyal bdun te/ nga rgyal/ che ba'i nga rgyal/ nga rgyal las kyang nga rgyal/ nga'o snyam pa'i nga rgyal/ mngon pa'i nga rgyal/ cung zad snyam pa'i nga rgyal/ log pa'i nga rgyal lo/ /mngon pa 'og mar/ bdag mchog yin no/ /bdag dang 'dra'o/ /bdag dman no/ /bdag pas mchog yod do/ /bdag dang mnyam pa med do/ /bdag pas dman pa med do snamaXpa'i nga rgyal dgu mdo las bshad pa dang / bsdu na/ nga rgyal/ lhag pa'i nga rgyal/ cung zad snyam pa'i nga rgyal gsum du 'du bar bshad do/ /gnyis pa 'ching ba ni dug gsum mo/ /gsum pa bag la nyal ni/ 'dod pa'i 'dod chags kyi bag la nyal/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ khong khro/ srid pa'iX'adod chags/ ma rig pa/ lta ba/ the tshom gyi bag la nyal te bdun no/ /bzhi ba nye ba'i nyon mongs pa ni gong du bshad pa'i nyeXnyon nyi shu'o/ /lnga ba kun dkris ni/ rmugs pa/ gnyid/ rgod pa/ 'gyod pa/ phrag dog ser sna/ ngo tsha med pa/ khrel med pa ste brgyad do//drug pa chu boXni/ 'dod pa/ sridaXpa/ lta ba/ ma rig pa'i chu bo ste bzhi'o/ /183

bdun pa sbyor ba ni/ 'dod pa'i sbyor ba sogs bzhi ste snga ma dang 'dra'o/ /brgyad pa nyeXbar len pa ni/ 'dod pa/ lta ba/ tshul khrims brtul zhugs/bdagaXtu smra ba nye bar len pa ste bzhi'o/ /mngon pa 'og mar/ skabs 'dir lung ma bstan gyi lta ba bcu bzhi la/ dri ba bzhi ni/ mgo gcig tu lungaXbastan par bya ba'i dri ba/ rnam par phye nas lung bstan pa'i dri ba/dris nas lung bstan pa'i dri ba/ bzhag par bya ba'i dri ba dang bzhir bshad do/ /dgu ba mdud pa la/ brnab semasaXlus kyi mdud pa/ de bzhin du sbyar te gnod sems/ tshul khrims brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin/ lta ba mchog 'dzin gyi lus kyi mdud pa ste bzhi'o/ /bcu ba sgrib pa ni/ 'dod pa la 'dun pa/ gnod sems/ rmugs gnyid/ rgod 'gyod/ the tshom gyi sgrib pa ste lnga'o/ /bcu gcig pa tha ba/ bcu gnyis pa dri ma/ bcu gsum pa sdig pa/bcu bzhi ba zug rngu/ bco lnga ba ci yang / bcu drug pa nyes par spyod pa rnams dug gsum mo/ /mngon pa 'og mar/ dri ma la/ sgyu/ g.yo/ rgyags pa/'tshig pa/ khon 'dzin/ rnam 'tshe ste drug tu bshad do/ /bcu bdud pa zag pa ni/ 'dod pa/ srid pa/ ma rig pa'i zag pa ste gsum mo/ /bco brgyad pa phongs pa/ bcu dgu ba yongs su gdung ba/ nyi shu ba 'khrug pa/nyer gcig pa 'thab pa/ nyer gnyis pa rims nad/ nyer gsum pa nags sbyor/ nyer bzhi ba gegs rnams kyang dug gsum mo/ /mngon pa 'og mar/phra rgyasaXkun du 'gro ba dang / kun 'gro ma yin pa gnyis/ gong ma'i cha 184

mthun lnga dang / tha ma'i cha mthun lnga ste gnyis dang / dmigs pa dang mtshungs ldan gyi rgyas 'gyur gnyis sogs bshad kyangaXgong gi der 'du'o/ /log par zhugs pa la/ yul dang lta ba la log paraXzhugs pa/ sems can dang lta ba la log par zhugs pa/ lta ba la log par zhugs pa/ gnyen po la log par zhugs pa/ thams cad la log par zhugs pa/ sdug kun la log par zhugs pa 'gog lam la log par zhugs pa ste brgyad do//khams kyi dbye ba ni/ khams gong ma gnyis na khong khro med do/ /nyon mongs lhag ma ni khams gsum ka na yod do/ /spang bya'i ris ni/ mthong spang nyon mongs brgya dang bcu gnyis/ sgom spang bcu drug go /mngonaXpa 'og mar/ 'dod pa naXsdug bsngal mthong bas spang bar bya ba bcu/ kun 'byung mthong spang bdun/ 'gog pa mthong spang bdun/ lam mthong spang brgyad/ sgom sgang bzhi ste so drug gzugs gzugs med na khong khro ma gtogs pa sum cu so gcig reXste dgu bcu rtsa gcig tu bshadaXdo/ /spong byed gnyen po la/ spong ba'i sbyor baXni/ yongs su shes pa/ dang du mi len pa/ gnyen po rnyed pa gsum mo/ /yongs su shes pa ni/ rgyu/ ngo bo/ nyes dmigs te gsum shes pa'o/ /gnyen po la grol byed kyi lam bdag med rtogs pa dang / 'byung byed kyi lam mi rtag pa rtogs pa sogs teXganyis so/ /spangs pa la gnyis te/ re zhig mi skye ba'i nyams smad pa dang / sa bon spangs pas skyeraXmi rung ba'i chos can du byas pa'o/ /las kyi kun 'byung la/185

sgras brjod kyis dbye na las lnga ste/ dmigs pa'i las/ byed pa'i las/rtsol ba'i las/ bsgyur ba'i las/ thob pa'i las so/ /las dngos la/sems pa'i las/ bsam pa'i las gnyis/ snga ma la bsod nams dang /bsod nams ma yin pa dang / mi g.yo ba'iXlas gsum mo/ /phyi ma la rten gyi sgo nas lus ngag yid gsum gyi gsum dang / ngo bo'i sgo nas dge mi dge gnyis so/ /sems pa las gyur pa'i las lnga ni/ gzhan gyis bsgo ba/gzhan gyis gsol ba gdab pa/ mi shes pa/ rtsa ba la mngon par zhen pa/phyin ci log gi sems pa las gyur pa'o/ /sems pa'i las dang yid las don gcig bsam pa'i las la lus ngag gi las gnyis dang / de re re la rnam par rig byed dang / rnam par rigaXbyed ma yin pa gnyis gnyis/ phyi ma la rang yin gyi sdom pa dang sdom min dang bar ma'i tshul khrims kyis bsdus pa'i rnam rig min pa dang gsum du bshad cing / dge ba la donaXdam pa'i dge ba/ ngo bo nyid kyi dge ba/ mtshungs ldan gyi dge ba/ kun slong gi dge ba bzhi/ mi dge baXdang / lung ma bstan gnyis la'ang dbye ba de dang 'dra/ las kyi kun slong la/ rgyu'i kun slong dang / dus kyi kun slong gnyis las/ snga ma rab tu 'jug byed dang / phyi ma rjes su 'jug byed yin la/ de yang rab 'jug yin la rjes 'jug ma yin pa'i myu/ rjes 'jug yin la rab 'jug ma yin pa'i mu/ gnyi ka yin pa'i nu/ gnyi ka ma yin pa'i nu ste bzhi dang / bye brag smra bas rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs kyang 186

rdzas grub tu 'dod par bshad do/ /yang las la myong bar nges pa'i las dang / ma nges pa'i las gnyis/nges pa la/ byed pa nges pa/ rnam smin sbong bar nges pa/ dus nges pa ste gsum/ yang las byas shing bsags pa/ bsags la ma byas pa/ byas la ma bsags pa ste gsum/las kyi 'bras bu gaspum ni/ rnam smin gyi 'bras bu/rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu/ bdag po'i 'bras du ste gsum/ de ni dge mi dge gnyisaXka la 'dra'o/ /yang 'phen byed kyi las dang / rdzogs byed kyi las gnyis/ 'phen byed dge bas 'phangs la rdzogs byed mi dge bas rdzogs pa/'phen byed mi dge bas 'phangs la rdzogs byed dge bsaXrdzogs pa/ gnyi ka dge ba/ gnyi ka mi dge ba ste mu bzhi/ 'phen tshul la/ las gcig gis lus gcig 'phen pa/ las gcig gis lus du ma 'phen pa/ las du mas gcig 'phen pa/ las du mas lus du ma 'phen pa ste su bzhi/ mngon pa 'og mar/ las du mas skye ba gcig 'phen pa dang / las gcig gis skye ba du ma 'phen pa bye smra'i lugs laXmed par bshad do/ /las smin tshul gyi rim pa la/ spru yang gi khyad par yod na/ lci ba thog mar smin la/ de yang 'dra na 'chi dus gang mngon du gyur pa dang / de yang 'dra na goms shas gang che ba dang / de yang 'dra naXthog mar gang byas pa sngon la smin par byed do/ /mi dge ba'i lasaXlam bcu ni/ srog gcod/ ma byin len/ log g.yem ste lus kyi gsum/ rdzun/ phra ma/ tshig rtsub/ tshig kyal ba ste ngag gi 187
