bzhi/ brnab sems/ gnod sems/ log lta ste yid kyi gsum dang bcu'o/ /deXbacu ka yang rtsom byed dug gsum gang rung dang / rdzogs byed dug gsum ci rigs pas byed do/ /log g.yem la/ bgrod bya min pa/ yan lag min pa/ dus min pa/ gnas min pa'i bye brag gis bzhi'o/ /rdzun smra la/ mthong ba/ thos pa/ bye brag byed pa/ rnam par shes pa bzhi la/ ma mthong ba sogs su smra ba bzhi dang / ma mthong ba sogs bzhi la/ mthong ba sogs su spru ba bzhi ste brgyad do/ /log lta la/ rgyu/ 'bras bu/ byed pa/ yod pa'i dngos po la skur ba 'debs pa bzhi/ byed pa la/ sa bon 'debs 'dzin la skur ba/ 'gro 'ong la skur ba/ skye 'gyur gyi byed pa la skur ba ste gsum mo/ /las lam bcu las/ lus ngag gi bdun ni las yin la/ yid kyi gsum ni las min par mngon pa 'og ma las bshad do/ /bcu ka yang gzhi/bsam pa/ sbyor ba/ mthar thug ste bzhi bzhi dang / bsam pa la/ 'du shes/nyon mongs/ kun slong gsum gsum gyis bshad do/ /dge ba bcu'i las lam ni/ srog gcod spong ba sogs mi dge ba las bzlog ste sbyar ro/ /las de dag gi byed las ni/ las so sor nges pa/ las 'phel che ba/ las byas pa dang mi phrad/ las chud mi za ba'o/ /stobs ldan gyi las la/ gnyen po stobs ldan/ mi mthun phyogs stobs ldan/ rang bzhin stobs ldan/ zhing dang kun slong gis stobs dngaXldan pa bzhi dang / yang zhing / dngos po/ngo bo nyid/ rten/ kun slong drag po/ bsam pa/ grogs/ lan mang du byed 188

pa/ mang po tshogs pa'i sgo nas stobs dang ldan pa ste dgu'o/ /stobs dang mi ldan pa ni de las ldog pa'o//sdom pa'i las la/ so thar gyi sdom pa/ bsam gtan gyi sdom pa/ zag med kyi sdom pa ste gaspum mo/ /so thar gyi sdom pa la rigs brgyad de/ dge slong pha ma gnyis/ dge slong ma/ dge tshul pha ma gnyis/ dge bsnyen pha ma gnyis/ bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa'o/ dge bsnyen la/ skyabs 'gro'i dge bsnyen/ sna gcig spyod pa/ sna 'ga' spyod pa/ phal cher spyod pa/ yongs rdogs spyod pa/ tshangs spyod dge bsnyen te drug go /'ga' zhig tu/ go mi'i dge bsnyen zhes pa gcig kyang bshad do/ /mngon pa 'og mar/ ming gi sgo nas brgyad dang / rdzas kyi sgo nas dge slong / dge tshul/ dge bsnyen/bsnyen gnas te bzhi/ rten gyi sgo nas khyim pa dang / rab byung gi sdom pa gnyis/ yan lag gi sgo nas/ spong bdun/ spong bzhi gnyis/ dus kyi sgo nas/ ji srid 'apa'i mtha' can dang / nyin zhag gi mtha' can gnyis/bsnyen gnas kyi yan lag la/ tshul khrims kyi yan lag bag yod pa'i yanaXlag brtul zhugs kyi yan lag ste gsum du bshad la/ de dag mngon pa gong ma'i lugs la yang mi 'dod pa minaXno/ /'di'i bsnyen par rdzogs pa bcu sogs rgyas paraX'adul ba'i skabs su blta'o/ /bsam gtan gyi sdom pa la/ bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs dang / bsam gtan bzhi'i bzhi ste lnga'o/ /mngon pa 'og mar/ bsam 189

gtan gyi sdom pa dang / spong sdom yin min la mu bzhi ste/ bsam gtan gyi sdom pa yin la spong sdom ma yin pa/ spong sdom yin la bsam gtan gyi sdom pa ma yin pa/ gnyi ka yin pa/ gnyi ka ma yin pa'i sdom pa ste bzhir bshad do/ /zag pa med pa'i sdom pa ni/ khams gsum gyi gsum dang / sgong sdom dang sgong sdom ma yin pa gnyis su bshad do/ /nu bzhi brtsi tshul ni snga ma dang 'dra'o/ /sdomaXpa ma yin pa la/ shan pa dang / bya gag gsod pa/ phag gisaX'atsho ba/ nya ba/ riXdwags kyi rngon pa/ bya ba/ bong rgyas 'tsho ba chom rkun pa/ gshed ma/ glang po che 'dzin pa/ sprul gyis 'tsho ba/ btson bsrung /nyan rna byed pa rnams so/ /yang na rigs su skyes pa dang / blangs pa las byung ba gnyis so/ /bar ma la/ bar ma'i dge ba dang / bar ma'i mi dge ba gnyis so/ /soXthar gyi sdom pa'i rnam grangs la/ tshul khrims/ legs spyod/las/ sdomaXpa/ so sor thar ba/ bya ba'i lam ste drug tu bshad la don gcig pa ma yin no/ /sdom min la/ nyes spyad dang / tshul 'chal zhes kyang bshad do/ /spyir las la bde ba sbong 'gyur/ sdug bsngal myong 'gyur/btang stoms myong 'gyur gsum/ yang mthong chos myong 'gyur/ skyes nas myong 'akyur/ lan grangs gzhan nas sbong 'byur gsum/ las dang rnam smin nag pa/ gnyi ka dkar ba/ 'dres ma'i las dang gsum/ yang na zag bcas dang zag med kyi las gnyis/ 'dor ba dang blang bya'i las gnyis/blang bya la/ sbyin pa'i las dang / tshul khrims kyi las gnyis so/ /soXthar 190

gyiXsdom pa la/ mdo las byung ba'i ming gi rnam grangs ni/ ma smad pa'i tshul khrims/ gus par bslab pa'i tshul khrims/ bslab pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i tshul khrims/ lus ngag phun sum tshogs pa/ kun spyod yongs su dag pa/kun spyod dag pa/ kun spyod kha na tho ba med pa/ kun spyod gnod pa med pa/kun spyod rjes su mthun pa/ kun spyod rjes su 'byor ba/ kun spyod thabs dang ldan pa/ kun spyod 'tsham pa/ kun spyod mthun pa/ gdung ba med pa/'gyod pa med pa/ yid la bcags pa med pa rnams su bshad do/ /mngon pa 'og ma'iXmado las byung ba'i las kyi rnam grangs bco lnga bshad pa/ dang po ni/ dge ba/ mi dge ba/ lung ma bstan gsum/ gnyis pa ni/ bsod nams kyi las sogs gsum dang / bde ba myong 'gyur gyi las sogs gsum ste snga ma dang 'dra'o/ /pyongaXbar 'gyur ba'i las lnga ni/ ngo bo nyid kyis myong 'gyur/ mtshungs ldan gyis sbong 'gyur/ dmigs pas pyong 'gyur/rnam smin gyis myong 'gyur/ mngon sum du gyur pa las sbong bar 'gyur baXste lnga'o/ /gsum pa ni/ yon po/ skyon can/ snyigs ma'i las te gsum mo/ /bzhi ba ni/ gnag la rnam smin nag pa sogs te snga ma dang 'dra'o/ /lnga ba ni/ thub pa'i lus/ thub pa'i ngag thub pa'i yidaXgasum/ drug pa ni/ sgo gsum gyi gtsang byed gsum mo/ /bdun pa ni/ legs spyad nyes spyad gnyis so/ /brgyad pa rigs pas bskyed pa/ rigs pa min pas bskyed pa/ gnyis ka ma yin pa'i las te gsum mo/ /dgu ba ni/ 'phen byed dang rdzogs byed 191

de snga ma dang 'dra'o/ /bcu ba ni/ las sgrib/ nyon sgrib/ rnam smin gyi sgrib pa gsum mo/ /bcu gcig pa ni/ pha bsadaXpa/ ma bsad pa/ dgra bcom pa bsad pa/ dge 'dun 'khor lo'i dbyen byas pa/ de bzhin gshegasaXpa la nganaXsems kyis khrag phyung ba ste mtshams med pa lnga'o/ /bcu gnyis pa ni/ma dgra bcom pa sun phyung ba/ byang chub sems dpa' nges pa la gnas pa bsad pa/ slob pa 'phags pa'i gang zag bdun po gang rung bsad pa/dge 'dun gyi 'duXsgo 'phrogaXpa/ mchod rtenaX'ajig pa ste nye ba'i mtshams med lnga'o/ /bcu gsum pa ni/ sbyin pa las byung ba/ tshul khrimasaXlas byung ba/ bsgoms pa las byung ba'i bsod nams bya ba'i gzhi ste gzhi gsum mo/ /bcu bzhi ba ni/ bsod nams cha mthun/ thar ba cha mthun/ nges 'byed cha mthun te gsum mo/ /bco lnga ba ni/ rig pas rab tu bcug pa'i sgo gsum gyi las gsum mo/ /de dag ni dge mi dge ci rigs pa'i rnam grangs mdo las 'byung ba rnams btus par bshad do/ /kun 'byung bden pa spyi'i mtshan nyid bzhi ni phar phyin gyi skabs su bshad zin to//bsam gyis mi khyab pa lnga ni/ las kyi rnam par smin pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ nor bu sngags sman mkhyud spyad kyi nus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa/rnal 'byor pa'i mthu bsam gyis mi khyabaXpa/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dbang bcu'i las bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa ste lnga'o/ /gsum pa 'gog pa'i bden pa la/ chos 192

bcu gnyis ni/ mtshan nyid kyi 'gog pa/ zab pa/ brda'/ don dam pa/yongs su ma rdzogs pa/ rdzogs pa/ rgyan med pa/ rgyad dang bcas pa/ lhag bcas/ lhag med/ khyad par du 'phags pa'i 'gog paXdang / rnam grangs te bcu gnyis so/ /rnam grangs so bzhi ni ma lus par spangs pa/ nges par spangs pa/byang bar gyur pa/ zad pa/ 'dod chags dang bral ba/ 'gog pa/rnam par zhi ba/ nub pa ste spang bya'i sgo nas brgyad/ 'dus ma byas/ lta dka' ba/ g.yo ba med pa/mdud pa med pa/ 'chi ba med pa/ zag pa med pa/ gnas/ gling / skyob pa/ mgon/ dpung gnyen/ 'chi 'pho med pa/rims nad med pa/ yongs su gdung ba med pa/ bde ba/ zhi ba/ bde ba'i gzhi/ bde bar 'gyur ba/ nad med pa/ mi g.yo ba/ mya ngan lasaX'adas pa ste yon tanaXgyi sgo nas bzhag pa nyer gcig ma skyes pa/ ma byung ba/ ma byas pa/ 'dus ma byas pa/ skye ba med pa ste sdug bsngal ldog pa'i cha nas bzhag pa lnga ste bsdoms pas so bzhi'o/ /'gog bden spyi'i mtshan nyid bzhi ni phar phyin gyi skabs su blta bar bya'o/ /bzhi ba lam gyi bden pa la/byed las bzhi ni sdug bsngal shes par byed/ kun 'byung spong bar byed/'gog pa mngon du byed/ lam bsgoms par byed pas khyad par du byas pa'o/ /spyir lam tsam la lnga ste/ tshogs kyiXlam/ sbyor ba'i lam mthong ba'i lam/ sgom pa'i lam/ mthar phyin pa'i lam mo/ /tshogs kyi lam ni/ tshul khrims/ dbang bo'i sgo sdom pa/ zas kyi tshod rig pa/ nam gyi cha stod smad 193

la mi nyal bar rnal 'byor la brtson pa/ dran shes dang ldan pas dge ba la rtse gcig tu gnas par dga' ba ste yan lag lnga'o/ /mngon pa 'og mar/tshul khrims la gnas pa'i sgo nas thos bsam sgom gsum la rim bzhin sbyor ba dang / 'phags pa'i rigs bzhi la gnasaXpar bshad la/ rigs bzhi ni/ chos gos ngan ngon tsam gyis chog shes pa/ bsod snyoms ngan ngon tsam gyis chog shes pa/ gnas lam ngan ngon tsam gyis chos shes pa/ spong ba dang sgom pa la rab tu dga' ba bzhir bshad do/ /mi sdug pa bsgom pa la/ kha dog gi 'dod chags/ dbyibs kyi 'dod chags/ reg pa'i 'dod chags/ bsnyen bkuraXgyi 'dod chags bzhi'i gnyer por/ rnam par bsdos pa/ rnam par bam pa/ rnamaXpar 'bus gzhig pa/ shi ba'i ro g.yo ba med pa la dmigs pa dang bzhi'o/ /dbugs 'byung rngub kyiXsgo nas bsgom pa la/bgrangs pa/ rjes su 'gro ba/ 'jog pa/ nye bar rtog pa/ bsgyur ba/yongs su dag pa drug go /sbyor ba'i lam la/ drong sogs bzhi ste chung 'bring che gsum gyi dbye ba rnams phar phyin gyi skabs su blta bar bya'o/ /mthong ba'i lam la skad cig bcuXdrug ni/ bden pa bzhi re re la/ chos bzod/ chos shes/ rjes bzod/ rjes shes te bzhi bzhir phye ba'o/ /mngon pa 'og mar/ bzod pa brgyad bar chad med lam dang / shes pa brgyadaXrnam grol lam du bshad la/ skad cig ma la dus ma tha'i skad cig ma dang /bya rdzogs kyi skad cig ma gnyis yod pas 'di ni phyi ma'o/ /sgom pa'iXlam 194

la zhi rags kyi rnam pa can gyi 'jig rten pa'i lam/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam/ lam chung ngu / lam 'bring bo/ lam chen po/ sbyor ba'i lam/ bar chad med pa'i lam/ rnam par grol ba'i lam/ khyad par gyi lam ste dgu'o/ /'jig rten pa'i lam ni bsam gtan bzhi dang / gzugs med bzhi ste brgyad do/ /spyir bsam gtan la/ rgyu stoms 'jug gi bsam gtan dang / 'bras bu skye ba'i bsam gtan gnyis/ gzugs med la'ang / rgyu snyoms 'jug gi gzugs med/ 'bras bu skye ba'i gzugs med gnyis/bsam gtan sa drug ni/ dang po'i nyer bsdogs dang dngos gzhi tsam po ba dang / khyad par can gnyis/ phyi ma gsum gyi dngos gzhi gsum mo/ /bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi la/ nyon mongs can/ dag pa ba/ zag med gsum/ 'di phyi ma gsum la'ang rigs 'gre/ bsam gtan dag pa ba la dbye na/ nyams pa cha mthun/ gnas pa cha mthun/ khyad par cha mthun/nges 'byed cha mthun te bzhi'o/ /nyon mongs can gyi bsam gzugs bzhi ni/ sred pa/ lta ba/ nga rgyal/ ma rig pa bzhiXshas che bas phye ba'o/ /dag pa'i bsam gtan gzugs bzhi ni/ rang sa'i kun dkris dang bral ba'i chags bral gyi sems rtse gcig pa'o/ /zag med ni/ bdag med pa'i rnam pa canaXno/ /bsam gtan dang po'i yan lag lnga ni/ rtog pa/ dpyod pa/ dga' ba/bde ba/ sems rtse gcig pa ste lnga'o/ /gnyis pa la/ rab tu dang ba/dga' ba/ ting nge 'dzin te bzhi'o/ /gsum pa la/ btang stoms/ dran pa/195

btang snyoms/ dran pa/ shes bzhin/ bde ba/ ting nge 'dzin te bzhi'o/ /dran pa/ btang snyoms/ bde min sdug min gyi tshor ba/ bde ba/ ting nge 'dzin te lnga'o/ /bzhi ba la/ bsam gtanaXbazhi ba'i dngos gzhi snyoms 'jug ni/ g.yo byed kyi skyon brgyad dang bral ba ste/ skyon brgyad ni/ rtog pa/dpyod pa/ bde ba/ sdug bsngal/ yid bde/ yid mi bde/ dbugs rngub pa/dbugs dbyung ba ste brgyad do/ /yan lag bco brgyad po bsdu na/ gnyen po'i yan lag phan yon gyi yan lag gnas kyi yan lag ste gsum mo/ /gzugs med kyi stoms 'jug la yan lag mi 'dra ba'iXkhyad par med do/ /las dang po pa'i yid byed la/ yid la byed pa'i las dang po pa'i yid byed/las dang po pa tsam gyi yid byed/ nyon mongs rnam par sbyong ba'i las dang po pa'i yid byed gsum mo/ /yidaXl byed pa bdun ni/ mtshan nyid so sor rab tu rig pa'i yid la byed pa/ mos pa las byung ba/ rab tu dben pa/dga' ba sdud pa/ dpyod pa/ sbyor ba'i mtha'/ sbyor ba'i mtha'i 'bras du yid la byed pa'o/ /dang po drug bsdu na/ rjes mthun gyi yid byed/ gnyen po yid byed/ dang bar 'gyur ba'i yid byed/ so sor rtogs pa'i yid byed bzhir 'du'o/ /snyoms 'jug bsgom pa la/ yon tan 'thob pa'i phyir bsgom pa/ bsten pa'i phyir bsgom pa/ bsal ba'i phyir bsgom pa/ gnyen po bsgom pa ste bzhi'o/ /zhi gnas kyi dmigs pa la khyab pa'i dmigs pa/spyad pa rnam sbyong gi dmigs pa/ mkhas pa'i dmigs pa/ nyon mongs rnam 196

sbyong gi dmigs pa ste bzhi'o/ /khyab pa'i dmigs pa la/ rnam par rtog pa dang bcas pa'i gzugs brnyan/ rnam par rtog pa med pa'i gzugs brnyan/ dngos po'i mtha'/ dgos pa yongs su grub pa ste bzhi/ spyad pa rnam sbyong gi dmigs pa la/ mi sdug pa/ byams pa/ rten 'brel/ khams kyi rab dbye/ dbugs 'byung rngub bsgom pa ste lnga/ mkhas pa'i dmigs pa la/phung bo/ khams/ skye mched/ rten 'brel/ gnas dang gnas min la mkhas pa lnga/ nyon mongs rnamaXsbyong gi dmigs pa la/ zhi rags kyi rnam pa can dang / mi rtag sogs bcu drug rtogs pa'i rnam pa can gnyis/ teng nge 'dzin gyi dmigs pa'i ming gi rnam grangs la/ dmigs pa/ gzugs brnyan/ ting nge 'dzin gyi mtshan ma/ ting nge 'dzin gyi spyod yul/ ting nge 'dzid gyi thabs/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo/ yid la byed pa'i rten/ nang du rnam par rtog pa'i lus/ snang brnyan te dgu'o/ /ting nge 'dzin bskrub pa la/spang bya nyes pa lnga ni/ le lo/ gdams ngag brjed pa/ bying rgod/ mngon par 'du mi byed pa/ 'du byed pa'o/ /'du byed brgyad ni/ dad pa/ 'dun pa/ rtsol ba/ shin sbyangs/ dran pa/ shes bzhid/ 'du byed pa/ 'du mi byed pa'o/ /sems gnas pa'i thabs dgu ni/ sems 'jog pa/ rgyun du 'jog pa/ blan te 'jog pa/ nye bar 'jog pa/ dul bar byed pa/ zhi bar byed pa/rnam par zhi bar byed pa/ rtse gcig tu byed pa/ mnyam par 'jog pa ste dgu'o/ /yid byed bzhi ni bsgrims te 'jug pa'i yid byed/ chad cing 197

'jug pa'i yid byed/ chad pa med par 'jug pa'i yid byed/ rtsol ba med par 'jug pa'i yid byed do/ /phyi ma la lhun gyis grub pa'i yid byed ces kyang zer ro/ /stobs drug ni/ thos pa'i stobs/ bsam pa'i stobs/ dran pa'i stobs/ shes bzhin gyi stobs/ brtson 'grus kyi stobs/ yongs su 'dris pa'i stobs so/ /sgrub pa'i 'bras du lus sems las rung gi shin sbyangs la/ lus shin sbyangs/ sems shin sbyangs/ shin sbyangs mi g.yo ba ste gsum mo/ /bsam gtan la brten nas bsgom bya'i lam gyi rnam grangs bcu gcig ni/ yongs su rtogs pa'i lam/ rtsol ba las byung ba'i lam yongs spu byang ba byas pa'i las/ mngon par rtogs pa la sbyor ba'i lam/ mngon par rtogs pa dang ma 'dres pa'i lam/ mngonaXpar rtogs pa'i lam nges 'byin gyi lam/ gnas dang dbang boXtha dad pa'i lam/ bslab gaspum yongs su sbyong ba'i lam/ yon tan bsgrub par byed pa'i lam/ lam sdud pa'i lam mo/ /byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos so bdun ni/ lus/ chos/tshor ba/sems rjes su dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bzhi/ dge ba'i chos maXskyes pa rnams skyes pa/ skyes pa rnams bsrung ba/ mi dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa rnams mi skyes pa/ skyes pa rnams spong ba ste yang dag par sgong ba bzhi/'dun pa/ brtson 'grus/ sems/ dpyod paXste rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang ba bzhi/dad pa/ brtson 'grus/ dran pa/ tingaX'adzin/ shes rab ste dbang bo lnga/198

dad pa sogs stobs lnga yang de dang 'dra'o/ /dran pa/ chos rab tu rnam 'byed/ brtson 'grus/ dga' ba/ shin sbyangs/ ting nge 'dzin/ btang stoms te byang chub yan lag bdun/ yang dag pa'i lta ba/ yang dag pa'i rtogs pa/ yang dag pa'i ngag yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha'/ yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba/ yang dag pa'i rtsol ba/ yang dag pa'i dran pa/ yang dag pa'i ting ngeX'adzin te 'phags lam yan lag brgyad rnams so/ /gnas dang dbang bo tha dad pa'i lam bzhi ni/ mngon shes bul la dka' ba/ mngonaXshes myuraXl dka' ba/ mngon shes bul la sla ba/ mngon shes myur la sla ba'o/ /chos kyi gnas bzhi ni/ brnab sems med pa/ gnod sems med pa/yang dag pa'i dran pa/ yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /yon tan bsnyub byed kyi lam la/ zhi gnas lhag mthong gnyis las/ zhi gnas gong du bshad zin/ lhag mthong la/ rnam par 'byed pa/ rab tu rnam par 'byed pa gnyis/ de re re la yang rtog dpyod gnyis gnyis so/ /yang mtshan ma las byung ba/ yongs su tshol ba lasaXbyung ba/ so sor rtogs pa las byung ba'i lhagaXmathong gsum1 yang zhi gnas lhag mthong la brten pa'i lam bzhi ni/zhi gnas la brten nas lhag mthong 'tshol ba/ lhag mthong la brten nas zhi gnas 'tshol ba/ gnyis ka ma thob pa thob par bya ba'i phyir 'tsholaXb/gnyis ka thob pa zung 'brel du nyams su len par brtson pa'o/ /'di'i lhag mthong thob la zhi gnas ma thob pa ni bsamaXgatan dang po'i nyer 199

bsdogs kyis bsdus pa'i zhi gnas ma yin gyi bsam gtan gyi dngos ༷ gnyis bsdus pa'iXzhi gnas so/ /lam thams cadaXsdud par byed pa'i dbang bo gsum ni/ dri med kyiXdabang bo gsum ste sngar bshad zin to/ /mthar phyin pa'i lam la/ spang bya zad par spangs pa/ bral thob mtharaXphyin pa ste spangs pa mthar phyin pa gnyis/ rgyu rdo rje lta bu'i nying nge 'dzin/dus de'i mjug thogs de ma thag tu thob pa/ ngo bo zang mi skye ba shes pa'i ye shes te khyad chos gsum ldan ni rtogs pa mthar phyin pa'o/ /spang rgyu'i gnas ngan len ni/ mngon par brjod pa'i gnas ngan len/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ tshor ba/ nyon mongs pa/ las/ rnam paraXsmin pa/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa/ las kyi sgrib pa/ rnam par smin pa'i sgrib pa/ sgrib pa/ rtog pa/zas/ 'khrig pa/ rmi lam/ nad/ rga ba/ 'chi ba/ yongs su ngal ba'i gnasaXngan len te/ gnas skabs can gyi dbang du byas pa bcu bdun/ gnas ngan len chen po/ 'bring / chung ngu / nyon sgrib kyi gnas ngan len/ snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa'i gnas ngan len/ shes sgrib kyi gnas ngan len te gnas skabs kyi dbang du byas pa bdun no/ /rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la/ sbyor ba'i lam gyis bsdus pa dang / bar chad medaXpa'i lam gyis bsdus pa gnyis/ gnas 'gyur mthar phyin pa gsum ni/ bral thob sems kyi gnas 'gyur/ lam gyi gnas 'gyur/ ye shes kyi gnas 'gyur ro/ /zag med kyiXphung bo lnga ni/ tshul khrims/ ṭīng nge 'dzin/ shes rab/ rnam par 200

grol ba/ nom par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba'i phung bo'o/ /lam bden spyi'i mtshan nyid bzhi ni phar phyin gyi skabs su balha bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa chos rnam par nges pa la/ gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis ni/ mdo'i sde/ dbyangs kyis bsnyad pa'i sde/ lung bstan pa'i sde/ tshigs su bcad pa'i sde/ ched du brjod pa'i sde/ gleng gzhi'i sde/ rtogs pa brjod pa'i sde/ de lta bu byung ba'i sde/ skyes pa'i rabs kyi sde/ shin tu rgyas pa'i sde/rmad du byung ba'i sde/ gtan la dbab par bstan pa'i sde'o/ /gsung rab yan lag dgu ni/ rtogs brjod/ de lta bu byung / skyes rabs gsum gleng gzhi'i 'khor du bsdus pa'o/ /sde sgod gsum ni/ 'dul ba/ mngon pa/ mdo sde'i sde snod gsum mo/ /chos kyi spyod yul dmigs pa'i rab dbye bzhi ni khyab pa'i dmigs pa sogasaXte sngar bshad zin to/ /chos kyi don dpyod byed kyi rigs pa bzhiXni/ ltos pa'i rigs pa/ bya ba byed pa'i rigs pa/ 'thad pas bsgrubaXpa'i rigs pa/ chos nyid kyi rigs pa'o/ /tshol ba bzhi ni/ mingaXtshol ba/ dngos po tshol ba/ ngo bo nyid du 'dogs pa tshol ba/ bye zag tu 'dogs pa tshol ba'o/ /phyi ma la khyad par 'dogs pa tshol ba zhes kyang zer ro/ /yongs su shes pa bzhi ni/ ming tshol bar gtogs pa ji lta ba bzhin du yongs su shes pa sogs bzhi ste lnga ma dang 'dra'o//yongs su tshol ba drug ni/ don/ dngos po/ mtshan nyid/ phyogs/ dus/201

rigs pa yongs su tshol ba'o/ /rnal 'byor gyi sa lnga ni/ gzhi/ skyed pa/ me long lta bu/ snang ba/ gnas so/ /mkhas pa'i rim pa lnga ni/ mngaXdu thos pa dang ldan pa/ don la mkhas pa/ yi ge laXmakhas pa/ ngesaXpa'i tshig laXmakhas pa/ sngon dang phyi ma'iXmatha'i dgongs pa la mkhas pa rnams so/ /shes rab gsum gyis chos la gnas pa ni/ thos byung / bsam byung / sgom byung gi shes rab gsum gyis gnas pa'o/ /shin tu rgyas pa'i sde snod ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa rnams chos bcu'i sgo nas rgyas par ston pa ste/ chos bcu ni pha rol tu phyin pa rnams kyi grangs bstan pa dang / de bzhin du sbyar te/ mtshan nyid/ go rim/ nges tshigabasgom pa/ rab tu dbye ba/ bsdus pa/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs/ yon tan gyi basbags pa/ gcig la gcig ngesaXpa bstan pa ste bcu'o/ /chos don mi rtogs pa'i rgyu lta ngan nyi shu rtsa brgyad ni/ mtshan mar lta ba/ btags pa la skur 'debs kyi lta ba/ kun rtog la skur 'debs kyi lta ba/ de kho na nyid laXskur 'debs kyi lta ba/ yongs su 'dzin pa'i lta ba/ sgyur ba'i lha ba/ kha na ma tho ba med pa'i lta ba/ nges par 'byung bar lta ba/ dbang za ba'i lta ba/rab tu 'khrugs pa'i lta ba/ phyin ci log tu lta ba/ 'phel ba'i lta ba/ khas mi len pa'i lta ba/ ngan g.yo'i ltaXb/ bkur ste'i lta ba/ rmongs pa bstan pa'i lta ba1 rtsa ba'i lta ba/ lta ba la lta ba ma yin par lta ba/ sbyor ba sel ba'i lta ba/ nges 'byin ma yin par lta ba/ sgrib pa la sogs par lha ba/202

sdig pa 'phel ba'i lta ba/ 'bras bu med pa'i lta ba/ chad pas bcad pa'i lta ba/ skur ba 'debs pa'i lta ba/ bsnyad pa ma yin pa'i lta ba/ lta ba chen po/ mngon pa'i nga rgyal gyi lta ba'o/ /chos thams cad ngo bo nyid med par bstan pa'i dgongs pa ngo bo nyid med pa gsum ni/ kun brtags mtshan nyid ngo bo nyid med pa/ gzhanaXdabang skye ba ngo bo nyid med pa/ yongs grub don dam pa ngo bo nyid med pa'o/ /dgongs gzhi gtso bor bzung ba'i mdo'i dgongs pa bzhi ni/ mnyam pa nyid la dgongs pa/ dus gzhan la dgongs pa/ don gzhan la dgongs pa/ gangaXzag gi bsam pa la dgongs pa ste bzhi'o/ /dgongasaXpa gtso bor bzung ba'i mdo'i ldem por dgongs pa bzhi ni/ gzhug pa la ldem por dgongs pa/ mtshan nyid la ldem por dgongs pa/ gnyen po la ldem por dgongs pa/ bsgyur ba la ldem por dkongs pa'o//mdo la mos pa'i phan yon lnga ni/ gnas ngan len gyi gnas thams cad 'jig pa/ chos kyi dga' ba la dga' ba thob pa/ tshad med pa shes pa/rnam par mi rtog pa'i mtshan ma rnams kun du 'byung ba/ gong ma bas kyang ches gong ma'i rgyu yongs su 'dzin par byed pa'o/ /gsum pa 'thob pa rnam par nges pa la/ 'thob byed gang zag gi dbye ba ni/ spyod pas dbye ba/nges par 'byung bas dbye ba/ nye bar bstan pas dbye ba/ sbyor bas dbye ba/ 'bras bus dbye ba/ khams kyis dbye ba/ spyad pas rab tu dbyeXb ste 203

sde tshan gyi sgo nas bdun no/ /spyod pas dbye ba la/ dus gsum/ nga rgyal/rnam paraXrtog pa/ cha mnyam la spyod pa/ nyon mongs chung ba'i gang zag ste bdun no/ /nges 'byung la/ theg pa gsum gyis nges par 'byung ba'i gang zag gsum mo/ /zhugasaXganas kyi rnam bzhag la/ skyes bu zung bzhi'am gang zag ya brgyad ni1 rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'brasaXbu la zhugs pa dang gnas pa gnyis/ lan gcig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras du la zhugs pa dang gnas pa gnyis/ phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la zhugs pa dang gnas pa gnyis/ dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu la zhugs pa dang gnas pa gnyis te brgyad do/ /rgyun zhugs zhugs pa la sbyor lam stan gcig pa dang / 'phags pa gnyis/ yang dad pa'i rjes 'brang dang / chos kyiXrjes 'brang gnyis/ rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas la tsam po pa dang / khyad par can gnyis/ snga ma'i re ltar thogs na srid pa lan bdun pa ba la/ so skye dang / 'phags pa gnyis/ 'phags pa la/ nges pa dang / ma nges pa gnyis so/ /khyad par can la rigs nas rigs su skye ba dang / mthong chos zhi gnyis/ rigs skye la lha'i rigs nas rigs skye dang / mi'i rigs nas rigs skye gnyis/ phyir 'ong zhugs pa ni rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas khyad par can dang rdzas gcig go /phyir 'ong 'azas gnas tsam po ba dang / khyadaXpar can gnyis/ phyi ma la tshe gcig bar chad gcig pa dang / de ma yin pa gnyis/ phyir mi 'ong zhugs pa ni phyir 'ong 'bras gnas khyad par can dang rdzas gcig go /phyir mi 'ong 204

'bras gnas tsam po ba dang / khyad par can gnyis/ yang gzugs spu nyer 'gro/ gzugs med nyer 'gro/ mthong chos zhi/ lus kyis mngon sum du byed pa/ tshe yongs su gyur pa ste lnga/ gzugs spu nyer 'gro la/ bar dor 'da' ba/ skyes nas 'da' ba/ gong du 'pho ba ste gsum/ bar dor 'da' ba la myur ba/ myur ba ma yin pa/ ring mo zhig nas 'da' ba gsum/ skyes nas 'da' ba la/ skyes pa tsam nas 'da' ba/ mngon par 'du byed pa med par 'da' ba/ mngon par 'du byed dang bcas nas 'da' ba gsum/ gong du 'pho ba la/ 'og min 'gro dang / srid rtse'i mthar thug par 'gro ba gnyis/ snga ma la 'phar ba/ phyed du 'phar ba/ gnasaXthams cad du 'chi 'pho zhingaX'aphar baXgasum/ 'di'i bsam gtan spel sgom la lnga ste/chung ngu gsum spel/ 'bring drug spel/ ched po dgu spel/ shin tu che ba bcu gnyis spel/ ches shin tu che ba bco lnga spel te lnga'o/ /gzugs med du nye bar 'gro ba la/ skyes nas 'da' ba/ 'du byed med par 'da' ba/ 'du byed dang bcas te 'da' ba/ gong du 'pho ba ste bzhi'o/ /tshe yongs su gyur pa la/ 'dod par tshe yongs grur dang / gzugs su tshe yongs gyur gnyis so/ /dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu la zhugs pa ni/ phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas khyad par can dang rdzas gcig go /dgra bcomaX'abras gnas la/ spang bya spangs pa'i sgo nas shes rab kyis rnam par grol ba dang / gnyis ka'i cha las rnam par grol ba gnyis/ khaXcig de gnyis la/205

rgyan bcas dang / rgyan med ces kyang zer ro/ /mthong ba'i chos la bde bar gnas pa las nyams pa dang mi nyams pa'i sgo nas phye na/ nyams pa'i chos can/ 'chi bar sems pa'i chos can/ rjes su bsrung ba'i chos can/gnas pa las mi bskyod pa'i chos can/ rab tu rtogs pa'i 'os su gyur pa'i chos can/ mi 'khrugs pa'i chos can te drug go /de'i gnyis pa la bdag gsod pa'i chos can dang / drug pa la mi g.yo ba'i chos canaXzhes kyang bshad do/ /dbang bo'i bye brag gis/ dus dang sbyor ba'i grolaXb dang /dus dang mi sbyor ba'i grol ba gnyis/ de gnyis la dad pas mos pa las skyes pa dang / mthong bas thob pa las byung ba zhes kyang zer ro/ /de dag ni phal cher 'bras bu rim gyis mngon du byed pa dang / spang bya mthar gyis sbong ba'iXdabang du byas pa yin la/ 'bras bu thod brgal ba ni/ 'bras bu bar ma gnyis kyi zhugs gnas bzhi kho na la 'jog go /de la chags bral sngon song zhes kyang zer ro/ /de yang phal cher las chags pa dang bral ba dang / 'dod pa las chagasaXpa dang bral ba gnyis so/ /spang bya cig car baXni/ 'bras bu dang po dang tha ma gnyis la yod kyi gzhan la med par bshad do/ /'di dag gtso bor mngon pa gong ma'i lugs ltar bris pa yin la/mngon pa 'og mar 'di dag gi go rim dang rnam bzhag mi 'dra tsam mang du 'byung yang ming gi rnam grangs logs pa med do/ /skyes bu dam pa'i 'gro ba bdun dang miXslob pa dgu sogs kyang der 'du'o/ /206

spyad pas rab tu dbye ba la/ mos pas spyod pa can/ lhag pa'i bsam pas spyod pa can/ mtshan ma dang bcas pas spyod pa can/ mtshan ma med par spyod pa can/ mngon par 'du byed pa med par spyod pa can gyi byang chub sems dpa' ste lnga'o/ /thob bya'i chos mngon par rtogs pa bcu ni/chos mngonaXpar rtogs pa/ don mngon par rtogs pa/ de kho na mngon par rtogs pa/ rjes la mngon par rtogs pa/ dkon mchog mngon par rtogs pa/ kun du mi 'byung ba mngon par rtogs pa/ mthar thug pa'i mngon par rtogs pa/ nyan rang byang sems kyi mngon par rtogs pa gsum mo/ /byang chub sems dpa'iXmangon rtogs kyi khyad par ni/ dmigs pa/ nye bar ston pa/ rab tu rtogs pa/ khas len pa/ nges par 'byung ba/ yongs su 'dzin pa/ gnas dang g.yog 'khor/ btsun par skye ba/ skye ba/ 'bras bu'i khyad par te bcu'o/ /phyi ma la gnas 'gyur ba/ yon tan phun sumaXtshogs pa/khyad par rnam pa lnga/ sku gsum/ mya ngan las 'das pa/ 'dres shing nye bar 'dres pa'i ye shes kyi nus pa 'thob pa/ sgrib pa rnam par dag pa/ 'dres shing nye bar 'dres pa'i las byed pa/ mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa/mya ngan las 'das pa ston pa'i thabs/ yongs su rgyu ba rnam pa lnga'i khyad par te rnam pa bcu gcig go /tshad med pa bzhi ni/ byams pa/ snying rje/dga' ba/ btang stoms tshad med pa'o/ /rnam par thar ba dgu ni/gzugs can gzugs la lta ba'i rnam thar/ gzugs med gzugs la lta 207

ba'i rnam thar/ sdug pa'i rnam thar/ nam mkha' mtha'aXyas skye mched kyi rnam thar/ rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched kyi rnam thar/ ci yang med pa'i skye mched kyiXrnam thar/ 'du shes medaX'adu shes med min skye mched kyi rnamaXthar/ 'du shes dang tshor ba 'gog pa'i rnam thar ro/ /zil gyis gnon pa'i skye mched brgyad kyang des shes par bya'o/ /zad par gyi skye mched bcu ni/ 'byung ba bzhi/ 'byung 'gyur bzhi/ nam mkha'/ rnam shesaXl dmigs pa'i sgo nas bye ba'o/ /mngon shes drug ni/ rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon shes/ lha'i rna ba'i mngon shes/ gezhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes/ sngon gnas rjes dran gyi mngon shes/ 'chi 'pho ba dang skye ba shes pa'i mngon shes/ zag pa zad pa'i mngon shes so/ /'dir ma bshad pa'i yon tan lhag ma rnams ni phar phyin gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar ro/ /spang bya rnam rtog bcu ni/ rtsa ba'i rnam rtogamatshan ma'i rnam rtog mtshan mar snang ba'i rnam rtog mtshan mar 'gyur ba'i rnam rtog mtshan mar snang bar 'gyur ba'i rnam rtog gzhan kyis bstan pa'i rnam rtog tshul bzhin ma yin pa'i rnam rtog tshul bzhin gyi rnam rtog mngon par zhen pa'i rnam rtog rnam par g.yeng ba'i rnam par rtog pa'o/ /rnam g.yeng gi rtog pa bcu ni/ ngo bo med par rtog pa/ ngo bor rtog pa/sgro 'dogs pa'i rtog pa/ skur ba 'debs pa'i rtog pa/ gcig tu rtog pa/208

tha dad du rtog pa/ ngo bo nyid du rtog pa/ khyad par du rtog pa/ ming ji lta ba bzhin du don rtog pa/ don ji lta ba bzhin du ming rtog pa'o/ /rnam par mi rtog pa ni/ 'phags pa bzhi'i rgyud kyi rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes so/ /bzhi ba 'bel gtam rnam par nges pa la/ don rnam par bshad pa/ rab tu phye nas kun du bstan pa/ yang dag par dri ba/ bsdu ba/ smra ba/ ldem por dgongs pa rnam par nges pa ste bcu'o/ /rnam par bshad pa'i sgo bcu bzhi ni/ rnam par bshad pa bsdu ba'i sgo/ dngos po bsdu ba'i sgo/ yan lag dang nye ba'i yan lag gi sgo/ gong nas gong du mngon par sgrub pa'i sgo/spong ba'i sgo/ yi ges yongs su bsgyur ba'i sgo/ chud za ba dang chud mi za ba'i sgo/ gang zag rnam paraXbazhag pa'i sgo/ rab tu dbye bas rnam par bzhag pa'i sgo/ tshul gyi sgo/ yongs su shes pa la sogs pa'i sgo/ stobs dang stobs ma yin pa'i sgo/ bzlas te brjod pa'i sgo/ mngon paraXspub pa'i sgo'o//smra ba rnam par nges pa ni/ smra ba/ smra ba'i zhal che ba/ smra ba'i gzhi/ smra ba'i rgyan/ smra ba chad pas bcad pa/ smra ba las 'byung ba/ smra ba la gces spras byed pa'i chos te bdun no/ /'bel ba'i gtam gyi rnam par nges pa 'di'iXskabs kyi ming gi rnam grangs 'ga' zhig ni gong du bshad zin par 'dug 'ga'aXzhig ni gtan tshigs rig pa'i skabs su blta'o/ /de dag ni mngon pa gong 'og gnyis kyi gzhung las byung ba'i ming gi rnam grangs che 209

long tsam mdor bsdus pa'o//bzhe ba 'dul ba'i gzhung las byung ba'i mingaXgi rnam grangs ni/ spyir 'dul ba la brjod bya don gyi 'dul ba dang / rjod byed tshig gi 'dul ba gnyis las/ snga ma ni spong bdun 'khor dang bcas pa'i tshul khrims so/ /phyi ma la mdo dang bstan bcos gnyis/ dang po la/ rtsa ba'i mdo/ bshad pa'i mdo/ phyogs mthun gyi mdo gsum/ rtsa ba'iXmado la dge slong pha'i so thar gyi mdo/ dge slong ma'i so thar gyi mdo gnyis/ bshad pa'i mdo la lung gzhi/ lung rnam 'byed/ lung phran tshegs/ gzhung dam pa'am gzhung bla ma ste bzhi/ phyogs mthun gyi mdo ni/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis ston pa sogs so/ /bstan bcos la dgra bcom pa rnams dang / 'phags pa thogs med dang / slob dpon yon tan 'odaXsogs kyis mdzad pa'i bstan bcos rnams so/ /'dir 'dul ba mdo rtsa ba ni da lta yongs su grags pa'i 'chad nyan byed pa'i 'dul ba'i gzhung rnams las gtso bor gyur pa yin la/ de las byung ba'i ming gi rnam grangs rnams zhib par bris na ha cang mang bar 'gyur bas rags bsdus tsam zhig 'bri bar bya'o/ /de la sdom pa ma thob pa thob par byed pa'i thabs/ thob paXmi nyams par bsrung ba/nyams na phyir bcos pa'i thabs te gsum/ dang po ni/ spyir tshul khrims la 'jigs skyob kyi tshul khrims/ legs smon gyi tshul khrims/ nges 'byung gi tshul khrims gsum/ so thar gyi sdom pa la/ khyim pa'i sdom pa dang / rab 210

byung gi sdom pa gnyis/ 'di'i dang po la/ bsnyen gnas/ dge bsnyen pha ma'i tshul khrims te gsum/ phyi ma la dge tshul pha ma/ dge slong ma/ dge slong pha ma ste lnga'o/ /bar ma rabaXbyung gi tshul khrims dang / tshangs spyod nyer gnas kyi sdom pa gnyis tshul khrims tsam yin gyi/ sdom pa ma yin no/ /bsnyen gnas la pha ma gnyis kyi rgyud kyi gnyis so/ /theg chen ltar na/ lha kluXsogs rgyud lnga'i lnga dang / nyin byed rer blang ba dang / nyin zhag gi mtha' can du blang ba dang / byang chub bar du blang ba yang yod par bshad do//dge bsnyen la rten gyi sgo nas pha ma gnyis/ sgras brjod kyis bye na sna gcig spyod pa sogasaXbadun te mngon pa'i skabs dang 'dra'o/ /dge tshul la pha ma'i sdom pa gnyis/ dge slong ma la dbye ba gzhan med do/ /dge slong la rten gyi sgo nas pha ma'i sdomaXpa gnyis/ sgras brjod kyis dbye na/ rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i dge slong / ming gi dge slong / yang dag pa'i dge slong ste gsum mo/ /yang da ming gi dgeXslong / slong ba'i dge slong / khas 'che ba'i dge slong / don dam pa'i dge slong / gsol ba dang bzhi'i las kyi dge slong ste lnga/ bsnyen par rdzogs tshul gyis dbye na bcu ste/ rang byung gis bsnyen par rdzogs pa/ nges par 'jug pas bsnyen par rdzogs pa/ tshur shog gis bsnyen par sdogs pa/ ston par khas blang bas bsnyen par rdzogs pa/ dri bas mnyes pas bsnyen par rdzogasaXpa/ bla ma'i chos khas blang bas bsnyen par rdzogs pa/ pho nyas bsnyen par rdzogs pa/ lnga tshogs kyis bsnyen 211

par rdzogs pa/ bcu tshogs kyis bsnyen par rdzogs pa/ skyabs su 'gro bas bsnyen par rdzogs pa ste bcu'o/ /'di'i gnyis pa la ye shes khongaXdu chud pa dang / bdun pa la 'phrin gyis bsnyen par rdzogs pa zhes kyang bya'o/ /lung ma mor sangs rgyas dang rang rgyal gnyis so sor bgrang / lnga tshogs dang bcu tshogs gnyis gcig tu 'dren paraXbashad do/ /cho ga la sngon gyi cho ga dang / da ltar gyi cho ga gnyis/ sngon cho ga gnang ba'i yul ni/ rgyud smin pa/shes rab smin pa/ dbang bo smin pa gsum dang ldan zhing / rnam smin/ las/nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa gsum shas chung ba'i gang zag go /sgrub tshul ni rab byung bsnyen rdzogs cig car du bsgrub pa'o//da ltar gyi cho ga laXganyis las/ tshigs snga ma dge tshul du bsgrub pa la/sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ mjug gsum/ sbyor ba la gnyis las/ dge bsnyen du bsgrub pa la/ stod pa dang slob dpon la phyag 'tshal ba/ tsog pur 'dug pa dang thal mo sbyor du gzhug pa gnyis ni sbyor ba'o/ /skyabs 'gro dang dge bsnyen du khas len pa ni dngos gzhi'o/ /'di'i rangaXdon gyi sngags la/skyabasaXbarjod/ gzhan brjod/ bdag brjod de dum bu gsum mo/ /bslab pa brjod cing khas blang ba ni 'jug chog go /gnyis pa rab byung la/ mkhan pos bsgrub bya dge 'dun la zhu ba'i dge slong la gtad pa/ des dge 'dun bsdus nas zhu ba/ yang mkhan por gsol baXgadab pa/mkhan pos bsgrub bya la brje ba gsum byed pa dang /212

bar chad spang ba'i phyir mtshan brtag pa rnams niXsbyor ba'o/ /'di'i brje ba gsum ni/ bsam pa brje ba/ rtags dang cha lugs brje ba/ ming brje ba gsum mo/ /bsgrub byas ston pa nang mkhan po la phyag 'tshal te tsogaXpur 'dug pa/ rab tu byung ba'i rtags len par khas len du 'jug pa ni dngos gzhi'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi dge tshul du sgrub pa la/ nyes med phun tshogs kyi dbang du byas na 'gal rkyen bzhi bral zhing / mthun rkyen lngaXtshang ba gcig dgos so/ /'gal rkyen bar chad bzhi ni/ skye ba'i bar chad/gnas pa'i bar chad/ mdzes pa'i bar chad/ khyad par du 'gyur ba'i bar chad bzhi'o/ /de dag ni sprul ba/ za ma/ ma ning mtshan gnyis pa/ mtshan med/ zla ba phyed pa sogs kyi ma ning / 'khyud nas ldang ba'i ma ning / ma ning phrag dog can/ nyams pa ma ning ste lnga/ ma ning gle 'dams pa/ rtag tu zla mtshan 'dzag pa/ zla mtshan gtan mi 'dzag pa/ mtshan ma tsam yod pa/ mtshan dug ma dud 'gro/ sgra mi snyan pa/ mi ma yin pa/ rku thabs su gnas pa/ mu stegs can/ nuXstegs can zhugs pa/ dge slong ma sun phyung ba/ sngon rab tu byung ba/ pham pa 'chab bcas byung ba/ mtshams med lnga byas pa/ mtshan lan gsum du 'gyur ba/ tha dad du gnas pa/ gnas par mi bya ba/ rgyal pos bkrabs pa/ bu lon chags pa/ bran/ pha mas ma gnang ba/ rgyal pos ma gnang ba/ chom rkun par grags pa/ phung krol ba/ lham mkhan/ gdol ba/ g.yung po/ lag rdum/ rkang rdum/ lag sor klum por 213

'jas pa/ mchu med/ lus la rma mtshan yod pa/ rgan ches pa/ gzhon ches pa/ 'theng po/ smad 'chal/ zhar ba/ lag sor zlum po/ sgur po/ mi'uXthung /wa ba can/ lkugs pa/ 'on pa/ rted 'phye/ rkang bam can/ bud med kyis dub pa/ khur gyis dub pa/ lam gyis dub pa/ ya za ma lug gta' gam/skraXser/ skra ser skya/ skra lngang khu/ skra dkar ba/ glang chen skra 'dra/ skra med/mgo 'bar 'bur can/ mgo glang chen 'dra ba/ lus ha cang sbom pa/ lus srubs glebs 'dra ba/ bong ba'iXmago 'dra/ phag gi mgo 'dra/ mgo gnyis pa/ mgo chung ba/ rna ba glang chen/ rta/ ba lang / spre'u/ bong bu/ phag gi rna ba 'dra ba/ rna ba gcig pa/ rna ba med pa/ mig dmar ba/ mig ha cang che ba/ ha cang chung ba/ ha cang ser ba/ shel migaX'adra ba/ chu yi chu dur 'dra ba/ mig gcig pa/ mig med pa/ sna glang po che dang / rta/ ba lang / spre'u/bong bu/ phag gi sna 'dra ba/ sna spubs gcig pa/ sna med/ kos ko glang chen/rta/ ba lang / spre'u/ bong bu/ phag gi kos ko 'dra ba/ kos smyung / kos med/so glang chen/ rta/ ba lang / spre'u/ bong bu/ phag gi so 'dra ba/ so gcig pa/so med/ mgul ringaXche ba/ 'jing nub/ phrag mig ches sgur/ pho mtshan chad pa/ rlig rlugs/ rlig gcig rlig med/ lus ha cang ring ba/ lus bongs thung ba/ skem po/ma 'os par ngal skyen pa/ sha mdog ha cang sngo ba/ser ba/ dkar ba/ dmar ba/ rkang ba gyol bo/ 'gro ba nyams pa/ gling gzhan nas skyes pa tshul byang mi 'dra ba/ skyes pa 'dra ba'i bud med/ sdig 214

sdig lta du'i mtshan nyid can/ sen mo gcig pa/ lag pa 'jas te ltebs pa/ gzhogs byed 'jas pa/ mgo smyung / skra sgra sgre can/ dgye bo/ dgye sgur can/ sor mo drug pa/ sor mo 'byar ba/ sor mo med pa/ mig gi rdzi ma nang du 'jug pa/ mig ne'u le lta du/ mig 'ug pa lta du/ mig phyin ci logamig bar 'dzings pa/ mig rlo ba/ mig bsle'o/ /mig klum po/ mig po che/mig 'dzer can/ mig shu ba can/ mig 'brum bu can/ rna ba ha cang ser ba/ dkar ba/ dmar ba/ rna spubs can/ khyi rdo g.ya' ba/ khyi rdo 'apūngs pa/ khyi rdo che ba/rlig pa'i nang du pho mtshan nub pa/ glen pa/ lce med pa/ skra sngon/ mgo khyi lta bu/ lug lta bu/ ri dwags lha bu/ nya lta du/ sprul lta bu/ ring ba/ mang ba/ mgul ba ta la lta bu/ skrangs pa/ spyod lam byis dub pa rnams dang / gzhan yang nad kyi rnam pa sna tshogs pa ste bar chad de dag ni mdo rtsa ba las byung ba'i ming gi rnam grangs ci rigs par bsdus pa yin te/ de dag las gang skye ba'i bar chad yin pa sogs kyi dbye ba ni gzhung las shes dgos so/ /gnyis pa mthun rkyen lnga ni/ yul dang / rgyud dang / rtags dang /bsam pa dang / cho ga mthun pa'i rkyen no/ /'di dag ni bsnyen rdzogs la'ang 'dra bas/ phyogs gcig tu bshad na/ yul ni/ ston pa'i sku gzugs dang / chos dang / zhuXba'i yul mkhan po dang / las kyi slob dpon dang / dge 'dun rnams so/ /de la mkhan po ni/ bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo 216

bcu bar ma chad du lon pa/ 'dul ba'i tshigaXdon la mkhas pa/ kha skongaXgi chos bcu gsum dang ldan pa/ lnga phrugs nyer gcig gang yang rung ba dang ldan paXrnams tshang ba'o/ /kha skong giXchos bcu gsum ni/ mi 'dug par 'greng ba ma yin/ gangaXl bya ba'i yul yin/ 'dun pa dang yongs su dag pa'i cho ga las ma yin/ bsnyen par ma rdzogs pa ma yin/ nyams pa ma yin/mtshams med byas paXm yin/ sdig lta can ma yin/ sa gzhan na gnas pa ma yin/ tha dad du gnas pa ma yin/ 'khrul bcas ma yin/ mtshams gzhan na gnas pa ma yin/ dkon mchog gzhan ma yin/ shes pa rang bzhin duXmi gnas pa ma yin/ mtshan mi mthun pa ma yin pa ste bcu bzhi las/ chos phyogs pas las byed na tha dad du gnas pa ma gtogs pa bcu gsum dang / chos ma yin pa'i phyogs pas las byed na sdig lta can ma yin pa ma gtogs pa bcu gsum mo/ /rgyud ni/ tshogs su ma tshang ba dang / sdom pa de sngar thob pa pham pas nyams pa ma yin pa'o/ /rtags ni/ rab byung gi rtags cha lugs dang ldan pa ste/ gos/ snod spyad/ lus kyi byi byad kyi rtags gsum mo/ /bsam pa la lnga ste/ sems rang bzhin du gnas pa/ rgyu'i kun slong thob 'dod/ dus kyi kun slong thob shes/ 'gal rkyen nges pas lnga bral/de thamasaXcad nges 'byung gi bsam pas zin pa'o/ /nges pa lnga ni/ sems can nges pa/ yan lag nges pa/ yul nges pa/ dus nges pa tshe nges pa ste lnga'o/ /phyi ma la/ gnas skabs nges pa zhes kyang zer ro/ /cho ga ni/ sbyor ba 216

bshad zin/ dngos gzhi skyabs 'gro rtsom byed du byas nas dge tshul du khas len pa'i sngags tshig lan gsum brjod pa/ thabs legs bya ba rnams yin la/ 'di'i dum bu gsum ni sngar ltar ro/ /mjug ni/ dus go brjod pa dang / bslab pa brjod pa ste gnyis so//zhar byung bla ma'i rnam bzhag la/ mkhan slob spyi'i mtshan nyid drug ni/tshul khrims dang ldan pa/ 'dul ba'i cho ga shes pa/ nad par snying brtse ba/nang 'khor dag pa/ chos dang zang zing gis phan 'dogs pa/ dus su 'domasaXpa'o/ /mkhan po ni gsum ste/ rab byung gi mkhan po/ dge slong ma'i mkhan po/ dge slong gi mkhan po'o/ /slob dpod ni bdud te/ bsnyen gnas kyi slob dpon/ dge bsnyen gyi slob dpon/ dge tshul gyi slob dpon/gsang ste ston pa'i slob dpon/ las byed pa'i slob dpon/ klog pa'i slob dpon/ gnas kyi slob dpon no/ /'ga' zhig tu 'phrin chog gi slob dpon bgrang ba yang yod do/ /las slob ni gsum ste/ dge slob ma'i las slob/tshangs spyod nyeraXganas kyi las slob/ bsnyen rdzogs kyi las slob rnams so/ /tshigs phyi ma dge slong du bsgrub pa'i cho ga la/ yul ni/ mkhan po dang /slob dpon dang / dge 'dun no/ /de yang yul dbus su bcu tshogs dang /mtha' 'khob tu lnga tshogs so/ /dge slong ma la pha ma gnyis ka'i dge 'dun dgos so/ /dge 'dun rnams mi mthun pa gnyis dang zal ba/ kha skong gi chos dang ldan pa zhig dgos la/ mi mthun pa gnyis ni/ ma 'dus pa'i mi 217

mthun pa/ 'dus pa phyir log gi mi mthun pa gnyis so/ /basprub bya ni/ skye ba'i bar chad dang mi ldan pa/ yo byad drug tshang ba/ bsam pa'i khyad par lnga ldan/ tshigs snga ma sngon du song ba ste khyad par bzhi ldan no/ /bsnyen prar rdzogs tshul dngos la/ mngon gyur bcu ni/ ston pa mngon du gyur pa/ sangs rgyas mngon du gyur pa/ chos mngon du gyur pa/ mkhan po mngon du gyur pa/ slob dpon mngod du gyur pa/ bsnyen par rdzogs pa mngon du gyur pa/ bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i yo byad mngon du gyur pa/ yongs spuXdag pa mngon du gyur pa/ gsol ba mngon du gyur pa/ las mngon du gyur pa rnams so/ /cho ga'i khyad par la sbyor dngos 'jug gsum las/sbyor ba'i khyad par brgyad ni/ mkhan pos las byed pa sogs la gsol ba/bsgrub byas mkhan por gsol ba/ chos gos sogs byin gyis brlabs nas ster ba/ lcang ba byin rlabs dang gnas la blo mthun bgyi ba/ bkar nas gsang ston gsol ba'i las kyis bsko ba/ gsang ston gyis sgog tu bar chad dris shing nang du 'ongs nas zhu ba/ las byed pas brda' sprad nas dge 'dun la gsol ba/ bar chad 'dri ba'i gsol ba byas nas nang du bar chad dri ba'o/ /dngos gzhi ni/ gsol ba dang bzhi'i las kyis bsnyen par rdzogs pa'o/ /mjug la dus go brjod pa dang / gdams ngag brjod pa gnyis las/ snga ma la rten bsgos pa'i dge slong gis/ dus mjug sdud kyi de ma thag tu/ las thur ma sor bzhis grib tshod gzhal nas/ brjod tshul 218

dngos po bdun brjod pa'i sgo nas bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i dus go bar byed pa ste bzhi'o/ /brjod pa'i dngos po ni bdun te/ lo/ dus/ zla ba/ zla ba'i ngo / tshes grangs/ nyin mtshan gyi cha/ grib tshod rnams so/ /lo ni byi ba'i lo sogs bcu gnyis dang / de re re la 'byung ba lngas bye na drug cu'o/ /dus ni lnga te/ dgun gyi dus/ dpyid kyi dus/ dbyar gyi dus/dbyar thung ru'i dus/ dbyar ring po'i dus so/ /zla ba ni bcu gnyis te/mgo rgyal/ mchu/ dbo/ nag pa/ sa ga sgon/ chu stod/ gro zhun/ khrums stod/tha skar/ smin drug go /zla ba'i ngo ni/ zla ba re re la yang yar ngo mar ngo gnyis dang / phyogs gnyis te/ lo gcig la ngo dang phyogs nyer bzhi'o/ /tshes grangs ni/ yar ngo'i tshes bco lnga dang / mar ngo'i tshes bco lnga'o/ /de re re la dga' ba/ bzang bo/ rgyal ba/ stong ba/ rdzogs pa ste lngaXre/ de re re la gsum gsum du bye ba rnams so/ /nyin mtshan gyi cha ni nyer gnyis te/ skya rengs shar ba/ nyi ma ma shar ba/ nyi ma shar ba/ nyi ma'i brgyad cha shar ba/bzhi cha shar ba/ snga dro/ gung tshigs ma yol ba/ gung / phyiXdro/ nyi ma bzhi cha lus pa/ brgyad cha lus pa/ nyi ma ma nub pa/ nyi ma nub pa/ rgyu skar ma shar ba ste nyin mo'i cha shas bcu bzhi/ rgyu skar shar ba/ mtshan mo'i thun dang po/thun dang po'i phyed/ gung thud/ gung thun gyi phyed/ thun tha ma/ thun tha ma'i byed/ skya rengs ma shar ba ste mtshan mo'i cha shas brgyad de bsdomasaXn nyeraXganyis so/ /grib tshod ni/ thur ma sor bzhi bas gzhal ba'i grib ma sor 219

bzhi la skyes pa/ sor gcig la rtsa ba'am rkang ba zhes zer ro/ /gdams ngag brjod pa la bcu gcig ste/ tshangs spyod kyi gnas brjod pa/ lhung ba brjod pa/ dge sbyong gi chos brjodaXpa/ mchog tu 'dod pa nyid kyis rdzogs pa brjod pa/ tshul khrims kyis mnyam pa bsgrub paXbarjod pa/ 'jig rten gyi tshul dang 'brel ba'i mthun pa brjod pa/ dul bar gnas pa brjod pa/dgos pa rjes su bsgrub pa brjod pa/ ma brjed pa yang dag par shes pa bsgrub pa brjod pa/ gus pa la sbyar ba brjod pa/ baspub pa'i thabs nges pa brjod pa'o/ /dge slong ma la de'i steng du lci ba'i chos brjod pa bsnan nas bcu gnyis su bshad do/ /dge bsnyen ma/ rab byung ma/ dge tshul ma gsum gyi cho ga'i khyad paraXni pha dang 'dra/ dge slongaXma'i sdom pa la/ rten gyi khyad par ni khyim so ma bzung naXlo bco brgyad dang / bzung na lo bcu lon pa'i dge tshul ma'o/ /yul gyi khyad par yul dadus su dge slong ma bcu gnyis dang / mtha' 'khob tu dge slong ma drug go /dngos gzhi ni gsol gnyis kyi las kyis ster ba'o/ /mjug dus go dang gdams ngag brjodaXpa gnyis so/ /tshangs spyod nyer gnas kyi sdom pa la/ rten gyi khyad par dge slong ma'i sdom pa lo gnyis spyad pa/ khyim so bzung na lo bcu gnyis/ ma bzung na nyi shu lon pa'o/ /yul ni snga maXdang 'dra la/ gsang stod mas skog tu bar chad dri ba/ las slob mas bu'i dge kadun gyi dbus su bar chad dri ba rnams sbyor chog dang / dngos gzhi gsol gnyis kyi las kyis ster ro/ /220

dge slong ma la rtenaXgyi khyad par snga ma dang 'dra/ yo byad kyi khyad parasgyuchos gos smadaXlnga dang ldan pa/ yul gyi khyad par gnyis ka'i dge 'dun no/ /gzhan rnams pha dngaX'adra la/ mjug chog gdams ngag gi skabs su shing drung ba ma gtogs pa rnams brjod par bya'o/ /gnyis pa thob pa mi nyams par srung ba ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyenaXl bsten te srung baXl/ gdas kyi bla ma ni/ btsud pa'i yan lag tshul khrims dag pa/ brtan pa'iXyan lag bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo bcu bar ma chad du lon pa/ mkhas pa'i yan lag 'dul ba shes shing lnga tshan nyer gcig gang rungaXdang ldad pa/ phan 'dogs kyi yan lag lhaXb mthun pa/ mtshan mthun pa/ tha snyad gsum dang ldan pa/ lus tha mal du gnas pa/ sa rang bzhin du gnas pa/ snyingaXrje dang ldad pa/ bzod pa dang ldan pa/ nang 'khor ba dag pa/ chos dang zang zing gis phan 'dogs la brtson pa/ dus su 'doms pa ste chos bcu ldad no/ /gnas pa slob ma ni/ sde lnga'i sdom pa gso rung yan chad dang ldan pa/ dge ba 'a bsgro na pa/ bla ma la byungs pa/ bla mami byung ba la grims pa/ dul ba/ bzod pa dang ldan pa ste drug dang / dge slong yid na bsnyen par rdzogs das lo bcu ma lon pa'am/ lon yang lnga tshan dngaXmi ldan pa'o/ /gnas pas gnas la bsten tshul ni/ bsam pas bsted pa/ sbyor bas bsted pa/ bya ba nar ma dang / glo bur ba rnams zhu ba rnams so/ /gdas kyis gnas pa la ji ltar sgrub pa ni/ rjes su bzung ba'i tshul gyis sgrub pa 221

dang / chad pas bcad pa'i tshul gyi spub pa gnyis rnams so/ /'di'i lnga phrugs nyi shu rtsa gcig la/ dang po lo bcu lon pa'i lnga tshan ni/ bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo bcu lon pa dang / nad g.yog byed pa/ 'alhod pa sel ba/sdig lta spong ba/ gnas mngon par mi dga' ba 'dor ba bzhi byed dam byed duX'ajug pa ste lnga'o/ /gnyis pa 'dzinaXpa'i lnga tshan la 'dul ba 'dzin pa/ mdo sde 'dzin pa/ mngon pa 'dzin pa/ mang du thos pa/ tshul khrims dang ldan pa'o/gsum pa mkhasaXpa'i sde tshan ni/ sde snod gsum laXmakhas pa/mang thos/ tshul ldan te lnga'o/ /bzhi ba rig pa'i sde tshan ni/ sde snod gsum rig pa/ mang thos/ tshul ldan te lnga'o/ /lnga ba gsal ba'i sde tshan ni/ sde snod gsum gsal bar 'chad nus pa/ mang thos/ tshul ldan te lnga'o/ /drug pa 'dzin du 'jug pa'i sde tshan ni/ sde snod gsum gzhan laX'adzin du 'jug nus pa/ mang thos/ tshul ldan te lnga'o/ /bdun pa slob pa'i sde tshan ni/ bslab pa gsum la slob pa/ mang thos/ tshul ldan te lnga'o/ /brgyad pa slob tu 'jug pa'i sde tshan ni/ gzhad bslab pa gsum la slob tu 'jug nus pa/ mang thos/ tshul ldan te lnga'o/ /dgu ba 'dul ba la slob pa'i sde tshan ni/ lhag pa'i spyod pa/ 'dul ba dang so sor thar bar bslab pa/ mang thos/ tshul ldan te lnga'o/ /bcu ba 'dul ba la slob tu 'jug pa'i sde tshan ni/lhag pa'i spyod pa/ 'dul ba dang so sor thar bar slob tu 'jug nus pa/mang thos/ tshul ldan te lnga'o/ /bcu gcig pa phun sum tshogs pa'i sde tshan 222

ni/ dad pa/ tshul khrims/ thos pa/ gtong ba/ shes rab phun tshogs te lnga'o/ /bcu gnyis pa mi slob pa'i phun tshogs lnga ni/ mi slob pa'i tshul khrims/ ting 'dzin/ shes rab/ rnam par grolaXb/ mi slob pa'i lta ba ste lnga'o/ /bcu gsum pa dran ldan gyi sde tshan ni/ tshul ldan/ mang thos/ brtson 'grus/ shes rab/ dran pa dang ldan pa ste lnga'o/ /bcu bzhi ba nang du 'jog pa'i sde tshan ni/ tshul ldan/ mang thos/ brtson 'grus/ shes rab/nang du yang dag 'jog pa dang lnga'o/ /bco lnga bar mnyam par bzhag pa'i sde tshan ni/ mang thos/ tshul ldan/ brtson 'grus/ shes rab/ mnyam par 'jog pa dang lnga'o//bcu drug pa slob pa'i sde tshan ni/ slob pa'i tshul khrims kyi phung bo/ting nge 'dzin gyi phung bo/ shes rab kyi phung bo/ rnam par grol ba'i phung bo/rnam par grol ba mthong ba'i phung bo ste lnga'o/ /bcu bdun pa mi slob pa'i sde tshan ni/ mi slob pa'i phung bo lnga ste snga ma dang 'dra'o//bcoXbargyad pa byung shes kyi sde tshan ni/ byung ba shes pa/ bcas pa shes pa/ rjes su bcas paXshes pa/ bkag pa shes pa/ gnang ba shes pa ste lnga'o/ /bcu dguXb gnas 'char gzhug nus kyi sde tshan ni/ b.raXdu gcod pa shes pa/ bar du gcodaXpa ma yin pa shes pa/ smra ba dang / rjes su bstan pa/ gnas 'char gzhug nus pa ste lnga'o/ /nyi shu ba re zhig gnas 'char gzhugaXnus kyi sde tshan ni/de dang 'dra'o/ /nyer gcig pa ltung shes kyi sde tshan ni/ lhang ba shes pa/223

lhang med shes pa/ yang ba shes pa/ spru ba shes pa/ so thar dang rgyas pa thon pa ste lnga'o/ /gong giXsde tshan bco brgyad pa'i byung shes kyi dbye ba la/ byung la ma bcas pa dang / byungaXl bcas pa gnyis/ phyi ma la byung la bcas pa dang / byung ba'i rjes bcas gnyis/ bcas pa la/ dgag pa'i bcas pa/sgrub pa'i bcas pa/ gnang ba'i bcas pa ste gsum/ rjes bcas la/ spub pa'i rjes su sgrub pa bcas pa/ sgrub pa'i rjes su gnang ba bcas pa/ sgrub pa'i rjes su dgag pa bcas pa/ gnang ba'i rjes su sgrub pa bcas pa/gnang ba'i rjes su gnang ba bcas pa/ gnang ba'i rjes su dgag pa bcas pa/ dgag pa'i rjes su spub pa bcas pa/ dgag pa'i rjes su gnang ba bcas pa/ dgag pa'i rjes su dgag pa bcas pa ste dgu'o/ /de yang rjes bcas kyis mtshan nyid mi 'dor ba gsum dang / mtshan nyid 'dor ba drug go /zhar byung lhung bzed kyi skor la rung ba lnga ni/ rgyu'i rung ba sa rdo lcags gsum gang rung las byasaXpa/ kha dog gi rung ba bya rog gi mig ltar nag pa/ dbyibs kyi rung ba sgo nga byed bkas ltar klum pa/ ngo bo'i rung ba lhan pa lnga yan chad ma phog cing longs spyod du bzod pa/ cho ga'i sgo nas rung ba byin gyis rlabs pa'o/ /tshad kyis dbye na che 'bring chung gsum/ rten gyiXsgo nas pha ma'i gnyis/ chad las su bcang ba'i 'brel med lhung bzed dang gsum/ lhang bzed la slong phor zhes kyang bya'o/ /'khar gsil gyi skor la/ rgyu'i khyad par yas mas lcags dang / bar shing las 224

byas pa/ dbyibs kyi khyad par smad gzhogs zur bdun dang / stod gzhogs zur brgyad pa/ dum du gsum pa rtse la mchod rten dang / rwa klumaXpo'i rtse mor yang mchod rten yod pa/ rwa re re la a long gsum gsum stod du lcags kyu dang bcas pa'o/ /dbye da/ ra gcig pa/ rwa gnyis pa/ rwa bzhi ba/ rwa drug ma rnams so/ /'di la 'khar gsil/ gseg shang / go byed/ khyiXskrod//gsil byed ces kyang bya'o//chu tshags la lnga ste/ sbyar tshags dang / thum tshags dang / ril ba zhabs tshags can/ bsal tshags/ tshags gru gsum ste lnga'o/ /bsro khang gi skor la/ yon tan lnga ni/ rdul dang dri ma 'byang ba1pags pa mdangs gsal ba/ pags pa la nad yod pa rnams 'byin pa/rlung dang bad kan med par byed pa/ nad med par byed pa'o/ /yang na snga ma bzhi'i steng du skyoXb skyed par byed pa'o/ /bsro khang gi dkyil du skar khung dra ba can bya ba/ sgo glegs/ 'khor gtan/ gnam gzer/ 'phred gtan/ dbyug gu skam kha dang bcas pa'o/ /sgo ni sgo glegs/ sgo gtan/yang mig lag gzung dang bcas pa'o/ /'og tu so phag gcal bkram pa dang / der dgos pa'i yo byad lcagasaXkyi thal phyags dang / pog phor/bdug spos/ lcags kyi phrugs spyad rnams so/ /'di la dugs khangaXzhes kyang zer ro/ /khrus khang gi skor la/ nang du so phag gis sgron pa'i khrus dong / phyi rol du chu 'bo ba'i gtor khung / yo byad la thal ba dang / ba glang gi lci ba/so shing gis bkang ba'i gyo mo'o/ /khrus la legs sbyar gyi khrusaXdang / khrus 225

rang dga' ba gnyis so/ /mi mthun phyogs ngo shes par byas te sgong ba'i sgo nas mi nyams par bsrung ba ni/ spyir sdom pa'i gtong rgyu la/ bslab pa phul ba/shi 'phos pa/ mtshan gnyis byung ba/mtshan lan gsum du 'byur ba/dge rtsa chad pa ste lnga'o/ /bslab pa phul nyams la mu bzhi ste/ phul la ma nyams pa/ nyams la ma phul ba/ gnyi ka dang gnyi ka ma yin pa ste bzhi'o/ /'dul tshul la/ ngo bo 'bul ba/ rten 'bul ba/ bdag rkyen 'bul ba/ mi mthun phyogs khas len pa'i 'bul ba ste bzhi'o/ /ltung ba sde lnga'i skor ni/spyir lhang ba la/rang bzhin gyi ltung ba dang/bcas pa'i lhang ba gnyis/ rten gyi sgo nas pha ma'i gnyis/ sde tshan gyi sgo nas pham pa sogs lnga rnams su yod la/ bsdus na dngos bsam gyi sgo nas dngos po gtso che ba'i lhung ba/ 'du shes gtso che ba'i lhang ba gnyis sbyor ba'i sgo nas na re ba/ skad cig ma gnyis/ ngo bo'i sgo nas mi dge ba dang /lung ma bstan gnyis/ mtharaXthug 'grub tshul gyi sgo nas yid kyi kun slong tsam gyis 'grub pa dang mi 'grub pa gnyis/ gzhi'i sgo nas sems can la brten paXdang / sems can ma yin pa la brten pa gnyis/ byed pa'i sgo nas rang gis bsnyub dgos pa dang/ gzhan la bcol bas kyang 'grub paXganyis/ lus ngag gi sgo nas lus dang ngag gi lhang ba gnyis/ bya ba'i sgo nas bya rung ba mi byed pa dngaX/ bya mi rung ba byed pa gnyis rnams so/ /ma bsrungs pa'i nyesaXdamigs bcu ni/ tshul khrims nyams pas bdag smad pa/226

lha dang ston pas smad pa/ mkhasaXpas smad pa/ chos nyid kyis snad par 'os pa/ phyogs mtshams su mi snyan pa'i sgra grag pa/ ma rtogs pa'i chos mi rtogs pa/ rtogs pa'i chos rnams nyams pa/ 'gyod bzhin pa'i dus byed pa/ shi ba'i 'og tu ngan 'gror lhung ba'o/ /bsrungs pa'i phan yon bcu ni/bslab pa gsum gyi rim pas myo ngan las 'das pa 'thob pa/ 'gyod pa med par 'chi ba'i dusaXbyed pa/ phyogs phyogs su snyan grags kyis khyab pa/bde bar gnyid log cing sad par 'gyur ba/ rtag tu lha rnams kyis srung ba/ sdig pas 'jigs dngangs med pa/ dgraXbos kyang glags mi rnyed cing phan 'dogasaXpa/ gnod sbyin dang mi ma yin gyis mi gnod cing phan 'dogs pa/ chos gos la sogs pa tshegs chung ngus 'thob pa/ smon lam yang dag par 'grub pa rnams so/ /ltung ba bskyed pa'i rten ni/ so thar gyi sdom pa gso rung yan chad dang ldan pa/ med mi rung gi sbyor ba nas mjug gi bar bsgab tshigs gcig pa/ de'i bar sdom rgyun gcig pa/ las dang po pa ma yin pa ste bzhi'o/ /ltung ba re re la'ang dngos gzhi'i ltung ba/ sbyor ba'i lhang ba/ sbyor ba'i sbyor ba'i ltung ba ste gsum gsum dang / ltung ba'i rgyu las sems bsrung tshul gyi bslab bya ci rigs pas bshad do//ltung ba sde lnga'i dang po pham pa'i sde la bzhi ste/ mi tshangs par spyod pa/ma byin par len pa/ srog gcod pa/ mi chos bla ma'i rdzun smra ba ste bzhi'o//gnyis pa'i rdzasaXbadag la bzhi ste bsam sbyor gyis bdag por gyur pa/227

yul chos kyis bdag por gyur pa/ rigs rgyud kyis bdag por gyur pa/sangs rgyas kyi bka' bstsal bas bdag por gyur pa'o/ /dge 'dun dbang tshul la gsum ste/ dus kyi rnyed pa'i dbang tshul/ glo bur gyi rnyed pa'i dbang tshul/ shi ba'i yo byad rnyed pa'i dbang tshul lo/ /rin thang tshang ba la'ang drug ste/ brku ba'i gnas der rin thang tshang ba/ rku ba'i dus su rin thangaXtshang ba/ brku bya la ltos te rin thang tshang ba/ rku byed la ltos te rin thang tshang ba/ sbyor ba gcig gi nang du rin thang tshang ba/ rin thang tshang ba'i tshad rnams so/ /tshad ni 'gron du nyi shu la ka ka ni gcig de bzhi la ma sha ka gcig de lnga ni kar pa ṇi'i bzhi cha'o/ /kar+sha pa ṇa dang / pa ṇa dang / na na ka ni ming gi rnam grangs so/ /rkuXba'i kun slong ni khyad par drug ste/ gzhan gyi yin pa dang / ma byin pa/ rang don du/ 'tsho ba'i don du/ gtan du 'bral 'dod pa/bsam pa rgyun ma log pa'o/ /mang pos rku na/'jog rdzas kyi ched du rku ba dang / bgod rdzas kyi ched du rku ba gnyis so/ /pham pa gsum pa'i skabs kyi mi'am mir chags pa gnyis kyi phyi ma ni/ mer mer po/ nur nur po/ ltar ltar po/ 'khrang 'gyur ro/ /mi ni rkangaXlag 'gyus pa/ byis pa/ gzhon nu/ dar la bab pa/ bar ma/ rgan po rnams so//pham pa bzhi ba la/ bsam gzugs brgyad/ mngon shes/ zil gnon/ 'du shes nyi shu/ zhugs 'bras brgyad dang / sgrib pa lnga spangs pa'i yon tan sogs gang rung ma thob bzhin du thob par smra ba'o//228

zhar byung sbom po la/ sgras brjod kyis dbye na/ nyes pa sbom po dang /dman pa sbom po gnyis so/ /yang sbyor ba'i sbom po/ sbyor ba'i rnam pa'i sbom po/ dngos gzhi'i sbom po/ dngos gzhi'i rnam pa'i sbom po'o/ /sel ba la gzhi/ bsam pa/ kun slong / sbyor ba/ mthar thug gi sel ba lnga/ yang na smad/ chesaXn smad/ shin tu da smad/ ltung med de bzhi/ bcas pa 'ba' zhig gi ltung med la/ dgag bya nyes dmigs med pas lhung med/ skrub mi nus pas ltung med/ bag yangs dang 'brel bas ltung med/ rkyen dgos kyis ltung med de bzhi'o/ /gnyis pa dge 'dun lhag ma'i sde la bcu gsum ste/ khu ba 'byin pa/ lus kyis reg pa/ 'khrig tshig smra ba/ bsnyen bkur bsngags pa/ sprun byed pa/ khang ba byed pa/ khang chen byed pa/ gzhi med skur 'debs/ bag tsam skur 'debs/ dge 'dun dbyen byed pa/ de'i rjes su phyogs pa/ khyim sun 'byin pa/ bka' blo mi bde ba'o/ /gsum pa ltung byed kyi sde la spang lhang dang / lhung byed 'ba' zhig pa gnyis/ dang po la bcu tshan gsum las/ bcu tshan dang po ni/ 'chang ba'i spang lcang / de bzhin du sbyar te/ 'bral ba'i/ 'jog pa'i/ 'khrur 'jug gi len pa'i/slong ba'i/ slob bar rigs pa slong ba'i/ sbags pa slong ba'i/ so so nas sbags pa slong ba'i/ rin bskur ba'i spang lhung ste bcu'o/ /de'i gsumaXpa'i skabs kyi shan gyi rnam bzhag la/ shan dang / rjes zhugs/ rgyun 'brel/shugs rnams don gcig la/ dbye na/ gos kyi shan/ lhung bzed kyi shan/229

sman gyi shan/ lhang ba'i shan dang bzhi/ gos la zhag bcu ba dang / zla 'jog gi shan gnyis/ bsdu na/ rdzas shan/ lhung shan gnyis/ yang na zhag shan/ spang shan/ lhang shan gsum mo/ /rdzas shan/ zhag shan/ dus shan gsum don gcig de la khyad par can dang / khyad par can ma yin pa gnyis/ brdeg bya brdeg byed kyi shan 'dres tshul la dus mnyam pa'i shan dang / dus mi mnyam pa'i shan 'dres tshul gnyis so/ /bcu tshan gnyis pa la/ srin bal gyi/ bal nag 'ba' zhig gi cha gnyis bsre ba'i/— lo drug gi nang du stan gnyis pa byed pa'i/ mtho gang gi bal 'khur ba'i/ bal rmel du 'jug pa'i/ gser dngul len pa'i/ mngon mtshan can gyi/ nyo tshong byed pa'i spang ltung ste bcu'o/ /bcu tshan gsum pa la/ lhung bzed 'chang ba'i/ ltung bzed 'tshol ba'i/ 'thag tu 'jug pa'i/'thag pa skyed pa'i/byin 'phrog gi gtad pa las byung ba'i/ zhag bdun gyi 'azal ba'i/dbyar gyi gos ras chen gyi/ bsngos bsgyur gyi/ gsog 'jog gi spang ltung ste bachu'o/ /'di'i drug pa la dbye na/ dbyar rnyed bdag gir bya ba sngas pa dang / bgo ba lnga baXdang / bzhag pa 'phyis pa'i spang lhang gsum/ brgyad pa la yang / ras chen btsal ba sngas pa dang / bzhag pa 'phyis pa'i spang lhang gnyis so/ /gnyis pa ltung byed 'ba' zhig la bcu tshan dgu las/ bcu tshan dang po ni/ rdzun spra ba'i lhang byed/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ skyon nas smra ba'i/ phra ma byed pa'i/ skyo sngogs byed pa'i/ khyim pa mo la chos ston pa'i/230

'don pa'i/ gnas ngan len brjod pa'i/ mi chos bla ma bden par smra ba'i/bshes ngor byas so zhes skur ba 'debs pa'i/ khyad du gsod pa'i lhung byed de bcu'o/ /bcu tshan gnyis pa ni/ sa bon 'jig pa'i/ 'phya ba'i/bsgo ba rna la gzon pa'i/ gnas mal gyi/ gding ba'i/ skyod pa'i/ phyis gnon byed pa'i/rtsa ba 'byung ba la 'dug pa'i/ 'debs pa'i/ rim pa lhag par byed pa'i ltung byed de bcu'o/ /bcu tshan gsum pa ni/ ma bskos par ston pa'i/ nyi ma nub kyi bar du ston pa'i/ zas kyi phyir bstan par skur ba 'debs pa'i/ gos byed pa'i/ gos sbyin pa'i/ dge slong ma dngaXlhan cigaXlam du 'jug pa'i/ de dang lhad cig grur 'jug pa'i/ dud med dang lhan cig 'dug pa'i/ dge slong ma dang lhan cig 'greng ba'i/ dge slong mas sbyor du 'jug pa'i ltung byed de bcu'o/ /bcu tshan bzhi ba ni/ yang yang za ba'i/ 'dug gnas su za ba'i/ tshad las lhag par len pa'i/ spangs pa za ba'i/ spangs pa stob pa'i/ 'dus shing za ba'i/ dus ma yin par za ba'i/gsog 'jog za ba'i/ byin len ma byed par za ba'i/ bsod pa slong ba'i ltung byed de bcu'o/ /'di'i brgyad pa la cha la brten pa'i nyes pa ni/brtsams ldang gi nyes byas dang / lag nya/ mtshams bcos/zhag lon/ dge slong gis rjen paraXbatsos pa'i nyes pa bzhi dang / bzhi za ba'i nyes pa bzhi dang brgyad do//bcu tshan lnga ba ni/ srog chags dang bcas pa la spyod pa'i/ nyal bo 231

byed par shom pa'i khyim na 'dug pa'i/ der 'greng ba'i/ gcer bu la sbyin pa'i/ dmag la lta ba'i/ dmag gi nang na gnas pa'i/ dpung gi yan lag nyams su myong ba'i/ brdeg pa'i/ gzas pa'i/ gnas ngan len 'chab pa'i lhung byed de bcu'o/ /'di'i bdun paXl dmag la reg pa'i/ bshams dkrugs byed pa'i/ dmag la balha ba'i ltung byed gsum du bshad do/ /bcu cad drug pa ni/ zan gcod du 'jug pa'i/ me la reg pa'i/ 'dun pa phyir bsgyur ba'i/ bsnyen par ma rdzogs pa dang lhan cig nyal ba'i/ sdig lta mi gtong ba'i/ spang ba'iXrjes su phyogs pa'i/ bsnyil ba sdud pa'i/ kha dog ma bsgyur ba'i gos gyon pa'i/ longs pa gzhir gtogs kyi/ khrus byed pa'i lhang byed de bcu'o/ /bcu tshan bdun pa ni/ dud 'gro gsod pa'i/ 'alhod pa bskyed pa'i/ ga ga tshil byed pa'i/ chu la rtse ba'i/ bud med dang lhan cig nyal ba'i/ sdangs par byed pa'i/ sped pa'i/ gdeng med par sbyongad pa'i/ skur ba 'debs pa'i/ bud med dang lhan cig lam du 'gro ba'i rtsang byed dang bcu'o/ /bcu tshan brgyad pa ni/ rkun ma dang lhan cig lam du 'gro ba'i/ nyi shu ma lon pa bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i/ sa brko ba'i/ mgron gnyer ring 'dug gi bsgab pa la nye b.raX'ajog pa sgong ba'i/ nyan rna byed pa'i/ mi smra bar 'gro ba'i/ ma gus pa'i tshul gyi/ myos 'byur 'thung ba'i/dus ma yin par 'gro ba'i ltung byed deXbacu'o/ /bcu tshan dgu ba ni/ zas bcas khyem du rgyu ba'i/ rgyal po'i pho zang du nub mor 'groXba'i/ bslab 232

pa'i gzhi khyad du gsod pa'i/ khab ral 'chos pa'i/ khri rkang 'chos pa'i/shing bal gyi gos byas pa'i/ gding ba las gyur pa'i/ g.yan pa dgab pa las gyur pa'i/ dbyar gyi ras chen las gyur pa'i/ bde gshegs chos gos kyi tshad las kyur pa'i lhang byed de bcu'o/ /sde tshan bzhi ba sor bshags kyi sde la/ dge slong ma las zas len pa'i sor bshags/gral rim du ma phebs par 'brim du 'jug pa ma bzlog par za ba'i sor bshags/ bslab pa dral te khyim du 'jug pa'i sor bshags/ nags ma brtags pa las gyur pa'i so sor bshags par bya ba ste bzhi'o/ /lnga ba nyes byas kyi sde tshan la sde tshan dgu las/ dang po gosaXbago ba'i sde tshan la/ sham thabs mnyam por ma bgos pa/ ha cang brtsengs pa/ ha cang 'jol ba/ phyogs gcig glang po'i sna ltar nar ba/ lte ba'i gong du sham thabs kyi mgo ltebs pa/ lte 'og tu sprul mgo ltar gdengs pa/ ska rags kyi nang du 'bru yi phur ma lta bur 'dug par bgos pa dang / chos gos gnyis ha cang rtsengs pa dang / ha cang 'jol ba dang / skum por ma bgos pa ste bcu'o//gnyis pa khyim du 'gro ba'i sde tshan la/ ma bsdams par 'jug pa/gos legs par ma bgos par 'jug pa/ ca co'i sgra ma bskyungs par 'gro ba/ dgos med du gnya' shing gang las lhag por lta zhing 'gro ba/ mgo ras sogs kyis g.yogs shing 'gro ba/ chos gos brjes te 'gro ba/ chos gos phrag pa gnyis kar gzar ba/ lag pa gnya' gong du bsnol ba/ lag 233

pa ltag par bsnol ba/ mchong zhing 'gro ba/ sgyid pa brkyangs bskum byed cing 'gro ba/ tsog pus 'gro ba/ rting ba bteg ste brang bas 'gro ba/ gru mo snyung por byas te 'gro ba/ lus bsgyur cing 'gro ba/ lag pa kyog cing 'gro ba/ mgo bsgyur cing 'gro ba/ gzhan dang phrag pa gnyis sprad cing 'gro ba/gzhan dang lag pa sbrel te khyim gzhan du 'gro ba ste nyi shu'o//gsum pa khyim na 'dug pa'i sde tshan la/ gzhan gyis ma bsgo bar 'dug pa/ ma brtags par 'dug pa/ gya tshom du lcid kyis phab ste 'dug pa/ rkang ba'i steng du rkang ba bzhag ste 'dug pa/ brla'i steng du brla bzhag ste 'dug pa/ long bu'i steng du long bu bzhag ste 'dug pa/ rkang pa khri sogs kyi 'og tu bkug ste 'dug pa/ byin pa dang rkang ba thag ring b.raXphral te 'dug pa/ 'doms snang bar 'dug pa ste dgu'o/ /bzhi ba zas bslang ba'i sde tshan la/ zas legs par ma blangs pa/ nu dang kha da chad du blangs pa/ bya na dang zan bye sogs mnyam por blangs pa/ gral mthar chags su min par blangs pa/ lhung bzed la yid ma gtad par blangs pa/zas ma 'ong bar lhung bzed bzed pa/ bya na bye sogs gcig gis gcig dgab pa/ zas kyi steng du zas snod bzung ba ste brgyad do/ /lnga ba zas bza' ba'i sde tshan la/ zas legs par ma zos pa/ kham ha cang chung ba/kham ha cang ches pa/ kham ran pa min par zos pa/ zas ma 'ong bar kha gdangs pa/ kha kham gyis bkang ste smra ba/ tsug tsug dang / cag cag dang /234

hu hu dang / phu phu zer zhing za ba/ lce phyir phyung ste za ba/ 'bru re re nas tha dad du byed cing za ba/ zas la 'phya smod byed cing za ba/ mkhur ba gcig nas gcig tu spo zhing za ba/ can btog cing za ba/ kham phror sos bcad cingaXza ba/ lag pa lces ldag pa/ zas snodaXlce dang sor mos 'byogs pa/lag pa la zas chags pa sprug pa/ zas dang bcasaXpa'i snod bskyal ba'am/yang na srang la gdab pa/ zas la mchod rten gyi dbyibs byas te gzhoms nas za ba ste nyi shu rtsa gcig go /drug pa lhung bzed duXspyad pa'i sde tshan la/ gzhan gyi lhang bzed la 'phyas gdags pa'i phyir bltaXb/ lagaXpa zas kyis sbags bzhin snod bzung ba/ gzhan la zas dang sbags pa'i chus gtor ba/ khyim du ma dris par zas dang sbags pa'i chu dbo ba/ lhung bzed du zas zos pa'i snyigs ma dor ba/ 'og gzhi med pa dang / ngam grog gi kha dang / g.yang sa dang /dkan gzar por lhung bzed bzhag pa/ 'greng bzhin lhung bzed bkru ba/gad kha dang / g.yang sa dang /dkan gzar por lhung bzed bkru ba/'bab chu'i rgyun las bzlog ste lhung bzed kyis chu bcu ba ste bcu bzhi'o/ /bdun pa chos 'chad pa'i sde tshan la/ mi na bar 'dug pa la 'greng ste bshad pa/ nyal ba la 'dug ste ston pa/ stan mthon po dang bzang por 'dug pa la dma' bab dang ngan par 'dug ste bshad pa/ mdud nas 'gro ba la rgyab nas ston pa/ lam das 'gro ba la lam gyi 'gram nas 'gro 236

zhing ston pa/ mgo 'khogs pa dang / gos brjes pa dang / chos gos phrag pa gnyis kar gzar baXdang / lag pa gnya' gong du bsnol ba dang / ltag par bsnol ba dang / do ker can dang / zhwa gyon pa dang / cod paṇa can dang / mgo la phreng ba bcings pa dang / mgo thod kyis dkris pa dang /glang po che la zhon pa dang / rta la zhon paXdang / 'do li sogs khyogs la 'dug pa/ bzhon pa'i steng na 'dug pa/ mchil lham lhon pa dang / lag na 'khar ba thogs pa dang / gdugs thogs pa dang / mtshon thogs pa dngaX/ral gri thogs pa dang / dgra sta thogs pa dang / go cha gyon pa la chosaXbashad pa ste nyi shu rtsa drug go /brgyad pa bsgrub pa'iXsde tshan la/ mi na b.raX'agreng ste bshang gci byed pa dang / chu'i nang du bshang gci sogs 'dor ba dang / rtsa sngon po yod pa'i sa phyogs su bshang gci sogs 'dor ba dang byas zin chu dang rtsa sngon por 'dor ba ste bzhi'o//dgu ba rgyu ba'i sde tshan ni/ gnod pa byung ba ma gtogs par rang dgar shing la mi gang tsam las mtho bar 'dzeg pa ste nyes byas gcig go /de dag rnam pa kun du spong bar byed pa'i khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum mo/ /dge slong ma'i lhang ba sde lnga ni/ pham pa la thun mong ba bzhi dang / reg pa/ lus bkan pa/ 'chab pa/ bzlog pa'i pham pa ste brgyad do/ /dge 'dun lhag ma la/ spyan byed pa/ gzhi med/ bag tsam/ ci yang rung ba len pa/ ci yang rung ba len du 'jug pa/ mtshan mo 'bral ba/ nyin moX236

'bral ba/ lam du 'jug pa/ chu brgal ba/ rab tu 'byid pa/ shi ba'i nor len pa/ bzod pa gsol du 'jug pa/ spong ba/ 'thab krol byed pa/ bud med bsten pa/ bud med bsten du 'jug pa/ dge 'dun dbyen sogs thun mong ba bzhi dang nyi shu'o/ /spang ba'i lhung ba la/ 'chang ba sogs bcu tshan dang po sngar bzhin dang / gser dngul la reg pa/ mngon mtshan can/nyo tshong byed pa/ lhung bzed tshol ba/ 'thag tu 'jug pa/ 'thag pa bskyed pa/ 'phrog pa/ bsngos bsgyur/ gsog 'jog las gyuraXpa/ lhung bzed 'chang ba/ byin gyis mi rlobs pa/ sra brkyang 'byin pa/ sra brkyang mi 'byin pa/ rin po che slong ba/ gos za ba las gyur pa/ gos kyi rgyu sogs za ba las gyur pa la/ dbyar khang / malaXcha/ gos kyi ched du yo byad gang yang rung ba zas su byas te bzang ba'i phyir 'jog pa ste gsum/ skye bo mang bo la bsngos pa byin gyis rlobs pa/ dge 'dun la bsngos pa byin gyis rlobs pa/bcings pa 'grol du 'jug pa/ gos lci ba bsten pa/ gos yang ba bsten pa'i spang ba'i ltung ba ste sum cu rtsa gsum mo/ /lhang byed 'ba' zhig pa la/dge slong dang thun mong ba'i bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyi ming ni sngar gyi der 'du la/ thun mong ma yin pa brgya dang brgyad ni/ ma lon pas nye bar 'jog pa/ 'khor nye bar 'jog pa/ 'khor mang bo nye bar 'jog pa/ lo bcu gnyis ma lon par bsnyen par rdzogs par byed pa/ lo nyi shu ma lon par bsnyen par rdzogs par byed pa/ khyim so bzung ba tshigs las 'das 237

par bsnyenaXpar rdzogs par byed pa/ khyem so ma bzung ba tshigs las 'das par bsnyen par rdzogs paraXbyed pa/ bslab pa la ma bslabs pa bsnyen rdzogs byed pa/ bsgab pa la bslabs pa bsnyen rdzogs mi byed pa/chos 'tshong ba/ 'drid pa/ 'khor mang po gsog pa/ ma gnang ba sdud pa/'khrul ba mo sdud pa/ sprum ma sdud pa/ mya ngan gyis gzir ba sdud pa/ rtsab krol can sdud pa/ phan miX'adogs pa/ bar chad mi 'dren pa/ bsgab pa la mi slob pa/ nad g.yog mi byed pa/ 'dod pa bsten pa/ 'dod pa bsten pa ltar 'chos pa/ 'dod pa bsten pa ltar gnod pa/ bsten par bya ba 'chos pa/ dben pa skyabs yod par khyim pa dang lhan cig 'greng ba/ der dge slong dang lhan cig 'greng ba/ bla gab med par khyim pa dang lhan cig 'greng ba/ der dge slong dang lhan cig 'greng ba/ khyim pa'i rna bar shub cing smra ba/ khyim pas shub cing spru ba nyan pa/ dge slong gi rna bar shub cing smra ba/ dge slong gi shub cing smra ba nyan pa/ khyim pa las rig pa len pa/khyim pa las rig pa klog pa/ sgyu thabs kyis rma bcings shing 'grol du 'jug pa/ bu 'tshoXb/ khyim gzhan du mtshan mo nyal ba/ mtshan mo ma brtags par skyabs yod par nyal ba/ mtshan mo dge slong ma gzhan med par nyal ba/ longs spyod cing gnas pa btang ba/ rang gi lus la dge slong ma dang / dge slob ma dang / dge tshul ma dang / khyim pa mo dang / nu stegs mos dril phyis byed du 'jug pa lnga dang / bud med gzhan gyis bkru 238

bshal byed du 'jug pa/ lus la dri zhim pos bskud pa/ 'bru mar gyi tshigs mas skud pa/ chu la longs spyod pa/ pu shel tsis skra shad pa/ so mangs kyis skra shad pa/ sgyug shad kyis skra shad pa/ de gsum char gyis skra shad pa/ skra brnyan bkab pa/ khyim pa'i rgyan thogs pa/ bro brdung ba glu len pa/ rol mo byed pa/ gdugs thogs pa/ mchil lham gyon pa/ khri'u'i bsnyen bkur nyams su sbong ba/ thugs thub tu phyis gnon byed pa/ khyim pa la log thabs byed pa/ dge slong ma'i tshogs kyi gos bdag gir byed pa/ zas 'tshong ba/ khyim gyi bya ba byed pa/ chang las byed pa/ rjen btsos byed pa/ lto 'dun las gyur pa/ tshogs par dbyung ba ma yin pa'i dri bsten pa/ ste gab mi 'chang ba dang / chu gos mi 'chang ba dang / bkru bshal ba la 'khrur 'jug pa ste/ gsu bel ba las gyuraXpa gsum/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan la ma gus pa/ rgyal mtshan brje ba/ bsngags pa dang / gnas dang / khyim pa dang /rnyed pa dang / chos la ser sna byed pa ste lnga/ dbyar khang nas dge slong ma sgrod pa dang / snga nas gnas pa sgrod pa ste skyod pa las grur pa gnyis/ tho 'tshams pa las gyur pa/ log par ston pa/ mi brtan pas rnam paraX'agyur ba/ dge slong ma'i tshogs la brnyas thabs byed paXdang / spyo ba dang / dge slong la chus 'thor ba ste brnyas thabs byed pa gsum/ 'khrug long yal bar 'dor ba/ blo mthun par mi byed pa/ zla ba byed phyedā cing dge slong las gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pa nyams su sbong bar mi byed pa ༷ 239

dang / dge slong med par gso sbyong byed pa dang / der dbyar khas len pa dang / gnyis ka'i dge 'dud las dgag dbye mi byed pa ste/ lci ba'i chos las 'das pa bzhi/ dadul por sra brkyang sbyor du 'jug pa/ bag yangs su bya ba'i tshogs pa mi sbyin pa/ gos 'god pa'i phyir mi sbyin pa/ dbyar khang yal bar 'dor ba/ dbyar nang du sngongs rgyu ba/ dbyar gyi 'og tu der mi 'gro ba/ yul 'khor dogs pa dang bcas par 'gro ba/ mi mthud pa dang bcas par 'gro ba/ rtsod pa byed pa/ skabs ma bye bar 'dri ba/ phyi sar gcig pur 'gro ba/ rtsa sngon por bshang ba 'dor ba/ rtsig pa'i phan tu ma bltas par bshang gci 'dor ba'i lhung byed de brgya dang brgyad cu'o/ /so sor bshags par bya ba la/ gzhan gyi khyim nas bdag gi don du 'o ma dang / zho dang / mar dang / zhun mar dang / 'bru mar dang / sbrang rtsi dang /bu ram gyi dbu ba dang / nya sha dang / sha dang / sha skam gang yang rung ba blangs te longs spyad pa ste bcu dang / dmag dpon seng ge las gyur pa'i so sor bshags par bya ba ste bcu gcig go /nyes byas la/ sham thabs rked pa snang bar bgo ba dngaX/ 'khrig pa'i 'dod chags kyis chags par gyur cing khyim gzhan du 'gro ba gnyis dang / dge slong dang thun mong ba brgya dang bcu ste bsdoms na brgya dang bcu gnyis so/ /de dag rnam pa kun tu spong bar byed pa'i khrims sum brgya dang drug cu rtsa bzhi'o//zharaXbyung dge slob ma'i gdams ngag bcu gnyis ni/ gcig pu lam 240

du mi 'gro ba/ chu'i pha rol rkyal bar mi bya ba/ skyes pa la reg par mi bya ba/skyes pa dngaXlhan cig 'dug par mi bya ba/ sprun du 'gyur ba mi bya ba/ kha na ma tho ba 'chab par mi bya ba ste rtsa ba'i chos drug gser la bzung bar mi bya ba/ 'doms kyi spu 'breg par mi bya ba/ byin len ma byas par mi za ba/ gsog 'jog byas pa mi za ba/ rtswa sngon por mi gtsang ba mi 'dor ba/sa mi brko ba ste rjes mthun gyi chos drug rnams so//dge slong ma'i lci ba'i chosaXbargyad ni/ zla ba phyed phyed cing dge slong gi dge 'dun las gdams ngag nod pa/ dge slong gi dge 'dun med pa'i sa phyogs su dbyar las mi len pa/ dgag dbye byed pa'i tshe gnyis ka'i dge 'dun la byed pa/ dge slong mas mkhan mo byed pa'i tshe gnyis ka'i dge 'dun la gsol ba 'debs su gzhug pa/ dge slong gsar bu la yang phyag 'tshal ba/ dge slong la co mi 'dri ba/ dge slong la ltung ba gleng dran mi byed pa/ mgu ba spyod pa'i tshe gnyis ka'i dge 'dun la spyod pa ste brgyad do/ /zhu ba spyir bstan gyi skor la/ lhung ba rnams rten/ yul/ sbyor ba/mthar thug ste yan lag bzhis ston par byed la/ rten la bsgabaXpa/bsam pa/ tshigs/ mtshan/ yul/ lus/ gnas skabs te bdun no/ /basbab pa'i yan lag la/ nyams paXdang ma chags pa gnyis la nyes byas su 'gyur ba/ma rdzogs shing rab tu byung ba la blangs 'das dang phyogs mthun gyi nyes byas su 'grur ba/ bslab byin dge slong la dmigs bsal gsum ma 241

gtogs pa dngos gzhir 'byur ba'o/ /'di'i blangs 'das la dge tshul pha ma gnyis la thun mong du bcas pa bcu gsum/ dge slong ma'i rten la bcu gnyis te nyer lnga dang / yang srog gcod pa la sogs pa sum cu so drugabasdu na/ mkhan po las dngos su khas blangs pa dang / slob dpon las dngos su khas blangs pa gnyis las 'gal ba gnyis/ yang rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba dang / bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba gnyis/ yang 'du shes gtso che ba dang / dngos po gtso che ba gnyis/ yang tshul khrims kyi mi mthun phyogs/ bag yod kyi mi mthun phyogs/ brtul zhugs kyi mi mthun phyogs te gsum mo/ /phyogs mthun bsdam bya'i nyes byas la/ rtsang baXmed pa ni phyed dang bco brgyad do/ /phyogs mthun dngos ni/ rtags kyi gzhi/ slong ba'i gzhi/ snod spyad kyi gzhi/ longs spyod kyi gzhi/ 'phyar g.yeng gi gzhi/ 'dod pa la brten pa'i gzhi/ gnong ba'i gzhi/ gnas pa'i gzhi/ ma gus pa'i gzhi/ mi sbyong ba'i gzhi ste bcu'o/ /bsdu na/ sdom pa nyams pa'i phyogs mthun dang / bar ma nyams pa'i phyogs mthun gnyis so/ /'di'i mthun pa gsum ni/ dgag bya nyes dmigs mthun pa/ sbyor ba rjes snyub mthun pa/rgyud pa rgyur 'gro mthun pa'o/ /bsam pa'i yan lag ni/ shes pa rang bzhin du gnas pa ste/ 'di'i ldog phyogs mi gnas pa brgyad ni/ smyo ba/sems 'khrugs pa/ tshor bas gzir ba/ 'gro ba gzhan gyi rnam pa bsten pa na dge slong gi 'duXshes brjed pa/ gnyid log pa/ snyoms par zhugs pa/242

ra ro pa/ de'i dod thub pa rnamasaXso/ /tshigs kyi yan lag ni/ nyes byas kyi sde ma gtogs pa lhang ba sde la rdzun sogs bzhi cu rtsa lnga maXgatogasaXpa ༷rnams la sbyor ba nas mthar thug gi bar bslab tshigs gcig pa dgos pa —ste/ gzhan du na smad do/ /mtshan gyi yan lag la/ thun mong ba dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis/thun mong ba la mtshan nyid spyi 'dra'i thun mong ba lnga bcu rtsa lnga/ rjes mthun ming tsam gyi thun mong ba la gsum ste/ mtshan mthud pa yan lag tu dgos pa bzhi bcu tham pa/ mtshan mi mthun pa yan lag tu dgos pa lnga/ cho ga 'jig pa'i thun mong ba bzhi'o/ /thun mong ba ma yin pa la dge slong pha'i thunaXmong ma yin pa so brgyad/ ma'i thun mong ma yin pa brgya dang gya bdun no/ /yul gyi yan lag la/ da ltar gyi lus lhang ba'i byedaXpa por ston pa/rang nyid 'gro ba gang du gtogs pa'i lus rtsang ba'i byed pa por stonaXpa/rang gi rgyud gang du gtogs ba'i lus ltung ba'i byed pa por ston pa/'phen pa gcig gis bsdus pa'i lus lhung ba'i byed pa por ston pa ste ༷bzhi'o/ /rtsang baXthaXdad paXl bslab pa dang mtshan gyi rgyun tha dad pa/ kun slong gi rgyun tha dad pa/ bcas rigs tha dad pa/ kun slong gi rnam pa thaXdad pa/ 'bras bu tha dad pa la brten nas ltung ba tha dad par 'gyur ba ste lnga'o/ /tshan tshan gyi yan lag ni/ yul gyi yan lag la sems can las gyur pa dang / sems can ma yin pa las gyur pa gnyis/ dang po la/ mi 243

las gyur pa dang / dud 'gro lasaXgyur pa gnyis/ snga ma la mi tsam spyis bskyed pa gnyis/ bye brag khyim pa byis bskyed pa nyi shu rtsa bdun/ bud med spyis bskyed pa drug bsnyen par rdzogs pa spyis bskyed pa gsum/ bsnyen par ma rdzogs pa spyis bskyed pa lnga/ tha snyad spyis bskyed pa bcu gnyis/chos 'di pa'i rab byung spyis bskyed pa gnyis/ dge slong phas bskyed pa bzhi bcu zhe drug mas bskyed pa bcu bzhi/ dge tshul gyis bskyed pa gciganu stegs can gyis bskyed pa gnyis/ khyem pa phos bskyed pa drug mos bskyed pa bzhi rnams so/ /sems can ma yin pa las byur pa la/ lhang ba las gyur pa lnga/ zas las gyur pa nyer gcig gos la brten pa so drugasnod spyad la brten pa brgyad/ nor las gyur pa bzhi/ ngag kho nas byed pa can bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi/ lusaXngag gnyis ka dgos pa gsum/ gang rung gi byed pa can dgu/ bcol yang rdzogs pa sum cu rtsa gsum rnams su yod la/mthar thug dang sbyor ba'i rnam bzhag kyang der 'du'o/ /gzhi stod dang zhu ba spyir bstan gyi skor rdzogs so/ /gzhi smad la/ gzhi bcu bdun ni/ rabaXbyung gi gzhi/ gso sbyong gi gzhi/dgag dbye'i gzhi/ dbyar gyi gzhi/ ko lpags kyi gzhi/ sman gyi gzhi/ gos kyi gzhi/ sra brkyang gi gzhi/ ko shasnyi'i gzhi/ las kyi gzhi/ dmar ser can gyi gzhi/ gang zag gi gzhi/ spo ba'i gzhi/ gso sbyong bzhag pa'i gzhi/ gnas mal gyi gzhi/ rtsod pa'i gzhi/ dgeX'adun dbyen gyi gzhi rnams so/ /'di'i 244

ko shasdi la/ las bye ba'i gzhi dang / dmar ser can la phyir bcos sti gzhi dang / gang zag la dus dang dus min bsdus pa 'byung ba'i gzhi dang / sbo ba la sa gzhan na gnas pa spyod pa'i gzhi dang / gso sbyong bzhag pa la yongs sbyong gi gzhi zhes kyang zer ro/ /gzhung dam par gzhiXbartso brgyad zhes gsungs pa ni/ rnam par 'byed pa'i gzhi bsnan nas 'dren pa'am/ phyir bcos la ltung ba phyir bcos dang rtsod pa phyir bcos gnyis su phye ba'o/ /'di'i rab byung gi gzhi ni sngar gyi bshad zinaXpa de rnams yin la/ lhag ma rnams laXlnga las/ dang po bsgab pa yongs su sbyong ba'i gzhi la/ gso sbyong dang / dbyar gnas dang / dgag dbye gsum mo/ /gso sbyong la/ zhi gnas kyi gso sbyong / mthun pa'i gso sbyong / bkra shis kyi gso sbyong / gnod pa bzlog pa'i gso sbyong /dbyen bsdum pa'i gso sbyong / gso sbyong bcu bzhi ba/ gso sbyong bco lnga ba ste bdud no/ /bsdu na/ zhi gnas kyi gso sbyong dang / mthun pa'i gso sbyong gnyisaXsu 'du'o/ /zhi gnas kyi gso sbyong la/ gnas kyi khyad par 'jigs pa dang gnod pa las bral ba/ 'du 'dzis dben pa/ bag phebs pa ste gsum ldan no/ /spong khang ni/ gnyis dang / drug dang / bcu la sogs pa'i bar du spang 'dod pa/ skar khung sgo sogs ni bsro khang gi skabs dang 'dra la/ dge slong mang bas ma shong naXkhang mo che dang / yang thog dang / der 'dzegs pa'i phem skas dang / lan kan gyis bskor ba rnams/ yang na spong 245

khang chen po'am/ gnas khang gi tshar dag kyang bya la/ nye 'khor du sa phug bya ba rnams so/ /spong khang nang du sa'i stegs bu dang / khri'u gru bzhi ba dang / der thags ma rnam pa lngas dra ba bya ba dang / de'i steng du stan nang tshan can 'ding bar bshad do/ /sgom pa po'i rten gyi gang zag ni/ tshul khrims dag cing mang du thos pa/ gnod pa chung zhing chog shes pa/ gdams ngag dang ldan pa/ lus sems dben pa dang bcas pa ste chos bzhi ldan no/ 1gangaXbasgom pa ni/ mos pa yid byed kyi bsgom pa dang / de kho na nyid yid byed kyi bsgom pa'o/ /de re re la'ang las dang po pa'i bsgom tshul/cung zad sbyang ba byas pa'i bsgom tshul/ yid la byed pa rdzogs pa'i bsgom tshul gsum gsum ste/ zhi lhag gi ming gi rnam grangs rgyas par mngon pa'i skabs su bshad zin to/ /sgom pa phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ba'i yan lag gnyis ni/ bying ba bsal ba'i phyir du gdos pu gdags pa dang /bde bar gnas pa'i ched du spong ba po'i zhal ta pa bsko ba'o/ /bsgo tshul ni/ sbyor ba spro ba 'dri ba/ dngos gzhi gsol gnyis kyi las kyis bsko ba/mjug sdud brjod pa rnams so/ /mthun pa'i gso sbyong la/ sbyor ba ni drug ste/ gso sbyong giXganas thabs dang bcas pa/ rang gzhan gyi lhang ba dag par byed pa/ gtsug lag khang gi bya ba rjes su sgrub pa/ chos nyan bshad byaXb/ bskos pa'i dge slong gis tshul shing brims nas bgrang ste ma 'dus na 'dun pa dang yongs dag blang ba/ dge slong gis me tog phul nas so sor 246
