thar ba'i mdo 'don par gsol ba gdab pa dang drug go /de 'a/sa gnas kyi khyad par la/ blo mthun par byed pa'i gnas/mtshams dang bcas pa'i gnas/ mtshams med pa'iXganas dang gsum mo/ /blo mthun gyi gnas la grub pa/ byas pa/ zin pa ste gsum gang rung yin pa/ nye 'khor 'dom gang dang bcas pa/ dge 'dun gyis 'dod pa/sngar blo mthun ma byas pa ste khyad par bzhi ldan no/ /mtshams dang bcas pa'i gnas la/ las kyi mtshams dang / rtsig pa'i mtshams gnyis/ mtshams maXbacad pa'i gnas la yang ra ba med pa'i khang ba sogs kyi wa kha nas chu 'dzag pa tshun chad dang / grong la nye 'khor gyi mtha' tshun chad dang dgon pa la rgyang grags kyi mtha' tshun chad de gsum mo/ /las kyi mtshams bcad pa la yang gsum ste/ mtshams po che dang / mtshams bu chung dang / dkyil 'khor ba'o/ /mtshams po che ni/ tshad dbus nas dpag tshad phyed dang gsum du nges pa/ phyogs bzhir mtshan ma brtan po yod pa/ chu bo sogs mtshams gzhan byung ba min pa/ sngar mtshams bcad pa dang ma 'brel ba/gzhan gyis mtshams gcad pa'i ched du mtshan ma brtan po btsugs pa ma yin pa ste khyad par ldan no/ /zhar byung gnas de dag gang yang rung bar mchod pa dang bcas te stonaXpa'i sku bsham pa/ dkar gtor cha bzhi bsham pa/ dge 'dun bsdu ba'i ched du garnyi brdung ba ste tshul khrims bzhi mi mthun pas 'don pa'o/ /247

mjug ni/ bsngo ba 'don pa/ tshigs su bcad pa 'don pa/ dkar phyogs la dga' ba'i lhaXklu sogasaXkyi ming nasaXbos te yon bshad byed pa'o/ /dbyar gyi gzhi la dgos pa dguXni dbyar khas ma blang ba'i nyes pa khegs pa/ srog chags la gnod pa sgong ba/ gzhan gyis 'phya ba spong ba/ lus srog la gnod pa spong ba/ don dang bya ba nyung ba/ dgag dbye 'byung ba/ sra brkyang gding ba 'byung ba/ gnasaXral ba dang grum pa 'chos pa thos bsam 'phel ba ste dgu'o/ /gnas ni/ bde ba'i rkyen gnas shing gnod rkyen med pa/ steng g.yogs dang bcas la gnas gcig yin pa/ dge slong gnas shing sgo glegs dang bcas pa/ mtshams gzhan min pa ste bzhi'o/ /yul ni/ dge slong chos bdunaXldan dang dge tshul gang rung ngo / /rten ni rab byung yin pa/ dbyar khas len pa'i mthun rkyen tshang ba/ shes pa rang bzhin du gnas pa/ lus tha mal du gnas pa/ gnas nasaXphyung ba ma yin pa ste khyadaXpar lnga ldan no/ /dus ni/ dbyar snga ma yar ngo sngon 'gro'i dbyar zla 'bring bo'i nya'i phyi de nyin tshes bcu drug dang / mar ngo sngonaX'agro'i gro zhun zla lo la zla bshol med na zla ba bcu gnyis yod cing / zla ba re re'i yar ngo mar ngo la gso sbyor re re'o/ /gso sbyong bcu bzhi ba ni/ rgyal/ dbo/ sa ga chu stod/ khrums smad/smin drug noms kyi mar ngo la re re ste drug go /zhar byung dus tshigs la lngar dbye ba ni/ dgun gyi dus/ dpyid kyi dus/ dbyar gyi dus/ dbyar 248

thung ngu'i dus/ dbyar ring bo'i dus rnams so/ /gsum du dbye ba ni/dgun/ dpyid/ dbyar ro/ /bzhir dbye ba ni/ dgun/ dpyid/ dbyar/ston no/ /drug tu dbye ba ni/ dgun/ dgud smad/ dpyid/ sos ga dbyar/ston no/ /cho ga la/ bsnyen par ma rdzogs pa'i rab byung gi dbang du byas pa dang / bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i dbang du byas pa gnyis/ so sor thar ba'i mdo 'don tshul lnga ni/ gleng gzhi 'don pa/ pham par 'gyur ba 'don pa/ dge 'dun lhag ma 'don pa/ ma nges pa 'don pa/ ril gyis 'don pa'o/ /spang bya chos ma yin pas 'don pa ni/ 'don bya min pa/ tshad min pa/ dus min pa/ 'don par byedaXpa de kho na bzhin min pas 'don pa ste bzhi'o/ /phyi ma ni/ bsnyen rdzogs dang / lta ba dang / mtshan dang tshul khrims bzhi mi mthun pas 'don pa'o/ /mjug ni/ bsngo ba 'don pa/ tshigs suXbacad pa 'don pa/ dkar phyogs la dga' ba'i lha klu sogs kyi ming nas bos te yon bshad byed pa'o/ /dbyar gyi gzhi la dgos pa dgu ni dbyar khas ma blang ba'i nyes pa khegs pa/ srog chags la gnod pa sgongaXb/gzhan gyis 'phya ba sgong ba/ lul srog la gnod pa spong ba/ don dang bya ba nyung ba/ dgag dbye 'byung ba/ sraXbarkyang gding ba 'byung ba/ gnas ral ba dang grum pa 'chos pa/ thos bsam 'phel ba ste dgu'o/ /gnas ni/ bde ba'i rkyen gnas shing gnod rkyen med pa/ steng g.yogs dang bcas la gnas gcig yin pa/ dge slong gnas shing sgo glegs dngaXbacas pa/249

mtshams gzhan min pa ste bzhi'o/ /yul ni/ dge slong chos bdun ldan dang dge tshul gang rung ngo / /rten ni rab byung yin pa/ dbyar khas len pa'i mthun rkyen tshang ba/ shes pa rang bzhin du gnas pa/ lus tha mal du gnas pa/ gnas nas phyung ba ma yin pa ste khyad par lnga ldan no/ /dus ni/dbyar snga ma yar ngo sngon 'gro'i dbyar zla 'bring bo'i nya'i phyi de nyin tshes bcu drug dang / mar ngo sngonaX'agro'i gro zhun zla ba'i tshes gcig gi nyin khas len pa dang / dbyar phyi ma yar ngo sngon 'gro'i dbyar zla tha chung gi nya'i phyi de nyin tshes bcu drug dang / mar ngo sngon 'gro'i khrums stod zla ba'i tshes gcig la khas len pa'o/ /yun tshad ni zla ba gsum gsum mo/ /cho ga la sbyor ba ni/ gtsug lag khang byi dor bya ba/ gnas mal sta gon bya ba/ de stob pa'i dge slong bsko ba/ tshul shing nye bar bzhag pa/ khrims su bca' ba brjod pa/ tshul shing len pa'i gsol ba 'ba' zhig gi las bya ba/grangs bzung ba'i pyir tshul shingaX'abrims pa ste bdun no/ /dngos gzhi ni/yul gyi mdun du sngags tshigs lan gsum brjod pa'o/ /mjug thabs legs par bya ba'o/ dam tshig ni/ dbyaraXkhas blangs pa'i dam bca' bsgrub pa/ dbyar ral ba'i rgyu sgong ba/ gnas mal stob pa'i dam tshig rnams so/ /dgag dbye'i gzhi la/ yul ni phyogs bcu'i dge 'dun no/ /rten ni rab byung sde lnga'i sdom pa gso rung yan chad dang ldan pa/ shes pa rang bzhin du gnas pa/ yul tha mal du gnas pa/ gnas nas phyung ba 260

min pa/ dbyar khas blangs pa ste khyad par drug ldan no/ /go bar bya ba'i yul ni/ bsgos pa'i dge slong ngo / /dngos po gang gis dgag dbye bya ba ni/ltung ba'i dgag dbye rang gi bslab gzhi mtha' dag dang / rdzas kyi dgag dbye khab sogs gang yang rung ba'o/ /dus ni dbyar snga ma yin na ston zla 'bring bo'i nya dang / phyi ma yin na ston zla tha chung gi nya'o/ /cho ga la sbyor ba ni/ dgag dbye 'byung ba spyod yul gyi sbyin bdag la brjod pa dang /gtsug lag khang brgyan pa dang / tshes bcu bzhi'i mtshan thog thag tu chos bshad nyan byed pa/ tshes bco lnga'i las kyi sngon du kun dga' ra bar phyag dar sogs byed pa/ dgag dbye'i byed paXpo bsgo ba/ rtswa dur ba 'brims pa/ dgag dbye bya ba'i ched du gsol ba 'ba' zhig gi las bya ba ste bdun no/ /dngos gzhi ni lcang ba'i dgag dbye dang / rdzas kyi dgag dbye gnyis so/ /gnyis pa bde bar gnas pa'i rkyen bsten pa'i sgo nas srung tshul la/gos kyi gzhi/ sman gyi gzhi gnyis/ dang po la/ bag yangs dang 'brel ba'i sra brkyang gi gzhi/ 'tsho ba'i yo byad dang 'brel ba'i gos kyi gzhi/ dmigs bsal dang 'brel ba'i ko lpags kyi gzhi gsum las/ dang po sra brkyang la/gding ba'i dgos pa ni/ dge 'dun gnas gcig tu 'du ba/ lhung ba 'ga' zhig mi 'byung ba/ sbyin bdag gis bsod nams chen po 'thob pa ste gsum mo/ /gding ba'i gang zag ni/ bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa rnam dag dang ldan pa/ lta ba mthun pa/ mtshan mthun pa/ bye tshe chos min phyogs min 251

pa/ tha snyad gsum dang ldan pa/ sa gzhan na gnas nga1 min pa/ sa gzhan na gnas pa'i rgyu la gnas pa min pa ste thun mong gi chos bdun/ dbyar khas blangs pa/ ma ral ba/ dbyar lnga ma khas blangs pa/ gnas der khasaXblangs pa dang thun mong ma yin pa'i bzhi ste bcu gcig dang ldan pa'o/ /gding bar bya ba ni/ spang ba/ ma brtags pa/ bral 'phrad min pa ste rgyu'i rung ba gsum dang / bshadaXbardabs ma byas pa/ ya yor ma gyur pa/ ma lhag pa/ ma zag pa/ lhan can ma yin pa ste dbyibs kyi rung ba lnga/ rung ba'i tshon gyis kha bsgyur ba'i kha dog gi rung ba/ chos gos gaspum che tshad dam de las lhag pa'i tshad kyi rung ba ste rung ba bzhi dang ldan pa'i chos gos rnam gsum mo/ /gding ba'i cho ga la sbyor ba ni/ gang zag so so'i sbyor chog chos gos kyi byin gyis brlabs dbyung ba/ dge 'dun tshogs pa'i sbyoraXchog zhag ma lon par tshogs pas mos par bya ba/ mtshams nang du blo mthunaXbya ba/ gsol gnyis kyi las kyis gding ba po bsko ba/ gsol ba'i las kyis sra brkyang gi rgyu gtad pa ste bzhi/ bskos pa'i dge slong gisaXbasgrub pa'i sbyor chog la/ las gsum sgrub pa/ sems gsum bskyed pa/tshogs pa la brjod pa/ dge 'dun 'du ba'i skabs sgrub pa ste bzhi/ las gsum ni/ chos gos kyi rgyu bkru ba/ drub pa/ kha bsgyur ba'o/ /sems gsum ni/ gding bar 'gyur ro/ /gding ngo / /bting ngo snyam pa'o/ /dngos gzhi'i cho ga ni/ bskos pa'i dge slong gis gzeb kyi sgrog ma'i nang du chos 252

gos gsum brkyang ba thogs te byin gyis brlab pa'i sngags tshig lan gsum brjod pa'o/ /mjugaXchog ni/ btang zin par brjod pa'o/ /brkyang tshul ni/ dus dus su bsang ba/ bsrang ba/ sprug par byed pa'o/ /dbyung tshul la/ bcos ma'i dbyung ba/ rang rjes su 'jug bral gyi dbyung ba'o/ /phyi ma la dge 'dun mtha' dag dang / gang zag so so'i rang 'jug bral gyi dbyung ba gnyis/ dang po la/ sra brkyang mtshams gzhan du khyer ba/ bsrung mkhan med par skya rengs shar ba/ zla ba lnga 'das pa/ dus ma yin par shes nasaXgaso sbyong byas pa/ ngo bo zhing mid par gyur pa/ rten zhing min par gyur pa/ mtshams nang du dge 'dun gcig kyang med pa ste bdun no/ /gnyis pa la ma ma sum cu'i 'ijug bralaXgyi dbyung ba/ gang zag zhing ma yin par grur pa'i 'jug bral gyi dbyung ba ste gnyis/ ma ma sum cu ni/mtshams la re ba med pa'i ma ma brgyad/ mtshams la yid gnyis za ba'i ma ma brgyad/ mtshams la re ba yod pa'i ma ma brgyad/ rnyed pa la yid gnyis za ba'i ma ma drug rnams so/ /dngaXpo brgyad ni/ sbyor bas 'gro ba'i ma ma bzhi/ nges par 'byed pa'i ma ma bzhi ste brgyad/ 'di bzhi tshan re la/'brel med gcig dang / 'azel bcas gsum re'o/ /des brgyad tshan phyi ma gnyis la'ang rigs 'gre/ bzhi ba la mtshams dang rnyed pa gnyis kar yid gnyis za bas mtshams las 'das pa/ dang poXmed kyang mtshams kyi phyi rol du yid gnyis za ba gnyis te gsum dang / mtshams la re ba med cing 253

rnyed pa la re bas mtshams las 'das pa dang / mtshams kyi phyi rol du de skyes pa gnyisaXte gsum dang drug go /gnyis pa gos kyi gzhi la/ mi rung ba'i gzhi ni/ ma dras pa'i kha tshar phun tshar can/ rgyu dpag bsam shing las byung ba/ ra bal rnga bal las byas pa/ rung ba kha ma bsgyur ba/ mu stegs kyi cha lugs su gtogs pa'i skra'am g.yang gzhi sogs so/ /rung ba bdun ni/ bal las byas pa/ rtswa sha naXlas byas pa/ nyi 'og pa'i gos/ ras gos/ zar ma/ rtswa go'u te pa las byas pa/ rtswa du gu la las byas pa'o/ /mi rung ba'i tshon chen brgyad ni/ rgya skyegs/ leb rgan rtsi/btsod/ smag shing rtsi/ mthing shing / mtshal/ sirdu ra/ gur gum ste brgyad do/ /rung ba'i tshon gsum ni/ sngon po/ jitsag dur smrig go /'tsho ba'i yo byad bcu gsum ni/ snam sbyar bla gos/ mthang gos/ sham thabs/ sham thabs kyi gzan/ rngul gzan/ rngul gzan gyi gzad/ gdong phyis/ rnag gzan/ g.yan pa dgab pa/ skra bzed/ gding ba/ dbyar kyi gos ras chen no/ /chos gos gsum la tshad kyi sgo nas che 'bring chung gsum re'o/ /snam sbyar la/ snam phran dang / tshal bu'i sgo nas dbye na dgu ste/ chung ngu skor gsum ni/ snam phran dgu ba/ bcu gcig pa/ bcu gsum pa gsum ste/snam phran re re la yang glegs bu phyed dang gsum re'o/ /'bring gsum ni/snam phran bco lnga ba/ bcu bdun pa/ bcu dgu ba gsum ste snam phran re re la'ang glegs du byed dang bzhi re'o/ /chen po gsum ni/ snam phran nyer 254

gcig pa/ nyer gsum pa/ nyer lnga ba gang ste snam phran re re la'angaXglegs du byed dang lnga re'o/ /bla gos gsum ka snam phran bdun pa dang /snam phran re re la'ang glegs bu phyed dang gsum re'o/ /mthang gos gsum ka snam phran lnga ba dang / snam phran re re la'ang glegs du phyed dang gnyis re'o/ /chos gos gsum dras drub tu byed pa dang / lhan thabs su byed pa gnyis/ mthang gos kyis lus mi yogs na ral kha dpung bcad 'thud par bya'o/ /dge slong ma'i chos gos smad lnga ni/ chos gos gsumaXgyi steng du shing nga dpung bcad dang rngul gzan bsnan pa'o/ /'tsho ba'i yo byad phran tshegasaXni/ zhwa/ ske rags/ lhang bzed kyi shubs/ lham sgrog ram phyis/ phor phyis/ gtur bu rnams so/ /lhag pa'i yo byad ni/ 'tsho ba'i yo byad kyi rdzas lhag pa'o/ /mkho ba'i yo byad ras yug dar yug ring 'gag bem po sogs so/ /phran tshegs ni/ ras kha byed dang / dar kha byedaXl sogs pa'o/ /chos gos rnams 'jal byed kyi khru la/ lus khru/ lag khru/ rngul khru gsum du bshad do/ /byin gyis brlab tshul la/ dngos kyi byin brlab dang /rgyu'i byin brlab gnyis dang / lhag pa'i yo byad la rnam brtags kyi byin brlab byed par bshad do/ /gsum pa ko lpags kyi gzhi la/ sa tshigs kyis bye ba'i yul dbus dang / chos tshigs kyis bye ba'i yul dadus gnyis/ snga ma la dmigs bsal ma gtogs pa mchil lham bkag cing / mtha' 'khob 265

tu mchil lham rim pa gcig pa dang / ko lpags kyi yu ba byas pa'i yu ring dang / mchil lham rim pa mang bo can/ yu ring sgro gu can dang / yu chad sogs gnang ngo / /mchil lham la kha chu chus byung zhes kyang zer ro/ / des ko lpags kyi stan dang / mig nad can la dom lpags bcang bar gnang ba sogs shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa sman gyi gzhi la/ sman rnam pa bzhi ni/dus rung gi sman/ thun tshod du rung ba'i sman/ zhag bdun pa'i sman/ ji srid 'tsho bcang gi sman no/ /yang na dus rung gi sman dang / dus min du rung ba'i sman gnyis so/ /thun tshod du rung ba'i sman la/ dus rung gi sman gyi rgyu las byung ba/ zhag bdun pa'i sman las byung ba/ ji srid 'tsho bcang gi sman las byung ba ste gsum mo/ /ji srid 'tsho bcang gi sman la 'jig rten na sman du grags pa'i rtsa ba/ sdong bu/ 'dab ma/ me tog 'bras bu'i smanaXte lnga'o/ /zhar byung rung khang gcod tshul ni/ rung khang gcod pa'i gnas ma yin pa ni/ shing drung / glang po che'i rwa ba/ nu stegs can gyi 'dug gnas/rgyal po'i pho brang dge slong ma'i dbyar khang / gtsug lag khang gi bang rim/sgo khang / khyams/ bsro khang / dpong sa'i rwa ba ste bcu'o/ /rung khang la/ ba glang lhas lta bu'i rung khang / rdo bteg pa'i mtha' las byung ba'i rung khangaX/sems bsdus pa'i mtha' las byung ba'i rung khang / las kyi mtha' las byung ba'i rung khang / 'phral gyi rung khang ste lnga'o/ /rgyu mthun zag pa 'dor 266

tshul gyi skor rnams ni go sla'o/ /gsum pa thams cad la mkho ba las kyi gzhi la/ cho ga'i khyad par ni/ blo mthun gyi gzhi dge 'dun/ brjod par byed pa'i las mkhan/ gang la bsgrub pa'i bsgrub bya ste/ las 'chags pa'i gzhi'i yan lag gsum/ bsam pa'iXyan lag las de rung ba'i mtshanaXnyid du 'du shes pa dang / sems can la byed tshe sgrub byas kyang las de byas so snyam du 'du shes pa ste gnyis so/ /las byed pa'i ngo bo'i yan lag la/ brjod pa tshang ba/ brjod pa ma nor ba/ brjod pa ma 'khrugs pa ste gsum/ brjod pa tshang ba ni/ gsol ba 'ba' zhig pa'i las la gsol ba tshang ba/ gsol gnyis kyi las la gsol ba gcig dang brjod pa gcig tshang ba/ gsol bzhi'i las la gsol ba gcig dang brjod pa gsum tshang ba ste gsum mo/ /brjod pa ma nor ba la/go rim ma nor ba/rigs ma nor ba/ ma bu ma nor ba ste gsum/ brjod pa ma 'khrugs pa la/ spyod lam ma 'khrugs pa/ las kyi go rim ma 'khrugs pa/ tshig ma 'khrugs pa ste gsum mo/ /las thos pa nyams su sbong ba'i yan lag la/ gang zag gang gis nyams su myong ba/ tshad ci tsam du nyams su stsong ba/ shes pa gang gis nyams su sbong ba ste gsum mo/ /las kyi dbye ba la/ las brgya rtsa gcig ste/ gsang ston bsgo ba'i las/ dge 'dun gyi nang du bar chad dri bar gsol ba'i las/ gso sbyong gi tshe so thar gyi mdo 'don par gsol ba'i las/ de'i tshe dge 'dun gyi ltungaXb thun mong ba/ ltung ba 267

yid gnyis can/ ltung ba'i phyir rtsod pa/ ltung bar nges kyang gang yin maXnges pa ste bzhi la byin gyis brlab par gsol ba'i las bzhi/ dgag dbye'i las/ de'i dus kyi ltung ba bzhi'i bzhi/ dbyar khas len dang tshul shing brims par gsol ba'i las/ shi ba'i rdzas dang de'i nor 'dra ba byen gyis brlab par gsol ba'i las/ sra brkyang gtad pa dang rasaXyug chen sbyin pa'i las/ sdig lta can gyi gnas nganaXlen brjod pa po bsgo ba'i las/zhal ta bar bshes ngor 'phya ba/ zur gyis 'phya ba/ bsgo ba rnar gzon pa/cang mi smra bas rnar gzon pa la ngan pa'i grangs su gzhug pa'i las bzhi/khyim pa dbul po'i zas mi len par bslab pa ster ba'i las/ de bshig pa'i las/ lhung bzed kha spub pa'i las/ de'i kha bsgang ba'i las te gsol ba 'ba' zhig pa'i las nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ gso sbyong gi gnas la blo mthun byas pa'i las/ mtshams che chung gcod pa'i las/ mtshams po che'i nang du chos gos dang mi 'bral bar gnang ba'i las/ smyos pa'i gnang ba sbyin pa'i las/ dgag dbye byed pa bsko ba'i las/ gnas mal stob pa bsko ba'i las/ rung khang byin brlab kyi las/ dgag dbye byed paXbasko ba'i las/gnas mal stob pa bsko ba'i las/ rung khang byin brlab kyi las/ sra brkyang la blo mthun byas pa'i las/ sra brkyang gding ba po bsko ba'i las/ spong ba po'i zhal ta pa bsko ba'i las/ lag gi bla bsko ba'i las/ gnas khang bsko ba'i las/ zas la bsko ba'i las/ thug pa la bsko ba'i las/ bag chol 268

'brim par bya ba'i las/ phran tshegs 'brim pa'i las/ snod spyad 'drubs pa'i las/ gos 'gyed pa'i las/ dbyar gyi ras chen sped pa'i las/dbyar gyi ras chen 'gyed pa'i las/ mngag gzhug bsko ba'i las/ mjos 'chos bsko ba'i las/ rtsod pa 'dum po gzu bo bsko ba'i las/ gsal ba bsko ba'i las/ rtsod pa sbed pa po bsko ba'i las/ rtsod pa shes slad tshul shing 'brim pa bsko ba'i las/ khang ba'i gzhi rung ba bstan pa'i las/ khang ched gyi gzhi rung baXbastan pa'i las/ khyim pa sun 'byid pa la chos min pa mang bo gleng ba bsko ba'i las/ rgan po dang nang ba la chos gos dang mi 'bral bar gnang ba sbyin pa'i las/ lag gi bla la lo drug gi nang du stan gnyis pa byed pa'i gnang ba sbyin pa'i las/ 'brel med lhung bzed 'brim pa po bsko ba'i las/ sdig lta can khyim so sor go b.raXbyed pa po bsko ba'i las/ dge slong ma'i ston pa bsko ba'i las/ nags nyul ba bsko ba'i las/gnas nas phyung ba'i dge slong la dge slong mas phyag mi bya bar sdom pa sbyin pa'i las/ lo bcu gnyis lon cing 'khor skyong nus pa'i dge slong ma la 'khor 'jog pa'i gnang ba sbyin pa'i las/ 'khor mang bo 'jog pa'i gnang ba sbyin pa'i las/ rgan po dang nad pa la 'khor ba'i gnang ba sbyin pa'i las/ dra ba'i gnang ba sbyin pa'i las/ gso sbyong tha dad pa'i gtsug lag khang gi rnyed pa gcig tu bya ba'i las/ dge slob ma'i sdom pa sbyin pa'i las/ tshangs spyod nyer gnas kyi sdom pa sbyin pa'i las/ dge slob ma bu dang 269

lhan cig nyal ba'i gnang ba sbyin pa'i las/ myuXge'i tshe dge slong ma nye du'i khyim du 'gro ba'i gnang ba sbyin pa'i las/ dbyar mtshams kyi phyi rol du 'gro ba'i gnang ba sbyin pa'i las te gsol gnyis kyi las bzhi bcu zhe ༷ bdun no/ /bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i las/ mu stegs la gnas pa sbyin pa'i las/ mtshams che chung dgrol ba'i las/ phan tshun mthun pa sbyin pa'i las/mthun pa'i gso sbyong sbyin pa'i las/ nan tur bya ba'i las/ nan tur la bzod pa gsol ba'i las/ spo ba dang mgu ba'i las drug dbyung ba'i las/sra brkyang dbyung ba'i las/ dran pa'i 'dul ba sbyin pa'i las/ smyos pa'i 'dul ba sbyin pa'i las/ ngo bo nyid 'tshol du gzhug pa'i las/ dge 'dunaXdabyen/ de rjes phyogs/ khyim sun 'byin/ bka' blo mi bde ba/ sdig lta mi gtong ba/ gnas nasaXphyung ba'i rjes su phyogs pa'i dge slong ma/ dkon mchog gtong ba'i dge slong ma/ 'thab krol byed pa/ bde zhing gnas pa/bde zhing gnas su 'jug pa ste bcu la bzlog pa bsgo gyur byed pa'i las bcu/ sdig lta mi gtong ba'i dge tshul bsnyil ba'i las/ nyamasaXpa la bslab pa sbyin pa'i las te gsol ba dang bzhi'i las sum cu rnams bsdoms pas brgya rtsa gcig go /gzhan yang dge 'dun dbyen spang ba dang / gang zagaXrlabs po che bstan pa la 'jug pa'i don du bag yangs kyi las bya ba dang /bstan pa 'phel bar byed pa'i don du bag yangs kyi las bya baXdang /mdo sdud pa po bsko ba'i las sogs gsol baXdang bzhi'i las du ma dang /260

chos gos byin brlab/ gso sbyong byin brlab/ sman byin brlab sogs mang du yod do/ /bzhi ba phyir bcos kyi gzhi la/ lhung ba phyir bcos/ rtsod pa phyir bcos gnyis/ dang po la bzhi las/ phyir bcos kyi gzhi dngos ni/ nan tur la dbye na bco lnga ste/ bsdigs pa nan tur/ smad pa nan tur/ bskrad pa nan tur/ phyir 'gyed nan tur bzhi dang / ma mthong ba gnas nas dbyung ba'i nan tur/ phyir mi 'chos pa gnas nas dbyung ba'i nan tur/sdigaXlha mi gtong ba gnas nas dbyung ba'i nan tur/ 'thab krol la 'bad pa gdas nas dbyung ba'i nanaXtur/ rnam par gtan la 'bebs pa las gyur pa nye bar ma zhi ba gdas nas dbyung ba'i nad tur/ 'thab krol gyi rgyu nye bar bsgrub pa gnas nas dbyung ba'i nan tur/ dge slong maXdang 'dre zhing gnas pa gnas nas dbyung ba'i nan tur te gnas dbyung bdun/ gso sbyong bzhag pa'i nan tur/ dgag dbye bzhag pa'i dan tur/dge tshul snyel ba'i nan tur/ khyim pa la lhung bzed kha spub pa'i nan tur te bsdoms pas bco lnga/ bsdu na smad pa nan tur/ bskrad pa nan tur/rnam par bzhag pa'i nan tur te gsum mo/ /nan tur 'grol ba'i rgyu ni/bzod pa gsol ba/ bden pa mthong ba/ dgra bcom thob pa ste thun mong gi rgyu gsum/ phyir bcos la/ mthol ba'i tshul/ bshags pa'i tshul gnyis/bshags pa la dge slong mid pa'i bshags tshul/ dge slong gi bshags tshul 261

gnyis/ dge slong gi bshags tshul la/ bshags pa tsam dang / zhagaXgi chad las kyi sgo nas bshags tshul gnyis/ ltung ba dag par byed pa'i rgyu gsum ni/ ming rigs kyi sgo nas phyir bcos pa/ dgra bcom thob pa/ stong nyid zab mo sgom pa'o/ /yang na de'i steng du mtshan 'gyur ba/ 'phags pa'i bded pa mngon du byas pa/ rnam thar sgo gsum rtogs pa/ stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgoXnas bshags pa/ theg chen ltar na byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa rnams kyang yin no/ /gnyis pa dus dang dus ma yin pa bsdu ba 'byung ba'i gzhi la/ bcabs nyes 'byung ba'i rten/ bsam pa/ sbyor ba/ mthar thug rnams dang / 'chab sems dang 'chab pa'i lhung ba gnyis kyi khyad par rnams te go sla'o/ /gsum pa sa gzhan na gnas pa'i gzhi la che long rags rim gyi dbye ba ni/ spo spyod gsum/ spo ldan gsum/ mgu spyod gsum/ mgu ldan gsum te bcu gnyis dang / bsdigs pa/ smadaXpa/ bskrad pa/ phyir 'gyed bzhi/ gnas dbyung bdun/ dge tshul bsnyil ba/ ngo bo nyid 'tshol ba/ bslab pa byin pa ste nyer drug zhib mo rnam dag gi sgo nas dbye na/ spo ba spyod pa/ gzhi nas sbo ba spyod pa/ yang gzhi nas bslang ste spo ba spyod pa gsum/ mgu ba spyod pa/ gzhi nas mgu ba spyod pa/ yang gzhi nas bslang ste mgu ba spyod pa gsum/ spo ba spyad nas mgu ba spyod pa gsum/ gzhi nas spo ba spyod nas nu4gu ba spyod pa gsum/ yang gzhi nas bslang ste sgo ba spyad nas mgu ba spyod pa gsum/ yang de lta bu'i spo ldan gsum mgu ldan gsum/262

bsdigs sogs bzhi/ gnas dbyungaXbadun/ bsnyil ba/ nan tur/ ngo bo nyid 'tshol ba/ bsgab pa byin pa ste bzhi bcu zhe bzhi'o/ /bsdu na ngo bo'i sgo das shasum ste/ spang ba sa gzhan/ smad pa sa gzhan/ rnam par dag pa sa gzhan no/ /rnam grangs kyi sgo nas gnyis te/ sa gzhan na gnas pa la nan tur byas pa dang ma byas pa'o/ /bslab bya'i sgo das gnyisaXte/ sa gzhan na gnas pa chen po dang chung ngu'o/ /chen po rnams kyis khyad par cad gyi spyod pa lnga spang ba dang / dman pa'i spyod pa lnga dang du len dgos/ chung ngu rnams kyis khyad par can gyi spyod pa lnga sgong dgos kyang / dman pa'i spyod pa lnga dngaXdu len mi dgos so/ /khyad par can gyi spyod pa lnga ni/ gus pa'i las bdag gir byed pa dang / sa rang bzhin du gnas pa dang mnyam pa'am lhag par 'gro ba/ bla ma'i gnas byed pa/ dge slong la lhang ba gleng dran sogs chad las su gtogs pa'i las byed pa/ sa rang bzhin pa dang mnyam 'grogs byed pa ste lnga'o/ /dman pa'i spyod paXlnga ni/ nangs par gyi dus su sgo 'byed pa sogs byed pa/ chos ston sogs kyi dus su bdug spos dang pogaXphor sogs 'jog pa/ dge 'dun 'du ba'i dus su spyi dungasaXbasham pa na gni brdung ba sogs byed pa/ gral gyi dus su bsnyen par rdzogs pa thams cad kyi mthar 'dug pa/ dgongs kha'i dus su dge slong rnams kyi rkang ba la snum 263

byug pa ste lnga'o/ /sgo mgu dbyung gsum gyi dbyung ba ni/ nyes pa las dbyung ba yin pas gnas dbyung dang don mi gcig go /sa gzhan na gnas pa las grol ba ni/ dgra bcom pa thob pas sa gzhan na gnas pa thams cad las grol/ bzod pa byas pas nan tur las grol/ spo mgu 'khor bas spo spyod mgu spyod las grol/ mgu ba sbyin pas sgo ldan las grol/ dbyung baXsbyin pas mgu ldan las grol/ rtsang ba dran cing bzod par byas pas ngo bo nyid tshol ba las grol/ gnas dbyung ma gtogs pa la nan turaXphyi ma byas pas nan tur snga ma las grol ba ste bdun no/ /bzhi ba yongs su sbyong ba'i gzhi la/ lhang ba gleng dran bya tshul sogs te ming gi rnam grangs ni phal cher snga ma rnams su 'du'o/ /dge 'dun dbyen dang 'khor lo'i dbyen gyi skor rnams mngon pa'i skabs dang 'dra'o/ /gnyis pa rtsod pa phyir bcos la/ rtsod pa'i rgyu bzhi ni/ de bzhin nyid la log par bsgrub pa/ gdams ngag sgong ba/ ltung ba dang bcas pa/las la mthun pa mi sbyin pa'o/ /rtsod pa'i rgyuraX'agro tshulaXbazhi ni/ 'gyed phyir rtsod pa/ mi gdams pa'i phyir rtsod pa/ ltung ba'i phyir rtsod pa/ lasaXkyi phyir rtsod pa'o/ rtsod pa zhi byed bdun ni/ zhi byed mngon sum/ zhi byed dran pa/ zhi byed ma smyos pa/ zhi byed gang mang / zhi byed ngo bo nyid/ zhi byed rtsa bkram pa/ zhi byed khas blang ba'o/ /mngon sum la brgyad de/ rgol phyi rgolaXgyi mngon spum/ gzu bo'i mngon sum/ dge 'dun gzhi bo'i mngon 264

sum/ gsal ba'i mngon sum/ gsal bas gsal ba'i mngon sum/ gdas brtan dang bcas pa'i dge 'dun gzhan gyi mngon sum/ sde snod 'dzin pa'i mngon sum/ gnas brtan mthu dang ldan pa'i ma ngon sum mo/ /gang mang gi skabs su tshul shing mi lenaXpa lnga ni/ chos min gyi tshul shing mi len pa/ the tshom byung na ma dris par mi len pa/ dge 'dun dbyen du 'gyur ba'i bsam pas mi len pa/ rtsod pa chos min phyogs su zhi ba'i bsam pas mi len pa/ de gnyis ka'i sgo nas mi len pa ste lnga'o/ /len pa drug ni/ de lnga las log pa dang / grangs mnyam na nyan thos chen po ko'u di zu'i tshul shing gcig lenaXpa dang drug go /lnga ba de thamasaXcad kyi rten gnas mal gyi gzhi la/ phyag 'os kyi khyad par ni/ khyim pa'i phyag yul rab byung sde lnga dang / rab byung gzhan gyi phyag yul dge slong dang / dge slong gi phyagaXyul rang lasaXbaslab pa rgan pa dang / thams cad kyi spyi'i phyag yul sangs rgyas so/ /phyagaXbya mi rung ba ni/ sa gzhan na gnas pa/ nyams pa/ dge slong ma sun phyung ba/ chos ma yin pa'i phyogs dang mthun pa/ thaXdad par gnas pa/ mtshams med pa byas pa/ nyal ba/ snyoms par zhugs pa/ brel ba/sems gzhan du g.yeng ba/ rgyab kyis phyogs pa/ khyim gzhan na 'dug pa/zas kyi gral na 'dug pa/ sbags pa rnam pa gnyis/ gcer bu/ gos gcig pa ste bcu bdun no/ /phyag ni gnyis te/ yan lag lnga phyag dang / sgyid pa la 'khyud pas phyag 'tshal ba'o/ /gnyis pa gtsug lag khang gi khyad par la/266

gnas kyi khyod par ni/ skye bo mang po'i 'gro 'ong gi gnas dang / dben pa'i gnas te gnyis so/ /dben pa ni/ rgyun lugs dngaX/ glag cor dang /sgra dang / tug rid de bzhis dben pa'o/ /sgrub tshul la/ zhig gsos dang /sngar med gsar bsgrub kyi tshul gnyis/ phyi ma la 'og gzhir so phag gi gcal bdun brtsegs sam brgyad brtsegs bya ba/ de'i steng du phyogs so sor ka stan/ de'i steng du ka ba'i tshar/ bre gdan/ bre gzhu/ gdung stan/gdungaX/ gdung khebs/ mchod brtsegs khebs ma/ par mchod rnams brtsegasaXshing / de'i steng du kadung mig mang ris dngaX/ khyams tshar la phyogs so sor gdung rgyug pa dang / de'i steng du lcam/ lcam khab dang /de'i steng du shing leb bam gral ma/ de'i steng du so phag 'grems pa/ rdza 'dag gis mtshams sbyar ba/ steng du zhal zhal byed pa/ dbus su rgya mthongs dang / de'iXsteng dbus su kardzi ra/ phyogs gnyis su khyung mgo bya 'dabs suXdra ba dra phyed kyis brgyan pa ste spyi'i rnam bzhag go /de'i phugs su dri gtsang khang dang / yang sgo dang rta babs kyi bsgrub tshul/ gzhan yang rab gsal lnga brtsegs bdun brtsegs bya ba sogs mang du yod do/ /ri mo'i khyad par ni gtsug lag khang giXkhyams suXston pa'i skyes rabs dang /dpong sa'i khang bar sha ri'i bu sogs bri ba/ dri gtsang khang gi sgor gnod sbyin 'phreng thogs/ mdzod kyi sgore gnod sbyin lag na myu gu thogs pa/ zas kyi khang bar lag na bca' ba thogs pa/ bsro khang du lag na myu gu dang 266

dum pa thogs pa/ me'i khang bar grul bum me sbar bar byed pa sogs dang /chu'i khang bar klu'i bu moXlag na bum pa thogs pa sogs/ nad pa'i rung ba'i khang bar de bzhin gshegs pa nad pa'i rim gro mdzad pa dang /bshang gci'i skyabs su dur khrod dang mgo thod sogs dang / sgo khang gi khor yug tu cho 'phrul chen po dang / bdud bcom pa sogs bri baXdang /sgor mi rtag pa'i srin po'i gzugs kyi lto bar 'khor ba'i 'khor lo cha lnga ba bri ba dang / steng du de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs/ 'og tu brtsam par bya zhing dbyung bar bya zhes sogs bri ba dang / gzhan yang gtsug lag khang gi phyogs phyogs su rgyal mtshan rnam pa bzhi dang / ba dan dang / rol mo'i cha byad snaXtshogs pa dang / mchod pa'iXyo byad du mas brgyan par bya ba'o/ /'dul ba'i gzhung las byung ba'i ming gi rnam grangs che long tsam mdor bsdus pa'o//lnga ba grub maza' spyi'i gzhung bsgyur ba la mkho ba'i ming gi rnam grangs ni/ spyir grub mtha' ni/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum mam lta sgom spyod gsumaXgyi rnam bzhag la rigs pas dpyad nas rang gi blo ngor 'dir nges so snyam du thag bcad pa'i mthar thug pa'i cha zhig la zer zhing / de ston pa'i brjod byed kyi tshig la'ang grub mtha' zhes btags pa yang yod do/ /grub mtha' smra ba la dbye na/ phyi rol pa dang / nangaXpa'i grub mtha' smra ba gnyis las/ dang po la gzhan ste/ phyi rol pa/ mu stegs byed/ chos 'di 267

pa ma yin pa rnams don gcig de la lta ba'i sgo nas dbye na/ lta ba'i rtsaXb ni brgya rtsa bcu ste/ sangs rgyas pa/ 'dzin pa med pa/ 'tshe ba ba lo ma can/ gtsang spra can/ khyab 'jug pa/ khyab 'jug sems pa ba/ dbyug gu gsum pa/ ko lpags dum bu can/ mnyam par spyod pa/ lha mchog pa/ chos kyi mchog sbyin can/ gdung ba can/ lag pa gdung ba can/ rgyal por smra ba/ rgan por smra ba/ me yo u da ri/ rigs dngaXrjes su mthun pa/ bcings nasaX'adug pa/ 'khor lo skyong ba/ ri la gnas pa/ rgyal po'i bsod snyoms can/ glang po che'i rgyal mtshan can/ klog can/ nang can/ rta 'dul ba/ ka lan da ka pa/ snod gtsang ma can/ slong mos rgyu ba/ yan lag ral ba'i nang du bstums pa/ sgron ma lhag pa can/ gser can/ grub par smra ba/dbang bo chen po/ zha nye can/ byang phyogs kyi 'gram na gnas pa/ lho phyogs kyi 'gram na gnas pa/ 'ug pa ba/ dge sbyong ba/ lus la gnod pa med pa/ka kan rnya pa/ lha'i grong ba/ sa khung na gnas pa/ chos sems pa ba/ zla ba phyed pa/ nags na gnas pa/ bai shi ṣa ka tshangs par spyod pa/ go ta ma ba/pha la gus pa ba/ ma la gus pa ba/ zla ba shar ba ba/ nyi ma shar ba ba/ lag par za ba/ snying gis 'tsho ba/ phung po gsum pa ba/ shin tu khrus byas pa/ba ra'i spyod pa can/ 'thor byed pa/ 'khor ba las grol ba/ pa tai dza la ba/lha mchod pa/ gzhan la mi 'dud pa/ gos kyi dum bu can/ 'ug pa'i gshog pa can/ lan gsum duXchur 'jug pa/ mkha' ldingaXb/ khyim gyi ra ba 268

na gnas pa/ ba lang dang / ri dwags dang /rta dang / khyi dang / gsol ba mi 'gebs pa'i brtul zhugs pa/ me'i brtul zhugs pa/ gzhonaXnu'i brtul zhugs pa/ zhib mo'i brtul zhugs can/ mthong ba'i chos la zu ngan las 'da' bar smra ba/ chu las skyes pa'iXphreng ba can/ bzang po'i brtul zhugs can/ rdo 'thag pa ba/ chus dag par lta ba/ skyes nas dag par lta ba/ las kyis dag par lta ba/ chu la byi 'dzul byed pa/ dgon pa ba/ sa/ chu/ me/rlung / dam mkha' la sems yod par lta ba/ nam mkha' 'byung ba/ shing rta mang po can/ bsam gtan la dga' ba/ chos can pa/ zas grang mo can/phrag pa'i gos can/ don thams cad pa/ phru ba gcig pa/ grangs can gyi rnal 'byor pa/ so'i gtun rdudzas can/ mtshe'u'i 'gram na gnas pa/ bha ra dh+wa dza pa/gcer bu ba/ gnyenaXgyi bu ba/ mes po ba/ phyug bdag pa/ dung sgra can/ lha rten sbyin ma'i bu/ ka r+ya'i bu ba/ sna tshogs lta ba ste brgya dang bcu'o/ /lta ba 'di rnams 'dren tshul mi 'dra ba mang bo yod kyang rtog ge ༷ ༷'bar ba dang / legs ldan chung ba'i dbu ma rin chen sgron ma gung bsgrigs nas bris pa'o/ /gzhan yang ya mtshan can gyi lta ba dgu bcu go drug sogs mang du yod kyang dbu ma dang mngon pa'i skabs kyi lta ba ngan pa'i ming gi rnam grangs bshad zin pa rnams su phal cher 'du'o/ /phyi rol pa'i grub mtha' la dbye na/ chad smra gcig dang / rtag smra bcu 269

gcig ste bsdoms pas bcu gnyis so/ /dang po chad smra la/ ston pa ni/ lha yi bla ma'am/ phur du pa/ drang srong 'jig rten mig drang srong 'jug stobs/ lu ba can/ rta mchog rnams so/ /ming gi rnam grangs ni/ tshu rol mdzes pa ba/ chad smra ba/ med smra ba/ lha yi bla ma ba/ phur bu ba/ rgyang 'phen pa/ ngo bo nyid spra ba/ rang bzhinaXsmra ba rnams so/ /dbye ba ni/ rtog ge pa/stoms 'jug pa gnyis/ sgras brjod kyis dbye na/ chad lha'i dbang du byas pa/ gsang tshig gi dbang du byas pa/ rnam rtog gi dbang du byas pa gsum mo/ /'dis ni skye ba snga phyi dang / kun macan dang / rgyu 'bras sogs med par 'dod do/ /gnyis pa rtag smra la bcu gcig las/ dang po grangs can pa la ston pa ni/ drang srong ser skya/ drang srong mchod 'os/ ston pa chu klung sogs so/ /ming gi rnam grangs ni/ grangs can pa/ rang bzhin rgyur smra ba/ gtso bo ba/ ser skya pa sogs so/ /'ga' zhig tu ser skya ba dang grangs can pa gnyis tha dad du bshad pa'ang yod do/ /dbye na gsal byed pa dang / lha med pa dang / lha bcas pa sogs yod par bshad do/ /'dis shes bya thams cad bem rig gnyis su 'dod do/ /bdag ni/ shes pa'i ngo bo dang /miXskye ba'i chos can dang / rtag pa dang / za ba bo dang / khyab paXdang /yon tan ma yin pa dang / byed pa med pa dang / gcig pu dang / mtha' med pa'i mtshan nyid can du 'dod cing / bdag gi dbye ba la spyi'i blor 270

gnas pa dang mi gnas pa gnyis/ bdag gi ming gi rnam grangs la/ myong ba bo/ shes rig skyes bu/ zab po/ sems pa can zhes zer ro/ /shes bya nyer lnga ni rtsa ba'i rang bzhin dang / chen po/ nga rgyal/ dbang po bcu gcig de tsam lnga/ 'byung ba lnga/ skyes bu dang nyer lnga'o/ /rang bzhin dang / gnas lugs/ gtso bo/ don dam bden pa rnams ming gi rnam grangs so/ /chen po ni blo'o/ /nga rgyal ni gsum ste/ rnam par 'byur ba can/ snying stobs can/ nun pa can no/ /dbang bo bcu gcig la/ las kyiXdabang bo lnga ni/ ngag lag pa/ rkang ba/ rkub/ 'doms kyi dbang bo'o/ /blo'i dbang bo lnga ni/ mig rna ba/ sna/ lce/ pags pa'i dbang bo'o/ /gnyi ka'i bdag nyid can ni yid kyi dbang bo'o/ /de tsam lnga ni gzugs sogs lnga'o/ /'byung ba lnga ni sa sogs lnga'o/ /shes bya nyer lnga bo de dag kyang nu bzhi ste/ rang bzhin kho na yin pa/ rang bzhin dang rnam 'grur gnyi ka yin pa/ rnam 'grur kho na yin pa/ gnyi ka ma yin pa'o/ /rtsa ba'i rang bzhin gyi yon tan gsum ni/ rdul/ mun pa/ snying stobs so/ /mtshan nyid lnga bcu ni/ chu/ chu rgyun/ chu bo/ char 'bab/ legs brgal/ mig bzang /'od can/ 'tshe mthong / thar dga'/ lus mchog ste mgu ba dgu/ grol ba/legs grol/ mthar phyin/ dga' ba/ rab dga'/ bla ma mgu bar 'gyur ba/ nyams dga'/ rtag dga' ste grub pa brgyad/ dbang bo bcu gcig la gnod pa'i nus pa bcu gcig dang / mgu ba dgu'i mi mthun phyogs dgu 271

dang / grub pa brgyad kyi mi mthun phyogs brgyad de nus pa nyer brgyad/gzhan min la gzhanaXdu rlom pa/ legs min la legs par bsgrub pa/ bde min la bde bar nga rgyal ba/ mi nus pa la nus par sems pa/ mi bzod pa la bzod par yid ches pa ste phyin ci log lnga bsdoms pas lnga bcu'o/ /gnyis pa tshangs pa ba la/ ston pa ni/ tshangs pa dang / de'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i drang srong rnams so/ /ming gi rnam grangs ni/ bram ze ba/ rig byed pa/ tshangs pa ba sogs so/ /'dis tshangs pas 'jig rten thams cad sprul bar 'dod pa dang / mes po'i gdong bzhi las rig byed bzhi dang /lus kyi cha shas bzhi las mi rigs bzhi skyes pa dang / yang rig byed niXrang byung nam mkha' lta bu dang / rig byed kyi gzhung las bshad pa'i sbyin sreg dang / rta'i mchod sbyin bsang mchod sogs grol lam du 'dod do/ /gsum pa brda sprod pa la ston pa ni sngar dang 'dra/ ming gi rnam grangs ni/brda' sprod pa/ sgra byedaXpa/ lung ston pa sogs so/ /'dis dngos po thams cad sgra'i tshangs pa oṃ yig las skyes par 'dod la/ phyugs kyi mchod sbyin sogs dang / me lngas gdung ba/ khams 'dzag pa'i sbyin sreg sogs grol lam du 'dod do/ /bzhi ba rig byed mtha' ba la/ ston pa ni sngar dang 'dra/ ming gi rnam grangs la/ rig byed mthar smra ba/ bram ze mchog smra ba rnams so/ /dbye ba la khyab pa'i bdag dang / phra ba'i bdag khas len pa gnyis so/ /lam gyi khyad par phal cher sngar dang 'dra/ lnga ba gsang ba ba la 272

ston pa sngaraXdang 'dra/ ming gi rnam grangs rig byed gsang ba ba/ gnyis med lta ba ba/ rnam shes tshangs smra ba rnams so/ /'dis lung bdudaXrtsi thigs pa la brten nas shes rig rtag bdag cha med bden grub tu 'dod do1 /drug pa khyab 'jug pa la ston pa ni/ nor lha/ sred med kyi bu sogs ming mang bo yod pa'i khyab 'jug dang / bla ma zla ba/ ston pa gzhon nu ma len rnams so/ /ming gi rnam grangs ni/ khyab 'jug pa/ zla ba ba/ glu'i chos smra ba rnams so/ /khyab 'jug gi 'jug pa bcu ni/ nya/ rus sbal/ phag rgod/mi yi seng ge mi'u thung / shing rta bcu ba'i bu ra ma ṇa/ dza mā da asdi'i bu ra ma ṇa/ nag pa/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa/ rigs ldan karki rtse ste bcu'o/ /phyi ma la ka pa li can zhes kyang zer ro/ /'di snod bcud kyi byed pa po/rtag pa cha med kyi bdag dus rtag dngos/ 'byung ba'i rang bzhin/ snying stobs sogs yon tan dngos mnyam pas stong ba/ bskyed bya skyed byed kyi rten 'brel sogs khas len la/ lam ni oṃ yigaXbasgom pa dang / 'pho ba rlung sogs rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa bsgom pas khyab 'jug gi dngos grub ster bar 'dod la/ 'khor ba yang mtha' can du 'dod do/ /bdun pa rgyal dpog pa la ston pa ni/ drang srong khyab 'jug pa dang /drang srong rgyal dpog pa sogs so/ /mingaXgi rnam grangs ni/ dpyod pa ba/rgyal dpog pa rnams so/ /'dis rig byed tshad mar 'dod cing dri ma sems kyi rang bzhin du smra'o/ /zam zer byed pa'i chos bya ba'iXshugs bzhi 273

bcu zhe brgyad dang / byol song bcing ba/ mar la sogs pas mchod sbyin bya ba/ chung ma dang 'brel ba'i las bya ba sogs mtha' yas pa zhig yodaXdo/ /tshad ma la/ mngon sum/ rjes dpag dpe nyer 'jal/ sgra las byung ba/don go ba/ dngos po med pa'i tshad ma ste drug tu 'dod do/ /nges brjod/mchod sbyin/ srid bsrung / snyan dngags te bzhi ni grub mtha' thams cad kyi rtsa bar spru'o/ /brgyad pa zhi ba ba la ston pa ni lha chen po dbang phyug drang srong rkang mig sogs so/ /ming gi rnam grangs ni dbang phyug pa/ ye srid pa/ zhi ba ba sogs so/ /dbye na/ grangs can lha bcas pa/ gsal byed pa/ rna ba ma phub pa gsum zhes zer ro/ /lung ni dbang phyug sgra bsgrags kyi rgyud/ sme brtsegs kyiXrgyud rnams so/ /dbang phyug gi yon tan brgyad ni/ phra ba/yangs pa/ mchod bya ba/ bdag por gyur pa/ dbang du gyur pa/ gar yang phyin pa/ 'dod dgur ldan pa/ dga' mgur gnas pa'o/ /'di bas snod bcud thams cad dbang phyug gis byas par 'dod do/ /lam ni dum pa can gyi rlung bsgom pa dang / zhi ba la dmigs nas oṃ brjod pa dang / drag po'i dbang bskur dang / khams 'dzag pa'i bde ba dang / 'khrig pa las byung ba'i bde ba rnams grol lam du 'dod do/ /dgu ba bye brag pa la/ ston pa ni/ thub pa 'ug pa/ drang srong gzeg zan rnams so/ /ming gi rnams grangs ni gzeg zan pa/ rkang mig pa/ 'ug 274

phrug pa/ bye brag pa/ lung tsam pa rnams so/ /'di dang 'ug pa'i thul ba lhon pa gnyis mi gcig go /'dis 'dod pa'i shes bya tshig gi don drug ni/rdzas/ yon tan/ las/ spyi/ khyad par/ 'du ba rnams so/ /rdzas ni dgu ste/sa/ chu/ me/ rlung / nam mkha'/ dus/ phyogs/ bdag yid do/ /yon tan ni nyi shu rtsa bzhi ste/ gzugs/ ro/ dri/ reg bya/ sgra/ grangs/ bongs tshod/so so ba/ 'du ba/ gzhan/ gzhan ma yin pa/ blo lnga/ bde ba/ sdug bsngal/'dod pa/ zhe sdang / bag chags/ gnas pa/ 'jig pa/ 'bad pa'o/ /'ga' zhig las/ lci ba/ gsher ba/ snum pa/ byas pa'i shugs 'dren pa'ang yod do/ /las ni rnam pa lnga ste/ 'degs pa/ 'jog pa/ bskum pa/ brkyang ba/ 'gro ba'o/ /'di'i snga ma gnyis la steng du 'byin pa dang / 'og tu gnon pa zhes kyang zer ro/ /spyi ni gsal ba du ma la thun mong du byed pa byi rtag pa don gzhan cha med do/ /'di la spyi chen po dang / nyi tshe ba'i spyi gnyis/ khyad par ram bye brag ni/ gsal ba rnams tha dad du byed pa'i chos dod gzhan rtag pa cha med do/ /'du ba ni/ gang la gang ldan par byed pa'i chos rtag pa cha medaXdon gzhan no/ /ldan pa/ 'phrod pa/ 'du ba gsum don gcig dbye na/ go sa tha dad dngaXtha mi dad kyi 'du ba gnyis so/ /lam ni/ dag byed kyi khrus/ dbang bskur ba/ bsnyung bar gnas pa/tshangs par spyod pa'i bla ma'i khyim du gnas pa/ nags su gnas pa/ mchod sbyin sogs so/ /275

bcu ba rig pa can la/ ston pa ni/rkang mig pa yin la/ shes pas yul 'dzin tshul dang / lam gyi rnam bzhag 'ga' zhig tsam ma gtogs phal cher snga ma dang 'dra bas ming gi rnam grangs logs pa cher med do//bcu gcig pa zad byed pa la/ ston pa ni/ rgyal ba dam pa/ khyu mchogaldong ris nyer lnga sogs so/ /ming gi rnam grangs ni/ zad byed pa/ mchod 'os pa/ gcer bu ba/ kun du rgyu/ phyogs kyi gos can pa/ nam mkha'i gos can pa/ 'tsho ba ba/ 'dzem med pa/ thal ba ba sogs so/ /dbye na/ srog can gyi sde dgur 'dod pa dang drug tu 'dod pa gnyis/ lung ni rgyas byed skar ma'i bstan bcos sogs so/ /tshig gi don dgu ni/ srog zag pa/sdom pa/ rga ba/ 'ching ba/ las sdig pa/ bsod nams/ thar ba'o yang na srog ldan/ srog ldan min pa/ zag pa/ sdom pa/ spong ba/ mdud pa/ thar ba/'gro ba/ 'ong ba ste dgu'o/ /rdzas drug ni/ srog gang zag dus/ nam mkha'/ bsod nams/ sdig pa'o/ /srog can gyi sde dgu ni/ sa/ chu/ shing /me/ rlung / srin bu/ grog ma/ bung ba/ mi rnams so/ /lam la/ spyod pa'i sdom pa/ skad kyi sdom pa/ ngag 'chal gyi sdom pa/ bsod snyoms chud 1 su mi 'dor ba'i sdom pa/ nye bar rab gnas kyi sdom pa ste lnga dang / mi 'tshe ba'i brtul zhugs/ bden smra'i brtul zhugs/ byin pa tsam len pa'i brtul zhugs/ tshangs par spyod pa'i brtul zhugs/ yongs su gtong ba'i brtul zhugs te lnga sogs so/ /thar ba ni/ 'jig rten gsum gyi steng du 276

dbyibs gdugs kyi rnam pa/ khaXdog zho dang ku nu da ltar dkar ba/ srog yod pas dngos po yin pa/ 'khor ba las grol bas dngos po med pa yin pa/ 'jig rten 'dus pa zhes bya ba yod par 'dod do/ /de ltar phyi rol myu stegs byed kyi grub pa'i mtha' rnams kyi ming gi rnam grangs ragasaXbasdus tsam bris kyi/ zhib par yi ges 'jigs nas ma bris so/ /gnyis pa rten 'brel zab mo'i gdong lnga'i nga ros log smra ri dwags kyi tshogs de dag bcom par mdzad pa'i thub dbang smra ba'i seng ge gang de'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i grub mtha' smra baXrnams kyi ming gi rnam grangs ni/rang sde/ nang ba/ sangs rgyas pa/ chos 'di pa/ shākya'i ring lugs pa rnams don gcig dbye na/ bye brag smra ba/ mdo sde ba/ sems tsam pa/ dadu ma pa ste bzhi/ yang na pheg dman grub mtha' smra ba dang / theg chen grub mtha' spra ba gnyis/ theg dman grubaXmatha' smra ba dang / theg dman gyi gang zag gnyis don mi gcig des theg chen la'ang rigs 'gre /dang po bye brag smra ba la/ rtsa ba'i sde ba bzhi ni/ thams cad yod smra/ phal chen pa/gnas brtan pa/ mang pos bkur ba'o/ /de las gyes pa'i sde ba bcoXbargyad ni/ 'od srung sde ba/ sa ston pa/ chos srung ba/ mang thos pa/ gos dmar ba/ rnam par phye ste spra ba/ gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba ste thams cad yod smra las gyes pa bdun/ shar gyi ri bo'i sde ba/ nub kyi ri bo'i sde ba/ gangs rir gnas pa/ rtag par smra ba/ 'jig rten las 'das par smra 277

ba ste phal chen pa las gyes pa lnga/ rgyal byed tshal na gnas pa/ 'jigs med ri la gnas pa/ gtsug lag khang chen la gnas pa ste gnas brtan pa las gyes pa gsum/ sa sgrog ri ba/ srung ba ba/ gnas ma khu ba ste mang pos bkuraXb las gyes pa gsum ste bsdoms pas bcoXbargyad do/ /yang na phal chen pa/ tha snyad gcig pa/ 'jig rten las 'das par smra ba/ mang thos pa/rtag par smraXb/ mchod rten pa/ shar ri ba/ nub ri ba ste phal chen paXlas gyes pa brgyad/ gangs ri ba/ thams cad yod smra/ gnas ma bu ba/ chos mchog pa/ bzang po'i lam pa/ kun gyis bkur ba/ mang ston pa/ chos sde ba/ 'od srung ba/ bla ma ba ste gnas brtan pa las gyes pa bcu rnams so/ /gzhan yang de dag ci rigs pa la gzhung gzhan las ming gi rnam grangs mi 'dra ba du ma 'byung ba rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus na/ ba lang gnas/ri chen po/ grong khyer drug pa/ rgyal po ri ba/ rgyur smra ba/ rnam bye smra ba/ mo tun+da pa/ a ban+da ka kun gyisaXbakur ba/ ku re ku le ba/ char bzang 'bebs pa/ 'pho bar spru ba/ zhi ba ba/ don grub pa zhes pa rnams 'byung ngo / /rtsa ba'i sde bzhi la thams cad yod smra ni/ skad saṃskre ta/ mkhan po rgyal rigs sgra gcan 'dzin/ snam sbyar gyi gru rtags ud pa la/ pad ma/ rin po che/ shing lo ste bzhi'o/ /ming 'dogs lugs/ dpal/ 'od/ grags pa/bzang bo'i mtha' can no/ / 278

phal chen pa ni skad pra kri ta/ mkhan po bram ze'i rigs 'od srung / grwa rtags dung / ming ye shes/ sbas pa/ snying bo'i mtha' can no/ /mang pos bkur ba ni skad a wa bhā sha mkhan po dmangs rigs nye bar 'khor/ grwa rtags me tog so rtsi ka ming tshul khrims/ zla ba/ seng ge sbas pa'i mtha' can no/ /gnas brtan pa ni skad pi sha tsi/ mkhan po rje rigs ka t+ya na/ grwa rtags 'khor lo/ ming lha/ 'byung gnas/go cha'i mtha' can rnams so//yang bye brag smra ba la/ kha che ba dang / nyi 'og pa gnyis/ yang theg chen gyi mdo bkar khas len pa dang mi len pa gnyis rnams su yod do/ /bcom gzhig gang rung gis rang yin gyi blo 'dor du mi rung ba don dam bden pa dang / de las bzlog pa kun rdzob bden par 'dod do/ /dus gsum rdzas su grub pa/ dbang shes kyis yul rnam med thug phrad du 'dzin pa/ /rdul phra rab re re ba dbang bo'i yul las 'das pa'i don yin pa/ ldan min 'du byed dang bem po'i gzhi mthun yod pa/ sangs rgyas gyi gzugs/sku sangs rgyas min pa dang / lhag med myang 'das kyi tshe bem rig rgyun chad pa/ rtag pa'i dngos po khas len pa sogs thun mong ma yin pa'i grub pa'i mtha' ste/ de dag gis kyang rtag gcig rang dbang can byi gang zag gi bdag med 'dod do/ /gnyis pa mdo sde ba la ming gi rnam grangs ni/ mdo sde ba dang / dpe ston pa'o/ /dbye ba la/ lung gi rjes 'brang / rigs pa'i rjes 'brang gnyis/279

yang rnam pa'i sgo nas gzung 'dzin grangs mnyam pa/ sna tshogs gnyis med pa/ sgoXng byed tshal ba ste gsum/ yang na snga ma gnyis dang / sna tshogs rim 'dzin pa ste gsum mo/ /'di'i rigs pa'i rjes 'brang gis/ don byed nus pa/ don dam bden pa/ don dam du grub pa/ rang mtshan rnams don gcig kun rdzob bden pa/ don byed mi nus pa'i chos/ kun rdzob bsgrub pa/ spyi mtshan rnams don gcig par 'dod cing / de yang don dam par don byed nus pa ni rang mtshad dang / de las bzlog pa spyi mtshan du 'dod do/ /rdul phra rab cha bcas su 'dod pa dang cha med du 'dod pa gnyis yod/ cha med la'ang bar yod cing ma 'byar la bskor te gnas paraX'adod pa dang / bar med kyang ma reg par 'dod pa gnyis yod do/ /gzhan lam dang 'bras bu'i rnam bzhag ni/ sngar gyi deXdag tu ma 'dus pa cher med do/ /gsum pa sems tsam pa la ming gi rnam grangs ni/ sems tsam pa/ dngos smra ba/ rnam rig pa/ rnam par shes pa tsam du smra ba/ shes bya nang gir smra ba/ gnyis med du smra ba/ nol 'byor spyod pa ba rnams don gcig shing rta'i srol 'byed ni 'phags pa thogs med do/ /dbye na/ lung gi rjes 'brang dang / rigs pa'i rjesaX'abrang gnyis/ rnam pa'i sgo nas rnam bden pa dang / rnam rdzun pa gnyis/ nom bden pa la gzung 'dzin grangs mnyam pa/ sna tshogs gnyis med pa/ sgo nga byed tshal ba gsum/ rnam rdzun pa la dri bcas dang dri med gnyis/ rnam shes 'dod tshul gyi sgo nas rnam shes 280

tshogs brgyad du 'dod pa dang / tshogs drug du 'dod pa gnyis/ yang tshogs dgu dang / gcig tu 'dod pa'ang yod par bshad do/ /'khor lo gsum la bka' dang po bden bzhi'i chos 'khor/ bka' bar ba mtshan nyid med pa'iXchos 'khor/ bka' tha ma legs par rnam par phye ba'i chos 'khor gsum las/ dang po gnyis drang don dang / tha ma nges don du 'dod do/ /'di'i skabs kyi rton pa bzhi ni/ gang zag la mi rton chos la rton/ tshig la mi rton don la rton/ drang don la mi rton nges don la rton/rnam shes la mi rton ye shes la rton pa ste bzhi'o/ /drang ba dang nges pa'i don gyi khyad par ni/ sgra ji bzhin par bzung du mi rung ba dang rung ba la 'dod do/ /mtshan nyid gsum ni mngon pa'i skabs ltar ro/ /rigs la theg pa gsum gyi rigs dang / ma nges pa'i rigs/ rigs chad de lnga dang /mthar thug theg pa gsum du 'dod do/ /kun rdzob dang / don dam gyi khyad par la bshad tshul mang du yod kyang bden gnyis kyi skabs 'dir ni ming brda'iXdabang gib1 bzhag pa'i chos su grub pa kun rdzob tu grub pa dang / de lha ma yin par sgrub pa don dam du sgrub paXste kun brtags ni snga ma dang /gzhan dbang yongs grub gnyis phyi mar 'dod do/ /yang kun nyon skyeXrung gi dmigs pa'i chos tha snyad pa de kun rdzob bden pa dang / rnam dag lam gyi dmigs pa mthar thug de don dam bden pa'i mtshan nyid dang /gzung 'dzid rdzas gzhan gyis stong ba chos kyi bdag med mthar thug tu 281

'dod do/ /bzhi ba dadu ma ba la/ dbu ma ba/ ngo bo nyid med par spra ba/ bden med du smra ba rnams don gcig shing rta'i srol 'byed ni dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub bo/ /dbye na/ dbu ma rang rgyud pa dang / thal 'gyur ba gnyis/ dang po la rnal 'byor spyod pa'i dbu ma rang rgyud pa dang / mdo sde spyod pa'i dbu ma rang rgyud pa gnyis/ klu sgrub dang ār+ya de ba gnyis la gzhung phyi mo'i dbu ma ba dang / gzhan rnams la phyogs 'dzin pa'i dbu ma ba zhes zer ro/ /'di rnams kyis 'khor lo gsum gyi bar ba nges don dang / snga phyi gnyis drangaXdon du 'dod la/ drang nges kyi khyad par ni/ don dam bden pa brjod bya'i gtso bor byas nas mi ston pa dang ston pa la bshad do/ /mdo sde spyod pa'i dbu ma rang rgyud pa la/ rdul cha med dbang shes kyi dmigs rten du bzhed pa dang mi bzhed pa gnyis yod cing / gnyis kas phyi don khas len pa dang / rang rig khas mi len pa/ rnam shes tshogs drug tu khas len pa/ dman lamyo1 sngon du ma song bas nyon sgrib sa bdun pa nas spong zhing / shes sgrib sa brgyad pa nas spong ba sogs 'dod do/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa'i dbu ma rang rgyud pa la tha snyad du sems tsam rnam bden dang mthun pa dang / rnam rdzun dang mthun pa gnyis/ phyi ma la yang dri bcas dang mthun pa dang / dri med dang mthun pa gnyis/ de dag gis tha 282

snyad du gzung 'dzin rdzas gzhan gyisaXstong ba'i bdag med sems tsam pa dang mthun par khas len cing phyi don khas mi len la rang rig khas len pa/ dman lam sngon du ma song bas sgrib gnyisaXcig car du spong bar 'dod do//dbu ma thal 'gyur ba la ming gi rnam grangs ni/ thal 'gyur ba/gzhan grags pa/ rab tu mi gnas pa'i dbu ma ba'o/ /slob dpon ni sangs rgyas bskyangs/ zla ba grags pa/ zhi ba lhaXl sogs pa'o/ /'di bas rang mtshan tha snyad du'ang med pa dang / snang bas yod mtha' sel zhing stong bas med mtha' sel ba sogs thun mong ma yin pa'i grub mtha' mang ste/ ming gi rnam grangs phal cher sngar dadu ma'i skabs su bshad zin to/ /dbu ma ba 'di dag ni mthar thug theg pa gcig tu grub par bzhed pa khoXna'o/ /grub mtha' spyi'i gzhung bsgyur ba la mkho ba'i ming gi rnam grangs mdoraXbasdus pa'o/ /gsum pa sgra rig pa'i gzhung las 'byung ba'i ming gi rnam grangs bshad pa la/ thun mong ba tshogs gsum gyi rnam bzhag bshad pa dang /thun mong ma yin pa sgra rig pa'i brjod bya'i gtso bo rnams kyi ming gi rnam grangs bstad pa'o/ /dang po la tshogasaXgasum gyi ngo bo ni/ don gyi ngo bo tsam brjod pa ming / khyad gzhi khyad chos su 'brel nas ston pa tshig brjod bya gang yang mi ston pa'i a sogs ni yi ge'o/ /283

'on kyang sgra ba'i lugs la/ yi ge dang ming mi 'gal bar bshad pa'ang yod do/ /yi ge ni dbyangs bcu bzhi dang / gsal byed sum cu rtsa gsum mo/ /yi ge'i gzugs la tshangs pa'i yi ge lalca na/ deXdang cha mthun pa rnya ri/ de'i mgo gyen du gzed pa na ga ra/ de'i mgo thur du bkug pa wa rtu la/'dra min shas che ba katrī ra/go ḍa ga'u ra/ rgya mtsho mtha'i yi ge sirdu/bru sha/ rgya dang bod hor la sogs pa'i yi ge'i gzugasaXrnams so/ /mdo sde rgya che rol bar yang tshangs pa'i yi ge kha rosnyi'i yi ge pad+ma'i snying bo'i yi ge aṅga'i yi ge baṅga'i yi ge mā ga rnya'i yi ge bkra shis pa'i yi ge sor gdub kyi yi ge sā rnya ni'i yi ge sa kā ni'i yi ge ā hu ba'i yi ge rtsub mo'i yi ge 'gro lding ba'i yi ge mon yul gyi yi ge lho phyogs pa'i yi ge drag po'i yi ge grangs kyi yi ge spyi'u tshugs kyi yi ge rjes su mthun pa'i yi gebha ra da'i yi ge khyu phya'i yi ge rgya nag gi yi ge hū na'i yi ge dbus kyi yi ge rgyal gyi yi ge lha'i yi ge klu'i yi ge gnod sbyin gyi yi ge dri za'i yi gemi'am ci'i yi ge lto 'phye chenaXpo'i yi ge lha ma yin gyi yi ge nam mkha' lding gi yi ge ri dwags 'khor lo'i yi ge bya rog skad kyi yi ge sa'i lha'i yi ge bar snang gi lha'i yi ge byang sgra mi snyan gyi yi ge nub ba lang spyod kyi yiXge shar lus 'phags po'i yi ge 'degs pa'i yi ge bzhag pa'i yi gerab tu bzhag pa'i yi ge rgya mtsho mtha'i yi ge rdo rje'i yi ge 'phrin yig spring ba'i yi ge 'phrin yig rab tu spring ba'i yi ge rnam par bzhag pa'i yi 284

ge chung ngu ma yin pa'i yi ge bstan bcos bskor ba'i yi ge rtsis bskor ba'i yi ge 'degs pa'i bskor ba'i yi ge rkang pas bris pa'i yi ge tshig phyi ma gnyis grub pa'i yi ge ji grid tshig phyi ma bcu grub pa'i yi ge bar ma sgrub pa'iXyi ge sgraXthams cad kun bsdus pa'i yi ge rig pa dang rjes su mthun pa'i yi ge rnam par bsres pa'i yi ge drang srong dka' thub kyis gdungs pa'i yi ge gsalaXba'i yi ge sa rab tu lta ba'i yi ge sman thams cad kyi rgyu mthun pa'i yi ge snying bo thams cad kun bsdus pa'i yi ge ste drug cu rtsa bzhi'o/ /yi ge'i byed pa ni/ ming tshig brjod pa kun gyi gzhi dang / bslab pa kun gyi gzhi dang / rig byed smra ba rnams kyi rgyu byed pa'o/ /yi ge'i dbye ba ni/ sa i u ṛ ste dbyangs kyi yi ge bzhi bo so sor re re la thung ngu dang ring bo dang p+lu ta zhes pa'i shin tu ring bor bye bas gsum gsum ste/ de gsum re re la'ang u data ta dang / sa nu data ta/ su ri ta ste gsum gsum du bye bas dgu dgu'o/ /dgu bo re re la yang sna ldan dang snam ldan yin pa gnyis gnyis su bye bas a la sogs pa re re yang bco brgyad du 'gyur ro/ /e i o yo rnams mtshams sbyor gyi yi ge'i ming can yin zhing de bzhi la zung ngu med la '-i la ring bo med pas bcu gnyis re ste/bsdoms pas brgya dang sum cu rtsa gnyis so/ /yi ge'i bsdu ba ni/ ha sa zhes pas bar gyi yi ge rnams go bar byed pa lta du ste go sla'o/ / 285

yi ge'i rgyu ni/ brjod 'dod dang / rlung dang / gnas dang / byed pa dang /rtsol ba dmas so//klog tshul ni gzhan du shes par bya'o//ming la nges tshig ni/ don la blo gzhol zhing 'bab par byed pas na ming ngo / /dbye ba la dngos ming dang / btags ming dang / 'dod rgyal ba dang / rjes su sgrub pa rnams so/ /ming gcig don du ma la 'jug pa dang / don gcig la ming du ma 'jug pa rnams yod do/ /btags ming la/ rgyu la 'bras bu'i ming gis btags pa/ 'bras bu la rgyu'i ming gis btags pa/ phyogs la phyogs can gyi ming gis btags pa/ cha shas la tshogs pa'i ming gis btags pa/ rten la brten pa'i ming gis btags pa/ grogs la grogs can gyi ming gis btags pa rnams su yod do/ /tshig la rnam dbye brgyad la/gcig tshig gnyis tshig mang tshig gsum gsum du bye bas nyi shu rtsa bzhi steX'og tu 'byung ngo / /tshig sdud la/ 'bru mang po ba'i sdud pa/ las 'dzin kyi sdud pa/ ba gnyis pa'i sdud pa/ skyes bu'i sdud pa/ zlas dbye'i sdud pa/grangs med pa'i sdud pa ste drug go /gnyis pa la rtogs dka' ba bye brag tu bshad pa dang / sgra'i bstan bcos kyi snying bo'i don bsdu ba gnyis las/ dang po la/ yi ge so sor ngos gzung ba dang / rnam dbye bstan pa'o/ /dang po la/ mtshungs pa'i yi ge ni/a i u ṛ '-i rnams so/ /'dra ba'i yi ge ni/ thung ngu ring bo glu ta ste yun tshad kyi dbye bas a ā a nywa rnams so/ /mtshams sbyor gyi yi ge ni/ e glu o 286

yo rnams so//de dag mtshams sbyor tshul ni/ e yig ni/ a dang i mtshams sbyar ba las 'byung / i yig ni/ a dang e mtshams sbyar ba las 'byung /yo yig ni/ a dang ku mtshams sbyar ba las 'byung / yo yig ni/ a dang yo mtshams sbyarā ba las 'byung ngoX/ /dbyangs kyi yi ge ni/ a i spu ṛ '-i e ka yo yo rnams so/ /nā mi'i yi ge ni/ a yig ring thung gnyis bor ba'i i khri u lca ṛ dzā '-i lī e i yo yo rnams so/ /gsal byed kyi yi ge ni/ ha ya wa ra la/ nya ṇa na nga ma/ dzha rnya rnya gha bha/ dza ḍa da ga ba/ kha pha tsha ṭha tha/ tsa ḍa ta ka pa/ sha ṣa sa rnams so/ /thog ma'i yiXge dang tha ma'i yi ge brjod pas de gnyis kyi bar gyi yi ge rnams go bar byed de/ dper na ha sa zhes pa ha nas sa'i bar gyi yi ge dang tsa pa zhes pa tsa nas pa'i bar gyi yi ge rnams ngos bzung ba ste des dzha bha zhes pa sogs gzhan rnams la'ang rigs ༷'gre'o/ /rang gi sde tshan mtshon pa'i yi ge ni/ ku tsu ṭu tu pu rnams so/ /yon tan gyi yi ge gsum ni/ ṛ'i yod tan ar ces pa dang /i'i yon tan e zhes pa dang / u'i yon tan o zhes paXrnams so//'phel ba'i yi ge bzhi ni/ a yig gi 'phel ba ā dang / ṛ yig gi 'phel ba ār dang / i yig gi 'phel ba e dang / lha yig gi 'phel ba au rnams so/ /mtshams sbyor la lnga/ ming gi rab tu byed pa'i mtshams sbyor/dbyangs kyi mtshams sbyor/ rang bzhin du gnas pa'i mtshams sbyor/ gsal byed kyi mtshams sbyor/ rnam par bcad bya'i mtshams sbyor teXlnga'o//287

gnyis pa rnam dbye bstan pa la gnyis las/ dang po si sogs kyi rnam dbye dang 'brel ba'i ming gi rnam grangs la/ skyes pa'i rtags dbyangs kyi mtha' cad dang / bud med kyi rtags dbyangs kyi mtha' can dang / ma ning gi rtags dbyangs kyi mtha' can dang /ha sa'i mtha' las skyes pa'i rtags dang / ha sa'i mtha' las bud med kyi rtags dngaX/ ha sa'i mtha' las ma ning gi rtags dang / yut+padra asmadra kyi cho ga dang / mi zad pa'i sde dang /bud med kyi rkyen dang / byed pa can gyi rab tu byed pa dang / tshig sdud kyi rab tu byed pa dang / de phan gyi rab tu byed pa rnams so//dang po la/ skyes pa'i rtags a thung mtha' can dang / de bzhin du/ ā ring / i thung / u thung / ka ring / lca ring / ṛ/ i/ yo/ yo yig mtha' can no/ /gnyis pa la yang / bud med kyi rtags a thung mtha' canaXdang / de bzhin du/ ā ring /i thung / yī ring / u thung / spru ring / ṛ/ i/ yo/ yo yig mtha' can rnams so/ /gsum pa la yang / ma ning gi rtags a thung mtha' can dang /de bzhin du/ i thung / yī ring / ā ring / u thung / e/ skru ring / ṛXyig mtha' can rnams so/ /bzhi ba la yang / hra yi mtha' can dang / de bzhin du/ dra/ d+ma/ mra/ dh+ra/ dz+ra/tshwa/ shra/ṣā/ tādz+ra/ yadz+ra/ mṛdz+ra/bhādz+ra/ dra/ thra/tsu tra/ sra yig mtha' can dang / de bzhin du bsgrub pa'i tra mtha' u yig rjes 'brel can dang / tra mtha' ṛ yig rjes 'brel can sogs shin tu mang ngo / /lnga ba la yang / hra yig mtha' can dang / de bzhin du/ bra/ dra/ dh+ra/bh+ra/288

dra/za/ tsu/ sra/ shra/pe/ pra yig mtha' can rnams so/ /drug pa la yang tra yig mtha' can dang / de bzhin du/ pe/ dra/ mu/ tsu tra/ khya/ sra yig mtha' can rnams so//rnam dbye 'jug tshul la dbye na/ rnam dbye dang po'i skabs su/ gcig tshig la si dang / gnyis tshig la yo dang / mang tshig la dza sra ster ba'o/ /de bzhin du/ rnam dbye gnyis par/ amu/ yo/ shasra/ rnam dbye gsum par/ ḍā/ hūṃ/ nyisra/ rnam dbye bzhi bar/ de/ hūṃ/ bh+yasra/ rnam dbye lnga bar/ nga si/ hūṃ/ snyisra/ rnam dbye drug par/ dasra/ yosra/ āpo/ rnam dbye bdun par/di/ yosra/ supra byin nas bsgrub tshul rnams so//de yang gcig la mtshon na/ de ba la si byin nas blo'i srog i phyis/ sa rnam bcad du song bas/ de baḥ lha/ de ba la oṃ byin o dang yo la tshu 'o zhes pas rtags mtha'i a yo ru bsgyur bas/ de bo/ lha dag de ba la dzasra byin/ dza khyad don phyis srog gi a bzhag 'dra ba'i yi ge 'dus pa la ring po dang sa rnam bcad du 'gyur bas/ de bāḥ lha dmas/ yang rnam dbye gnyis pa dang 'brel ba ni/ de ba la samra byin/ aphra shasra dag gi a'o zhesaXpas a dbyi/ ma yig rjes su nga ror 'grur bas/ de baṃ/ lha la/ de ba la yo byin nas dang po'i gnyis tshig ltaraXbasgrub pas/ de bo/ lha dag la/de ba la shasra byin/ shasra la'o zhes pas/ sha khyad don phyis/ srog gi a 'dra'i yi ge 'dus pa la ring bo dang / skyes pa la sa'i na'o zhes pas sa na ru 'gyur bas/ de bān/ lha rnams la/ rnam dbye gsum pa dang 'brel ba ni/ de ba la 289

ṭā byin/ ṭā i na'o zhes pas ṭā i nar 'gyur a i la e'o zhes pas rtags mtha'i sa er song bas/de be na/lha yis/ de ba la bhā phra byin/ bha la ā'o zhes pas rtags mtha' ring bo dang / ma nga ro byas pas/ de bā bye/ lha dag gis/de ba la nyi sra byin/ bha'i bha a'o zhes pas rnyisra kyi bh+ra a ru 'gyur/a dang yi gnyis 'dus pas e ru song rtags mtha'i a dang e gnyis 'dus pas i ru song / sra rnam bcad byas pas/ de baiḥ lha rnams kyis1rnam dbye bzhi ba dang 'brel ba ni/ de ba la de byin/ de la akra'o zhes pas akra ā ga ma ster kra rjes 'brel phyis/sa khyad don yin pas phyis srog ge e saphra ru song / 'dra ba'i yi ge 'dus pa la ring bo dang phra srog med a la drangs pas/ de bā ya/ lha'i ched du/ de bā r+bha/ lha dag gi ched du/ 'di'i baspub tshul rnam dbye gsum pa dang 'dra'o/ /de ba la bh+yasra byin/ bha sa mang po nyid la e'o zhes pas rtags mtha' e dang sa rnam bcad du song bas/de be bh+yaḥ lha rnams kyi ched du/ rnam dbye lnga ba dang 'brel ba ni/ de ba la nga si byin/ nga blo ata'o zhes pas/ nga si atra tu 'gyur/ 'dra'i yi ge 'dus pa la ring bor song bas/ de bā tra/ lha las/ de bāhūṃ/ lha dag las/de be bh+yaḥ lha rnams las/ 'di gnyis baspub tshul rnam dbye bzhi ba dang 'dra'o/ /rnam dbye drug pa dang 'brel ba ni/ de ba la ngasra byin/ ngasra su'o zhes pas ngasra phya ru 'gyur te/ de ba su/ lha'i/ de ba la yosra byin/yosra la'o zhes pas rtags mtha'i saX.e ru 'grur/ e a phra ru 'gyur/ ba srog med a 290

la drangs/ ya srog med yo la drangs/ sa rnam bcad du 'gyur bas/ de ba yoḥ lha dag gi de ba la āphra byin/ āmra la nu ṭa'o zhes pas/ rnam dbye'i sngon du nuṭu.ā ga ma byin/ ṭā rjes 'brel lha brjod don phyis/ tsāmra la'o zhes pas rtags maza' ring bo dang / spe srog med ā la drangs/ mra rjes spu nga ror 'gyur bas/ de ba dz+wa/ lha rnams kyi/ rnam dbye bdun pa dang 'brelaXb ni/ de ba la de byin/ nga khyad don phyis/ srog gi i bzhag rtags mtha'i sa dang yi gnyis 'dus pas e ru song / de bo/ lha la/ de ba la osra byin gong bzhin bsgrub pas/ de ba yoḥ lha dag la/ de ba la supra byin/ pra rjes 'brel phyis/ku i la la ṣa ru byed de sa'o zhes pas/ sa yig ṣa ru bsgyur ba dang / bha sa mang po nyid la e'o zhes pas rtags mtha' e ru song bas/ de be sgyu/ lha rnams la/ bod pa'i don gyi rnam dbye dang 'brel ba ni/ te de ba si bzhag kun tu bod pa la si rnyi'o zhes pas si la rnyi'i thaXsnyad btags/byings ma yin pa'i mtshungs pa la rnyi dbyi'o zhesaXpas/ si la rnyi'i tha snyad btags pa phyis pas/ he de ba/ kye lha/ de bzhin du 'og ma rnams la bsgrub tshul rnam dbyeXdang po sogs kyi skabs lhar sbyar bas/ he de bo/ kye lha dgate de baḥ kye lha rnams sogs so//gnyis pa byings las tshig tu bsgrub pa'i kun bshad kyi rab dbye la/byed pa po'i rab tu byed pa dang / dngos po dang las kyi rab tu byed pa dang / sgog gyur gyi rab tu byed pa dang / smon par byed pa'i rkyen dang / de 291

ring ma yin pa'i 'byung 'gyur gyi dod gyi rkyen gyi rab tu byed pa dang /'byung 'gyur gyi rkyen gyi rab tu byed pa dang / bya ba shor ba'i rkyen gyi rab tu byed pa dang / byung zin gyi rkyen gyi rab tu byed pa dang / dngos po dang las rab tu byed pa dang / yadra rkyen gyi rab tu byed pa dngaX/ yadra 'jig pa'i mtha'i rab tu byed pa dang / rkyed dang sbyor ba'i rab tu byedaXpa dang /kun nas bsgyur ba'i rab tu byed pa dang / kun nas bshad pa'i rab tu byed pa rnams dang / kṛtra la sogs pa'i rab tu byed pa'o/ /dang po la/da lta ba la 'jugaXpa ni/tipra/ tasra/ arnyi/ sipra/ thasra/ tha/mipra/ bsra/ masra/ te/ ā te/ an te/ se/ ā the/ ṭī / e/ ba te/ ma te rnams so//'jug bzhin pa dang bya ba shes par nus pa'i da lta ba'i don la rnam dbye ti pra la sogs pa 'di rnams 'jug go /cho ga 'byung ba'i gnas dag la 'jug pa ni/ yātra/ ya tāza/ yusra/ yāsra/ yāte/ yātra/rmā/ yāb/ yā mā/yī ta/ spru yā hūṃ/ yī ranu/ yī thasra/ yī yā r+ghaṃ/ yī dzhai/yī ya/ yī baXnyi/ yī ma nyi rnams so/ /cho ga zhes pa bya ba'i don la nye bar ston pa dang 'byung ba'i gnas te rtogs pas shes pa'i bya ba'i don la rnam dbye yātra la sogs pa 'di rnams 'jug go /shis byed dang byed du 'jug pa dag laX'ajug pa ni/tupra/ hūṃ/ artse/nyi/ te/ ta/ā nipra/a ba pra/ā ma bra/hūṃ/ā hūṃ/atsāza swa/ā thā/ za/ i pra/ā ba haibra/ ā ma te bra rnams so/ /ma thob pa thob par byed pa sogs bkra shis pa'i don dang / 'dod pa dang mthun par bskul ba 292

sogs byed du 'jug pa'i don la tupra la sogs pa'i rnam dbye 'di rnams 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /de ring ma yin pa'i 'das pa la 'jug pa ni/ dipra/ tāmra/ ad/ sibra/ taza/ tra/ a mipra/ ba/ ma/ tad+ma/ ā tāza/ asnya/ dzāsra/ ā thāza/ / dz+wa/ i/ ba hi/ ma hi rnams so/ /de ring ma yin pa'i 'das pa ste dus 'das pa yin pa la 'das nas yun ring ma song ba'i don la/ di pra la sogs pa'i rnam dbye 'di rnams 'jug go /gnyis pa dngos po dang las kyi don la 'jug pa ni/ byings las bcas las med gnyis la dngos po'i don du rnam dbye āblo ne pa da noms 'jug cing / de yang nyer bsgyur gyi stobs kyis bsgyur ba la ma nges pa sogs khyad par 'ga' zhigaXm gtogs ming giXrnam grangs logs pa med do/ /gsum pa lkog tu gyur pa'i don la 'jug pa ni/ ṇa pra/ a tu sra/ spu sra/tha pra/ ma thu sra/ yi / ṇa pra/ba/ma /te /lha te/che re/ se/ji the/ rnya/ e/ba ho/ma te rnams so/ /byings las lkog tu gyur pa'i dus brjod pa'i byed pa'i don la ṇa pra la sogs pa'i rnam dbye 'di rnams 'jug cing / lkog tu gyur pa'i dus de la'ang 'das ma 'ongs gnyis su yod paXlas 'das pa la 'jug la/ 'das pa de yang 'das nas yun ring lon pa'i dus la 'jug pa shas che'o//bzhi ba smon par byed pa'i don gyi bya ba brjod pa la 'jug pa ni/'a tra/ yā tram̐ / yā su pra/ yā sra/ yād / yā sta/ yā su/ yā sma/ ci ṣ+ṭa sī/ yā hūṃ/ ci 293

ran/ sbostusra/ si yā sbo sī dze+e/ sīya/ sī ba nyi/ sī ma nyi rnams so/ /smon par byed pa'i don gyi bya ba brjod pa la yātra la sogs pa'i rnam dbye 'di ༷ rnams 'jug go /lnga ba de ring ma yin pa'i 'byung 'grur gyi don la 'jug pa ni/ tā/ tā ro/tā rasra/ tā blo/ tāsbisra/ tāsgri/tāsmi/tāsbasra/ tā smasra/tā/ tā ro/ tā rasra/tā se/ tā sā phe/ tā rnyi/ tā he/ tā sba te/ tā smate rnams so/ /de ring ma yin pa'i 'byung 'gyur gyi don la tā la sogs pa'i rnam dbye 'di rnams 'jug la/ 'byung 'grur de yang dus ring po ma yin pa'i nye bar 'byung ba la 'jug pa shas che'o//drug pa 'byung 'gyur dus ring po'i don la rnam dbye tipra la sogs pa bco brgyad po la su bra bar rkyen du 'gyur ba 'di rnams 'jug la/ de yang ma 'ongs pa dus ring po la 'jug pa shas che'o//bdun pa bya ba shor ba'am mi 'jom pa'i don la rnam dbye di pra la sogs pa bco brgyad po la bar rkyen su pra byin pa 'di rnams 'jug ste/ de yang bya ba shor ba ste dus la ma khel ba'am rgyu tshogs ma 'dzom pa dang / bya ba ma rdzogs par 'phro lus pa dang / bya ba zin ma thag pa'i grub zin gsar ba rnams kyi don la 'jug pa shas che'o//yang brgyad pa byung zin tsam gyi don brjod pa la rnam dbye dipra la sogs pa bco brgyad po la bar rkyen si byin pa 'di rnams 'jug ste/ deX294

yang dus 'das nas yun ring song ba la 'jug pa shas che'o/ /rnam dbye 'di rnams kyi ming 'dogs tshul mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ni dbyangs can byā ka ra ṇa'i lugs la/ kun bshad kyi rnam dbye tipra sogs brgya dang brgyad cu bo la sde tshan bcu ru yod la/sde tshan re re la'ang dgu tshan gnyis gnyis su yod pa las/ dang po dgu ni pa ra spe pa da ste gzhan don gyi tshig can gyi rnam dbye dang / phyi ma dgu ni/ sāblo ni pa da ste bdag don gyi tshig can gyi rnam dbye zhes tha snyad btags so//pā ṇi pa'i lugs la/tīpra sogs kyi rnamaXdabye sde tshan bcu'i dang po la/ laṭā zhes pa dang / gnyis pa la/lidra zhes pa dang / gsum pa la loṭu zhes pa dang / bzhi ba ladra zhes pa dang / lnga ba la lidra zhes pa dang / drug pa la smon pa'i lidra zhes pa dang / bdun pa la luṭa zhes pa dang / brgyadaXpa la liṭā zhes pa dang / dgu ba la khridra zhes tha snyad btags so/ /gzhan yang rang bzhin/ rkyen/ rnam 'gyur gsum gyi sgo nas bsgrub tshulaXni/ gcig la mtshon na da rnya 'dzin pa la'o zhes pa'i byings bzhag naṭa ki dag go zhes pas ki rkyen byin/ ka yonaXtan 'gog pa'i don gyis phyis/ srog gi i bzhag gang zhig itra kyi ming can de ni dbyi‘re zhes pas byings mtha'i a phyis/dbyangs kyis dman pa pha rol tu yang dag par sbyor ro zhes pas rnya srog med i la drangs pas/ da rnyi 'byung / ṇ+ḍatī thob paXdang 'dren pa la'o zhes pa'i byings bzhag nya gnyis ka'i tshig can gyi don phyis/ rim pa las ma 'das par phral bar bya'o zhes pas ṇa'i srog gi 295

spru phra la/ dbyangs las a'o zhes pas kṛtra rkyen a byin/ yon tan nos/khri'i yon tan er song / e a ya 'os e a yar bsgyur/dang po'i sha ṇa ni sa na 'os ṇa nar song / de nas srog med rimaXgyis drangs pas na ya 'byung / de'i sngon nyer bsgyur ādra bzhag nga phyis pas a na ya 'byung / de nas yang / da rnyi a na ya zhes pa bzhag rimaXpa las ma 'das par phral bar bya'o zhes pas/rnyi'i srog gi dbyangs i phral/ dbyangs la i yu 'os/i ya ru bsgyur/ ha sa las ra ha ma yin pa'i ha sa rnams so zhes pas rta yig gnyis brjod/ dzha bha la dza ba rnams so zhes pas/ rnya yig gong ma dra ru bsgyur/ dbyangs kyis dman pa pha rol tu yang dag par sbyor ro zhes pas rim pas drangs pas/ da rta na ya zhes pa grub pas zho longs shig ces pa'o//gnyis pa la/ mdor bstan dang / rgyas bshad gnyis/ dang po ni/ rangaXbazhin dang / rkyen dang / rnam 'gyur gsum gyis brda sprod pa'i gzhung gi brjod bya ma lus par bsdus pa'o/ /gnyis pa rgyas par bye ste bshad pa la/dang po rang bzhin ni/ byings dang ming gnyis yin la/ de la'ang thog ma'i rang bzhin byings yin zhing bya ba'i don zhes kyang bya'o/ /rang bzhin gnyis pa ming ngam rtags ni pho mo ma ning gi rtags gsum gang rung can no/ /dbyangs sam gsal byed srog med gang rung gi mtha' can yin te dper mtshon na bṛk+ṣa zhes pa dbyangs kyi mtha' can dang / bidhutra zhes pa gsal 296

byed kyi mtha' can yin pa lta bu'o/ /de yang ming gcig mang po'i don dang ldan pa ni/ ngag dang / phyogs dang / sa dang / 'od zer dang / phyugs dang /mig dang / rdo rje dang / mtho ris dang / chu ste don dgu la go sgra btags pa lta bu'o/ /ming gi rnam grangs mang bo gcig pu'i don dang ldan pa'ang nyi ma la/ tahūṃ shu/ tsha zer can/ sabhā shā/ rta bdun pa la sogs pa du mar 'dogs pa lta bu'o/ /de lta bu byings dang tshig ma gtogs pa dag ni ming yin no/ /ming gi bye zag grangs med ces pa byings las ma baspubs pa 'ga' zhig la ni pho mo ma ning gi rtags su nges pa med de/ pra zhes pa skabs 'gar rab ces bya bar bsgyur du rung la rtags gcig tu ma nges pa lta bu'o/ /byings 'ga' zhig gi sngon du nyer sgyur zhes pa grangs med kyi bye zag pra dang /par dang /niXdang / grir dang /udra dang / durnga dang / saṃ dang / ji dang /a ba dang / a nu dang / pa ri dang / a nyi dang / sa rnyi dang / pra ti dang / bu dang / ādra dang / a ti dang / a ba dang / a ji dang / u pa rnams las gang rung 'jug pa yod de/ shes pa'i byings tshwa zhes pa'i gong du nyer sgyuraXpra byin pas shes rab tu 'grur ba lta bu'o/ /de rnams rang bzhin bshad pa'o//rkyen 'chad pa ni byings la sbyar nas ming sgrub pa kṛtra rkyen yin te/ tshwa shes pa'i byings la byed ldan gyi rkyen k+ta ster ba la/ ga khyad par gyi don bsubs nas/ ta byin te 4 ta zhes pa shes pa'i ngo bo la 'jug pa dang / de ltar byings gcig laXshes pa'i las dang / shes par byed pa po lha bu la 'jug 297

pa'i kritra'i rkyen ster tshul du ma yod de/ de bzhin du kritra'i rkyen la la 'og nas 'chad pa'i byed pa can drug la 'jug pa yod de/ sgyu zhes pa sdod pa'i byings la k+ta ster ba la ka subs/ mdo gcig gis ta na ru bsgyur te/ sgyu na zhes rnam dbye bdun pa gnas gzhi ston par 'gyur ba lta bu'o/ /ming las rang dang 'brel ba'i ming gzhan baspub par byed pa la ster ba'i de phan gyi rkyen yin te/ shusto da na zhes pa zas gtsang ma la bu rgyud la 'jug pa'i de phan gyi rkyen saṇa byin/ de phan gyi le'uraX'abyung ba bzhin baspubs pas/ sho bha da ni zas gtsang sras po zhes par 'gyur ba lta du'o/ /yang rang gi dngos po sgrub pa la 'jug pa'i de phan gyi rkyen yang yod de/ rnyarma zhes pa chos kyi dngos po brjod pa la rkyen tā byin pas dharma tā chos nyid ces pa lta bu'o/ /grangs med pa 'ga'aXzhig sgrub pa la yang 'jug ste/ ming tatra ste zhes pa la rnam dbye bdun pa'i don can gyi de phan tra byin pas tatra de la zhes par 'gyur ba lta bu'o/ /tshig sdud pa'i mtha' la yang 'jug ste/ rnyamo rā dza na chos kyi rgyal po zhes pa rnam dbye drug pa'i tshig sdud yod pa laXṭa tsa'i rkyen byin nas/ tsan+d+ra pa nas 'byung ba bzhin bskrubs pas rnyarma rādza ru 'gyur ba lta bu'o/ /'ga' zhig ting gi rnam dbye byin pa'i tshig mthar 'jug ste/gats+tsha ti 'gro ba zhes pa ti byin pa'i tshig mthar ta ma zhes pa byin pas gats+tsha ti ta ma mchog tu 'gro ba zhes pa lta bu'o/ /gzhan yang rkyen gyi rnam grangs ming pho rtags can la mo rtags can gyi ched du dī la sogs pa dang / ka lā 298

pa'i lugs su/ i la sogs pa ster ba'ang yod de/ yo gi po rnal 'byor pa zhes pa pho rtags can la dī'am yī byinaXnas mtshams sbyar bas yo gi bhā rnal 'byor ma zhes pa lta bu'o/ /byings 'ga' zhig med 'ga' zhig dag la ji ltar rigs par sbyar bas byings su 'gyur ba'i rkyen sran sogs rnams kyang yod de/ rno ba'i byings ti dza la sapre gyi rkyen sbyar nas ā khyu ta'i le'u gsum pa nas 'byung ba bzhin baspubs pas ti tik+ṣa zhes pa bzod pa'i byings su 'gyur ba dang /su rā chang gi ming la tsan+d+ra pa'i ṇi tsa'am/ ka la pa'i in byin nas bsgrubs pas/ su rī zhes paXchad mkhan du byed pa'i byengs su 'gyur ro/ /ngo bo brjod pa'i tring byed pa'i byings kṛ la ti sogs kyi ti byin nas bsgrubs pasaXkṛ ya ti byed pa'i zhes pa lta bu dang / byed pa po brjod pa'i byings gong ma nyid la ta sbyar nas bsgrubs pas ga ro ti ka ṭi re lde byed do zhes pa lta bu dang /las brjod pa'i byings de nyid la ta sbyar nas bsgrubs pas/kri ya ti ka ṭaḥ re lde bya'o zhes paraX'agyur ba lta bu ste/ gsumaXpo de lta bu'i tedra gis byings las tshig bsgrub pa yin zhing / supra'am si sogs kyis ming las tshig sgrub ste/ snga ma ti sogs kyis dus kyang rnam par 'byed cing /ting subra gnyis kas brjod bya don rnam par 'byed pa'i phyir rkyen de gnyis la rnam dbye zhesarwa par grags so/ /byed pa po dang / las dang / byed pa dang / dgos ched dang / 'byung khungs dang / gzhi rnams te/ byed canaXdrug 299

ni subra'i gnas yin no/ /rnam dbye drug pa dang / brgyad pa dag ni 'brel ba dang / bod pa la 'jug pa'o//byed can drug po de la ma brjod pa dang /brjod pa gnyis gnyis su bye ste/ de la ma brjod pa'i byed pa po la rnam dbye gsum pa dang / drug pa skabs ji lha bur sbyar te/ kri ya ti kra ṭaḥ de ba darte na/ re lde bya ba lhas byin gyis so zhes pa ni gsum pa'i ṭā byin pa lta bu dang / kṛ ti ri yi rnyarma tīrti byed pa po chos kyi grags pa la rnam dbye drug pa'i desra byin pa ltaXbu'o/ /byed can drug po brjod na drug po thams cad la rnam dbye dang po nyid 'jug ste/ kri ya te ka ṭaḥ re lde bya'o zhes pa las brjod pa la las su gyur pa'i ka ṭa la blo byin pas tsheg drag tu gyur pa lta bu dang / ka ro ti ka ṭi de ba dat+taḥ re lde byed do lhas byin zhes pa byed pa po brjod pa na/byed pa por gyur pa'i de ba dat+ta la si byin pa lta bu'o/ /gzhan byed can bzhi bo brjod pa la rnam dbye dang po byin pa'i dper brjod ni ༷ gzhan du blta bar bya ste go sba'o/ /byed pa po sgrub pa dang las sgrub pa la ti sogs kyi rnam dbye rim pa ltar byed pa po dang las dag gi dbang du gyur pa 'byung ste/ byed pa'i byings kṛnywa la byed pa po'i dbang du 'gyur ba'i rnam dbye pa ra spe las ti dang u ā ga ma byin nas bsgrubs pas/ kaXro ti/byed do zhes pa lta bu byed pa po yin no/ /yang kṛnywa las la dbang du 'gyur ba'i rnam dbye ād+ma ni'i te dang / yaṇa ā ga ma byin nas baspubs pas/ kri ya ti/ bya ba'o zhes pa las brjod la byedaXpa po ma brjod pa yin no/ /rang 300

bzhin byings sam ming dang pha rol gang yang rung ba'i rkyen gyi bar du'am/rang bzhin gyi mtha'i dbyangs dang gsal byed srog med kyi bar du'am/ de phan gyi ṇa rjes su 'brel ba yong ba la rang bzhin gyi thog ma'i yi ge gcig gi rjes su dang / byings kyi dang po ru'ang ā ga ma 'byung ba yang yod do/ /gzhan yang sgra sgrub pa'i tshe/ dkyus su 'byung ba min na yang gzhan dang mi nor ba'i dgos pa dang ldan pa'i yi ge 'ga' zhig la rtags kyi don nam/khyad par gyi don zhes te rnam dbye'i si'i srog gi i lta bu'o//de rnams rkyenaXbashad pa'o//rnam 'grur 'chad pa ni/ rang bzhin dang 'brel ba'i bsgyur ba a yig sgra ldan la ring bor 'gyur ba lta du dang / de dang 'brel ba'i dbye baXrtags mtha'i na yig lta du dang / rkyen dang rjes 'brel bsgyur ba ṭā i na ru 'gyur ba lta bu dang / de dang 'brel ba'i dbyi ba ā yig mo rtags can la si dbyi ba lta bu dang / yi ge tsam dang 'brel ba'i bsgyur ba dbyangs dang gsal byed mtshams sbyor ba lta bu dang /de dang 'brel ba'i dbyi ba la/tshig mthar eta ota las pha rol gyi a yig dbyi ba lta bu rnams rnam 'gyur yin zhing / de yang tshig sdud phal cher su pra'am/ a za sogs kyi rnam dbye 'jug go /tshig sdud ni ming rnams sbyor ba'i don te ming re re la rnam dbye re re 'thob pa la mingaXganyis sam mang po'i thaXm la rnam dbye gcig byinaXpa yin no/ /de la yang dbye na/ gsum mam drug yod pa las/ khyad par 301

can khrut+pa la lta bu dang / khyad par nī la sngon po lha bu'i tshig dag gzhi mthun par sdud pa nī la dang ut+pa la gnyis ka la rnam dbye re re 'thob pa la rī la'i rnam dbye phyis nas ut+pa la'i mthar si byin pas/ bhā lot+pa laḥ ka la pa'i lugs kyi las 'dzin pa'i sdu ba/ tsan+d+ra pa'i lugs kyi khyad par gyi sdu ba yin no/ /las 'dzin de nyid pañtsa skarnyi phung bo lnga zhes pa grangs dang bgrang bya gzhi mthun du sdud pa yin la/ ka lā par/ ba gnyis pa'am/ tsan+d+ra par/ grangs dang po can gyi sdu ba zhes pa'o/ /ming grwa ma lta bu dang / pha rol gyi tshig ga te lta bu dag gi rnam dbye gnyis pa sdud paXste/ grwa rma ga ti/ grong la 'gro ba zhes pa la rnam dbye'i e phyis das grwa ma ga tiḥ zhes bsdus pas grong 'gro zhes pa lta bu la sogs pa ni byed can drug pa'i sdu ba zhesaXtsan+d+ra par bshad do/ /de lhar las 'dzin pa dang / ba gnyis pa dang / gnyis pa la sogs pa'i sdu ba ste/ 'di gsum la de'i skyes bu'i sdu ba zhes ka khā par bshad do/ /tshig sdud gang gi snga mar grangs med pa'am mi zad pa'i tshig gis brjod bya'i gtso bor ston par 'grur ba thu pa kum+bha zhes pa'i u pa nye ba'i zhes pa mi zad pa snga mar gtso bor brjod cing / kum+bha bum pa zhes phyis brjod pa'i bar nas rnam dbye dang poXphyis pa lta bu ni/ tsan+d+ra par grangs med pa'i sdu ba zhes bya'o/ /tshig gnyis dag gam tshig mang po rnams bsdoms nas don gzhan go bar byed pa la/ ka lā par 'bru mang po ba dang / tsan+d+ra par gzhan gyi don gyi tshig sdud ces bya ste/ tsitraguḥ ba khra mo 302

can zhes pa la/ tsitra'i rjes su rnam dbye dang po phyis pas/ ba khra mo can zhes smos pa 'di las ba khra mo yod pa'i sa phyogs go ba lta bu'o/ /shar dang /lho la sogs pa'i phyogs kyi ming dag las/ phyogs bral shar lho la sogs pa go ba de yang 'bru mang po'i sdu ba yin no/ /ming sil bu ba gnyis sam mang bo rnams la ming re re la rnam dbye 'dra ba re re sbyin dgos pa la de thams cad kyi tha mar rnam dbye gcig byin pas chog par bsdus pa ni ka lā par/zlas dbye 'am/tsan+d+ra par/ dang gi don gyi sdu ba zhes bya'o/ /de la ni gnyis te/gzhan dang gzhan sbyor ba ming gnyis kyi rnam dbye bsdus na gnyis tshig ster zhing / mang po'i bsdus na mang tshig ster ba dang / /kun sdud pa ming gnyis su yod kyang rnam dbye gcig tshig ster ba'o/ /de rnams rnamaX'agyur bshad pa'o//'di ni sgra'i bstan bcos kyi don shin tu bsdus pa ste/ rang bzhin dang rkyen so so'i dbye ba dang / de dag don gang la 'jug pa'i tshul dang /rnam 'gyur rnams rgyas par shes 'dod na ming gi spros pa rnams ni a ma ra ko ṣa la sogs pa mngon brjod kyi bstan bcos rnams dang / gzhan rnams ni byings kyi glegs bam dang / sgra'i bstan bcos ka lā pa la sogasaXpa'i gzhung du ltos shig saṃ skre ta la bod skad du bsgyur ba'i tshe legs sbyar gyi skad la tshig sdud du bsdus pa'i rnam dbye/ ra dza pu ru ṣa/ zhes pa rnam dbye drug pa phyis na'ang / bod skad du rgyal po'i skyes bu zhes rnam dbye drug 303

pa yod par 'gyur te dbye ba lta bu dang / so so bsdu ba don gcig gi khyad par mang po rnams—so sol rnam dbye re re byin pa/ sarba rnyi ṇ+ḍi na ka yi di na ka ra pa pu ṣe/ zhes pa la sogs pa bod skad la sgra drang thad du bsgyur na thams cad mang la ye shes sku la nyin byed sku la/ zhes pa 'byung yang / de mi bde bas thams cad mang pa ye shes sku dang nyin byed sku can/zhes pa la sogs pa kun gyi mthar la zhes pa gcig sbyar nas/ rgyal po zla ba bzang pos mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas dris zhes pa lta bu dang / rnam dbye gzhan du bsgyur ba/ kṛ tisgorma krirtaḥzhes pa/ chos kyi grags pa'i mdzad pa'o zhes rnam dbye drug pa yod pa la/ chos kyi grags pas mdzad pa'o zhes gsum par bsgyur ba lta bu ni/ bod skad la go bde zhing ji ltar brjod par 'dod pa'i don bde blag tu go bar 'gyur ba'i ched du de ltar mdzadaXpa'o/ /gong du bshad pa'i rang bzhin rkyen dang rnam 'gyur gsum gyi rnam bzhag 'di dag ni sgra rig pa slob par 'dod pa rnams la phan par bsams nas mkhas pa chen po dpang lo tsā ba'i gsung ji lta ba bzhin btus pa'o/ /de dag ni sgra rig pa'i gzhung las byung ba'i ming gi rnam grangs che long tsam mdor bsdus pa'o//gnyis pa gtan tshigs rig pa'i gzhung las 'byung ba'i ming gi rnam grangs la/gtan tshigs rig pa dang /rgyu mtshan rig pa don gcig la/rig pa'i gnas 'di rgyas par ston pa'i rang sde nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i gzhung 304

gi gtso bo ni/ dpal ldan phyogs kyi glang po dang / rigs pa'i dbang phyug chos kyi grags pa gnyis kyis mdzad pa'i sde bdun mdo dang bcas pa yin la/de yang tshad ma kun las btus pa'i don 'grel ba'i bstan bcos la/rgyas pa'i bstan bcos tshad ma rnam 'grel/ 'bring du ston pa rnam par nges pa/ bsdus te ston pa rigs pa'i thigs pa ste gtso bo lus lta bu'i bstan bcos gsum/ gtan tshigs thigs pa/ 'brel ba brtag pa/ rgyud gzhan sgrub pa/ rtsod pa'i rigs pa ste 'phros pa yan lag lha bu'i bstan bcos bzhi rnams la tshad ma sde bdun zhes grags so//'di dag gi brjod bya'i gtso bo rtog ge'i tshigaXdon brgyad ni/ mngon sum yang dag ltar snang gnyis/rjes dpag yang dag lhar snang gnyis/skrub ngag yang dag ltar snang gnyis/ sun 'byin yang dag ltar snang gnyis te brgyad do/ /brjod bya'iXlus dngosaXl/ shes bya yul gyi rnam bzhag ni/ yul/ shes bya/ gzhal bya/ yod pa/ gzhi grub rnams don gcigamatshan nyid ni rim pa bzhin du/ blos rig par bya ba/ blo'i yul du byar rung ba/ tshad masaXrtogs par bya/ tshad mas dmigs pa/ tshad mas grub pa rnams so/ /dbye na/ rang mtshan/ spyi mtshan gnyis/ deXyang yul dus rang bzhin ma 'dres par gnas pa dang / thun mong du rjes su 'groXbar byed pa'i chos gnyis so/ /spyi/ rags pa/bye brag rgyun rnams spyi mtshan yin kyang 305
