de dag yin na spyi mtshan yin mi dgos so/ /rang mtshan ni/dngos po dang / /don byed nus pa'i chos yin la/ spyi mtshan ni/ dngos po med pa dang / don byed mi nus pa'i chos so/ /yang yul bzhir dbye ba ni/ snang yul/ gzung yul/ 'jug yul/ zhed yul bzhi'o/ /de'i snga ma gnyis don gcig la/'jug yul la gnas skabs dang mthar thugaXgi 'jug yul gnyis so/ /zhen yul la/ skyes bu dang rtog pa'i zhen yul gnyis so/ /yang yu'1 la dbye na/mngon gyur dang / sgog gyur gnyis/ mngon grur la/ rang rig dang gzhan rig gi byed pa 'jug pa'i yul gnyis/ lkog gyur la rjes dpag gsum gyi byed pa 'jug pa'i yul gsum mo/ /yang yul la dbye na/ 'dus byas dang /'dus ma byas gnyis/ 'dus byas/ byas pa/ skyes pa/ 'jig pa/ don byed nus ba/ dngos po/ mi rtag pa/ skad cigaXm rnams don gcig dbye na/ bem po/ rig pa/ ldan minaX'adu byedaXgasum/ bem po ni/ rdul du grub pa ste/ phyi'i bem po dang / nangaXgi bem po gnyis/ yang na rags pa dang / rdul phra rab gnyis/ rigs pa dang / ldan min gnyis mngon pa'i skabs su bshad zin to/ /rgyu 'bras gnyis su dbye na/ rgyu la/ dngos rgyu/ brgyud rgyu gnyis/ yang na nyer len dang / lhan cig byed rkyen gnyis/ 'bras bu la/ dngos 'bras/brgyud 'bras gnyis so/ /'dus ma byas kyi chos/ rtag pa/ ma skyes pa'i chos/ma byas pa'i chos/ skad cig ma ma yin pa'i chos rnams don gcig dbye ba 306

mngon pa'i skabs su blta'o/ /yang yul la dbye na/ dgag pa dang / sgrub pa gnyis/ dgag pa la med dgag dang / ma yin dgag gnyis/ ma yin dgag la chos gzhan dngos su 'phen pa/ shugs la 'phen pa/ skabs stobs kyis 'phen pa gsum mo/ /yang yul la dbye na/ 'gal ba dang /'brel ba gnyis/ 'gal ba la/ lhan cig mi gnas 'gal/ phan tshun t+pang 'gal gnyis/ de re re la'ang dngos 'gal dang / brgyud 'gal gnyis gnyis so/ /'brel baXl bdag gcig 'brel dang / de byung 'brel gnyis/yang brjod bya dang / rjod byed gnyis su dbye na/ rjod byed la ngo bo'i sgo nas ming / tshig yi ge gsum/ ming la dngos ming / btagasaXming gnyis so/ /brjod bya'i sgo nas dbye na/ rigs brjod dang / tshogs brjod gnyis/brjod tshul gyi sgo nas dbye na/ chos brjod kyi sgra dang / chos can brjod pa'i sgra gnyis/ 'di gnyis la khyad par gzhan sgong ba dang / mi sbong ba'iXsgra zhes kyang zer ro/ /rnam gcod kyi sgo nas dbye na/ mi ldan rnam gcod kyi sgra/mi srid rnam gcod kyi sgra gsum mo/ /yang yul la dbye na/snang ba dang /selaXb gnyis/snang ba dang sgrub pa don gcig sel ba/dgag pa/ gzhan sel ba rnams don gcig sel ba la dbye na/ don gyi gzhan sel/ blo'i gzhan sel/ med dgag gi gzhan sel gsum las/ dang po ni/ bum pa ma yin pa las log pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ bum 'dzin rtog pa la dum pa ma yin pa las log par snang ba lhaXbu'o/ /gsum pa ni/ bum pa'i steng gi dum 307

pa ma yin pa rnam par bcad tsam gyi cha lta bu'o/ /'di'i snga ma la bum pa rang mtshan paX'ajog par bshad pa yang yod do//yang yul la dbye na/ spyi dang / bye brag gnyis/ spyi la/ rigs byi/ tshogs spyi/don spyi gsum mo//yang rdzas chos dngaX/ ldog chos gnyis su dbye na/ldog chos la/ rang yin ldog chos/ rang ma yin ldog chos/ldog chos phung sum tsam po ba rnams rjes mthun pa dang bcas pa yod do/ /yang mtshanaXnyid dang /mtshon bya gnyis su dbye na/ mtshon bya ni/ rnam par bzhag bya'i chos gsum tshang ba ste/ spyir mtshon bya yin pa/ rang gi mtshan nyid las gzhan pa'i mtshon bya ma yin pa/ mtshan gzhi la srid pa gsum mo/ /mtshan nyid ni/ rnam par 'jog byed kyi chos gsum tshang baXste/ spyir mtshanaXnyid yin pa/ rang gi mtshon bya las gzhan gyi mtshan nyid ma yin pa/ mtshan gzhi la srid pa gsum mo/ /yang bden pa gnyis dang /mtshan nyid gsum du dbye ba sogs ni mngon pa dang grub mtha'i skabs su blta'o/ /yul can blo'i rnam bzhag la blo/ shes pa/ rig pa/ gsal ba rnams don gcig dbye ba lnga las/ dang po rtogs ma rtogs gnyis su dbye ba la/ rtogs pa'iXblo dang ma rtogs pa'i blo gnyis/rtogs pa la dngos rtogs shugs rtogs gnyis/de la yang spyir tshad ma'i dngos rtogasaXshugs rtogs/mngon sum tshad ma'i dngos rtogs shugs rtogs/ rjes dpag tshad ma'i dngos rtogs shugs rtogs/ tshad ma ma yin pa'i dngos rtogs shugs rtogs te bzhi/ ma rtogs pa'i blo la/ ma rtogs 308

log rtog the tshom gsum/ ma rtogs pa la'ang snang la ma nges kyi blo dang /rtog med log shes gnyis so//gnyis pa bdun du dbye ba la yid dpyod/ snang la ma nges pa/ bcad shes/ log shes/ the tshom/ mngon gsum/ rjes dpag dang bdun no/ /yid dpyod la/ rgyu mtshan can dang / rgyu mtshan med pa'i yid dpyod gnyis/ snang la ma nges pa'i blo la/ rang yin par gyur pa'i dbang mngon/ yid mngon/rang rig gsum mo/ /de la rang rig med par 'dod pa'i lugs kyang yod do/ /bcad shes la/ mngonaXsum bcad shes/ rtogs pa bcad shes/ de gang rung ma yin paraXgyur pa'i bcad shes te gsum/ bcad shes la dran pas khyab par bzhed pa'i lugs kyang yod do/ /log shes la/ rtog par gyur pa'i log shes/ rtog med du gyur pa'i log shes gnyis/ phyi ma la rang yin gyi dbang shes dang yid shes gnyis/ the tshom la/don 'grur gyi the tshom/don mi 'gyur gyi the tshom/cha mnyam pa'i phe tshom gsum mo//gaspum pa rtog bcas rtog med kyi dbye ba la/ rtog pa ni sgra don 'dzin pa'i blo'am sgra don 'dres rung du 'dzin pa'i zhen rig go /dbye na/don sbyor rtog pa/ming sbyor rtog pa gnyis/ yang na brda' rten can gyi rtog pa/ don gzhan la sgro 'dogs pa'i rtog pa/ lkog tu gyur pa'i don can gyi rtog pa ste gsum/ yang na ma rtogs pa'i rtog pa/ ngesaXshes gnyis/ dang po la/ log rtog the tshom gnyis/ phyi ma la rjes dpag tshad ma dang /bcad shes 309

gnyis rnams so/ /bzhi ba tshad ma dang / tshadamin gnyis su dbye ba la/tshad ma la/ rang las nges kyi tshad ma dang gzhan las nges kyi tshad ma gnyis/yang na mngon sum tshad ma dang / rjes dpag tshad ma gnyis/ tshad ma ma yin pa la/ rang yin du gyur pa'i rtog bcas rtog med gnyis so/ /lnga ba mngon sum rjes dpag gnyisaXkyi dbye ba khyad par du bshad pa la/ mngon sum la dbye na/ dbang bo'i mngon sum/ yid kyi mngon sum/ rang rig mngod spum/ rnal 'byor mngon sum dang bzhi'o/ /de re re la'ang tshad ma/tshad min gnyis re yod la/ dbye na gzugs 'dzin dbang po'i mngon sum sogs lnga'o/ /de re re laXrkyen gsum gsum ste/ dmigs rkyen/ bdag rkyen/de ma thag rkyen no/ /yid kyi mngon sum ni/ gzugs 'dzin yid kyi mngon sum sogs lnga'o/ /dbang mngon dang / yid mngod skye tshul la mngon sum 'gros gcig pa dang / 'gros gsum pa dang / spel mar skye ba dang / rgyun mthar skye ba sogs lugs du ma yod do/ /gsum pa rang rig ni/ kha nang lta ba'i 'dzin rnam ste 'di ma gtogs gzhan rnams la kha phyir lta ba'i shes pa dang / gzung rnam/don rnam/ gzhan rig ces bshade la/ 'di la kha nang lta ba'i shes pa dang / 'dzin rnam/ rang rig zhes bshad do//zhar byung tshad 'bras kyi rnam bzhag la 'bras rtog dang po'i rnam bzhag ni/ gzugs gzhal bya/ de'i rnam pa shar nas de la gsar du mi sluXba'i shes pa tshad ma/ gzugs rtogs pa 'bras du'o/ /'bras rtogs gnyis 310

pa la gzung ba'i rnam pa gzhal bya/ de la mi slu ba'i 'dzin nom tshad ma/rang rig pa 'bras bu'o/ /'bras rtog gsum pa la/ mdo sde bas phyi rol don du 'dod pa'i gzugs gzhal bya/ rang yul gyi rnam pa shar nas de la gsar du mi slu ba'i shes pa tshad ma/ shes pa'i bdag nyid du gyur pa'i gzugs rtogasaXpa'i tshad ma 'bras bu'o/ /phyi ma 'di la mi mthun pa mang du snang yang 'dir ming gi rnam grangs tsam la bstan bcos rigs pa'i rgyan ltar bshad pa yin gyi rang lugs su ji ltar khas len pa'i tshul ni gzhan du bshad par bya'o/ /bzhi ba rnal 'byor mngon sum la/ nyan thos/ rang rgyal/ byang sems 'phags pa/ sangs rgyas kyi rgyud kyi rnal 'byor mngon sum ste bzhi'o/ /'di'i skabs kyi bden bzhi'i rang bzhin dang / dbye ba sogs ni mngonaXpa'i skabs su bshad zin to//mngon spum ltar snang la/'khrul ba'i rtog pa/ kun rdzob pa'i rtog pa/rjes dpag gi rtog pa/ rjes su dpag pa las byung ba'i rtog pa/ dran pa'i rtog pa/ mngon 'dod kyi 'dod pa ste rtog pa mngon sum ltar snang drug dang / rtog med mngon sum ltar snang gcig ste bdun no/ /rjes dpag ni rang gi rten tshul gsum tshang ba'i rtags la bsted nas rang gi gzhal bya lkog grur rjes su dpog pa'o/ /sgras brjod kyis dbye na/ rang don rjes dpag dang / gzhan dod rjes dpag gnyis/ rang don rjes dpag rjes dpag rjes su dpag pa'i tshad ma rnams don gcig dbye na dngos poX311

stobs zhugs kyi rjes dpag grags pa'i rjes dpag yid ches pa'i rjes dpag dang gsum mo/ /rjes dpag gi rgyu rtags 'dzin sems ni/ rtags kyi tshul 'dzin pa'i blo'o/ /tshul gsum dus gcig tu dran pa'i blo la bzhed pa yangaXyod do/ /dbye na phyogs chos 'jal ba dang / khyab pa 'jal ba gnyis so/ /de re re la'ang tshad ma dang bcad shes gnyis gnyis yod par bshad rjed//rjes dpag gi rten gtan tshigs la/ rtags/ rgyu mtshan/ gtan tshigs rnams don gcig de sgrub kyi rtagasaXdang / de sgrub kyi gtan tshigs sogs kyang don gcig dbye na rtags yang dag dang / rtags ltar snang gnyis/rtags yang dag gi mtshan nyid ni/ tshul gsum tshang ba'am tshul gsum yin pa'o//tshul gsum ni/ phyogs chos/ rjes 'gro'i khyab pa/ldog pa'i khyab pa ste gsum mo/ /de spub kyi chos dang chos can gyi tshogs don ni/ de sgrub kyi rjes su dpag par bya ba/ de sgrub kyi phyogs/ de sgrub kyi bskrub bya/ de sgrub kyi dam bca' rnams yin la/ de sgrub kyi chos dang / baspub bya'i chos gnyis don gcig rjes su dpag par bya ba'i gzhi/ phyogs chos zhes pa'i tshig zur gyi phyogs/ rtsod gzhi/ dpag gzhi/shes 'dod chos can rnams don gcig de sgrub kyi bskrub pa'i chos/ phyogs kyi chos/ gtan tshigs/ rtags/ rgyu mtshan rnams don gcig dper na sgra chos can/ mi rtag ste/ byas pa'i phyir zhes pa lta bu la mtshon na/ sgra ni de sgrub kyi chos can yin zhing / chos can zhes pa'i 312

chos ni/ rtags chos gnyis yin la/ de gnyis dang ldan pas na chos can zhes bya'o/ /sgra miXrtag pa de spub kyi spub bya yin la/ mi rtag pa de sgrub kyi bsgrub bya'i chos yin/ byasaXpa de spub kyi gtan tshigs so/ /spyir phyogs kyi sgra ni shes 'dod chos can dang / shasgrub bya'i chos dang / de gnyis ka'i tshogs donaXgasum ka la 'jug go /phyogs chos kyi mtshan nyid ni/ de sgrub kyi shes 'dod chos can gyi steng du 'god tshul dang mthun par yod pa nyid du tshad mas nges pa'o/ /rjes khyab ni/ de skrub kyi mthud phyogs kho na la yod par tshad mas nges pa'o/ /ldog khyab ni/ de sgrub kyi mi mthun phyogs la med pa nyid du nges pa'o/ /mthun phyogs mi mthun phyogs gnyisaXkyi mi mthun phyogs la/ de sgrub kyiXmed pa mi mthun phyogs/ gzhad pa mi mthun phyogs/'gal zla mi mthun phyogs te gsum mo/ /khyab pa la/ rjes khyab/ ldog khyab/dngos khyab/ ldog pa'i khyab pa rnams so/ /'gal khyab dang thur khyab zhes pa'i ming gi rnam grangs kyangaXyod do/ /rtags yang dag gi dbye ba la/'bras bu'i rtags yang dag rang bzhin gyi rtags yang dag ma dmigs pa'i rtags yang dag go /dang po la/ dbye na/ rgyu dngos sgrub pa'i 'bras rtags/ rgyu sngon song sgrub pa'i 'bras rtags/ rgyu'i spyi spub pa'i 'bras rtags/ rgyu'i khyad par sgrub pa'i 'bras rtags/ rgyu chos rjes dpag gi 'bras rtags te lnga'o/ /de dag la'ang bkod tshod kyi rtags dang song tshod kyi rtags gnyis gnyis yod do//313

rang bzhin gyi rtags la dbye na/ khyad par ltos pa ba'i rang bzhin gyi rtags dang / khyad par dag pa ba'i rang bzhin gyi rtags gnyis/ snga ma laXbyed chos tha mi dad la ltos pa dang / tha dad la stos pa gnyis/ phyi ma la/byed chos dngos su 'phangs pa dang / shugs la 'phangs pa gnyis rnams so/ /ma dmigs pa'i rtags la dbye na/ miXsnang ba ma dmigs pa'i rtags dang / snang rung ma dmigs pa'i rtags gnyis/ dang po'i skabs kyi bskalaXdon gsum ni/ yul phra ba/ dusaXphra ba/ ngo bo phra bas bskal ba'o/ /snang rung ma dmigs pa la dbye na/ 'brel zla ma dmigs pa'i rtags dang / 'gal zla dmigs pa'i rtags gnyis/ 'azel zla ma dmigs pa la/ rgyu/ khyab byed/rang bzhin/ dngos 'bras ma dmigs pa'i rtags yang dag dang bzhi/'gal zla dmigs pa la/ rang bzhin 'gal dmigs/ 'gal 'bras dmigs pa/ rgyu 'gal dmigs/ rgyu dang 'gal ba'i 'bras bu dmigs pa/'azas bu 'gal dmigs/ khyab byed 'gal dmigs te drug yang lhan cig mi gnas 'gal la brten pa dang / phan tshun spangs 'gal la brten pa'i 'gal zla dmigs pa'i gtan tshigs gnyis so//yang rtags yang dag la bsgrub bya'i sgo nas dbye na/ dngos po stobs zhugs kyi rtags yang dag grags pa'i rtags yang dag yid ches pa'i rtags yang dag ste gsum mo/ /bsgrub tshul gyi sgo nas dbye na/don sgrub kyi rtags yang dag tha snyad sgrub kyi rtags yang dag dang / tha snyad 'ba' zhig 314

spub kyi rtags yang dag ste gsum/ baspub bya'i chos kyi sgo nas dbye da/ sgrub rtags dang / 'gal rtags gnyis so/ /mthun phyogs la 'jug tshul gyi sgo nas dbye na/ mthun phyogs la khyab byed du 'jug pa'i rtags dang / de la cha gnyis su 'jug pa'i rtags gnyis so/ /rgol ba'i sgo nas dbye na/ rang don gyi rtags yang dag gzhan don gyi rtags yang dag gnyis so/ /rtags kyi skyon la rtags skyon/ dpe skyon/ phyogs skyon gsum/ rtags skyon la/'gal ba/ ma nges pa/ ma grub pa gsum mo// rtags ltar snang la/ ma grub pa'i rtags/ 'gal ba'i rtags/ ma nges pa'i rtags dang gsum/ dang po ma grub pa la/ rtags kyi ngo bo med nas ma grub pa/ chos can gyi ngo bo med nas ma grub pa/ gzhi rtags kyi 'brel ba med nas ma grub pa/ chos can gyi phyogs gcig la rtags med nas ma grub pa/ rtags kyi phyogs gcig laXchos can med nas ma grub pa ste don la ltos nas ma grub pa lnga/ chos can la the tshom ma za nas maXgrub pa/ rtags la the tshom za nas ma grub pa/ gzhi rtags kyi 'brel ba la the tshom za nas ma grub pa ste the tshom za nas ma grub pa gsum dang / gzhi rtags tha dad med nas ma grub/ gzhi chos tha dad med nas ma grub/ rtags chos tha dad med nas ma grub pa ste shes 'dod la ltos nas ma grub pa gsum ste bsdoms pas blo la ltos nas ma grub pa drug snga nol la ltos nas ma grub/ phyi rgol la ltos nas ma grub/ gnyis kaXl ltos nas ma grub paXste rgol ba la ltos nas ma grub pa 315

ga/sum/ 'gal ba'i rtags la/ chos kyi ngo bo 'gog pa/ chos can gyi ngo bo 'gog pa/ chos kyi khyad par 'gog pa/ chos can gyi khyad par 'gog pa ste bzhi/ ma nges pa'i rtags la/ thun mong ma yin pa'i ma nges pa'i rtags dang / thun mong ba'i ma nges pa'i rtags gnyis/ phyi ma la phyogs gnyis ka la mthong tsam du grub pa dngaX/ mthun phyogs la mthong mi mthun phyogs la ma mthong ba dang / mi mthun phyogs la mthong mthun phyogs la ma mthong ba'i ma ngesaXpa'i rtags te gsum mo/ /yang na mi mthun phyogs la rnam gnyis mi mthun phyogs la khyab byed du 'jug pa/ mi mthun phyogs la rnam gnyis mthun phyogs la khyab byed du 'jug pa/ gnyi ka la rnam gnyis su 'jug pa/ gnyi ka la khyab byed du 'jug pa ste bzhi'o/ /lhag ldan gyi gtan tshigs ni mkhas pa 'ga' zhig ma nges pa'i rtags kyi bye brag tu bshad la 'ga' zhig gis ma nges pa'i rtags dang don gcig tu bshad do/ /gzhan don rjes dpag la/ ming gi rnam grangs ni/ gzhan don rjes dpag rtags tshig yang dag sgrub ngag yang dag rnams don gcig la/rjes dpag tu btags pa tsam yin kyi rjes dpag dngos min no/ /dbye na chos mthun sbyor gyi sgrub ngag yang dag dang / chos mi mthun sbyor gyi sgrub ngag yang dag gnyis/ dang po ni/ gang byas na mi rtag pas khyab/ dper na bum pa bzhin/ sgra yang byas so/ /zhes pa lta du'o/ /gnyis pa ni/gang rtagaXn ma byas pas khyab/ dper na 'dus ma byas kyi nam mkha' bzhin/ sgra ni 316

byas so/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /sgrub ngag yan lag lnga ldan ni/ lugs 'di phas mi 'dod kyang grub mtha' gong ma 'ga' zhig gis 'dod la/ de yang sgra ni mi rtag ste/ byas pa'i phyir/ dper na bum pa bzhin/ dum pa byas pa de bzhin du sgra yang byas/ de'i phyir sgra mi rtag ces pa ste/ dam bca'/ dpe/phyogs chos/ nyer gtod/ 'jug sdud lnga'o/ /'di la la lar khyab paX'adren no/ /spub ngag gi lam sbyong sun 'byin la/ sun 'byen dang thalaX'agyur don gcig dper na sgra chos can/ ma byas pa yin par thal/ rtag pa yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa lha bu'o/ /de la bkod tshod kyis dbye na/ khyab rtags gnyis ka ma grubaXpa/rtags kho na ma grub pa/ khyab pa kho da ma grub pa/ khyab rtags gnyis ka grub pa bzhi/ phyi ma la rtags tshad mas grub cing /khyab pa khas blangs kyis grub pa dang / khyab pa tshad mas grub cing rtags khas blangs kyis grub pa/gnyis ka tshad mas grub pa/ gnyis ka khas blangs kyis kyang grub pa ste/bzhi rnams so/ /yang na thal 'gyur yang dag dang / ltar snang gnyis/ yang dag la sgrub byed 'phenaXpa dang / mi 'phed pa gnyis/ 'phen pa la bzlog pa rang rigs 'phen pa dang / gzhan rigs 'phen pa gnyis/ 'azas mtshungs kyi lhag chod ni spun 'byin ltar snang ngo / /rgol ba'i rnam bzhag la snga rgol ni/ sgrub byed 'god par khas len pa'i gang zag phyi rgol ni sun 'byin brjod par khas len pa'i gang zag de re re la'ang yang dag dang 317

ltar snang gnyis gnyis/ dpang po niXrgyal pham shan 'byed pa'i gang zagadabye na/ shan 'byed pa'i dpang po/ rjes su brjod pa'i dpang po/ tshar gcod pa'i dpang po'o/ /snga rgol tshar gcod pa'i gnas su gyur pa ni/ grub gsal zhugs pa dam bca' ba/ dris kyang lan mi 'debs pa/ mi 'os pa dam 'cha' ba/ skabs su ma babs pa bsgrub byar byed pa/ khas blang ba'i don la spub byed mi dgod pa/ ma grub pa ma nges pa'i gsal ba brjod pa/shes 'dod med pa'i sgrub byed dgod pa rnams so/ /pyi rgol tshar gcod pa'i gnas su gyur pa ni/ 'dri bar khas blangs nas btang snyoms su 'jogaXpa/ grub bsalaXzhugs pa 'dri ba/ skabs su ma babs pa 'dri ba/ skyon brjod rgyu yod kyang mi brjod pa/ skyon min pa skyon du brjod pa/ skabs su maXbabs pa'i skyon brjod pa rnams so/ /dpang po tshar gcod pa'i gnas su gyur pa gsum ni/ bden rdzun shan mi 'byed pa/ rgyal pham phyin ci log tu shan 'byed pa/ rtsod pa mthar ma phyin par shan 'byed pa'o/ / rtsod pa'i rgyu ni/ skyes thob kyi shes rab che ba/ sgra tshad la blo sbyangs pa/rang gzhan gyi gzhung lugs la legs par sbyangs pa'o/ /rtsod pa mdzes pa'i rgyan ni/ bzhin gyi mdangs gsal ba/ ngagaXsnyan cing 'jam pa pha rol dma' 'bebs pa'i tshig mda' mi 'phen pa/ lung dang rigs pa gsal la rno ba/ sgyid lug pa dang nga rgyal med pa/ rigs lam 'dor ba'i g.yo sgyu dang chags sdang med pa/ rang gzhan gyi don dang bstan paXl 318

gces par 'dzin pa rnams so/ /rtsod pa'i dpe ni/ rang gzhan gyi gti mug gcod pa 'khor lo lta bu/ spun 'byin pa'i rlung gis mi g.yo ba lhun po lta bu/ tshig don la ma rmongs pa thub pa'i dbang po'i sras lta bu dgos so/ /rtsod pa'i 'bras bu ni/ rtsod pa'i rgyu/ rgyan/ bsam pa/ sbyor ba phud sum tshogs pa la brten nas rtogs pa 'phel bas rang rgyud tshim pa/ snyan pa'i grags pas phyogs kun khyab pa/ bstan pa bsrung bas chos kyi rgyal por 'gyur ba'o/ /gtan tshigs rig pa'i gzhung las 'byung ba'i ming gi rnam grangs mdor bsdus pa'o//gnyis pa gsang sngags kyi theg pa'i ga'ung nas 'byung ba'i ming gi rnam grangs la/ spyir bcom ldan 'das kyis gdul bya dman pa la mos pa rnams la chags bral gyi spyod pa/ rgya chen po la mos pa rnams la sa dang pha rol tu phyinaXpa'i spyod pa/ zab mo la lhag par mos pa rnams la 'dod chags kyi spyod pa bstan nas 'dul bar mdzadaXpa las/ dang po ni theg pa dman pa dang / gnyis pa ni pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang / gsum pa ni gsang sngags kyi beg pa'i tshul lo/ /des na theg pa thams cad kyi mchog ni gsang sngags kyi theg pa ste/ 'di'i ming gi rnam grangs ni/ gsang sngags kyi theg pa/ 'bras bu'i pheg pa/ rdo rje'i theg pa/ thabs kyi theg pa/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i theg pa rnams so/ /mtshan nyid kyi theg pa las khyad chos bzhis khyad par du 'phags pa ste/ ma rmongs pa'i khyad par/ thabs mang ba'i khyad 319

par/ dka' ba med pa'i khyad par/ gdul bya dbang bo shin tu rno ba'i dbang du byas pa'i khyad par te bzhi'o/ /dbye ba ni bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud de bzhi/ de yang lam gyi gdul bya la/ rgod pa/ lta ba/ lag bcangs/ gnyis gnyis 'khyud pa ste 'dod yon la chags pa lam du byed tshul mi 'dra ba bzhi dang / lam sgom pa'i nus pa dman mchog mi 'dra ba bzhi yod pa'i sgo nas bye ba'o//phyi ma bzhi ni/ stong ba dang lha'i rnal 'byor mngon du byed pa la phyi'i bya ba shin tu mang bo la ltos pa dang / bya ba ha cang mi mang bar phyi'i bya ba dang nang gi ting 'dzin gnyis cha mnyam pa la ltos pa dang / phyi'i bya ba dang nang gi ting 'dzin gnyis las ting 'dzin gtso bor byur pa la ltos dgos pa dang / phyi'i bya ba la mi ltos par gong na med pa'i rnal 'byor skyed nus pa ste bzhi'o/ /de la bzhi las/ dang po bya ba'i rgyud la/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs/ pad+ma'i rigs/ rdo rje'i rigs te/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rigs gsum/ nor can gyi rigs/ lngas rtsed gyi rigs/ 'jig rten pa'i rigs te ma 'das pa'i rigs gsum rnams bsdoms pas drug go /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs la sde tshan brgyad de/ rigs kyi gtso bo/ rigs kyi bdag po/ rigs kyi yum/ rigs kyi gtsug tor/ rigs kyi khro bo khro mo/rigs kyi pho nya pho mo/ rang rigs su gtogs pa'i byang sems/ rang rigs su gtogs pa'i lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin sogs kyi sde tshan no/ /de 320

bzhin du pad+ma dang rdo rje'i rigs la yang sde tshan brgyad re yod do/ /bya ba spyi'i rgyud bzhi ni/ gsang ba spyi rgyud/ legs par grub pa/ dpung bzang gis zhus pa/ bsam gtan phyi ma noms so/ /bsam gtan phyi mas bya rgyud kyi don thams cad rnams grangs bcur bsdus pa ni/ gang du bsgrub pa gnas kyi mtshan nyid/ bdag gi de kho na nyid/ rig sngags kyi de kho na nyid/lha'i de kho na nyid/ me la gnas pa'i bsam gtan/ sgra la gnas pa'i bsam gtan/ sgra mthar thar ba ster ba'i bsam gtan/ rig sngags bsgrub pa la 'jug pa'i cho ga sbyin sreg gi cho ga dbangaXbaskur gyi cho ga ste bcu'o/ /'di'i dbang la me tog phreng ba/ chu/ cod paṇa/ rdo rje/ dril bu/ming gi dbang ste drug go /mtha'aXrton du lung bstan/ dbugs dbyung /rjes gnang gsum btags kyang rung bar bshad do/ /sdom pa ni thun mong ba byang sems kyi sdom pa tsam mo/ /dam tshig ni legs grub kyi rgyud las mang du bshad do/ /lam gyi rim pa la bzlas brjod la ltos pa'i bsam gtan ni/ sbyor ba la/ rigs spyi'i sngags rgya bcang ba/ rgyal ba sras bcas la phyag 'tshal zhing bdag nyid dbul ba/ skyabs su 'gro zhing sems skyed pa/ sngags dang phyag rgyas bsrung ba/ gnas khang gi phyi rol du phyinaXte khrus bya ba/ nang du 'ong nas chas su zhugs te stan la 'khod pa/ mchod pa byin gyis rlabs pa/ bdag dang gnas bsrung ba ste bdun no/ /dngos gzhi la bdag bskyed bsgom pa ni/ lha drug gi skyed chog bya ba ste/ de kho na nyid kyi 321

lha/ sgra'i lha/ yi ge'i lha/ gzugs kyi lha/ phyag rgya'i lha/ mtshan ma'i lha ste drug gi sgo nas rnal 'byor bsgomaXpa'o/ /ye shes pa bstem pa/ dbang bskur ba/ rigs bdag gis rgyas 'debs rnams kyang byar rung ngo //mdud bskyed bsgrubs nas mchod pa sogs bya ba la/ rten bskyed pa/brten pa lha spyan drangs te bzhugs su gsol ba/ phyag rgya bstan pa/mchod bstod bya ba/ bshags sogs bya ba/ tshad med bzhi bsgom pa sogs bya ba ste drug go / bzlas brjod dngos la yan lag bzhi ni/ bdag gi gzhi/ gzhan gyi gzhi/ sems la gzholaXba'i yan lag sgra la gzhol ba'i yan lag go /bzlas pa bya tshul la yi ge'i gzugs la dmigs pa'i bzlas brjod dang /sgra la dmigs pa'i bzlas brjod gnyis so/ /de'i snga ma la'ang mdun gyi thugs ka'i yi ge'i gzugs la dmigs pa dang / rang gi snying kha'i yi ge'i gzugs la dmigs pa gnyis yod do/ /bsnyen pa la mtshan ma/ dus/grangs kyi bsnyen pa gsum mo/ /bzlas brjod la mi ltos pa'i bsam gtan la gsum/ me la gnas pa'i bsam gtan/ sgra la gnas pa'i bsam gtan/sgra mthar thar ba ster ba'i bsam gtan no/ /spyir bya spyod kyi lam rnams/sku phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa/ gsung sngags bsgom pa/ thugs de kho na nyid bsgom pa gsum du 'du'o/ /bsnyen pa mthar phyin nas dngos grub spub pa'i tshul la/ rigs 322

gsum re re la yang dngos grub rab 'bring tha ma gsum gsum dang / zhi ba/rgyas pa/ drag po gsum gsum mo/ /yang ngo bo'i sgo nas rab 'bring tha ma gsum/ rtags kyi sgo nas me/ du ba/ drod gsum/ gzhi'i sgo nas lus/ rdzas/longs spyod kyi dngos grub gsum/ gsung ba po'i sgo nas 'phags pa/ lha/sa bla'i sngags gsum rnams so/ /gnyis pa spyod pa'i rgyud la/ rgyud 'di'i gtso bo ni rnam snang mngon byang gi rgyud yin la/ gsung ba po ni/ longs sku rnam snang gangs chen mapa'o/ /gsung ba'i gnas ni gzhi dang snying bo me tog gis brgyad pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi 'og min stug po bkod pa zhes bya ba'o/ /'di la dbang bskur ba'i tshul dang / dam tshig dang sdom pa dag par bya tshul ni bya rgyud dang 'dra'o/ /lam gyi rim pa la/ mtshan bcas dang / mtshan med gnyis/ snga ma la phyi'i yan lag bzhi'i bzlas brjod dang / nang gi yan lag bzhi'i bzlas brjod de gnyis/ de re re la yang bdag gi gzhi/ gzhan gyi gzhi/ sems la gzhol ba'i gzhi/ sgra la gzhol ba'i gzhi ste bzhi re yod do/ /mtshan ma med pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ stong nyid bsgom pa'o/ /gzhan rnams phal cher snga ma dang 'dra bar sbyar ro/ /gsum pa rnal 'byor rgyud la/ rtsa rgyud/ bshad rgyud/ cha mthud gyi rgyud de gsum/ rtsa ba'i rgyud ni de nyid bsdus pa'o/ /de la dum bu bzhi ste/rdor dbyings kyi dum bu/ khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi dum bu/ 'gro 'dul 323

gyi dumaXbu/ don grub kyi dum bu ste bzhi/ de las bshad pa'i rigs lnga ni/de bzhin gshegs pa/ rdo rje/ rin po che/ pad+ma/ las kyiXrigs so/ /rtsa rgyud du—las kyi rigs rin po che'i rigs su bsdus te bzhir bshad do/ /rigs bzhi ni rim pa bzhin ngo bo nyid/ rnarma par smin pa/ longs spyod rdzogs pa/sprul pa'i sku ste bzhi/ meXlong lta bu/ mnyam pa nyid/ so sor rtogs pa/ bya ba sgrubaXpa'i ye the/sa te bzhi/ byang chub kyi sems/ sbyin pa'i phar phyin/ shes rab kyi phar phyin/ brtson 'grus kyi phar phyin te bzhi rnams su bshad do/ /yang dum bu bzhi bo re re las gdul bya gsum gyi ngor ting 'dzin gaspum rgyas 'bring bsdus pa gsum tshan bzhi gsungs la/ dum bu so so nas dkyil 'khor chen po/ gzungs kyi dkyil 'khor/ chos kyi dkyil 'khor/las kyi dkyil 'khor te bzhi re bshad la/phyag rgya bzhi ni/ phyag rgya chen po/dam tshig gi phyag rgya/ chos kyi phyag rgya/ las kyi phyag rgya ste bzhi'o/ /'di bzhis sbyang gzhi tha mal ba'i lus/ ngag yid/ bya ba rnams sbyong / 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sku gaspung thugs 'phrin las rnams 'grub bo/ /de ltar na sbyang bya gzhi'i phyag rgya/ sbyong byed lam gyi phyag rgya/ sbyangs pa 'bras bu'i phyag rgya ste gsum mo/ /yang mtshon bya don dang / mtshon byed kyi phyag rgya gnyis/ phyi ma la mtshod byed phyi dang / mtshon byed nang gi phyag rgya gnyis su yod do/ /ting 'dzin gsum ni/ dang po sbyor ba/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchogalas rgyal mchog gi ting 'dzin gsum mo/ /rgyudaX'adir dbang bskur ba la/324

dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa tsam byed pa/ slob ma'i dbang tsam bskur ba/rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang man chad rdzogs par bskur ba ste gsum/ phyi ma ltar byed na rigs lnga'i dam tshig bsrung ba dang / rtsa ltung la 'dzem pa rnams bla med skabs dang 'dra/ lam sgom pa la/ mtshan bcas/ mtshan med gnyis/ dang po la thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor rags phra gnyis/ rags pa la gnyis las slob ma'i dbang tsam zhig thob pas ni/ bdag bsrung ba dang chus khrus bya ba/ khro bo'i rnal 'byor bsrung 'khor bya ba/ tshogs rten gyi sprun sngar phyag dang skyabs su 'gro ba sogs bya ba/ rdo rje thal mo nas ye shes dbab pa'i bar bya ba/ rang cho ga lngas lhar bskyed nas ye shes pa bcug ste phyag rgya bzhis rgyas gdab bya ba/ bzlas pa bya ba ste drug tu bshad la lugs gzhan yang yod do/ /'di ni rnal 'byor gcig ldan kho na'o/ /slob dpon gyi dbang thob pas ni slob ma la dbang bskur na/ bdag rdzogs rnal 'byor chen po dang bcas pa'i ting nge 'dzinaXgasum bri ba med par bsgoms pa'i bsnyen pa rgyas pa/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi skyed chog sogs bsdus pa'i bsnyen pa 'bring / rnal 'byor ched po lha re re'i bzlas brjod 'bum dang bcas pa'i bsnyen pa bsdus pa gsum gang rung ngo / /rang gi lha baspub pa la ting nge 'dzinaXrnal 'byor chen po dang bcas pa bsgom pa'o/ /phra mo la dmigs pa la/ sems brtan par bya ba dang /brtan pa thob nas spro bsdu sogasaXbya ba gnyis so/ /mtshan med ni/ de kho na 325

nyid kyi don spros bral dmigs pa'i lhag mthong bsgom tshul te/ rigs bzhis sgom tshul mi 'dra ba bzhi yod do/ /dngos grub bskrub pa'i tshul la/ bsam gtan gyis dngos grub baspub pa/ bzlas brjod kyis dngos grub bsgrub pa/ sbyin sreg gis dngos grub baspub pa ste gsum mo//bzhi ba rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud la/ pha rgyud/ ma rgyud gnyis/rnal 'byor gyi rgyud/ thabs kyi rgyud/ mkha' 'gro pha'i rgyud rnams don gcig de re re la'ang brjod byed tshig gi rgyud/ brjod bya don gyi rgyud gnyis gnyis yod/ snga ma la rtsa rgyud/ bshad rgyud/ rgyud phyi ma/ cha mthun gyi rgyud gsum/ phyi ma la rgyu'i rgyud/ thabs kyi rgyud/ 'bras bu'i rgyud gsum/de gsum la gzhi'i rgyud dang / lam gyi rgyud/ mi 'phrog pa'i rgyud zhes kyang bshad do/ /thabs kyi rgyud la'ang ma smin pa smin par byed pa dbang gi rgyud/ smin pa mi nyams par byed pa dam tshig dang sdom pa'i rgyud/ nyams su blang bya'i ngo bo bskyed rdzogs kyi rgyud/ nyeXrgyu spyod pa'i rgyud dang bzhi yod/rgyud bshad thabs kyi rgyan bdun ni/ dang po gleng bslang ba'i rgyan la/mtshan gyi khyad par/ ched du bya ba'i gdul bya'i khyad par/ mdzadaXpa po'i khyad par1 tshig don gyi tshad kyi khyad par/ dgos pa'i khyad par te lnga/gnyis pa 'tshang rgya tshul gyi rgyan la/ rgyud/ gleng gzhi/ nges tshig rgyu dang bzhi/ gsum pa mtha' drug gi rgyan la/ drang don/ nges don/ dgongs pas 326

bshad pa/ dgongs pa ma yin pas bshad pa/ sgra ji bzhin pa yin pa/ sgra ji bzhin pa ma yin pa ste drug bzhi ba tshul bzhi'i rgyan la/ yig don/ spyi don/ sbas don/ mthar thug gi don te bzhi/ lnga ba 'chad tshul gyi rgyan la/tshogs bshad/ slob bshad gnyis/ drug pa nyan pa po'i rgyan la/ nga la/pad dkar/ pad+ma/ tsan dan/ rin po che lha du'i gang zag ste lnga/ bdun pa bded gnyis nges pa'i rgyan la/ kud rdzob bden pa nges pa'i rgyan dang /don dam bden pa nges pa'i rgyan gnyis te so sor phye na nyi shu rtsa brgyad do/ /rgyud kyi grangs ni/ pha rgyud bye ba phrag drug ma rgyud bye ba phrag bcu drug go /bla med kyi rgyud thams cad kyis bde stong gnyis su med pa brjod bya'i gtso bor byed pas gnyis med kyi rgyud ces kyang zer ro/ /lam bsgom pa'i snod rung du bya ba la dbang bskur ba'i dpon slob phan tshun brtag pa/slob mas gsol ba gdab ba/ slob dpon gyis bsrung ba bya ba/ dbang bskur ba'i sngon du bsnyen pa bya ba/ bsnyen pa las su rung nas dbang bskur bya ba ste lnga/ bsnyen pa la mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa/ grangs kyi bsnyen pa/dus kyi bsnyen pa gsum las/ 'dir ni lhas gnang ba'i mtshan ma byung ba'am grangs rdzogs pa gang rung ngo / /dbang bskur ba la sa'i cho ga sta god gyi cho ga dngos gzhi'i choXg ste gsum/ sa'i cho ga la/ sa brtag pa/ sa bamang ba/ sa sbyang ba/ sa gzung ba/ bsrung zhing byin gyis brlab pa ste lnga/sa sbyang ba la/ brkos nas sbyang ba/ rdzas sngags ting 'dzin gsum gyis 327

sbyang ba/ bla na med pa'i dag pas sbyang ba ste gsum/ rko ba la/ zug rngu dag pa'i ched du rko ba/ lto 'bye brtag nas brko ba ste gnyis/ sa gzung ba la/lha'i rnal 'byor gyis gsol ba btab cing dkyil 'khor gdegs pa/bslang ste bgegs la bka' bsgo ba/ stangs stabs bya ba gsum/ stangs stabs la rdo rje rtse gcig pa/ rtse gsum pa/ rtse lnga ba/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i rkang stabs/ g.yas brkyang / g.yon brkyang / sa ga zlum po/ mnyam pa'i stangs stabs rnams so/ /bsrung zhing byin gyis brlab pa la/ lhar bskyed nas gegs dgug pa/ gegs la phur dus gdab pa gnyis so/ /sta gon gyi cho ga la/ sa yi lha mo sta gon/ dkyil 'khor gyi sta gon/ bum pa sta gon/ slob ma sta gon bzhi/ lha sta gon/ thig gdab paXdang / lha sta gon bya baXdangos gnyis so/ /'di'i thig la/ las kyi thig dang / ye shes kyi thig gnyis/ thig skud ring bo'i phyogs dang / thung ngu'i phyogs gnyis rnams so/ /dum pa sta gon la/ rnam rgyal bum pa/ las kyi bum pa gnyis dang / rnam rgyal la yang dus 'khor lugs kyi dbang bum dang / rgyud gzhan gyi lugs gnyis dang /grangs ni lha grangs dang / lnga dang / gcig sogs su bshad do/ /slob ma sta gon la lha la gsol ba gdab pa/ sgos slob dpon dang las kyi rdo rjer lhag gnas bya ba/ slob ma lhag gnas bya ba/ dkyil 'khor bteg cing rmi ltas ngan na bzlog thabs bya ba ste bzhi/ slob ma lhag gnas dngos la lnga/ kun slong bcos shing nang dbang bskur ba/ gsol ba gdab cing 'dzin du 328

gzhug pa/ sdom pa gzung zhing byin gyis brlabs pa/ so shing dor zhing khyor chu sogs gaspum sbyin pa/ spro ba bskyed cing bsrungs te rmi lam brtag par gdams pa'o/ /khyor chu/ ku sha dpung skud do/ /thi lam ngan pa bzlog thabs ni/ gtor ma/ bsrungaX'akhor/ bzlas pa/ go cha'i lha dgongs pa/gsol ba gdab pa/ rgyan drug bgos nas lha'i nga rgyal bya ba/ sbyin sreg ste bdun no/ /dngos gzhi'i cho ga la/ ye thig gdab cing tshon dgye ba/ bum pa dgod cing dkyil 'khor brgyan pa/ bskrubasaXshing mchod nas dbang bskur ba ste gsum/ phyi ma la dkyil 'khor baspub pa/ dkyil 'khor mchod pa/ dbang bskur ba'i cho ga ste gsum/ dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa la bdag mdun tha dad dang tha mi dad kyi lugs gnyis/ yang bsgrub rgyu'i dkyil 'khor la/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor/ ras ris kyi dkyil 'khor/ bsam gtan gyi dkyil 'khor/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor te bzhi/ mchod pa la/mchod pa dngos/ chad lhag zhi bar byas shing bskor nas sgo dbye ba dang gnyis/ mchod pa dngos la nang du dkyil 'khor gyi lha mchod pa/ phyi rol du gtor ma'i mchod pa ste gnyis/ lha mchod pa la/ chu bzhi/ nyer spyod lnga/rig ma bzhi'am/ lnga'am/ drug gam/ brgyad dam/ bcu drug 'dod yon lnga/ rgyal srid snaXbadun/ bkra shis rtags brgyad/ bla bre/ gdugs/ rgyal mtshan la sogs phyi mchod/ nang mchod/ gsang mchod/ de kho na nyid kyi 329

mchod pa/ sngags kyi mchod pa/ bstod pa rnams so/ /dbang bskur ba'i cho ga la rang nyid zhugs shing dbang blangs nas gdang ba nod pa/ dngos grub zhu zhing bden pa'i byin brlab bya ba/ slob ma la dbang bskur ba ste gsum/ phyi maXl dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa/ zhugs pa la dbang bskur ba/dbang gi mtha' brten gyi cho ga ste gsum/ gzhug pa la gdong g.yogs dang bcas te gzhug pa/ dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i bdag nyid can du gzhug pa gnyis/ snga ma la yol ba'i phyi 'jug dang / nang 'jug gnyis/nang 'jug la nang du gzhug cing bskor nas phyag bya ba/ dam la bzhag pa/ye shes pa phab nas bden pa brjod pa ste gsum/ zhugs pa la dbang bskur ba la bzhi las/ dang po bum pa'i dbang la/ thun mong ba rdo rje slob ma'i dbang / thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gnyis/ thun mong ba la mi bskyod pa chu'i dbang / rin chen 'byung ldan cod pan gyi dbang / 'od dpag med rdo rje'i dbang / don yod grub pa dril bu'i dbang / rnam par snang mdzad ming gi dbang ste lnga/ slob dpon gyi dbang la/ rdo rje/ dril bu/ phyag rgya'i dam tshig ste dam tshig gsum sbyin pa/ de gsum bzung zhing de nyid bstan pa/ mtha' brten gyi cho ga ste gsum/ phyi ma la sngags gtad pa'i cho ga mig sman gyi cho ga me long gi dbang gi cho gamada' 'phang ba'i cho ga rnams so//gnyis pa gsang dbang la/ rig ma dadul zhing gsol ba gdab pa/330

'od dpag med du bskyed pa/ gsang rdzas gnyis kyis dbang bskur ba/dbang gi dag pa sbyin pa rnams so/ /gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang la/ yon dadul ba/ gsol ba gdab pa/ rig ma gtad pa/ lhar bskyed pa/ mkha' gsang brlab pa/stoms par zhugs nas lhan skyes bskyed pa/ byangaXsems btung ba/ dbang gi don bshad pa dmas so/ /bzhi ba dbang bzhi ba ni/ tshig dbang ngo / /mtha' brten gyi cho ga ni/rig ma'i brtul zhugs sbyin pa/ rdo rje'i brtul zhugs sbyin pa/ spyod pa'i brtul zhugs sbyin pa/ lung bstan pa/ rjes gnang / dadugs dbyung rnams so/ /'di'i sta gon dang / dngos bzhi'i skor rnams rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbang du byas kyi/ dkyil 'khor gzhan du dbang bskur na 'dor len ji ltar rigs par sbyar dgos kyang ming gi rnam grangs ni sngaXmar 'du'o/ /dus kyi 'khor lo'i lugs la gzhan rnams phal cher sngar dang 'dra zhing / byes pa ltar 'jug pa'i dbang bdun ni/ chu/ cod pan/ dar dpyangs/ rdo rje dril bu/ brtul zhugs/ ming / rjes gnang / 'dogs bcas te bdun no/ /dbang gong ma la kun rdzob 'jig rten pa'i dbang gong ma dang / nges don 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dbang gong ma gnyis/de re re la'ang bum pa'iXdabang sogs bzhi bzhi yod do/ /rdo rje slob dpon bdag po'i dbang la gsol ba gdab cing dbang stegs la bzhag pa/ chu 331

dbang sogs so sor bskur ba/ rnam dag bstan cing sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i dbang bskur sbyin pa rnams so/ /gzhan yang dbang bskur ba'i cho ga la/ lha la dbang bskur ba'i rabaXganas kyi cho ga dang / dbang gi yan lag gi cho ga lha mnyes par byed pa'i thabs sbyin sreg dang / mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i thabs tshogs 'khor/dpa' bo'i ston mo/ dpa' mo'i ston mo/ lag pa'i mchod pa/ lag pa la mchod pa sogs byed tshul dang / rig pa 'dzin pa'i cha lugs mi nyams shing bang ba'i dam tshig gi yan lag gtsug tor/ rigs lnga/ dpa' bo'i dar dpyangs/ stod g.yogs/ smad g.yogs/ cang te'u/ ṭa ma ru/ rdo rje/dril bu/ dgang gzar/ blug gzar/ rus pa'i rgyan drug ka pā la/ kha ṭa kastag lpags kyi sham thabs/ ro gdan/ tshangs skud la sogs pa rnams lugs 'di'i mkho ba'i yo byad do/ /snod du grur nas dam tshig dang sdom pa bsrung ba la/ rigs lnga'i dam tshig ni/ tshul khrims gsum gzung ba dang /skyabs su 'gro ba ni rnam snang gi dam tshig rdo rje/ dril bu/ phyag rgya/ slob dpon gzung ba ni mi bskyod pa'i dam tshig zang zing / chos/ mi 'jigs pa/ byams pa'i sbyin pa bzhi'am/ yang na nor/ nor gyi snying bo/ yan lagayan lag gi snying bo ste sbyin pa bzhi nyin re bzhin dus drug tu sbyin pa rin 'byung gi dam tshig phyi dang / gsang ba dang / theg pa gsum gyi chos bzung ba 'od dpag med kyi dam tshig mchod pa'i las la brtson pa ni don grub 332

kyi dam tshig go /rtsa lhung bcu bzhi ni/ rdo rje slob dpon la brnyas pa/ bde gshegs bka' las 'das pa/ rdo rje spun la khros nas nyes pa brjod pa/ sems can gang yang rung ba la byamasaXpa spong ba/ smon sems gtong ba/ rang gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha' la smod pa/ snod min la gsang ba ston pa/ rang gi phung bo la brnyas pa/ stong nyid la yid ma ches nas spong ba/ mngon spyod bya bar 'os pa'i yul la byams pa/ chos bdag med pa'i lta ba yod bzhin du ma bskyang bar zhag gcig 'da' ba/ dad pa dang ldan pa'i sems sun 'byin pa/ dam tshig giXrdzas dang rig ma sogs bsten nus bzhin du dang du mi len pa'am/ rnal 'byor rgyud ltar na rdor dril lag pa'i phyag rgya sogs smad nas 'dor ba gang rung / bud med spyi la smod tshig tu 'gro ba'i skyon brjod byed pa ste bcu bzhi'o/ /sbom po brgyad ni/ shes rab stobs kyis len pa/ de'i bdud rtsi stobs kyis len pa/ snod minaXl gsang rdzas dang phyag rgya ston pa/ tshogs kyi nang du rtsod pa/ dad ldan la dri ba'i don las gzhan du chos ston pa/nyan thos kyi nang du zhagaXbadun gnas pa/ rdzun gyis rnalaX'abyor nga rgyal byed pa/ dad pa medaXpa la chos ston pa ste brgyad do/ /gzhan yang der ma 'dus pa'i sbom po mtha' yas so/ /dus kyi 'khor lo las bshad pa ni 'di dang cung zhig mi 'dra yang ming gi rnam grangs ni phal cher der 'du'o/ /333

rgyud dag par byas nas nyams su len pa'i rim pa la/ bskyegapa'i rim pa dang / rdzogs pa'i rim pa gnyis las/ dang po bskyed rim la/ spang bya ni/tha mal snod bachud kyi snang ba dang zhen pa'o/ /gnyen po ni rten brten pa'i gsal snang dang nga rgyal lo/ /bsgom pa'i gnas skabs ni/ las dang po ba/ye shes cung zad babs pa/ ye shes la cung zad dbang ba/ ye shes la yang dag par dbang ba ste bzhi/ bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ rags pa dran pa gcig pa'i rnal 'byor dang / phra ba rtog pa'i rnal 'byor gnyis/ bskyed rim spyi'i chings la bsnyen bsgrub yan lag bzhi ni/ bsnyen pa/ nyer sgrub/sgrub pa/ sgrub pa chen po'o/ /rdo rje bzhi bskyed ni/ stong nyid byang chub rdo rje/ sa bon bsdus pa'i rdoXrje/ gzugs nyid rdzogs pa'i rdo rje/ yi ge dgod pa'i rdo rje ste bzhi'o/ /rnal 'byor bzhi ni/ rnal 'byor/ rjes su rnal 'byor/ shin tu rnal 'byor/rnal 'byor chen po'o/ /ting nge 'dzin gsum ni/ dang po sbyor ba/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog las rgyal mchog gi ting 'dzin no/ /mngon rtogs bsgo ma pa'i rim pa la/ mthun rkyen sgrub pa tshogs bsags pa/ 'gal rkyen sel ba bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa/ sngags gnyis brjod nas 'chi ba chos sku'i lam 'khyer bsgom pa/ rgyud rdo rje 'dzin pa bskyed nas bar do longs sku lam 'khyer bsgom pa/ 'bras du rdo rje 'dzin pa bskyed nas skye ba sprul sku'i lam 'khyer bsgom pa/ skye mched dam go cha'i lha lngags gang rung 334

dgod pa/ ye shes pa bstem pa/ dbang skur rgyas gdab byed pa/ mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba/ dag pa dran pa/ phraXthig bsgom pa/ bzlas pa byed pa/ gtor ma 'bul ba rnams te/ go rim ni mngon rtogs rnams las mi 'dra ba du ma byung ngo / /skad cig dkrong skyed ni/ skad cig gis bskyed pa'o/ /cho ga gsum bskyed ni/ sa bon/ phyag mtshan/ sku rdzogs pa las bskyed pa'o/ /mngonaXbyang lnga bskyed ni/ de bzhin nyid/ zla ba/ sa bon/phyag mtshan/ sku rdzogs pa las byang chub pa lnga'o/ /de dag thun gyi ngo bo la bsgom rgyu'i rim pa yin la/ thun mtshams kyi rnal 'byor la/ longs spyod dag pa'i rnal 'byor/ las dag pa'i rnal 'byor/ dam tshig dag pa'i rnal 'byor/ zas kyi rnal 'byor/ khrus kyi rnal 'byor/ nyal ba'i rnal 'byor/ldang ba'i rnal 'byor rnams su yod do/ /gnyis pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa la/'dus pa 'phags lugs kyi rdzogs rim ni/ lus dben/ ngag dben/sems dben/ sgyu lus/ 'od gsal/ zung 'jug ste rim pa drug dang / rim pa dang po gnyis gcig tu bgrang na rim pa lnga'o/ /ye shes zhabs lugs la/mi shigs pa'i thig le/ sprul ba'i thig le/ sngags kyi thig le/ de kho na nyid kyi thig le ste thig leXbazhi'o/ /'khor lo ched po'i rdzogs rim la/ lus byin brlab/ ngagaXbyin brlab/ sems byin brlab/ de kho na nyid byin brlab ste byid brlab bzhi'o/ /dmar nag 'jigs gsum la/ sngags kyi rnal 'byor/dam tshig gi rnal 'byor/ dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor/ rnam dag ye shes kyi 336

rnal 'byor te rnal 'byor bzhi'o/ /bde mchog lu nyi pa'i lugs la/ lte ba'i sprin sgra la sems gtod tshul dang / de las rdor bzlas bya tshul dang /lag rjes te gsum/ dril bu ba'i lugs la/ bdag byin brlab/ sna tshogs rdo rje/ nor bu 'gengs pa/ dza larnyi ra/ bsam mi khyab kyi rim pa ste rim pa lnga'o//bde dgyes thun mong ba'i rdzogs rim na ro chos drug la/ gtum mo/'od gsal/ sgyu lus/bar do/ 'pho ba/ grong 'jug ste lnga'o/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sbyor ba yan lag drug gi rdzogs rim ni/ so sor sdud pa/bsam gtan/ srog rtsol/ 'dzin pa/ rjes dran/ ting nge 'dzin gyi yan lag ste drug go /'di'i bsgrub bya'i gtso bo ni/ dmigs bcas stong gzugs phyag rgya chen po dang / dmigs med mchog tu mi 'grur ba'i bde ba ched po gnyis so/ /nye rgyu spyod pa ni/ spros bcas/ spros med/ shid tu spros med kyi spyod pa gsum/ las bsgrub pa la/ bzlas pa tsam gyis sgrub pa/bsam gtan tsam gyis sgrub pa/ rdzas kyis spub pa/ 'khrul 'khor gyi sgo nas sgrub pa/ sbyin sreg gi sgo nas sgrub pa sogs te/ re re la'ang zhi rgyas dbang drag bzhi re yod do/ /grub chen brgyad ni/ ril bu/ mig sman/ sa 'og ral gri/ nam mkhar 'phur ba/ mi snang ba/ 'chi ba med pa/ nad 'joms pa rnams so/ /mchog gi dngos grub ni/ mi slob pa'i zung 'jug kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang ngo / /'dir ni ming gi rnam grangs rags bsdus tsam yin la/ shin tu gsang ba'i gnas rnams 336

kyi ming ni dgag bya che bas 'dir ma bkod do/ /de ni gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i gzhungaXlas byung ba'i ming gi rnam grangs mdor bsdus pa'o/ /bzhe ba basba rig pa'i ga'ung las 'byung ba'i ming gi rnam grangs la/spyir rig gnas thams cad bzo rig pa'i khongs su 'du bar bshad pa'ang yod cing / 'dul ba lung las bshad pa'i rig gnas bco brgyad ni/ gsang sngags kyi rgyud/ cho ga zhib mo/ gtan tshigs rig pa/ rig byed/brda sprod pa/ sgra nges par sbyor ba/ shes gsal/ nges pa'i tshig sdeb sbyor bsdus pa/ skar ma'i rib pa/ rtog byed kyi rig pa/ chur lhung gi rig pa/cher spyod kyi rig pa/ 'jig rten rgyang 'phen pa'i rig pa/ bye brag pa'i rig pa/ rgyud drug cu ba/ khyur mid kyi rig pa/ gnas 'dug gi rig pa ste bco brgyad do/ /sgyu rtsal drug cu rtsa bzhi la bzo la sogs par gtogs pa sum cu ni/ yi ge lag rtsis/ grangs/ rtsis chen thor tshugs/ gom stabs/lcags kyusaXsgyur thabs/ ral gri'i thabs/ zhags pa gdab pa/ mda' bo che 'phen pa/ mdun du bsnur ba/ phyir bsnur ba/ bcad pa/ dral ba/dbug pa/ rgyang nas 'phog pa/ sgra grag par 'phog pa/ gnad du 'phog pa/mi 'chor bar 'phog pa/ tshabs che bar 'phog pa/ mchongasaXpa/ gyad kyi 'dzing stangs/ bang / rkyal/ brgal ba/ glang po che'i gnyar zhod pa/ rta laXzhod pa/ shing rta'i bzo thabs/ mda' gzhu'i bzo thabs/ 'gyed stobs dang sum cu'o/ /rol mo'i bye brag bco brgyad ni/ bro/ rnga bo che/ rdza rnga/ rnga 337

phran/ rdza rnga chen po/ 'khar rnga/ pi wang rgyud gcig pa/ rdza rnga kha gcig pa/lcags kyi sil khrol/ 'khar ba'i sil khrol/ pi wang rgyud gsum pa/ rnga mu kurnya/ sil snyan glu dbyangs dang bsnyun pa/ pheg rdob/ — rol mo'i sgra/ pi wang / gling du dang bco brgyad do/ /glu dbyangs kyi nges pa bdun ni/ bar ma ba/ drang srong ba/ sa 'dzin pa/ drug ldan/ lnga ba blo gsal/ 'khor nyan dang bdun no/ /gar gyi cha byad dgu ni/ sgeg pa/ dpa' ba/ mi sdug pa/ drag shul/bzhad gad/ 'jigs su rung ba/ snying rje/ rngam pa/ zhi ba dang dgu'o/ /gzhan yang / mtheb kyis sha non pa/ rkyal gyis chu chen chod pa/ yang rtsal bya lta bu ste lus rtsal gsum/ lo rgyus kyis dge thon pa/ gtam gyis bzhad gad thon pa/ shags kyis pha rol gnon pa ste ngag gi rtsal gsum/ mdzangs la blo 'gyu ba/ dpa' la bsran tshugs pa/ kha gsal zhing gting mi rtogs pa ste yid kyi rtsal gsum dang bcas pa'i pho rtsal sna dgu dang / gtam yig rtsis gsum/ mda' rdo mchong gsum/ bang rkyal sbe gsum ste pho rtsed sna dgu rnams kyang bzo rig par gtogs so/ /lus bzo mchog ni sku gaspung thugs rten bzhengs pa sogs yin la/ ngag bzo mchog niXsngags bzla ba/chos 'chad pa/ rtsod pa/ rtsom pa sogs dang / yid bzo mchog ni ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab kyi rtsal sbyong ba'o/ /lus bzo phal ba ni/ rgya mtsho chen por bgrod pa'i gru gzings chen po/ chu gzhan la bgrod pa'i gru chung /338

khang khyim/ khang brtsegs/ khang mig lnga brgya ba/ bza' btung gi g.yos/gos rgyan gyi khyad par/ ngo mtshar ba'i sbyoraXb thang rdzong gzhig pa rdo'i 'khrul 'khor te sgrogs/ chu rdzong 'joms pa gru'i 'khrul 'khor/ ri rdzong 'joms pa me'i 'khrul 'khor/ ral gri 'khor ba gri gug gi 'khrul 'khor/rtse mo 'gyed pa rlung gi 'khrul 'khor/ rtsig pa 'jig pa gur gyiX'akhrul 'khor/ go chaX'ajig pa lcags mda'i 'khrul 'khor rnams dang / rang phyogs basprung ba ral gri'i 'khrul 'khor/ rgyal rigs 'thab pa shing rta'i tshad/ ltad mo la 'gro ba'i don du khang bzang gi mtshan nyid/ dga' ston gyi don du khyogs kyi mtshan nyid/ ldum ra bcu ba'i don du chu gyen du 'dren pa'i 'khrul 'khor bzo ba rnams so/ /ngag bzo phal ba la/ gdangs dbyangs/ gyer dbyangs/ glu len pa sogs la/ 'gyur/ khugs/ 'degs/ 'jog sbom/ phra ste drug dang ldan pas snyan pa/ brjid pa/ rngam pa sogs so/ /yid bzo phal ba ni/ sa gzhi/rid po che/ ljon shing / gos/ glang po che/ rta/ skyes pa/ bud med/ gnas khang / mtshan brtags pa rnams dang / rgyal srid skyong ba/ phal ba'i gnyen skyong ba/ dgra 'dul ba/ nor 'phel ba sogs kyi thabs la dpyad cing sems pa'o/ /khyad par du gtsug lag rtsis kyi skor ni/ bdag cag gi ston pa sngon drang srong rnga bong du skye ba bzhes pa'i tshe/ lo/ zla ba/ dus bzhi/gza'/ skar ma sogs kyi go rim mdzad par grags la/ rtsod dus 'dir 339

ston pa thub pa'i dbang bos lcags pho 'brug lo nag pa nya ba'i yar tshes bco lnga la/ ṭī ṅgā n+ya ka ṭa kar/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i skur bzhengs te gsungs pa'i dpal dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi rgyud las bshad pa ni/ snod kyi 'jig rten chags tshul la/ rlung dkyil/ me dkyil/ chu dkyil/ sa dkyil rnams zlum po/ de'i dbus su lhun po dpangs su dpag tshad 'bum phrag gcig yod pa/ dbyebs klum po rdo rje lta du rwa lnga dang ldan pa/ kha dog shar phyogs in+d+ra dī la sngon po/ lho phyogs pad+ma rā ga dmar bo/ nub phyogs karke ta ser bo/ byang phyogs chu shel dkar bo/ dbus mar gad ljang gu'o/ /lhun po nas khor yug bsil ri'i bar/ dpag tshad stong phrag bcu drug yod pa'i sa'i dkyil 'khor cha mnyam bco brgyad du phye ba'i cha re la gling drug mtsho drug ri drug spel te gnas pa'i gling drug ni nang nas rim pa bzhin/ zla ba dang / 'od dkar dang / rab mchog ku sha dang / mi'am ci dang / khrungaXkhrung dang / drag po'i gling zhes pa'i ming can drug go /mtsho drug ni nang nas rim pa bzhin/ sprang rtsi dang / mar dang / zho dang / 'o ma dang / chu dang / chang gi rgya mtsho'i ming can drug go /ri drug ni nang nas rim pa bzhin/ 'od sngon dang / man da ra dang / ni ṣa ṭa dang / nor bu'i 'od dang / dre ṇa dang / bsil ri zhes bya ba'i ming can drug ste/ de rnams ni longs spyod kyi sa pa dang / bablol ri nasaXchu dkyil gyi nang mtha'i bar ni gling bdun pa 'dzam gling chen po las kyi sa pa zhes bya zhing / de yang 340

lhun po'i phyogs 'tshams kyi cha bcu gnyis la gling bcu gnyis te/ shar gling zla gam/ lho gling gru gsum/ nub gru bzhi/ byang klum po ste rlung me sa chu'i rang bzhin gyi rten 'brel las grub pa'o/ /'ga' zhig gis shar gling zum po dang / byang gling zla gam du bshad la/ gling re re yang gling g.yog gnyisaXre dang bcas pas dum bu bcu gnyis so/ /de'i phyi rol du lan pa'i rgya mtsho dang /de'i phyi rol du rdo rje'i ri rnams yod par bshad do/ /lho gling dbus ma 'di nyid kyang cha drug tu bye ba la/ gangs ldan/ shasta la/ rgya nagali/ bod/ 'phags yul rnams ni dngos grub kyi sa par bshad/ rlung dkyil nas sa dkyil byed man du daspyal ba/ sa byed steng ma la gong 'og gnyis las 'og mar klu/ gong ma la lha min/ sa'i steng du 'gro ba mi/ lhun po'i rtse mor rgyal chen bzhi dang / mgrin pa'i sum cha man la 'dod lha gzhan mas gnas/ de nas gtsug tor gyi 'og gi bar la gzugs khams gnas rigs bcu bdun dang / de nas gtsug tor gyi rtse'i bar du gzugs med rigs bzhi gnas so/ /de dag kyang bsdu na rigs drug gam rigs lngar 'du la/ khams gsum/ 'jig rten gsum/ srid paXgasum/ sa gsum rnams su 'du'o/ /de dag gi gzhal byed kyang rdul phra rab/ phra mo/skra rtse/ ske tshe/shig nas/ sor mo rnams rim bzhin brgyad 'gyur/ sor mo nyi shu la khru gang / khru bzhi la gzhu 'dom/ de nyis stong la rgyang grags/ de bzhi la dpag tshad gcig go /skye 'gro de dag gi tshe tshad gzhal byed kyi lo 341

ni/ skyes bu nad med kyi dbugs grangs sum brgya dang drug cur chu tshod gcig de drug cur zhag gcig de sum cu la zla ba/ de bcu gnyis la lo zhes bshad/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs ni/ thog ma'i mgonaXpo/ dang po'i sangs rgyas/ gdod ma'i mgon po/ rigs med pa/ rnam kun mchog ldan/ gnyis med ston pa/ bzhi ldan pa/ shes ldan/ shes bya'i bdag nyid mchog 'pho med/ bden dod rnam pa bcu gnyis can/ phyi nang gzhan gsum bdag nyid can/ dpal ldan rgyu skar dkyil 'khor gtsoXbo rnams so/ /sham+bha lar/ yul chen dgu bcu rtsa drug rgyal phran go drug dbus su chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i sar mi 'jigs gdong lnga'i khri la/ chos rgyal zla bzang / lha dbang / gzi brjid can/ zla bas byin/ lha'i dbang phyug sna tshogs gzugs/ lha'i dbang ldan te chos rgyal bdun/ rigs ldan grags pa/ pad+ma dkar bo/ bzang bo/ rnam rgyal/ bshes gnyen bzang bo/ rin chen phyag khyab 'jug sbas pa/ nyiXm grags pa/ shin tu bzang bo/ rgya mtsho rnam rgyal/ rgyal dka'/ nyi ma/ sna tshogs gzugs/ zla 'od/ mtha' yas/sa skyong / dpal skyong / seng ge rnams byon zin gyi rigs ldanaXdang / da lta seng ge'i khri la rnam gnon gyi zhabs zung bkod nas chos ston pa/ slar stobs po che/ ma 'gags pa mi yi seng ge dbang phyug chen po/ mtha' yas/drag po rnams 'byon 'gyur gyi rigs ldan/ drag po 'khor lo can gyi dus sbar yang 'dzin mar rdzogs ldan 'char ro /342

nam mkha'i go la ni/ go la zhes pa'i sgra/ sgang gshong / lci yang /sbubs khong / sprum po rnams la 'jug pas khyim gyi 'khor lo klum po'i tshal gyis 'khor ba laXkhyim gyi go la zhes zer ro/ /de yang khyim rnams sgang gshongs su gnas par/ g.yas skor rgyu lam rags par yin/ khyim rer rgyu skar gyi rkang ba dgu re/ rkang ba rer chu tshod bco lnga re/ de yang tha skar/bra nye/ smin drug gi bzhi cha gcig gi bar lug khyim/ smin drug gi rkang ba gsum dang / snar ma/ mgo'i phyed bar glang khyim/ mgo'i phyed/ laganabs so'i bzhiXcha gaspum gyi bar 'khrig pa'i khyim/ nabs so'i rkang gcigargya la/ skag gi bar karka ṭa'i khyim/ mchu/ gre/ dbo yi rkang ba gcig gi b.raXseṅge'i khyim/ dbo yi rkang gsum/ me bzhi nag pa'i phyed kyi bar bu mo'i khyim/ nag pa'i byed/ sa ri/ sa ga'i rkang gsum gyi b.raXsrang gi khyim/sa ga'i rkang gcig lha mtshams/ skrun gyi bar sdig pa'i khyem/ snubs/ chu stod/ chu smad kyi rkang gcig gi bar gzhu'i khyem/ chu smad kyi rkang gsum/ gro bzhin/ mon dre'i byed bar chu srin khyem/ mon dre'i byed/ mon gru/ khrumasaXstod rkang gsum gyi bar bum pa'i khyim/ khrums stod rkang gcig khrums smad/ nam gru'i bar rnams nya'i khyim mo/ /nabs so'i bzhi gsum thog nyi ma skyes/ tha skar gyi thog mar zla ba/ mchu'i phyed du mig dmar/ lha mtshams kyi phyed du lhag pa/ me bzhi'i thog mar phur bu/ nabs so'i thog mar pa sangs/ snabs kyi thog mar spen pa/ nag pa'i byed thog sgra gcan gdong /343

nam gru'i mtha' la mjug ma rnams skyes so/ /khyem gyi mtho sar skar ma brtan pa dang / dma' sar ri byi gnas/ gzhan yang mtho sar spe bdun/dma' sar spen pa gnas so/ /lo'i ming / zla ba'i phreng ba/ 'dor byed/dus tshigs/ bgrang bya/ 'gro 'ong / bgrang gzhi/ dus kyi cha shas can rnams so/ /rab byung / rnam byung / dkar po/ rab myos/ skyes bdag aji ra/ dpal gdong / dngos po/ na tshod ldan/ 'dzin byed/ dbang phyug 'bru mang / sbos ldan/ rnam gnon/ khyu mchog sna tshogs/ nyi ma/ nyi sgrol byed/ sa skyong / mi zad/ thams cad 'dul/ kun 'dzin/ 'gal ba/ rnam 'gyur/bong bu/ dga' ba/ rnam rgyal/ rgyal ba/sbos byed/ gdong ngan/ gser 'phyang /rnam 'phyang / sgyur byed/ kun ldan/ 'phar ba/ dge byed/ mdzes byed/ khro mo/sna tshogs dbyig zil gnon/ spre'u/ phur du/ zhi ba/ thun mong / 'gal byed/yongs 'dzin/ bag med/ kun dga'/ srin po/ me/ dmar ser can/ dus kyi pho nya/ don grub/ drag po/ blo ngan/ rnga chen/ khrag skyug mig dmar/ khro bo/zad pa rnams so/ /lo bsags pas bskal ba/ rdzogs ldan/ sum ldan/gnyis ldan/ rtsod ldan no/ /lo'i yan lag lo'i cha shas/ dbugs skyes/ lo yi mdzod/ zhag gi phung bo rnams zla ba'i ming / zla ba dang po la/mchu zla/mā gha/ rta zla/ dka' thub zla ba/ 'du byed zla ba/ kam pa/ cho 'phrul rnams so/ /gnyis pa la/ khra zla/ dbo zla/ 'bras ldan/ro nyi ta/ phalgu ṇa/ sbo zla rnam shes zla ba rnams so/ /gsum pa la/ nag zla/ sbrang zla/ sbos byed/ dri zhim 344

ldan/ yid srubs zla ba/ 'dod dus zla/ ming gzugs zla/ tsi tra/ mo ha ti rnams so/ /bzhi ba la/ sa ga zla ba/me tog ldan/ sgrub byed/ sprang rtsiXbaskyed/be sha kha/ bha dra/ skye mched zla ba rnams so/ /lnga ba la/ ston zla/ des srega'adod 'phel/ rig pa zla ba/ ri ṣa bha/ dag byed/ joṣ+ṭha/ gtsang ma rnams so/ /drug pa la/ chu stod can/ gtsang ma'i zla ba/ ā ṣa rnya/ tshor ba'i zla/kurma rnams so/ /bdun pa la/ gro bzhin zla ba/ ma ka ra/ nam mkha'i thod ldan/sbos zla/ sred pa'i zlaXb/ shu ba ṇa rnamasaXso/ /brgyad pa la/ khrums zla/ nor ldad/ khyu mchog can/ bzang zla/ba glang rkang /bha dra ba/ sprin bzang can/dartse/ len pa'i zla ba rnams so/ /dgu ba la/ tha skar zla ba/ ltad sbyor/ rtsi thog zla ba/a shra ni/ mi ki ri/ glu dbyangs/ srid pa'i zla ba/ rgod ma can/ltad mo'i zla baXrnams so/ /bcu ba la/ smin drug zla ba/ mang bo 'dzin/ karte ka mgo las skyes/ skye ba'i zla ba/ jisbyi/ sa ga skyes rnams so/ /bcu gcig pa la/ mgo zla/ mṛg shi r+ṣa/ ri dwags mgo smal bo'i zla/ tshim byed/ rga shi zla ba/ nus ldan rnams so/ /bcu gnyis pa la/ rgyal zla/ tshim byed/ po ṣa/ ma rig swasna/ me tog ldan/ nus zla ba rnams so/ /lo ni byi ba/ glang / stagayos/ 'brug sbrul/ rta/ lug spre'u/ bya/ khye/ phag rnams 'byung ba shing me sa lcags chu ste reXre la yang lnga lnga ste lo drug cu'o/ /de yang tshes gcig nas bco lnga'i bar la dkar phyogs/ zla tshes zhi rgyas phyogs/ yar ngo / phyogs kyi dang po'o/ /tshes bcu drug nas gnam gang 345

bar la/ dmar phyogs/ 'byung bo 'du/ dam can 'du/ phyogs kyi phyi ma/dbang drag po'i phyogs/ mar ngo'o/ /nyi ma lho bgrod dang / byang bgrod gnyis so sor lo rer 'dzid pa dang / nyi ma'i khyim zhag sum brgya drukaXcu dang / nyin zhag sum brgya dang drug cu re lnga chu tshod rjes 'brang / tshes zhag sumaXbargya don gcig chu tshod rjes 'brang dang bcas par lor 'dzin pa gnyis so/ /skabs 'dir dus ni bzhir nges te/ dpyid/ dbyar/ ston/dgun/ de re re la/ ra ba/ dzabring bo/ tha chung gsum gsum mo/ /dkar phyogs la/ nam mkha'/ rlung / me/ chu/ sa rnams gsum skor/ nag phyogs la/ sa/ chu/ me/ rlung / nam mkha' rnams gsum skor/ dkar phyogs la/'dod yon/ sgra/ reg ro/ gzugs/ dri lnga/ nag phyogs la/ dri1 gzugs/ ro/reg sgra rnamasaXlan gsum 'khor/ dga'/ bzang / rgyal stong / rdzogs pa lnga dang / dar/ rgud/ byis/ gzhon/ lang tsho/ rgan/ smin rnams chags gnyis kar gsum 'khor/ nam langs skyes bu'i lag ris mngonaXpa nas ri rtse nyi nub bar la/ nyin mo/ mdangs gsar/ gsal snang / pad+ma bzhad/ mun sel/snang ba ldan ces so/ /nyi nub nas tho rangs bar la/ nges nyal/mun bcas/nyal dus/ thun gsum/ ku mud bzhad/ mtshan mo'o/ /khyim ni/ lug glang /'khrig pa/ karka ṭa seṅge/ bu mo/ srang / sdig pa/ gzhu/ chu srin/ dum pa/ nya rnams/ nyi ma gar gnas pa'i sa nas rim par nyin zhag phrug gcig la lan re 'khor ba'o/ /346

gza' ni/ nyi ma la/ tsha zer/ sna tshogs shing rta/ mi sbyin skyes/ pad+ma'i gnyen/ dus kyi bdag po/nun pa'i dgra/ 'jig rten mig dus la dga'/'gro ba'i sgron me/ bcuXganyis bdag po/ lo yi shing rta/ ku nud dgra/ srid pa'i sgron me/ nyin byed/ snang byed/ 'od byed/ dam mkha' nor/ rta ljang can/ gza'i bdag po/ 'od stong 'bar/ 'od ldan/ nun sel/ nyin mo'i nor/ 'od gzung / 'od 'byin/ nyin mo 'dren/ bsrub byed/'od gtsang / wa ru ṇa/ 'od 'gro/ rgyas byed/ mkha' 'gro/ rnam sgyur/ 'gro lus/ gsal nor/cha ldan/ nges bsreg 'od zer ldan/ 'od rgyun/ phyogs snang byed/ gdung byed/tsha byed/ rnam snang byed/ nun 'joms/ 'dam skyes mtshan/ mchod ldan/phyogs bdag mchog 'dod/ char 'bebs/ 'dzin byed/ snang ba'i nu khyud/snang ldan/ mig gzugs gsal byed/ 'od 'gyed/ bsten bya/ bdud las rgyal/ ma klum/ 'phrog byed/ rtsen pa/ phyogs dgod byed/ gtum po'i 'od/'od kyi skra can/ sna tshogs 'od/ snang ba'i mdzod/ nor gyi mdzod/ rgyu ba'i brtul zhugs/ mdza' bshes/ mchod 'os/ 'od kyi nor can/ pad+ma'i lag pa/ rtag 'char/ rig byed 'byung / las sna tshogs/ khyab byed/ 'thungaXbyed/'od phreng can/ mig gzugs/ 'od snang / 'od stong 'dzin/ khri can/ long ba'i kha lo ba/ lam ston/ srid byed/ shing rta mtho/ dbyig gi khu ba/ rlum po 'dzin/ dus kyi byed po/ nam mkha'i mig 'jig rten spang po/ 'od kyi phung po/ 'od zer gzugs mang / nam mkha'i tog phyogs kyi nu khyud/ tshangs 347

pa'i rta/ dam mkha'i thig le/ sna tshogs 'od/ rta bdun pa rnams nyi ma'o/ /zla ba la/ ri bong can/ rgya mtsho dga'/ tshes bdag bsil byed/bsil zer can/ chags skyed/ 'od dkar/ bdud rtsi 'od/ drag po'i gtsug rgyan/ ga bur 'dzin/ bsil ldan/ 'tsho byed/ rgya mtsho skyes/ mtshan mo'i bdag po/ mig gsum 'dzid/mig gaspum gtsug nor/ snar ma'i bdag po/ ri dwags mtshan/ ri bong mtshan ma/ sgrib byed/ rdul gyi thig le/ shar gyi thig le/ gnyis skyes rgyal/ gza'i nu khyud/ ri bong 'dzin/ rgyu skar mru khyud/rgyu skar gtso/ rgya mtsho mar gsar/ kha ba'i 'od/ srid byed/ ri dwags sna 'dzin/ bdud rtsi spro/ grib ma'i lus/ rta dkar/ chu skyes/ steng phar/gsher ldan/ bi ku shra/ pad+ma'i dgra/ mtshan mo'i mgon po rnams so/ /mig dmar la/ bkra shis/ lus dmar/ sa'i bu/ gzhon nu/ sa skyes/yan lag dmar/ 'od zer dgu ba/ chu stong skyes/ rtsibs ldan/ sa byung /mkha' steng 'gro/ dmag dpon rnams so/ /lhag pa la/ zla skyes/ zla bu/ lus gcig pa/ mdza' lha'i grogs po/ sngo bsangs lus/ snar ma skyes/ lha mtshams skyes/ rgyal po'i bu/ gsal ldan/thos ldad skyes/ tshim byed skyes/mkhas pa rnams so/ /phur du la/sgra mkhan/ blo ldan/me bzhi skyes/ tshig bdag sgra mkhas/lha'i slob dpon/ sna tshogs gtsug rgyan/ rig byed bdag gre skyes/ 'tsho byed/ smra 348

mkhas/ bcu gnyisaX'od 'pho/ nyi rigs skyes/ mtho ris thob/ 'bar ba ldan/rtsub ldan/ shin tu gsal ba'i gcung / tshig ldan/ mig ldan/ dpyod ldan/lha'i bla ma rnams so/ /pa sangs la/ snyan ngag mkhan/ ngan spongaXdu/ lha min bla ma/ mchu skyes/lha min bdag po/ ngan spong 'dzin/ ngan las rgyal/ tshig brgya'i dbang bo/bcu drug 'od ldan/ dkar bo/ khu ba rnams so/ /spen pa la/ nyi ma'i bu/ dal bar 'gro/ nyi skyes/ tshangs skyes/ rjes su skyes/ 'od zer bdun pa/ mi bzad mig gshin rje'i bdag po/ dbyeXba'i bu/ 'khyog 'gro/ gos sngon can rnams so/ /sgra gcan la/ bsod nams ldan pa/ nun pa can/ mtho ris snang byed/gza'i rna ba/ mgo rlum/lam nag zla ba'i dgra/ seṅge mo'i bu/ zla ba 'joms/nye bar 'phar 'gro/ sha za/ sprin las rnam rgyal/ bra nye skyes/ khams gsum rnam rgyal rnams so/ /de'i mjug ma la/ mig sman mdog can/ nyi zla za/ dus kyi me/ spyang ki sna tshogs mdog can rnams so/ /du ba mjug ring la/ phod can/ mjug phod can/ gtsug phod can/ sprul can/ skag las skyes/ skra gnyis pa rnams so/ /rgyu skar nyer brgyad la/ gro bzhin/ byi bzhin gnyis longs spyod gcig pas rgyu skar nyer bdun la/ skar chung re'i rjes 'brang yod/ phal ba'i skar ma dung phyur gnyis bye ba brgyad sa ya lnga yod/ de yang tha skar la/ gsal ba'i bu mo/rta ldan ma/ dbyu gu zhes so/ /za nye la/ gshin rje ma/ sgeg mo'o/ /smin drug la/ mang bo garti/ ma drug bu'o/ /snar ma la/ be rdzi/349

dal ba'i lha ldan ma/ skye dgu'i bdag po'o/ /mgo la/ smal bo/ mgo skyes/ ri dwags mgo zla skyes so/ /lag la/ nag mo/ drag mo/ drag shul ma/ dmag dpon dgra'o//nabs so la/sbyin mo'iXlha mo/shu kra ma/ rgyal stod do//rgyal la/bla ma'i lha ldan/ sbyor ldan ma/ grub pa/ tshim byed do/ /skag la/ gdengs can lha mo/ wa zhes so/ /mchu la/ pha mes lha skyes/ snyan ngagaXmakhan/ rta chen no/ /gre la/ rta chung / 'tsho ba/ skyes pa'o/ /dbo la/ phyi mo/ nyi ma'i lha ldan/ khra/sbo'o/ /me bzhi la/ rig byed/ bya ma 'don no/ /nag pa la/ bye'u/ brgyad ldan ma/ zla ba'i thog ma'o/ /sa ri la/ rlung gi lha mo/ rlung gi dbang phyug swāste'o/ /sa ga la/ be shā khā/ rgyud ldan ma/ dbang bo'i lha ldan no/ /lha mtshams la/lag sor/ a nu rā rnya/ sa ga la/ be shā khā/ rgyud ldan ma/ dbang bo'i lha ldan no//lha mtshams la/ lag sor/ a nu rā rnya/ mdza' bo'i lha'o/ /sgron la/ lde'u/gang bu/ lha dbang ldan/ dz+re ṣ+ṭha'o/ /snabs la/ snyu la/ gru sog ma/ rtsa ba'o/ /chu stod la/ bre/ bu zuṣa dzha / chu lha ldan no/ /chu smad la/ ut+ta ra ṣa lho/ phul/sna tshogs lha ldan no/ /gro bzhid la/ shu wa ṇa/ ḍa8phrog byed/ bon po'o/ /byiXbazhin la ming gzhan med/ mon dre la/ nam mthong / thob ldan ma/ dha ni ṣ+ṭha'o/ /mon gru la/ chu'i lha mo/ sgrog nam mthong 'og sha ta rnyi ṣa'o/ /khrums stod la/ bya mchu/ ra yi lha mo/ gnas ma'o//khrums smad la/ at+ta ra bha dra bā/ze'u/ sprul/ 'chings so/ /dam gru la/ bso ba'i lha mo/ re ba ti/ shes pa/rgyas byed do/ /'phrod chen ni/ kun dga'/ dus kyi dbyig pa/ dul ba/ skye 360

rgu/ gzhon/ bya rob rgyal mtshan/ dpal be'u/ rdo rje/ tho ba/ gdugs/grogs/ yid/ 'dod rgyal/ 'gal me/ rtsa bton/ 'chi bdag mda'/ grub pa/ mdung / bdud rtsi/ gtun shing / glang po/ rtag sbos/ zad pa/ g.yo ba/brtan pa/ 'phel ba'o/ /sbyor ba ni/ sel ba/ mdza' bo/ tsheXldan/ skal bzang / bzang bo/ shin tu skrangs dang rab sgrangs rab stong rnams dod gcig las bzang / 'dzin pa/ gzer dang zug rngu don gcig 'bras/'phel ba/ nges pa/ kun 'joms dang rma ched don gcig dga' ba/ rdo rje/dngos grub/ kun brdung / dpa' bo/ yongs bsnun dang yongs 'joms don gcig zhi ba/ grub pa/ baspub bya/ dge ba/ dkar po/ tshangs pa/dbang po/ 'khon 'dzin dang sha 'khon don gcig byed pa ni/ gdab pa/byisaXpa/ rig pa can/ til brdung / khyim skyes/ tshong ba/ biṣ+ṭi ste bdun ni/tshes gcig gi phyi cha nas nyer dgu'i snga cha'i bar lan bzhi re 'khor ba dang / nyer dgu'i phyi cha nas/ shad+ku ni/rkang bzhi/ klu/ mi sdug pa bzhi/ tshes gcig gi snga cha'i bar lan re 'khor ba yin no//rten 'brel ni/ ma rig pa/'du byed/ rnam shes/ ming gzugs/ skye mched/ regaXpa/ tshor ba/ sred pa/len pa/ srid pa/ skye ba/ rga shi rnams so//grangs ni/ ri bong cad/ zla ba/gzugs/ 'od dkar can/ bse ruXrnams gcig gi ming / 'khrig pa/bgrod pa/ thabs shes/ mtshe ma/ lag pa/ mig zung rnams gnyis gyi ming /'jig rten/ tsha ba/rtse mo/ me/ yon tan/ srid pa rnams gsum gyi ming / rgya 351

mtsho/ chu bo/ rig byed/ bdud/ sde ba/ chu gter rnams bzhi'i ming /'dod yon/ nyeraXspyod/ dbang bo/ mda'/ phung bo/ 'byung ba rnams lnga'i ming / ro/ dus/ mtshams/ bro / rgyan/ bzang bo rnams drug gi ming /rin chen/ sa 'dzin/ thub pa/ ri bo/ drang srong / gza'/ rta noms bdun gyi ming / bkra shis/ lha/ klu/ nor/ gdengs can nor lha/ sto 'gro rnams brgyad kyi ming / rtsa/ srin po/ bu ga gter rnams dgu'i ming / khro bo/'byor ba/ phyogs/ 'jug pa/ stobs/ sor mo bcu'i ming / bde byed/bde 'byung / dbang phyug drag po/ byed pa rnams bcu gcig gi ming / nyi ma/ rten 'brel/ khyem ni bcu gnyis kyi ming / 'dod pa/ lus med/ myos byed/ sna tshogs/ gdugs rim bcu gsum gyi ming / srid/ yid/ ma nu/shed bu bcu bzhi'i ming / tshes/ nyin zhag bcoXlnga'i ming / mi bdag rgyal po/ cha shas/ bcu drug gi ming / nyes pa/ skyon/ khams bco brgyad kyi ming /rgyal ba/ yul ni nyer bzhi'i ming / de nyid nyi shu rtsa lnga'i ming / 'khor lo/skar ma nyer bdun ming / so/ gnyis skyes sum cu rtsa gnyis ming / stong ba/nam mkha' jig gi ming / gcig bcu sogs grangasaXkyi gnas rnams ni mngon pa'i skabs dang 'dra'o/ /'bri bgrang g.yas nas brtsam/ bsgyur bgod g.yon/ sgyur byed kyi thig gral mthar bkod/ stong bas bsgyur dus bsgyur bya dbye/ bgo byed thig les 'og mtha' bkag bsgyur ba'i don gang bsgyur grangs su spelaXb yin/ bgo byed ni grangs su sdud pa/ gza' 352

dang byed pa'i 'khor lo bdun/ skar sbyor gnyis ni nyer bdun/ chu tshod chu srang gnyis ni drug cu/ dbugs drug cha shas nges pa med/ bsre ba/ ster ba/ phul ba/ sbyid pa/ 'bul ba/ bsnan pa/ bsnon pa/ nor du 'gyur ba/ldan pa rnams don gcig 'phri ba/ sbyang ba/ 'phrog pa/ zhu ba/ 'phral ba/dor ba/ 'brid pa/ dman pa/ bu lon 'gyur ba/ dben pa rnams ni don gcig bsgyur ba/ bsnun pa/ spel ba/ bsgres pa/ gsil ba rnams don gcig bgo ba/ phye ba/ gsal ba/ bcad pa rnams don gcig phyis pa/dbyi ba/ bsubs pa rnams don gcig rnyed pa/ thob pa/ nor gsum don gcig go /de yang gza' rnams myur 'gros shar/ dal 'gros lho/ 'khyog 'gros nub/ 'byung 'gros byang du byed/ de ltar skar rtsis su grags pa rnams ston pa'i mdo rgyud ni/ rgyal bas gsungs pa'iXdus 'khor rtsa rgyud/mkha' 'gro bde mchog mig bcu gnyis pa'i mdo/ stag rna'i rtogs brjod la sogs pa rnams so/ /de dag ni bzo rig pa'i gzhung las 'byung ba'i ming gi rnam grangs che long bkam mdor bsdus pa'o/ /lnga ba gso ba rig ba'i gzhung las 'byung ba'iXming gi rnam grangs la/spyir gso dpyad kyi skor mdo dang rgyud sde las thor du thor bu mang du 'byung la/ 'phags pa klu'i zhabs dang / slob dpod dpa' bo/ kha che zla ba mgon po rnams kyis mdzad pa'i sbyor ba brgya ba dang / yan lag brgyad pa zla zer sogs 'phags yul gyi paṇa grub rnams kyis mdzad pa'i sman 363

gzhung mang du yod kyang / deng sang bod sog gi pa'i rib/ byed 'dzin pa rnams la 'chad nyan dang lag len shin tu rgyas che ba ni/ dpal ldan rgyudaXbazhi rinaXpo che nyid yin pas/ 'dirade las 'byung ba'i ming gi rnam grangs che long tsam bsdu bar bya'o/ /de la dad dang lus zungs dri ma rnam gsum po rang rang gi gnas dang / ldang tshad las rnam par ma gyur pa dang gyur pa gnyis las dang po ni/ lus gnas par byed pa minaXpa'i lus la/srog 'dzin/ gyen rgyu/ khyab byed/ me mnyam/ thur sel te rtsa ba'i rlung lnga/'ju byed/mdangs 'gyur/ sgrub byed/ mthong byed/mdog gsal te rtsa ba'i mkhris pa lnga/ rten byed/ myags byed/ sbong byed/ tshim byed/ 'byor byed de rtsa ba'i bad kan lnga'o/ /dwangs ma/ khrag sha tshil/ rus/ rkang / khu ba ste lus zungs bdun/ bshang ba/ gci ba/ rdul te dri ma gsum rnams bsdoms pas nyi shu rtsa lnga'o/ /gnyis pa la/ na ba'i lus dang / nad gso ba'i tshul gnyis las/ dang po ni/ lus 'joms par byed pa na ba'i lus la/ rgyu/ rkyen/ 'jug sgo/ gnas/ lam/ ldang dus/ 'bras bu/ ldog rgyu/ mdo don dang dgu las/ 'dod chags/ zhe sdang / gti myug gsum ni rgyu gsum mo/ /dus dman lhag log pa/ gdon glo bur ba/ zas dman lhag log pa/spyod lam dman lhag log pa bzhi ni rkyen bzhi'o/ /pags la 'gramasaXpa/sha la rgyas pa/ rtsa ru rgyu ba/ rus la zhen pa/ don la babs pa/ snod du lhung ba drug ni 'jug sgo drug go /klad pa/ mchin mkhris/ dpyi sked gaspum ni 354

rim pa bzhin bad mkhris rlung gsum gyi gnas gsum mo/ /rus pa/ rna ba/reg bya/ snying ngam srog rtsa/ long ste lnga ni rlung gi rgyu lam lnga/ khrag rdul/mig mchin mkhris/ rgyu ma ste lnga ni mkhris pa'i rgyu lam lnga/ dwangasaXm sha tshil rkang khu ba/ bshang gci/ sna lce/ glo ba mtsher ba mkhal ma/ pho ba sgang ba ste lnga ni bad kanaXgyi rgyu lam lnga'o/ /rgas pa/ dar ma/ byes pa gsum ni naXsos rlung mkhris bad kan gyis gnyan pa gsum mo/ /dad can grang ba/ skam sa tsha gdung che ba/ rlan can snumaXpa gsum ni nyes pa gsum gyi yul gsum mo/ /dbyar dus rgongs dang tho rangs/ ston dus nyin gung mtshan gung /dpyid dus srod dang snga dro gsum ni nyes pa gsum gyi ldang dus gsum mo/ /'tsho ba gsum zad pa/ 'du ba gshed du babs pa/ sbyor ba mtshungs pa/gnad du babs pa/ dus las 'das te rlung nad srog rten chad pa/ tsha ba la bzlas pa/ grang baXgating 'khar ba/ zungs kyis mi thub pa/ rnam par 'tshe ba ste dgu ni 'bras bu srog gcod kyi nad dgu'o/ /rlung zhi nas mkhris par ldog pa/ bad kan du ldog pa/ rlung ma zhi bar mkhris par ldog pa/bad kan du ldog pa/ mkhris pa zhi nas rlung du ldog pa/ bad kan du ldog pa/ mkhris pa ma zhi bar rlung du ldog pa/ bdaXkan du ldog pa/ bad kan zhi nas rlung du ldog pa/ mkhris par ldog pa/ bad kan ma zhi bar rlung du ldog pa/ mkhris par ldog pa ste ldog rgyu bcu gnyis so/ /rlung dang bad kan grang ba chu'i rang bzhin/ khrag dang mkhris pa tsha ba me'i rang bzhin/ srin dngaX355

chu ser tsha grang thun mong gi rang bzhin can du gnas pa ste mdo don tsha grang gnyis rnams bsdoms pas brgyad cu rtsa brgyad do/ /gnyis pa la gsum las/ dang po nad kyi ngo bo ngos bzung ba la/ nad kyi ming go dka' ba rnams phyogs gcig tu bstan pa ni/ rlung nad la/ a wa rta/ da rgan phyir 'gyed/ da rgan nang gug 'gram pa nyams pa/ lce ldib pa/ phyogs gcig tu gug pa/ rtsa 'dzin/ gzhogasaXphyed skams pa/ lus kunaXskams pa/ shing rengs/ dpung pa 'ja' ba/ be+e sha tsi/ sra 'theng / brla rengs/ lce spyang mgo tsher ma/ gzugs 'khums/ kha la/ rkang ba brtse ba/rkang ba tsha ba ste nyi shu'o/ /bsdu na/ rengs pa/ 'khums pa/ skam pa/ sbos pa/'byes pa/ gzer ba/ 'phyos pa/ bogs pa dang brgyad do/ /mkhris pa'i nad la/ thang la lhags pa/ gnas gyur pa/ kha lud pa/ kha shor ba/ rtsar rgyug pa/ sha ser/ mig ser/ k+ṣaXya dang brgyad do/ /bad kan byi nad la/lten/ lcags dregs/ me nyams/ mgul 'gags/ bad kan grum bu/ 'ju skem steXrang rgyud can drug go /bad kan ser po/ sprug po byer ba/ sprug po rgyas pa/ sgrug po 'gyings pa/ sprug po 'dril ba/ smug po rdol ba/ sprug po gab pa ste gzhan rgyud can drug go /ma zhu ba'i nad la/ gyong / rlan/ snum ma zhu ba ste rdzas kyis dbye ba gsum/ dwangs ma/ snyigs ma ma zhu ba ste ngo bos dbye ba gnyis/ be snabs/ gsud nad/ ma zhu shing 'dra/ dug 'dra ste rigs kyis dbye ba bzhi'o/ /gcong chen skran nad la/ zas skran/ lhan skran/366

do skrad/ rlung gi lhing skran/ khrag skran/ mkhris skran/ rtsa skran/ spu skran/ srin skran/ chu skran/ rnag skran te bcu gcig bsdu na/ phyi skran/ nang skran/ bar skran gsum mo/ /skya rbab la/ glo ba/ mchin pa/ mtsher ba/ chu ser/ rlung gi skya rbab ste lnga'o/ /'or la/ rlungaX/ mkhris pa/ khrag bad kan/ gnad/ dug gi 'or te lnga'o/ /bsdu na/ tsha 'or/ grang 'or gnyis so/ /danu chu la/ byer chu/zabs chu/ 'khyems chu/ rgyu ma'i rdol chu/ gdon las gyur pa/ dug las gyur pa ste drug go /chu'i mkhar brgyad ni/ bol gong / ngar gdong / chu so/bcu drug mdo/ pho ba/ brang zhol/ kha gdong /mig lcibs rnams so//gcong chen zad byed la/ nyes pa gsum gyi dbye bas gsum dang bla gnyan drug go /tsha ba'i nad la/ rten/ dus/ nyes pa/ gnas/ rgyud/ gnas skabs/rigs kyis dbye ba ste bdun bshad kyang gzhan rnams go sba la/ gnas skabs kyis dbye na/ ma smin tsha ba/ rgyas pa'i tsha ba/ stongs tshad/ gab tshad/rnyings tshad/ rnyogs tshad de drug rigs kyis dbye na/ 'grams tshad/'khrugs tshad/ rims tshad/ dug tshad bzhi rnams so/ /tsha grang 'khrul gzhi gal 'gag rnam bzhi ni/ phyi rtags tsha la ngo bo grang ba/ ngo bo tsha la phyi rtags grang ba/ gnyis ka tsha ba/ gnyis ka grang ba ste bzhi'o/ /ri thang 'tshams kyi phrang gsum ni/ rlung gi zhu 'khyags spun nas bsu ba/ mkhris pa'iXzhu 'khyags phrang la sgug pa/ bad kan zhu 'khyags phyi rjes bcad pa'o/ /ma smin tsha ba la/ rang nyid smin stobs che ba/ chung ba gnad du 357

babs pas smin long med pa/ sbyor ba log pas smin long med pa/ rlung dang bad kan rkyen gyis byer bas smin du mi 'ong ba ste lnga/ rgyas tshad la/rims rgyas 'khrugs rgyas gnyis/ stobs che chung gnyis/ babs sgo nas dbye na/ spyi dang byeXbrag gnyisaXrnams so/ /stongs tshad la/ tsha ba stongs pa/rtsa stongs pa/ rlung stongs pa ste gsum/ bye brag gis dbye na/ rims stongs/khrag stongs/ mkhris stongs/ bad kan stongs pa/ chu ser stongs pa/ glo snying stongs pa ste drug go /gab tshad la/ tsha stobs can dang / grang stobs can gnyis/ yang da/ snying / pho ba/ mkhal mar gab pa ste gsum mo//rnyings tshad la/ rlung ldan/ rlung med gnyis so/ /rnyogs tshad la/ tsha bas rnyogs pa/ grang bas hogs pa gnyis so/ /'grams tshad la/ phyi 'grams/nang 'grams gnyis/ 'khrugs tshad la/ rgyas 'khrugs/ stongs 'khrugs/'jam 'khrugs gsum/ rims tshad la/ bal nad/ 'brum bu/ rgyu gzer/gag lhog cham rims dang lnga/ yang rlung rims la/ 'dar bu/ yer bu gnyis/ mkhris rims la/ leb rgan/ klad gzer gnyis/ bad kan gyiXrimasaXl/ rmongs bu/ lkugs pa gnyis/ 'dus rims la/ rgyun rims/rtag pa'i rims/ nyin gcig pa/ nyin gsum pa/ nyin bzhi ba ste lnga/gnyan rims la/ mkhris pa rtsar rgyug rims/ mkhris pa klad gzer/ rims smyon/ tre tre ho dang gsum/ 'brum du la gnyis las/ nag po la/ skrangs pa glung gnya'/ khrag skam rtsel te/ zangs gzer spu gu can dang gsum/368

dkar bo la sha ‘ra skya shar/ rmog mgo sbyi glum/ sib bu kob tse ste gsum mo/ /rgyu gzer la don 'khru/ snodaX'akhru/ stobs che chung ste bzhi/ yang rgyu gzer/rgyu 'khor/ rgyu 'khrol/ rgyu lkugs dang bzhi'o/ /gag pa la/ pho gag mo gag bu gag gnyan gag dang bzhi/ lhog pa la/ sa/ chu/ me/ rlung gi bzhi/dkar/ nag khra bo gsum/ rgod/ yang rgod/ yam du/ yu mo dang bzhi'o/ /cham paXl/ glo cham/ rims cham/ gre cham/ sna cham dang bzhi rnams so/ /mgo bo'i nad la/ rlung / khrag mkhris pa/ bad kan/ ldan nad gsum/ mgo srin dang brgyad/ mgo nad phal ba la/ ma rlung / rmen 'bras/ glog pa can/ skra byi/ spyi ther/ skra dkar dang drug go /mig nad la/ mig chu'i nag mig chag ling thog rab rib/ 'gribs dang lnga/ mig chu la/ nyes pa gsumaXdang / khrag 'dus pa/ srin bu/ mig nad sgra ngan dang bdun/ tshag la/ skam tshag gsher tshag gdung 'gyur dang gsum/ 'gribs la/ srod long / phyi nang bar gsum gyi 'gribs dang bzhi/ phyi 'gribs la/ sha lhag sha mdzer/ rtsa dra/sngo rib/ ling ros khebs pa dang lnga/ nang 'gribs la/ chu 'khrugs/ rtsa mdangs nyams pa dang gnyis te/ gzhan rnams go sba'o/ /rna ba'i nad la/rlung sogs gsum dang / khrag las gyur pa/ rnag 'dzag 'brum thor 'byung ba dang drug 'on pa la/ sgra bcas 'onaXpa/ rna spabs 'gagasaXpa/ma rlung bu la shor ba/ skam 'on dang bzhi'o/ /sna nad la/ sna bsubs/'brum thor/ sha lu/ rnag 'dzag khrag 'dzag dang lnga'o/ /kha nad la/ sum cu 369

tham pa yod de/ gre mchu/ sho re/ bad kan/ gcen/ khrag rgyas/ kha shu ste mchu nad drug rnyil nad gcig bad rlung / khrag mkhris/ so 'bras/ so srin te so nad bzhi/ rlungaX/ mkhris pa/ bad kan/ lce lhag skrangs pa ste lce nad lnga/gre nad gcig lce chung babs pa/ lce 'dra/ rkan 'brum/ chu bur/ rus sbal/rkan smin te rkan nad drug rlung sogs bzhi/ khrag 'bras/ rmen bu ste gre nad bdun rnams so/ /mgul nad lba ba la/ rlung lba/ mkhris lnga/ khrag lba/bad kan gyi lba ba/ tshil lba/ 'dus pa'i lba ba/ g.yang lba/ byur lba dang brgyad do/ /snying nad la/ snying 'phyos/ snying gzer/ snying tshad/ snying chu/ snying 'thibs/ snying srin/ snying nad kha le nag po dang bdun no/ /glo ba'i nad la/ thang po/ skya rbab/ tsha ba/ chu shor/ phes po/ glo gcong / glo rgyas/ bung tshad can dang brgyad do/ /mchin nad la/ leb rgan rgyas pa/ ldem bu/ dug thabs/ chu shor/ rkun bu/ 'or lhung / kha lud/ gzhung rengs/ mchin grum nag po/ mchin nad hal skems/ mchin dri dkar nag gnyis/ gnad mchin rtsa byer/ mchin rlung / mchin rgud/ rlan grangs/ glang dgur/ grang sbos te bco brgyad do/ /mtsher nad la/ mtsher tshad/ khrag sbos/ mtsher rlung / mtsher ba'i bad kan/ rlugs pa ste lnga'o/ /mkhal nad la/ mkhal rlung / mkhal gcong /'or lhungs/mkhal tshad/chu shor/mkhal 'grams/da rgan dang bdun no/ /pho ba'i nad la/ tsha ba 'grams babs/ 'khrugs babs/ dug thabs/360

gnyan glang / pho ba sur ya/ mkhris pa lud pa/ mchin khrag lud pa ste tsha ba bdun/ pho rlung / ma zhu/ lcags dreg lten/ me nyams/ rdo skran/ danu rdzing / pho srin/pho 'bras te grang ba dguXrnams bsdoms pas bcu drug go /rgyu ma'i nad la/ rgyu 'khrol/ rgyu 'khril/ rgyu 'gyings/ rgyu 'gags/ rgyu gzer te lnga'o/ /long gi nad la/ grang sbos/ grang 'gyings/ tsha rnyongs/ 'ju skem/ rlangs pa cad dang lnga'o/ /pho mtshan gyi nad la/ sos zin/ 'brum can/mdud 'dra/ spubs 'byar/ gra ma can dang lnga/mo mtshan nad la rlung sogs bzhi'o/ /skad 'gag nad la/ nyes pa gsum/ khrag zad byed/ tshil grur/ das chadaXdang bdun no/ /yi ga 'chusaXpa la/ rlung sogs bzhi'i bzhi'o/ /skom nad la/ rlung sogs bzhi dang /bcud zad de lnga'o//skyigs bu la/ zas byung /phran tshegs/ zung 'byung / chen po/ zab mo ste lnga'o/ /dbugs mi bde ba la/phran tshegs/ myun can/ dbugs chad/ chen po/ gyen 'byung ste nga / /glang sbabs nad la/ don glang / snod glang / rtsa glang / tsha glang / grang glang / spin glang / gnyan glang ste bdun no/ /srin bu'i nad la/ phyi sren shig dang / sro ma gnyis/ nang srin la klad srin/ mkhris srin/ so srin/ pagasaXsrin/ gzhang srin/ mtshan ma'i srin/ ya srid dang bdun no/ /sgyugs nad la/ rlung sogs bzhi'i bzhi'o/ /'khru ba'i dad la/ ma zhu ba'i 'khru ba/ pho ba'i me nyams pas 'khru ba/ rgyu long grang bas 'khru ba/ mkhris pa snod du lhung bas 'khru ba/mchin tshad thur du babs pas 'khru ba ste lnga'o/ /dri ma 'gags pa la/ nyes 361

pa gsum/ srin nad/ thur sel log pa ste lnga'o/ /gcin 'gagasaXl/ gcin sri/ kha 'chus/ rlung 'khyil/ khrag sha spu 'gags/ skrangs pa/ khu bas 'gags pa/ rde'us 'gags pa dang bdun no/ /gcin snyi'i nad la/ nyes pa gsum gyiXza khu skyed tshul gsum mo/ /rgya nad tshad 'khru/ dreg nad gnyis kyi dbye ba go sla'o/ /grum du'i nad la/ shaXtrem/ rusaXtrem/ rtsa trem/ chu trem/ trem dkar/trem nag dang drug go /chu ser nad la/ dkar nag gnyis so/ /rtsa dkar nad la/ tsha grang gnyis so/ /pags nad la/ sha bkra/ glang shu/ mdzer ba/ za rkong / shu ba/ srin thor/ ro khabs/ khye ma sogs so/ /phran bu'i nad la/ nya loga'akhru/ sgyugs/ mes tshig khab bam mde'u khong du shor ba/ gre bar gra ma zug pa/ sha'am zan gyis brnangs pa/ gnya' rengs/ bse dri/ nu ma skrangasaXpa sogs so/ /lhan skyes rma la/ 'bras/ gzhang 'brum/ me dbal/ sur ya/ rmen bu/rīgs rlugs/ rkang bam/ mtshan par rdol ba dang brgyad de/ 'di rnams dang byis pa nyer spyod kyi le'u'i skabs kyi ming gi rnam grangs rnams go sla bas ma bris so/ /byis pa'i nad la/ lhan skyes dang / glo bur gnyis/ phyi ma la/rags pa/phraXb/zhib tshags dang gsum mo/ /byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga ni/ skem byed/ sa ga lug gdong / khyi gdong / bya gdong / yi dwags gdong / srul mo/ grang ba'i srul mo/ srul mo long ba/ bzhinaXrgyas/ nam gru sngon mo/ nam gru skem po/ rgyal po/ bsen mo/ lha chen dang bco lnga'o/ /mo nad spyi la/ khrag tshabs/ rlung tshabs gnyis/ bye brag 362

la tshabs skran chu bur can/ khrag skran trem po/ bem po rmen skran/ pho skran nag po/ rtsa skran/ sa bon skran/ za khu/ ma ra tse/ a so/ mngal srin langs pa sogs gtsoXbo sum cu rtsa gnyis yod par bshad do/ /mo nad phal ba la/mtshan ma'i nad/ bu ma phyin pa/ mgo mjug log pa/ rog ma phyin pa/ bu snod lug pa/ khrag ma chad pa/ nad gzhug lus pa/ dug thabs gyur pa ste brgyad du gsungs so/ /'byung po'i gdon la/ lha/ lha min/ dri za/ klu/ gnod sbyin/tshangs pa/ srin po/ sha za/ yi dwags/ grul bum/byad stems/ g.yengs byed/ ro langs/ mtshun lha/ bla ma/ drang srong / rgan po/ grub pa zhes bya ba ste bco brgyad do//sbyo byed dang / brjed byed kyi gdon gyi dbye ba yang goXsla'o/ /gza' gdon la/ me chu gnyis/ klu gdon la/ gnas kyis dbye na/ skyi/ pags/rtsi mdog stobs/ sha tshil/ chu ba/ rtsa/ khrag chu ser/ rus/ tshigs/ lha ba/ klad pa/ rkang / khu ba/ don la zhugs pa ste bco brgyad/ rigs kyis dbye na/ thod 'dra/ klum po/ glang shu/ u dum wa ra/ ri sha'i lce/ pags mdze/ 'brum phran/ sha bkra/ 'bras/ byer/ ser ga shu ba/ kha brgya/ pad ma dkar po/ 'brum bu/g.yan pa/ pags spyags pa/ 'ol se 'dra ba ste bco brgyad rnams bsdoms pas so drug go /rma la/ lhan skyes rma ni sngar bshad zin la/ glo dur rma la/bshus pa/ gshags pa/ bcad pa/ rnam par bcad pa/ rab tu 'phyang ba/lhung ba/ grum pa/ phug pa ste brgyad do/ /gnas kyis dbye na/ mgo byang khogayan lag rma/ ske rma dang bzhi'o//dug gi nad la/ sbyar dug byur pa'i dug363

rang bzhin gyi dug ste gsum dang / phyi ma la rgyu ba dang mi rgyu ba'i dug gnyis so/ /'di dag ni man ngag rgyud kyi le'u gya dgu ba yan gyi nad rigs du ma'i ming gi rnam grangs go dka' ba rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa yin la/ le'u phyi ma gsum gyis tshe ring ba bcud len gyi skor sogs ston zhing /ming gi rnam grangs go dka' ba cher med do/ / gnyis pa brtag thabs la gsum las/ dang po reg pa rtsa la brtag pa ni/ sngon 'gro zas spyodaXbaslab pa/ lta dus/ blta gnas/ mnan tshad/ lta tshul rnams la ming gi rnam grangs go dka' ba mngaXbo med cing / tha mal rtenaXgyi rtsa rgyud rnam gsum ni/ pho rtsa/ mo rtsa/ byang chub sems rtsa gsum mo/ /dus bzhi'i rtsa la khams lnga'i 'byung ba brtsi ba ni/ dpyid/ dbyar/ ston/ dgun/dus mtshams te lnga la/ shing / me/ lcags/ chu/ sa ste khams lnga'i rtsa rgyu tshul ngos bzung ba yin la/ de yang rim pa bzhin/ mchin/ snying / glo/ mkhal/mtsher rtsa rnams dang sbyor ba'o/ /ngo mtshar rtsa bdun ni/ khyim phya/ mgron phya/dgra phya/ grogs phya/ gdon phya/ meXchu go bzlog bu rtsa brtag pa'o/ /nad dang nad med 'phar ba'i grangs ni/ dbugs rer lan lnga rer 'phar ba dang /che/ chung / stod/ smad/ drag dal/ bying / rgyas/ sdod/ 'then/ thang / lhod med par 'phar ba ni nad med dang / bzlog pa nad can no/ /byi dang bye brag rtsa la spyi rtsa ni/ drag rgyas/ 'dril/ mgyogs/ grims/ 'khrang ba ste tsha ba'i spyi rtsa drug zhan/ bying / gud/ bul/ lhod/ stong ba ste grang ba'i spyi rtsa drug rnams 364
