bsdoms pas bcu gnyis so/ /bye brag rtsa ni/ming gi rnam grangs rags pa spyi rtsar 'du bas 'dir ma bris so/ /'chi rtsa gsum ni/ rtsa rgyud 'grur ba/ ma tshang ba/ sdod pa'o/ /sdod la na sdod/ 'chi sdod/ 'dre sdod gsum mo/ /gdon rtsa rim gros 'chos pa dang / tshe rtags bla yi rtsa la brtag pa ni go sla'o/ /gnyis pa mthong ba chu la brtag pa ni/ sngon 'groXzas spyod bslab pa ni shes sla la/ blta dus ni/ snod la nyi mdangs byung ba'o/ /snod ni/ dkar yol/mkhar gzhong / lcags dkar snod sogs so/ /gyur tshul ni chu dang / ku ya'i 'gyur tshul gnyis so/ /tha mal nad med chu ni/ kha dog 'bri mar bzhus pa 'dra ba/ sbo dri mnam pa/ rlangs pa che chung dang yun tshad ran pa/ me tog stoms/ ku ya stoms shing khyab pa dang / ko chu'i spris ma tsam du yod pa/rlangs pa yal dus mtha' nas gor mor ldog pa/ log rjes dkar ser dwangs pa rnams ni nad med dang / de las bzlog pa nad chu'o/ /de la byi'i brtag tshul la/ tshan de'i dus su/ mdog rlangs pa/ dri/ me tog bzhi dang /ngad yal dus su/ ku ya spris ma gnyis dang / grangs zin nas ldog dus/ldog tshul/log rjes la brtag pa gsum rnams bsdoms pas rnam pa dgu'o//bye brag gi brtag tshul ni/ dad chu/ 'chi chu/ gdon chu gsum so sor brtag tshul te go sla zhing ming gi rnam grangs logs pa med do/ /gsum pa dri ba'i sgo nas brtag pa la/ yang la rtsub pa'i zas spyodaXkyis g.yal ba/ lus 'dar ba/ bya myangaXbyed pa/ grang shum byed pa/ stod smad dpyi rked kun na ba/365

gzer nges med du 'pho ba/ stong sgyugs byed pa/ dbang bo mi gsal ba/ shes ba 'tshub pa/ bgres dus na ba/ snum bcud phan pa rnams rlung gi byi rtags dang / no zhing tsha ba'i zas spyod kyis/ kha kha ba/ mgo na ba/ sha drod tsha ba/stod gzer ba/ zhu rjes na ba/ bsil ba phan pa rnams mkhris pa'i spyi rtags dang / lco la snum pa'i zas spyod kyis/ dang ga mi bde ba/ kha zas 'ju dka'aXb/ sgyugs pa/ kha mngal bro ba/ pho ba sbos pa/ sgregs pa mang ba/lus sems spru ba/ phyi nang gnyis ka grang ba/ zos rjes mi bde ba/ zas spyod dro na 'phrod pa rnams bad kan gyi spyi rtags te/ de dag gis mtshon pa'i lus kyi gnas gang na ba dang / jiXltar du tshul legs par dris te shes par bya ba'o/ /brtag pa 'di gsum la/ dpyod pa don rig brtag pa/mthong ba yul rig brtag pa/ thos pa sgra rig brtag pa zhes kyang gaspungs so/ /yang nyes pa dngos ston brtag pa/ ngan g.yo skyon gyis brtag pa/ spang blang mu bzhir brtag pa gsum dang / de'i dang po la/ slong ba rgyu'i sgo nas brtag pa/ mtshan nyid rtags kyi sgo nas brtag pa/ phan gnod bsten pa'i sgo nas brtag pa gsum du yod par bshad do/ /gsum pa gso byed thabs kyi rnam bzhag la gnyis/ dngosaXdang /zhar byung sman ming go dka' ba rnams phyogs gcig tu sdebs pa'o/ /dang po la bzhi las dang po zas ni/ rta sha bong sha 'phyi ba'i sha lo sha sha chen/'bru mar/ lo mar/ bu ram/ sgog skya/ btsong / 'o ma/ zan chang / dur chang /366

rus chang rnams rlung nad can gyi zas dang / ba ra'iXzho dang / mar gsar/ri dwags kyi sha ra sha skom sha gsar ba/ chag tshe/ skyabs/ khur tshod/ chab tsha/chu bsil/ bskol grang rnams mkhris nad can gyi zas dang / lug shagayag rgod kyi sha gcan zan gyi sha nya sha sprang rtsi/ skam sar skyes pa'i 'bru rnying gi zan dron/ 'bri'i zho dar/ gar chang / chu bskol rnams bad kan gyi nad can gyi zas so/ /gnyis pa spyod lam la/ dro sar 'dug pa dang / yid du 'ong ba'i grogs bsten pa ni rlung sel spyod lam/ bsil sar 'dug pa dang /dal bar 'dug pa ni mkhris sel spyod lam/rtsol bas bcag pa dang /dro sar 'dug pa ni bad kan sel ba'i spyod lam mo/ /gsum pa sman la/rlung sel gyi ro ni/ mngaraXb/ skrur ba/ lan tshwa gsum/ nus pa ni snum pa/ spru ba/ 'jam pa gsum mo/ /sel gyi ro ni/ mngar ba/ kha ba/ bska ba gsum/nus pa ni/ bsil ba/ sla ba/ rtul ba gsum mo/ /bad kan sel ba'i ro ni/ tsha ba/ skyur ba/ bska ba gsum/ nus pa ni/rdo ba/ rtsub pa/ yang ba gsum mo/ /khu ba/ sman mar gnyis rlung gi zhi byed dang / thang dang / cur nis gnyis mkhris pa'i zhi byed/ ril bu/ tres sam gnyis bad kan gyiXzhi byed do/ /sle 'jam/ bkru 'jam/ bkru ma slen te 'jam rtsi gsum ni rlung gi sbyong byed/ spyi bshal/ sgos bshal/ drag bshal/ 'jam bshal bzhi ni mkhris pa'i sbyong byed/drag skyug 'jam skyug gnyis ni bdaXkan gyi sbyong byed do/ /bzhi ba dpyad la/rlung gi dpyad ni/ sku mnye/ hor gyi me btsa' gnyis/ mkhris pa'i dpyad ni/367

rdulaXdabyung / gtar ga chu'i 'khrul 'khor te gsum/ bad kan gyi dpyad ni/dugs dpyad/ me btsa' gnyis so/ /byir dugs/ lums/ byug pa gsum 'jam dpyad/ gtar ba/ bsregs pa/dbugs pa gsum rtsub dpyad/'dral ba/ gcod pa/ 'drud pa/ 'byin pa bzhi drag po'i dpyad do/ /gnyis pa ni/rin po che'i sman/ rdo sman/ sa sman/ shing sman/ rtsi sman/ thang sman/ sngo sman/srog chags kyi sman dang brgyad las dang po ni/ gser/ dadul/ zangs/lcags/ g.yu/ nu tig nya phyis/ dung / byu ru/ nu men sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/sprug po sbal rgyab/ dkar po sbal rgyab/ rdo dkar po chig thub/ gangs thigakhab len/ be snabs/ mardzi ra/ phag mgo bye mgo gser rdo/ dngul rdo/ stang zil/ gser zil/ dngul zil/ gru bzhi/ cog lam/ rdo klad/ li kri/ rdo chu/ rdo mkhris/bsha' rdo/ldong ros/ ba bla/rdo sol/ba nu/rdo rgyus/mthing rgyus/ti tsha ser bo/ mtshal/ lig bu mig btsag yug cong zhi/ rdo thal/ ha shig la sogs pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ gser gyi bye ma/ siji ra/ ze tshwa/ ya bak+ṣa ra/ bul tog nu zi ser bo/ nu zi nag po/ nag mtshur/ ser mtshur/ jig pad/ rdo dreg brag zhun la sogs pa'o/ /bzhi ba lnga ba drug pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bstan pa la/ mang ga bur/ stag zil ga bur/ tsan dan dkar dmar gnyis/ ya ka ru/ghi wang / cu gang / kur gum/ sug sbel/ dza ti/ li shi ka ko la/ gla rtsi/ dom mkhris/ kut+pal/ tsā ga pusgo/ tsā ga ge sar/ pad+ma ge sar/ zi ra dkar bo/zi ra nag po/ la la phud/ so ma ra dza/ thal ka rdo rje/ gser gyi me tog gser gyi 368

phur bu/ dug mo nyung / rgyan 'brum/ 'uXsu/ star bu/ bse yab/ se 'bru/ na le sham/ pi pi ling / sman sga/ sga skya/ tsi tra kashing tsha/ ka ralnga/ shing kun/ byi tang kami ru tse/ go byi la/ spos dkar/ gu gul/ shel ta/ rgya tshwa/ rgyam tshwa/lce myang tshwa/kha ru tshwa/tsabs ru tshwa/rwa tshwa/ thal tshwa/mdze tshwa/wa tshwa/tsha la/sa ru rnam rgyal/a ru 'jigs med/a ru bdud rtsi/a ru 'phel byed/a ru skem po/sa ru mchu snyung / a ru nag chung / ba ru ra/ skyu ru ra/snying zho sha mkhal ma zho sha gla gor zho sha sa 'bras/sra 'bras/ 'jam 'bras/ 'dra go ma nu pa tra/ pu ṣ+ka ra rūl/ma nu se shing / ma nu shu zur/ ru rta/ yung ba/ shu dag nag po/ shu dag dkar bo/ pu shel rtse/ khyung sder dkar sprug gnyis/ dpa' bo dkar bo/ dpa' bo ser bo/ dpa' rgod/ bong nga dkar bo/ bong nga dmar bo/ shing mngar/ sle tres/ gce ka ri/ ga bra/ rgya tig bal tig ba sha ka ba le ka ga dur/ stab seng / sgron shing / skyer ba/ se rgod/ seng ldeng / po so cha/ dan rog dan 'dra/shri khaka/ dong ga ka bed/ da trig smag mon cha ra sogs so/ /bdun pa ni/hong len/spang rtsi do bo/ re skon pa/kyi lce dkar nag gnyis/ sum cu tig pri yad+ku/ zangs tig lcags tig gser tig sro lo dkar bo/ sug 'dra'am sprug po/ g.ya' kyi ma/ gang ga chung / bya rgod spos/ srol gong ba/ yu mo mde 'byin/ dar ya kan/ rta lhags/a be ṣa/stag sha spang rgyan dkar bo/ yu gu shing / rtsad/ rgu thub/ lcam stag a byag gzer 'joms/ sa byag tsher sngon/sgrug chung / mdan yon/ gser skud/ dadul skud/ lug ru sprug po/ lug ru 369

ser bo/ lug ru dkar bo/ chu rug pa/ se ba'i me tog 'du su hang / sgong thog pa/ a krong nag po/ phur dkar a krong / tshar bong / tang kun/ se rgod 'bras bu/ shugaXpa tsher ma can/ skyer ba'i me tog thang phrom dkaraXpo/ thang phrom nag po/ lang thang tsi/ srin shing sna ma'i 'bras bu/ dres ma'i ge sar/dkar po chig thub/ rtsa a wa/ a 'dra/ zhim thig dkar nag gnyis/ par paXta/ dwa ba'i rtsa ba/ 'dam bu kar/ 'bri ta sa 'dzin/ bya pho tsi tsi/ shu mo za/ snyi ba/ lug mur/ g.yer shing ba/ me tog ser chen/ brag skya ha bo/ brag spos/ rgya spos/ spang spos/ myang rtsi spris/ rgu dru/ 'bam po/ sngo sprin/ me tog lug migamakhan pa dkar nag gnyis/ chu ma rtsi dkar nag gnyis/ byi tsher/ rtsa mkhris/ rim de ba/ chu de ba/ sngo de ba/ re ral/ 'om bu/ zhu mkhan/ rgya skyegs/btsod/ lcam pa/ brag lcam/ gra ma'i rtsa ba/ mdzo mo shing / phang ma'i 'bras bu/srad dkar ba/ byi rug pa/ bre ga mtshe ldum/ lug chung / lug ngal/ stong ri zil ba/ zangs rtsi ba/ snya bo/ sho mang / pa yag rtsa ba/ bye'u la phug ug chos/skye ba'i 'bras bu/ sa rdzi ka lce tsha/ dbyi mong dkar bo/ dbyi mong khra bo/ ba lu dkar bo/ go snyod/ tha ram/ na ram/ bya rkang / sogasaXka ba/ dbang bo lag pa/ri sho spyang tsher/ dur byid/ thar nu/ sngon bu/ khron bu/ lcum rtsa/ chu rtsa/ re lcag pa/ lca ba/ nye shing / ra mnye/ ba spu ba/ gze ma la sogs pa'o/ /brgyad pa srog chags las byung ba la/ bshad rgyud du sde brgyad du dril nas gsung ba dang /thor bu 'byung ba gnyis las/ dang po la khron gyis rko ba'i sde ni/ rma bya/ gong 370

mo/ sreg pa/ skyung ka bya nag ri bya rnams so/ /mchu yis rko ba'i sde ni/ ne tso/khu byug thi ba/ skya ka 'jol mo/ byi'u rnams so/ /ri dwags sde ni/ sha ba/ gla ba/dgo ba/ snyan/ri bong / no ba/ gtsod/rgya/kha sha ra rgod/phag rgod/ma te/bse ru/ sprug rkyang / g.yag rgod/ mdzo rgod la sogs pa'o/ /gcan gzan sde ni/seng ge stag gzig gung / dom/ dred/ mi rgod/ gsa'/ sprung ki g.yi/ wa/'phar ba/ sprel sogs so/ /rtsal mthus za ba'i sde ni/ bya rgod/ glag rgo bo/ khu ta/ rlag mo/ ne le/ bya rog khu byug 'ug pa/ rgya khra/ byi'u khra sogs so/ /mis bdag byed pa'i sde ni/mdzo/ g.yag rnga mong / ba/ glang / bong du/ ra/ lug khyi phag khyim bya/ byi la sogs so/ /khung gnas sde ni/ 'phyi ba/ byi thur/ byi ba/ sbal ba/ sprul/ grum pa/rmig pa/ rtsangs pa/ sdom/ sdig pa sogs so/ /rlan la gnas pa'i sde ni/ khrung khrung / ngang skya/ ngur ba/ bzhad/ so bya/ skyar mo/ sram/ nya la sogs pa ste/ de dag gi rwa/ rus pa/ sha khrag spu/ rkang / rgyus pa/ klad pa/ tshil/ pags pa/ sen mo/ chu/brun sogs so/ /gnyis pa thor bur 'byung ba ni/glang chen sha 'brug rus/ mi thod/ thog rus/ 'gron du/ ser ba rus/ ba men rwa/ zer mo'i rus/'bu skyog da byid/ srin bya/ khug rta/ pu shud/ bya wang sha byi'u co ga mchil ba/nas zan/ chu srin sder mo/ spra/ spre'u/ bya ma byi/ byang ba/ rus sbal/ sdig srin/chu spur/ bse spur/ grog ma/bying bying thu lu/spru ma'i 'bu/na bun bu mo/chu byi/rba byi/ cha ga ba/ spur mgyogs/ zi sdi ra/ tshe gcig lus gnyis/ zho spur/ sbal 371

ba nag po/ chu sprul/sre mong /lcags sprul/ te'u lo pa'i sha byi stag sha dbang ril rnams srog chags las byung ba'o/ /zhar byung gong gsal rnams su ma 'dus pa'i sman dang zas kyi mingaXthor bur 'byung ba ni/ dkar khra men/lcags rdo/ thog lcags/ zangs rdo/zha nye/ spang ma/mthing / chu rdo/ rgya mapa'i spru ba/ lhang 'tsher/ nim pa/ tshar 'brum/ yog mo/ sba ma'i 'bru/ sgro ba/ yo 'bogam gal/ khu byug rdzi thog skra bzang / dhe ba nga ru/ rgya shug ba mkhal/ byi shang dkar mo/ gro lo sa 'dzid/ ci tsi sa 'dzin/ mtshan dkar/ yo'u rtsi/ zwa tshod/byi bzung / sprum dkar nag gnyis/ ming can ser bo/ lug mig gre gu ser bo/ g.yar mo thang / pad rtsa/ ming can nag po/ nad ma sbyar ma/ nad ma snun ma/ nad ma g.yu mo/ lug sho rgya sho lug sug ra sug 'bri mog ba la/ rtsa ram pa/ me tog leb rgan rtsi/ pa to la/ bya rog nor bu/ khrag chung ba/ spang tshan/ spu ru/ sngo khrag gcod/ sbra ba'i tho gu/ gla sgang snel rgod/ snel dmar/ pha ba dgo dgo shal ma li/ 'jib rtsi/ dmar shad/ chang phab/yungs dkar/ se sha chu'i nad ma/ dud pa/ bya bal/ rgya snag so phagaslang dregagrog zhing / ram/sa sprug za log 'ba' cha/ zhing gi bong ba/ sog tshig dngul chu/ sngon mo chab 'dren/ me long gi g.ya'/ spra tshil/ srin bal/ mtshal thal/ se zho/ me tog glang sna/ spang ma/dkar rtsi/ khang ba'i sa rul/ 'khar gong srin can/la cha/ 'dzin pa dkar bo/ ser bo/ nag po/ ra dug 'dzin pa/ spyang dug phyi 'dzin/ nang 'dzin/ gsang 'dzin rnams dang / zas kyiXskor ni/ 'bru la 372

gnyis te/ gra ma can ni/ 'bras/ khre/ khra ma/ gro/ nas/ so ba/ sred rnams so/ /gang bu can ni/ sran ma/ mon sran/ rgya sran/ ma sha sran chung / til/ zar ma/bra bo rnams so/ /snum ni/ mar gsar/ mar rnying / zhun mar/ zo mar/ til mar/ yungs mar/ rkang mar/ tshil/ klad ma sogs so/ /sngo ni/ sgog pa/ btsong /kun dong / ke'u/ nyung ma/ la phug zwa tshod/ lham/ chu lo/ rug pa/ thul ba sogs so/ /g.yos su sbyor ba'i sde ni/ 'bras thug sla ba/ skaXb/ gar ba/'bras chan/'bras yos/ srus thug nas thug yos dral/ rtsam pa/ mkhur ba/ btsos zan/zan chang / zan skam/ sha khu/ lan tsha can/ sped cad sogs dang / btung ba la/ 'o ma rlon pa/ 'o bskol/ spris ma/ bzhos thog 'o ma/zho/ zho kha chu/ dar ba/phyur khu/ zhoXbatsos/ sing bo/ rtsan mo/ 'bru'i chang / rgun chang / chang gar ma/shing tog khu ba/ shing gi chu/ ba tshwa can gyi chu/ khron pa'i chu/ chu mig gi chu/ chu klung gi chu/ gangs chu/ char chu/ gaṅga'i chu rnams so/ /de dag ni gso ba rig pa'i gzhung las 'byung ba'i ming gi rnam grangs mdor bsdus pa'o/ /gnyis pa thun mong la mkho ba brda' gsar rnyib gi nam bzhag bshad pa la/ kwa ni kye/ gag ni gang / te por ni shin tu/ snyem pa ni sgom pa/ skyor skyor ni yang yang / tsha ba ni dro/ bla 'og ni steng 'og ram phyis ni snag bum/bla skyal ba ni mi zad pa/ 'tshal ma 'tshal ba ni zas za ba/ rtsa lag ni gnyen/gnya' bo ni dpang po/ bskyud pa dang bsnyel ba ni brjed pa/ gya ba ni nyams 373

pa/khyag pa ni brlag pa/dpung bo ni phung bo/ zhig gu ni sbon pa/ ye 'byam ni stong nyid/ dbal ni tog sogs/ ngo ga ni snang ngor/ gam yoXni nye 'khor/dmyus byung ni tshi chad dam yi chad/ then khyer ni ca re/ ga zha ni bzhad gad/ya lad ni go cha/ gna' ma ni thog ma'am sngon/ cog ni kun/ phyi mo ni rtsa ba/sbrebs pa ni skom pa/ sbyi'ur ni byi bo/ rod pa ni rnam pa/ 'o cog ni ma lus/mdung ngor ni rgyan 'gyed/ cham du miXskyer ba ni gtan du ma skyes pa/ rgyol ba ni rgol ba/ nod pa ni bzhag pa/ khu ba ni 'chags pa/ tha tshig ni rtsa ba 'am tshig gi don/ bste ba ni ngal gso/ brnag pa ni bsam pa/ brnab pa ni 'dod pa/ btung ba ni spyod pa/ sprung ba ni brkyang ba/ nam zhar ni nam yang /gzhur ni gzhung / 'on tan ni 'on kyang / dbrag ni bar/ phyam phyad dam cham chad ni mnyam nyid/ 'dzar ba ni mdza' ba/ rma ga chad ni yang dgabastar ba niXbyi dor ram gzabs pa sogs/ bzhab pa ni 'jam pa/ gting phyin ni dpyis phyin/bro ni mna'/ chang khyu ni tshogs pa/ spa lo ni spobs pa/ tha ramaXni ngan/ brnyang ba ni 'khru ba/ dbye ni thang / bsnyil ba ni dor ba/ gzhag yang ni gzhan yang / rgya yis btab paXni tha mi dad pa/ 'go nan ni thog ma/'ja baXni 'dod pa/ mthong ga ni brang / lag pa bsnyal ba ni lag pa bkrus pa/ glam pa ni snam bu 'thug po/ khra khro can ni spro thung ba/ rung khus za ba ni gtum pa/ je ni dang po'am re zhig la'ang 'jug gzhi bo ni gzhi ma/ ji 'os ni 'tsham pa/ gnong ba ni nyes pa/ mi bkur ba ni khas mi len pa/ gzon pa 374

ni mi nyan pa/ 'chab pa ni gsang ba'am sbed pa/ bcabs pa ni sbas pa/'dzan dka' ni sbyor dka'/ 'khu ba ni zhe sdang ba'am log pa/ bcil ba ni bcom pa/ gya com pa ni ma brtags pa/ rda blags ni rna gtad/ tha chad ni ngan pa/ cha ba ni skeg pa/ gzan pa ni gsan pa/ nga ba ni sel ba/ 'phye ba ni 'gro ba/ smreng tshig ni gsang tshig spreng ni smra ba/ smre ba ni nganaXpar spru ba/rmas pa ni dris pa/ mi 'jab pa ni rtsub pa/ bla mthang ni stod smad dam phyi nang / stos pa ni 'brim pa'am ster ba/brta pa ni rgyas par bya ba/ brtas pa ni rgyas pa/ da ko ni da ni/ 'di ko ni 'di ni/ bkon pa ni khro ba/ ji ga ni brtag pa/ khyo shug ni bza' tsho/ gzhol ba ni 'bab pa/ ring pa ni rdzud pa'am ngan pa/ nyis na ni brtags na'am rnam pa gnyis su na/ tha ba ni rengs pa'amaXnyon mongs/ mthar gyis ni rim gyis/ gzhar yang ni slar yang ngamaXnam yang / bsho ba ni 'khrig pa/ gar yang ni gang yang / mnos pa ni bsams pa/ red pa ni grub pa/ gya nom ni phun sum tshogasaXpa/ mgo mnyam ni dus mnyam/ sdum pa ni khang /pog ni spos/ pog phor ni sposaXphor/ sha dag ni sha stag bkol ba ni bskosaXpa/ 'jud pa ni 'jug pa/ rngub pa ni 'dus pa/ tsham ngam ni 'jigs stangs/ bab chol phyar yang ni ma bsam par 'phrin lam// dbud ni dbus/ snam logs ni zur ram rgyab/ snrel zhi ni 'phred dam logs sam 'chol ba/ nyod pa ni zas/ rod pa ni gos/ yeng ye ni nges par1 bstir med ni mnar med/ sbibs pa ni logs pa/ bru tsha ba ni 375

bkres pa/ bas pa ni zad pa'am mtha' dag pa/ ramaXshag ni 'byor ba/mtha' gru ni rgya khyon/ mnab rtsal ni kha zas/ khos ni 'dun ma/ chab mi 'tshal ba ni chud mi za ba/ ji rob ni ji phyir/ g.yer bo ni mkhas pa'am grims pa/ bskyudaXpa ni brjed pa/ khad kyi ni dal du/ byur ni myaXngan/gtugs pa ni chad pa/ yol go ni snod/ bsnye ba ni 'jigs pa/ bsnyems pa ni nga rgyal/ yugaXpa ni rkang pa/ sug pa ni lag pa/ rgya cang ni ska rags/ gur bu ni gru bzhi/ gyi na ni dman pa/ kho lag ni chu zheng / brtang ba ni glo bur ba/mi yog pa ni mi khebs pa/ 'ubs pa ni 'dus pa/ khud pa ni skyes sam rdzongs/ slags pa ni bkod pa/ phyang chad ni thag bcad/ la gor ni skyen pa/mur 'dug ni nu stegs/ thal byung ni ma lus/ co 'dri ni tho 'tshams/gzher ba ni bsten pa/ yel 'phyos ni zung 'jug 'phrod ni tshogs pa/ phya le baXni mnyam pa/chib pa ni khyab pa/ khos pa ni 'dun pa/ ngo mthon ni nan gyi/mol ba ni gtam mam gros/ tshud mo mkhan ni rkos mkhad gyin 'das ni rang bzhin/ go 'dun ni tshogs shing 'du ba/ gzhur brtag ni zur za ba/ myag phran ni mda'/ nyer bsdogs ni sta gon nam sngon 'gro/ gor ma chag dang gor ma bkum pa ni rbe tshom med pa/ gnam ru ni gzhu/ sprug pa ni zad pa/bkar btags ni khrims bsgrags pa/ phung krol ni don med pa/ lhags pa ni gtad pa/ phyar g.yeng ni rnam g.yeng / sgam pa ni zab pa/ bgam pa ni nyams sad pa/ mnabs pa ni gyon pa/ rtsegaXlog ni phran tshegs sam sred 376

zhen che/ tshar byin ni mthar phyin/ gzas pa ni brdeg par brtsams pa phon po ni tshogs pa/ 'chel ba ni zhen pa'am 'chad pa/ tha rams ni gtams pa/phyis bu ni snod/ rtser phyibs ni mthar phyin/ glal ba ni kha gdangs sam rnam par bsgyings pa/ klubs pa ni phub pa'amaXgyon pa/ g.yem pa ni 'dod pa/nu cor ni kha zer ba'am kha drag gnam po ni drang po/ khor zug ni khor yugam red pa ni ma grub pa/ go 'dunaXni gang mos/ mong du chud pa ni khong du chud pa/ rmibs pa ni rgya che ba/ mchil ba ni lcags kyu/ 'gyed pa ni 'gyod pa/ 'gyer ba ni spong ba/ ger ma ni rag ma/ rum pa ni lto ba'am phag phom pa ni bum pa/ rton pa ni 'dod pa'am rjes su 'brang ba/ 'gems pa ni 'joms pa/ snyugs su ni yun du/ dbrog pa ni 'phrog pa/ glebs pa ni mnan pa/ gal gyis ni nan gyis sam rgyal gyis/ 'jen pa ni dngos po/rlugs pa ni lug pa/ nongs pa ni nyes pa/ 'phye bo ni gong po'am yan lag med par lto bas 'gro ba/ lce rten ni brjod pa'am snyad 'dogs pa/sribs pa ni bsgribs pa'am grib ri'am mtshan mo/ slag pa ni pags pa'i gos/ sdod pa niX'aphen pa/ khol ma'am ba glang mig ni skar khung / 'grim pa ni 'gyed pa/ nur thug ni mthar thug phol ba ni rtogs pa/ la zlas pa ni thag bcad pa/ la zlo ba ni mtha' 'gegs pa'am thag gcod pa/ mi cha ba ni mi shesaXpa/ cha med ni rgyus med/ gtol med ni thabs med/ ci gar ni ji ltar/ ci chib ni mthar phyin/ gar cig ni gang zhig sprun ka ni gnyen 377

ka 'bags pa ni nyams pa/ dmun pa ni blun pa/ shob dang sho be ni rdzun/shing zan ni ro zan/ shid ni gshin po la dmigs pa'i dge ba bsgrubs pa/phru ma ni pho zang ngam dmag sgar/ spong ba ni rtse ba/ brtun pa ni brtson pa/sgo 'phar ni sgo glegs/ spyos pa ni bsdigs pa/ snyom pa ni g.yelaXba'am snyom las/ dbye tshong ni tshong khang / thang la ni bkram pa/ bslan pa niXbasdus pa'am phyogs gtogs/ tshog phor ni rdzogs par/ rwa ba ni bcad pa'am gzhogs pa/ gzengs pa ni brkyang ba'am gzi byin/ 'tsheg pa ni 'jig pa/glos pa ni rmongs pa/ rmeg med ni gtan med/ g.yen spyo ba ni co 'dri/g.yam ni zhar/ rmed pa ni gsol ba'am dri ba/ slong phor ni lhung bzed/ bya ma rta ni nyan rna'am bang chen/ 'bro 'tshal ni nad pa/ rnang ni zhing / da bur ni sreg gnas/ bsnyad pa ni bshad pa/ gtsug lag ni sde snod dam gsung rab/ go re ni rdzogs pa/ brlang po ni rtsub mo/ gzhogs stegs ni sgeg chos/shur bu ni ska rags/ gtos pa ni tshad med/ spad ni pu/ brtsang ba ni bsang ba/ 'dzan mo ni bgrodaXbya/ 'dzan pho ni bgrod byed/ 'jud mthun ni smadaX'atshong / 'gre ba ni g.yo ba/ 'thur ba ni 'khrugs pa/ 'thab krol ni gnod rgyu/ do zan ni mching du/ khong stom pa ni sgyid lug pa/ dkyus mo ni malhogs pa/ dang la ni rdzing bu/ klab pa ni la ba/ dam rgya ni khrims/ zha sgro ni sna med/ltag sgre ni ltag ther/ gor mo ni sdang sems/ spub mo ni bor shugs/ sna sbrang ni mde'u/ bshug pa ni bslang ba/ pus mkhyud ni sgom thag g.yar ni gdong 378

ngam mdun/ byur bu ni spung ba/ thags ran ni btags pa/ rmas paXni nyams pa/ mngan ni mthu/ gaspug pa ni rngan pa/ brngan ni mchod pa/ rnam 'dal ni rnam 'dud/ dpres pa ni badzes pa/ bsenaXkhus ni gnyen bslus/brgyad bkag ni bkyon pa/ bablugs pa niXzhus pa'am dris pa/ 'o ni ni kho ni'am 'di/ mi slon ni mi bzlog 'brongs ni nye bar bsten pa/ go ra niXbatson ra/ ya ma brla ni snying bo med dam mi bded/ sbang rol ni phyi rol/chang thub ni gang zag dog ma niXmadun/ 'phag pa'am cha ba ni 'jug pa/ran pa ni lcug phran/ reng ba ni 'brel med dam rkyangaXb/ mi 'gong ni mi zhum/ than kor ni nye 'khor/ bog re ni ba gam/ ma stes pa ni ma legs pa/stes dbang ni stobs shugs/ gna' bo ni sngon/ sna bo ni gtso bo/ mi gu ni mi zhum/ be no ni 'dzin pa/ nye'u gyi ni bcud tshor/ nyen ni rmang / gdong mo ni mjug ngo'i nang / nil ni so rnyil/ chu brub pa ni khol ba'am rba klong /las yan kin ni kha phyer ram stegs bu/ gzhags pa ni brgyanaXpa/ 'drub pa ni 'tshem pa/ drubs pa ni btsems pa/ chan pa ni khye bo'am gri gugajing ni dbyangs/ gya tho ni rna rgyan/ lan bon ni lan slon/ ther zug ni 'grur med/ rngub re ni hur re/ brug pa ni 'dral ba/ tshig brtsig ni tshig btsun/ gzhogs ma ni steng g.yogs/ nyug rum ni rlig phyung ngam 'bras bu bton pa/ gzhal ba ni mgu ba/ bskyad pa ni bsad pa/ ga ge ni yul/ che ge ni gang zag gi ming gi spyi/ phyi be ni phyi rol/ dgun gdung ni tshad gdung /379

mong brtul ni blun po/ pha ji ni pha rol/ lung bong ni ba glang / phol mig ni 'khor lo'am nad kyi bye brag la'ang 'jug mtshun pa ni bsod nams/mches pa ni khas len/ 'phe'u ni gsol ba/ che zhe ni ci zhes/ gzha' gsang ni g.yung drung / dam dem ni dam bcas/ phyang phrul ni rna rgyan/ dbu rmob ni dbu 'phang / yid smo ni yid dga'/ gnyi zer ni nyi zer/ gtigs pa ni 'khrigs pa/ gdud pa ni 'dud pa/ sbon pa ni za ba/rnyong ba ni brkyang ba/zhe la 'byor ni sems la 'gro ba/ 'khyug pa ni 'chug pa/ 'drid pa ni bslu ba/'pho ba ni 'phen pa/tsen de ni thams cad/ byer ba ni song ba/ gzod ma ni dang po/ ril ni thams cad/ 'dzeg pa ni phrad pa/ gzeb ni gur/ klong du gyur pa ni dbang du gyur pa/ mi bzad ni chen po/ gcam bu ni bcos ma/'chobs shig ni gsangs shig gnyod ka ni mkhos ka ngom pa ston pa/gzu lum ni rang bzo/ glags pa niX'akhebs pa/ lud par ni byur bur/gnongs pa ni nyes pa/ dong ste ni song ste/ dben pa ni mkhoXb/ jis na ni cis na/ blo cing niXbarjod kyang / gzhog pa ni 'jog pa/ kos thag ni nyam thag btul bcil ni sbyangs pa/ khren ni skyon/ gyin ta ni rgyu med/ snga mkho ni snga ma/ sgyur te ni myur du/ kha sbon ni kha ton/ 'o ni ni 'di ni/ 'on cig ni byon cig ldem po ni drang po min pa/ nyid dor ni nges par/ byos shig ni gyis shig rangs pa ni bde ba/ khong 'khyid ni khong 'byin/ gtu lum ni bzi ba/ gyu ba ni bkru ba'am skabasaXl lar nga rgyal can la zer ba'ang 380

'dug pho theka ni khur khyer/ rme ba ni smra ba/ sprun po ni blun po/ 'phan pa ni chag pa/ ga thag ni gang dag sben zha ta ni yang dag min/ 'or 'ga' ni res 'ga'/ 'o cog ni thams cad/ bya rkon ni bya rgya/ gnyig tu ni gcig tu/ 'di ko ni 'di ni/ 'bogs pa ni brtson pa'am brgal/ go cog ni thams cad/ zhag ste ni mgu ste/ gzhen 'debs ni bskul ba/ phon te ni phan te/ 'go ba ni blang ba/ 'du mched ni thabs dang / 'ung nas ni 'di nas/ nyid grul ni rigs ngan/ rdang mo ni dmod mo/ rang nyamasaXni rang bzhin/ 'gran thor gal ba ni 'gran zlar gal ba/yibs su ni dbyibs su/bla khyad ni dregs pa/ bdar ba ni steraya/ 'ung ting ni 'on kyang / gnyen te ni bos te/ 'or ba ni skyob pa'am bor ba/ pha logs ni pha rol/ spu du ni spu gu/ gyimaXshingaXni rol mo/ cho lo ni rgyan po/ zus nas la zug nas/ blon 'debs ni chos ston/ rgya rna ru ni mi tshangs spyod/ 'grong ba ni rma sgo/mchis 'brang ni chung ma/ re rma ni bud med/ ma drangs ni ma ngul/ rlug pa ni gnang ba/ gzhongs ni ljongs/ 'angebs ni phan pa/ brtsu ba ni bsu ba/dmas pa ni nyams pa/ yus te ni bden te/ rmen ngan ni lhas ngan/ ban la ni byas glag gti na ni smre ba/ sbad bzhin ni phyi bzhin/ 'phyan pa ni 'khyamaXpa'am yan pa/ bkum pa ni bcad pa/ mtshun ni pha mes/ nye gnas ni slob bu/ rnyis pa ni rnyings pa/ 'das pa ni des pa/ slos pa niXzlos pa/ smyo ba ni zhan pa/ le'u glon ni lan 'don/ dgum du ni bcad du/ 'drag mthil ni 381

lag mthil/ bum bu ni bum chung / rtsig gu ni rtsig pa/ brungs kyang ni kun kyang / nan thur ni nan tan/ g.yur ramaXyur ni gnyid/ sgro'u chung ni 'dzag snod/ bar tang ni stan 'bol/ yu bu ni rang re/ gtan pa ni sra brkyang / kog tshe ni snying thag sgyung nas niXbacug nas/ dgu ste ni lhag ste/dkyer ba ni sbyin pa/ ma la ni mod la/ 'dod 'gro ni smad 'tshong / ngog go ni nod to/ thong khor ni gar bu/'gebs pa ni sgrib pa/ khrol ba ni shes pa/mtshan dkor ni mtshan legs/ dubs su ni dus su/ lag tub ni mgyogs pa/ ldongs pa ni long ba/ dmigs bu ni khrid byed/ dog na ni song na/ 'ol yang ni dpe yang / mong mi dma' ba ni dpang ni mtho ba/ skyang nul ni zhal zhal/ yugs shig ni byugs shig zhe 'o ni zer to/ /lhung rus ni ltung 'bras/rtsal ba ni byin pa/ 'dzer to ni smras so/ /dug khang ni khrus khang ngam bsro khang / dpya ba ni 'phya ba/ snga za ni snga ba/ bar thang ni phrug stan/ khu sha ni sha khu/ 'de gu ni skyom gu/ tham lag ni man ngagamanang bar bzhag pa ni legs par brgyan pa/ g.yam la ni zhar la/ 'drubs pa ni gsos pa/ snam phyings ni phyi sa khang ba/ de mo ni dgos pa/ skun bu ni gzhong bu/ ya gang ni rkang rten/ci chog ni ci yod/ tha gi ni zhi ba/ rgyu khuXcan ni gcer buXpa/ gzar thag ni dpyang thag nod pa ni len pa'am thob pa/ phyi mo ni btsun mo/ slas ni btsun mo'i 'khor/ blangs kyang ni slar yang/ rims shig ni drongs shigagyong ral ni sa zhag chems bzhag ni 'phrin bzhag shul du ni lam du/mad 382

pa ni bden pa/ sbyan pa pa ni bya ra ba/ gzhilaXb ni brtsom pa/ tshig gu ni 'azas bu/ regs pa ni breg pa/ skyos pa ni nyams pa/ sla ba ni zla ba/ nyul ba ni bul ba'am 'akor ba/ gzhar ba ni mthun pa/ mkha' 'phring ni phor shubs/ rab pas ni btsan pa/ phyogs gcig ni khor gcig ched 'ga' ni res 'ga'/ skyo sngogs ni 'khrug long / bags kyis ni rim gyis/tshang thur ni gos shubs/ brla brnyang ni snon pa/ brnyas pa ni g.yas pa/ brnyan pa ni g.yar ba/ 'chong shig ni chongs shig khom pa ni ngalaXb/pho long ni gru gu/phyag las khom ni ra ro ba/ dgum pa ni gsod pa/ bar 'ga' ni res 'ga'/ rmed du ni gsol du/ sgo sgo ni spang sha 'khob pa niXngan pa/ 'gum pa ni 'chi ba/ bkum pa ni bsad pa/ gor ma ni rdo ba/ 'khrun ring ni mchu ring ngam dkyus ring / banogs te ni bsdams te/ mnags pa ni bsran pa/che zhe ni a che'am sring mo/ cha byad ni cha lugs/ 'byes pa ni mdzes pa'am mtshams phyed pa/ mi chog ni mi phod/ shing thags ni cog g.yer bag ni snang g.yel can/rtsang nan ni btung ba/ 'thams pa ni byams pa/ 'khams pa ni brgyal ba/ sdum mtshes ni khyim mtshes/ ma nangs ni ma langs/brlams pa ni bskyod pa/ sbal du ni dod du/ dral po ni ming po/ nangs kyi ni sngon gyi/ gor bu ni gru bzhi/ sgre bo ni sa rjen/ 'od pa ni yod pa'am chu lam gyi 'obs la zer ba'ang 'dug tsum pa ni 'o byed pa/ rna ru ni 'khrig pa/ mdud pa ni 'ching ba/ dus bab ni 'chi ba/ dus 'das ni shi ba/ phyung 383

phyung ni gzhon nu ma/ snog gzan ni 'khur ba/ dus byed ni mi 'tsho/ bya mo lab ni mchod pa'i rdzas lan kan ni seng ma'am pu shu/ rgyun lugs ni rgyu 'grul/ bsil ba ni skyel ma/ g.yar ngo ji gdong / g.yar len ni khas len/g.yar 'dren ni spyan 'dren/ g.yar dam ni dam bca'/ g.yar lam ni mdun/ g.yar tsha ni ngo tsha/ g.yar khams niXsku khams/ mi 'tshal ni mi tshab/sge'u chung ni 'gro ba/ drungs pa nyag ni rtsa ba nag 'gyur byed ni pra chal/mings ni mi nad dam rims nad/ thog por ni thog nyams/ 'khod pa ni 'dug pa/ do sger ni thor tsug sbebs pa ni nyen pa/ zhal tshus ni zhal zas/long bu ni shing tog lcam bu ni shing tog 'khos su bab pa ni logs su bzhag pa/ gzugs can ma ni smad 'tshong ma/ 'os pa ni gcer bu pa/ ga shes ni kha zer/ rtsen pa ni rtse ba/ thoms shig ni soms shig mthol ni smra ba'am mi spong ba/ gshos pa ni 'khrig pa/ smos 'drin ni grogs po/ ne'u ldang ni na zla'am na mnyam/ 'khyogs ni khri/ bgros pa ni glengs pa/ don mthun ni mgronaXpo/ bskyung ba ni chung ngu/ ma drangs ni mi bsrun/ gum pa ni shi ba/ chen thags ni phyugs nad/ kha dag ni nyam thag ma glas ni khyad bsad/ 'tshog pa ni gshegs pa/ nongs pa ni shi 'dab shog ni nyes/ lhadaXpa ni byi ba/ dral ba ni zhig pa/ co to ni mgo spu/ bsdum thab ni khyem thab/skyin gor ni rtsangs pa'am gangs sbal/ khyoXshug ni bza' tsho/ ran ni rtswa/g.yar khral ni kha khral/ ke'u ni ri sgog kun dong ni sgog pa'am tsong la 384

zer ba'ang snang / nge ni de/ ji ga ni gang / gle ba ni sel po/ zhugs ni me/bskal ba ni bkru/ srel ni mug pa/ srel zan ni mug zos/ sril ni sro chags mug pa zhes pa'ang 'dug lhung bzed gyu ni bkrus nas bzhag ti tsa ni 'og gdan/ phyag sbal ni btson dong / gsud pa ni ma zhu'am sgregs pa/ bzang mkhan ni gos bzo/ ya khad ni steng skas/ rkang rten ni steng 'dzeg them/ sgyu rum ni tshod ma/ khab ral ni khab snod/ chol bzang ni bkru chu'i snod/ ro nye ni bsha' tshe'am zha nye nag por zer ba'ang yod/ ga gon dang tshon mo steng ni zha nye nag po/ bsang zel ni bsha' rdo/ bsrel ni 'chang ba/ dbyul ni myul ba/ go re longaXni lag g.yog gam gad byed pa/gzhi bo ni rgyun sdod/ mtshams bskum pa ni mtshams bcad pa/bshung ba ni dma' bab/ nang bcas ni zhe 'gras/ khyer ni khang thog dpong sa ni chos grwa sogs/ gor bu ni stan blum/ tshar ni phreng ba/ par thang ni sa gdan/ sa mo nig ni stan ring / bsnyil ba ni phyir 'don/ bsel byed ni lam skyel/thags ma ni sne zur/ go los ni kha zer tsam/ gying gong ni zhi ba/ 'bram zer ni dum grugs/ dngar ba ni bsgrigs pa/ 'khos su bab ni 'dun pa/rtse rgod ni 'khor g.yog gam lha 'bangs/ longs pa ni rgyags pa/ lag giXbla ni las dpon/ ltag 'og ni snga phyi'am gong 'og spun pa ni bstun pa/thog thog ni dang por/ reg zeg ni zin bris sam bkas bcas/ bon pa ni zlas pa/ baibs po ni mi mngon/ rings po ni brtsod pa/ spul ba ni rung 386

ba/ mig gi rdu ma ni mig gi dri ma'am skyo ma/ gtam 'dres pa ni phebs par smra ba/ dbos pa ni sbos pa/ slad tsha ni mi gtsang ba'am bshang ba/ sha chags pa ni blo la yod pa/ kyal ka ni ku re'i tshig bstang ba ni mgon nam grogs/ dus po che ni 'dzin pa che ba/ nying sha ni rang gi sha stong ba ni phan pa'am grogs/ dkor ni nor pyi zhe sa/ ka ca ni nor gyi spyi ming / dkyel che ba ni khong yangs pa/ chu gang ni snying stobs/ skrus pa ni gcod pa/ sgrun pa ni 'gran pa/ bskru ba ni gzhanaXl thabs kyis 'brad pa/ man ni tshong dang dus/ ju bo ni rdo/ sha kon zhugs pa ni khon yod pa/ mnyel ba ni ngal ba/brdul ni bsdus pa'am 'jam pa/ 'khrun ni 'phang ngam srid/ 'dren ma ni sna tshogasaX'adres sam khra bo/ mnag dka' ni sran dka'/ mnog chung ni kha chung ba/ phyang de ni 'jol le ba/ byug ris ni grel/ nu rdzi ni nying khu/dgong ba ni smad pa/ shin te ma ni chud za ba/ sag rtsa skyel ba ni spungs skyed pa'am dam bca' brtan pa/ skyo ma ni phra ma'am bye ba/ sbon pa ni gtong ba/ spun pa ni bsres pa'am rdzun pa la'ang 'jug so sto ni so zing /sprebs pa ni zas/ btogs pa ni phrogs pa/ bye ni sdug bsngal/ bye ba ni nyams pa/ chums pa niXchags pa/ dus kyis 'chu ba ni dbang gis 'chu ba/sbang ba ni miX'ajigs pa/ sgyugs pa ni bcug pa/ dkre ni pho mtshan gyi togakog rtse ni rgya'am rnyi rnyong / ther to ni rtse mo/ rdzi ni rlung / btungs pa ni bsad pa/ wan pa ni song ba/ ram shag ni 'gyod pa/ ltog mo ni khud pa/386

tshang mang ni thab tshang / gdugs ni nyin mo/ dgung ni mtshan mo/ bser bu ni rlung / bsgo ba rnar gzon ni bslab bya la mi nyan par phyir bzlog pa'am bskul tshig dang du mi len pa/ mno ba ni sems pa/ lnga ba ni 'chi ba/ che zhe ni khyo/ che zhi ni chung ma/ 'bel gtam ni yang dag pa'i gtam/ ga gon ni nyung ma/ mngan bgrang ni skyon nas brjod pa/ mchor ni mdzes pa/ ci ga ni de skad/ 'jor ba ni tog rtse'am 'jug thug gnyug ma ni gdod ma/ 'do ba ni rta/ rtsab mo ni rab byung gi btung ba'i khyad par/ 'tshem pa ni rmoga'ajol ba ni nor ba/ 'dzed pa ni bzed pa/ 'dzab ni sngags bsnyen grogs byed ming / gzhungs pa ni rab tu grub pa/ gzigs dang gzon ni lus dang ngag gi khyad par/ gzegs ma ni cha shas tsam/ zol ma ni g.yo sgyu/srul ba ni rul ba/ dku ni lus kyi sta zur ram dri mi zhim pa la'ang 'juga'abyor byin ni g.yo sgyu/ bka' mchid ni gleng mo/ bkol ba ni bkar ba'am las bkol sogs/ bkad sa ni g.yos khang ngam 'dug sa/ dkon pa ni snang ba/ mkhu ba ni ldog pa/ ga ga tshil ni skyi g.ya' ba/ gob lon ni bya sla/ gal bzung ni sun 'byin/ gor ma ni rdo/ gar bu ni ljags/ brded pa ni 'drid pa/ ci zhig ltar ni 'bad rtsol med/ nu cor ni rdzun/ la ga can ni sho gam/ bcom ni khengs dregs/ lcam ni sring mo/ mi mjid ni bzodaXpa/ 'ja' dang 'jums pa ni khengs pa btang ba/ 'jang ba ni za ba'am btung ba/ nyan rna ni phag nyan/ snang brnyan ni snang la rang bzhin 387

med/ nyon mongs ni chags sogs/ snyon mongs ni sdug bsngal/ bsnyen pa ni nye ba/ bgrings pa ni ring ba/ bsnyil ba ni bsgod pa/ gtol med ni cha med/ gtur bu ni chos gos kyi snod/ brton ni yid brtan rung / bstar ba ni rdul phyis/ ma than ni ma zhum/ mthang ni nang / dog le ni chu sro ba'i snod dam dbyeb le'ang zer/ gdos bu ni snod chung chus gang ba/ bda' ba ni zhim pa/ bdar ba ni byi dor ram bye mar byas pa/ bdo ba ni dar ba/bden pa bdar ram mdun du bdar ni dbang du byas pa/ go 'thun ni snaXtshogs/ gnag ni phyug gnog pa niXmang bo/ tho ni gal/ rnang maXni zhing las/ brnan pa ni nges bzung ngam dgar ba'ang zer/ brnangs ni yi ga gyen du 'phyur ba/ spags ni 'phags pa/ spyin ni 'byar byed/ khyad par ni rtag tu'am rgyun du/ dbre ni rtsog pa/ smag ni nun pa/ bsnyems pa ni nga rgyal/ khad kyis ni dal bu/ nye zho med pa ni legs pa'am skyon med pa'am bkra shis pa sogs/ dbang thang che ba ni skal ba che ba'am dpal che ba'am skal ba bzang po'o/ /de dag ni brda' gsar rnying gi rnam bzhag che long tsam bsdus pa'o/ /de ltar rgyal ba'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa chen po hor gyi skad du bsgyur ba la nye bar mkho ba'i gzhung lugs mkhas pa'i 'byung gnas zhes bya ba 'di nyid la sbyangs par 'dod pa rnams kyis/ byang chub kyi sems dang / theg pa chen po'i bsgrubs pa dang / macan pa gsum dang /388

theg chen sbyor ba/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan la sogs pa'i ming gi rnam grangs ni phar phyin gyi skabs su blta bar bya'o/ /de bzhin du bdag 'dzin dang / lta ngan dang / bdag med gnyis dang / stong nyid kyi dbye ba/ sa bcu/ byang sems kyi spyod pa phyin drug bsdu ba bzhi/ byang sems kyi rtsa lhung / nyes byas sogs ni dbu ma'i skabs su blta'o/ /bden pa bzhi/ rten 'brel bachu gnyis/ phung bo lnga/ khams bco brgyad/ skye mched bcu gnyis/ sems sems byung / las dkar nag 'bras bu dang bcas pa/nyon mongs kyi rnam bzhag snod bcud kyi 'jig rten gyi khams/ dge 'dun nyi shu/ mtshan nyid gsum/ bsam gtan gzugs med kyi ting 'dzin/ zhi gnas lhag mthong gi rab dbye sogs ni mngon pa'i skabs su blta'o/ /so thar rigs brgyad kyi sdom pa len tshul/ mkhan po dang slob dpon gyi rnam bzhag ltung ba'i rnam bzhag las brgya rtsa gcig gi dbye ba sogs gzhiXbacu bdun gyi skor ni 'dul ba'i skabs su blta'o/ /phyi rol pa'i grub mtha' bcu gnyis/ nang pa'i grub mtha' bzhi rnams kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i 'dod pa so so ba'i ming ni grub mtha'i skabs su blta'o/ /gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde bzhi so so'i dbang / dam tshig sdom pa/ rgyud kyi dbye ba/lam gyi rnamaXbazhag rnams kyi skor ni sngags kyi skabs su blta'o/ /shes bya yul gyi rnam bzhag shes byed tshad ma dang tshad min gyi dbye ba/ rgol phyir 389

rgol gyi rtsod tshul gyi skor sogs ni gtan tshigs rig par blta'o/ /sgra bsgrub pa dang / klog pa/ a li ka li 'bri tshul/ rnam dbye'i 'jug tshul sogs ni sgra rig par blta'o/ /rig gnas bco brgyad dang / gtsug lag rtsis kyi skor gyi ming gi rnam grangs ni bzo rig par blta'o/ /nad dang /sman dang / dpyad dang / tshe bsring ba'i thabs lus gso bar byed pa'i skor ni gso ba rig par blta'o/ /brda' gsar rnying gi rnam bzhag ni le'u tha mar blta bar bya'o/ /gzhan yang 'dir ma 'dus pa'i ming gi rnam grangs gzhan dang ༷ gzhan ni sngar gyi mkhas pa tshad ldan rnams kyis mdzad pa'i dag yig che chungaXsna tshogs 'dug pa rnams la zhib tu dpyad nas gang zag la mi rton chos la rton/ tshig la mi rton don laXrton pa'i sgo nas legs par shes par bya yi/ pho tshod kyis zom 'jog dang / phyogs zhen dang / g.yo thabs 'ba' zhig lhur len pa'i sgo nas rgyal bstan rin po che dri ma can du byed pa ni blo gros dang ldan pa rnams kyis dug bzhin du spang bar bya'o/ /ji skad bshad pa'i tshul gyis bsam pa dang sbyor ba rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa legs par bsgyur ba dang /bsgyur zin 'chos pa dang / de nyid tshul bzhin du 'chad pa dang / rang gis don nyams spu len cing gzhan dag kyang tshul de la sbyor ba sogs gang yang rung ba'am/ de dag ci rigs pa la brtson pas/ rgyal ba'i bstanaXpa 390

rin po che ring du gnas par byed pa ni/ dal ba'i rten la snying bo len pa'i thabs mchog tu gyur pa/ skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis gcig tu bsngags par bya ba'i gnas/ 'gro ba mtha' dag gi sman yon dam pa/ rgyal ba sras bcas dgyesaXpar byed pa'i thabs rmad du byung ba yin pas/bdag legs su 'dod pa rnams kyis nus pa dang rtsal ci yod kyis tshul deXl 'bad par bya rigs so zhes kun la thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs so /smrasaXpa/ rnam dkar lhag bsam sa bon smin pa las/ /nyer 'khrungs gzhung lugs yongs 'du'i ljon pa che/ /don 'bras g.yur za rig gnas lo 'dab rgyas/ /blo gsal lha bu'i nyer 'tsho 'di ko rmad/ /gzhung brgya'i rnam mang tha snyad me tog tshogs/ /sdeb mkhas srad buraXbargyus pa'i spel legs 'phreng / /mkhas mchog mgul ba'i rgyan du nyer 'os 'dis//yid kyi brtan pa mi 'phrog shes ldan gang / /grong tshig ljan sdin khengs gtam dri ngan 'thul/ /ma dag kun slongaXsnyems pas dz+rengs pa la/ /rnam sad mchod yon dam par rlom pa des/ /mkhas rnams yi mug dpyod ldanaXzhe re khrel/ /legs nyes 'byed pa'i rtsal med blo dman rnar/ /legs bshad sgra las rmongs pa'i glu snyan mod/ /legs gsungs don la ches goms mkhas pa'i tshogs/ /legs lam chos tshul sgrogs pas ga la ngoms/ /bcu phrag rig gzhung tha snyad ches mang po/ /rgya cher bshad na blo ldan mgu bskyed kyang / /391

glegs bam gzugs kyis 'jigs rnams rjes bzung pyir/ /mdor bsdus tsam 'di go sla'i ngag gis bshad/ /'dun 'jigs zhe sdang rmongs pa'i dbang gyur pa'i/ /'gro ba bzhi yis 'dir ni bshung gyur kyang / /gzhung dang byed po'i skyon du mi 'gyur gyi/ /blun po rang gi de nyid ston par zad/ /phyogs kun snang byed bcu gnyis bdag po la/ /byang bstan phug gnas sbal lhong 'bye bo yis/ /'bad pas smod kyang rang gi nyes pa ste/ /gling bzhi'i mun sel rten 'brel ji ltar khegs/ /rab 'byams gzhung la tshul bzhin legs sbyangs pas/ /gsung rab dgongs don rig pa'i mkhas rnams kyis/ /tshul 'dir nyes pa'i cha gang gzigs gyur na/ /de ni nges par bdag blo'i nongasaXpa ste/ gnong bzhin 'chags so nyes pa kun bsal nas/ /byis pa chung ngus smras pa'i 'khrul ba la'ang brtse ba'iXpha mas mtshar du 'dzin pa bzhin/ /phyir zhing bdag la lhag par brtse bar mdzod/ /'dir 'bad dge ba rab dkar bdud rtsi'i rgyun bzang ji snyed mchis pa kun/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyalaXb sras bcas spyan sngar kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin gyur te/ /stobs bcu mnga' rnams dgyes pa 'dzum 'phreng srid zhi'i phun tshogs 'od 'bar bas/ /rab 'byams rgya mapa'i 'jig rten khams kyiXrgud mun cig char 'phrog gyur cig /mkha' khyab 'gro kun re re'i phyir yang bgrang yas bskal bar 'khor ba 'dir/ /brnag dka'i dka' ba sna tshogs dang blang thar lam gsal bar byed dgos kyang / /skyo 392

med rgyal ba'i mdzad bzang bsgrubs la bdag ni skad cig tsam du yang / /lhod pa med pa'i snying stobs ched pos rnam kun spro bzhin 'jug gyur cig /gang zhig gzhung 'dir thos bsam 'bri klog blta bas 'jug pa'i skye bo kun/ /ring bor mi thogs gtugs pa med pa'i rnam dpyod spobs pa mchog brnyes te/ /nu mtha' yas pa'i yon tan tshogs thob rgyal ba'i dam chos 'dzin pa la/ /mang pa'i gter dang mi pham mgon bzhin zla bral go 'phang 'thob grur cig /go'u te ring lugs 'dab brgya'i tshal chen legs par bzhad pa'i dga' ston la/ /'gro 'di'i rkang drugaXrnam par rol bas gtan bde'i phun tshogs sbrang rtsi'i bcud/ /longs su spyod pa'i dpal gyis nam mkha'i dngosaXpo gzugs gzhan ma gyur pa/ /de srid 'jig rten mtha' dag rnam pa kun tu mdzes pa nyid gyur cig /'gran bral stobs 'byor rdul brtsegs chab srid zla zhun gos can ri bo'i spor/ /sde bzhi'i rtsal gsum yongs rdzogs rnamaXpar 'gying ba'i mi rje gdong lnga'i dbang / /bsngags 'os dge bcu'i bka' khrims nga ros phyogs kyi 'khor lo 'gengs bzhin du/ /mchog gsum bla mar 'dzin pa'i dpal 'di nam yang nyams pa med gyur cig /mtha' yas rgyal dang de sras byin brlab lha dang drang srong bden pa'i mthu/ /skye dgu'i legs byas phungaXbo gcig bsdu4 bkra shis ji snyed yod pa des/ /dbyig ldan can 'di ma lus nag po'i las kyi 'bras bus rab dben cing / /'gro rnams ya rabs spyod tshul lhur lenaX393

phun tshogs dge mtshan rnam rgyas shog /ces dag yig mkhas pa'i 'byung gnas zhes bya ba 'di ni/ 7tshe ring gnam gyi she mong gis yangs pa'i nor 'dzin gyi nga la dbang bsgyur ba 'jam dbyangs brtan pa'i 'khor lo mi rje'i tshul du rol ba gong ma bdagaXpo chen pos bka' stsal spyi bor blangs te 'phags yul paṇa grub rnams kyi gsung rab rmad du byungaXb bstan bcos 'gyur ro cogaXchen po hor gyi skad du bsgyur ba la nye bar mkho ba'i yan lag tu dmigs nas/ gong ma'i lung gis bkān ting phu'u shan bkang tshi tā kau shir bsngags shing grub pa'i mtha' du maXl sbyangs pa'i blo gros mi dman pa shākya'i dge slong ye shes bstan pa'i sgron me ming gzhan lcang skya hu thog thur 'bod pas gzhung lugs mang por legs par gzhigs te dka' ba'i gnas rnams/ gong ma'i lung gis go'i lha chan shir bsngags shing thub pa'i bstan pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i gnad la gzhanaXdring mi 'jog pa'iXmang rab kyi dbang phyug dam par gyur pa khri chen sprul ba'i sku blo bzang bstanaXpa'i nyi ma dpal ༷ bzang bo'i zhal snga nas la 'dri gtugs bdar sha bcad nas legs paྈ bsgrigs pa'i yi ge pa ni tā'i ku shri dge slong ngag dbang bstan 'phel dang lo tsā pa ku shri dge slong ngag dbang chos dpal gnyis kyis bgyis pa lags shing / chen po hor gyi skad du bsgyur skabs khri chen sprul ba'i sku dang / nged rang gnyis/ phu'u yin bla ma zur ba dge slong shes rab rgya mtsho/ bod kyi 394

bsgab grwa'i spyi dpon mi bzang rim pa dngaXpo'i tha'i ji e phu u ju mu chin mgon po skyabs/ bodaXkyi bslab grwa'i rimaXpa gnyis pa'i slob dpon lung phu zi'i ja sag bla ma so nyid dge slong bstan 'dzin chos dar/ lha khang ser bo g.yas ma'i ja sag bla ma dge slong chos 'phel dar rgyas/ bod kyi bslab grwa'i rim pa gnyis pa'i slob dpon cing ju zi'i tā bla ma dge slong shes rab rgya mtsho rnams dang / bod dbus gtsang nas phebs pa'i bzo rig smra ba se chen rab 'byams pa blo bzang sangs rgyas/ sgra rig smra ba mer gen rab 'byams pa shes rab bstan 'dzin/ gso ba rig pa sbyangs pa dar han em chi 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan/ mdo smad chags mdo thang ba pha'i kya dga' ldan phan bde gling gi smon rams pa ngag dbang rgya mtsho/ smon rams pa ngag dbang bzang boXkhu dbon gnyis/ sa mdo sgo mang dam chos gling gi dus 'khor baXpani ta chos rje rab 'byams paXblo bzang rgyal mtshan/dpalaXldan 'bras spungs sgo mang ba pani ta chos rje rab 'byams pa ye shes tshul khrims/ dpal ldan 'bras spungs sgo mang ba a pa ga g.yod ru'i gling bsres bka' bcu ngag dbang rin chen te gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba bka' rams lngaXdang / hor chin noXyon huXthug thu hu pi la kan ngag dbang blo bzang yar 'phel/ a pa ha nar g.yas ru'i ta bla ma a chi thu mer gen chos rje blo bzang chos 'dzin/ ha ra chin thu sa thu chos rje ku ṭī ngag dbang stobs ldan/ ja rod shī ke thu u lem ci pi lig thu er te ni ku 395

ṭī chos rgya mtsho/ mkhar sngon chos skyabs ti yan chi hu thug thu'i er te ni dar han ku ṭī bstan pa rgya mtsho/ sa pa ha nar g.yon ru'i dar han ṭī ke thu tā'i ku shrī dge slong ngag dbang bstan 'phel/ 7rje btsun dam pa'i sgar gyi nom chi nang so ku ṭī grags pa/ pi lig thu ku ṭī grags pa/ hur cha pi lig thu ku ṭī chos rdo rje/ zhi dar nang so ku ṭī blo bzang dge legs/ u cu mu chin lo tsā ba ku shrī dge slong ngag dbang chos dpal te skad gnyis smra ba'i ku ṭī bcu rnams kyis sngon gyi 'gyur rnying dang gsung rab kyi dgongs pa la legs par dpyad de ta'i ching lha skyong rgyal po'i gnam lo drug pa lcags mo bya lo'iXsmin drug zla ba'i rgyal phur gnyis grub sbyor nyin dbu btsugs te gnam lo bdun pa chu pho khye lo'i mgo zla ba'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin mjug rdzogs par byas te 'thad pa dang lung dang ma 'gal bar bkas bcad kyi tshul du gtan la phab pa'o/ /'dis kyang thub dbang bstan pa'i snying bo rgyal ba blo bzang grags pa'i ring lugs dri ma med pa phyogs dus thams cad du daraXzhing rgyas pa dang / 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen po'i lugs bzang dge ba'i chab srid bskal brgyar brtan pa dang skye rgu mtha' dag rdzogs ldan gyi dpal la longs spyod par gyur cig /(dag yig 'di dgon lung dgon pa'i shing par gzhir bzung nas bsgrigs pa yin)396
༄༅ //bod kyi skad las gsar rnying gi brda'i khyad par ston pa legs par bsha/da pa li shi'i gur khang zhes bya ba bzhugs so//skyogs ston rin chen bkra shes kyis brtsams/

༄༅ / /na mo mdzi ṭī ye/ de yang 'dir brda gsar rnying gi tha snyad bshad paXl/ thu mi sa 'bor(lho banyal byi thumisnang grags kyi du a nu ste/ sasto ṭa dang/sasgyu dra sogasaXrgya skad du bzhed pa byung yang / 'di gnyal na yod pa sa 'dur bo zhig 'dug pas/sa 'bo ra yin pa 'dra/ gangana'ang bod skad du snang )dang / btsad po khri srong lde btsan gyi dus dang por byas pa'i 'gyur rnams ni/ dngaXpo'i bkas bcad kyis bsgyur ba ste/ sangs rgyas phal po che dang / lung sde bzhi dang / mdo sde kha cig dang sher phyin gyi mdo kha cig ste/ skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la ma phab pa rnams so//de la ni/ gang la gag dang / ci phyir la ji rob dang / ji snyam la ji ltaraXdang / rtse mo la spyi bo dang / shin tu'am rab tu laXte por dang / yang /wā lha zhes pa bsgyur ba'i te por ni/ dam pa dang / sra ba dang / drag pa dang / tshabs che ba rnams la 'jug pa dang / rkyen sman la rkyen rtsi dang /ltag pa la glag pa dang / sgos dang spos phor la pog dang pog phor dang /bsal ba la bstsal ba dang / sogs pa la stsogs pa dang / bsu ba la bstsu ba dang / dri baspung la dri brdzung dang / bsangs pa la bstsangs pa dang /rdzogs so la rdzogs sto/ g.yogs pa laXyogs pa dang / go cha la go ca dang /brag cha la brag ca dang / rin po che la rin po ce dang / dkon mchog laXdakon cog dang / rin chen la rin cen dang / khyim la sdum pa dang /dadus la dbung dang / 'gro ba la bgom pa dang / grub paXl red pa dang /398

'grel ba la 'grol bar bsgyur ba la sogs pa mang ste/ rgyas par ni gsung rab las shes par bya'o/ /yang / de dag tu da drag dang / dpyid sla ra ba sogs dang / de' la' ni' zhes pa lta buX' yig mtha' rten sbyar ba ni sum rtags kyi dgongs pa yin kyang don la thob pa gzhir bcas nas yi ge nyung ba'i sgad du bzhag pa dang / yang / myed/ pyin sogs ya btags pa dang / ral gyi sogasaXni lo tsā ba kha cig gis yul skad shor bar grags pa yin no/ /gnyis pa skad gsar bcad laXni de dag gi zlas drangs pa ji skad bshad pa rnams dang / gzhan yang gsung rab la grags pa'i ming phal che ba rnams so/ /bkas bcad gnyis po de ni mnga' bdag khri ral ba can yan chad du ska cog zhang gsum la sogs pas mdzadaXpa yin no/ /bkas bcad gsum pa ni lha bla ma yeXshes 'od kyi dus kyi sgra sgyur lo tsā baXchen po rin cen bzang po nas dpang lo tsā ba chen po dang snyigs dus kyi skad gnyis smra ba gcig pu pa lo chen dharma pā la bha dra'i bar du byon pa rnams yin la/ lo chen gyis ni/ gnyi zla la nyi zla dang / bstan bcos la bstan chos dang / stug po la 'thug po dang / nyi shu dang sum cu dang sum brgya rnams la/ gnyis bcu dang gsum bcu dang gsum brgya dang / bsam gtan la bsam btan sogs 'chos par mdzad kyang / bkas bcad bar ba bzhin du gnas pa mang zhing / de dag gi brda'i khyad paraXgasung rab rnams su 'byung ba 'di snyed cig mchisaXte/ ka dang gag ni kye dang gang /399

skyor skyor ni yang yang / bla 'og ni steng 'og bla skyal ba ni mi zad pa/ rtsa lag ni gnyen/ gnya' bo ni dbang bo/ rid pa dang sbeg pa ni dngos ngan pa dang sha chung ba'am skem pa/ gya ba ni nyams pa/ gyag pa ni brlag pa/ ye 'byam ni stong nyid/ dbal ni tog dang rtse mo dang sha nyams dang me'i drod/ngo ga ni snang ngo / gam yo ni nye 'khor/ dmus byung ni tshi chad dam yi chad/then cher ni ca re/ ga zha ni bzhad gad kyi sgra/ ya lad ni go cha spyi dang skabs thob kyis rmog gi ming la 'jug pa'ang yod/ gna' ni thog ma'am sngon/ yod do cog dang 'gyur ro cog lta bu'i cog ni mtha' dag gi don/gyur cig gu lta bu'i gu ni smon pa'i tshig sbrebs pa ni skem pa/ gsang khung ni bshang lam/ mdung dor ni rgyan 'gyed/ cham du ni gtan du/ nod pa ni thob pa'am bzhag pa/ tha tshig ni tshig gi don/ bste ba ni ngal gso ba/brnag pa niXbasam pa/ sprung baXni brkyang ba/ nam zhar ni nam yang / 'on tang ni 'on kyang / bkri ba ni drang ba'am 'khrid pa/ dbrag ni bar/gzags pa ni zags pa/ phyam phyad ni mnyam nyid/ bgro ba ni gleng ba/ rma ga chad ni yang dag pa'am phal po che dang snyan gyi gong rgyan/ bstar ba ni byi dor legs pa dang gzabs pa/ spras pa/ sems la sgom pa/ yodaXpa la/gting phyin pa ni dpyis phyin pa/ bro ni mda'/ chang khyu ni tshogs pa/ spa lo ni spobs pa/ tha ram ni ngan pa/ brnyang ba ni 'khru ba/ dbye ni thang /bsnyil ba ni dor ba'am phyir bskrad pa/ lag pa bsnyal ba ni lag pa bkrus 400

pa/ mthong ga ni zang / glam pa ni snam bu 'thug po/ khra khro can ni spro thungaXb/ rung khus za ba ni gtum pa/ mgo nan ni thog ma/ je ni dang po dang re zhig ces pa la'ang / gzhi bo ni gzhi ma/ ji 'os ni 'tsham pa/ gnong mi bkur ba ni nyes pa khas mi len pa/ bsgo ba rnar gzon pa ni bsgo ba la mi nyan pa/ 'chab pa ni gsang ba'am sped pa/ 'dzan dka' ni sbyor dka'/'khu ba ni zheXsdang ba/ bcabs pa ni sbas pa/ gya tsomaXni ma brtags pa/ rna blags ni rna ba gtod pa/ tha chad pa ni ngan pa/ nga ba ni sel ba/ 'phye ba ni 'gro ba/ smreng tshig ni gsang tshig dang smra ba tsam la'ang / smreng ba ni smra ba/ spre ba ni ngan par smra ba/ smreXsngags kyang de nyid/ rmas pa ni dris pa/ mi 'jab pa ni rtsub pa/ dral ba ni bcom pa'am zhig pa/ bla mthang ni stod smad dam phyi nang / bsod pa ni bzang po'am legs pa/ bstabs pa ni brims pa'am byin pa/ stos pa ni 'brim pa'am ster ba/ stob pa niXmagron du gnyer ba/ byer ba ni song ba/ brta ba ni rgyas par bya ba/ brtas pa ni rgyas pa/ da ko ni da ni/ 'di ko ni 'di ni/ bkon pa ni khro ba/ ji ga ni brtag pa/ khyo shug ni bza' tsho/ gzhol ba ni 'bab pa/ nyis na ni rnam pa gnyis su na zhes pa lha bu'am/ yang na tha ba ni rengs pa/ mthar gyes ni rim gyis/ gzhar yang ni slar yang ngam nam yang / mnos pa ni bsams pa/ gya nom ni phun sum tshogs pa/ gya nom snang ba ni yodaXpa dang legs pa'i don yang yin/ phyad par ni rgyun par/ bsnams pa ni thogs pa/ sha 401

dag ni sha stag 'jud pa ni 'jug pa/ rngub pa ni 'dus pa'am 'jug pa/tsham ngam ni 'jigs stangs/ bab bab bam bab col ni ma bsam par smra ba'am 'phral ma/ phyang yar ni 'phrin las/ snam logs ni zur dang rgyab/skril zhi ni logs sam 'phred dam 'chol ba go rim du mi gnas pa/ nyod pani zas/ rod pa ni gos/ yong ye ni nges par rwam rnam pa kun tu'am rnam pa thams cad kyi thams cad du zhes pa lta bu/ bsnyir med ni mnar med dam ngal gso medaXpa/ spribs pa ni ltogs pa/ bru ba tsha ba ni bkres pa/bas pa ni zad pa'am mtha' dag pa/ brnan pa ni nges bzung / ram shag ni 'byor ba/ mnangs ni nom pa'am srid/ mtha' gru dang thagaXgru ni rgya khyon/ mnab rtsal ni la zas/ g.yer po ni mkhas pa'amaXgrims pa/ khos rang chab mi 'tshal ba ni mdun ma chud mi za'o/ bsgyud pa ni brjed pa/khad kyi ni dal bu/ byur ni mya ngan/ yol go ni snod/ bsnyengs pa ni 'jigs pa/ bsnyems pa ni nga rgyal/ yug pa dang yob yob ni rkang ba/ sug pa ni lag pa/ nem nur ni yid gnyis/ rgya cang ni ska rags/ guraXbu ni gru bzhi/ gyi na dang gyin 'dar ni dman pa'am don med dam rang bzhin pa/brtad pa ni glo bur ba/ mi yogs pa ni mi khebs pa/ 'ubs pa ni 'dus pa/ khud pa ni skyes sam rdzongs/ slags pa niXbakod pa/ phyang chad ni thag bcad/ la gor ni mgyogs pa'am skyen pa/ nur 'dug ni mru stegs/ co 'dri ni tho 'tshams/ gzher ba ni bsten pa/ yel 'phyos ni zung 'jug402

'chos pa ni zosaXpa/ 'du 'phrod ni tshogs pa/ phya le ba niXmanyam pa/ chib pa ni khyab pa/ khos pa ni 'dun pa/ ngo mthon ni nanaXgyi/ mol ba ni gtam mam gros/ tshud mo mkhan ni rkos mkhan/ go 'dun ni tshogs shing 'du ba/gzhur brtag ni zur za ba/ nyer bsdogs ni sta gon/ myag phran ni mda'/gor ma chag pa ni the tshom med pa/ gor ma bkum pa'ang de nyid/ gnam ru ni gzhu/ sprug pa ni zad pa/ bkar btags ni khrims bsgrags pa/ phung krol ni don med pa/ lhags pa ni gtad pa/ phyar g.yeng ni rnam g.yeng dang rang nyid 'dod pa'i chos gzhan la ngom zhing sgeg pa'i don yang yin/sgam pa ni zab pa/ bgam pa ni nyams sad pa/ mnabs pa ni lhon pa/rtsag log ni phran tshegs sam sred zhen che ba/ tshar phyin ni mthar phyin/dbab pa ni 'bebs pa'am bzhag pa/ gzas pa ni brdeg par brtsams pa/phon po niXtshogs pa/ 'dzer ba ni smras pa'am zer ba/ 'chel ba ni zhen pa'am 'chad pa/ tha rams ni gtams pa/ phyis bu ni sdod/ rtser phyibs ni mthar phyin/ glal ba ni kha gdangs sam rnam par basbyings pa/ klubs pa ni phub pa'am gyon pa/ g.yem pa ni 'dod pa/ nu cor ni kha zer ba dang kha drag gnam po ni drang po 'jug par/ kye ma gzhan gyi gnam po nyid/ ces pa lta bu'o/ khor zug ni khor yug chabs cig pa ni lhan cig pa/ chub pa ni rtogs pa/ go 'dun ni sna tshogs sam gang mos/ mong duXchud pa ni khong du chud pa/ rlibs pa ni rgya che ba/ mchil pa ni lcags kyu/ lcags kyo zhes 403

pa'ang de nyid/ 'gyed pa ni 'gyod pa/ zang zing ni sha'am zas/ zang zing sbyin pa'ang gtso bor sha ster ba'i don du bshad/ 'gyer ba ni spong ba/ger ma ni rag ma/ rum ni lto ba'am phag phomaXpa ni bum pa/ rton pa ni 'dod pa'am rjes su 'brang ba/ don la ni mi rton tshig la rton/ 'phyo ba ni lding ba/ 'gems pa ni 'joms pa/ snyugs su ni yun du/ dbrog pa ni 'asbag pa/ glebs pa ni mnan pa/ rjen pa ni gcer bu'am rkyang ba/ gal gyis ni nan gyis sam rgyal gyis/ 'jin pa niXlen pa dang bcags pa dang dngos po yid dang rna bar 'thad pa lta du la'ang yod/ rlugs pa ni lug pa ste zas ma zhu ba phyir byungaXb/ nongs pa ni nyes pa/ 'phye bo ni gong po'amaXyan lag med par lto bas 'gro ba/ tshur sheg ni tshur shog lce rten ni brjod pa'am snyad 'dogs pa/ sribs pa ni bsgribs pa'am grib ri dang mtshan mo/ sbag paXni pags pa'i gos/ sdod pa ni 'phen pa/ khol ma'am glang mig ni skar khung / 'di dkar gsal dang mun dkar zer ba dang bstun na das 'phul thob par snang yang / 'dul ba la skar tshod blta ba'i ri mig bzhag pa las btags pa'i brda btsan par byas pa'o/ /'grems pa ni 'gyed pa/ gseg shang dang gsil byed ni 'khar gsil/ spyi tor can ni gtsug tor can/ gsong por smra ba ni sngar spra ba'am drang por smra ba/ do ker canaXni thor cog can/ dpe mkhyud ni chos ston 'os pa la'ang sba ba/'bel ba'i gtam dang bka' mchid ni yang dag pa'i gtam/ mkhyud spyad 404

ni man ngag phran bu sbas te 'chad pa/ nur thug ni mthar thug phol ba ni rtogs pa/ la zlas pa ni thag bcad pa/ la zlo ba ni mtha' 'gegs pa'am thagaXgacod pa/ mi cha ba ni mi shes pa/ cha med ni rgyus med/ gtol med pa ni thabs med pa'am rgyus med pa/ ci gar ni ji ltar/ ci chib ni mthar phyin/ gar cig ni gang zhig sprun ka ni gnyen ka 'bags pa ni nyams pa/dmun pa ni blun po/ sho be ni rdzun/ shob kyang de nyid/ shid zan ni ro zan nam gshin zas sam dad zas/ shid ni gshin po la dmigs pa'i dge ba bsgrubs pa/ phru ma ni pho brang ngam dmag sgar/ sgong ba ni rtse ba/ brtun pa ni brtson pa/ sgo 'phar ni sgo glegs/ spyos pa ni sdigs pa'am khros pa/ snyem pa ni g.yel ba'am stom las/ dbye tshong ni tshong khang / thang la ni bkram pa/bslan pa ni bsdus pa'am phyogs gtogs/ tshog phor niXrdzogs par/bdar ba ni bcad pa'amaXgazhogs pa/ gzengs pa ni brkyang ba'am gziXbyin/ 'cheg pa ni 'jig pa/ glos pa ni rmongs pa/ rmeg med ni gtan med—/g.yen spyo ba ni co 'dri'am sdang bar byed pa/ g.yam ni zhar/ rmed pa ni gsol ba/ slong phor ni lhung bzed/ bya ma rta ni nyan rna'am bang chen/ bro 'tshal ba ni nad pa/ da bur ni sreg gnas/ bsel ba ni skyel ma'am 'jigs pa las skyob paXgatsug lag ni sde snod/ bsod nyams ni 'dod pa la lhag par longs spyod pa'i ming / bsnyad pa ni bshad pa/ go re ni rdzogs pa/ brlang po ni rtsub mo/ gzhogs stegs ni zur mig gam sgeg chos/ shuraX406

du ni ska rags/ 'dzan mo ni bgrod bya ste bud med/ 'jud mthun dang 'dod 'gro dang gzugs 'tshong ni smad 'tshong / lag gi bla ni las de dang de la bskos pa/ 'dzan pho ni bgrod byed de skyes pa/ ska rags phog gu can ni ska rags rgyan can/ 'thab krol ni gnod rgyu/ 'gre ba ni g.yo ba/ do zan ni mching bu/ lcags phod ni ska rags kyi rgyan/ khong stom pa ni yid mi dga' ba'am sgyid lug pa/ dkyus mo ni malhogs pa'am rgyug pa/ dang la ni rdzing du/ klab pa ni la ba/ dam rgya ni khrims/ zha sgre ni rna med/ lhag sgre ni lhag ther/ gor mo ni sdang sems/ rna sbrang ni mde'u/ bshug pa ni bslang ba/pus mkhyud ni sgom thag g.yar ni kha'am gdong ngam mdun/ hwagasaXni bu ram gyi dwangs ma'i sha kha ra ste 'grel ba zla zer du gal laXzhes kyang grags pa/ thags ran ni btags pa/ rmas pa ni nyams pa/ mngan ni mthu/dngar ni gral lam phreng ba/ gsug pa ni rngan pa/ brngan zhes pa ni mchod pa/ rnam 'dal ni rnamaX'adud/ 'gyed pa ni gtong ba/ dbres pa ni brjes pa/ bsen khus pa ni gnyen bslus pa/ brgyad bkag ni kha smras sam bkyon pa/ 'o ni ni 'di/ bzlugs pa ni zhus pa'amaXdris pa/ po zos kyang ni ji ltar thogs kyang zhes pa ste yul skad la po mtho yang zer/ spyon pa ni 'bod pa'i brda tshuraXshog ces pa lta bu'o/ /byon ces pa slebs zin pa'i don te ding sang brda nor mang / 'brongs paXniXnye bar bsten pa/ bshes spring du mtho ris bu mos 'brongs shing zhes pa lta bu'o/ /mi slon ni mi zlogs/ smag 406

ni myun pa/ go ra ni btson ra/ ya ma brla ni snying bo med pa'am mi bden pa/ slad rol ni phyi rol/ chang thub ni gang zag dog ma ni mdun/ gel ba ni yal ga 'phag pa'am cha ba ni 'jug pa/ ran pa ni lcug phran/ reng bu ni 'brel med dam rkyang ba/ mi 'gong ni mi zhum/ than kor ni nye 'khor/bog re ni ba gam/ ma stes pa ni ma legs pa/ stes dbang ni stobs shugs/gna' bo ni sngon/ sna bo ni gtsoXbo/ mi gu ni mi zhum/ nye'u gyi ni bcud tshor/nyen ni rmang / be no ni 'dzin pa/ sro gang ni khrus/ dku mnye/ dril phyi/ me/stan rnams kyi ming / 'di la bsro khang zhes pa'ang snang / jeng ni rgyud mangs sam dbyangs/ rmang lam ni rmi lam/ gya tho ni rna rgyan/ lan bon ni lan slon/ mdong mo ni mjug do'i nang / rdil nad ni so rnyil gyi nad/rngub re ni hub re/ chu brub pa ni khol ba'am rba k+kongaX/ nyug rum ni rmig phyung ste btsun mo'i 'khor du 'byung ba/ zhogs ma ni steng g.yogs/ gzha' ba ni mgu ba/ gzhan tshon ni 'ja' tshon/ bskyad pa ni bsad pa'am 'gran pa/ phyi be ni phyi rol/ pha bi ni pha rol/ dgon dung ni chu med pa/ tsha sgo can ni ba tshwa cad/ mong brtul ni blun po/ lung bong dang ban klang ni ba glang /phol mig ni 'khor lo/ mtshun ni lha'am pha mes/ 'ches pa ni khas len pa/'phe'u ni gsol ba/ gzha' gsang ni g.yung drung ngam 'phrin las/ dam dem ni dam bca'/ phyang sprul ni rgyan namaXspud pa/ dbu rmog ni dbu 'phang / yid smo ni yid dga'/ gnyi zer ni nyi zer/ sbon pa ni za ba/407

rnyong ba ni brkyang ba/ 'byer ba ni 'gro ba/ 'drid pa ni slu ba/ gzod ma ni dang po/ ril ni thams cad/ gzeb ni gur/ klong du gyur pa ni dbang du gyur pa/ bcibs pa ni zhon pa/ mi bzad pa ni drag po drag shul mi sdug pa/gcam bu ni bcos ma/ brkam pa ni 'dod zhen/ brkam chags ni 'dod chags che ba/ 'chobs shig ni gsongs shig gnyod ka ni 'khos ka g.yung ba ni zhan pa/ brtun nges pa ni gzu lam dang rang bzo/ gzhib pa ni 'jib pa/ glags pa ni 'jug pa'am 'gro 'tshams/ dong ste ni song ste/'dong ba ni 'gro ba/ dben pa ni mkho ba'am 'phangs pa'am yid du 'ong ba/ btsog po ni pho btsog rnyong ni gal/ jis na ni cis na/ ta la la ni sgon me/ bsnyungs pa ni nyung ngur byas pa/ bsnyen sring ni nye ring / sbang byed ni rdo ba/ kos thag ni nyam thag snga mkho ni sngar bzhin/ sgyur te ni myur du/ 'on cig ni byon cig ldem poXni drang po min pa/ nying tor ni nges par/ byos shig ni gyis shig rangs pa ni dga' ba dang ril bo/ khong 'khyid ni khong 'byin/ gtu lum ni bzi ba/ gyu ba ni bkur ba/ pho pheg che ba ni khengs pa steXlta ba mtho ba'i don/ phog snya che ba ni sran che ba/ rme ba ni spru ba/ rmun po ni blun po/ 'phan pa ni chag pa'am nyams pa/ chu'i dngo ni chu ngogs/ gri'i dngo ni gri'i so/ yon khar ba ni yang dag min pa/ 'or 'ga' ni res 'ga'/ 'brus 'gogs ni brtson 'grus/ 'bogs pa ni brgal ba/ 'bog pa ni brgyal ba/ bya rkon ni bya rgya/ gnyig tu ni gcig tu/408

blong ba ni rmugs shing song ba/ blo blong ni yi nug gam rigaXpa mi gsal ba/blong blong yang zer/ gzhen 'debs dang gzhan bskul ni dran bskul/chad pa'am bang so ni dur gyi gnas/ phol te ni phan te/ 'ung nas ni 'di nas/ nyid grul ni rigs ngan/ rngad mo ni dmod mo/ rang nyams ni rang bzhid/ 'gran do ni 'gran zla/ yibs su ni dbyibs su/ bla khyad ni dregs pa/ 'ung teng ni 'on kyang / 'or ba ni bor ba/ pha logs ni pha rol/ gyim shing ni rol mo/ cho lo ni rgyan po/ zus nas ni zug nas/ blon 'debs ni chos ston nam zur nas gros 'debs/ gdas pa ni smra ba'am zhus pa'am zhu ba/ sna ru ni na ro/ 'grongs ni rma'i sgo/ mchis 'brang ni chung ma/ ma drangs pa ni ma dul ba/ gzhongs ni ljongs/ bus pa ni byis pa/ 'jibs pa ni 'grogasaXpa'am legs pa'am snyan pa/ nan tur ni chad las/ yus te ni bded te/ zha 'bring dang zham 'bring ni zhabasaX'abring / rmin ngan ni ltas ngan/ gti ba ni smra ba/ slad bzhin ni phyi bzhin/ gshor ba ni rtsub pa/'phyan pa ni 'khyam pa/ gshor ba ni snod/ klag cor ni ca co/ shen pa ni bshen pa/ rnyisaXpa ni rnyings pa/ snye ba ni zhan pa/ le'u glon pa ni lan ldon pa/ 'drag mthil ni lagaXmathil/ bum bu ni bum chung / rtsig gu ni rtsig pa/brungs kyang ni kun kyang / re rma ni bud med/ nan thur ni nan tan/g.yur dang yur ni gnyid/ sgro'u chung ni 'dzag snod par tang dang dre'u rngog ni stan khra bo/ smyugs nas ni bcug nas/ dku ste ni lhag ste/ ma la ni 409

kye ma'am kyi hud/ ngog go ni non no/ /mdun bdar ba ni mdun das bstod pa'am mdun du bgyis pa/ thong khor ni gar bu/ lag tub ni sgrogs/ldongs pa ni long ba/ dmigs du ni long khrid/ ngog na ni song na/ mod mi dma' ba ni dpangs mtho ba'am phra mo ma yin pa/ rnyong ngam byug pa'am skyang nul ni zhal ba/ zhal zhal kyang de nyid/ than skor ni nyeXskor/ yugs shig ni byugs shig za phod pa ni ltoXche ba/ ltung rus ni ltung 'bras/'dzer to ni zer to/ /dugs khang ni khrus khang / dpya ba ni 'phya ba/ snga za ni snga ba/ tshang mang ni nags tshang ngam me lang / khu sha ni sha khu/ tham lag niXmanaXngag las yan ni kha khyer ram stegs bu/ gzhags pa ni brgyan pa/'drub paXni 'tshem pa/ drubs pa ni btsems pa/ de mo ni dgos pa/ rnam phyings ni phyi sa khang ba/ skun du ni gzhong bu/ ya gad ni rkang rten nam skas ka ci chog ni ci yod/ tha gi ni zhi ba/ rgyu khu can ni gcer bu ba/ gzarathag ni dpyang thag slas ni btsun mo'i 'khor/ gyong ral ni sa zhagabashul ni lam/ mad pa ni bden pa/ spyan pa ni bya ra ba/ chems pa ni 'phrin pa/ mdun khang ngam bkadaXs ni 'dug sa/ 'dun pa ni tshogs pa/tshig gu ni 'bras bu'i snying bo/ skyes phrad ni dar la bab pa/ lce rten ni brjod pa'am snyad 'dogs pa/ regs pa niXbregs pa/ skyos pa ni nyams pa/chu 'dal ba ni dal bor 'dug pa'i chu/ nyul ba ni bul ba'am 'gor ba/gzhar ba ni mthun pa/ chan pa ni khye bo'i gri gug ldang sko ska dang bse kha 410

sgo ni seng ge sha ra bha ste seng ge rkang ba brgyad pa'i ming / ched 'ga' ni res 'ga'/ skyo sngogs ni 'khrug pa/ bags kyi ni rim gyi/ nod pa ni len pa'am thob pa/ brla brnyan ni snon pa/ tshang thur no gos shubs/ brnyan pa ni g.yar ba/ brnyas pa ni g.yas pa/ skabs thob nyos paXla'ang / yu du ni rang re'am bdag cag khom pa ni dal ba/ pho long ni gruXgu/ phyag las khom ni ra ro ba/ dgum pa ni gsod pa/ 'gum pa ni 'chi ba/ bkum pa dang gum pa ni bsad pa'am shi ba/ rmed du ni gsolaXdu/ 'khob pa ni ngan pa'am mtha'/ rdzi ni rlung / 'khrun ring ni mchu ring ngam dkyus ring /banogs pa ni bsdams pa'am sbas pa/ mnags pa ni bzod pa'am bsran pa/ dral po ni ming po/ che zhe ni a che'am sring mo/ 'byes pa ni mdzes pa'am mtshams byed pa/ spu la bab pa ni rung ba/ mi chog ni mi phod/ shing thags ni cog rtsang nan ni btung ba/ 'thams pa ni byams pa/ 'khams pa ni brgyal ba/ sdum mtshes ni khyim mtshes/ dbang thang che ba ni skal ba che ba'am dpal che ba'am skal ba bzang ba/ ma nangs pa ni ma langs pa/nangs kyi ni sngon gyi/ g.yer bag ni snang g.yel can/ brlams paXni bskyod pa/ sgro bo ni sa rjen/ 'od pa ni yod pa/ mig gi rdu ma ni mig gi dri ma'am skyo ma/ sbal du ni dong du/ phyugs phyung ni gzhon nu ma/ snog gzan ni 'khur ba/ bya mo lab ni mchod rdzas/ lan kan ni puXshu/ rgyun lugs ni rgyu 'grul/ g.yar 'dren ni spyan 'dren/ g.yar len ni khas len/ g.yar dam 411

ni dam bca'/ g.yar lam ni mdun/ g.yar khral ni kha khral lam ngo khral/g.yar tsha ni ngo tsha/ g.yar khams ni sku lams/ g.yar ngo ni gdong / sge'u chung ni 'gro ba/ sge'u gsher niXkha 'dam ste bca' sga dang ro nus cha mthun zhig gi ming / drung ni rtsa ba/ 'gyur byed ni pra chal/ mi ngas ni mi nad dam rims nad/ zhal tshus ni zhal zas/ long bu ni shing tog 'os pa ni gcer bu ba/ rtsen pa ni rtse ba'am rol ba/ bla gab ni stengaXgayogs/ thoms shig ni soms shig mthol ba ni smra ba'am mi sbed pa/ bshos pa ni 'khrig pa/ gtam 'dres pa ni phebs par smra ba/ smon 'drin ni grogs po/ ltag 'og ni snga phyi'am gong 'og spun pa ni bstun pa/ thog thog ni dang po/reg zig ni zin bris/ bon pa ni zlas pa/ ne'u ldang ni na zla/ sgog pa ni sgog skya ste ra su na'am la shu na/ kun dong ni btsong ste pa lā rtu/ ke'u ni riXsgog hab shang mtshe'u ni dbang lag lig shi wer ni dzā ti ste sna ma'i me tog kru kru tres ni tsi tra ka ja hong ni btsod mdog slad tsha ni mi gtsang ba'am bshang ba/ thob kyis 'jal ba ni thabs kyis gzhan nor 'gugs pa/sha chags paXni blo la yod pa'am bab thob yod pa dang 'thug pa'am brlingaXb/ ngag 'khyal ni 'brel med du spra ba/ kyal ga ni ku re'i tshig bstang ba ni mgon nam grogs/ bsnyings tshig ni sun 'byin pa'i tshig ste mi ngan paXl mi ya mtshan can ces brjod pa lha bu/ dus po che niX'adzin pa che ba/stongs pa ni phan pa'am grogs/ dkor dang ka ca ni nor gyi spyi'iXming /412

dkyel che ba ni khong yangs pa/ chu gang ni snying stobs/ bkrabs pa ni mang po'i nang nas 'dams pa/ bskrun pa ni bskyed pa'am btsugs pa/ skrus pa ni gcod pa/ sgrun pa ni 'grad pa/ bskru ba ni gzhan laXthabs kyis 'bridaXpa/ bska ba ni gar ba'am ro'i khyad par/ skyin kor ni gangs sbal lam rtsangs pa/ mi 'gong ba ni mi skrag pa/ dbos pa ni sbos pa/ dngan 'thed ni gzhan gyi nor khyer ba phyir mi gtod pa/ zil dngar ni bdud rtsi/bcom bsgyungs ni 'jigs nasaXskad chung dur sprus pa'am kha rog 'dugaXpa/ man ni tshod dang dus/ 'jungs pa ni zhen chags che ba/ nying sha ni rang gi sha ju bo ni rdo/ lag nya ni byin len ma byas paraXlen pa/ nye reg ni khrus/ mchig dang mchig gu ni mas gtun dang yas gtun/ shaXkon zhugs pa ni khon yod pa/ mnyelaXb ni ngal ba/ phyag brnyan ni 'khor g.yogaspyo ba dang brgyad pa ni 'thab pa'am smad pa/ skra bsnyen ni skra tshab/ sgra brnyan ni brag cha/ gtams pa ni khengs pa'am bcol ba/ bltams pa ni skyes pa'am 'khrungs pa/ rdul phod ni snying stobs che ba/ brtul ni bsdus pa'am 'jam pa/ dgung ni gnam/ mtshan mo/ dgung lo sogs/ gdugs ni nyi ma'am nyin par/ 'khrun ni 'phang ngam srid/ kho lag ni zheng ngam sboms/ bda' ba ni zhim pa/ 'dren ma ni sna tshogs 'dres ma'am khra bo/ bla brdol ni bla col/ mnag dka' dang mnog chung ni sran dka' dang khe chung ba/ 'phral ba ni dpral ba/ phyang nge ba ni 'jol le ba/ byug ris ni 413

gral/ rtse rgod ni lha 'bangs/ nang byan ni g.yog mtshag bzang ba ni nyams rgyas pa'am yan lag dang nyingaXlagaXrgyas pa/ mtshal lu ni rteng dkar/ 'tshal ma ni zas sam lto/ 'tshal ni shes pa'am chog pa'am 'dod pa/ 'khums pa ni thos pa'am shes pa/ nu rdzi ni nying khu/ gzhes pa ni sdodaXpa'am bzhugs pa/ bskal ba ni bar chod pa'am rgyang ring ba/ gzhib pa ni 'jib pa/ ma rtabs pa ni mi rings pa/ rlam khyer ni ham khyer/ brtagasaXpa ni gus pa'am sgrin pa/ gsud pa ni sgregs pa/ gshung ba ni ngos kyis skyon brjod pa'am shub bus smod pa/ skyel bdar ni skyel gla/ dri dku ba ni dri mi zhim pa'am dri tsha ba/ 'gong ba ni smad pa/ mngag gzhug dang ciXbagyi ni g.yog po/ shin te ma med pa ni snyigs ma med pa'am chud za ba'am nyam chung ba med pa/ sag rtsa skyel ba ni spungs skyed pa'am dam bca' brtan pa/skyo ma ni phra ma dang phye ba/ sril ni srog chags nug pa/ sgyu rum ni tshod ma/bya na ni tshod ma'am spags ma/ spun pa ni bsres pa/ spen tog ni rgyan/ spa ba ni mdzes pa'am byin chags pa/ spyoms pa ni ngom pa'am bdag bstod/la gcan pa ni la'i tshugs pa/ sho gam pa ni yul gyi tshugs pa/ gru btsas pa ni gru tshugs pa/ don mthun ni tshong ba/ 'gron po'angaXde nyid/ sta zur ni dpyi mgo spon pa ni gtong ba/ spun pa ni rdzun pa/ rje btsan ni rje btsun/ dngags ni ngag bla ni rung ngam bzod dam chog klad ni gong ngam steng / dbyig ni nor/ so sto ni so zing / spyi cer ni spyi ther/ bklums 414

pa ni bsdus pa/ bajid pa ༷dang rim gro dang btsun par bya ba ni bkuraste dang mchod pa'i ming sga rnam grangs/ bkus te bor ba ni khu ba bton pa'i snyigs lta bu/ chab mi 'tshal ba ni chud mi za ba/ phyid ni dar yol ba'am rgan po/ sle 'dams pa ni mtshan ma chad pa/ mtshan par rdol ba ni mo mtshan gyi nad/ spyi brtol cheXb ni dpral ko 'thug pa/ dmyus pa ni tshi chad pa/ smeg pa ni nyams dang 'khos ka ba cig tu rtsa ba'am lhag ma/ smrig ni gos tshos ma/ ngur smrig ni gos dmar ser la grags kyang tshos snyigs mas btsos pa'i don yin/ ga gon dang tshon mo steng ni zha nye/ ro nye ni zha nye nag por yan lag brgyad pa'i 'grel ba zla zer las bshad/ sprabs pa ni zas/ btogs pa ni phrogs pa/ go re long ni gad byed pa/ smre zhes pa ni sdug bsngal/ yan lag skyes ni pho mtshan/ rmya ba ni nyams pa/ gtams pa ni bshad pa'am bstan pa/ khud du byas pa mang po'i yin pa bdag nyid gcig pus dbang du byas pa/ dga' 'dun ni skyes pa'am bud med rkyang ba dga' spro la tshogs pa/ tshogs can ma ni smad 'tshong ma'i tshogs la zer ba'ang snang / mnyes pa ni legs pa'am gros mthun pa/ mi bkyig pa ni mi brgyang ba'am myur ba/ spu bsnyal ba ni nyes pa bshags pa'am zhe sdang zhi ba/spu snyol ba ni lus ngag yid kyi zhe sdangaXzhi bar byed pa/ chags rgya ni bu lon bda' ba'i dpang rgya ste yi ge bcug pa/ kha phyin pa ni gros mthun pa/ bru ba ni ltogs pa'am bkres pa/ sman btags pa ni phad btags pa/ rnal du 415

phab ste ni gzhan gyi 'tshe ba med paraXrang dbang du gnas pa/ bze re can ni sran chung ba'am gzhon sha can/ chums pa ni chags pa/ 'tshal ma 'tshal ni zan za ba/ brnyan pa ni g.yar ba/ bla na ni spra ba'am zer kha dum pa ni 'chams pa'am mthun pa/ che bzhi ni bden dpang / skugs su btsugs pa ni rgyal btsugs pa/ spyos pa ni 'thab pa'am kha smras/ gzhongs spyod pa ni ljongs rgyu ba/ chung ba ni zhing ba/ dus kyis 'chu ba ni dbang gis 'chu ba/ bzang mkhan ni gos bzo ba/ spang ba ni mi 'jigs pa/ 'grong gis 'grong la sbyar ba ni pho mtshan gyis pho mtshan la sbyar ba/ smyugs pa ni bcug pa/ dkre ni pho mtshan gyi tog spogs 'gyid pa ni tshong khe ba na rgyag cing mnyam pa dang gyong byung ba na mi rgyag pa dang mod nyo dkon tshong la'ang / kog rtse ni rgya'am rnyi rnyong ngo / /thor to ni rtse mo/ btungs pa ni bsad pa/ skri shig ni thongs shig bshes gnyen ni yon tan/ dpung tshogs yanaXlag bzhi rmongs btab bam/ nam sros kyi bar du brongs shig chu lon ni rags/ ma reg tsam du drung du bsnyen te ni nye ba/ gnas nas sped pa ni gnas nas phyur ba/ nye zho med pa ni legs pa'am skyon med pa'am bkra shis pa laXsogs pa ste rgyas par na snga 'grur gyi gsung rab rnams rgya cher bklags paXlas shes par 'gyur gyi mtha' dag pa ni yi ge'i las su che la/'on kyang cung zadaXbarjod pas blo gros kyi 'jug pa 'phel ba'i thabs su mthong nas/ bcom ldan rig ral dang / dbus pa blo gsal la sogs pas 416

mdzad pa'i yi ge las kyang ji lhar rigs par btus shing / dpal ldan bla ma lo chen gyi gsung las 'byung ba'ang bsnan te bris pa'o//yang 'dir/ legs sbyar gyi skad zur chag pas brda rnying bar 'khrul ba'ang 'ga' zhig snang ste/ ab ces pa chu'i skad dod yin pa dang / mar chung ngu la sto ka zhes pa'ang chung ru'iXskad dod nyid yin pa dang / kol ma zhes pa gzan dron gyi ming du yod pa'ang / kuphywa ṣa zuraXchag pa dang /sman dpyad las ni/ mon sran sde'u sran chung la sogs pa btsos nas shing kun la sogs pa spod du btab pa'i thug pa la 'dod do/ /a rku zhes pa chung ngu'am phra mo'i skad dod yin pa la/ a nu zhes grags pa dang / mi khengs pa che ba la mi 'gar po zhes zer ba'ang / garba zhes pa nga rgyal gyi skad dod zur chag pa dang / mi sgrob che ba zhes pa'ang / ā ṭo pa zhes pa brjidaXpa'am bsgyings pa zur chag pa dang / kiṅka ra zhes pa ci bgyi ste/las byed dam pho nya'am g.yog gi skad dod zur chag pas ging pa dang /ging pho ging mo zhes grags pa dang / spru la zhes pa sbom po dang rags pa dang rgya che ba'i skad dod zur chag pas thul che ba zhes pa dang / byuli zhes paXzur chagaXpas rdul zhes pa dang / snyu ka zur chag pas dug pa zhes pa dang / drwa h+maṇa zhes pa tshangs pa las byung ba ste zur chag pas bram ze dang /phaska zhes pa ri mo'i skad dod zur chag pas 'phal ka dang / kalba'ang bskal pa zhesaXpa bod kyiXbardar mdzad pa dang / laka ka raXzhes pa dpa' 417

mdzad de/ zur chag pas legs smin ka ra dang / piṣ+ṭa pa bsod stoms pa zhes pa ste/ zuraXchag pas pe nya ba dang / pen da bar 'don pa dang / bi hā ra 'es pa gtsug lag khang ba zhes pa ste zur chag pas dpe har dang dpe dkar du bod pa dang / in+d+ra nī la zhes pa dbang sngon te/ zur chag pas an+da rnyil zhes pa dang / a mi tā bha zhes pa 'od dpag med de zur chag pas a mi de wa dang / āṅgā wa lo ki ta 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs zhes pa zur chag pas ād+ma pa lo dang / pusnyi ka glegs bam kyi skad dod zur chag pas po ti zhes pa dang / su tra dzī wa bu'i 'tsho ba zhes pa zur chag pas 'bo de tsi dang / ru dā k+ṣa zhes pa drag po'i mig ces pa zur chag pas rag sha dang / si dz+nyā ra zhes pa li khri'i skad dod zur chag pas/ se 'dur ra dang / kud+ku ma zur chag pas gur gum dang / gugru la zur chag pas gu gul dang / bit+pa zhes pa spu gzugs kyi skad dod zur chag pas 'bum pa dang /'bi 'bi zhes pa dang / gañdzi ra mdzod ldan te zur chag pas 'gan 'ji ra dang / na ku la rigs med de zur chagaXpas ne'u le dang / pa tā ka zur chag pas ba dan dang / sā ts+tsha dam pa'i gzugs brnyan te zur chagaXpas tsha tsha zhes pa dang / myut+ta ka grol ba can te/ zur chag pas mu tig dang / ke sa ra zhes pa ral ba yin pa zur chag pas ge sar dang / byañdza na zhes pa tshod ma'am zas spags ma la 'jug pa zur chag pas bya na dang /snye ka sbal ba la 'jug pa la mi gceraXdur 'dzings pa la sbe ka zhes pa'ang 418

zur chag pa dang / rnyika nyes pa ngan pa'i skad dod zur chagaXpas mi glen pa la dig pa dang / sa ho ra zhes pa rgyaXgar gyi rgyal rigs yan gar ba zhig gi ming zur chag pas za hor zhes pa dang / ka ṭo ra zhes pa snod kyi skad dod zur chag pas ka to ra dang / la hu zhes pa yang ba'am myur ba'i skad dod zur chag pas la mo dang la gor/ ma tī lha sar nyal gyi skad dod zur chag pas ma he dang / bzlas pa'i skad dod dza pa dang / dza bhi zur chag pas 'dzab ces sngags kyi mingaXdu 'khrul ba dang / tri ka zhes pa ri mo nyisaXrim dang khron pa'i mu khyud kyi skad zur chag pas/ pri ka dang / dgog('di la skogazer ba'ang yod)tu phyin pa ni rgas pa/ go la blum po'i skad dod/ go ra zhes pa dang / rin po che du ma phyogs gcig tu bzhu ba gser dmar bor grags pa/ dzhai k+ṣe ma zhes pa la zi khyim dang / mgrin pa'i skad dod shrī ba zur chag pas gre ba dang / sgron me'i skad dod ta la la zur chag pas tal tsam dang / tal sbyin sogs mtha' yas par snang zhing / yang kha cig gis legs par sbyar ba'i skad dang / bod skad shan ma byed par bod skad kyi 'bru bsnan pa mthong ste/ de yang / be+ernya pa zhes pa rgya mtsho las byung ba ste/tshwa dang ral gri dang rta sogs la 'jug pas sgra don skabs stobs kyis shes dgos pa la/ sen mo'i brda se gol du 'chad pa dang / a ga ru'i ming gi rnam grangs shim sha pa zhes pa'i shim gyi klad kor nga yig tu klog pa/ bod skad kyi shing du 'khrul nas sha ba'i shing zer ba dang / ri po ta la'i(poṭa 419

la'ang zer/ bod skad gru 'dzid)pa yig kha bsum ste/ ri bo ta lar 'don pa dang / sih+la la tshim byed de/ tu ru ka dang ming gcig pa la/ bsil la zhes bsil sgan du 'don pa dang / pi sba li zhes pa grog ma la 'jug cing de dang 'dra ba'i sman nag po la grog sman pi pi ling zhes pa la'ang / drod sman pi pi ling du 'don pa dang / sha rī re zhes pa gdung dang sku la 'jug pa la/ sha zhes pa bod skad dang / rī re zhes pa ring bsrel gyi don du bzung nas/ gdung nya rī re dang / chu rī re dang / mi rī re dang / bi ma la mi tra dri med bshes gnyen zhes pa la bye ma'i nang nas mig bkra ba'i gtam rgyud dang / tu ru ṣ+ka zhes pa gar log gi skad dod yin pa ma shes par/ ngan pa tsam gyi don du bsams te bskal ba du ru ka dngaX/ me du ru ka dang / chu du ru ka dang / sa du ru ka sogs zer ba da'i / a tiXyo ga shin tu rnal 'byor yin pa'i a ti nyid zab mo'am nying khu lta bu'i don du rlom pas zab tig dang yang tig sogs dang / do ha zhes pa mi zad pa'i skad la gnyis la rgod pa dang / nā ro pa zhes pa rtsa bshadaXpa zhes pa'i skad dod la/ a na na dang ro ru song zhes pa dang / te lo pa til brdung la/ te na te zer lo zhes mang du 'chad snang ba ni brjod pa'i lam las 'das pa lta bur snang mod/ shin tu mi mkhas pas smras pa ni dgag par yang miXldang ngo / /che sa mkhas pa dag gsung zhing phal cher ni mkhas pa snga ma dag gis bkag pa ltar ro//420

kha cig tu rgya nag gi skad brda rnying du 'khrul ba snang ste/ blon po la phying sang zhes pa dang / dngul rdzus ma la ha yang ha zhesaXpa dang / rgya la hung la dang 1 gzhan yang grum rtse dang / cog rtse dang / lugs rgyu mtshan bsnyad pa la g.yang rtse zhes pa dang / phing chang dang gzan gyi ming la zin gzan dang / cing phingaXdang / as man gur gum sogs mang du snang la/rgyal po'i zhal la gser zhal dang / bang chen la gser yig pa dang /gser skyems sogs kyang rgya nag gi brdar snang zhing / la la hor gyi brdar yang snang ste/ btsun pa la pag shi dang / dbang che ba la dar khra che dang /daraXrgan byin sogs mang la/ kha cig bon po'i brdar yod de/legs pa la gnamaXmachod pa dang / mi shi ba la gnam du gshegs pa dang / bsodaXnams che ba la gnam gyis bskos pa zhes pa dang / dbang che ba la gnam sa'i bdag ces pa sogs shin tu mang zhing / kha cig ni bod skad nyid ma dag pas brda rnying du 'khrul ba'ang yod de/ kuṇ+ḍa li'iXbod skadaXbadud rtsi thab sbyor la/ bdud rtsi thal sbyor dang / artso t+pa'i bod skad/ khol ba la chol ba dang / g.yar dam la yal gam dang / rma bya'i ming mdongs mtha' can la mdongs thal can zhes pa dang / gta' ma la gte ba/ sbyon zhes pa la byon zhes pa dang / zhag gi sor ris zhes sor mo gsum gyi ri mo la zhag giXzo ris zhes pa dang / dring zhes pa ni ne le dang / pra t+ya ya bsgyur ba gzhan gyis 'dren pa'am rkyen gyi don yin pa dang / bka' drin zhes pa/421

pra sā da bsgyur ba'ang ma phyed pa dang / mi blo bsral can la/ blo ral zhes pa mtha' yas la/ kha cig ni bod skad nyid la zhe sar sbyaraXb ma go bar brda rnying du 'khrul ba'ang snang ste/ chu la chab dang / me la zhugs dang /rlung la bser du dang / sa la dog ma dang / rdo la gor mo dang / gnam la dgung dang / gnam lo la dgung lo dang / bden pa la mad pa dang /bzhugs pa la gzhes pa dang / lto ba la phyal dang / chab shog chab srid/chab 'bangs/ chab sgo sogs kyang zhe sa'i tshig go /yang rgya rna ru can sogs(dbus paXblo gsal)brda rnying du bshad snang yang / de dag ni gab tshig tu mdzad pa yin gyi brda rnying min no//yang la la ni zhang zhung gi skad du snang ste/ sle tres dang phye ma la tres sam dang / zhib mo la cur nis sogs sman dpyad kyi skabs su mtha' yas pa snang ba dang / der ni legs sbyar zur chag pa'ang mang ste/ sru smre la zhes pa e la phra mo'i skad dod la/ sug mel du grags pa sogs mtha' yas mod kyang yi ge mang bar 'jigs pas spros pa bsdu'o/ /'on kyang 'di tsam zhig brjod pa min na tshig ma go bas don la 'khrul ba shin tu mang po mthongaXb de dag slar yang gya tshom du gyur te/ gsung rab kyi tshig don phyin ci log tu 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /des na 'chad pa dang rtsom pa dang zhu chen gyiXgrwar mchi ba dag gis/ gsar rnying gi brda'i khyad par 'di tsam zhig mi shes su mi rung bar byas te gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa chud 422
