mi gsonaXpa la bslab par bya'o/ /zhes 'doms par byed do//gangs ri'i sngongs 'dir mnyam med rgyal ba'i bka'/ /dgongs 'grel bcas pa 'akyur ro cog rnams kyi/ /gsar rnying brdaXyi khyad par mtha' yas pa/ /chos spyan mnga' ba'i 'jig rten mig rnams kyis/ /spyod yul min na bdag ltas ci zhig rtogs/ /de slad 'khrul ba'i cha rnams tshig dang don/ /ji bzhin mang pa'i mkhas pas bzod mdzad de/ /legs par bshad pa'i bdud rtsis mnyes par mdzod/ /lhag bsam dag pa'i dgeXlegs ni/ /zla zer 'thungs pa'i kun+das kyangaX/ mtshon pa min des rgyalaXba'i bstan/ /'khrul med yun du gnas gyur cig ces bya ba 'di yang gdong ngan zhes bya 'i lo/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'ga' zhig gis zhal ta phebs pa dang / shī mad+ma ṇi kas 'phral du bskul zhing yi ge'i rkyen sbyar ba la brten nas/ skyogs ston gyisaXreg zig tu bkod pa'o// maṅga lo/oṃ dza ya dza yan+tu/ gsung rab yan lagaXbacu gnyis chu gter che//gsar rnying brda tshigaXgating zab spog dka' ba/ /rnam dpyodaXkhyor chung gsolaXbyed li gur 'di/ /thos bsam bdud rtsir bsgyur byed mkha' la bskrun// brdaXtshig skom gyis gdungs pa'i gyi na ba/ /tshig don yan lag brgyad ldan da thungs shigs/ /grangs med cig car bskrun pa'iXchos sbyin 'di/ /sde dge lhun grub steng gi chos grwa ru/ /byang phyogs nor 'dzin chos bzhin skyong ba po/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa bsod rnams phun tshogs kyis/ /par du 423

bsgrubs pa'i legs byas gang thob pa/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa'iXmachod par 'bul/ /dpe 'di phyi mo gnyis dang bsdur nas bris shing dpang bo po ta la'i par yig yid brten dang mi 'gal bar rgyas pa'i yan lag 'ga' zhig zhabs rtog gi tshul du bkod cing sgan chad kyang zhus dag sogs 'dug na mdzad par zhu zhu/ yi ge ba ni bkra lus bgyis so/ /sa rba maṅga lo//bha wan+tu/(dag yig 'dz+wa ni sde dge'i shing par gzhir bzung nas bsgrigs pa yin)424
bas pa bzhub ba'i 'o ma

༄༅//ngag gi dbang phyug lha mo dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dred mchog shākya seng ge yis/ /legs gsungs chos— kyi 'khor lo'i don/ /tshul bzhin dpyod pa'i shes rab mig /nga mdzad lha dang bla mar 'dud/ /gang de'iXbastan pa'i nyin byed 'bum/ /gangs can dgung du 'dren pa'i mchog /thonaXmi'i gzhung lugs nyer mkho'i cha/ /'ga' zhigaXbatus nas 'dir gcig bya/ /'jam dbyangs thon mis 'phags yul du/ /yig rigs kun bslab gangs can brdar/ /mkho ba'i gsal byed sum cu dang / /dbyangs bzhi dang bcas gtan la phab/ /gsal byed rnams las ya btags bdun/ /ra btags bcu dang la btags drug /wa btags bcu gnyis mgo can gsum/ /'phul dang mtha' rten sogs su dbye/ /ya btags bdun ni ka la dang / /ga dang pa pha ba ma'o/ /ra btags ka khaXg dang da/ /pa pha ba ma sa ha'o/ /la btags drug ni ka dang ga /ba za ra dang saXyin no/ /wa btags kwa ye 'dab chags khu/ /brtswa brgyad nywa bzhi dwa phrug bu1 /rtswa sngon lan tshwa phrug zhwa gyon/ rwa co shā drag wa ba'i hwa/ /ra la sa yi mgo can ni/ /ra mgo ldan pa ka ga nga / /ja nya ta daXn dang ni/ /ba ma tsa dang dza la'o/ /la mgo bcu ni ka ga nga / /ca ja ta da pa ba ha/ /sa mako ka ga nga nya ta/ /da na pa ba ma tsa la'o/ /ga da ba ma 'a dang lnga/ /'phul yig yin la gas 'phul ni/ /ca nya ta da na tsa zha/ /za ya sha sa bcu gcig go /das 'phul drug ni ka ga nga / /pa ba dang ni ma yin no/ /bas 'phul bcu ni ka ga ca/ /426

ta da tsa zha za sha sa'o/ /mas 'phul kha ga nga cha ja/ /nya tha da na tsha dza 'o/ /'as 'phul laXg cha ja tha/ /da pha ba tsha dza dang bcu/ /rjes 'jug bcu ni ga nga da/ /na ba ma 'a raXl sa/ /sngon rjes gnyis po las gzhan pa'i/ /yi ge rnams ni ming gzhi'o/ /da ni snga ma'i tshig shugs kyis/ /phyi ma ji ltar 'thob tshul bshad/ /thog mar rnam dbye drug pa yi/ /kyi gi gyi 'i yi rnams ni/ /da ba sa dang da drag dag /thob mthar kyi dang ga nga gi (khyod kyi rgyab kyi g.yas kyi gyurd kyi lha du'o)(bdab/ gi gsung gi lha bu'o)na ma ra la bzhi bo gyi/ /(bzhanagyi 'a ma gyi dpal gyi lta gu'o)mtha' rten med mthar 'i 'thob cing / /(sems pa'i lta bu)rkang ba skong tshe yi zhes 'thob/ /(tshigs bcad kyi tshig ma tshang tshe yi 'ji'o)'o nyu 'am gyi tsheg khyim yang / /kha skong kha skong minaXpas dbye/ /de yang dga' 'o bde 'oXsogs/ /rdzogs tsheg la ni 'o nyid de/ /mdzes dga' bo dang kun dga' bo/ /mdza' bo dpa' bo ngo bo dang / /spyi bo la sogs ming gi cha/ /wa phyed nyid du 'bri zhing bklag /kug gyed can dang brtsegs pa dang / /mtha' rten can mthar 'a mtha' t+pangs/ /rnam dbye bdun pa la don gyi/ /tu du su ru'i zhabs kyu ni/ /ga ba da drag can mthar tu/ /(dper na/ rtaka tu rab tu shid tu phyi rol tu lta bu)nga da na ma raXl du/ /(dper na gang du bshad duXspyan du bsam du bar du dpal du lta bu)'a mthar ru zhes brjod pa yin/ /(dga' ru lhabu'o)tshig phrad ga ba da rjes su/ /cing cesaXce'o ce na cig /(dper nartag cing rtag ces rtagaXce na rtag cig lta bu ni da dang ba gnyis la'ang 'gre)nga 'a na ma ra la dang / /mtha' rtenaX427

med pa'i rjes dag tu/ /zhing zhes zhe'o zhe na zhig /(dper na bzang zhing dpa' zhes sra zhingaXmang lta bu dang / gang zhe na gang zhig lha du ni gzhan rnams la 'gre'o)sa mthar byungang sgo ba da sa che sgo ga /(sa mthar shes zer ba mi legs pas zhes dmikas bsal gyis 'thob)da drag thob nges na ra la'i/ /rjes su cing sogs lnga bo sbyor/ /(dper na byod cig gyur cig rol cig)na ra la sa da drag gi /rjes su te rkyang da mthar de/ /(yin te 'khor te mjal teXgyur te lta bu dang / bshad de yod de sogasaXlta bu'o)ga nga ba ma 'a dang ni/ /mtha' rten med rjes steXzhes 'thob/ /(rtag ste bzangaXste bab ste bsam ste mnga' ste/ lha ste mi ste bum pa ste ka ba stelta bu'o)'am mas sbyor kyang 'ang yang rnams ni/ /ga da ba sa nyid dang ni/ /da drag thob pa'i rjes suXkyang / /(bdag kyang mchod kyang bab kyang shes kyang lha bu)(gyur kyang phyin chad kyang rol kyang zhes pa lha bu)nga na ma 'a ra la yang (sang yang mnga' yang yin yang bsam yangashābar yangaXdapal yang lta du)mtha' rten med mthar 'ang dang ni/ (de la'ang lha'ang6mi'ang lta bu)rkang ba skong tshe yang zhes bya/ /(dper na phun tshorgas ldan pa de la yang lta bu)dri dang rdzogs tshig skabs su ni/ /mtha' rten med dang 'a mthar 'am mo/ /(gtam 'dri ba sogs bde'am bde'o lha'am lha'o)mtha' rtenaXcan rnams rang rang dang / /da drag can mthar da yig la/ /rim bzhin ma dang na ro gnyis/ /(da drag can rnams la 'dra'o)mkhas pas yang dag sbyar bar bya/ /(dper na bdag gam bdag go bzang ngam bzang ngo ltaXbu dang / bsgyur ram bsgyur te byond tam byond to rold tam rold to lta du'o)ming mtha'i paXba'i khyad par ni/ /ga da na ba ma sa dang / /da drag can mthar pa dang ni/ /nga 'a ra la mtha' med mtha'i/ /ba byed war 428

'bod rnams la ba/ /(dper na bsring baX'abar ba dga' ba rgyal ba bdeXb spro ba lha bu dang / gyurd pa byodad pa rold pa lha bu'o)gzhan la pa nyid sbyar te bklag /( bdag sgra thob pa'i tshe dper na/ spu pa/ mda' pa/ shar pa/ lho pa/ rta pa lta bu'o)gcod mtshams mtha' rten ga yig mthar/ /gcig shad nga yig ma gtogs pa'i/ /gzhan la pa nyid sbyar te bklag /gcod 'tshams mtha' rten ga yig mthar/ /gcig shad nga(bdag sgra thob pa'i tshe dper na/ phu ba/ mda' ba/ shar ba/ lho ba/ rta ba/ lta du'o)yig ma gtogs pa'i/ /shad gongaXrnams su phyi tsheg spangs/ /tshigs su bcad pa'i rkang mtha' dang / /lhug pa'i sde tshan rdzogs mtshams kyi/ /na ro can mthar gnyis shad bya/ /sde tshan chen po rdzogs mtshams dang / /le'u mtshams ltaXbur bzhi shad 'thob/ /tsheg shad dang ni rkyangaXshad gnyis/ /'thob tshul rang rang skabs dang sbyor/ /da ni 'phul dang mtha' rten mgo /med la sbyor dang yod la spong / /'dam nga can la mtha' gcig tu/ /'dzin pa'i 'khrul spong cung zad bshad//rnga yab ge sar sil snyan dang / /mngon sum phunaXsum tshogs sogs la/ /gas 'phul nor ro gsha'aXm dang / /gshags 'byed sogs la med na nor/ /sar ba lha bur gang yangaXrung / /skyil krung sogs la das 'phul med/ /dgung lo mtshan dgung long khrid kyi/ /dmigs bu sogs la med na nor/ /༵dī bhedī~X ༵gaXs la 'a ༵dī ༵— dī/nga/ ba/ se/hūm̐g bud bye ༵༵nga dī rargya ༵ ༵ dīng/ /byi/ / /429

bdar sogs la med na nor/ /sngo sangs lta bu gang yang rung / /tha gru za maXtshar du dngar/ /tshon rtsi sogs la mas 'phul spangs/ /mthe bo mtshe ma sngo sman mtshe/ /khyim mtshe sogs la med na nor/ /thun mong la sogs gang yang rung / /tshong 'dus khams dang tshogs pa tshoms/ /phra ma khon 'dzin khro ba khros/ /rim gro phra mo phongs pa dang / /phyugaXpo sogs la 'as 'phul spangs/ /'thab 'khob 'khri shing 'khur ba dang / /tshul 'chos sogs la med na nor//'phrin las phreng sogs gang yang rung / /yi ge myu gu lu gu rgyud/ /shākya sogs la ga mtha' spangs/ /phrag dog phrug gur med na nor/ /pus mo'i lha nga sgo nga dang / /sga nga sogs la da mtha' nor/ /yi dam yi ring yi dwags sogs/ /sri zhu sogs la da mtha' nor/ /skad cig ltaXbur gang yang rung / /se mo do la na mtha' spangs/ /byan mo lta bur med na nor/ /lha btsun bza'aXbatung gdu bu dang / /le rgan sogs la ba mtha' nor/ /rgya 'dre kha mchu ra mda' dang / /ra mnye na bza' rtsa mchog grong / /rgya mtsho sogs la ma mtha' nor/ /lha rje mdo rgyud nga rgyal can/ /bya rgod rdo rje mtha' rten dang / /lha rten sogs la ra mtha'aXnor/ /dur khrod mdor bsdus med na nor/ /bde gshegs sogs la gang yang rung / /snyun gyi gso smad kha dro dang / /grwa lnga sogs la la mtha' nor/ /rig sngags gsung rab macan rab dang / /nam mkha' go 'phang khri 'phang mchog /skyed rim rdzogs rim 'du shes dngaX/ /mkha' spyod sa spyod do shal 'phreng / /nyam chung nyam thag nyam nga ba/ /log rtog som nyi chom rkun 430

dang / /cho ga sogs la sa mtha' nor/ /lhas byin klus byin gdams ngag sogs/ /mang bo zhig la med na nor/ /dri bzang rgyudaXmangs go rim dang / /'khor los bsgyur sogs gang yang rung / /klad kor stod kor gdub kor dang / /pad kor than kor 'od kor 'phreng / /a mra sogs la sa mgo med/ /rur smig smig rgyur med na nor/ /yi ge zhal ta da lta dang / /la sogs tha dad ces rnams la/ /bar tsheg mi byed —blun po'i lugs/ /'khrul spong 'di ni ches cher du/ /mkho phyir loXtsā'i(dpal khang lo tsā ba)gsung dngos bris/ /rjes 'jug ga sogs phal cher la yang 'jug sa mtha' yod med kyi/ /don gyi khyad par tha dad du/ /'byed pa'i tshul de cung zhig smra/ /rgyun du rtag dang rtags mtshan dang / /mi rtag 'jig dang skrag nas 'jigs/ /g.yang sa'i grog dang mdza' ba'i grogs/ /nyin mtshan zhag dang thag pa'i zhags/ /gcan gzan gzig dang spyan gyis gzigs/ /mi dge sdig dang gshe ba'i bsdigs/ /gnod pa'i gdug dang 'bub pa'i gdugs/ /rus kyi gdung dang nyi mas gdungs/ /zhal gyi gdong dngaXkha mig gdongs/ /dud 'gro'i lug dang dpe yi lugs/ /nor gyi phyug dang dud 'gro'i phyugs/ /lus kyi lag dang zhe sa'i lags/ /blo yi rig dang rgyud kyi rigs/ /smra ba'i tshig dang mtshams kyi tshigs/ /ri mo'i thig dang zags pa'i thigs/ /kha dog nag dang shing gi nags/ /dum bur chag dang yul der chags/ /rdul gyi dregaXdang stobs kyi dregs/ /mig 'bras long dang 431

'dzom pa'i longs/ /phyin ci log dang zur gyi logs/ /chung ba'i dog dang dgra la dogs/ /steng gi thog dang gzhan gyis thogs/ /gyen du bslang dang slong mo basbangs/ /gsor gyis dbug dang kha yi dadugs/ /mig gis mthong dang nam mkha'i mthongs/ /thams cad tshang dang gtsang ba'i tshangs/ /reg bya'i grang dang rtsis kyi grangs/ /grangs kyiXstong dang zad nas stongs/ /bu ga'i khung dang phugs kyi khungs/ /dri ba'i gang dang kha ba'i gangs/ /mtshan mo'i mdang dang tshon gyi mdangs/ /mtshams kyi dang dang gsal ba'i dwangs/ /yo med drang dang gnas das drangs/ /nub pa'i bying dang phal che'i byings/ /dud pa'i grong dang gum pa'i grongs/ /bteg pa'i yang dang rgya che'i yangs/ /nangs par sang dang rig pa sangs/ /sgyed pu'i thab dang blo yi thabs/ /bzang po'i rab dang rim pa'i rabs/ /zas sogs stob dang she mong stobs/ /snga gzhug rim dang yams kyi rims/ /za ba'i kham dang 'byung ba'i khams/ /brjid pa'i rngam dang 'thug pa'i rngams/ /mdun gyi drung dang drungs nas 'byin/ /cha lang sogs dang gyen la langs/ /kha bskang ba dang thugs dam bskangs/ /rtswa yi 'jag ma 'thas pa'i 'jags/ /rkang ba 'khum dang shes pa 'khums/ /'khyag nas 'khob dang chum pa'i 'khobs/ /zin pa'i grub dang chags 'byor grubs/ /thag ring rgyang dang mngon pa'i rgyangs/ /rkang ba'i rgyug dang ja sogs rgyugs/ /brab pa'i lcag dang mgar ba'i lcags/ /'dab chag glag dang bslu thabs glags/ /rdo sogs bcag 432

dang zhabs kyis bcags/ /khang ba'i lhog dang blo yis lhogs/ /btung ba'i chab dang lhan cig chabs/ /bcag pa'i chogs dang rung ba'i chog /nyam nga ba dang nyams rtogs bzang / /snyom 'jug sogs dang kun la snyoms/ /spra ba'iXgatam dang mdzod kyi gtams/ /tha gas btag dang de la btags/ /rnam rtog sogs dang blo yis rtogs/ /nags kyi stag dang yas stags dang / /skas kyi gdang dang skadaXkyi gdangs/ /gdeng thob pa dang zhal sgo gdengs/ /rnam grangs sogs dang mang po'i rnams/ /bden rdzun dpang dang mthon po'i dpangs/ /sa gzhi'i spang dang nyes pa spangs/ /dad pa'i phyag dang sa rdul phyags/ /lha mi'i go 'phang rgyang du 'phangs/ /skyed po'i 'phong dang lus kyi 'phongs/ /g.yo 'gul 'phag dang mtho ba'i 'phags/ /lhag pa'i lhag dang byon pa'i lhags/ /sha gzug dang ni dbyibs kyi gzugs/ /dri ma dag dang ri dwags sogs/ /bran gyi g.yog dang thum gyis g.yogs/ /lag pa'i 'dom dang gsang gnas 'doms/ /shub dur smra dang mtshon cha'i shubs/ /spun gyi sring dang phyogs su srings/ /'phrad pa'i thug dang lha yi thugs/ /nor rdzas sog dang mang sdud sogs//'di 'dra'i tshig gi gdangs mthun kyang / /donaXkhyad sa mtha' khoXn yis/ /'byed dgos phyir na mkhas rnams kyis/ /sa mtha' yod med shes gal che/ /'on kyang 'dasaXdang bskul tshig 'gar/ /yang 'jug thob nges skabs shes dgos/ /tshig tsam mthun pa la 'khrul nas/ /yi ge log par bris pa de'i/ /sems kyi 433

rmongs pa bsal ba'i phyir/ /khyadaXpar cung zad bye ste bshad/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa sa bstan la/ /mi 'gyur brtan pa ra brtan yin/ /rang gis bsten pa sa bsten la/ /gzhan la brten pa ra brten yin/ /gnod pa'i dgra ni da dgra la/ /snyan pa'i sgra ni sa sgra yin/ /lus kyi mgo ni ma mgo la/ /nad sogs 'go ba 'a 'go yin/ /rin chen dngul ni da dngul la/ /lus kyi rtul ni ra rngul yin/ /mgrin pa'i mgul ni ma mgul la/ /g.yo ba'i 'gul ni 'a 'gul yin/ /phan pa'i drin ni da drin la/ /nyo tshong brin pa ba brin yin/ /stobs kyi dregs pa da dregs la/ /phyogs su grags pa ga grags yin/ /gzhan la stsal ba sa stsal la/ /lus kyi rtsal ni ra rtsal yin/ /bsran thub bzod ni ba bzod la/ /rjes kyi gzod ni ga gzod yin/ /thung ngur bstungs pa sa bstungs la/ /nyes pa'i ltung ba la ltung yin/ /mdza' ba'i grogs ni ga grogs la/ /khur ba'i drogs ni da drogs yin/ /lhan cig 'grogs pa ga 'grogs la/ /bred nas 'drogs pa da 'drogs yin/ /'gug pa'i dgug ni da dgug la/ /grogs pos sgug pa sa sgug yin/ /yi ge klog pa ka klog la/ /phyi nang slog pa sa slog yin/ /mtshungs pa'i 'gre ba ga 'gre la/ /gnod pa'i 'dre ni da 'dre yin/ /sa mtho'i sgang ni sa sgang la/ /chu snod lgangaXni la sgangaXyin/ /blo rig grung ba ga grung la/ /mdun gyi drung ni da drung yin/ /mig tsang rtug ni ra rtug la/ /'thug pa'i stug ni sa rdug yin/ /ri dwags gla ba ga gla la/ /tsheg chung sla ba sa sla yin/ /steng gi bla ni ba bla la/ /lus kyi brla ni ra brla yin/ /gcod 434

pa'iXste'u sa ste'u la/ /rgod ma'i rte'u ra rte'u yin/ /nang rol rgyu ma ra rgyu la/ /mi bden sgyu ma sa sgyu yin/ /'phongaXgi skyen ni sa skyed la/ /mthun pa'i rkyen ni ra rkyen yin/ /gnas sogs skor ba sa sgor la/ /dkon mchog dkor ni da dkor yin/ /chu la brgal ba ra brgal la/ /lus kyi sgal ba sa sgal yin/ /sa bdag klu ni ka klu la/ /snyan pa'i glu ni ga glu yin/ /reg bya 'jam pa ja 'jam la/ /khyab pa'i 'byams pa ba 'byams yin/ /sra ba'i rdo ni ra rdoXl/ /bslu ba'i bsdo ni sa bsdo yin/ /dus kyi dbyar ni da dbyar la/ /nom pa g.yar ba ga g.yar yin/ /rnam shes g.yeng ba 'greng can la/ /gad pa'iXgayang ni 'greng medaXyin/ /gug can dbyings ni chos dbyings la/ /gug med dbyangs ni skad dbyangs yin/ /gnam gyi skar ma sa skar la/ /kha dog dkar ba da dkar ro/ /ra rtag sa stag la ltag rnams/ /mi 'gyur gcan gzan mgo bo'i rgyab/ /ra rdang sa sdang la ldang rnams/ /'dogs thag gshe dngaXstan las langs/ /ra rku sa sku da dku rnams/ /gsang len zheXs lus kyi zur/ /ra rga sa sga da dga' rnams/ /na tshod bzhon chas semasaXyid spro/ /ra rnga sa snga la lnga rnams/ /brdung bya dusaXdang rtsis kyi grangs/ /ra rba sa sba la lnga rnams/ /chu drag mi mngon mgul ba'i rgyan/ /ra rgo sa sgo ba bgo rnams/ /ri dwags khang sgo gosaXrnams gyon/ /ra rka da dka' sa ska rnams/ /chu lam mi nus lce yi yul/ /la lkal sa skalaXb bskal rnams/ /mid dang thob dang dus yin no/ /ga gral da dralaXb bral rnams/ /bsgrigs dang ral ba byes pa'o/ /ga 4 35

gra da dra ba bra rnams/ /tshogs pa gos bzo sems stor ro/ /ga gri da dri ba bri rnams/ /mtshon dang sna yi yul nyams pa'o/ /ga gred da dred ba bred rnams/ /'gyed dngaXdud 'gro skyengs pa'o/ /ga grod da drod ba brod rnams/ /zas snod tsha ba yid dga'o/ /'di 'dra'i tshig mthun la 'khrul nas/ /yi ge gang byung bris gyur na/ /don rnams log par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ /rtag tu mkhas pa'i gzhung rnams sten/ /rnam dbye brgyadaXlas drug pa dang / /gsum pa'i khyadaXpar cud zad dbye/ /cha can dang ni cha shas kyi/ /bar gyi kyi sogs drug pa'i sgra/ /yin tshe sa mtha' mi 'thob dper/ /khyod kyi sku dang bdag gi lus/ /sman gyi bcud dang mkhas pa'i blo/ /lha yi spyan sogs lta bu'o/ /rnam dbye gsum pa byed canaXdang / /bya ba'i bar gyi kyi sogs kyis/ /sa mtha' nges par 'thob dgos dper/ /khyod kyis chos byed rang gis mthong / /sman gyis nad gsos mang bos bkur/ /lha yis char phab mkhas pas mchod/ /nyi zlas nun sel lta bu sogs/ /rnam dbye sa mtha' yod med kyi/ /don la khyad par che ba'i phyir/ /mkhas pas 'di la nan tan mdzod/ /legs pa'i yon tan kun gyi gzhi/ /yi ge'i gtsug lag yin pa'i phyir/ /blo ldan skye bo gang gis kyang / /rgyaXchen gzhung la brtun pa bskyed/ /mkhas mchog gsung gis bskul ba'i ngor/ /mdor bsdus tsam zhig brjod pa 'dis/ /dge ba'i dpag bsam 'bras bul/ /lus can yongs kyis spyod gyur cig /ces dag yig mkhas pa dga' skyed zhes bya ba 'di ni gso ba rig 436

pa'i gzhung lugs mtha' dag la blo gros kyi sgobs pa mchog tu yangs pa dge slong bsod nams bstanaXpa'i gsung gis basbul ba ltar/ yi ge sdeb sbyor la smra ba'i ljags cung zad ring ba dbyangs can rol ba'iX'o mtshor 'bod pas/ 'dzam sping yongs la grags pa'i mkhas pa chen po thonaXmi sasto ṭa/ rngog lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab/ rje byams pa gling ba/ zha lu lo tsā ba chenaXpo/ dpal khang lo tsā ba sogs kyi gaspung rab rgya mtsho lha du las nyer mkho'i cha rnams bsdus te rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i mos ldan zhes pa sa mo yos kyi dbo zla ba'i dmar phyogs kyi bzang bo gnyis par sbyar ba dzaXyan+tu/ dga' ldad chos 'khor gling nas par du bkod/ /bkra shis// //(dag yig 'di ni dga' ldan chos 'khor gling gi shing par gzhir bzung nas bsgrigs pa yin)437
ma / /dag yig rnams kyi zur 'debs legs bshad mkhas pa dgyes byed bdud rtsi'i mchod sprin rnam dag ces bya ba bzhugs so//dge 'dun shes rab kyis brtsams/

༄༅/ /oṃ swa ste/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gus btud nas/ /tshig don zab mo rtogs phyir du/ /nye bar mkho ba'i yi ge 'ga'/ /mkhas pa'i gsung bzhin btus nas bshad/ /gsung rab nas gsungs de dag dang / /(dag yig ngag sgron dang za ma tog nas)/ /rig gnas(mig gis gzugasarig pa sogs kyis mtshon)gzhung gi brjod bya'i rigs/ /mang du brjod na mangs dogs kyang / / ༷ dpyad pa'i sgo tsam bstan te dper/ /lo 'dab rgyas pa'i nags 'dabasaXsu/ /sbyang bya'i sdig sgrib kun sbyangs tshe/ /'khor dang mngag gzhug (brad ༷ ༷bayog )gzhan du mngags/ /kham zas chung ngus khams snyoms phyir/ /tshom buXtsam rer tshoms su bzhes/ /'gro 'ong las dang ma 'ongs pa'i/ /sha gzug zas dang gzugs mdzes dang / /zan g.yog gos kyi stod g.yogs sogs/ /spang bya 'di kun blos spangs pa'i/ /rnam dag chos pa de rnams yin/ /lum pa'i tshal na gzu lums(rang bzo'am bab col du smra ba)mkhan/ /rgyang 'phen ston pa gad rgyangs can/ /shig gis zos kyang mi shigs pa/ /khu ba'i 'khrig pa sprin ltar 'khrigs/ /sems ma khug tshe khugs su nyal/ /da dung sred pa'i ༷ yul la dungs/ 1mchong sogs nor phyir 'gro zhing mchongs/ /gom stabs bde yangaXblo ngan goms/ /chang dang zan changs ma 'phrod par/ /sbyong sman drag po bsten drags pas/ /skye 'gag bcas pa'i snyan grags 'gags/ /chem chem sgra yis kha chems bzhag /grong mi 'dus tshe grongs zer ro yang ༷min brtan mkhas spyan yangs khyod/ /'tshang rgya'i ched du dben par ༷440

'dz+wangs/ /nam zhig bsod nams skye phyir du/ /blung bya'i dge tshogs nyams blangs nas/ /dus la bab tshe ri las babs/ /rtsig pa'i 'gram du 'grams tshad brtags/ /rim bzhin rims nad gzhom 'dod de/ /dpag med nadaX ༷ rkyen blos dpags nas/ /smyo 'bog sogs kyi sman rnams 'bogs/ /lhag ༷ par nad sel phyir du lhags/ /'di na phyug po'i nor phyugs (phyugs rdzi dang ༷ phyugs nad lhabu)sogs/ /'brug ltar grag cing snyan grags che/ /gzhung don mi ༷ shes yidaXgazhungs(rab tu grub pa)pa'i/ /grog ma lta bu'i grogs mang yang / /thun mong las dang nyon mongs kyi/ /dbang gis nyam thag bsod nams nyams/ /mig la ldong ros(smanagyi)byugs nas ldongs(migalong ba'i don)/ /rkang ༷ ba chag ste zas laXchags//phrug gu rnams kyis ltogs nas phrugs//gang zag ༷ de yiXmachi ma zags/ /thab tu sla nga 'dzugs thabs dka'/ /rkyen la thug 'di thugs kyi yul/ /bgrang(bgranga'agreng lta du)bya'i nad kyi grangs bgrangs nas/ /sman la rtog dpyod kyis rtogs te/ /gzig sha chung du'ang thugs ༷ ༷rjes gzigs/ /kha sang bdag ni gnyid sangs te/ /gtsub shing gtsubs ༷nas me sbar dus/ /gdug sems can gyis gdugs rgyal mtshan(nyid mo'i gdugs la'ang 'jug)/ /brag gi rdzong gi nor rdzongs dang / /khrag zhag zhags ༷ ('ching byed kyi zhags pa) paXbacas pa brkus/ /deng dus khyed cag gnas der dengs//phyin ci log de logs shig tu/ /mtshon gyis dbug ste srog dbugs ༷chod/ /bya glag sogs kyis glags tshol 'gyur/ /sdig can yongs la sdigs 441

mdzub ston/ /mdog nag gartsong rong nags khrod du/ /sprang pos sbang ma chu ༷ ru sbangs/ /mgo boXgyen bslang zas bslangs nas/ /dma' ba'i gshong dang ༷ ༷ spang gshongs(spangaljongs)myul/ /brtse gdung nyams te sha yis gdungs/ /༷ dpyang thag sne la rnyi rnams dpyangs/ /rtsang thur rtser 'khyud rtsangs(srog ༷ chags)pa sogs/ /bu ga dog por 'dzin gyis dogs/ /dang ba can la dwangs shel dang / /(dwangs pa'i mtsholha bu)lha shing shug pa shugs bskyedaXde/ / ༷ ༷snod gang btusaXnas gangs ri'i rtser/ /drang po'i mi yis gyen drangs nas/ / chab dang zas phud chabs(lhanacig)cig tu/ /thog mar lag tu thogs(mchod tshus thogs palta bu)te phul/ /bsam bya bsams nas bsang btang tshe/ /gsung snyan can des gsungs na mdzes/ /ha ha te te grogs dag la/ /spro ba bskyed ba'i rtsed mo zhu/ /'di ltar tshig sbyor byas na blo gsar ba 'ga' zhig gis mi ༷ go snyam du grong tshig dang / rang gzhan gyi bshad srol du ma'i rjes su zhugs te/ gsung rab rnams su grags che ba'i yi ge 'khrul gzhi 'byung srid pa rnams dang / sngar bshad zin pa 'ga' zhig yang bskyar gyi tshul du bshad par bya'o//smras pa/ shes bya'i ming gi dbye ba kun/ /shes na zi ga don thams cad ni/ /shes par 'gyur zhes gsungasaXphyiraXn/ /shes rab chung yang 'di skad smra/ /rtags kyi 'jug pa'i dgongs don bzhin/ /dus gsum dbang gis thob tshul sogs/ /nga yis gzhan du bshad pa ltar/ /rig pas yang yang 442

dpyad na shes/ /dper brjod spros kyang rtogs mi nus/ /'dir ni ming gi cha shas la//dogasaXpa sel tshul mdor bsdus bshad//mchog gi rab dang skyes pa'i rabs/ /phan tshun thug dngaXrgyal ba'i ༷ thugs/ /yod pa'i tshang dang lha tshangs pa/ /smra ba'i gtam dang byur bur gtams/ /zhig pa'i 'jig dngaXskrag pa'i 'jigs/ /gnam lcags thog ༷ dang thogs pa med/ /gdeng thob pa dang mtshon cha gdengs(gdengs ka can la 'ang 'jug)/ /tshem drub dang ni zhal gyi tshems/ /thur du phab dang chang gi phabs/ khang ba'i skas gdang zhal ni gdangs/ /gos kyi 'gel gdang skad kyi gdangs(snyan pa'igadangasacan)/ /mi 'gyur rtag pa rtags mtshan ma/ /'ching byed sgrog dang sgra chen sgrogs/ /rnam pa'i rnam dang mang tshig rnams/ /thung min ring dang myur ba'i rings(rings par byon lha bu)/ /'os pa'i rung ༷ dang ma rungs bdud/ /ljid med yang dang rgya khyon yangs/ /lha yi phyag dang ༷rtswa'i phyags ma/ /'phong rkyen bslabs dang lus kyi 'phongs/ kha dog dag dang nags kyi tshal/ /skul byed lcag dang sra mkhregs lcags/ /nyag por ༷gnyag dang rigs kyi gnyags(gnyagasakyi rigasa'akhrungs lta bu)/ /zhar ba'i long ༷ dang lha'i longs spyod/ /drag poha cang thal ches drags/ /ba lang rgod po langs te bros/ /khu byug grag dus grags pa thob/ /gtam gyi dpang po mthon po'i dpangs/ /sgyed pu'i thab ka thabs cig tu/ /mjug giXgatang rag che ba'i rags(phra rags ltabu)/ /rten gyi drung du drungs nas phyung / /lhag 443

ma zos dus lhags pa che/ /lus kyi rtsib logs 'khor lo'i rtsibs/ /'dzin pa'i gzung bya sngags kyi gzungs(mi brjed pa'i gzungs sogs)/ /de las sgar logaXzur gyi logs/ /kha dog kham ser 'jig rten khams/ /rkang ba'i gom ༷ stabs goms su bcug /lcags kyi thu lum sman lums dang / /snod kyi gzhong ba t+pang gi gzhongs(ljongs)/ /sga yi yung ba(sga ser)yungs kar dang / /dgyes bzhin gnang dang gnangs kyi dus/ /shub bur smra dang gri yi shubs/ / gnyis kyi zung dang lus zungs bzang / /rtogs dka'i zab dang gting ring zabs/ /'khyags pa'i grang dang brtsi bya'i grangs/ /brag gi phug dang gtan gyi phugs/ /stong dang khri phrag zad nas stongs/ /'phrin gyi spring yig ༷ skur ba'i springs(bsrings kyang 'thad)/ /rkang lag 'khum dang go ba'i 'khums/ /lag pa'i 'dom pa gsang gnas 'doms(bshad pa'i 'doms)/ /yi ge'i tsheg dang las tshegs(phranatshegs)che/ /dri ma'i zag bcas stor ba'i ༷ ༷ zags//dpangs kyi 'phang(khri 'phang sogs)dang rgyang du 'phangs/phathong ba'i rig dang gtogs tshad rigs(rib/sa rus kyi rigs dang rigs payang dgasogs)/ /mig gis mthong dang nam mkha'i mthongs(rgya mthongs)/ /ral gris gsheg dang byon pa'i gshegs/ /til gyi gang bu kha ba'i gangs/ /'dam pa'i gdam nga zhal nas gdams/ /blo ngor 'tsham dang mtho 'tshams pa/ /ri yi lhog dang ༷ blo yis lhogs/ /zang zing dngos po zangs dmar lcags/ /zhabs kyi long(che longadang long yod med)bu 'dzom pa'i longs/ /rtswa yi 'jag ma sbyor 'jags 444

(brtan 'jags)byas/ /zhal du stob dang lus kyi stobs/ /brtag dpyad sgo nas legs brtags te/ /nad bslang dus su sman rnams bslangs/ /chang gi ༷ sbang ma rta sbangs dang / /btsan dug gdus pa'iXdugs kyis bdugs/ / 'phag nas langs tshe khyad par 'phags/ /dang ga bde dusadwangs snyigs byas/ /'thab rtsod 'khrug pas sems 'khrugs nas/ /skyin pa 'tshab tshe khyod ༷blo 'tshabs/ /kha shags 'gyed dang ting ting shag /mang tshig dag(skyon dngadri ༷ ma dag pa)dang tshig bla dwags/ /gnyan gyi lhog pa gdong lhogs dang / /chu ru bying dang sngags kyi byengs(dud 'gro byings na gnas)/ /chag grum snod du zasaX ngan chags//dpal gyi dbang phyug dud 'gro'i phyugs/ /bkur ste'i rim ༷ ༷ (nyis rim sogs kyisamatshon)gro nad kyi rims/ /bong bu'i lus kyi bongs tshod ༷ ༷ chung / /'tshog chasadon du phyogs gcig 'tshogs/ /'khor g.yog mang pos sa steng g.yogs/ /stag gzig khyu la gzigs pa yi/ /rdzong dpon de la rdzongs kyis brdzangs/ khoraXyug gnas su yugs('gomayugs)mo bskrad/ / phyogs kun bsang gtor gyis bsangs(sngo bsangasadang skyobasangs)so /tshig rkang re res don gsum bstan/ /snga ma gnyis la yang 'jugamed/ /phye mar yang 'jug yod pa ni/ /bde blag btso blag(tshos malan)rna ba blags/ /'dab ༷ chags shang shang(bya)zhal gyi shangs/ /sgyid lug ra lug khrims kyi lugs/ / ༷ ༷ ༷ khong giXkhong khro khongs su gtogs/ /ngam grog chu grog mdza' ba'i grogs/ / ༷'dab gshog 'dab ma ri yi 'dabs/ /bag ma bag chags rim gyi bags ༷ ༷ 445

(bags kyis phra zhing zhesapa lta bu)/ /deng sang sang nyin gza' pa sangs/ /bste stang stang stabs bzhugs stangs can/ /'gas 'chag 'gro 'chag sdig sgrib 'chags/ /mestag sha stag yas stags dang / /gsung bcag rdo bcag zhabs ༷ ༷ kyis bcags/ /kha dog phrag dog blo'i dogs pa/ /ngan rtog log rtog sel ༷ tshul rtogs//spras pa/ 'di ni dka' ba'i gnas min yang / /tshegs med shes pa shin tu dka'/ /kun gyis rtogs phyir phyogs gcig tu/ /bsgrigs la mkhas pas thugs ma khrel//yang 'jug yod med bstan pa'i sde tshan te dang po'o//tshig rkang re re'i nang nyid du/ /'dra ba gnyis gnyis bstan pa ni/ /mang po'i rab 'byams 'byams klas pa/ /rtse gcig blo bsgrims srad bu ༷ bsgrims/ /mgo yi thoratshugs sha yi tshugs/ /dus kyi mdangs sang tshon gyi ༷ ༷ mdangs/ /zad pa'i gtugs dang zhabs la gtugs/ /nad kyi skya rbab rbab ༷ rdo 'dril/ /nags kyi klung dang chu yi klung / /bzod dka'i 'o brgyal dran med brgyal/ /mig gi lta stangs blo'i 'dzin stangs/ /tshagasaXsu chud dang chu yi tshags/ /nam mkha'i glong dang chu'i rba glong / /bsgo ba rnar gzon chud ༷ gzon dang / /'bubs pa'i spra dang gtsang sbra dang / /ham pa'i rngams(srog la rngams lha bu)dang 'thug po'i rngams/ /duḥ kha'i gdung ba rus kyi gdung / /༷ sol ba'i mgalaXme ya mgal dang / /gcan gzan stag dang shing stag pa/ /༷ nga rgyal rgyags pa zas kyi rgyags/ khal bkal skud pa'i srad khu bkal/ /446

'khrugalong skyongogs 'jug ngogs bde/ /'thag rgyu'i thags dang tshems thags bzang / /'thab krol can dang phung krol dang / /rta yi srab dang ༷ 'thug min srab/ /rma bya'i mdongs dang dpral ba'i mdongs/ /nad kyi me ༷ dbal pūr bu'i dbal(rtse mo)/ /rga bas lus nyams gar gyi nyams/ /skrangs ༷ pa'i rnag brtol spyi brtol(tha shal)can/ /ska rags lcag bod re'u lcag ༷dang / /se gol gtogs dang phyogs su gtogs/ /myu stegasaXgazegs zan ༷chu'i gzegs ma//ri mo'i tshangs thig tshangs spyod do//'dra ba gsum gsum bstan pa ni/ /me tog lo tog nor bu'i tog /cig shos kha cig thang cig dang / /glegs bam glegs bu sgo glegs dang / / gzugs brnyan sgra brnyan brnyan po'i gos/ /nyam nga nyam chung nyam thag dang / /gtan tshigs dus tshigs lhu yi tshigs/ /lkog gyur lkog ma lkog shal ༷ ༷ dang / /tog sgra zhabs tog za ma tog /lag pa rtsa lag kho lag yangs/ /ji ༷ ༷ ltar ji srid ji snyed dang / /rnam mang rnam grangs rnam bzhag dang / /lde gu ༷ ༷ lde mig ming gi lde/ /phying gzar(phying ba'i stan gyi ming)ri gzar gzar du ༷ ༷ dang / /na bza' bza' mi bza' ba'i zas/ /chab 'og chab shog chab sgoX ༷ ༷ dang / /sga nga (lcagasakyi)lha nga(pusamo)bya'i sgo nga / /g.yang sa g.yang gzhi ༷ ༷ ༷ dpal gyigayang / /yi chad yi rang yi dam lha/ /zla gam zla ba 'gran zla bral// ༷ ༷ rgan rabs snga rabs tshe rabs so//smras pa/ shes par sla ba thams cad kyi/ /'go phyung tsam zhig 'di ru 447

spros/ /re'u mig rgyas bsdus gnyis su ni/ /dka' gnad phal cher bkod zin to/ /'dra ba'i yi ge bstan pa'i sde tshan te gnyis pa'o//'dra ba min yang brjod tshul gyis/ /yi ge nor 'khrul 'byung ba ni/ /drang bor bsrang dang yun ring bgring / /rang gis bsten dang rang la brten/ /nam mala'i dbyingasaXdang snyan pa'i dbyings/ /rno ba'i gri dang zhim pa'i dri/ /brjed pa'i gtam gleng ri rab gling ('bud pa'i gling du)/ /lus kyi mgo dang thog ma'i 'go /go 'phang brnyes dang gzhan la brnyas/ /sa bdag ༷ ༷klu dang snyan pa'i glu/ /ming po'i sring mo 'jal byed srang (lamasrangaX)/ /rgyal ༷ ༷pos bkrabasaXdang lcag gis brab/ /lusaXkyi pang (ma'i pang na bu chung banas)dngaXmagyogs pa'i bang / /chung du'i phran dang 'bangs kyi bran/ /bya ba byas tshe ༷byes su bsdad/ /zas kyis 'grangs nas 'greng ma nus//ldang 'dug mi shes ༷ mkha' la lding / /rdang la btags kyang gzhan la sdang / /sgra yis brda byed las bda' mkhan/ /rin gyis blus(nyosapa'i dan)nas bdag gis bslus/ /'bud pa'i chos dung btson gyi dong / /'thas pa'i sa brkos dpon por bskos/ /rkun mas brkus dang tshon rtsi bskus/ /mi ro rangs po shing ltar rengs/ /nam mkha'i glog dang glegs bam klog /rtsub mo'i tshig brlang dul ba'i brling //yid ches rton pa(rton pa bzhi lha bu)chos ston pa/ /gyen du bteg dang bsrung skud btags//grangs kyi brgya stong mda' yi ltong / /mthun pa'i ༷rkyen dang 'phong gi skyen/ /rgol ba'i klan ka lhan pa glan/ /lam gyi 'phrang ༷448

dang sems la 'phreng / /gzhu bdungs rnga la dbyug gus brdungs//nang khrol ༷ rgyu ma g.yo sgyu mkhan/ /'akor ba'i dus 'gyangs rtsal gyis 'gying / /log 'tsho'i kha gsag rdo'i gseg ma/ /nang nas phyir phyung brten nas byung / /'dzin byed rnyi dang reg bya snyi/ /lug gi bal rmel sga yi med/ /tho rangs 'das nas skya rengs shar/ /sdig pa spong dang phung bor spungs/ /phyi dro'i dgongs dang mtshan mo'i dgung / /mdzes pa'i sdug dang thabs rdugs pa/ / ༷ 'grod lam bgags dang mna' tshig bsgags/ /'thag pa'i bye ma rdo'i bye ༷ma/ /mkha' la rgyan bres ltogs pa'i bkres/ /skad kyi gzengs bstod gru ༷ gzings bsdams/ /dar ba'i bdo(snyigs malnga bdo lta bu)dang sku la bsdo/ /༷ ༷ ༷zhags pa'i thag pa khur chen pheg /mig gis bltas dang rgyas pa'i brtas/ / bzang po'i legs dngaXzhe sa'i lags(yod pa'am yinapa'i donala'ang 'jukapa yod)/ /dri ma 'dag dang gyen du 'degs/ /bskyar nas bldabs dang zhabs ༷ ༷ gnyis brdabs/ /rin chen sprug dang ral ba sprugs/ /ya rabs dra ma shing ༷gra ma/ /pags pa dang ni shun lpags(gzhi dang 'brel ma 'brel gyi khyad par)srab/ / dom lpags dom gyi pags(rnam dbye drug pa'isgra yod med kyi khyad par)pa nag /༷ phyogs gcig sdud dang skom skyems ldud/ /kha dog gsal dang myud pa bsal/ /lus la gos bgo bshad pa'i bsgo/ /mgron po'i 'grul ba rul 'gyur 'drul/ /sa la 'drud dang bslu ba'i 'drid/ /bstan la mjal dang blo ༷ yis 'jal/ /phan tshun 'brel dang gzhung don 'grel/ /gang la gang 'tsham 449

phyogs kyi mtshams/ /brgyab pa'i brdeg dang yodapa'i bdog /ngal ba'i ༷ dub dang rung ba'i btub/ /nor ba'i lam gol g.yogasogs bkol/ lang ༷ ba'i bar khyams 'phyan pa'i 'khyams/ /zad pa'i 'bri dang yi ger 'dri/ / dus kyi bskal ba zas kyi skal/ /'gro ba'i mchi dang yod pa'i mchis/ /lus kyi lgang ba ri yi sgang / /mkhas pa'i mdzangs pa skra sogs 'dzings/ /bzod ༷dka'i mi bzad zad mi shes//nye ba'i btud dang dgra bo btul//phyi bshol mkhan des snod chus bshal/ /zhing gi thong gshol rngams zheng che/ /smra ba'i ngag lkugs rgyal 'gugs skugs/ /'phral gyi don dang phan tshun 'phrad/ /chu ༷ yis 'khrud dang nor ba'i 'khrul/ /chos lugs gsha' ma'agab kyi gsham/ /༷ byas pa'i bgyis dang byed pa'i bgyid/ /lus kyi rngul chu rin chen dadul/ / gsong por smras te de'u gsing du/ /na tshod bgres kyang bgro gleng byed/ /ri ༷ bo'i gtos tsam gta' mar 'jog /bzhon ba glang chen thal kar zhon/ /༷ zlog pa byas nas rtsod pa bzlog /rgyal ba'i bstanapa brtan par byas/ / ༷ 'badartsol can des bka' nga cig /dong du brubs dang dras drubs dang / /snga dro phyi dro nas sran gro/ /lhan cig 'grogs dang 'brog dgon pa// bkrag mdangs rgyas phyir skra rnams bregs(regs yang zer)//lus kyi lnga ba sba bar bya/ /shesapa'i 'tshal dang tshon rtsi'i mtshal/ /snyan pa'i sgra dang mi ༷ mthun dgra/ /grangs kyi lnga dang brdung bya'i rnga/ /mngaXtshig snyed(ji snyed dang de ༷snyed lhabu)dang nor rdzas rnyed/ /g.yo ba'i 'gul dang mgrin pa'i mgul/ /chu 460

yi lteng ka rting ba yangs/ /tshig rkang re re'i nang nyid du/ /'dra min gnyis gnyis bstan zin to//rang dang rang 'dra phan tshun la/ /nor bar dogs nas rtags byas pa/ /de la wa btags zer te dper/ /kwaXye grwa pa sman pa yis/ /shā ba'i ga dor rwa sna tshogs/ /lan tshwa zwa tshod dwa ba'i 'bru/ /ri dwags bse ru'i nywa sha bcas/ /zhwa dang lu ba btsongs nas nyos/ /yi dwags lta bu'i dwa(pham shi ba'i byis pa)phrug gis//shā 'od chu khar bya khā ta//'phur ma nus pa bzungaXlta bu//phan tshun la ltos chung ngu la/ /gu khu 'u gsum 'jug ste dper/ /dbyug gu phran bu be'u sogs/ /'di 'dra sbyar ba shin tu mang / /ming gi cha shas 'ga' zhig tu/ /chung ngu min yang deXgasum 'jug /pha gu gcer bu dre'u —sogs/ /sbyor tshul de rnams rtogs par sla//bcu nas bcu dgu'i b.raXdag dang / /bzhi bcu lnga bcu dgu bcu la/ / ༷ bas 'phul yod cing sum cu dang / /drug cu bdun cu brgyad cur med/ /chig brgya nyis brgyaXsum brgya dang / /chig stong sogasaXl gas 'phul spang / /༷ chig rkyang sogs la rigs 'gre'o//smras pa/ snga phyi'i bkas bcad(rim bzhinabakas ba6da gsumamadzad par grags)dbang gis ni1 /yiXge'i bshad srol du ma byung / /dag yig ngag sgron nas gsungs pa'i/ /ming gi sbyor tshul kun kyang 'thad/ /'dra min yi ge bstan pa'i sde tshad te gsum pa'o//451

rnam dbye dang ni tshig phrad dang / /brda dang grong tshig mngon brjod sogs/ /'dres pas yi ge sna tshogs byung / /rgyal po'i zhal la gser zhal zer/ /de la 'bul phyir gser skyems dang / /bla ni stod dang mthang ni smad/ /blaXgos mthang gos zer ba ltar/ /'dod rgyal ming rnams ma gtogs pa'i/ /chos kun ming don shes dgos na/ /dag yig rnams las gsungs pa yi/ /brda sogs dbye ba cung zad bshad/ /tshar du dngar ba bsgrigs pa'i ming / /'phyang mo nyug niXthe tshom dngaX/ /gor maXchag ni the tshom med/ /sa sgre bo ni sa rjen dang / /brtul phod pa ni snying stobs che/ /'jungs pa zhen chags che ba dang / /phya le ba ni ngos mnyam pa/ /'bel gtam yangaXdag gtam gyi ming / /mi 'gong ba ni mi zhum pa/ /ya ma brla ni snying bo med/ /bru tsha ba ni bkres paXdang / /bro 'tshal ba ni nad pa'i ming / /nying sha zhes rang gi sha /bslan pa phyogs su gtogs pa dang / /dkyel che ba ni khong yangs pa/ /slad bzhin 'brang ni phyi bzhin 'brang / /phya ma rta ni pho nya'i ming / /bdud kyis brlams pa bskyod(bdud kyis)pa'i don/ /mnog chung ba ni khe chung ba/ /bsnyungs pa chung ngur byas pa dang / /ya lad ces pa go cha dang / /phru ma(mngal gyi phru ma)dmag sgar sogs la 'jug /jo mi thogs ni mi nus pa/ /mchig dang mchig gu yas mas gtun/ /ldom du ba ni bsod snyoms pa/ /'khos kha chung ba kha thabs chung / /lag gi bla ni(dge 'dun spyi'i)las byed pa/ /'brongs pa nye bar bsten pa dang / /danus byung ba ni yi chad pa/ /gam(mkhas pa'i gam452

du zhes pa lta du)ni drung ngam mdun gyi don/ /gtol med pa ni rgyus med dang //byas pa gzo ba drin gzoXb/ /lus mtshag bzang ba lus nyams rgyas/ /ga ge yul gyiXspyi ming dang / /che ge gang zag spyi yi ming / /sdong grogs grogs kyi ming yin no//bkaraXbatags khrims bsgrags yol go snod/ /bas pa(lus kyi sha bas shing ༷ zhes pa lta bu)zad paXlha cor rdzun/ /brgyad bkag bka' bkyon dam rgya ༷khrims/ /dadu rmog dbu 'phang byur mya ngan/ /g.yar dam dam bca' nye ༷ reg khrus/ /bste ba ngal gso bshul ni lam/ /go ra btson ra sngon skyes gcen/ /mchil ba lcags kyu rjes skyes gcung / /brkam pa 'dodaXchags dkor ni nor/ /tsham rngams 'jigs stangs gnam ru gzhu/ /gzod ma dang ༷ ༷ po nyag phran mda'/ /gcam bu bcos ma 'khu ba 'gran/ /bka' mchidaXgleng mo cog ni kun/ /slad rol phyi rol bro ni mna'/ /mches pa khas len mchel ༷ ༷ ba zhen/ /do ker thor cog dbyig ni nor/ /sgron mo gcer du 'dren byed mig /rlid bu rkyal ba brang 'gro sprul/ /red pa grub pa rod pa gos/ /kyal ka ku re nyod pa zas/ /gor mo sdang sems gor ma rdo/ /bskrun pa bskyed pa sgrun pa 'gran1 /bgam pa nyams sad sgam pa zab/ /sim pa bde ba spe sdug ༷bsngal/ /lto 'phye lto 'gro 'bye ba 'gro/ /brnab pa 'dod pa brnag pa bsam/ / ༷ bsnyel ba brjed dang mnyel ba ngal/ /'ubs pa 'dus pa stug po 'thug / 'phyar g.yeng rnam g.yeng gya ba nyams/ /brtul ba 'jam pa brtsen pa rol/ /༷453

co 'dri mtho 'tshams rtsa lag gnyen/ /mkhyud sprud man ngag bda' ba zhim// rangs bo ril po dbrog ni 'phrog /gya tshom ma brtags zhugs ni me/ /dkar chag tho yig 'dzolaXb 'chug /sbebs pa skem pa 'di ko 'di/ /phyag brnyan 'khor g.yog 'gems paX'ajoms/ /ther zug 'gyur med 'dzer ba zer//zhal lce chad pa sgo(sgo glegs kyangasgo )'phar sgo/ /ltag 'og gong 'og 'dzud pa 'jug /'khrun ring dkyus ring zang zing nor(nor gyi spyi ming)/ /bza' tsho ༷bza' mi gna' ni sngon/ /sug pa lag pa ro 'dzin lce/ /dri bsung dri zhim ༷dngags ni ngag /gtsug lag sde snod legs bris lha//tshi gu 'azas bu bsnyunaX ༷ ༷ni nad/ /zil dngar bdud rtsi kun gsal mkha'/ /dkos thag nyam thag chu ༷ 'dzin sprin/ /phyi mo rtsa ba nyal 'gro chu/ /gting phyin gshis phyin dri bzhon ༷ ༷rlung / /gseg shing 'khar gsil zol ni sgyu/ /gyim shing rol mo ka cha'ang nor/ /mi ngas rims nad dbang gzhu 'ja'/ /pho long gru gu dpya ni khral/ /༷bkrabs pa 'dams pa chu mthongs gnam/ /nyeraXbasdogs sta gon sreg za me/ /lag ldan glang chen bal ldan lug /bkums pa bsad pa 'gum pa 'chi//nan tur nan tan sprin bcud char//dal ba khom pa'i ming yin no//༷don gcig ming gnyis tsam gyis bstan/ /gnyis po phan tshun gzhi mthun du/ /rnam dbye drug pas ston te dper/ /bshad pa zon pa sbran pa ni/ /bshad pa'i ming yin de bzhin du/ /'og ma rnams la sbyar bar bya /ngoms pa'i spyoms dang bsdigs pa'i spyos/ /dman pa'i gyi na bden pa'i 454

mad/ /'gro ba'i 'dong dang bzhugs pa'i gzhes/ /bcom pa'i bcil dang zhig pa'i dral/ /'khyogs pa'i ldem po 'jigs pa'i bsnyengs/ /brjed pa'i bskyud dang bskrad pa'i sprugs/ /brtson pa'i brtun pa 'gyangs pa'i bul/ /༷ ༷chung ngu'i bsgyungs dang khung bu'i rlubs/ /bzang po'i bsod pa nyes pa'i ༷ nongs/ /byin pa'i bstabs dang mchod pa'i brngan/ /'khrid pa'i bkri ba khro ༷ba'i bkyon/ /song ba'i byer ba 'gro ba'i 'byer/ /sbed pa'i 'chabaXdang sbas pa'i bcabs/ /g.yar bo'i brnyan po len pa'i nod/ /dbul ba'i bkren pa sta zur dpyi/ /des pa 'jam pa sogs la 'jug /dpal gyi dbang thang che ba ni/ /bsod nams skal ba che ba'iXming / /nye zho med pa skyon med pa/ /gya nom pa ni phun sum tshogs/ /sgrin po mkhas pa'i ming yin no//smras pa/ gsar rnying brda dang rgya bod skad/ /mngon brjod la sogasaXshesaX'adod kyang / /don gcig nyid la ming mtha' yas/ /ming gcig nyid kyis don mang ston/ /de'i phyir bdag 'dras gting mi dpog /'on kyang ming gi cha shas rnams/ /ma rtogs bar du de dag la/ /brten pa'i tshig phrad sbyor mi shes/ /dag yig rnams kyang mthun dka' na/ /malas pas gtso bor 'dzin pa yi/ /dag yig za ma tog bzhin du/ /'phul(sngon 'jug lnga)dang mtha' rten(rjes 'jug bcu)sbyor tshul dang / /ra la sa yi mgo can(ra mgo)dang / /ra mgo cad bcu gsum ni/ rka rga rnga rja rnya rta rda rna rba rma rtsa rdza rla'o//laXmago can bcu ni/ lka sga lnga lca lja ba lda lha lba lhad / /sa mgo can bcu 466

gnyis ni/ ska sga snga snya lta sda sna spa sba sma stsa sla'o/ /ya ra la yi smad 'dogs sogs/ /ya btags bdun ni/ kya khya gya pya phya bya spya'o/ /ra btags bcu gcig ni/ kra khra gra mra thra dra pra phra braXsra hra'o/ /la btags lnga ni/ kla gla bla zla sla'o/ /de rnams sbyor tshul shes pa gces/ /brda gsar rnying dang mngon brjod sogs kyi ming sna tshogs bstan pa'i ste tshan te bzhi ba'o/ /smras pa/ (ming 'ga' zhig ha cang bsdus pas/ brtag dpyad yang yang byed dgos)dbye ba 'ga' zhig0 / thabs tsam du bstan pa sogs/ /'di la nor 'khrul ci mchis pa/ /mkhas pa'i spyan sngar bshags par bgyi/ /blo ldanaXmakhas pa'i gsung rab la/ /blo yis dpyad de bris pa 'di/ /blo spyan yangs pa'i grogs dag gi /blo dang rig pa 'phel phyir sbyar/ /'di ru ma bris gzhan rnams kyang / /'di bzhin sbyar na rtogs par sba/ /'di yis mtshon pa'i dge tshogs mthus/ /'diXphyi'i don chen myur 'grub shog /ces pa 'di ni rab 'byams smra ba'i dbang bo 'jam dbyangs blo gros dang / don gnyer can gyi dge slong gsum dang bcas pas/ 'di lta bu zhig bgyis na nged cag rnams kyis dpar du bsgrub ces nan gyis bskul ba'i ngor rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i nang tshan dbang phyug ces pa me glang gi lo'i sa ga zla ba'i yar tshes la/ dge 'dun shes rab kyis sug bris su bgyis te/ dga' ldan bkra shis 'byung gnas(ra rgya dgon pa)su par du baspubs pa'o//(dag yig 'di ni ra rgya dgon pa'i shing par gzhir bzung nas bsgrigs pa yin)466
༄nyu / /dag yig gces kasdumu kakhruka spod legaka par bshad pa'i skya redaka gsarda ka zhemu bya ka bzhugs so//a lag ma ngag dbang bstan dar gyis brtsams/

༄rtse/ /('is brdzod kyi rgyan)rgyal kun 'phrin las mdzes sdug lha mo yi/ /rnam pa'i gar bsgyur rje btsun sgrol ma dang / gnyis med klong rdol ngag dbang blo bzang la/ /skyabs su mchi'ikun tu shis gyur cig /(ngo bstodakyi dpe) dus gsum rgyal ba mtshan dpe yongs su rdzogs/ /bdag gi bshes gnyen mgrin pa'i mdud bkrol tsam/ /de lta na yang rgyalab kun dngos dang / /gnyisasu med par shes nas dadapas bsten/ /(yongs brjes kyi rgyan)lus dngalongs spyod dus gsum dge tshogs sogs/ /bdag la cibadog mang pa'i gter la dbul/ /des kyang sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub mchog /lus pa med par 'gyangs min nga da cig gu/ /(dngos dpe)nyinabyed stong gisa'akhyud pa'i 'o mtsho yis/ /lanabargyar byugs pa'i shel gyi sa 'dzin kyang/ /gang gi dkar ma/dzes dpal la mi bzod pa'i/ /dbyangs can lhamo mgrin par rtag rold cig /(khyad 'phags phul byung)spin posabazung ba'i mtha' 'khob gangs ljongs su/ /bka' bstan 'gyur ba'i thabs su bod yig srol/ /byed po sa 'bo ra yi bka' drin mtha'/ /khyab 'jug gnasakyis gzhal bar mi nus so/ /(cha shas gzugs can)bod yig gis bskrun gtsug lag nam mkha'i nor/ /thugs rje rtabadun rol bas rab drangasanas/ /thub bstan pad ma'i srog zungs gso mdzad pa'i/ /gna' bo'i chosargyal lo paṇa rnams la dad/ /(bya ba'i rang bzhin brjod pa)gang gi tshad med thugs rje g.yo tsam gyis/ /rmad byung myur ba'i sgobs pa ma 458

'bod par/ /bde blag ster ba'i klog gi slob dpon drin/ /da gzod dran nas drin gzo'i bsamaXpas bsten/ /(bsdus pa'i kazugs can) dpyadaXkyang the tshomaXmun pas bcud ma myong / /nyesaXbashad 'dab ma brgya yis btum pa'i nang / /blo gsal rkang drug 'phur 'dod skal zhan na/ /legs bshad skya rengs gsar ba 'di sgugs shig /(mtha' thog zung ldad) bstan pa'i rtsa ba yi ge 'di la zer/ /zer sgros bsgrigs pa'i dag yig phal ba la la las chog paraX'adzin mod byis pa'i blo/ /blo rtsal yod na 'di nyid bsten rigs so//thog mar mgo can bshad pa la/ /chu rka 'then pa ra rka yin/ /sa ska roXyi bye brag go /rgyu yi rkyen ni ra rkyen yin/ /myur ba'i skyen ni sa skyen no/ /sa dong brkos zin ra brkos yin/ /las la bskos zin sa bskos so/ /྅di gnyis 'das tshig yin pas na/ /rjes 'jug thob mod bya tshig la/ /med kyang rung ba'i gnad gcig yod/ /rkun ma rku byed ra rku yin/ /das 'phul dku ni dpyi mgo'i ming / /glen zhing lkugs pa la lkugs yin/ /rgyal sbugs btsugs pa sa skugs so/ /kha nang rkan ni ra rkan yin/ /yod re skan ni sa skan no/ /das 'phul dkan ni dkan gzar po/ /chu las rgal ba ra rgal yin/ /lus kyi sgal ba sa sgal lo/ /dkyil mtho'i sgang ni sa sgang yin/ /gcin snod lgang ni la mgo can/ /ri dwags rgo(za ma tog tud yis 'phul/)ba ra rgo yin/ /tsha sgo can ni sa sgo yin/ /pha ba dgo dgo da yis 'phul/ /zla bo 4 5 9

sgug pa sa sgug yin/ /shing rengs dgug pa da yis 'phul/ /shing tog rgun 'brum ra rgan yin/ /dus bzhi'i dgun ni da yis 'phul/ /nang khrol rgyu ma sgyu maXmakhan/ /nor roXsnyam pa'i dogs gzhi chung / /dbugs rgod sngam ni sa sngam yin/ /'jigs stangs rngam ni ra rngam mo/ /lus kyi rngul ni ra rngul yin/ /rin chen darul ni da yis 'phul/ /rid pa'i jud ni ra jud yin/ 1lci ba'i lcid ni la mgo can/ /til gyi rjang bu ra rjang yin/ /myu gu'i ljang bu la ljang ngo / /de bzhin ljan sprun yul ljongs sogs/ /la yig thod du bcings pa'i ja/ /rjen btsos sa rjen la sogs pa/ /ja yig ra mgo can du bri/ /reg bya snyi ba sa snyi yin/ /rgya yi rnyi ni ra rnyi'o/ /de bzhin mi gtsang rnyang dang rnyong / /so yi rnyil sogs ra mgor bri/ /rang gis bsten pa sa bsten yin/ /gzhan la brten pa ra brten no/ /'di gnyis 'phul yig canaXdu nges/ /byin len bstabs dang gos bltabs pa/ /sa la'i zhwa can 'das tshig yin/ /'thug po'i stug ni sa stug yin/ /mi gtsang rtug ni ra rtug go /mig gis bltas zin rgyas zin brtas/ /rim pas la ra'i klad can no/ /rgyab kyi ltag ni la ltag yin/ /ther zug rtag ni ra rtag yin/ /gcanaXgazan stag dang ga la mtshungs/ /stes kyi dbang dang ltas ngan ni/ /sa dang la yi zhwa can lags/ /mda'aXyi ltong ni la mgo can/ /grangs kyi stong dang nor don med/ /de bzhin rtod thag lus stod dang / /bkres pa'i ltogs dang shes pa'i rtogs/ /de sogs khyad par 'byed pa gces/ /rings pa'i 460

rtab nir rtab yin/ /brtabs kyang 'thad mod 'das tshig yin/ /rjes ma'i rting ni ra rting yin/ /gting zab gting dang gtan mi 'dra/ /zal mo brdab dang pheg rdob dang / /noXmed rdugs dang thabs rdugs dang / /rdeg byed brdeg bya khang rdib rnams/ /ra mgo can du shes par bya/ /ne'u ldangs dang ldom bu ba/ /gyang ldebs ldobs skyen lan ldon dang / /lus pa'i ldas dang blugs pa'iXldugs/ /log pa'i ldog dang spum bu dang / /ldab ldib smra dang lder bzo dang / /lde mig re lde me la lde/ /'brug sgra ldir dang 'dab chags lding / /chad longs ldang dang stan las ldang / /lces bldag so yis bldad pa sogs/ /la mgo can du shes par bya/ /nyer bsdogs thag bsdogs thug sdor dang / /snod kyi sder ma sder mo rnams/ /sa yig thod du bcings pa'i da/ /skom skyems ldud pa la mgo can/ /phyogs su sdudaXdang nor sa chung / /rta 'dogs rdang ni ra rdang yin/ /skas kyi gdang bu gas 'phul can/ /khangaXba'i sdum ni sa sdum yin/ /ldum ra'i ldum ni la ldum yin/ /dum bur gtub pa dum rkyang yin/ /klum por gtub paXgazhan yin no/ /srog bsdos bas 'phul sar btags da/ /dbu ba rdos pa 'phul med pa'i/ /ra yi 'og tu btags pa'i da/ /'gran pa'i sdo ni sa mgo can/ /gri sogs brdar ba ra mgo can/ /bye mar bdar ba bas 'phul tsam/ /rnag brtol zhabs rdol sdeb mi gcig /de gnyis nor dogs shin tu che/ /mdun du brdur('then pa'i ming )dang brnab sems dang / /nges bzung brnan dang 461

sbas pa'i brdogs/ /gre bar zas thogs brnangs pa sogs/ /brtsegs 'phul thob pa'i ra rna'o/ /zhing gi rnang ma khug rna sogs/ /brtsegasaX'aphulaXthob pa ma yin no/ /phanaXtshun bsnol dang bsnor ba dang / /dus bsnur zhib bsnur mjug ma bsnar/ /de dag ba 'og sar btags bsna/ /chu yi rba rlabs gsang ba'i sba/ /mgul rgyan lba gsum rim bzhin du/ /ra sa la yi 'og tu gdags/ /nor med sprang dang sprang rtsi dang / /lha yi sprul dang gdug sprul dang 4 /lag pa'i spar mo meXsogs sbar/ /mdzes pa'i spa dang gsang ba'i sba/ /phung por spungs/ dang dam bca'i spungs/ /me gso'i spra dang dadub bya'i spra/ /rgyan gyis spud dang me chas spud/ /(spud pa lta bu)rin chen spug dang phug gi srug /lhang bzed kha spub spu gu'i spubs/ /thags kyi spun dang shun pa'i spun/ /gnas das spags dang 'dres pa'i sbags/ /nyes pa spangs dang rta sbangs rnams/ /rim bzhin sde ba bzhi ba yi/ /dang po gsum pa'i pa bar bri/ /sngon chad nor ba mang snang bas/ /da nas ma nor bri ba gces/ /spa dbyug sba dbyug gnyis ka rung / /'di ni gdam nga ma yin zhing / /shing rigs so so'i ming yinaXno/ /rgyas paraXmatha' dpyod skabs su 'chad/ /lus sbrid nyis sbrags ra mda' sgon/ /'di yang sde ba bzhi ba yi/ /wa ru 'bod rgyu'i ba yig yin/ /rmeg med gong rmed bal rmel rnams/ /ra yig klad du bkur ba'i ma/ /dris pa'i rmed ni ra rmed yin/ /'dri byed smed ni sa smed do/ /sme sha can yang de bzhin no/ 1btsog pa'i dme ni das 462

'phul can/ /gzhan la smodapa sa mgo can/ /dmod pa'ador ba da yis 'phul/ /munapa'i smag ni sa mgo can/ /'thab pa'i dmag ni da yis 'phul/ /bu mo'i mag pa mag rkyang ngo / /gzhan la bka' stsal sa stsal yin/ /lus kyi rtsal stobs ra rtsal lo/ /de bzhin nga da cig sa nga yin/ /'bad rtsol rtsol sogs ra rtsol lo/ /dag yig gces bsdus 'khrul sgong legs bshad skya rengs gsar ba las mgocan la 'khrul ba spong ba'ile'u dang ༷po'o//smras pa/ (rigs pa'i rgyu)mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bshes gnyen dam pa mchog /bsam dang sbyor bas bsted tshul ma log pas/ /tshul 'di 'chad dang rtsom la 'jug pa la/ /'tsher med spra ba'i sgobs pa gzengs su mtho/ /(gzurgas can gyigazugs can)legs bshad rdzing du chu skyes dga'atshal 'dir/ /blo gsal ngang mo ra yig gnyis pa'i tshogs/ /mi shes dri 'khrud sprang rtsi 'thung bzhin du/ /rtsed 'jo'i 'phur lding rol bas dus 'da' rigs/ /(rab spel)slob dpon thu mi'i dgongs pa ji bzhin pa/ /bdag gi blo dang yid gcugasamadza' ba 'di/ /rgyal brnams kyi thugs rje zhags pa'i 'od/ /'gro bami gtong dam por 'khyud pa bzhin/ /(chos dpe)bong ba gser gzigasachags bral skye bo la/ /mnyam gzhag ro sbong nyid las gzhan yod min/ /de bzhin yig don dpyod pa'i gtam de las/ /bdag la bya ba cung zad yod ma yin/ /zhes pa ni b.raXskabs kyi tshigs su bcad 463

pa'o/ /da ni 'dogs can bshad pa la/ /chu sogs skyomasaXpa ka sder gtogs/ /ngom pa'i spyoms ni pa sder gtogs/ /de bzhin zas sgyugs bskrad pa'i sgyugs/ /chu dang mtsho sogs bskyil ba dang / /khang chung spyil bu la sogs pa/ /sdebaXgacig bri na shin tu nor/ /dus bzhi'i dbyar ni ba yig yin/ /brnyan po'i g.yar ni ya yig go /'thab mo 'gyed la ga yig bri/ /mdzod sgo 'byed ni ba yig ga /gyen du 'phyur la pha yig bri/ /sgyur khu 'khyur baXkha yig go /de bzhin nor ba'i 'phyugs pa dang / /glog 'od 'khyugaXpa shes par bya/ /ltogs pa'i bkres dang na tshod bgres/ /yi ge so sor thob pa yin/ /mtshon cha'i gri ni gaXgri yin/ /snaXyul dri ni da dri'o/ /lam rgyus 'grul ba ga 'grul yin/ /de bzhin nas gro snga dro dang / /zas snodaXgrod dang lus kyi drod/ /'akyel ba'i 'gred dang dud 'groX'adred/ /dngar bsgrigs gral dang ral ba'i dral/ /brtsi bya'i grangs dang gdan drangs sogs/ /tshig don gnyis ka mi 'dra zhing / /mdza' ba'i grogs ni ga grogs yin/ /khur bo'i drogs ni da drogs so/ /grogs dang 'grogasaXkyang zhed nas 'drogs/ /zhes pa lta bu 'phul thob pa'i/ /skabs kyang yod pa shes dgos so/ /mtshungs pa'i rigs 'gre ga 'gre yin/ /gnod byed 'dre dang ches tha dad/ /chig thub chig stong la sogs la/ /tsa rtags 'dogs pa ma yin no/ /'khrungs pa'i bskrun dang 'gran pa'i bsgrun/ /rgyal pos bkrabs 464

dang thun gyis brab/ /de dag so sor shes dgos so/ /gaXgril thum gyis gril ba'i ming / /da dril gcig tu dril ba'i ming / /klan ka klad pa kla klo dang / /'byams klas bklag bya klog pa dang / /klag cor chu klung gos klubs rnams/ /sde ba dang po'iXdang por bri/ /nam mkha'i glog dang kha gdangs glal/ /glags lta glags rnyed glum bcos dang / /gtam gleng gling bzhi glos phab nyal/ /glegs bam sgo glegs la sogs pa/ /sde ba dang po'i gsum par bri/ /de phyir klu gnyan glu snyan rnams/ /yig don gnyis ka gtan mi gcig /dba' klong ngag sgron dgongs pa yin/ /gzhan du rba glong mang zhig snang / /gdam nga yin min brtag par bya/ /'dzar ba'i rlug ni ra rlug yin/ /ldugs pa'i blugs ni ba blugs so/ /rkang bsaXglebs dang gnas su sleb/ /ma 'dres so sor dbye bar bya/ /bablums ni tshogs pa bskrums pa'i ming / /bsdum ni 'gyed pa bsdum pa'i ming / /des na dbyen bsdum mchod rten la/ /dbyen bablums mchod rten brisaXkyang 'thad/ /lag sor rlum la lag ldum zer/ /de phyir de gnyis tha dad do/ /bcwa lnga bcwa brgyad ces 'og tu/ /ba yig 'dogs pa mi 'thad de/ /rgyu mtshan gzhan du 'chad par 'dod/ /des na rna ru can du bri/ /dag yig gces bsdus 'khrul spong legasaXpar bshad pa skya rengs gsar ba las 'dogs can gyi 'khrul ba spong ba'i le'u gnyis pa'o//sprus pa/ (rab rtogadape)lus can dbang du sdud pa'i 'phrin las kyi/ /466

byed po nga zhes yongs 'du'i dbang bo khyod/ /nga rgyal mchog gi mtha'aXl ci ste 'dzeg /gtam gsar 'disaXkyang mkhas mngaXsdud la ltos/ /(phreng ba'i gsa' byed)chos rgyal mes pos yi ge bzos pa'i mthus/ /skad gnyis smra rnams dam chos legs par bsgyur/ /de yis klog pa thos bsam 'khoraXlo ste/ /klog pas lung rtogs bstan pa nyams med 'phel/ /(dngos po'i dpe) kha drag dpung gis 'phrog par mi nus pa'i/ /klu dbang gtsug gi nor bu rin chen ltar/ /gtam bzang 'di yang bem chos rang bzhin gyi/ /gser dngulaXrin chen zong gis nyo bya min/ / (gtan tshigs kyi ldog pa can) mchan dang sdom bsdus 'bru non rgyas bsngus sogs/ /legs par bshad pa'i dag yig mi nyung mod/ /mtha' dpyod rigs pas dag ther med pa'i phyir/ /legs bshad gsar ba 'di las cung zad dman/ /zhes pa ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /da ni 'phul yig bshad pa la/ /'phul yig lnga bo de las ni/ /ga da ba yi sngon 'jug gsum/ /bya byed dbang gis thob pa dang / /'dor dgos zabs sogs shin tu mang / /ming du grub pa'i rigs rnams la/ /rang rang sngon 'jug rgyun du gces /de phyir 'dir yang ming rkyang tsam/ /'ga' zhig brjod kyi mtha' dag min/ /de la ga yis 'phul yig ni/ /sum cu'i cu ni cuXrkyang yin/ /'khyog po'i gcu ni ga yis 'phul/ /de bzhin cal col gcal tu bkram/ /de'i tshig bla dwags ming gis gdags/ /long yod dal 466

dang khyab gdal dang / /sdom pa nod dang gzhan la gnod/ /rang bzhin nag po shin tu gnag /'das pa'iXzhig pa brtag gzhig dang / /lus zungs dras drub gzungs('dul ba las dra'o drub bo gzungs btab bo ltaXbu'o)btab dang / /lo snying yos dang zas g.yos dang / /sems yengs pa dang rnam g.yeng dang / /yung nga dang ni g.yung drung dang / /mig gi yul dang g.yul sprod g.yul/ /khangaXba'i mda' yab dbub bya'i g.yabs/ /mdun du shog dang 'dab gshog dngaX/ /lag nas shor dang dbu skra gshor/ /nyug rum sgos nyug gnyug ma'i sems/ /shis brjod bkra shis gshis lugs dang / /kha dog ser dang rin chenaXgaser/ /sog po'i mi la gsog rdzus med/ /de rnams 'phul yig med pa dang / /yod pa'i tshul kyi sa bon tsam/ /gzhan yang gcom skrungs gdags sribs dang / /gshog rtsal gshol mda' g.ya' gsang dang / /mig g.yor mnyes gshin snyun gdangs dang / /drin gzo gcan gzan sbas gsang sogs/ /gas 'phul ming mtha'aXbarjod mi lang / /lan cig thang cig kha cig dang / /lhan cig skad cig thabs cig dang / /cig car cig shos rnams la ni/ /ga yis 'phul yig dor bar bya/ /de bzhin nyis (nyis rim)'gyur nyisaXldab dang / /nyis brgya sum brgya sum cu yang / /'phul med bri ba'i srol yod do/ /da ni das 'phul bshad pa la/ /glang chen thal kar dkar chag dang / /klad kor pad kor dkor rdzas dang / /bya gag dang ni dgag dbye dang / /467

zur gyi grwa dang gnod byed dgra/ /ri yi ngos dang dngos po dang / /lto ba'i pang dang gzu dpang dang / /spos kyi pog dang rjes su dpog /shing bal dang ni me dbal dang / /'jal byed bre dang btsog pa'i dbre/ /'gor ba'iXdul dang bkren pa'i dbul/ /dbang bo'i migaXdang buXga'i mig /rgyud mangs dang ni dmangs rigs dngaX/ /'bri yi mar dang kha dog dmar/ /gzhan yang zho dkrugs rol moXdakrol/ /dka' thub dgung sngon dpya khral dang / /dpyis phyin dpungaXchung la sogs pa/ /gzhan du shes par bya ba mang /da ni bas 'phul bshad par bya/ /thob skal chags 'jika bskal ba dang / /ro kha skrur dang rgyab tu bskyur/ /skur ba 'debs dang yig bskur dang / /sgos kyi don dang bag chags bsgos/ /lus kyiXrgyab dang dbyug pa brgyab/ /dregs pas rgyags dang brgyags bye dang / /drung gi gam dang tshod bgam dang / /snod kyi sgam dang zab pa'i bsgam/ /spyang po'i sgrin dang 'gran pa'i bsgrin/ /mkhas pa'i grung po rnyog ma bgrungs/ /sum cu dang ni bzhi bcu dang / /drug cu dang ni lnga bcu dang / /bdun cu dang ni dgu bcuXdang / /brgyad cu dang ni skyogs kyis bcu(ma'ongs pa)/ /lag pa'i rjes dang phan tshun brjes/ /bkur bzo'i rjed dang bskrud pa'i brjed/ /ston mongs (nyon mongs kyi byed las)dang ni bsnyon 'dor dang / /snyung ngur byas dang bsnyung gzhi dang / /snyad 'dogs pa dang bshad pa'i bsnyad/ /mi 'gyur 46mi

rtag dang brtag dpyad dang / /dbang po rtul dang brtul zhugs dang / /gnas spu rtol dang rnag khrag brtol/ /sdigs mdzub dang ni gzhan la bsdigs/ /khang ba'i sdum dang 'gyed pa bsdum/ /gzhi yi rten dang de la brten/ /mtshan ma'i rtags dang kun brtags dang / /mang ja'i dod dang 'bur du bdod/ /skar ming snar ma mjug ma bsnar/ /rgyu mtshan rtsad gcod brtsad cing dri/ /rtsed mo rtse dang snying brtse dang / /rdzus te skyes dang khro bor brdzus/ /mig ya zhar dang skra bzhar dang / /mi zad pa dang mi bshad pa('jigs su rung ba)/ /rkang rjes shul dang lam gyi bshul/ /nyes pa sel dang bsel ma(skyelama'iming )dang / /rmugs gnyid sangs dang skyo bsangs dang / /rigs rgyud gdung rgyud 'phul med kyang / /snyanaXbargyud bla brgyud ba yis 'phul/ /lo rgyus lam rgyus 'phul med kyang / /phreng brgyus skud brgyus 'phul thob bo/ /mig gis ltos shig 'akul med kyang / /bltos sa bltos 'jog 'phul thob bo/ /bkur ste'i ste la 'phul med kyang / /bste stang bsnyiXl 'phul thob dgos/ /gzhan yang spa bkongaXbargyad bkag dang / /bka' bkyod sdug bsngal rnam par sbos/ /zhabs kyis bcags dang phan tshun bsdur/ /bzhams bsgo la sogs mtha' med pas/ /gsung rab dag pa rnams la ltos/ /da ni mas 'phul cung zad bshad/ /phying ba'i gur dang mgur bzhengs dang / /dregs pas ngar dang ro mngar dang / /gshis ka ngan la mngan bgrang dang / /gri gug chan pa mchan khung dngaX/ /rgyal 469

po'i chad pa dur gyi mchad(ro sgam la yang 'jug)/ /ji bzang je dga' pho mtshan mji/ /nyes pasaXnyen dang reg bya mnyen/ /steng nas thur dang srab kyi mthur/ /tshos kyi kha dog mdog mdangs dang / /nan tan byed dang 'og tu mnan/ /thams cad tshang dang skyon gyi mtshang / la mchu ra mda' ra mnye la/ /rjes 'jug dor nas sngon 'jug sbyor/ /gzhan yang mkhal rked mkhrang mkhregs dang / /mgal dum mgron po mngon sum dang / /mche ba mchil ba mchis brang dang / mi mjed zhing dang thugs mnyes dang / rgya mthongs mtha' mthil me mda' dang / /mna' ma mnal gzims na bza' mnabs/ /driXm mnam dang mtshun lha dang / /khyem mtshes mtshe ma mtsher sa dang / /mdzub mo malas pa'i mdzangs la sogs/ /rgya cheraXyod paXgazhan las shes/ /da ni 'as 'phul bshad par bya/ /dgun 'bab khang dang gzhan la 'khang / /gzhib bya'i khu ba gzhan laX'akhu/ /khrab rmog gyon nas bro gar 'khrab/ /drung gi gan dang 'gan 'khur dang / /sa yi gong bu sems mi 'gong / /brtsi bya'i grangs dang lto 'grangs dang / /sde tshan gras dang zhe 'gras dang / /nyi ma'i grib ma 'phel 'grib dang / /rig pa grim dang 'grim 'grul dang / /dkar yol chag dang 'chag sar 'chag /sna cham phog dngaX'achams lu kon/ /chom rkun jag pa rtsa 'jag ma/ /me yiXthab dang 'khrug pa'i 'thab/ /ring min thung dang skom skyems 'thung / /lan cig thengs 470

dang rkang ba 'pheng / /song ba'i dong dang 'gro ba'i 'dong / /rgya yi dra ba mtshungs pa'i 'dra/ /mo ba phya mkhan 'phya smod dngaX/ /lto ba'i phang dang khri 'phang(so 'phang dbu 'phang bogs)rnams/ /rnaXrgyan phyang phrul rnam 'phrul dang / /phyugs rji dang ni nor ba'i 'phyugs/ /lag pa phyi dang dus 'phyi ba/ /song ba'i byer dang 'gro ba'i 'byer/ /gtam gyi tshig dang me yis 'tshig /rgyal ba'i tshab dang skyin pa 'tshab/ /gzhan yang 'khru sar 'khren pa dang / /'khyags rom snyim 'khyor 'khobs pa(khyabapa'i don)dang / /'chums dang 'chel dang khas 'ches dang / /ser sna'i 'jungs dang bzhabs pa'i 'jabs/ /'jim pa'i 'ji ba zhi 'gyur 'jil/ /rtsaX'ajing mtsho 'jing grogasaXsu 'thams/ /mgo 'thom shing 'drud mda' 'phenaXdang / /nam 'phang go 'phang 'bri dang 'brong / /tshe 'byid ca 'byid 'byangs(spyang ba sbyong ba mthar phyin pa'i ming )'byongs dang / /gral du 'tshang dang longs pa'i 'tshar/ /'od 'tsher blo 'tshengs snod 'dzed dang / /chud 'dza' 'dzad 'gyur nor ba'i 'dzol/ /'du 'dzi phan tshun 'dzings la sogs/ /shes paraXbya ba mtha' yas so/ /'dir ni sa bon tsam bkod kyi/ /gzhan dgaXgazhan las shes par bya/ /dag yig gces bsdus 'khrul spong legs par bshadaXpa skya rengs gsar ba las 'phul can gyi 'khrul ba sgong ba'i le'u gsum pa'o/smras pa/ ('os shing mi 'os pa'i don sazhad bkod pa) bod gzhung chen po'i 471

dgongs don dpyad dka' mod/ /yi ge tsam gyi don ni ci ste dka'/ /bag chags srab pa'i rigs la de 'os shing / /sngon sbyangs las 'phro can laXm yin no/ /(gzhi gcig gi byed pa 'ab/la ba)tshulaX'adi mkhas pa'i spyan la thogs gyur na/ /shes 'dod don la blo skyed mang du 'phel/ /'gran sems can gyis bltas tshe sems 'khrugs nas/ /sngar shes yon tan dag kyang nyams par 'gyur/ /(bstod pa'i mtshungs sbyor) zla bas dga' skyed nyi mas gsal bar byed/ /lho rlung bsil ster lung gi bstan pa yang / /'gro ba'i phan bde sgrub byed yin no zhes/ /yid la brnag ste tshogs gsum zhib tu sbyangs/ /(smad pa'i mtshungs sbyor)sgyu ma'i na chungaXri mo'i mar me dang / /shog bus bzos pa'i bcos ma'i me tog dang / /blun pos bsgrigs pa'i dag yig sdom tshig sogs/ /mig sngar mdzes kyang dgos don bslu ba mang / /zhes pa ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /da ni 'phul can nang phan tshun/ /cung zad nor 'khrul bshad par bya/ /dri zhim bda' ba ba yis 'phul/ yod pa'i gda' ni ga yis 'phul/ /de bzhin gtugs bsher rlan gyi gsher/ /bza' ba bzas zin brdeg par gzas/ /chang gis bzi dang nor bu gzi/ /chos gos bzo dang bka' drin gzo/ /bsran thub bzod dang da gzod dang / /bya ba bshol dang thong gshol dang / /gsol ba'i bzhes dang bzhugs pa'i gzhes/ /gzhu rgyud bdung dang rus kyiXgadung / /sa dmar btsag dang khrag gtar gtsag /sprun 472

nas bsus dang gsus pa sbo/ /thub pa'i btub dang dum dur gtub/ /skyogs kyis bcus dang 'khyog por gcus(redasapa)/ /gzhan yang bzhon paXn tshod gzhon/ /rta la zhon pa zhon rkyang ngo / /gri yis shing bzhogs gzhogs slong dang / /dus snga'i zhogs pa zhogs rkyang ngo / /rlan gyi bzha' dang 'ja' tshonaXgazha'/ /zha bo'i zhwa mo zha rkyang ngo / /mar khu bzhu dang gnam ru'i gzhu/ /'tshams zhu byed paXzhu rkyang ngo / /'jib pa'i bzhibs dang bsgrigs pa'i gzhibs/ /zhib tu dpyod pa zhib rkyang ngo / /grang ba'i bsil dang dum bur gsil/ /rol mo sil snyan sil rkyang ngo / /zhim pa'i dri bsung rgyal ba'i gsung / /rul ba'i sung ni sung rkyang ngo / /bdug spos bdug dngaXgadug pa can/ /gsod byed dug ni dug rkyang ngo / /spungs pa'i bcir dang lus gcer dang / /skra med spyi ceraXcer rkyang ngo / /bser du'i rlung dang rin chen gser/ /kha dog ser bo ser rkyang ngo / /'khar gsil yin gyi mkhar bsil min/ /kha gsag yin gyi kha bsag min/ /ne'u gsing yin gyi ne'u bsing min/ /gsog 'jog 'thad kyi bsog 'jog nor/ /tsha gsur 'thad kyi tsha bsur nor/ /lus gsig yin gyi lus bsig min/ /bshang lam yin gyi gshang lam 'khrul/ /sku gzhogs 'thad kyi sku bzhogasaXmin/ /de yis ba dang gas 'phul ba'i/ /dbye bsresaXcung zad 'byed nus so/ /gzhan yang 'khos chung mkhos phab dang / /mgul nas 'khyud dang dpe mkhyud dang / /rgya mtsho'i 'jing dang ske yi mjing / /thog ma'i 'go dang lus kyi mgo /kayo 473

ba'i 'gul dang mgrin pa'i mgul/ /zad 'gyur 'dzad dang zhe sa'i mdzad/ /lag rten 'khar ba rdzong btsan mkhar/ /gtan gyi 'dun ma drung gi mdun/ /blo yis 'jal dang bla mar mjal/ /smad 'tshong 'judaX'athun mdza' ba'i mthun/ /gralaXdu 'tshang dang skyon gyi mtshang / /nor ba'i 'dzol dang mdzol bu(ri dwags 'dzin pa'i thabs)dang / /nang du 'jug dang rjes ma'i mjug /'ching byed dang ni mching bu dang / /rnyi las 'chor dang rgyan gyis mchor/ /bya ba 'tshar dang ngo mtshar dang / /chud 'dza' ba dang mthun pa'i mdza'/ /dri ma 'dag 'gyur me mdag dang / /'thing slad smra dang bya mthing ril/ /'tshog chas lus kyi mtshog ma dang / /tshong ba'i 'gron po 'bod rgyu'i mgrod/ /don med gron canaXgron rkyang ngo / 1shes pa'i 'tshal dang tshon rtsi'i mtshal/ /nags tshal skyed tshal tshal rkyang ngo / /yun ring 'tsho dang chu yi mtsho/ /dar bab lang tsho tsho rkyang ngo / /nyi 'od 'tsher zhing las la mtsher /shing gi tsher ma tsher rkyang ngo / /zas rigs snum 'khur za 'gram mkhur/ /rgyabaXtu khur ba khur rkyang ngo / /'du ba'i sa la 'dun saXzer/ /mdun gyi sa dang khyad par che/ /gzhan yang gang 'tshamaXblo dang 'tsham/ /'tshams zhu byed pa 'a yis 'phul/ /bar mtshams thun mtshams phyogs mtshams dang /sa mtshams nying mtshams sbyor ba rnams/ /ma yis 'phul zhes kho bos smra/ /kha cig de las ldog ste smra/ /gang 'thad mkhas pas brtag par byung/ /dag yig gces bsdus 'khrul sgong legs bshad skya rengs gsar ba las 'phulaX474

yig phan tshun la 'khrul ba spong ba'iXle'u bzhi ba'o//smras pa/ (sngon med bstus brjod)tsha gdung sel ba'i bsil zer mi spro zhing / /pad dkar tshogs kyang rnam par 'byed byed pa'i/ /kye ma ri dwags kyis mdzes zla ba ni/ /nag po'i phyogs la rim gyis 'grib par 'gyur/ /(rab rtob mi/ dpe)thub bstan lang tsho'i 'phel 'grib mtshonaXpa'i ched/ /zla khyod gom pa skyed la brel mi dgos/ /lam bzang lung ston tshogs gsum dag pa'i gzugs/ /phyogs 'dir nub pa la yang de yod phyir/ /(bsdus pa'i dpe)deng gi bstan pa mar ngo bcu bzhi ba'i/ /zla ba'i 'phel dang 'dra zhes bshung ba 'di/ /dran dbang nub paXgacig pus mtshungs pa min/ /bstan rtsa yig srol nyams pa 'dis kyang ngoX/ /(de nyid brjod pa'i dpe)yi ge 'di ni ming yin sgron meXmin/ /mig yangs stob byed yin gyi dmigs bu min/ /bslab gzhi yon tan ma lus slob pa yang / /brtson 'grus ma yin yi ge'i drin kho na/ /zhes pa ni bar skabs kyi tshigasaXsu bcad pa'o/ /da ni rjes 'jug bshad par bya/ /rjes 'jug bcu las da sa gnyis/ /yang 'jugaXyin zhing lhag ma brgyad/ /rjes 'jug tsam gyi tha snyad bya/ /'dir ni sa yi 'jug tshul bshad/ /gzhan dag zhar las shes par bya/ /skye 'gyur skye la sa mtha' dbyi/ /skyes zin skyes la sa mtha' sbyor/ /de bzhin so skye skyes bu dang / /'khri shing dang ni tshig 'khris dang / /chung min che dang yid ches dang / /mda' rten gzhu dang lcag gis gzhus/ /gser gyi ri dang 476

ris su bor/ /lcags kyi btsa' dang zhing gi btsas/ /skungasaXpa'i gzha' dang glu len gzhas/ /bya ba'i bgyi dang byas pa'i bgyis/ /gnyen gyi sru mo nas kyi srus/ /de bzhin rgyu dang lo rgyus dang / /skyabs su mchi dang yod pa'i mchis/ /thugs rje chos rje zhabs rjes dang / /nye ring nye du nyes pa dang / /gnod byed 'dreXdang mnyam bsres 'dres/ /yul gyi gzhi dang gzhis ka dang / /danu rgod dmu dang dmus long dang / /'dzin spyad yu ba bden pa'i yus/ /srog chags byi ba byis pa chung / /grangs kyi bye ba byes su 'gro/ /tshe ring tshe dang zla tshes dang / /mnyam skyes mtshe ma khyim mtshes dang / /rma rigs mdze dang legs pa'iXmadzes/ /de dag sa mtha' med pa dang / /yod pasaXrab tu phye ba yin/ /dag yig gces bsdusaX'akhrul spongaXlegs bshad skya rengs gsar ba las sa mtha' yod med la 'khrul ba sgongaXba'i le'u lnga ba'o//smras pa/ (mchog ginges bstan)ji snyed shes bya tshogs gsum rnam dag gis/ /rab tu gsal bar byed pa mtshon slad du/ /nam mkha'i nor bu 'od stong rab bkye ste/ /gling bzhi'i nun pa sel ba'i snang baX'adzin/ /(snga nas med pa'i rgyu)rig pa'i gnas 'di sbyang rin med ces dor/ /mkhas par ma dris the tshom yongs ma bsal/ /bslab paraX'os pa ma sbyangs skyes bu 'ga'/ /blun po'i go sa thob 'di skal ba phra/ /(rgyu'i gzugs can)'di ni don la dkri phyir dmigs bu ste/ /thar lam dam par bsu phyiraXgrogs kyi 476

mchog /mkhas rnams mguXbaXbaskyed pas skyes kyi phul/ /ma dag rnyog ma bgrungaXphyir ke ta ka /'e/sa pa ni b.raXskabs kyi tshigasaXsu bcad pa'o/ /da ni yang 'jug bshad par bya/ /spyang bo'i grung dang rnyog ma grungs/ /nyin zhag tshil zhag 'ching byed zhags/ /zhing las so nam bsod nams dang / /nad ro drag dang thal ba'i drags/ /tshig gi gtam dang byur bur gtams/ /go 'phang dang mi mda' rdo 'phangs/ /'phong skyen dang ni lus smad 'phongs/ /thung min ring dang brel ba'i rings/ /lngid med yang dang rgya che'i yangs/ /migaXgis mthong dang nam mkha'i mthongs/ /thun mong dang niXnyon mongs dang / /khom pa'i long dang tshad longs pa/ /'khrig pa spyod dang dud sprin 'khrigs/ /khong du chud dang khongs su gtogs/ /gtam gyi tshig dang tshigs(gtan tshigs lhu tshigs dus tshigs kyang )bcad dang / /bu ga'i khung dang 'byung khungs(khungs btsunayang )dang / /shan 'byed gzu dpang mtho ba'i dpangs/ /gnyis kyi zung dang lus kyi zungs/ /'gro 'ong las dang ma 'ongs dus/ /spang ljongs dang ni nyes pa spangs/ /khang rul shig dang mi shigs khams/ /rinaXchen mchong dang 'obs la mchongs/ /gom stabs gom dang 'byangs pa'i goms/ /btung bya'i chang dang zan changs dang / /grong khyer grong dang shi ba'i grongs/ /lus pa'i lhag dang mdun du lhags/ /grog ma ngam grog mched grogs dang / /me yi thab dang thabs shes thabs/ /sang nyin sang zhogs gnyid las sangs/ /phyin ci log dang logs 477

su bkar/ /g.yo med drang dang gzhan du drangs/ /khang chung dogaXpor chud kyis dogs/ /gdeng thob gdeng dang ral gri gdengs/ /dras drub tshem dngaXzhal gyi tshems/ /las su rung dang ma rungs pa/ /snad kyi gzhong ba ljongs kyi gzhongs/ /sga ser yung ba yungs kar dang / /rtogs dka'i zab dang gting ring zabs/ /bsil ba'i grang dang brtsi bya'i grangs/ /rus pa'i rtsib dang 'khor lo'i rtsibs/ /mkhar gyi rdzong dang 'bul ba'i rdzongs/ /so yi dregaXdang rgyags pas dregs/ /skas kyi gdang dang skad kyi gdangs/ /largaXpa'i phyag dang rdul phyags dang / /bu ga'i dmig dngaXblo yis dmigs/ /maṇ+ḍal tshom bu khang ba'i tshoms/ /chu yi chab dang chabs cig dang / /kha dog nag dang nagasaXtshal nags/ /tsher ma'i rtsang dang rtsangs(srob chags)pa dngaX/ /bran gyi g.yog dang gos kyis g.yogs/ /dkar yol chag dang 'jig rten chags/ /lus bzur skyog dang g.yar bu'i skyogs/ /rta skul lcag dang khro rigs lcags/ /stsal ba'i gnang dang dus kyi gnangs/ /khang ba'i thog dang gtugs pa'i thogs/ /phyug po dang ni phyugs rdzi dang / /chu bo'i rab dngaXskyes rabs dang / /zhig rgyu'i 'jig dang skrag pa'i 'jigs/ /lhun po'i lhog dang blo yis lhogs/ /gdug pa can dang nyin mo'i gdugs/ /rgyang ring grags pa'i gad rgyangs dang / /tshad ma'i gzhung dang yid gzhungs dang 1 /da dung 'dod yon sred pas dungs/ /rus kyi gdung dang tsha bas gdungs/ /za ba'i kham dang sa yi khams(lams gsum khams bde 478

sogs)1 /shub bur smra dang gri yi shubs/ /steraXba'i stob dang rtsal gyi stobs/ /chang gi sbang ma rta yi sbangs/ /brjid pa'i rngam dang 'thug po'i rngams(ha cang rngams srog la rngams kyang )/ /bya yi glag dang glags lha'i glags/ /bragaXgi phug dngaXgatan gyi phugs/ /sha gzug gcig dang dbyibs kyi gzugs/ /phrad pa'i thugaXdang lha yi thugs/ /rdzas nor sog dngaXsdud tshigaXsogs/ /skyin pa 'tshab dngaXblo 'tshabs dang / /nom pa lag pas noms nyug byed/ /dma' ba'i gshong dang spang gshongs(spang ljongs)dang / /yul gyi mtha' 'khob khyab pa'i 'khobs/ /stom las byed dang btang stoms dang / /bste stang byed dang lta stangs dang / /zas kyi mnab rtsal na bza'aXmanabs/ /grangs kyi stong dang zad zin stongs('khor ba stongs grong khyer stongs)/ /yi ge'i tsheg dang dka' tshegs(phradatshegs kyang )dang / /chu nang bying dang byings na gnas/ /rim pa bzhin dang go rims dang / /rtsig pa'i 'gram dang 'grams tshad rims/ /bong bu lus kyi bongs tshod dang / /pad+ma'i 'dab( 'dab gshog kyang )dang ri yi 'dabs/ /'chag sar 'chag dang nyes pa 'chags/ /khye'u phrug dang zung gi phrugs(snam bu'i phrugs dang za phrugs sogs)/ /phyi yi nang dang sang nangs dang / /rta rmig srog chags rmigs pa dang / /spyoms pa'i ngom dang tshim pa'i ngoms/ /srub thag srub shing yid srubs dang / /thig le chu thigs gtegs pa dang / /de la rag las phra rags(chu yirags kyang )sogs/ /gab na yang nyam nga nyam thag(nyam dma' yang )la/ /479

yang 'jug 'dor zhing nyams len dang / /nyams dga' nyams stsong gar dgu'i nyams/ /pham pas nyams(bsod nyams kyang)pa la sogs la/ /yang 'jug nan gyis bcug dgos so/ /gzhan yang skyigs bu mgyogs pa dang / /ming gdags blugs gzar gzhogs stegs dang / /myun sribs srol 'dzugs la sogs pa'i/ /ming la sa mtha' rgyun du dgos/ /rgyas par shes rab 'od zer dang / /kun grol grags pa'i yang 'jug mtha'i/ /thob tshul rab gsal sgron me zung / /zhib tu gzigs shig blo ldan tshogs/ /dag yig gces bsdusa'akhrul spong legs bshad skya rengs gsarab las sa mtha'i yang 'jug la 'khrul ba spong ba'i le'u drug pa'o//smras pa/ (chos la bston dor gyi rgyan)gangs can yi ge bcu phrag gsum tsam zhes/ /bshung ba'i skadangan sgrog la ya ma brla/ /chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong ston nus phyir/ /bod kyi yi ge'i grangs la mtha'amed do/ /(phan tshun dpe)yi ge'i 'jug tshul phamatha' mi mngon zhing / /rin chen 'byung gnas srid zheng bsam lasa'adas/ /chusrin grongagi rgya nga ji bzhin du/ /gsar rnying brdayi 'jugatshul 'byams klas so/ /(ngo mtshar phul byung)sngon rjes 'jug pa 'dra min sna tshogs pa/ /kun mang gyis kyang gzhal bar dka' ba de/ /dus mthar skyes pa'i bdag gi blo yul du/ /gu dog med par shong ba.e ma mtshar/ /(gzhi gcika gilas 'gal ba)phyogs ris can dag 'di 'dra mthong tsam nas/ /'gran sems phrag dog phan tshun dkrugs pa'i 480

mthus/ /shugs chen me la lde baXm yin yang / /lus kyi drod ni yang dag 'bar bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//bya byed dus gsum sogs kyis dbang / /yang 'jug thobaXdang mi thob pa'i/ /rnam gzhag shes rab 'od zer gyi/ /dag yig rab gsal sgron me ru/ /ches cher shin tu gsal yod pa/ /de la gzigs pas shes paraX'agyur/ /dag yig de ru ma chud pa/ /'ga' zhig 'di ru bshad kyi nyon/ /brtag bya (don)rtog byed brtags rtog cig /gzud bya(tshagasasu)'dzud byed btsud tshud cig /bsag bya(bsod nams)gsog byed bsags sog cig /bsnan bya(sdod kyi bar)snon byed bsnand snond cig /gzur bya (mtshon las)'dzur byed bzungad zurd cig /dbri bya (grangs kyi kha nas)bri byed phris phri zhig /gsoXbya(ngal)'tsho byed bsos sos shig /brngod bya(nas)jod byed brngos rngos shig /bza' bya(zas)za byed bzas zo zhig /dbyi bya(rimo)'byid byed phyis phyi zhig /sba bya (skyon)sbed byed sbas sbos shig /btso bya (sha)'tshod byed btsos tshos shig /ga nga ba ma'i rjes 'jug gi /yang 'jug rim pas bshad pa la/ ga /(mtshang)bsngog bya sngogs byed bsngogs sngogs shig(thag pas)bkyig bya 'khyegs byed bkyigs khyigs shig /dpag bya dpog byed dpags dpogs shig /(lces)bldag bya ldag byed bldags ldogs shig /(kaca)banog bya rdog byed brdogs rnogs shig /( ral ba)bsig bya gsig byed bsigs sigs shig ba /(yige)bskung bya spung byed bskungs 481

sbungs shig /btung bya 'thung byed 'thungs thungs shig /(gdan)gding bya 'ding byed btings tings shig 1(blo)sbyang bya sbyong byed spyangs sbyongs shig /(sbyin pa)gtang bya gtong byed btangaXthongs shig ba /(nyes pa)bcab bya 'chab byed bcabs chobs shig /(khu ba)gzhib bya 'jib byed bzhibs jibs shig /(mgrod lazas)bstab bya stob byed bstabs stob cig /(lonapa)bcib bya 'chib byed bcibs chibs shig /(rkang rjes)gsub bya sub byed bsubs subs shig /(lo)bsrub bya srub byed bsrubs srubs shig (kos)bltab bya lteb byed bltabs ltebs shig ma /(mtsho)bskyam bya skyom byed bskyams skyoms shig /(me tog)dgram bya 'grems byed bkrams grems shig /(gos kyis)btum bya 'thum byed btums thums shig /(kha)bsum bya sum (zum yang 'thad )byed btsums tshums shig /(gos)btsem bya tshem byed btsems tshems shig /(yeshesal)bstem bya stem byed bstems thim zhig /de lhar bya byed byas gsum gyi/ /tha ma'i tshig ni 'das tshig yin/ /'di la yang 'jug phal cher 'jug /skul tshig phal cher sngon 'jug med/ /yang 'jug sbyor dgos mang zhig yod/ /yang 'jug med pa'ang yod pas na/ /gong smos kha 'phangs dper brjod dang / /'dir yang cung zad bshad pas mtshon/ /dpag par bya ba mang mchis pas/ /rig pa rgya bkyed shes par 'tshal/ /dag yig gces bsdus 'khrulaXspong legs bshad skya rengs gsar ba las dus gsum gyi yang 'jug la 'khrul ba spong ba'i le'u bdun pa'o/ /482

smras pa/ ('akob pa'i gzugs can)gangs canaXming brda lhaXyi gos bzang 'di/ /blo gsar mde'u tsam gyis 'bigs dka' ba'i/ /sra zhing mkhregs pa'i reg bya 'dzin pas na/ /srab 'jam yang ba'i gos su brjod mi rigs/ /(bston dor gyi gzubs can) gtam 'di ming min glegs bam klog pa'i lce/ /yi ge ma yin legs nyes lta ba'i mig /tshig min zhus chen thub nges zhus dag pa/ /bstan bcos ma yin lam ston bshes gnyen no/ /(snga na medaXpa'i rgyu) rig gnas ma bslab mi shes ngang du 'phyan/ /dam pa ma bsten yang dag lam dang bral/ /rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi rtse dgas 'da' ba'i mi/ /rgas khar brang la sen mo 'debs par 'gyur/ /(bya ba thog gsal)'byed do nyin byed 'od kyis chu skye'i spubs/ /sked med chang gis sisgro wā ra'i kha/ /gser gyi lde chung bangaXmadzod btsan po'i sgo/ /legs bshadaX'adi yis sum rtags dka' ba'i gnad/ /('gogapa'i dpe)dag yig mang yang la la bsdus drags shing / /phal cher gzhan tshig bldab skyor byed pa mang / /'ga' zhig rang rang skad kyi shan 'dres pas/ /gsar bshad 'di dang 'gran zlar mi 'os so/ /zhes pa ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /da ni gdam nga can dag bri/ /(yige)'dri bar byed dang 'bri bar byed/ /skyon mtshang 'dru dang 'bruXbar byed/ /khung bu 'dru dang 'brud par byed/ /rigaXpa'i ral gris 'di bzhin bzhed/ /byams pa gling pas dgag par mdzad/ /kho bos bsam na rung ba 'dra/ /gan rkyal gan kyal gdam nga 483

yin/ /de bzhin mthol bshags 'thol bshags dang / /khong ba'i migamadongs mig ldongs dang / /gang ba'i gtams dang bltams pa dang / /skrag pa'i dngangs sbangs gnyis ka rung / /de bzhin snyanaXdangags snyan ngag dang / /mig pegrad mig bsgrad gang yang rung / /thur du 'dril bar byed pa dang / /'gril bar byed pa gnyis ka 'thad/ /dmigs kyis bkar dang dgar ba dang / /dmigs bsal dmigs gsal rung ba 'dra/ /dbyen bklums dbyen bsdum gang yang rung / /sngo bsangs sngo sangs gang yang rung / /gsar ba sar ba gangaXyang rung / /gzegs ma zegs ma gang yang rung / /'phreng ba phreng ba gang yang rung / /skad cig ska cig gang yang rung / /rmongs brtul rmongs rtul gang yang rung / /bder gshegs bde gshegs gang yang rung / /smyu gu spyi gu gang yang rung / /dma' 'bebs sma 'beb gang yang rung / /sgrim nas bag zon bya ba'i ming / /gzabs bzabs gnyis ka rung ba yin/ /gos bzangs khang bzangs dri bzangs dang / /rgyud mangs khur mangs go rims sogs/ /yangaX'ajug sbyor ram mi sbyor yang / /khyad med gdam nga yin no zhes/ /sngon gyi mkhas pa mang pos bzhed/ /rgyu mtshan ci yin ma go lags/ /dag yig ngag gi sgron me ru/ /mtho btsams pa dang mtho 'tshams dang / /las la mtsher dang 'tsher ba dang / /dri ma mnam dang bsnams pa dngaX/ /gnyis char byung bas rung bsam ste/ /kho bos gdam nga'i sdebs su bshad/ /rngams pa'i 'thug dang zhabasaXl 484

'thud/ /za ma tog tu 'as 'phul bshad/ /ngag gi sgron mer mas 'phul bshad/ /ngag sgron za ma tog gnyis kar/ /glo bur bshad kyang smra rgyan du/ /blo bur 'thad pa'i phyogs su mdzad/ /de dag gdam nga'am yang na ni/ /mi gtsang ming la btsog rtsog dang / /khar sang ming la kha rtsang dang / /'thug po mthug po zer ba dang / /'thud paXmathud pa zer ba dang / /glo bur blo bur zer ba'i gdangs/ /mngon sum sgrogs par snang ba bzhin/ /so so'i skad kyis bldab lugs sam/ /gdam nga yin min brtag par 'tshal/ /gces pa'i phangs dang dbul phongs la/ /'as 'phul yod med gnyis ka rung / /stongs grogs sdongs grogs gnyis ka rung / /gdam nga gdam ka zer ba dang / /lteng(yang 'jug chad dam)ka lhang ka zer ba'i tshig /ngag sgron rang du byung mod kyang / /gal te tshig de zhus dag na/ /slob dpon thu mi'i sum cu bar/ /mo yis mo yi ming mtha' drangs/ /zhes pa de dang mi 'gal lam/ /ci ltar yin zhes dpyad rigs so/ /dag yig gces bsdus 'khrul sgong legs bshad skya rengs gsar ba lasaXgadam nga can gyi rigs la 'khrul ba sgong ba'i le'u brgyad pa'o//smras pa/ (the tshom gyi dpe)dag yig rnams kyi yi ge mthun minaXde/ /byed po so so'i yul skad yin nam ci/ /yang na khyad med gdam nga yin pa'am/ /bdag gi yid ni the tshom dpyang thag 'dzin/ /(zla bo'i dngos dpe)dag yig mang yang ngag gi sgron me dang / /za ma tog dang dpe zlar 'os pa 485
