dkon/ /mkha' la 'od ldan rgyu skar mi nyung mod/ /mun snyug mthar byed nyi zla zung tsam mo/ /(rkang ba'i'i thog ma'i bar chod zung ldan)de phyir gzhan gyi lugs mang gzung dka' bas/ /de gnyis kho na tshad mar yid rton cing / /de la med pa'i gtam gsar 'ga' bsnan te/ /de yi gsal byed rgyan du 'di yang bskrun/ /(phulabyung gi dpe) slob dpon a nus yig srol thogaXmar phye/ /bdag niXdeng gi dus su bye ba tsam/ /de las gzhan pa'i khyad par 'byed chos zhig /mig stong ldan pa'i lhas kyang rnyed pa min/ /('os pa'i don gzhan bkod pa) yi ge tsam la dpyad pa zhib 'jug 'dis/ /bsam gtan pa yi rna baXsun par byed/ /snang zhen log pa'iXyid ngor kun rdzobaXchos/ /phalaXcher tsher mar rigs pa ma yin nam/ /(rigs kyi rang bzhin brjod pa)thos bral dben gnas bsten pa'i dka' thub pa/ /tshig skam kho nar zhen pa'iXrtog ge pa/ /de gnyis tshul 'dir dpyad pa bcug pa bas/ /snying las chung ngur gzhes na sos kyang bde/ /zhes pa ni bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /da ni ming gcig don gnyis la/ /'jug pa'i tshul la cung zad dpyad/ /ko ba mnyes dang dgyes pa'i mnyes/ /me tog mgo lhogs blo yis lhogs/ /stan las ldang dang tshad longs ldang / /bshad pa'i sgros (zer sgros lha bu)dang rma shul sgros/ /bzod pa'i brnag dang bsam pa'i brnag /rdog pas brdzis dang bag phye brdzis/ /bzhugs pa'i gzhes dang dus kyi gzhes/ /486

(bzhes nyin lta du)grangs kyi dkrigs dang dud sprin dkrigs/ /chab srid chab dang chu yi chab/ /phyags dar phyags dang lham gyi phyags(zhe tshig)/ /dud 'gro'i lci ba lcid kyi lci/ /bshul sha dang ni lam gyi bshul/ /ro zhim bda' dang ri dwags bda'/ /ri dwags gla dang rngan pa'i gla/ /yi chad dmyus byung dmus longaXdang / /chag bcom dkrugs('bras dkrugasalta bu)dang gong 'og dkrugs/ /rta yi srab dang 'thug min srab/ /rta yi srab skyogs gzar bu'i skyogs/ /khongs su gtogs dang se gol gtogs/ /nyin mo'i gdugs dang mchod rdzas gdugs/ /ro yi ska dang gar ba'i ska(thug pa chu nyung ba)/ /'jigs rung rngams dang 'thug po'i rngams/ /srog chags nya dang bco lnga'i nya/ /dras drub dra dang rgya yi dra/ /gtang rag de la rag las dang / /skya rbab dang ni rbabaXrdo dang / /'o brgyal sa la dran med brgyal/ /bsgo ba rnar gzonaXchud gzon dang / /rgyags pa'i longs dang tshad longs pa/ /gdong gi g.yar dang brnyan po'i g.yar/ /skra yi ral ba dral ba'i ral/ /dum bur gablol dang 'alar gsil dang / /chu mang ('thugapa)sla dang las sga ba/ /srog chags 'phyi ba dus 'phyi ba/ /lcags kyi btsa' dang mig ras btsa'/ /lusaXkyi brla dang ya ma brla/ /yi ge bri dang kha nas bri/ /khang ba'i thog dang rngo mi thog /rna yiXmanyan bya mnyan pa (grupa)dang / /g.yar po'i brnyas dang brnyasaXthabs byed/ /mtshon cha bsnams dngaXdri bsnams pa/ /thags kyi spun dang gnyen byi spun/ /ming gcig don mang la 'jug dpe/ /ngam grog chu grog487

grog ma dang / /phrag dog kha dog sa khongs dog /gzugs brnyan skra brnyanaphyag brnyan ('khor bayog)sogs/ /thor tshugs sha tshugs che tshugs dang / /sim gdung rus gdung gdung ma gdegs/ /'khrug long che long long skabs sogs/ /sgog gyur sgog mashog shal dang / /rtsalag kholag (rgya nga )'dzin byed lag /gzar stan ri gzar gzar bu dang / /na bza' bza' btung bza' mi dang / /g.yang sa g.yang gzhi g.yang lug sogs/ /bro brdungs ro bro bro 'tshal dang / /sga glo glo lud zur gyi glo/ /khal khral (bkal)sbud pabakal ba sogs/ /snyun gdangs skad gdangs kha gdangs sogs/ /glegs bam sgoglegs glegasabusogs/ /mu stegs gzhogs stegs stegs bu dang / /kun brtags brgal brtags brtags zin dang / /chu thigs gso thigs bdud rtsi thigs/ /mi gang sa gtsigs chemache ba gtsigs/ /gtams ni bcol grangs gang ba dang / /rgya ni rnyidang sma ra dang / /rgya gar rgya nag sogs la'o/ /dag yig gces bsdus 'khrul sgong legs bshad skya rengs gsar ba las ming gcig don du mar 'jug pa dpyod pa'i le'u dgu ba'o//smras pa/ (spyi'i bsdus brjod) skom pa'i gdung sel yan lag brgyad ldanapa'i/ /skal ldan shing rta'i du mo phyir bsal nas/ /ba nga khron chus skom gdung sel re mod/ /don med ngal ba bsten pa tsam du zad/ /('gal ba'i don sazhan bkod pa) 'ga' zhig rig pa gsal yangapha rol po'i/ yon tan 488

sgrib nas skyon gyi gong bur mthong / /lag na gsal byed mar meXthogs na yang / /snod kyi grib mas lag mthil nag por mthong / /(ngo bstodadape) sngon k+ṣe skad gnyis smra rnams sgra la mkhas/ /gsar rnying brda skad skye ba'i stobs kyes smra/ /kho bo gzabaXgashar yi ge chod tsam yin/ /brda don bshad tshul de dag dang ni mtshungs/ /(dpa' ba'inyams)bdag ni rig pa'iXganas la ma sbyangs shing / /gsar rnying brda dag khog dubs ma yin la/ /dag yig gzhung mang dpyis phyin mi shes par/ /rang dgar ming tshig spra ba'i rgyal poraXgyur/ /(bya ba ma tshang ba'i khyad par brjod pa) sdeb sbyor sgra la sbyangaXb ma byas shing / /sum rtags 'jug tshul snyan ngag bsgab pa med/ /bstan bcos rtsom pa'i rgyu tsam ma bskrubs par/ /rig byed bstan bcos 'di ni brtsams byas so/ /(khyad 'phags phul byung )rab dwangs dri med kun rtog rlung g.yos te/ /gtamaX'adi bskrun pa'i 'bras bu'i cha shas ni/ /khyad 'phags mkha' la spyod pa'i mes po yi/ /bsod nams bzhi bo dag gis mtshon ka yin/ /(mang ba'i dpe)de ltar 'bad pa las byung rnam dkar las/ /pad dkar chu shel khaXb dung lta bu/ /gcig tu dkar baXgang zhika bsags pa des/ /dam chos smra ba'i rgyal po thob gyur cig /ces pa ni bar r+ṣa bas kyi chigs su bcadaXpa'o/ /ming mang don gcig brjod pa'i dpe/ /bugaXpa bu ga dmig pu dang / /har mig rnams ni khung bu'i ming / /'bigs dang 'bugs dang 'khug pa 489

dag /khung du rtol bar byed pa'i ming / /ska dang gar ni thug pa ste/ /yon po kyog po gcu bo dang / /'chus po dang ni 'khyog po rnams/ /drang po min pa'i ming la 'jug /yib dang gab dang skungs pa dang / /bag la nyal dang gzha' ba rnams/ /sba ba'i ming du grags pa yin/ /sim dang stem dang zhu 'ju dang / /thim pa rnams ni nub pa'i don/ /rkang lag dam por bcings pa la/ /dkyigs dang bkyigs dang 'khyegs pa dang / /bcigs pa la sogs dpe dag par/ /yod pa mthong bsaXdus gsum la/ /bltos te 'jug skabs yod dam snyam/ /grung bo spyang bo g.yer bag can/ /sgrin poXsgrim po grim poXrnams/ /mkhas pa'am shes rab can la 'jug /gam dang gan dang drung dang ni/ /glo dang logs dang gzhogs dag kyang / /mdun nam nye 'khor nye ba'i ming / /'phyan pa yan pa 'khyaraXb dag /'khyam pa'i ming du skabs 'gar 'jug /brnyan dang brnyas dang bskyis pa rnams/ /g.yar po'i ming la 'jug pa yod/ /bkar dang dgar dang bkol ba dag /logs su bsal ba'i don can no/ /zud dang rid pa sbibs pa dang / /ske rtsong dag ni sha srab cing / /skem pa'i ming la 'jug tu rung / /rum dang pang dang phang dag ni/ /lto ba'i ming la 'jugaXpa yod/ /'drid dang brid dang brngod pa rnams/ /bslu ba'i ming du grags pa yin/ /'ji ba 'jim pa 'dam bag ming / /gcin dang gci ba dri chu'i ming / /bsnyel dang bsgyud pa brjed pa'i ming / /'di ni mtshon tsam smos pa ste/ /de tsam shes 490

pa'ang dkon po yin/ /ma shi'i tshun la thos pa gces/ /ming gi mtha' la zad paXmed/ 1thams cad sus kyang brjod mi nus/ /mngon brjod sogs kyi ming sna tshogs/ /malas pas bshad pa dag la ltos/ /dag yig gces bsdus 'khrul spong legs bshad skya rengs gsar ba las mingaXdu ma don gcig la 'jug tshul dpyod pa'i le'u bcu ba'o/ /smras pa/ (kun phan gyi rgyan) de 'dra zhig kyang rtsom 'dun dar drags pas/ /dpe mang gsog pa'i rtsol sgrub rtsom pa na/ /sngon mthong med pa'i dag yig du ma zhig /stes kyi dbang gis rjes mthun grogs su 'byor/ /(dga' bas 'byurab sgeg pa'i nyams)skyes sbyangs stobasaXlas 'khrungs pa'i dri med kyi/ /rig pas yun ring sbyang 'os rig gzhung 'di/ /thos nyung bdag gis ci dgar rtsom pa ni/ /slob dpon drin las thob pas 'dzum dmul lo/ /(spyi'i bsdus brjod) rgyu skaraXphreng bas rab mdzes ri bong 'dzin/ /nam mkha' mthon por rgyus pa yongs btang nas/ /dwangs pa'i mtsho ru nyal bar gnas so zhes/ /snang brnyan dngos poraX'adzinaXpa byis pa'i blo/ /(bsdus shing ma bsdus pa'i gzugasacan)blo mig mi shes rab rib grib mas g.yogs/ /gzhan gyis zer sgros rdzu bag 'alar bar brten/ /log smra'i g.yang kha 'grim pa'i grogs po dag /mig yangs stob byed gtam bzang 'di bsten rigs/ /(mang ba'i dpe)tshul 'dir spros pa las 'ongs phun tshogs dge /bsil zer can dang pad dkar rtsa ba dang / /dri med mu tig mdangs la 491

'khu ba gang / /bshes gnyen mnyes byed kunaXbazang mchod par dbul/ /(dpe las dpe cad lhag pa'i ldog pa can)blun pos spra yang sde snod 'chad pa dang / /legs bshad rtsom zhing rgol ba tshar gcod min/ /mkhas pa'i bya ba gsum gyis rgyud gtams shing / /dma' sa 'cha' ba'i mkhas rnams 'duXgyur cig /(bya ba ma tshang ba'i khyad par brjod pa)mi bzad rdo ba'i mda' mtshon 'phangs pa med/ /khros pa'i gnyer ma dpral bar ma bsdus shing / /mi sdug nyams kyi 'gyur ba ma bstan par/ /chu srin rgyal mtshan sde las rgyal gyur cig /(gzhi gcig gi chos du ma 'gal ba)rnam mang mkhyen pas phyug kyang rmongs pas dbul/ /lus can brtse bas 'khyud kyang chags pas btang / /pha rol 'joms nus ldan yang mi 'tshe ba'i/ /bshes gnyen dam pas rjes su 'dzin gyur cig /(phreng ba'i gsal byed)bshes gnyen dam pa'i drin las bdag blo rgyas/ /bdag blo rgyas pas gtam snyan 'di spel bas/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa nyams med phyogs su dar/ /des kyang lus can phan bdeX'aphel gyur cig /ces dag yig gces bsdus 'khrul spong legs bshad skya rengs gsaraXb zhes pa 'di ni snga mo nas bsgrigs 'dun yod thog 'gas kyang bskul ma byed pa ltar lha ldan grwa skor ba'i ming can a lag sha'i sa mthar skyes pa'i gyi na pa ngag dbang bstan dar gyis bsgrigs pa'o/ /'dis kyang rgyal bstan rin po che yun ring du rgyasaXpa'i rgyur gyur cig /zhes pa 'di ni sku 'bum byams pa gling du par du bsgrubs pa'o/ /(dag yig 'di ni sku 'bum dgon pa'i shing par gzhir bzung nas bsgrigs pa yin)492

rtsom sgrig 'gan 'khur pa/ mkha' 'gro tshe ring /mdun shog mdzes ris pa tshe gomadun shog gzigs byang pa/ grags pa/dag yig phyogs bsgrigs mu teg tshom bu/༵bye ༵hūṃ /spel/ mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang / (zililda grong khyer thun rin la sgo mang /0)sbrag ang 810001 kha par 6143426brgyudaX'atshong / mtsho sngon zhing chen zhin hwa dpe khang /par 'debs/ mtsho sngon mi rigs par khang /deb tshad/ 850poya 1168yaya 1732dbar shog 15 625yig grangs1 khri 26par bengs/ 1998lo'i zla 8 par par gzhi dang po bsgrigs/dpar thengs/ 2002 lo'i zla 6 par dpar thengs gnyis pa dpar/dpar grangs/ 3 200nga 5 200dpe rtags/ 1④2ya 7—6420—0693—27ma 9rin kob / sgor 14༷ 90par gzhe 'di garaXdabang bas par bshu brgyab na khrims chad phog(shog ngos chad nor slog skyon gang rung yod tshe par khang la dri gtug bya)
